job.title: Audio Production Engineer - On-Call
job.description:
Position Summary:

This On-Call position is responsible for, but not limited to recording, editing and mixing various radio programs (both pre-recorded and live-radio shows) and digital on-demand shows for SCPR/LAist, and working with show producers to produce high quality radio programs and podcast episodes. 

Expected Compensation Range: $31.00 - $33.00 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: On-Site

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibility:

  • Record, edit, mix and master, and maintain audio elements to produce high-quality audio for special radio programs, operating in-studio live radio programs, on-demand programs and remote sound recordings.
  • Transmit live remote programming utilizing POTS and ISDN codecs.  Creative use of microphones, mixing boards and ancillary equipment to insure that the highest audio quality possible is delivered to distribution channels.
  • Act as Technical Director for on-going projects providing quality control for recording, editing, mastering and distribution.
  • Perform studio engineer functions including control board operation; processing audio for Internet distribution; operating CDR duplication equipment.
  • Establish, calibrate and monitor any equipment necessary for radio broadcast, including ISDN lines, signal processing and various broadcast recording formats, as well as audio over IP (AoIP).
  • Prep necessary program material for air and digital platforms, including program sound management, and music supervision.
  • Perform sound recording and postproduction, including sweetening, editing, mixing; also working with voice talents and incorporating SFX.
  • Provide technical support for special programs and SCPR studios, and affiliates through triage and troubleshooting.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in recording engineering OR 5+ years of work experience as a broadcast or recording engineer.
  • 5+ years of work experience in audio: recording, mixing, editing, post production industry, and at least two years experience in the broadcast and podcast industry and working with on-demand shows.
  • Direct experience in troubleshooting complex audio, including editing, sweetening and final mixing for radio programs.
  • Experienced in operating public address systems.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Computer literate with experience using PC and Mac platforms. 
  • Comprehensive working knowledge of broadcast radio operations and program production, including direct experience in engineering for Live-radio and Remotes.
  • Solid working experience in audio systems including mixing consoles, mics, patchbays, routers, signal processing, record/playback machines.
  • Expert fluency in ProTools and other digital audio workstations.
  • High proficiency in post production, editing, mixing, and mastering.
  • Solid experience and knowledge in radio delivery systems including Wide Orbit automation for “on-air” program delivery.
  • Solid understanding of the audio signal flow and sound propagation.
  • Pro-active self-starter –must be highly self-motivated, and able to work independently and perform well under pressure.

Reporting To This Position:    None

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical Demands: 
    • Required to move about in an office environment
    • Reach with hands and arms
    • Balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch
    • Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping
  • Working Conditions: 
    • Moderate noise level
    • Occasional exposure to prevalent weather conditions

LAist (LAist 89.3/LAist.com/LAist Studios) is diverse in race, ethnicity, language, culture, social class, national origin, religious and political belief, age, ability, gender, gender identity, and sexual orientation in addition to other markers protected by law.  

At LAist, we strive to create an inclusive environment where we all feel pride in who we are and what we do. We are encouraged to show up as we are – always embracing and recognizing that our diversity is what brings us together. Our fundamental commitment to diversity:  

  • Enriches LAist and provides an atmosphere in which all human potential is valued 
  • Promotes learning through interactions among people of different backgrounds and many perspectives, and  
  • Enables the organization to prepare all employees to promote social responsibility, equity, freedom, and productive citizenship in a global society 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.   

We are committed to hiring a breadth of diverse professionals and encourage you to apply.

job.title: Data Quality Analyst - Temp
job.description:
Position Summary:

The Data Quality Analyst (Temporary) is responsible for improving the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across the organization’s CRM systems. This role works across multiple systems to identify and resolve data quality issues, standardize and maintain data in alignment with established data governance practices, and support reliable reporting and downstream processes.

This work supports improved reporting accuracy, more effective engagement and outreach efforts, reduced manual processing, and a stronger data foundation to enable scalable operations and future system integrations.

*This is a temporary 3-month role.

Expected Compensation Range: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Remote (see note below)

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled.

Position Responsibility:

  • Identify and evaluate duplicate records using defined matching criteria and business rules.
  • Perform record merges, ensuring preservation of key data such as giving history, contact details, and relationships.
  • Update and standardize constituent data, including names, addresses, email addresses, and other core fields.
  • Review and resolve data inconsistencies, incomplete records, and formatting issues.
  • Execute data cleanup activities in support of broader data quality initiatives and system improvements.
  • Follow established data governance standards and document handling procedures when making updates.
  • Handle Salesforce requests related to record merges, data corrections, and constituent updates.
  • Assist with ongoing data quality efforts, including validation and enrichment processes.

Required Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Minimum 2-year experience with data entry, database management, data cleanup, or other relevant experience.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong aptitude for learning new systems and processes.
  • Ability to independently prioritize multiple tasks and complete work within deadlines.
  • Ability to successfully communicate and work remotely with team members located in different states and time zones.
  • Strong service ethic and the ability to contribute to the overall quality of the Department.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with CRM systems and/or database platforms.
  • Experience with data deduplication, record merging, or data quality initiatives.
  • Familiarity with nonprofit data structures such as households, donors, and relationships.

Reporting To This Position:

None

Location:

  • This role is primarily remote, with the expectation that the individual will come into the office for initial training and occasional in-person sessions to review work and align on data quality efforts.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Physical Demands:

  • Required to sit for extended periods of time
  • Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping

Working Conditions:

  • Moderate noise level

job.title: Fellow, Reverb Video – MPR News
job.description:
Position Information:

  • Start Date: January 4 – December 3, 2027
  • Hours: 40 hours per week
  • Location: St. Paul, MN
  • Pay: $20/hour - $23/hour (salary will be based on individual's education and/or relevant experience)

 

Fellow, Reverb Video – MPR News:

Do you have a sharp eye for stories that shape the lives of younger Minnesotans, and a clear point of view on how to tell them on social platforms? Are you ready to take an idea from pitch to published video with independence and good judgment? Join MPR News as the Reverb Video Fellow, where you'll report, shoot and edit original social video about the people, places and issues that matter to young adults across Minnesota.

As a fellow, you'll work as a contributing member of Reverb, the MPR News social video team. You'll pitch and produce original stories, turn newsroom reporting into platform-native video for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, and spend much of your time in the field gathering interviews and community voices across the state. You'll also have room to develop a recurring series or format of your own, use audience data to sharpen what works, and partner with reporters across the newsroom on coverage. Your work will reach hundreds of thousands of Minnesotans, and you'll leave with a portfolio and professional network that position you for a career in public media.

Reverb is a small team of reporters, producers and an editor who create news for younger and more diverse Minnesotans. We center their perspectives, answer their questions, celebrate them and explore how issues affect them in unique ways. We serve young adults the news how they want it (faster, shorter and scannable) and where they are (on their phones and on social media).

You can see our work at mprnews.org/reverb and on the MPR News TikTok, Instagram and YouTube accounts.

 

Key Learning Goals:

The goal of this fellowship is to provide you with immersive learning and real-world experience through impactful work. By the end of your fellowship, you will be able to:

  • Learn how to develop, pitch and produce platform-native video journalism that meets public media editorial standards
  • Learn how a multi-channel distribution strategy works in practice, including how one story is versioned across broadcast, digital and social platforms and why accessibility practices like captioning matter to reach
  • Gain hands-on experience with the full short-form video workflow, from field shooting through editing and publishing
  • Build skills in mobile and desktop editing tools used by the team
  • Sharpen your news judgment, story framing and understanding of journalism ethics as it applies to social platforms
  • Learn how audience data informs editorial decisions, including how to read platform analytics and benchmark performance
  • Gain a greater understanding of how a social video team operates inside a daily news organization, including how social strategy connects to audience development and membership
  • Learn how to rapidly respond to news and turn video on a tight timeline

 

Responsibilities:

In this fast-paced position, you will:

  • Pitch, shoot, edit and publish short-form vertical video for MPR News social channels, with a focus on stories that resonate with younger and more diverse Minnesota audiences
  • Create and adapt MPR News reporting into platform-native video formats, working with reporters and editors to translate radio and digital stories for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
  • Ensure published video meets accessibility standards, including accurate captions and sound-off-friendly design
  • Assist with field production, including gathering interviews, b-roll and person-on-the-street content at news events and community gatherings
  • Monitor trends, sounds and formats across platforms and bring ideas to Reverb pitch meetings
  • Track performance of published video and contribute observations to the team's analytics reviews
  • Collaborate with journalists across the newsroom, gaining experience in cross-team collaboration

 

Benefits:

  • Eligible to accrue sick time off
  • Eligible for health insurance as required under the ACA
  • Eligible to participate in the APMG retirement plan

 

Programming:

  • Participate in robust on-boarding experience
  • Professional development: on-the-job training, workforce readiness training, formal performance review feedback sessions, etc.
  • Participate in brown bag sessions to gain broader perspective of the organization

 

Required Qualifications:

  • Completed bachelor's degree with at least two years relevant professional work experience in journalism or communications
  • Two years relevant professional work experience in journalism or communications
  • Available full-time (40 hours/week, Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-5 p.m.) throughout the fellowship
  • Knowledge of journalism ethics fundamentals and an understanding of what distinguishes journalism from other social content
  • Demonstrated experience creating short-form video for social platforms (personal, student or professional work all considered)
  • Willingness to conduct in-person interviews and approach members of the public on camera
  • Familiarity with at least one video editing application (mobile or desktop) and willingness to learn others
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts and attention to accuracy
  • Ability to work nights and weekends as assigned

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Self-motivated, resourceful, curious, creative and detail-oriented
  • Past experience in a daily news environment
  • Experience shooting video on both phones and cameras, including audio capture in the field
  • Experience with DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or similar editing software
  • On-camera comfort, including hosting or voicing video
  • Past experience in a daily news environment
  • Familiarity with platform or third-party social analytics tools

 

Next Step in the Application:

In addition to your skills and knowledge, we want to get to know you in the application process. Please include a cover letter (of no more than 1 page) with answers to the following:

  • What interests you about this fellowship?
  • What professional skills would you like to add to your toolbox in the months and years to come to grow in your career field?

 

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform the essential duties of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical Demands:
    • Required to move about in an office environment and sit for extended periods of time.
    • Required to move about in the community.
    • Frequent use of hands for data entry/keystrokes and simple grasping.
  • Working Conditions:
    • Moderate noise level.
    • Occasional exposure to prevalent weather conditions.

 

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We are committed to hiring a breadth of diverse professionals and encourage members of diverse groups to apply.

 

 

MacMillan Internship & Fellowship Program at MPR|APM

Minnesota Public Radio | American Public Media are grateful for the long-time, generous philanthropy of Whitney and Elizabeth MacMillan for investing in the future of public media through transformational internships and fellowships. Their recent grant will significantly strengthen our internship program, produce enriching programming, and prepare the next generation for careers in public media. job.title: Intern, Accounting/Finance
job.description:
Position Information:

  • Start Date: January 4 –June 4, 2027
  • Hours: Open to either 24 or 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday
  • Location: St. Paul, MN
  • Pay: $20/hour

 

Intern, Accounting/Finance

Are you driven by numbers, details, and analysis? Do you want to launch your career in non-proﬁt ﬁnance, but lack the hands-on experience required to land your dream job? This

Accounting/Finance internship provides exposure to the inner workings of ﬁnance and accounting, equipping you with the technical and supporting skills to succeed and grow in your career.

In this role, you’ll support the Finance team to strengthen the organization's ﬁnancial integrity, business processes, and system of internal controls by working on ﬁnancial projects and providing accounting support, insight, and recommendations.

This 22-week internship is offered at 24 or 40 hours per week, based on the candidate's availability.

 

Key Learning Goals:

The goal of this internship is to provide you with immersive learning and real-world experience through impactful work. By the end of your internship, you will be able to:

  • Expand Accounting Fundamentals - Learn the monthly and annual accounting cycle by completing account reconciliations and supporting schedules, accounting entries, and ﬁnancial reports to develop core accounting skills. Leverage technology to improve processes.
  • Participate in internal process improvements - Learn how document and analyze workflows (e.g., internal controls, accounting policies, systems, and procedures) and implement solutions to strengthen the team.
  • Build Critical Skills - Goals will be developed to help you sharpen the soft skills crucial for success like project management, collaboration, and business communications.

We are excited to help you step out of the textbook and into real-world ﬁnance experience!

As the broadcast engineering ﬁeld evolves, we're seeking a curious, tech-savvy intern to master multi-channel platforms, collaborate with teams and stations worldwide, and help innovate the systems that connect communities through public media. job.title: Senior Editor, Watchdog
job.description:
Position Summary:

As senior editor of our watchdog team, you will lead a small team of experienced reporters with the mandate to hold local government and powerful institutions to account. And there’s a lot of ground to cover in Southern California, where cutbacks across the news industry have left much of the region unwatched by journalists.

Because of that, we’re keeping the focus wide: from major L.A. law enforcement agencies to county government to workplace safety and the continuing housing and homelessness crises. The team will include a reporter focused on transportation, two government accountability reporters and additional newsroom resources.

As senior editor, you’ll shape ideas, deepen reporting and look for creative ways to tell stories across multiple platforms: radio, digital, social, video, on-demand and live events. You’ll be an advocate for collaborating with other newsrooms and the communities we cover, and partner directly with LAist’s general assignment and beat reporters as needed.

The senior editor should bring a track record of reporting, writing, and editing in-depth enterprise or investigative stories that reveal wrongdoing and injustice. You should have an interest and aptitude in analyzing data and guiding others on public records requests. This will be a quick-paced team with a goal of producing no fewer than 12 stories each month.

LAist is a leading practitioner of engaged journalism. We believe engaging with our audience throughout the reporting process can result in coverage that better reflects and listens to the concerns of our audience. We also believe community members know things that can lead us to groundbreaking work if we’re talking with them regularly.

LAist reporters and editors work closely together and highly value collegiality and a sense of humor, especially under pressure.

Please include a cover letter that links to your best work and describes the role you played in that work, what you learned along the way, and what you’d bring with you to the LAist newsroom.

Expected Compensation Range: $120,000 - $124,000 per year. The exact salary rate is determined by experience and education related to the role, organizational compensation structure, and internal equity.

Location: Hybrid, Pasadena, CA

Application Process: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Application Deadline: Open until filled. 

Position Responsibility:

  • Oversee high-impact investigations and daily enterprise reporting that betters the lives of Southern Californians, producing 12 stories or more per month from your team.
  • Develop and execute cross-platform strategies for your assigned beats that reflect LAist’s mission to deliver distinctive and unique content to our audiences.
  • Work with the engagement team to learn and uphold best practices for creating content that emphasizes an audience-first approach.

job.title: Licensing Senior Account Manager
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Licensing Senior Account Manager is responsible for driving new business and growing revenue by effectively communicating the need for and the benefits of an ASCAP license agreement to prospective new customers, closing deals with such customers as well as maintaining account relationships and concluding renewal deals with existing customers.

The Licensing Senior Account Manager will communicate and collaborate with the Senior and Associate Directors, SVPs and work cross-functionally with others within the Licensing Department (e.g., Operations, Reactive, Customer Service). Additionally, they will work closely with other departments such as Business and Legal Affairs, Revenue Accounting, Distribution, and Global Technology Solutions.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Identify, assess, and drive licensing efforts by generating and converting leads into both new license prospects and “click-through” licensees
  • Negotiate with select prospective new customers, answering questions, following up and remaining engaged until deal closure
  • Manage select accounts by answering customer queries, resolving issues and pursuing outstanding items
  • Develop, maintain and strengthen relationships among licensee accounts
  • Escalate matters/issues to senior team members when prescribed processes meet impediments and/or when otherwise necessary or appropriate
  • Perform as the backup to the Licensing Business Analyst, gathering and disseminating news and business intelligence to ASCAP leadership when they are not available

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; music industry studies a plus
  • Ability to work independently with guidance from senior team members
  • A minimum of three years of sales, business development and/or customer service experience, preferably in the music and/or media industry
  • Ability to effectively engage in revenue-generating activities to contribute to ASCAP’s revenue goals
  • Ability to clearly and concisely explain detailed subject matter (i.e. ASCAP and the need/benefits of an ASCAP license) to prospective customers
  • Knowledge of music/copyright, entertainment and technology industries preferred
  • Ability to foresee and stay apprised of new licensing opportunities (i.e. products, services, platforms), particularly those utilizing new/emerging technologies, and the ability to synthesize this information into high-quality formats (emails, reports, PowerPoint) for presentation to senior management
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and/or other CRMs preferred
  • Ability to work cross-functionally on multi-faceted projects
  • Ability to take direction and self-motivate; drive to master core responsibilities and to help a team maximize production and achieve goals
  • Excellent organizational, verbal and written communication skills; professional demeanor; ability to interact effectively with all levels of management and external personnel
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines under pressure
  • Proven ability to multitask, assess and shift priorities around as needed
  • Ability to work well both individually and on a team while sharing pertinent information, supporting colleagues, and encouraging participation
  • This position requires three days per week in the New York office

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy
  • Health care and dependent care flexible spending accounts
  • Short-term disability insurance/salary continuation and long-term disability insurance
  • Company provided basic life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance
  • Employee gym discounts at select gyms
  • Commuter benefits
  • Voluntary pet health insurance
  • Voluntary auto and homeowner’s insurance
  • Voluntary employee, spouse, and dependent life insurance options
  • Voluntary ID protection Coverage

The above summary of the current benefits is subject to the terms and conditions of the benefit plan documents. This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. Please note that ASCAP reserves the right to amend or otherwise revise or terminate, at any time and in its sole discretion, its benefit plans, programs, and policies.

Occasional travel for in-person meetings may be required.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $80,000 to $87,000 and will be determined on an individualized basis depending on several factors that are unique to each candidate including geographic location (due to differences in the cost of labor), skills, education and prior relevant experience.

Job Overview:

The Senior Business & Legal Affairs Coordinator is responsible for documenting and recordkeeping agreements between ASCAP and its Members, along with other related tasks. job.title: Consumer Product Strategist
job.description:
The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

The Associated Press seeks a Consumer Product Strategist for AP News based in New York City. We are a hybrid environment, with employees on site Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.  

  

About the Role  

As a Consumer Product Strategist, you will help AP News better understand its audience and use those insights to shape the future of our digital products and user experience. You will look beyond the numbers to uncover the story of how users discover, experience and engage across web and app platforms, turning those findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy, experimentation and long-term growth.  

 

This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, product strategy and analytics. The ideal candidate is naturally curious about consumers, comfortable digging into data and skilled at communicating what the data means with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  

  

What You'll Do: 

  • Analyze how audiences discover, navigate and engage with AP News by building repeatable analyses and dashboards in BigQuery, Looker, Omni and Hex to identify patterns in user behavior, feature adoption, engagement and friction points 

  • Connect behavioral data across journeys, funnels, features and retention to explain not just what is happening, but why 

  • Support tracking implementation in Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager to ensure the right data is captured to answer critical product and business questions  

  • Translate complex product and user data into clear recommendations that inform product priorities, audience growth and monetization decisions  

  • Identify strategic opportunities to improve user journeys, feature design and engagement funnels to deepen loyalty   

  • Development and evaluate product experiments and A/B tests, turning results into actionable product recommendations  

  • Build trusted relationships across product, editorial and technical teams to bring consumer insights into product decisions 

  • Translate business questions into meaningful analysis and clearly communicate what the data means  

  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data infrastructure supports critical decisions 

  

Who You Are:  

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in digital product analytics, product strategy, growth analytics, audience insights, user analytics or a related role  

  • You have a bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as communications, journalism, Data Science, Marketing or equivalent professional experience 

  • You communicate effectively and are a strong storyteller who can take complex or ambiguous data and turn it into a clear narrative about consumers, products and business opportunities 

  • You have demonstrated ability to analyze user behavior, product performance and using those insights to influence product or business decisions 

  • You bring curiosity, consumer empathy and sound judgment to open-ended questions and are comfortable making recommendations  

  • You have strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for querying large datasets, identifying trends and building repeatable analyses  

  • You have hands-on experience with analytics and visualization tools such as BigQuery, Hex, Omni and Looker

  • You have experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, including event tracking and measurement strategy  

  • You are comfortable collaborating with product managers, engineers, editorial teams and other cross-functional stakeholders 

 

What will set you apart:  

  • Experience using consumer insights to influence the strategy or development of a digital consumer product 

  • Experience in digital publishing, media subscription, marketplace or other content-driven consumer products  

  • Background working with BigQuery or other large-scale data warehousing platforms  

  • Familiarity with content recommendation systems or personalization strategies  

  • Experience with experimental design and A/B testing platforms  

  

  

Why join us:  

  • A mission-driven, inclusive environment focused on both individual and collective success.   

  • Opportunities for professional development to help you reach your career goals.   

  • Access to tools, mentorship, and resources tailored to elevate your proficiency and contributions.      

  

The anticipated salary range for this position is $103,000 – $128,000, based on a candidate’s skills and qualifications. The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:      

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage      

  • Retirement benefits      

  • Company paid life insurance      

  • Paid vacation and sick days      

  • Paid parental leave for any new parent      

  • Mental well-being resources      

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, status as a veteran, or other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Director, Newsroom Communications
job.description:
Company Overview

The Associated Press is an independent global news organization dedicated to factual reporting. Founded in 1846, AP today remains the most trusted source of fast, accurate, unbiased news in all formats and the essential provider of the technology and services vital to the news business. More than half the world's population sees AP journalism every day.

 

Role Overview

AP seeks a strategic, collaborative and highly skilled communications professional to serve as Director of Newsroom Communications. Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, this person will shape how AP communicates about its newsroom internally and externally, strengthening the organization and public's understanding of AP’s journalism, mission, standards and newsroom priorities among staff, media, customers, partners and other key audiences.    

 

The Director will develop global communications strategies and materials that strengthen employee connection, elevate distinctive AP journalism, support newsroom leaders and help prepare the organization for sensitive or high-profile issues. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of the news industry and is both a strategist and a hands-on operator: someone who can advise senior newsroom leaders, write staff notes with precision, pitch media, support internal programming, and move quickly in a demanding global news environment.    

 

This position is part of AP’s Corporate Communications team and will work closely with newsroom leadership, journalists, communications colleagues and other partners across the organization.

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute communications plans that support AP’s newsroom priorities, elevate distinctive journalism and reinforce AP’s reputation for accuracy, independence and nonpartisanship.   
  • Write clear, compelling and audience-appropriate materials for internal and external use, including staff notes, internal announcements, talking points, speeches, briefing materials, media pitches, executive messages and announcements.   
  • Serve as a trusted communications partner to newsroom leaders, helping them communicate clearly with staff, explain priorities, support change and recognize work across AP’s global newsroom, while navigating the considerations of a global and partially unionized workforce.  
  • Identify strong AP journalism and newsroom initiatives that merit broader visibility, then work with the wider communications team to amplify across earned media, owned channels, internal platforms, events and executive visibility opportunities.   
  • Support rapid response and issues management by monitoring risks, preparing messaging, coordinating with legal, human resources and editorial partners, and helping AP respond consistently and responsibly to sensitive matters.  
  • Strengthen newsroom culture and connection by shaping internal programming, editorial calendars, staff-facing updates and communications that make important information timely, accessible and useful. 

 

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 10+ years of communications experience in a large, complex organization, including experience developing communications strategies, advising leaders and managing both external and internal communications. 5+ years of experience working for a news organization is required.
  • Impeccable writing, with the ability to express ideas clearly, succinctly and compellingly for a range of audiences and channels. 
  • Demonstrated experience forging consensus among varied stakeholder groups.
  • Media fluency, with a strong understanding of the news industry, the broader media landscape, and how to identify opportunities to elevate AP journalism. 
  • Experience communicating in a unionized environment, particularly the U.S. and/or the U.K.
  • Experience working with broadcast bookers, producers and media  
  • Understanding and belief in the value of AP’s nonpartisan journalism 

 

Education

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience 

 

Work Location

This position is based in New York City and follows a hybrid work model.

 

Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated salary range for this position is $140,000 to $150,000, based on the candidate’s skills and qualifications.

The Associated Press offers comprehensive benefits, which include:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage.
  • Retirement benefits.
  • Company-paid life insurance.
  • Paid vacation and sick days.
  • Paid parental leave for any new parent.
  • Mental well-being resources.

 

Application Deadline is October 19th at 11:59PM ET. 

 

Inclusion & Diversity

AP seeks to build an inclusive organization grounded in respect for differences. We support all aspects of diversity and provide equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or status as a veteran. We encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Account Executive

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Director of Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Atlanta, GA 

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

This is an evergreen posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a roster of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

 

Overview:

Audacy Atlanta is looking for a dynamic sales professional who is truly one of the BEST. You will have the opportunity to represent a multi-media, multi-platform portfolio that includes exceptional over-the-air brands, streaming, the second largest podcast network in the world, extensive digital marketing assets including OTT, unique sponsorship opportunities, an e-commerce platform and original content (video/audio). Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell campaigns beyond Houston through Audacy’s extensive national footprint.

 

If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

Competitive base salary plus commission and bonus opportunities, including additional earning potential beyond quota attainment

The opportunity to bring creative marketing ideas to life and see the impact they have on your clients' businesses

  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, client meetings and events

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who is driven to win and motivated/disciplined to build something of their own.

 

You may be a media salesperson already, or you may come from another sales environment. What matters most is your ability to prospect, build relationships, understand business needs, present solutions and close.

 

Our ideal candidate is:

 

  • A proven hunter who enjoys developing new business
  • Self-disciplined and comfortable creating their own opportunities
  • Confident communicating and presenting to business owners and decision-makers
  • Curious and willing to ask questions to uncover client needs
  • Creative and able to think beyond a traditional advertising solution
  • Persistent and resilient when faced with rejection or obstacles
  • Organized and able to manage multiple clients and opportunities
  • Competitive and motivated by achieving and exceeding goals
  • Comfortable working independently while being a strong team player
  • Someone who takes ownership of their business and their results
  • Experienced in media, advertising, sponsorship, digital or another consultative sales environment preferred

 

Qualifications

 

  • Proven track record of success in sales, preferably new-business development
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to manage the full sales process from prospecting through close
  • Comfortable using CRM and standard Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to learn and confidently present new products and marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

 

The Bottom Line

 

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

  • Experience selling media, advertising, digital marketing or sponsorships; integrated sales experience is preferred.

  • Big Earnings Potential: Solid $75,000-$100,000 base salary with an uncapped commission structure that heavily rewards new business growth.

  • Opening Doors: Proactively identifying, researching, and pitching new business prospects across the Bay Area and beyond.
  • Strategic Problem-Solving: Connecting with local business owners, understanding their real pain points, and building custom, multi-channel media solutions that deliver results.
  • Owning Your Pipeline: Managing your sales cycle from initial outreach to campaign execution to stay connected to your clients’ results and renewals.
  • Hit & Exceed Goals: Staying driven to hit your revenue targets and grow your own income.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

  • The Pitch & Prospect Mindset: You enjoy business development. Cold calling, networking, and creating opportunities from scratch energizes you.
  • Track Record: 2–5+ years of experience in media sales, B2B sales, or digital advertising.
  • Big-Picture Thinker: You know how to weave over-the-air audio, streaming, and targeted digital tactics into a single pitch that makes sense to a CEO or Marketing Director.
  • Tech-Fluent: Comfortable working with CRM tools (Salesforce), Google Suite, and other sales tools.
  • Bay Area Native or Transplant: Ability to work from our San Francisco office with some remote flexibility.
  • Essentials: A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Perks & Culture:

  • Uncapped Earnings: Base salary + aggressive commission structure.
  • Flexible Time Away (FTA): We trust you to manage your time, pitch hard, and reset when you need to.
  • Solid Benefits: Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and 401(k) plans.
  • Culture: A collaborative, fast-moving, and supportive group that values fresh ideas and celebrates wins together.

Ready to Build Something Big?

If you're ready to take ownership of your earning potential and bring fresh energy to the Bay Area media landscape, apply today.

Overview:

Audacy’s Enterprise Team is looking to add to our Account Manager team. The Account Manager role is responsible for quarterbacking the post-sale process once a campaign has been sold, as well as helping strategize what we’re going to market with from a pre-sale perspective. The Account Manager oversees the entire Sales process, from the point of RFP to the final wrap report and must be familiar with each part in the process to ensure we’re going to market with the best service possible. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional client-facing skills, have a thorough understanding of marketing and integrated media channels, and be able to lead large-scale campaigns from start to finish while being the main point of contact for Audacy. You will have a knack for communicating efficiently and effectively under pressure to both internally & externally, and the detail orientation skills to ensure that the client’s needs are met.

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Quarterback internal strategy calls to ensure we’re providing our best recommendations.
  • Lead conversations with internal creative and execution teams to ensure client expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Provide “white glove” client service to advertisers through great communication and properly setting expectations.
  • Quarterback Internal & External pre-sale/post-sale Kickoff Calls
  • Work with Marketing to create in-depth detailed wrap reports, calling out prominent metrics to keep the client satisfied
  • Work closely with the Campaign Management team to ensure that we’re delivering well, or optimizing with the goal of delivering in full.
  • Manage all post-sale correspondence with the client and creative stakeholders.
  • Monitor and convey recording timelines and manage expectations for closed campaigns.
  • Present campaign performance reports including delivery, optimizations, insights, and program recommendations including mid-campaign and wrap reports
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on your client, and track anything that could result in risk
  • Work with planning on re-allocations while being cognizant of what the client is and is not interested in.
  • Communicate effectively with Podcast Partner Management to manage custom facets of campaigns and ensure we’re keeping to timeline.
  • Vet & monitor the podcast vetting portal to ensure we have approvals to run in shows at the point of sale

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum 2 years working with a media company, digital agency, or integrated media sales position, preferably in a client-facing capacity.
  • Basic understanding of digital advertising strategy and measurement is preferred.
  • Problem solver and solution-oriented thinker with great organizational skills.
  • Public speaking skills and ability to lead a room
  • Skilled at interpreting data to properly position sellback metrics.
  • A background working with and leading communication with internal teams
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented work environment
  • Exceptional communication and writing skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

Reporting To: Manager, Attribution (Digital Revenue Operations)

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Open (Eastern Time Zone Preferred)

 

Work Arrangement: Remote

 

Pay Transparency: 

The anticipated starting salary range is $60,000-68,000/yr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Overview:

The Attribution and Data Services team plays a critical role within Audacy’s revenue team by providing measurement and insights to demonstrate the impact of advertising campaigns to our clients. We are an enthusiastic and dynamic team focused on guiding business decisions through accurate, relevant, and timely data, analytics and insights. The team is highly entrepreneurial, and is working fast and smart to solve challenges within the fast-growing Audio space in new and innovative ways.

The team is growing and we are seeking an Analyst of Client Solutions who will be responsible for the execution of our Digital Attribution suite of products. Audacy offers a portfolio of attribution solutions to meet client needs, which include traditional pixel-based digital measurement, innovative solutions for podcast measurement, foot-traffic attribution, and brand lift studies. Analysts on our team are responsible for supporting execution of these campaigns to meet our clients’ needs.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Experience working with Digital Media in either a Planning, Campaign Management or Operations role is required.
  • Partner closely with our sales teams and vendors to design, implement and deliver advertising campaign measurement projects
  • Work with the Digital Ad Operations Team to properly structure ad campaigns for measurement and implement tracking pixels.
  • Support local sales teams and their clients on tag implementation on the clients’ own websites, typically using Google Tag Manager
  • Help with analyzing and interpreting campaign performance reports – craft a story from the data to help non-technical stake-holders understand and have confidence in the result
  • Scope out measurement and research projects, and manage our vendor relationships to ensure productive business partnerships
  • Create scalable, innovative approaches to managing and analyzing campaign performance data to solve challenging business problems
  • Keep abreast of current analytics trends, especially those pertaining to attribution. Introduce and help vet innovative techniques and vendors that will give Audacy a competitive advantage
  • Perform other related duties as required or assigned that contribute to the effectiveness of the department and to accomplish strategic goals and objectives.

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or Digital Marketing
  • Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Adobe, or other digital tracking technologies
  • 1-3 years of related work experience
  • Strong analytical mind and curiosity. Is skilled at digging into data to assess results and key takeaways to leverage for continuous optimization.
  • Strong analytical competencies such as ability to formulate an analytical problem; QC data and results; summarize key findings/insights; make actionable recommendations
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, strong attention to detail and can skillfully manage several complex projects with multiple moving parts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Effective listener.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills. Strong personal integrity
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture

This is more than a sales role—it's an opportunity to become a trusted marketing consultant, helping businesses navigate today's evolving digital landscape while building a rewarding career with an industry leader.

 

If you're energized by prospecting, passionate about digital marketing, and motivated by uncapped earning potential, Audacy provides the tools, training, partnerships, and support to help you succeed.

  • Proven Sales Success: 4+ years of digital media or advertising sales experience with a track record of winning new business and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Hunter Mentality: You thrive on prospecting, opening doors, and building a pipeline from the ground up.

Department: Digital

 

Reporting To: Senior Digital Content Lead

 

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

Location: Buffalo, NY

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

  Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $16.00/hr - $20.00/hr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

We are looking for a highly motivated, creative, and versatile audio and video producer who can identify the best moments, viral content, and news to drive user engagement, downloads, and listening. The ideal candidate has a sharp instinct for what both passionate and more casual fans will engage with, balanced with a mastery of best production practices -- isolating news-making segments and optimizing titles and descriptions. Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to bridge the UX gap between our over-the-air product and web/app streaming platforms.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Manage daily (M-F) live video stream
  • Leverage over-the-air content into short and long-form podcast clips and VOD content
  • Use creative headline copy and tagging concepts to help build customized user experiences to drive downloads and “superfans” (consistent users)
  • Produce and publish “Best of” episodes by compiling the top segments from the show each week
  • Work with central digital and local-market staff on workflow for optimizing top content clips (e.g. isolating exclusive interviews)
  • Help activate around breaking news by quickly getting reaction content onto user platforms
  • Partner with local staff to maximize Audacy’s ‘chaptering’ experience
  • Contributing topics and ideas for the show

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of audio production/editing experience
  • Proficient with Adobe Audition and video editing software
  • Experience with content management systems preferred
  • Experience with VMIX, OBS, and/ or Tricaster preferred
  • Sports knowledge, including current and historical figures and storylines
  • Strong writing and editorial skills and the ability to drive engagement for both local and national audiences
  • Strong news judgment, including the ability to make real-time judgments and react independently around breaking/viral audio

Audacy has an exciting digital division focused on providing local and regional businesses best-in-class solutions designed to help them aggressively compete across the web.  Candidates for the Digital Sales Manager must have sales experience in the digital space and be able to step in and drive the company's revenue.  The candidate must be able to demonstrate a strong understanding and history of new business development, lead generation, pipeline management and management of teams.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Digital Sales Specialist

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: Digital Sales Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Austin, TX

 

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

 

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a Digital Sales Specialist to spearhead revenue growth through the strategic adoption of our comprehensive digital portfolio. This is a consultative sales support role with client-facing interaction. The role is designed for a candidate with technical and strategic digital knowledge who does not just help sell "products," rather moves our sales team to create comprehensive multi-channel digital strategies tailored to a client’s business objectives.

 

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the digital landscape — customizing campaigns that bridge top-of-funnel awareness tactics (such as OTT and Digital Audio) with high-intent, bottom-of-funnel conversion tactics (such as Search), including conversion tracking best practices. You will act as a strategic advisor to both our internal local sales team and our valuable clients.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with account executives to identify and generate digital sales opportunities.
  • Collect and analyze digital marketing performance data, including client-specific metrics and consumer behavior trends.
  • Conduct needs analysis and present strategic recommendations to clients through in-person and virtual meetings.
  • Develop and present customized digital advertising solutions—including Search, OTT/Video, Display, Digital Audio, and Social Media—to deliver impactful client results.
  • Monitor and optimize active campaigns by analyzing performance metrics to improve efficiency and results.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to both internal sales teams and clients, fostering strong, collaborative relationships.
  • Strategic thinking, a flexible mindset, and problem solving skills are critical to success in this role. 
  • Maintain an active role in consistently driving digital revenue growth through sales activity.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bilingual preferred.
  • 2+ years sales related experience preferred.
  • 2+ years digital marketing experience preferred.
  • College Degree preferred but not required.
  • Proven success in building client marketing campaigns by utilizing digital platforms (Search, Social, Display, Video, and Audio).
  • Thorough understanding of digital advertising, multi-channel strategies, and customer-centric success metrics.
  • A creative, flexible mindset in creating custom multi-channel campaigns focused on solving client stated needs.
  • Strong problem solving skills - you’re someone who identifies a problem as an opportunity to develop business.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and MS Office Suite (specifically Excel and PowerPoint for data visualization). 
  • Must be self-motivated, self-disciplined, have a positive attitude and be an effective communicator.

Audacy Chicago is looking for a passionate and inspirational leader to join the Sales Management Team. This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished Sales Manager or Senior Account Executive who has management aspirations to move to the next level in a top market!

 

In this role, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate colleagues and with a high-achieving culture, committed to delivering results, marketing excellence and unwavering customer service. Best of all, you’ll receive best-in-class training, incentives and benefits from Audacy, a scaled, multi-platform audio content and entertainment organization with the country’s best radio broadcasting group. We are industry leaders in broadcasting, podcasting, digital, live experiences, and more!

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Executive Producer - The Chris & Amy Show

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): St. Louis, M.O

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

KMOX Radio, the legendary Voice of St. Louis, is looking for a modern, creative and digitally savvy Executive Producer to help take The Chris & Amy Show to the next level. We're looking for someone who understands that a great show can live far beyond the radio clock — on YouTube, social media, podcasts, video, digital platforms and wherever St. Louis audiences consume content. The Executive Producer will oversee the show's daily content strategy, preparation and execution while helping expand The Chris & Amy Show into a multi-platform St. Louis media brand. You'll work closely with Chris and Amy to develop ideas, create compelling conversations, find great guests and stories, and turn the best moments from the show into content that can reach new audiences. You should have a great ear for radio — but you should also have a great eye for content.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop the daily content strategy and show rundown with Chris and Amy.
  • Identify the stories, conversations and personalities that will drive the show.
  • Create original features, recurring benchmarks, games, bits and listener-driven content.
  • Research for interviews, conversations and major topics.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the show more entertaining, surprising, relevant and local.
  • Running a live radio board and executing a show in real time.
  • Understanding clocks, formats, commercial breaks and station logs.
  • Editing and producing audio quickly and cleanly.
  • Booking and preparing guests.
  • Writing compelling intros, teases, promos and digital copy.
  • Managing live callers, interviews and breaking content.
  • Working with newsroom, traffic, weather and other station resources.
  • Making quick decisions when the show doesn't go according to plan.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

But you also need to think beyond radio.

We're looking for someone who understands that the best moments on The Chris & Amy Show shouldn't end when the microphone is turned off.

You should be able to identify an on-air conversation and immediately see its potential as:

  • A YouTube video.
  • A short-form video.
  • A podcast segment.
  • A social clip.
  • A behind-the-scenes piece.
  • A digital-only conversation.
  • A community or live event opportunity.

The goal is not simply to produce a better radio show.  The goal is to build a bigger Chris & Amy audience — on the radio and everywhere else people consume content.

Expand the show beyond radio

  • Develop a daily content strategy that extends the show across YouTube, video, social media, podcasts and digital platforms.
  • Identify moments during the live show that have the potential to become compelling digital content.
  • Think proactively about content that should be created specifically for digital audiences.
  • Develop short-form video, social clips, interviews, behind-the-scenes content and other original digital features.

The ideal candidate is:

  • An experienced radio producer with a modern content mindset.
  • A strong writer and storyteller.
  • Someone who understands personality-driven radio.
  • Highly knowledgeable about digital video, social media and audience growth.
  • Comfortable creating and editing short-form video and digital content.
  • Someone who understands platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook and knows that each platform requires a different approach.
  • Highly organized but not afraid to throw out the rundown when a great idea comes along.
  • Curious about culture, entertainment, sports, news and — most importantly — St. Louis.
  • Comfortable working with strong personalities.
  • An idea generator who is constantly thinking about "What more can I do?"

Important Notes:

Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

Audacy is seeking a Manager of Legal Operations & Strategic Projects to serve as the lead for strategic projects and manage workflows and documents across our legal department. This role will serve as the central driver for all legal department initiatives and projects, while maintaining a high standard for document organization, retrieval, and life-cycle contract management.

 

The ideal candidate brings a strong project management background (preferably within the legal and/or broadcast media landscape). You will keep key transactions and departmental projects running seamlessly, while maintaining effective contract management, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and driving strategic legal initiatives to support overall organizational growth and efficiency.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Lead legal operations and  department initiatives and manage and execute legal department projects.
  • Lead project management for multi-faceted transactions (e.g., M&A and financings), including efficiently organizing complex contracts into virtual data rooms for internal and external stakeholders, coordinating cross-functional due diligence streams and responses to counterparty diligence requests, building and maintaining project management tools and trackers to monitor diligence requests and pre- and post-closing matters; maintaining closing conditions checklists, tracking corporate approvals (board resolutions, shareholder consents), overseeing legal document execution and escrow mechanics, securing third party consents, managing closing exchanges, and compiling closing binders.

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert on document and storage management, contract retrieval, leveraging a strong understanding of contracts and key terms in order to accurately organize, classify, and audit documents for internal searchability. 
  • Manage administration of contract-related resources and collaboration tools, including but not limited to iManage, DocMinder, and physical files and related licenses.  
  • Draft agreements and notices using templates, as well as disclosure schedules for M&A transactions, in each case with attorney oversight.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Senior Digital Content Producer

 

Employment Type: Part-Time

 

Location: Philadelphia, PA

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

  Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $16.00/hr - $20.00/hr. Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity. Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

 

A highly motivated, creative, and versatile audio and video producer who can identify the best moments, viral content, and news to drive user engagement, downloads, and listening. The ideal candidate has a sharp instinct for what both passionate and more casual fans will engage with, balanced with a mastery of best production practices -- isolating news-making segments and optimizing titles and descriptions. Must thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to bridge the UX gap between our over-the-air product and web/app streaming platforms.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Manage daily (M-F) live video stream
  • Leverage over-the-air content into short and long-form podcast clips and VOD content
  • Use creative headline copy and tagging concepts to help build customized user experiences to drive downloads and “superfans” (consistent users)
  • Produce and publish “Best of” episodes by compiling the top segments from the show each week
  • Work with central digital and local-market staff on workflow for optimizing top content clips (e.g. isolating exclusive interviews)
  • Help activate around breaking news by quickly getting reaction content onto user platforms
  • Partner with local staff to maximize Audacy’s ‘chaptering’ experience
  • Contributing topics and ideas for the show

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of audio production/editing experience
  • Proficient with Adobe Audition and video editing software
  • Experience with content management systems preferred
  • Experience with VMIX, OBS, and/ or Tricaster preferred
  • Sports knowledge, including current and historical figures and storylines
  • Strong writing and editorial skills and the ability to drive engagement for both local and national audiences
  • Strong news judgment, including the ability to make real-time judgments and react independently around breaking/viral audio
