The ideal candidate is funny, creative, and plugged into pop culture, entertainment, and current digital trends. This role combines social media management, video production and editing, content creation, livestream production, audience engagement, and digital marketing. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of what makes content perform across platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and X, with the ability to turn moments from the show into compelling, shareable digital content. This is an in-office position requiring five days per week at the Anna & Raven headquarters in Milford, CT. Essential Duties &

Responsibilities

Manage the Anna & Raven Show’s social media presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, X, and other relevant platforms. Develop and maintain daily and weekly social media content calendars. Monitor social media trends, audience conversations, comments, messages, memes, sounds, and emerging platforms to identify opportunities for content growth. Watch and listen to the daily show to identify funny, emotional, timely, viral, or otherwise highly shareable moments. Develop real-time content opportunities based on breaking news, pop culture, viral trends, and conversations happening on the show. Write engaging captions, headlines, hooks, calls-to-action, and other social copy designed to capture attention and drive engagement. Produce and distribute a weekly Anna & Raven Show e-newsletter designed to increase audience engagement and drive listeners back to the show’s digital content. Track content performance and audience engagement to identify opportunities for growth and improve future content. job.title: Street Team & Board Operator (Part-Time)
job.description:
Connoisseur Media – Amarillo, TX Love live events, great music, sports, and radio? Want to be part of the team behind some of Amarillo's most recognized radio brands? Connoisseur Media Amarillo is looking for an energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic Part-Time Street Team & Board Operator to help bring our stations to life both on the air and in the community. Represent KGNC 97.9 (KGNC-FM), 100.9 The Eagle (KXGL-FM), 102.9 The Rattler (KVWE-FM), and NewsTalk 710 & 97.5 KGNC (KGNC-AM) at concerts, festivals, live broadcasts, sporting events, and community appearances while also helping keep our stations sounding their best behind the scenes. No two days are the same! One day you could be hosting games and giveaways at a concert, and the next you could be running a live sports broadcast or operating the control board during a live show. If you're outgoing, love working with people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and have a passion for radio and live entertainment, we'd love to meet you!

What You'll Do

Represent our stations at live broadcasts, concerts, festivals, sporting events, and community events. Set up and tear down promotional equipment, including tents, banners, sound systems, tables, and displays. Engage listeners through contests, prize wheels, games, giveaways, and on-site promotions. Make announcements using microphones and PA systems while creating an exciting event atmosphere. Drive station vehicles and transport promotional equipment to and from events. Operate the on-air control board for live and syndicated programming. Run live sports broadcasts, programming, commercials, and station breaks with accuracy. Monitor automation systems, transmitters, and studio equipment to ensure smooth broadcasts. Maintain broadcast logs and accurately report discrepancies. Follow FCC regulations, EAS procedures, and station operating standards. Communicate effectively with station management regarding technical or programming concerns. Work collaboratively with promotions, programming, sales, and engineering teams. Perform other duties as assigned. What We're Looking For Positive, energetic personality with excellent customer service skills. Strong communication skills and the confidence to interact with listeners, clients, and coworkers. Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently or as part of a team. Comfortable working outdoors and in varying weather conditions. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds and assist with event setup and teardown. Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and occasional last-minute shifts. Valid driver's license and current auto insurance. Must be able to drive a company vehicle. Must be at least 18 years old (21+ preferred for events where alcohol is served).

Preferred Qualifications

Previous

experience

in radio, promotions, live events, sports broadcasting, or media.

Experience

operating radio automation systems such as Marketron or similar software. Familiarity with FCC rules and EAS requirements.

Experience

with social media platforms, WordPress, or digital content creation. Passion for music, sports, entertainment, and connecting with the local community. This is a part-time position averaging 10–15 hours per week, with additional hours available during busy event seasons and special programming opportunities. If you're looking for a fun, hands-on opportunity to break into broadcasting while representing some of Amarillo's favorite radio stations, we encourage you to apply!

job.title: Traffic Coordinator (Bay Area)
job.description:
Connoisseur Media is seeking a highly organized, detail-driven Traffic Continuity Coordinator to play a vital role in the success of our broadcast and digital advertising operations. This position will be in the office located in the Bay Area of California. This position sits at the intersection of programming, sales, and revenue, ensuring that premium advertising inventory is managed with precision, accuracy, and care across multiple radio stations. As a key member of our operations team, the Traffic Continuity Coordinator helps keep everything running smoothly—meeting tight deadlines, maintaining flawless logs, and supporting both internal teams and clients with reliable, timely information. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, stays calm under pressure, and takes pride in getting the details right the first time. You’ll collaborate closely with programming and management, use industry-leading tools to manage commercial activity, and contribute directly to the financial performance of the stations. If you enjoy a role where accuracy matters, teamwork is valued, and your behind-the-scenes expertise makes a visible impact every day, you’ll feel right at home at Connoisseur Media. What you need to do to be successful in this position: Prepare and Manage Program Logs: Accurately prepare daily program logs for one or more of our five radio stations, ensuring precision and adherence to strict deadlines. Schedule and Process Commercials: Efficiently schedule radio commercials and process commercial contracts on a daily basis. Provide Inventory Insights: Supply station management with accurate and up-to-date advertising inventory information. Collaborate on Programming: Work closely with station programmers to ensure hourly clocks are accurate and current on all program logs. Reconcile Daily Logs: Reconcile daily program logs for assigned radio stations, verifying all scheduled content aired correctly. Generate Reports: Prepare various reports for station management as needed, providing valuable insights into our traffic operations. Manage Commercial Copy as needed: Process and schedule commercial copy, ensuring all ad materials are ready for air. Utilize Industry Tools: Work with third-party service, programming, and spot providers such as Wide Orbit, Mr. Master, vCreative, or other industry networks. Support Team Operations: Perform other duties consistent with the position to ensure smooth and efficient traffic operations. What you need to bring:

Experience

At least three years Eagle Eye: Legendary attention to detail is legendary. Nothing gets past you! Withstand Pressure? What Pressure? Deadlines? No sweat! You stay cool, calm, and collected, even when things are hectic. Be a Solo Star: You can totally crush tasks on your own without needing constant hand-holding. Problem Solver Pro: You're quick to spot a snag and even quicker to flag it so we can fix it. Keyboard Ninja: You're a data entry whiz – fast and accurate. Tech Savvy: Picking up new software is a breeze for you. Preference may be given to candidates who meet the above requirements plus have the following:

Experience

working with WideOrbit and/or vCreative traffic software. Working knowledge of spreadsheet and word processing applications.

Package: Medical, Dental, and Vision. Supplement Life Insurance, AD&D Coverage, STD, and LTD coverage. job.description:

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Legal, Regulatory and Governance

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Toronto, ONT (Hybrid)

About the Role:

As a key member of Corus Entertainment’s Legal, Regulatory and Governance department, you will lead the resolution of complex and confidential respect, safety and violence in the workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies. You will be responsible for conducting timely, unbiased and fair investigations or engaging in other forms of resolution, including conciliation. You will also lead complaint intake, case documentation and management, and provide regular status reporting, including annual reporting under the Canada Labour Code. You will join a talented and collegial team that works closely with business partners and will report directly to the Director, Legal Counsel, Employment and Investigations.

You’ll contribute by:

• Conducting timely and confidential workplace investigations in areas including discrimination, workplace harassment, including sexual harassment, and violence.

• Conducting interviews, gathering and analyzing evidence, assessing credibility, and writing formal investigative reports with findings.

• Providing recommendations in accordance with established legal practices, policies and any applicable collective agreement.

• Acting as a conciliator to facilitate the process for parties that elect this resolution.

• Supporting the development and interpretation of policies and delivering training.

• Conducting the intake of investigation files, case management and post-investigative reporting and tasks.

• Conducting regular reporting on workplace complaints, investigations and other resolution avenues.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Minimum of three (3) years of related work experience managing and resolving workplace complaints and conducting complex workplace investigations, including experience in facilitating alternative dispute resolution.

• Demonstrated experience facilitating the management and resolution of workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies.

• Experience documenting investigative findings and writing reports that are clear, concise, complete, and provides analysis of the evidence considered in reaching conclusions.

• Demonstrated awareness, understanding and experience identifying and addressing discrimination and harassment, including racism and systemic and intersectional forms of discrimination.

• Ability to effectively manage multiple investigations, identify risks, react to changing situations and manage multiple priorities in a timely and judicious manner.

• You are an innovator, always looking to develop and improve your approach and that of the team, in line with legislative changes and industry best practice.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment yet independently on assigned files.

• Excellent writing and analysis skills.

• Able to handle confidential information in a mature and professional manner.

• Strong ability to multi-task and respond effectively to changing priorities and demands.

• Develop trust and rapport and influence partners and business leaders.

• Exemplifies Corus’ values and foster an inclusive and respectful working environment.

• Excellent project management, prioritization and planning skills.

job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.  This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting
  • Fluent in Spanish

 

This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience.   

 

Benefits for this role include: 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). 

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts 

  • Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) 

  • Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options  

  • Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. 

  • Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026

  • Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave  

  • Employee assistance program 

  • All other benefits required by applicable law. 

 

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.description:
Location: MA-Boston

Job Title:  Account Executive - WFXT TV Boston

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts.

 

We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences.  

 

This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. 

 

To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately.
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline.
  • Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts.
  • Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers.
  • Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists.
  • Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs.
  • Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives.
  • Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business.
  • Effectively negotiates advertising rates.
  • Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers.
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships.
  • Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process.
  • Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting.
  • Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results.
  • Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections.
  • Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role.
  • Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines.
  • Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment.
  • Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience.
  • Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting

 

The salary range for this position is $55k - $85k commensurate with background and experience + commissions and bonus.

 

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Account Manager - Orlando Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-John Young

Job Title:  Account Manager - Orlando Radio

 

Position Overview

Our Cox Media Group team in Orlando, FL is looking for an Account Manager (AM). Our AMs get to provide administrative support to the entire sales department. For example, our AMs work on special projects, set appointments, write correspondence, create presentations, compile data and research, and work directly with our clients and sales staff. Some of which could be of a sensitive or confidential nature.

 

Our ideal candidate will have worked in a support position in a sales environment, having an aptitude towards working with the digital sales process and open to learning new software programs.

 

As this position is in sales, the ideal candidate must enjoy working in a team-oriented environment and playing an integral role in achieving the goals of the department. This role may qualify for future promotion to a senior professional assistant or media consultant. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides high level internal and external customer service 
  • Works with Sales to provide customer-facing support including any billing errors or issues, inputting sales orders/revisions for traditional and digital sales, pulls various sales reports as required by sales management and MCs from Google Analytics, AdWords, DFP, and others. 
  • Serves as our Special Event coordinator. 
  • Creates proposals, presentations and various sales collateral. 
  • Become an expert with all internal systems: Wide Orbit, Miller Kaplan, Nielsen, DOT, XSM, to name a few. 
  • Provides general administrative support. 
  • Maintains keen attention to detail in organizing meetings and anticipating needs. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2 years' college or equivalent high-level administrative experience required. 
  • Excellent communication skills with attention to detail accuracy and follow-up required. 
  • Excellent written correspondence, document presentation, proposal creation (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Photoshop/Illustrator, or other similar tools) skills required. 
  • Experience communicating directly and confidently with clients required. 
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality required 
  • Must be fluent, or have the talent to become fluent, in sales technology assets (to include but not limited to Scarborough, Tapscan, Nielsen, Topline) 
  • Ability to prioritize and complete tasks, with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record

job.title: Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Athens Radio
job.description:
Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  Activation Specialist (Part-Time) - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

The Activation Specialist for Athens Radio reports directly to the Promotions & Activations Manager and represents the radio stations as a Brand Ambassador at events and on social media, as well as assisting the promotions team in the office by preparing for events, fulfilling contests and prizing, and utilizing other skills to create content across departments.

 

This role is an entry-level, part-time position, with the opportunity to potentially shadow current CMG employees and assist in videography, graphic design, social media, marketing, promotions, event planning, and sales and programming.

 

Exceptional communication skills and an energetic personality are a requirement. This role will require working nights, weekends and holidays regularly, as well as the ability to lift 50 pounds.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Engaging with the public at events ranging from client locations to major festivals and concerts, which may require high levels of energy for several hours
  • Show up professionally on-site at events, in the office and on social media
  • Represent each radio station in the cluster through knowledge of, and passion for, the brands
  • Set up and break down of station sound and promotional equipment (tents, banners, speakers, audio PA system) at station events
  • Create and post engaging content, photos and video on station social media
  • Assist with organization and maintenance of station vehicles and promotional equipment
  • Compose accurate and detailed event recaps for management
  • Effectively communicate with listeners via email, phone and in-person
  • Assist in various departments throughout the station as needed, including but not limited to digital content, programming, sales, and engineering

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must be a professional team player with customer focus and ability to take initiative and direction
  • 18 years of age or older
  • Highly adaptable and professional
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Able to multi-task in a high-speed environment
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills including grammar, spelling and the ability to tailor copywriting to each stations’ brand voice
  • Must be able to lift 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends and holidays throughout the year
  • Possess a valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Preferred Qualifications

  • College coursework in marketing, public relations, digital media, preferred
  • Videography, event coordination, customer service and/or social media skills preferred

job.title: Broadcast Technology Engineer - WFTV Orlando
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Broadcast Technology Engineer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Broadcast Technology Engineer is responsible for the design, installation, support, and continuous improvement of critical broadcast, production, newsroom, master control, RF, IP, and media technology systems. This role serves as a senior technical resource for integrating traditional broadcast infrastructure with IT, network, automation, cloud, and file-based media workflows. The position helps ensure reliable on-air operations, resilient content delivery, secure technology practices, efficient workflows, and strong collaboration across Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, vendors, and corporate technology teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain, support, and improve master control systems, including playout servers, automation, ingest, transcoding, content delivery, file transfer, monitoring, and interfaces with traffic and scheduling platforms.
  • Support newsroom and production technology workflows, including NRCS platforms, media asset management, shared storage, editing environments, graphics, encoding, streaming, and digital publishing integrations.
  • Provide senior-level support for production control room and studio systems, including production automation, routing, control interfaces, video/audio systems, timing, intercom, graphics, monitoring, and related operational workflows.
  • Partner with IT and network teams to support broadcast network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, subnets, ACLs, IP transport, streaming, connectivity, and system interoperability across broadcast and enterprise environments.
  • Lead troubleshooting and incident response for on-air, production, and distribution issues; document root cause, corrective actions, and follow-up steps to improve reliability and reduce repeat failures.
  • Maintain system security and operational readiness through software, firmware, and operating system updates; access control coordination; vulnerability remediation support; backup validation; disaster recovery planning; and compliance with corporate IT and broadcast technology standards.
  • Develop and maintain accurate technical documentation, drawings, signal-flow diagrams, system inventories, configuration notes, standard operating procedures, and version records.
  • Collaborate with end users, vendors, Engineering, IT, News, Production, Digital, and corporate technology teams to design, test, and implement workflow improvements that support reliable content creation, distribution, and live operations.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers and technical staff by sharing standards, troubleshooting methods, documentation practices, and operational best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of progressive experience supporting broadcast engineering, media technology, production systems, master control, newsroom systems, RF, or related IT/media workflows.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, file-based workflows, IP networking, streaming, encoding/transcoding, shared storage, media asset management, automation, and content delivery systems.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast platforms such as automation, playout, NRCS, editing, graphics, media storage, transcode, streaming, monitoring, and live production systems.
  • Knowledge of FCC requirements, EAS, RF systems, transmitter operations, technical compliance, and applicable broadcast industry standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under time-sensitive, live-broadcast conditions while communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating software, firmware, operating system updates, access controls, backups, documentation, and change-management practices in a mission-critical technology environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and a customer-service mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, support planned and unplanned work, participate in project execution, and remain effective in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Proficiency with standard productivity tools, technical documentation tools, remote support methods, and common operating systems used in broadcast and media environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred qualifications include experience with cloud or hybrid media workflows, IP-based video transport, automation scripting, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery planning, vendor management, mentoring, and platforms such as Avid, Telestream, Ross, Grass Valley, Harmonic, LiveU, or similar broadcast/media systems.

Position Overview

KIRO 7 News is seeking a Digital Content Center Producer to help drive audience growth, maximize engagement, and lead our digital-first news strategy.

 

This role is central to how we cover breaking news, elevate enterprise journalism, and connect with audiences across web, mobile, OTT, search, and social platforms.

 

The ideal candidate is an expert in digital audience development, SEO, and content optimization, with strong editorial judgment and exceptional writing and editing skills. They understand how audiences discover news, what drives engagement and loyalty, and how to use analytics to make real-time content decisions. They thrive in fast-moving news environments, know how to identify high-impact stories, and can quickly adapt coverage strategies based on audience trends and performance data.

 

This is a hands-on, on-site role within the Content Center. Digital Content Center Producers collaborate closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom leadership to ensure KIRO 7 is first, fastest, and most accurate online while continuously expanding our digital audience and strengthening our position as Western Washington's leading local news source.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor local and national news, field calls and tips, listen to police and emergency scanners, and track developing stories through public records and court systems.
  • Communicate and coordinate with newsroom staff and sources as stories develop.

  • Collaborate with newsroom teams to integrate digital storytelling into broadcast workflows and strengthen cross-platform coordination.

  • Proven ability to manage breaking news and make sound editorial decisions in a fast-paced newsroom environment.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, headline writing, and copy-editing skills.
  • Strong understanding of audience development, content optimization, digital content strategy, and engagement best practices.
  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO, analytics platforms, CMS workflows, live streaming, and social publishing tools.
  • Experience using audience data and performance metrics to shape editorial decisions and drive measurable growth.

Preferred Qualifications

Job Title:  Digital Media Director - Atlanta Radio

 

Position Overview

The Digital Media Manager will be responsible for driving digital revenue growth by working with local sellers and developing new direct digital advertising clients in the local market. In this role, you will identify, implement, and accelerate strategic digital sales initiatives to meet and exceed goals. This will be accomplished by working with our local sales team, sales management, market management, and the CMG Local Solutions team. CMG helps local and national clients grow their business year-over-year by providing customized digital marketing solutions that solve unique business needs with in-depth analytics. Our integrated portfolio of top-rated media properties and digital marketing solutions, combined with our in-house research team and creative services, provides clients with the optimal media mix for real business results.  

 

 

As the subject matter expert in the CMG Local Solutions’ suite of digital advertising products, strategies and processes, your main responsibility will be to drive digital revenue growth. Proficiency and expertise are required in digital advertising products; targeted display, digital video (OTT, streaming, long-form, and short-form), digital audio, sponsorships & premium advertising units, SEM, SEO/CRO, website development, paid social, and lead generation. Subject matter expertise is required in the digital advertising ecosystem including programmatic buying, supply and demand-side platforms, multi-touch attribution, Google analytics, and latest industry trends.  

 

 

The individual will be an expert in digital advertising and marketing solutions. Your focus will be on the retainment, development, and growth of current CMG clients and the development of new digital advertising clients. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Establish and execute a revenue strategy that maximizes our assets and revenue potential 
  • Uncover high-potential digital revenue growth opportunities and develop joint execution plans with local sales management. Development of new direct digital business 
  • Guide sales teams to develop advertising campaigns that are designed around advertiser needs and objectives and are executed across multiple media platforms 
  • Responsible for developing digital media strategies, product mixes, digital sales efforts, and revenue generation, working directly with CMG local market sales team and sales managers 
  • Protect, retain, and grow existing CMG digital advertising clients 
  • Develop advertising campaigns that drive revenue while driving return on investment for advertisers 
  • Must be a strong leader and possess excellent collaboration skills to ensure effective partnership with peers while reporting to the Sr Director of Digital Sales 
  • Report on digital sales revenue activity, strategies, and goals to ensure revenue and profitability achievement 
  • Accurately forecast and report on digital revenue attainment 
  • Facilitate group presentations and face-to-face client sales calls with key advertising clients and advertising verticals 
  • Develop, facilitate, and host client facing meetings, webinars, and video conference calls to sell and educate CMG clients and prospective advertisers 
  • Identify and share best practices to develop programs and solutions that drive customer ROI for increased and sustained local digital advertising revenue 
  • Travel required ~ 20% 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, computer sciences or related field
  • Strong (3+ years) experience in Digital Sales Management including:  
    • Demonstrated success in digital and integrated sales, internal/external customer satisfaction and territory management
    • Successful background growing advertising accounts and prospecting for new digital advertising verticals and strategies
    • Demonstrated experience working with both large and small advertising agencies and direct clients
  • Ability to establish priorities and work independently. This includes taking priorities from local markets and identifying the best course of action to accomplish goals
  • Project Management skills required with proven ability to take a concept from ideation to development to implementation
  • Demonstrated successful selling and management of digital advertising solutions to exceed goals
  • Demonstrated business acumen with exceptional knowledge of marketing, sales, and new business development
  • Experience with needs assessment (client needs analysis), digital sales training programs & curriculums, business development, implementation and facilitation required
  • Superior interpersonal skills and demonstrated command in large group settings
  • Strong command in front of large groups or video audiences. The gravitas to be a credible and dynamic sales leader in the digital space
  • Outstanding customer service skills with a keen ability to proactively anticipate and provide solutions for customer needs
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office products (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
  • Active and strong knowledge of all forms of social media
  • IAB Digital Media Sales Certification (IAB DMSC) required
  • Google AdWords Certification required
  • Must have a valid driver's license with a clean driving record

About Cox Media Group 
CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 14 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Digital Media Strategist - Atlanta Radio
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Digital Media Strategist - Atlanta Radio

 

Position Overview

Are you a digitally savvy, client-focused media strategist who enjoys helping businesses grow? CMG is looking for a Digital Media Strategist – Radio Sales to partner with our Atlanta Radio Sales team and develop smart, integrated advertising solutions for local and regional clients.

 

In this role, you’ll work side by side with Radio Sellers and market leaders to uncover advertiser needs, shape compelling media strategies, and connect clients with the right mix of CMG radio brands, digital audio, streaming, targeted display, video, paid search, SEO/CRO, paid social, lead generation, sponsorships, and premium digital advertising products.

 

We’re seeking someone who is curious, collaborative, analytical, and energized by the chance to turn customer goals into measurable results. You’ll be a trusted digital resource for our sales team and clients—helping develop proposals, support campaign recommendations, review performance, and identify opportunities to grow client partnerships.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partners with Radio Sellers in client discovery conversations to understand advertiser goals, business challenges, audience needs, and growth opportunities.
  • Builds thoughtful, insight-led recommendations that bring together radio, digital audio, streaming, display, video, paid search, SEO/CRO, paid social, lead generation, sponsorships, and other digital solutions.
  • Creates and presents clear, client-ready proposals that connect strategy, audience targeting, campaign objectives, KPIs, and expected business outcomes.
  • Works with sales leadership to identify high-potential digital revenue opportunities, priority accounts, renewal needs, upsell opportunities, and new business prospects.
  • Helps ensure digital campaigns are set up for success by documenting objectives, targeting, products, budgets, timelines, and fulfillment details clearly and accurately.
  • Collaborates with CMG Local Solutions campaign operations and analytics teams to monitor performance, assess pacing, recommend optimizations, and identify opportunities to grow client investment.
  • Serves as a trusted digital resource for Sellers, clients, and market leaders on digital media trends, product capabilities, measurement, and best practices.
  • Supports and coaches Radio Sales teams so they can confidently position digital solutions and deliver strong recommendations in the marketplace.

Minimum Qualifications

  • A consultative, results-oriented approach with the ability to build strong relationships with sales teams, clients, and internal partners.
  • Ability to translate client business needs into strategic digital media recommendations and compelling sales presentations.
  • Strong understanding of the digital advertising landscape, including audience targeting, programmatic buying, digital audio/streaming, OTT/CTV, paid search, paid social, attribution, campaign measurement, and emerging trends.
  • Comfort analyzing campaign performance, identifying optimization opportunities, and communicating results in a clear, client-friendly way.
  • Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple client priorities, deadlines, proposals, and campaign details in a fast-paced sales environment.
  • Experience using Microsoft Office, CRM tools, digital proposal platforms, analytics dashboards, and campaign reporting tools.
  • Valid U.S. driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel locally for client meetings, with occasional overnight travel as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in radio, audio, digital media sales, advertising, marketing, or media strategy is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting Sellers through needs analysis, proposal development, client presentations, campaign optimization, and renewal or upsell strategy.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications, business, or a related field preferred.

job.title: Dir, Traffic - TV
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Dir, Traffic - TV

 

Position Overview

Do you have a proven record of creating best practices, leading, and developing a traffic team? Do you have a passion for helping local and national businesses reach their target customers right where they are? If so, this is the job for you!

 

Cox Media Group “CMG” has an exciting opportunity for a best-in-class Director of Television Traffic. We are looking for a dynamic leader to standardize Sales and Traffic operations across markets.  

 

Reporting to the SVP, Chief Sales Officer, this role will focus on increasing revenue and minimizing errors by defining standard processes and setting up and maintaining database configurations, including Inventory Codes, property settings, sales codes, and security settings, to ensure optimal performance  and use.  

 

Location: Other CMG TV Markets locations will be considered 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Process Improvements:

  • Defines workflow communication processes for order errors, oversell, inventory management, late orders, material changes, preempts, makegoods, etc.  
  • Liaises between stations and the corporate office to build relationships and resolve issues.  
  • Works with the corporate sales operations team on divisional initiatives and workflow.  
  • Monitors changes and resolves traffic discrepancies.  
  • Partners with the Sales department to ensure current and updated inventory availability, sellout  information, and placement of bonus spots.  
  • Assists sales management with internal pricing and with communication of inventory to both local and national sales offices.  
  • Works with programming, account executives, and sales management to ensure a seamless flow of schedules and revisions. Assists the sales team with inquiries about AR and the traffic system
  • Works closely with Finance on cash-in-advance and credit-restricted accounts.
  • Standardizes formats, inventory codes, advertiser and agency profiles, sales codes, format codes, priority use, etc., so that these items are uniform across all stations and logs to maximize operational efficiency and minimize errors.  
  • Customizes the database and system properties for optimal performance and efficiency.  
  • Standardizes the day-to-day business processes for exchanging information between traffic and each station. This includes processing orders, managing spots, setting deadlines, logging changes, finalizing and reconciling logs, etc.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Training for Staff:

  • Trains log editors and creates a comprehensive checklist for daily duties and the best way to use the Software to be efficient and effective in doing that task, including WO Traffic tools.
  • Works with staff to identify the best workflows and processes for spot placement, log massaging, and barter.
  • Maintains daily staff schedules and vacation grids, and ensures backup coverage is available for sick leave, vacation, etc.  
  • Key Performance Indicators related to Traffic should be monitored, and workflows should be updated to reduce the most common errors.  
  • Creates Monthly Inventory Management Performance and reviews it with log editors and sales managers to increase revenue by reviewing spot placements.  
  • Assists staff with solving problems and troubleshooting issues with WO Support.  
  • Be available after hours and on weekends in case of on-air emergencies.
  • Resolves problems among Traffic Staff, Sales, Continuity, Programming, and Accounting.  

 

WideOrbit Traffic and Station Information: 

  • Maintains a complete understanding of the WideOrbit software system, including reviewing release notes and implementing new features.  
  • Interacts with engineering and broadcast operations regarding any "On-Air" malfunctions that may arise.  
  • Works closely with station programmers to ensure hourly clocks are accurate and up to date in the program logs.  
  • Maintains inventory and sales codes, selling elements, placer, and property settings related to traffic and sales.
  • Assists with the analysis of implementing or purchasing new features, implementing new workflows, and bridging the gap in understanding between the user and the executive team.  
  • Establishes a cross-functional, multi-station advisory team to test and review new features and ideas.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of Traffic Management experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of broadcast traffic to effectively manage the scheduling, placement, and delivery of advertisements across various media platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills to ensure accurate and timely implementation of traffic schedules, while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities to resolve any issues related to ad placements, discrepancies, or conflicts, ensuring smooth operations and client satisfaction.
  • Effective communication and people skills to collaborate with internal teams, clients, and media vendors, providing clear instructions and resolving any conflicts or discrepancies in a professional manner.
  • Project Management, planning, and/or Buying capacity.
  • Advanced experience working with Microsoft Outlook (creating and organizing folders, answering, and/or managing 500+ emails per day), Microsoft SharePoint, and WideOrbit Traffic. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, management, communications, or related field.
  • Advertising/ Media Agency Experience
  • Supervise Regional Traffic Managers at multiple locations, including training, scheduling, and performance evaluations.
  • Proven experience participating in or leading inventory optimization discussions and committees.

job.title: Director of Engineering - WFTV/WRDQ Orlando
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Director of Engineering - WFTV/WRDQ Orlando

 

Position Overview

WFTV/WRDQ Orlando TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.
  • Develop and lead a strong engineering culture focused on safety, accountability, service, collaboration, training, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage, coach, and develop the station technical team, including staffing plans, performance expectations, succession planning, technical training, and emergency coverage.
  • Partner with station leadership to align engineering priorities with operational goals, audience needs, local news production, company initiatives, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Plan, execute, and track annual operating and capital budgets, including forecasting, business case development, bid solicitation, vendor selection, documentation, and project delivery.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

  • Lead capital projects from concept through implementation, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to on-air operations.
  • Support modernization of the station’s broadcast and IT environment, including IP-based workflows, automation, cloud or hybrid systems, cybersecurity practices, disaster recovery, network resilience, and scalable production tools.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with vendors, contractors, corporate technology teams, property management, and internal departments to resolve issues and improve service.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during outages, planned maintenance, project work, and operational incidents, including impact, status, timelines, and follow-up actions.
  • Lead after-action reviews for significant technical incidents, document root causes and corrective actions, and implement improvements to reduce repeat issues.
  • Prepare timely status reports, budget updates, project documentation, technical records, and leadership briefings as required.
  • Serve as an essential leader during emergencies, severe weather, breaking news, major technical failures, or other events requiring immediate technical response.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in broadcast engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, media technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5–10 years of progressively responsible broadcast, media technology, or engineering experience, including leadership or management responsibility.
  • Strong understanding of television broadcast operations, RF transmission, studio production, newsroom systems, master control, automation, signal flow, media workflows, and FCC compliance.
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure, networks, firewalls, switches, servers, operating systems, endpoint management, cybersecurity fundamentals, and business continuity practices.
  • Experience managing operating budgets, capital budgets, technical projects, vendor relationships, documentation, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, prioritize, and develop technical staff in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, 24/7 operational environment.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and decision-making skills, including the ability to assess operational risk and respond effectively during urgent situations.
  • Customer-service mindset and professional approach when working with internal departments, corporate partners, vendors, contractors, clients, and the public.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and provide leadership during nights, weekends, holidays, emergencies, or outages as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a mid- or major-market television station, multi-site broadcast environment, or highly complex live production operation.
  • Experience with IP video/audio, cloud playout, broadcast automation, newsroom systems, remote production, bonded cellular, streaming, virtualization, and disaster recovery workflows.
  • Familiarity with ATSC 3.0, HDR, SMPTE standards, cybersecurity frameworks, and emerging broadcast technology trends.
  • SBE certification, PMP certification, cybersecurity certification, or other relevant technical credentials.

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

job.title: Director, AI Execution & Operations
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Director, AI Execution & Operations

 

Position Overview

The Director, AI Execution & Operations is a full-time hybrid role based in Atlanta, Georgia. This position is responsible for turning Cox Media Group's AI strategy into measurable business outcomes through the successful execution, adoption, governance, and operationalization of AI initiatives across the enterprise.

 

This role serves as the operational leader for CMG's enterprise AI initiatives, partnering with business, technology, and cross-functional AI stakeholders to drive adoption, coordinate execution, and accelerate value realization across the organization.

 

The ideal candidate brings firsthand experience implementing enterprise AI programs and understands both the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption at scale. They have helped organizations deploy, govern, enable, support, measure, and expand AI capabilities, and can leverage those experiences to help CMG accelerate adoption, scale successful outcomes, and avoid common implementation pitfalls. They combine strong operational leadership with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset, bringing curiosity, practical AI expertise, and a willingness to explore new ideas, experiment, and apply AI to solve real business challenges.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

AI Strategy Execution & Delivery

  • Execute and operationalize the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap.
  • Coordinate and support AI initiatives across business and technology teams, establishing repeatable execution and deployment models that enable successful adoption and scale across business units.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across the AI portfolio.
  • Identify and resolve execution risks, dependencies, and implementation barriers.
  • Ensure AI initiatives align with defined business objectives and success measures.

 

AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Leadership

  • Develop and coordinate enterprise AI adoption strategies in partnership with business leaders, AI champions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders by sharing AI best practices, lessons learned, and recommendations that help scale successful outcomes.
  • Partner with AI champions, business stakeholders, and cross-functional AI leaders to build, support, and expand CMG's AI Champion Network.
  • Coordinate communications, awareness campaigns, webinars, and employee engagement activities.
  • Partner with business leaders to support adoption and embed AI into day-to-day workflows.
  • Coordinate AI training, workshops, office hours, and enablement programs to accelerate adoption across the organization.
  • Create adoption playbooks, implementation guidance, best practices, FAQs, and success stories.
  • Establish mechanisms for gathering employee feedback and measuring adoption effectiveness.
  • Identify and address barriers preventing AI adoption and sustained usage.
  • Promote sharing of successful use cases and lessons learned across business units.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Analytics, Reporting & Value Realization

  • Define and maintain AI adoption, utilization, productivity, and value realization metrics.
  • Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and operational reporting frameworks.
  • Measure productivity improvements, operational efficiencies, and business impact generated by AI initiatives.
  • Establish methodologies for tracking ROI and benefits realization.
  • Monitor adoption trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare executive reporting on AI performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
  • Validate and communicate success stories and realized business value across the organization.

 

AI Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

job.title: Engineering Manager - Tampa Radio
job.description:
Location: FL-Tampa

Job Title:  Engineering Manager - Tampa Radio

 

Position Overview

Tampa Radio is looking for a Manager of Engineering who will be responsible for executing all broadcast related engineering functions for Cox Media Group (CMG) radio stations in the local market. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, all radio frequency (RF) operations, broadcast and digital distribution systems, studio equipment, tower site operations, IP-based broadcast infrastructure, cybersecurity practices, backup and recovery, and security systems. Planning, execution, and timely completion of all projects, maintenance, upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization initiatives while ensuring compliance with all FCC, FAA, FEMA, OSHA, and company rules, regulations, and guidelines. Maintain, maximize, and service the station’s transmitter, studio, digital distribution, networking, and station facilities. Advise management in the long-range planning for the replacement, modernization, resilience, and secure operation of station equipment and systems. The Manager of Engineering is responsible for improving operational capabilities and supporting all revenue and audience-producing efforts. They will work closely with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, operations, and other departments in the maintenance and operation of their equipment and technical systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and support all broadcast equipment including transmission systems, transceivers, satellite receivers, and broadcast automation equipment for optimum performance 
  • Mange remote, on-location broadcast scheduling, site coordination, timely broadcast equipment setup and operation.  Safely store and maintain remote broadcast equipment 
  • Document equipment installation, wiring, maintenance, repair, and replacement 
  • Ensure that all projects are properly implemented and executed per agreed-upon schedule 
  • Work varied and extended hours may include some weekends, holidays, on-call, and required local travel for scheduled after-hours projects or when emergencies or failure of critical equipment occurs to the operation of the station 
  • Respond to equipment outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems at studio, transmitter, and translator locations 
  • Ensure operation and oversee maintenance of company vehicles with the safety of the operator, other personnel, and the public in mind, according to the guidelines of the station and CMG 
  • Update, improve and implement our business continuity plan and contribute as a member of our crisis management team 
  • Support IP-based broadcast infrastructure, including switching, routing, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, wireless systems, AoIP platforms, remote control systems, and monitoring tools
  • Support cybersecurity, patching, endpoint protection, access control, secure configuration, backup and recovery, and vulnerability remediation practices across critical technical systems
  • Plan and execute preventative maintenance, technology upgrades, lifecycle replacements, infrastructure improvements, and modernization projects that strengthen reliability, security, scalability, and operational resilience
  • Partner with Engineering, IT, programming, content, sales, and operations teams to understand business needs, solve technical problems, and deliver dependable service-oriented support

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, radio technical operations, media technology, IT infrastructure, or a related technical field.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast systems, RF transmission, studio operations, automation, audio chains, remote control systems, and digital distribution workflows.
  • Hands-on experience supporting IP-connected infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, DNS, NTP, SNMP, and wireless systems.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals, patching, endpoint protection, backup and recovery, and secure system configuration.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly, especially during outages or time-sensitive station operations.
  • Strong communication, documentation, project management, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
  • Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to support station facilities, transmitter sites, and remote locations as needed.
  • Ability to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call support when critical systems require immediate response.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Society of Broadcast Engineers certification or relevant IT, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or vendor certifications.
  • Experience with radio automation, AoIP systems, HD Radio, high-powered AM/FM transmission, broadcast monitoring/control platforms, or remote broadcast technology.
  • Familiarity with virtualized or cloud-connected infrastructure, Windows Server, Active Directory/Azure, Linux, backup platforms, Fortinet, Cisco, Veeam, Wheatstone, WideOrbit, Burk, or comparable platforms.

job.title: Executive Business Partner - CMG
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Executive Business Partner - CMG

 

Position Overview

The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results.

 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support by serving as a highly organized coordinator, relationship builder, and problem solver who helps create structure, streamline processes, and improve efficiency across the executive's areas of responsibility. Success in this role requires sound judgment, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a commitment to excellence.

 

By anticipating needs, identifying risks and bottlenecks, and proactively driving follow-through, the Executive Business Partner helps maximize organizational effectiveness and the impact of executive leader(s) and their teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Executive Support & Coordination

  • Provides comprehensive support to executive and senior leaders, including complex calendar management, scheduling prioritization, meeting coordination, travel planning, expense reporting, and administrative support.
  • Proactively manages the executive’s time, energy and strategic priorities by identifying conflicts, anticipating emerging issues, preparing decision-ready materials, and ensuring leaders are well-prepared for meetings and positioned for effective decision making and execution.
  • Coordinates internal and external meetings, executive events, leadership forums, off-sites, and other business-related activities, including agendas, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
  • Maintains awareness of key business priorities, organizational developments, and leadership initiatives to help proactively coordinate activities; identify scheduling considerations, dependencies, risks, and opportunities; and items requiring executive attention.

 

Meeting & Communication Management

  • Develops meeting agendas, presentation materials, executive briefings, summaries, reports, and communications that support productive discussions and informed leadership conversations.
  • Coordinates follow-up communications, tracks action items, and maintains documentation of meeting outcomes and commitments to ensure accountability for critical deliverables.
  • Serves as a liaison between executives and internal and external stakeholders, maintaining professionalism, responsiveness, confidentiality, and discretion.

 

Project & Process Support

  • Supports special projects and business initiatives through organization, coordination, information gathering, documentation, and progress tracking.
  • Tracks key deliverables, deadlines, and commitments and follows up with stakeholders to support timely completion and clear accountability.
  • Creates and maintains project trackers, dashboards, templates, and other tools that support efficient execution and visibility.
  • Assists with coordination across departments, project teams, and executive support partners to promote alignment and effective communication.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Operational Excellence

  • Leverages technology and productivity tools, including AI-enabled solutions such as Microsoft Copilot, to streamline administrative and operational tasks.
  • Establishes and maintains effective processes, workflows, and organizational systems that improve efficiency and consistency.
  • Establishes and manages executive operating rhythms, including leadership meetings, business reviews, action-item tracking, communication cadence, and executive follow-up processes. 
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvements and recommends practical enhancements to increase effectiveness.

 

Relationship Management

  • Builds positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment when handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • Supports a collaborative and service-oriented environment while maintaining flexibility in response to changing business needs

Competencies for Success

Executive Presence - Communicates professionally and effectively with leaders, employees, and external stakeholders.

Operational Excellence - Creates structure, manages details, and consistently delivers high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Business Judgment - Understands priorities, exercises sound judgment, and appropriately escalates issues when needed.

Initiative - Anticipates needs, takes action, and looks ahead to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

Accountability - Demonstrates ownership, follows through on commitments, and ensures details are completed accurately and on time.

Relationship Building - Builds strong partnerships through collaboration, responsiveness, and trust.

Adaptability - Effectively manages changing priorities, ambiguity, and competing demands while maintaining a positive attitude.

Strategic Acumen - Understands organizational objectives, business priorities, and leadership goals; connects daily activities to broader business outcomes and helps drive strategic execution.

Influencing Without Authority - Builds alignment, gains commitment, and drives follow-through across stakeholders through credibility, relationships, communication, and accountability. 

Continuous Improvement - Seeks opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology, and enhance overall productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience providing executive support, executive operations, business operations, chief of staff, project coordination, or related support to senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate executive needs, exercise independent judgment, and operate with a high degree of autonomy while managing competing priorities. 
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience supporting C-suite, executive-level, or senior business leaders within a complex, fast-paced organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage highly complex calendars, competing priorities, time-sensitive meetings, travel, expense reporting, and executive communications.
  • Strong business judgment, discretion, professionalism, and ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare polished executive materials, presentations, summaries, and correspondence.
  • Expert proficiency with Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and related productivity tools.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships, collaborate across functions, and interact effectively with senior executives, external partners, and internal stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, communications, organizational leadership, project management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience supporting executives with distributed teams or managing scheduling across multiple time zones.
  • Experience in media, technology, professional services, or another dynamic, matrixed environment.
  • Experience supporting governance-related activities, executive off-sites, or confidential leadership forums.
  • Experience using AI and productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to streamline workflows, improve reporting, and enhance executive productivity.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards, project trackers, templates, and operating cadence tools.

About Cox Media Group 
CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 14 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com
