job.title: Executive Producer - WFTV Orlando
job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Executive Producer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Executive Producer at WFTV in Orlando, FL will manage a team of TV producers and writers while working with, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors to create dynamic newscasts in one of the top newsrooms in the country. The EP crafts the look of the shows, manages story count, flow and placement of every story. They set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news and the speed and style in which we get it on the air whenever news breaks. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment. The EP assists in all aspects of leading and managing a team such as establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations and works closely with fellow managers to craft and execute successful strategies and newscasts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Ensure product stays on brand.
  • Manage breaking news.
  • Copy edits stories in newscasts to ensure they are on target with research objectives.
  • Manages story count and placement. Must be intimate with the rundown. Manage story count vs. big story coverage.
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with producers and conducting newscast critiques.
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast.
  • Ensures the product stays on brand. Holds producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery.
  • Manages breaking news. Ensures that we are on the air quickly. Monitors the execution in the control room. Facilitates drills to ensure talent is up to speed.
  • Innovate to match research as viewing behavior changes.
  • Executes live-streaming strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms.
  • Works closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast.
  • Crafts newscasts look by working with the Creative Services Department.
  • Holds writing seminars and trains new employees.
  • Must fill in line producer as needed

 

Administrative – 10%

  • The EP leads and manages a team of TV and digital producers, writers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors.
  • Assists in establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations. 

 

Physical Demands:

  • A combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers.
  • Document review and computer use, including ability to manipulate fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse.
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines (including self-imposed deadlines). 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. 

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of newsroom experience required 
  • Must be a quick leading innovator who can lead a team in a changing media environment 
  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms 
  • Must be a good teacher and leader 
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
  • Must be well read on current affairs and have a wide range of working knowledge and understanding of general interest subjects. 
  • Must be able to understand research and execute on the findings. 
  • Ability to work well with others and deal with employee issues appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A. Degree in Journalism, Communications, or other field of study preferred 
  • Large market experience preferred

job.description:
Location: GA-Athens

Job Title:  General Sales Manager - Athens Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) Athens Radio is seeking a General Manager, Sales to lead the market’s advertising sales organization and own revenue growth across broadcast and digital platforms. This strategic sales leadership role requires significant digital advertising expertise, disciplined revenue management, and the ability to build accountable sales teams that deliver integrated marketing solutions for clients. Candidates without a strong foundation in digital advertising strategy, products, analytics, and sales leadership will not be successful in this role.

 

The successful candidate will be an accomplished sales leader with extensive knowledge of digital marketing solutions, including search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display advertising, audience targeting, and campaign analytics. The GSM will be responsible for coaching and developing the sales team to confidently identify client challenges, recommend integrated solutions, and communicate measurable business outcomes across both traditional and digital platforms.

 

This leader owns total market sales performance, including local and digital revenue, new business development, forecasting discipline, pipeline health, and account growth. The General Manager, Sales, will serve as the market’s primary sales leader on integrated marketing strategy, helping sellers connect client objectives with effective multi-platform solutions while ensuring campaigns are measured, analyzed, and optimized to deliver results.

 

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of leading successful sales teams, growing digital revenue, building integrated marketing strategies, holding teams accountable to performance standards, and developing high-performing sales professionals in a digitally focused media environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers consistent growth across total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business revenue, and account expansion.
  • Builds a sales culture defined by accountability, proactive prospecting, strong coaching, forecast discipline, and high client-service standards.
  • Increases seller confidence and adoption of integrated broadcast and digital solutions, supported by clear needs assessments, strong client strategy, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintains healthy pipeline visibility, accurate forecasting, and timely use of CRM and reporting tools to guide decisions and performance conversations.
  • Improves client retention and growth by using campaign performance data, market insights, and optimization recommendations to demonstrate value.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and inspire the sales organization to achieve and surpass total local revenue, digital revenue, new-business, and account-growth goals.
  • Establish and execute a market revenue strategy that maximizes radio, digital, event, promotional, and other available assets.
  • Drive new-business development and maintain accountability for prospecting, discovery, pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, and closing activity.
  • Develop the sales team’s ability to lead effective client needs assessments and create insight-driven, integrated advertising recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on leadership in digital sales strategy, helping sellers connect products and tactics to client objectives, audiences, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of priority digital advertising solutions and ensure sellers understand how to position them within integrated client strategies.
  • Guide customized campaigns across multiple platforms and use reporting, analytics, key performance indicators, and client feedback to evaluate results and recommend optimization.
  • Coach sellers to communicate campaign performance clearly, set realistic expectations, and strengthen client retention and growth.
  • Lead sales meetings, one-on-one coaching, account strategy sessions, client presentations, and market sales initiatives.
  • Collaborate with digital strategy, account management, operations, programming, and other internal partners to support accurate execution and a positive client experience.
  • Develop advertising events, promotions, seminars, and B2B marketing strategies that support revenue and community relationships.
  • Use consumer insights, market research, competitive information, and performance data to strengthen sales strategy and client recommendations.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain talented sales professionals while setting clear performance expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer focus.
  • Maintain accurate revenue forecasts, pipeline visibility, and sales activity through company-approved CRM and reporting processes.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated expertise in digital advertising strategy, campaign analytics, and performance measurement, with the ability to coach sellers and clients on solutions that support measurable business outcomes.
  • Minimum of three years of leadership experience in media sales, digital media, marketing, advertising, or a related field.
  • Proven success developing sales strategy, coaching and managing sales professionals, driving revenue growth, and achieving business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of search, social media, streaming audio, OTT/CTV, digital video, display, and audience-targeting strategies, with the ability to connect these solutions to client goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and present integrated marketing strategies that combine broadcast, digital, and promotional assets to solve client business challenges.

job.title: Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV
job.description:
Location: PA-Pittsburgh

Job Title:  Information Technology Manager - WPXI TV

 

Position Overview

WPXI TV, a Cox Media Group (CMG) station in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced, highly motivated I.T. Manager. Operating in the nation’s 26th largest television market, this hands-on leadership role manages the station's entire computing environment, localized server architecture, high-security network perimeters, and integrated broadcast-I.T. ecosystems.

 

The I.T. Manager ensures 24/7/365 operational continuity for our live news, production, and multi-platform digital channels. The ideal candidate will blend advanced systems administration with deep technical knowledge of specialized, automated broadcast television environments. This role reports directly to the Director of Engineering and works in tandem with the station's local engineering team and CMG corporate technology group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Broadcast-I.T. Integration & Support: Maintain high-level technical oversight, provisioning, and daily troubleshooting for mission-critical newsroom and automation systems including Avid, iNews, Grass Valley Ignite, Harmonic, Crispin, Chyron, and Wide Orbit.
  • Infrastructure & Storage Management: Administer and optimize local storage and server environments, directly overseeing the station’s virtualized server platforms (VMware/Hyper-V) and high-capacity NetApp network-attached storage (NAS/SAN) infrastructure.
  • Network & Security Enforcement: Serve as the local gatekeeper for network security. Manage, patch, and monitor the station's Fortinet infrastructure (firewalls, switches, and secure access points), ensuring strict adherence to CMG corporate cybersecurity mandates.
  • Systems & Automation Administration: Direct the optimization of Microsoft enterprise environments, Active Directory, endpoint systems, and localized automated script pipelines to minimize operational overhead and drive reliability.
  • User Support Leadership: Manage the local help desk workflow, ensuring high-priority, zero-downtime technical support for live control rooms, field news crews, digital production teams, sales, and administrative staff.
  • Disaster Recovery & Redundancy: Formulate, test, and manage strict local business continuity blueprints, ensuring off-site cloud backups and local hardware redundancies preserve the on-air and digital stream integrity during critical weather or emergency events.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or equivalent combined professional experience.
  •  5+ years of experience in systems administration, network engineering, or I.T. infrastructure management, with a proven track record working inside a high-pressure, live broadcast television or multi-platform media environment.
  • Technical Proficiencies:
    • Advanced administration of Microsoft Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and desktop operating systems.
    • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware Horizon/vSphere) and enterprise storage management (NetApp solutions).
    • Profound understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN segmentation, routing protocols, and QoS settings for media over IP).
  • Must be willing to participate in an on-call emergency rotation encompassing nights, weekends, and holiday coverage to support a continuous news cycle.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Security & Networking Certifications: Active certifications in corporate networking and perimeter protection (e.g., Fortinet Network Security Expert (NSE), Cisco CCNA, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert).
  • Industry Accreditations: Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) certifications—specifically the Certified Broadcast Networking Engineer (CBNE) or Certified Broadcast Networking Technologist (CBNT)—are highly valued.

job.description:
Location: FL-Jacksonville

Job Title:  Media Consultant - Jacksonville Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) is looking for Media Consultants (MCs) for outside sales roles focused on acquiring new clients and managing existing accounts. We’re seeking talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who are self-starters and excel in a fast-paced work environment.

 

As a Media Consultant, you will acquire new clients and strengthen relationships with existing ones to become a marketing solution provider that understands each customer’s unique business goals and helps them achieve those goals through your media assets. In this field-based role, you will regularly collaborate with a team of sales professionals and use industry-leading tools and resources to create integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve their business objectives.

 

This role focuses on generating new and incremental radio and digital revenue. The main job is to prospect for new business, develop innovative cross-platform advertising solutions, run effective marketing campaigns, and build strong relationships and business partnerships within the community. The Media Consultant is also responsible for retaining and expanding their existing accounts through insight-driven proposals, performance metrics, and by maximizing all radio station and digital assets.

 

To succeed, you’ll need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and a problem-solver. You also must have effective communication skills and the ability to build both new and lasting client relationships. The ideal candidate should have strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business.

 

In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you face a challenging mission, have access to world-class tools to help you succeed, and can realize your full potential as a sales professional. This position provides an opportunity to increase your income through a rewarding commission structure.

 

You’ll also join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and applies resources and strategies appropriately
  • Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling
  • Consistently manages target accounts within the pipeline
  • Generates revenue by developing new accounts and expanding existing ones
  • Prepares proposals to present to Sales leaders, along with existing and potential clients
  • Consults clients on all CMG solutions and offerings, demonstrating a deep understanding of product capabilities, measurement, attribution, and KPIs
  • Responsible for learning and selling fully integrated advertising solutions using our complete range of audio and digital products
  • Responsible for meeting and surpassing all sales targets as outlined by the General Sales Manager and/or Director of Sales
  • Performs a needs analysis and account review to identify the customer’s most important needs
  • Creates effective marketing strategies to satisfy each client’s needs and goals
  • Creates engaging and convincing presentations that generate new or additional business
  • Successfully negotiates advertising rates
  • Showcases product knowledge and its value to customers
  • Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients, then persuasively presents and sells those sponsorships
  • Collaborates with internal departments to oversee account stewardship throughout the process
  • Uses CRM (HubSpot) to track and manage daily activities, build a pipeline, ensure execution, and generate weekly projections and revenue reports
  • Upsells existing customers by sharing performance metrics, research insights, and proven results
  • Collaborates with account management to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions, conduct account maintenance, including make-goods, and collect on aging receivables
  • Attend sales meetings, training sessions, and remote client meetings

Minimum Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in new business development and prospecting within media sales or a related sales role
  • Demonstrated track record of increasing revenue through effective campaigns
  • Proven success in working with people (i.e., career, school, organizations, sports, etc.)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, interpersonal skills, and business acumen
  • Ability to multitask and work in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Excellent marketing, presentation, and closing abilities
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Capable of successfully negotiating with customers to achieve a strong return on investment
  • Experience in prospecting for new clients, selling services to them, and maintaining and upselling to existing clients
  • Proﬁcient in Microsoft Oﬃce, PowerPoint, and CRM tools like HubSpot
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree
  • Three years of experience in media sales, account management, or media buying
  • Proven track record of success in digital and radio sales within a local media environment

Position Overview

WNGC Radio is seeking a dynamic, personality-driven Morning Show Co-Host to join North Georgia's heritage Country radio station. This role is one of the primary on-air voices of the morning show and helps build audience loyalty, grow ratings and digital engagement, create compelling multiplatform content, and represent WNGC in the community.

 

We are looking for a great storyteller with a strong point of view, quick wit, and passion for Country music, local culture, and audience engagement. Minimum Qualifications

  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and vocal delivery skills.

job.description:
Location: WA-Seattle

Job Title:  News Producer - KIRO TV Seattle

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a News Producer who is creative, curious, and highly organized, and can build fast-paced, accurate, and memorable newscasts for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.

 

This role is ideal for a strong storyteller who thrives in a live newsroom, makes sound editorial decisions under pressure, and brings urgency, context, and clarity to every story. The News Producer will collaborate closely with anchors, reporters, meteorologists, editors, photographers, digital teams, and production staff to deliver compelling coverage that serves our viewers and upholds the highest standards of journalism.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Produces engaging, accurate, and well-paced newscasts that reflect strong news judgment and clear editorial priorities.
  • Writes compelling broadcast copy, including opens, teases, intros, tags, headlines, and transitions.
  • Leads live coverage with confidence, including breaking news, severe weather, developing stories, and special coverage.
  • Makes smart, timely rundown adjustments as stories change throughout the day.
  • Collaborates with anchors, reporters, meteorologists, photographers, editors, digital teams, and production teams to execute strong storytelling across platforms.
  • Uses video, graphics, live elements, social media, digital tools, and studio resources to strengthen story presentation.
  • Contributes story ideas, coverage plans, and creative approaches in editorial meetings.
  • Verifies information, upholds journalistic standards, and ensures accuracy, fairness, and clarity in all content.
  • Communicates clearly in the control room and remains calm, flexible, and solutions-focused during high-pressure coverage.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, Communications, Media, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Experience producing live newscasts and writing for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Strong news judgment and understanding of newscast structure, pacing, showcasing, and execution.
  • Ability to make fast, accurate editorial decisions during breaking news, severe weather, and other high-pressure coverage.
  • Strong writing, communication, organization, and control-room leadership skills.
  • Ability to prioritize, multitask, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced newsroom
  • High professional standards, sound ethics, and a commitment to accuracy, fairness, and responsible journalism.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior medium- to large-market newsroom experience.
  • Demonstrated track record producing strong live, breaking news, or severe weather coverage.
  • At least 2 years of professional local television news experience.

 

The wage scale for this position is $33.56 per hour to $35.58 per hour.

  • Part-time employees will receive one hour of paid sick leave for every 40 hours worked.

job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Sr. Client Performance Manager - Atlanta Radio

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group Atlanta Radio is looking for a Senior Client Performance Manager to help our largest and most strategic advertisers get the most from their media investments.

 

In this senior, client-facing role, you will be a trusted performance partner, turning campaign data, market insights, and advertiser goals into clear recommendations that strengthen relationships, improve outcomes, and support long-term account growth.

 

You will work directly with clients and collaborate closely with Account Executives, sales leaders, digital sales teams, and operations partners to align strategy, execution, reporting, and optimization across radio, digital, and cross-channel campaigns.

 

The right candidate is consultative, analytical, and confident leading performance conversations with senior client stakeholders. You know how to connect campaign results to business priorities, identify meaningful opportunities, and communicate value in a way that builds trust.

 

This is a highly visible role for someone who enjoys using data to tell a compelling performance story, guide optimization decisions, and help clients see the full value of their partnership with CMG Atlanta Radio.

 

Cox Media Group is an integrated company spanning broadcast, publishing, direct marketing, and digital media. We are digital experts – leveraging the best of television, radio, and digital marketing services to create innovative marketing solutions for businesses across the country.

 

At CMG Atlanta Radio, you will have the opportunity to work with well-known brands, influential local advertisers, and high-impact media campaigns in one of the country’s most dynamic markets. This role offers visibility, variety, and the chance to shape how strategic clients understand performance, value, and growth.

 

You will join a collaborative team that values smart insights, strong client partnerships, and creative problemsolving. If you enjoy connecting data to business impact and helping clients, make confident marketing decisions, this is an exciting opportunity to contribute meaningfully.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serves as the senior performance strategy lead for Atlanta Radio’s largest and most strategic advertising accounts
  • Leads client performance reviews, optimization conversations, strategic planning discussions, and renewalsupport meetings
  • Analyzes campaign performance, market trends, and client goals to create clear, actionable reporting and recommendations
  • Partners across Sales, digital, and operations teams to ensure high-quality campaign execution, reporting, optimization, and client follow-through
  • Identifies performance insights, risks, and growth opportunities that support stronger outcomes, client retention, and incremental revenue
  • Uses knowledge of digital advertising platforms, campaign workflows, and performance data to guide client conversations and internal execution
  • Connects performance insights across radio, digital, and cross-channel solutions to each client’s broader business objectives
  • Delivers a consistent, high-quality client experience through proactive communication, thoughtful recommendations, and strong internal follow-through

Key Success Measures

  • Client retention: Builds confidence and renewal readiness through proactive insights, performance storytelling, and consistent follow-through
  • Revenue growth: Surfaces opportunities to expand advertiser investment through data-driven recommendations and cross-channel solutions
  • Client satisfaction: Provides clear, timely, and useful performance communication that reinforces CMG Atlanta Radio’s value as a strategic partner

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, performance marketing, client success, account management, media strategy, campaign strategy, or advertising operations
  • Proven experience working directly with clients to present campaign performance, lead business reviews, and translate results into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Ability to manage complex advertising campaigns or account portfolios with multiple stakeholders, timelines, deliverables, and performance expectations
  • Working knowledge of digital advertising platforms, reporting tools, and campaign workflows, including performance monitoring, trafficking, optimization, and results communication
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and develop insights that support client retention, revenue growth, and stronger campaign outcomes
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create polished, client-ready reports, presentations, and performance narratives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting insights to clients, senior stakeholders, sales leaders, and cross-functional partners
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative media environment
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a strong commitment to client service, accountability, and measurable business results

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Media, Business, Analytics, or a related field
  • Experience supporting strategic or high-revenue advertising accounts in a client-facing performance, account management, or media strategy role
  • Background in radio, audio, broadcast, digital media, or integrated local advertising solutions
  • Strong understanding of campaign measurement, attribution, conversion tracking, optimization strategy, and digital reporting best practices
  • Experience creating polished client-facing presentations, business reviews, and performance narratives for senior-level stakeholders

job.description:
Location: FL-Orlando-South

Job Title:  Weekend Anchor - WFTV

 

Position Overview

WFTV Channel 9 Eyewitness News is seeking a dynamic, credible, and enterprising journalist to serve as our Weekend Anchor/Reporter. This position requires a strong newsroom leader who can confidently anchor weekend newscasts while also producing impactful, original reporting during the week.

 

The successful candidate will anchor Saturday and Sunday newscasts and report in the field three days per week. Reporting is a critical component of this role. We are looking for a journalist who can uncover stories through source development, document research, public records requests, and relentless newsgathering.

 

The ideal candidate is an enterprise-driven journalist who consistently generates original story ideas, develops exclusive content, and turns meaningful enterprise stories on the same day they are pitched, bringing forward investigative and accountability-focused story ideas that matter to Central Florida viewers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Weekend Anchor Responsibilities

  • Anchor live Saturday and Sunday newscasts with authority, credibility, and strong storytelling.
  • Lead breaking news and severe weather coverage during weekend broadcasts.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, meteorologists, and newsroom leaders to shape editorial content and presentation.
  • Write, edit, and review scripts to ensure accuracy, fairness, and journalistic excellence.
  • Serve as a newsroom leader who reinforces WFTV's standards of journalism and storytelling.

 

Reporting & Investigative Responsibilities

  • Report in the field three days each week for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch original enterprise story ideas in the morning editorial meeting and execute those stories the same day.
  • Develop and maintain a robust network of sources across government, law enforcement, business, education, and the community.
  • Generate exclusive content through public records requests, database research, source cultivation, and document analysis.
  • Pursue accountability journalism that uncovers information viewers would not otherwise know.
  • Identify investigative angles to daily news stories and develop them into deeper enterprise reports.
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field, particularly during breaking news and major community events.
  • Write accurate, impactful, and visually compelling stories under daily deadline pressure.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and digital teams to maximize storytelling across all platforms.
  • Produce digital content and supporting materials related to enterprise and investigative stories.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated success developing enterprise stories.
  • Exceptional live reporting and ad-lib skills.
  • Strong on-air presence with the ability to connect with viewers.
  • Excellent writing, storytelling, and interviewing skills.
  • Strong news judgment and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must possess a valid driver's license and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of three to five years of television news reporting experience; anchoring experience strongly preferred.

job.description:
Job Title

Associate Content Creator

Job Description

I. Job Summary | Major goals and objectives.

The Associate Content Creator brings original, exclusive and creative videos to life, from idea to execution. They participate in every step of the creative process, from pitching, booking, filming, editing and delivering final assets to be programmed on PEOPLE’s social channels and app. They are responsible for creative ideas and working with celebrity talent. This person should have an obsession with social media and pop culture, a strong understanding of the type of content users want to consume on the platform, and a desire to make people swipe and share. They will also produce “article treatment” videos during breaking news situations and be responsible for monitoring, pitching and creating videos from red carpet events.


The Associate Content Creator will be the last social video staffer working in the evenings, so they must be able to work independently during breaking news situations. They will pitch, create and deliver newsworthy videos and cuts of exclusive PEOPLE interviews. They will assist the Senior Content Creator with pre-productions on major PEOPLE shoots, coming up with questions for talent and pitching fun, scroll-stopping social concepts. They must be able to shoot social-first videos and have solid video editing skills. They will also attend red carpet events to produce, film, edit and post compelling video content. 


This role will require industry experience and the ability to join meetings and assist with guidance of other team members. 


II. Essential Job Functions

Approximate Weight %

Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results 

50% - Pitch and create compelling social videos

20% - Work closely with reporters, editors, social video producers, designers and the Video team 

20% - Conduct interviews and produce talent

10% - Attend events on behalf of brand and capture content, and other duties as assigned


III. Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements | All must be met to be considered.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in journalism or communications, related field or equivalent training and/or experience.

Experience:

Minimum 3 years of professional experience working in a fast-paced, creative environment

Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Proven success in building and growing audiences for media sites and digital brands

• An understanding of social media with a focus on reaching Gen Z audiences 

 •Strong news judgement and the ability to be a jack of all PEOPLE verticals, assessing performance data and newsworthiness to guide decisions

• Proficiency editing videos in Adobe Premiere

• Expertise in TikToks and Reels

• A unique voice that fits and evolves the People brand, coupled with a passion for creating, dissecting and consuming all kinds of content

• A sharp eye when it comes to editing content thoroughly on tight deadlines

• Availability to attend live events for the People brand and capture content

• Superior written and verbal communication skills, experience working in various content management systems

% Travel Required (Approximate): 0-10%, or as assigned

People Inc. is America’s largest digital and print publisher. Our 40+ iconic and fast-growing brands harness the best intent-driven content, the fastest sites, and the fewest ads to help nearly 200 million people every month, including 95 percent of US women, make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, FOOD & WINE, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, Southern Living and more.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Cloud Platform Engineering Intern to help build, automate, and validate infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes environments.

This role is ideal for someone interested in cloud engineering, platform automation, and the emerging use of AI in infrastructure operations. The intern will work alongside Cloud Platform engineers to build tools that interact with infrastructure, collect and analyze operational data, validate configurations, and produce actionable reports.

The position will have a strong focus on Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, and AI-assisted infrastructure management. The intern will gain practical experience working with production-oriented cloud platforms while learning how to build automation that is secure, observable, repeatable, and safe to operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop tools and scripts that query, inspect, and report on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes resources.

  • Build infrastructure inventory, configuration validation, compliance reporting, and operational health-check utilities.

  • Help automate cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Contribute to Configuration as Code using tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, and declarative YAML.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows for infrastructure analysis, troubleshooting, configuration generation, and validation.

  • Implement safeguards for AI-enabled infrastructure workflows, including schema validation, policy checks, dry-run capabilities, approval gates, and human review.

  • Integrate infrastructure tools with cloud APIs, Kubernetes APIs, CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and observability platforms.

  • Assist with validating Kubernetes manifests, Terraform plans, deployment configurations, and cloud resource settings.

  • Build reports and dashboards that identify configuration drift, resource usage, security risks, operational issues, and optimization opportunities.

  • Write unit and integration tests for infrastructure automation and validation tools.

  • Document tools, workflows, configuration standards, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform engineering planning.

  • Work with engineers to investigate infrastructure issues and identify opportunities for automation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or equivalent training in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Foundational programming or scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Bash.

  • Basic understanding of Linux, networking, APIs, source control, and software development practices.

  • Familiarity with containers and an interest in Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask effective technical questions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Interest in automation, developer platforms, and reliable infrastructure operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

  • AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or Kustomize.

  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code framework.

  • Ansible or other configuration-management tools.

  • CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or Argo Workflows

  • REST APIs, cloud SDKs, or Kubernetes client libraries.

  • Data collection, reporting, dashboards, or observability tools.

  • Large language models, AI agents, tool-calling systems, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Automated testing, policy-as-code, or configuration validation.

  • Cloud security concepts such as IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

* This People Inc. Canada internship is scheduled to end in May 2027.

The Director, Strategic Partnerships & Events will lead a key, multi-year strategic partnership across Food & Wine Classic in Aspen, Charleston, and Best New Chefs, serving as a senior leader within the Events Sponsorships team. Beyond the partnership, the Director will help identify new sponsorship opportunities, develop experiential offerings, support Sales, and contribute to our other events as needed. job.title: Director, Talent Development
job.description:
Job Title

Director, Talent Development

Job Description

Position Summary

The Director, Talent Development is a strategic, hands-on learning and talent leader responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving high-impact development experiences across People Inc.. Reporting to the VP, Talent Development, this role partners closely with HR Business Partners, and business leaders, to translate business priorities into practical, engaging, and measurable learning and talent solutions.

The Director will help strengthen manager capability, employee growth, leadership pipelines, and a culture of continuous learning. The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, excellent facilitation presence, modern learning-design expertise, and a demonstrated ability to execute enterprise-wide talent and development initiatives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.


Essential Job Functions

Weight % - Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

Learning Strategy, Program Design, and Facilitation — 40%

  • Design, develop, facilitate, and evaluate learning programs, workshops, leadership offsites, cohort-based experiences, and virtual learning solutions for employees, managers, and leaders.
  • Lead engaging, high-energy, inclusive facilitation for audiences at all levels, adapting delivery in real time based on participant needs, business context, and group dynamics.
  • Conduct needs assessments with HRBPs, leaders, and subject-matter experts to identify capability gaps, performance needs, and development opportunities.
  • Translate business priorities into clear learning objectives, practical curricula, participant materials, facilitator guides, toolkits, and reinforcement resources.
  • Build and evolve learning pathways for key populations, including early-career employees, new and experienced managers, high-potential talent, and senior leaders.
  • Create scalable learning experiences using a blended approach that may include instructor-led training, virtual workshops, on-demand content, peer learning, coaching, mentoring, and experiential development.
  • Apply adult learning principles, inclusive design practices, and sound instructional design methodology to ensure learning is relevant, accessible, engaging, and actionable.
  • Establish clear success measures for learning programs, including participation, learner feedback, knowledge or skill gain, behavior change, manager feedback, and business impact.

Talent Management and Leadership Development — 30%

  • Partner with the VP, Talent Development, HRBPs, and leaders to execute core talent management processes, including performance feedback, goal setting, midyear reviews, year-end reviews, 360-degree feedback, talent calibration, and development planning.
  • Lead the operational planning, communication, tools, resources, training, and stakeholder support required for successful performance management cycles.
  • Support the facilitation and ongoing refinement of the organization’s 9-box talent-review process, helping leaders calibrate performance and potential, identify development priorities, and create actionable follow-up plans.
  • Partner with the HRBP team and business leaders to identify high-potential talent, critical roles, readiness needs, and targeted development actions.
  • Support the design and delivery of succession-planning processes in partnership with the VP, Talent Development, including talent-pipeline development, successor readiness, and individual development planning.
  • Leverage internal or external coaching programs to strengthen manager effectiveness, leadership capability, and individual development.
  • Develop practical tools and resources that help leaders conduct high-quality career conversations, performance discussions, feedback conversations, and development planning.

Talent Consulting and Business Partnership — 20%

  • Serve as a trusted learning and talent development consultant to HRBPs and business leaders, helping diagnose needs and recommend appropriate solutions before escalation to the VP, Talent Development.
  • Partner with HRBPs to develop learning strategies for client groups that support organizational goals, career growth, manager capability, team effectiveness, and employee engagement.
  • Advise leaders on effective approaches to leadership development, change adoption, team dynamics, communication, feedback, influence, and emotional intelligence.
  • Collaborate with the Communications team to develop clear, compelling, and timely messaging that drives awareness, participation, and sustained engagement in learning opportunities.
  • Build productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external vendors, facilitators, coaches, and subject-matter experts.
  • Stay current on emerging learning, leadership development, and talent management practices; bring forward practical innovations that fit People Inc’s culture and business needs.

Learning Operations, Technology, and Measurement — 10%

  • Own and optimize the learning management system (LMS) to ensure an intuitive, well-organized, and engaging learner experience.
  • Curate and promote learning playlists, on-demand resources, and development content for employees and managers.
  • Expand and enhance the People Inc. onboarding experience to accelerate new-hire connection, productivity, and cultural integration.
  • Track participation, adoption, learner satisfaction, completion, and other key indicators; synthesize insights and recommend improvements.
  • Manage program plans, timelines, budgets, vendor relationships, and project communications to ensure high-quality delivery.

Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements | All must be met to be considered

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business, Psychology, Education, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.


Experience / Specific Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in talent development, learning and development, organizational development, talent management, leadership development, or a related HR discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating high-impact learning experiences for employees, managers, and/or senior leaders.
  • Proven ability to lead enterprise-wide learning, leadership-development, performance-management, or talent-management initiatives from concept through implementation and evaluation.
  • Experience partnering with HRBPs and business leaders to diagnose needs and develop practical, business-aligned development solutions.
  • Experience supporting talent reviews, succession planning, performance management, high-potential development, or other talent-management processes.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design, facilitation methods, and learning evaluation.
  • Experience using learning technologies, including an LMS, virtual-learning platforms, and digital or on-demand learning resources.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, consulting, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated project-management ability, including the capacity to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, timelines, and vendors in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Security Operations Supervisor
job.description:
Job Title

Security Operations Supervisor

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is seeking an experienced former law enforcement professional to serve as Security Operations Supervisor, to oversee front-desk security operations and provide hands-on support for event security and incident response. Reporting to the Manager, Security Operations, this position is primarily stationed at the ground-floor front desk and combines a professional, welcoming presence with the judgment and experience needed to protect employees, executives, and visitors.

The Supervisor works alongside in-house and contracted security personnel, coordinates front-of-house coverage, and provides operational direction during events and emergencies. The role works closely with the GSOC, reception, Facilities, and event organizers to maintain effective communication and consistent security procedures.


Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program.


About The Position’s Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results


Front Desk Security and Guest Services

  • Oversee daily front-desk security operations, coordinate post coverage, provide operational direction to assigned security personnel, and ensure visitor access procedures and service standards are consistently followed.
  • Greet and assist employees, executives, visitors, vendors, and delivery personnel in a professional and courteous manner. Verify visitor identities, appointments, and access authorization.
  • Maintain awareness of lobby and entrance activity; identify and address unauthorized access, suspicious activity, disruptive behavior, and other security concerns.
  • Use sound judgment and de-escalation techniques to manage difficult interactions and respond appropriately to potential threats.
  • Support routine visitor badging and temporary access needs in accordance with established procedures, and coordinate credential issues with designated security personnel.
  • Coordinate front-desk, turnstile, and reception coverage, ensuring appropriate relief when responding to incidents or supporting events.

Event Security Oversight

  • Assist with security planning and oversee on-site security operations for internal meetings, executive events, and third-party events.
  • Coordinate event security staffing and post assignments; brief personnel on event details, expected attendees, access procedures, relevant security concerns, and escalation protocols.
  • Oversee event entry procedures, guest check-in, and visitor flow; coordinate with event organizers, vendors, the GSOC, and public safety personnel as needed.

Incident Response and GSOC Coordination

  • Respond to security incidents, medical emergencies, workplace violence concerns, and evacuations; provide initial direction to security personnel until relieved by Security Management or public safety responders.

Education: 

College degree in criminal justice, security management, or a related field.


Required Qualifications


Law Enforcement and Leadership Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in de-escalation, emergency response, and making sound decisions under pressure.
  • Experience directing personnel or coordinating operations during routine assignments, incidents, or special events.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Must be authorized to carry a firearm in the performance of assigned security duties and maintain all required licenses, certifications, and qualifications.

Professional Skills and Operational Requirements

  • Ability and willingness to work primarily at the front desk in a hands-on security and guest-facing role.

  • Successful completion of required pre-employment screening.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate security, executive-facing environments, or event security operations.
  • Experience coordinating in-house and contracted security personnel and working with a GSOC or command center.

job.title: Financial Analyst II
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

Reporting to the Financial Analysis Manager, the Financial Analyst II provides experienced-level financial analysis and modeling to support strategic decision-making across the Ministry. This role independently manages portions of the forecasting, budgetary review, and financial planning process.

 

 

* This is an in-office position in Franklin, TN

 

Do our values align with yours?  Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on. 

 

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Conduct independent variance analysis and partner with departments to explain results.
  • Create and refine complex financial models for capital investment and Ministry growth initiatives.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly forecasting reports for senior leadership.
  • Improve existing reporting tools and propose automation or visualization improvements.
  • Assist with Ministry-wide budgeting processes and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Interpret financial data and develop actionable insights that support Ministry success.
  • Mentor entry-level analysts and provide quality review of work.
  • Track and report on cash management processes, helping to improve forecasting accuracy.
  • Collaborate with other departments to support special projects and strategic planning.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

 

We are looking for a very specific skill set and business acumen. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you!

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • MBA, CPA or CFA preferred or in progress
  • Minimum of 2+ years of financial analysis experience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage non-financial audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deliverables independently.
  • Excellent Excel and financial modeling skills; knowledge of financial systems preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills with a heart for Ministry.
  • Capacity to inspire and develop others while embracing feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • A collaborative and flexible style, with a strong service mentality. Need to be seen as a team player
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop sincere business/Ministry relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the social sector with a passion for our mission and values.

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members between its office in Nashville, TN and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Major Gifts Officer-Central Region
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

The Major Gifts Officer builds trusted, ministry-centered relationships with major gift donors and prospective partners, helping them connect their God-given passions with opportunities to advance K-LOVE’s mission. This role guides donors through meaningful engagement—identifying, cultivating, soliciting, stewarding, and closing philanthropic gifts—while developing thoughtful strategies that deepen long-term partnership and transformational generosity.

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours?  Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

Travel required. Central Region.

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

  • Serve as the primary relationship steward for an assigned portfolio of major gift donors and prospective partners, fostering trust, prayerful engagement, and alignment with the ministry’s mission.
  • Develop and execute donor strategies that invite transformational philanthropy, including five-, six-, and seven-figure gifts and planned giving opportunities that advance K-LOVE ministries.
  • Plan, coordinate, and travel to regularly visit donors and prospective partners in person, cultivating meaningful relationships through face-to-face engagement that supports donor strategy, stewardship, solicitation, and long-term ministry partnership.
  • Guide donors through the full major gift cycle, including identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, closing, stewardship, recognition, and ongoing engagement.
  • Create individualized engagement plans that reflect each donor’s interests, values, giving history, and desire to make a lasting ministry impact.
  • Prepare and present compelling gift opportunities in a timely, donor-centered manner that honors the donor’s relationship with the ministry and invites generous partnership.
  • Provide thoughtful stewardship that keeps donors informed of ministry impact, celebrates their generosity, and encourages continued engagement in sharing the hope of Christ.

job.title: Promotions Director
job.description:
Promotions Director

Federated Media | South Bend, IN (Mishawaka-based)
Stations: 103.9 The Bear, B100, Froggy 102.7, 95.3 MNC

Position Overview

Federated Media South Bend is seeking a Promotions Director to lead and execute all station promotions, events, contesting, and community engagement initiatives across four market-leading radio brands: 103.9 The Bear, B100, Froggy 102.7, and 95.3 MNC.

This is a hands-on role focused on planning, coordination, and execution, with additional operational and logistical support provided by a Promotions Coordinator. The Promotions Director owns the full promotions lifecycle from concept, through execution and recap, while providing clear direction, approvals, and oversight across on-air, online, and on-site platforms.

The role serves as the strategic and operational hub connecting Programming, Sales, Digital, on-air staff, and the Promotions Coordinator to ensure promotions are executed at a high level and on schedule.

 

Key Responsibilities

Promotions Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, plan, and execute station promotions aligned with each brand’s identity and audience.
  • Serve as the project manager for all promotions across on-air, web, social, email, and live events.
  • Plan and oversee major tentpole events, live broadcasts, charity initiatives, concerts, and station appearances.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with venues, promoters, sponsors, and community partners.


Contesting & Compliance

  • Design and manage contest structures, timelines, rules, and prize fulfillment.
  • Ensure all contesting and promotions are FCC-compliant and follow company guidelines.
  • Oversee ticket inventories, prize distribution, waivers, and winner documentation.

 

Event & Remote Management

  • Oversee all station events, remotes, and on-site activations from planning to execution.
  • Coordinate logistics including staffing, station vehicles, equipment, signage, and branding.
  • Serve as lead on-site representative at major station events.


Collaboration with Programming & Sales

  • Work closely with Program Directors to ensure promotions align with station strategy and on-air execution.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop promotions that support client initiatives while protecting station brands.
  • Evaluate promotional proposals to ensure brand fit, execution feasibility, and audience value.


Digital & On-Air Support

  • Oversee promotional messaging across social media, websites, email, and on-air platforms.
  • Write or approve promotional copy including liners, social posts, web content, and text/email messaging.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment across all platforms.


Leadership & Team Management

  • Directly supervise and provide direction to the Promotions Coordinator and part-time promotions staff.
  • Assign and prioritize tasks, timelines, and execution details through established workflows.
  • Lead promotions meetings, assign tasks, and manage timelines and expectations.
  • Serve as final approval point for promotional concepts, messaging, and execution plans.


Reporting & Recaps

  • Produce promotional recaps including photos, documentation, and sponsor deliverables.
  • Track execution performance and provide post-promotion summaries to internal teams.

 

Qualifications

  • Prior experience in radio promotions, events, or related fields is preferred but not required.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple promotions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed for events.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to lead promotions for four highly visible radio brands.
  • A collaborative, fast-moving radio environment with strong community presence.
  • Supportive leadership and clear operational structure.

Federated Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Email resume to Kyle Guderian at kyleg@federatedmedia.com

job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Red Seat Ventures is seeking a data-driven, results-oriented Account Executive to drive podcast and digital media sales for some of the most recognized names in the creator marketplace. This role spans across multiple platforms—including Podcast, YouTube, and Social Media—offering a unique opportunity to work with high-profile creators and innovative brands.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive business development by identifying and cultivating relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders across holding company advertising agencies and brands.
  • Sell various ad formats, including host-read endorsements, Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), programmatic, video, and custom branded content integrations across the entire podcast portfolio.
  • Develop and deliver tailored sales presentations that clearly articulate value and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prospect and pitch new business, expanding Red Seat Ventures’ footprint and share of client advertising budgets.
  • Lead the full sales cycle from initial outreach and proposal creation through negotiation, closing, and post sale client presentations.
  • Work with Sales Assistants and Account Managers to ensure flawless campaign execution, overseeing all aspects of delivery, reporting, and client satisfaction.
  • Create custom marketing and media solutions that align with client goals and optimize results across multiple platforms.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of meeting and exceeding revenue goals in media sales;, preferably across podcasting, digital audio, TV, or social platforms.
  • Existing relationships with audio and digital buyers at major holding company agencies and brand teams. 
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to inform strategy and decision making.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a talent for building long term relationships.
  • Self starter with a passion for storytelling, content, and the evolving creator economy.

job.title: Associate Manager, Strategy Promo Planning
job.description:
The Associate Manager, Strategic Promo Planning (Digital) will support the planning and execution of promotional strategies for FOX Entertainment programming across FOX One, Hulu, Tubi, MVPD partners, and other digital and synergy platforms. This role will help translate FOX’s programming priorities into organized digital plans and ensure that assets, messaging, metadata, and partner support are delivered accurately and on time.

The Associate Manager will manage day-to-day coordination across digital and distribution partners, including promo trafficking, on-platform merchandising, CRM planning, asset approvals, partner communications, and support tracking. The role will work closely with the Strategic Promo Planning team and partners across Creative, Publicity, Legal, Platform Marketing, Distribution, and Performance & Insights. The Associate Manager, Strategic Promo Planning (Digital) will report to the Senior Manager, Strategic Promo Planning.

We are looking for a strategic-minded marketing professional with impeccable attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate takes initiative, communicates clearly, builds strong working relationships, and can take ownership of projects from planning through execution. They should be comfortable adjusting as priorities change while maintaining accuracy and a high level of organization.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the development and execution of digital and non-linear promotional plans across FOX One, Hulu, Tubi, VOD, MVPD partners, and synergy platforms
  • Coordinate promo trafficking, asset delivery, approvals, and partner support in collaboration with the team coordinator and internal stakeholders.
  • Plan and track synergy support across TMZ, Tubi, and News, including AV, banners, and pause ads
  • Support FOX Entertainment CRM planning and coordinate CRM opportunities with FOX One, Hulu, and other internal partners
  • Coordinate FOX One support, including short-form content, on-platform merchandising calendars, marketing updates, and title visibility
  • Coordinate Hulu support, including show page openings, promotional placements, Hulu Spotlight opportunities, key art delivery, marketing briefs, and upcoming slate presentations
  • Manage and update Tubi episode release schedules, monitor for discrepancies, and manage communication with Tubi counterparts
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for FOX Distribution and MVPD partners by sharing marketing updates, tracking support, coordinating asset approvals, and helping present upcoming programming priorities
  • Oversee the metadata library and legal lines in partnership with Publicity, Legal, and other internal teams
  • Keep trackers, calendars, planning documents, and status updates while monitoring deadlines, work orders, and deliverables
  • Provide campaign details and execution context to the team for performance reporting, post-campaign recaps, and future planning recommendations
  • Communicate plans, changes, deadlines, and follow-up needs clearly and contribute to a collaborative team environment

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years of experience in digital marketing, media planning, entertainment marketing, distribution, broadcast operations, or a related field
  • Experience working with digital platforms, streaming services, MVPDs, content partners, or other media and entertainment businesses
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external partners
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep information, assets, and schedules accurate
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets, trackers, calendars, presentations, and asset-management or cloud-based systems
  • Familiarity with streaming platforms, on-platform merchandising, CRM, digital promotion, or content operations
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adjust quickly in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience in entertainment marketing, including work with streaming and digital platform partners, MVPDs, VOD, CRM, or digital content distribution
  • Experience supporting promotional campaigns, managing external partners, or coordinating entertainment marketing assets

job.title: Digital Journalist, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
As a Digital Journalist you will join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news channel. LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate content creators seamlessly moving between the biggest live events and stories as they happen to keep our viewers informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion. Our Digital Journalists watch with viewers as breaking news unfolds, leveraging the latest newsroom technologies to help the audience understand what is occurring and answering their questions.

Reporting to the Executive Producer you will curate, produce, and host live coverage of breaking news and important events as they happen. You will be responsible for giving our audience an in-the-moment view of what’s going on right now. If you are a self-professed news junkie who always knows what’s going on around the world looking for an opportunity that blends being a host, reporter, and producer, look no further than LiveNOW!

This position is based in LiveNOW’s west coast newsroom at FOX 10 Phoenix.

Schedule: Tuesday - Saturday, 4PM-12:30AM (local timezone)

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present original content live for breaking news and major news events, on digital, social, streaming and broadcast platforms nationwide.
  • Simultaneously manage content and live video production, including video switching and graphics.
  • Monitor live video feeds, newsgathering tools and social media for the latest information and content.
  • Maintain constant communication with FOX O&O stations as well as other internal and external partners to coordinate receiving video and new information.
  • Stay up-to-date on news and current events.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to the editorial process while adhering to journalistic standards
  • Assist in editorial planning and monitor real-time analytics.
  • Support other Digital Journalists in producing content.
  • Other duties assigned as deemed appropriate and necessary.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • At least 3 years of experience reporting and hosting live news coverage.
  • BA/BS degree preferably in Journalism, Communications or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of current events with a deep understanding of how viewers are consuming news in this media landscape.
  • Excellent live communicator with the ability to host continuous coverage over extended periods of time.
  • Proven ability to guide viewers through live breaking news and major events happening around the world in an easy-to-follow manner.
  • Great research skills and editorial judgment with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced breaking news environment.
  • Familiarity and curiosity for newsroom technologies (TriCaster).
  • Understanding of digital production and live video workflows.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Flexibility to work early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered breaking and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.
