job.title: Director, Insights & Analytics
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Director, Insights & Analytics to lead data and analytics for our subscription services portfolio. Anchored today by FOX Nation, a premium subscription streaming service, this leader will own all subscription analytics across the full and growing portfolio.

This is an entrepreneurial, high-visibility role for someone who is energized by ambiguity and wants to help build a business, not just report on it. You will be equally comfortable writing complex SQL to get to the data yourself, defining a brand-new subscriber metric framework from scratch, and presenting acquisition and retention insight to senior executives.

You will own the full subscriber lifecycle covering acquisition, engagement, and retention and translating consumer and revenue data into clear, decision-ready narratives that shape content, marketing, product, and pricing strategy across our subscription products.  This role will have two direct reports who will be focused on optimizing marketing strategies, spend to drive acquisition, retention and engagement on our platforms.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES 

  • Own end-to-end subscription analytics for FOX Nation and, as the portfolio grows, for additional subscription services across FOX News Media, spanning acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, churn, win-back, and lifetime value
  • Independently access, query, and interrogate data using advanced SQL, you will frequently be the one getting to the answer directly, not waiting on it
  • Define and evolve the subscriber analytics framework and metric definitions that will serve as the standard across current and future subscription products
  • Lead engagement analysis for FOX Nation across web, mobile app, CTV, social, third-party platforms, and FOX One — pulling data directly and partnering with other analytics, product, and data engineering teams to source what you need
  • Manage and develop two Managers, setting priorities across business units, allocating coverage as demand shifts, and reviewing analytical work before it reaches senior stakeholders
  • Partner with Marketing, CRM, Content, Product, Finance, and Data Engineering to turn insight into action across the full subscriber lifecycle
  • Analyze cohorts, subscriber segments, pricing/packaging, promotional performance, and CRM impact to inform acquisition and retention strategy
  • Serve as a trusted analytics partner to senior stakeholders (VP/SVP/C-suite and cross-company partners), delivering concise, executive-ready narratives that drive decisions
  • Have regular strategic discussions around content spend, marketing spend, operational strategies and how they related to subscription analytics
  • Support the convergence of FOX Nation with the FOX One ecosystem, ensuring measurement consistency and a unified view of the subscriber
  • Establish and uphold strong data integrity, governance, and metric-definition standards across all subscription reporting
  • Partner with Data Engineering to influence data architecture, scalability, and reliability (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) as the subscription business grows

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Advanced SQL is essential, this leader must be able to independently access, join, and analyze data across large, complex, imperfect sources without relying on others to pull it
  • Deep subscription-model experience, ideally for a streaming or DTC service, a demonstrated command of the subscriber lifecycle (acquisition funnels, retention/churn, cohort analysis, LTV) and the levers that move it
  • Typically 8+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or insights, including meaningful time in subscription, streaming, DTC, or media environments
  • Strong proficiency with BI/visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Hex)
  • A builder's mindset: proven ability to create structure, frameworks, and reporting in ambiguous, fast-changing situations
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication with the ability to distill complex analysis into clear business implications and recommended actions for senior audiences
  • Strong data integrity and governance instincts, with a track record of catching issues before they reach decision-makers
  • Demonstrated people-leadership ability: coaching and developing team members, delivering feedback in a clear, supportive, and developmental way, delegating effectively, and adapting communication style to different individuals and audiences
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with a track record of building trust across Marketing, Content, Product, Finance, and Data Engineering
  • Sound judgment on prioritization in a resource-constrained, high-growth environment

job.description:
FOX Entertainment Global is seeking a Director of TVOD and Revenue-Share to lead transactional content sales and account management across digital platforms and partners. This role will drive revenue growth through the strategic licensing and distribution of FOX content across TVOD, electronic sell-through, and revenue-share business models.

The Director will serve as a senior, client-facing leader responsible for day-to-day account relationships, commercial strategy, and execution. The role will maximize the value of FOX’s content by applying a deep understanding of licensed media rights, windowing, pricing economics, promotional strategy, and partner business objectives. Success will require strong analytical judgment, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to move complex initiatives forward under strict deadlines.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead TVOD and revenue-share sales strategy across a portfolio of digital platforms, retailers, and distribution partners
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for key client accounts, managing ongoing account activity, priorities, deliverables, and escalations
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with platform, retailer, and digital distribution partners to support renewals, growth, and long-term collaboration
  • Develop and execute joint business plans with clients, using sales analysis, performance trends, and market intelligence to identify opportunities and establish priorities
  • Analyze account performance, title-level results, revenue trends, pricing, and promotional effectiveness to inform commercial recommendations
  • Manage promotional strategy, including content selection, pricing economics, merchandising opportunities, release timing, and marketing support
  • Evaluate and optimize content availability, rights, and windowing to maximize revenue across transactional and revenue-share opportunities
  • Partner with internal teams to coordinate title setup, product information, materials, pricing, availability, promotions, and other launch requirements
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, Content Planning, and Distribution teams to execute deals and account plans
  • Review and apply licensing agreements, deal terms, revenue-share structures, and other commercial arrangements to ensure accurate and effective execution
  • Support negotiations and deal structuring, balancing partner needs with FOX’s financial, rights, and strategic objectives
  • Track account commitments, timelines, deliverables, and workflows to ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, platform changes, and emerging digital business models to inform sales strategy
  • Prepare clear account updates, sales analyses, forecasts, presentations, and recommendations for internal leadership and external partners
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities to expand distribution, improve performance, and increase the value of FOX’s content library
  • Represent FOX in relevant client meetings, industry events, and business planning discussions

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of experience in transactional content sales, digital distribution, licensing, or account management, preferably at a major studio or media company
  • 2+ years of experience operating as a direct client-facing primary point of contact and managing day-to-day account activities
  • Experience managing promotional strategy, including content selection, pricing economics, merchandising, and marketing coordination
  • Deep understanding of licensed media rights, content availability, windowing, and digital distribution models
  • Demonstrated experience in sales analysis, performance reporting, forecasting, and joint business planning
  • Familiarity with licensing agreements, revenue-share structures, commercial terms, and deal execution; negotiation experience preferred
  • Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to translate data, market dynamics, and client objectives into practical recommendations
  • Proven ability to lead projects and workflows across multiple teams while managing competing priorities and strict deadlines
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills
  • Self-starter who takes initiative, exercises sound judgment, and is comfortable managing responsibilities with limited direction
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple accounts, deliverables, and timelines in a fast-paced environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • MBA
  • Experience working with international clients, markets, or digital distribution businesses
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application in professional environments

job.title: Manager, Insights & Analytics - Subscription
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Manager, Insights & Analytics to support our growing portfolio of subscription products, anchored today by FOX Nation.

This is a hands-on analytics role. You will work across the full subscription lifecycle — how subscribers are acquired and retained, and what they actually do once they subscribe. Engagement and content consumption, marketing and activation, user journeys, churn and cohort behavior all sit within your scope. The common thread is SQL: we are looking for someone who can get to any subscription dataset, understand what it does and does not say, and turn it into an answer a business partner can use.

Because the role is scoped broadly rather than by function, it can flex as the portfolio grows. You may work across products alongside a marketing-focused counterpart, or take end-to-end analytics ownership of a single business unit depending on where the business needs depth. You will work closely with key operational stakeholders to understand how to best interpret data shifts day to day and identify trends to inform the business.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

Subscriber & Engagement Reporting

  • Build and own engagement reporting for subscription products — active days, session frequency, content starts and completion, title and category performance, and platform mix across web, mobile app, CTV, and third-party platforms
  • Analyze subscriber acquisition, retention, churn (voluntary and involuntary), cancellations, and plan mix and their impact on engagement
  • Connect engagement to retention, identifying the early-tenure behaviors that separate subscribers who stay from those who churn, and translating that into onboarding, content, and lifecycle recommendations
  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking key subscription and engagement metrics, in partnership with Data Engineering
  • Maintain and evolve recurring performance comparisons (month-over-month, cohort-over-cohort, pre- and post-launch), proactively flagging anomalies such as app issues, tracking gaps, and data quality problems before they distort reporting
  • Provide guidance to finance on cost as it relates to engagement of programming and inform future content strategies and acquisitions

Hands-On Data & Query Work

  • Write and maintain SQL (Snowflake or comparable) against subscription, billing, engagement, campaign, and behavioral data — joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large and imperfect sources
  • Conduct cohort analysis to identify trends by acquisition channel, offer, plan type, tenure, platform, and content affinity
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms and internal tracking (naming mismatches, missing records, deduplication logic) and resolve them at the query level
  • Support the transition from manual, on-demand reporting to self-service dashboards in partnership with Data Engineering

Marketing, Lifecycle & Campaign Measurement

  • Analyze campaign performance across marketing and CRM channels — email, push, in-app, SMS, and paid media — and connect activity to downstream subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Support attribution analysis (e.g., first-touch) to measure the impact of campaigns on subscription conversion and migration efforts
  • Conduct segmentation analysis to surface engagement trends, at-risk segments, and personalization opportunities
  • Support experimentation and test design, helping isolate confounding variables (for example content quality versus message format, or seasonality versus offer effect) so results are interpretable

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Translate analysis into clear, digestible summaries and recommendations for Programming, Marketing, CRM, Content, Product, and Finance stakeholders, tailoring the narrative to each audience
  • Respond to ad hoc requests from senior stakeholders with quick turnaround, clear caveats, and accurate data
  • Flag data quality issues and tracking gaps to Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering partners, and follow through to resolution

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Strong SQL skills required — able to independently write and troubleshoot queries involving joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large datasets. This is a must-have and the core of the role
  • Experience in subscription, growth, product, marketing, or media analytics, or a related quantitative and reporting role
  • Genuine curiosity about the whole subscriber picture — comfort moving between a churn cohort, a content engagement question, and a campaign performance read in the same week
  • Experience analyzing or reporting on subscription and lifecycle metrics (acquisition, churn, cancellations, retention, LTV)
  • Comfort working in a BI or visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or similar)
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for ad hoc analysis, including pivot tables
  • Good communication skills — able to explain data findings, and their limitations, clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented, with a track record of catching and resolving data quality issues before they reach leadership
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with recurring deadlines and frequent ad hoc requests
  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor
  • Familiarity with product analytics or engagement measurement tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4, Amplitude) a plus
  • Familiarity with subscription billing platforms (e.g., Recurly, Zuora, Stripe Billing) a plus
  • Exposure to a CRM or lifecycle platform such as Braze a plus
  • Prior experience in media, streaming, publishing, or another content subscription business a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Math, Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience

job.title: Project Manager - FoxNXT
job.description:
FoxNXT is FOX Entertainment’s next-generation technology studio, built to expand what our creative teams can achieve and put more of every production dollar on screen. Our work spans four pillars: R&D, Production, Talent, and Education.

We turn emerging technology into practical tools and workflows across scripted, unscripted, animation, and marketing. We test in real productions, learn what works, and make those lessons useful across the business. We also develop talent and help our creative and production teams build the skills to use these tools confidently.

Our approach starts with people and craft. We work with creative partners to solve real production problems, protect creative intent, and use AI responsibly, with respect for rights, the creative community, and the resources production consumes.

The Project Manager turns priorities into coordinated action. You will manage intake, establish clear plans and ownership, track delivery, and make sure the right decisions happen at the right time. Working across creative, production, technical, and business teams, you will keep an accurate picture of what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.

We are looking for someone who is organized, curious, direct, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You ask good questions, follow through, and raise problems early with a recommendation. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring others in. You build enough structure to help talented people do their best work as the business grows.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own project intake and help translate requests into clear objectives, scope, deliverables, owners, and timelines
  • Maintain a reliable, current view of active projects, priorities, dependencies, and team capacity
  • Coordinate across R&D, production, talent, education, and business teams to align resources and move work forward
  • Identify risks, conflicting priorities, and resource constraints early. Recommend solutions and escalate decisions with clear options and trade-offs
  • Drive follow-through on commitments, approvals, and next steps, with clear accountability for each
  • Give leadership and project teams concise, useful updates on progress, blockers, decisions needed, and outcomes
  • Track schedules, agreed budgets, and scope changes. Make the impact of changes visible before commitments are made
  • Capture requirements, decisions, workflows, and lessons learned so each project makes the next one stronger
  • Track meaningful measures of success, including delivery time, cost, adoption, and production impact
  • Improve how the team works, using practical processes and AI tools to reduce administrative work and keep information accurate

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of project management experience in media, entertainment, technology, or a closely related field
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise
  • Working understanding of television and film production, with the ability to connect creative requirements to technical and operational execution
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, including checking outputs and applying judgment to their use
  • Strong organizational skills and sound judgment about priorities, dependencies, risks, and when to escalate
  • Clear, concise communication. You can explain what matters, what needs to happen, and who owns the next step
  • The ability to build trust and hold people accountable across functions and levels of seniority
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Notion, and Google Workspace
  • Comfort working in a growing team where priorities evolve, and some processes still need to be built
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience moving emerging technology from experimentation into production use.
  • Experience working directly with creative teams, production crews, or technical artists.
  • PMP or equivalent certification.

job.title: Senior Manager, Experiential & Events
job.description:
At FOX Experiences + Design, boldness fuels our passion. We ignite awareness and forge meaningful connections across FOX’s diverse brands and our audiences through meticulously crafted, impactful experiences. Size isn’t our measure; we prioritize impact, meticulously planning events that resonate deeply with audiences and amplify reach beyond limits. Fueled by a relentless pursuit of excellence and unwavering audience-centricity, we cultivate a culture of fearless collaboration that transcends teams and industries. Our diverse team, architects of audacity, builds bridges, fosters innovation, and unlocks unprecedented synergy. We embrace bold risks with calculated precision, transforming potential challenges into springboards for success that propel FOX forward. We are an internal brand engagement and experience agency providing strategy, creative solutions, and measurable deliverables in events, activations, design, and technology to all divisions of FOX Corporation, including FOX Entertainment, FOX Sports, TUBI, Ad Sales, FOX News, Distribution, and FOX Corporate.

We are seeking a dependable Senior Manager, Event & Experiential with a high degree of ethical compass, who thrives on high energy, moves fast, thinks big, and LOVES ENTERTAINMENT! This individual will demonstrate strong ownership of projects, bringing original thinking, sharp execution, and creative strategy to deliver elevated, meaningful engagements that build and maintain trust with fans, stakeholders, and internal teams. They are a go-getter, specializing in big picture ideation, creative solution development, and full project ownership. This role requires anticipating stakeholder needs, providing creative solutions, and expertly leading and inspiring teams to create events and activations, sometimes with minimal oversight, ensuring stakeholder goals are brought to life.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and manage successful, on-budget small-to-midsize in-person and virtual events, corporate meetings, premiere events, presentations, and activations
  • Stay “in the know” on the hottest industry trends through research and ideation
  • Oversee and own event playbook, creating workback schedules, DACI, invoice tracking, and budget reporting
  • Communicate and collaborate clearly with FED Technology and Design teams, with an understanding of technical event needs and graphic specifications, and manage production
  • Manage all event logistics, including food and beverage, design, rentals, layouts, rooming lists, parking, budgets, and recaps
  • Lead administrative support, tech, and freelancers on mid to large sized events with minimal oversight, and lead stakeholder calls
  • Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, effectively manage their expectations, ask thoughtful, strategic questions to inform stakeholder decisions, actively listen to understand stakeholder objectives, define key goals, and develop actionable plans that support informed decision-making and advance strategic priorities
  • Track, measure, and report on event success using data metrics and KPIs to realize business goals
  • Negotiate hotel contracts and vendor agreements
  • Provide event recaps and billing debriefs
  • Support senior business leads on larger-scale events, meetings, and hospitality programs, both domestic and international, as needed

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of hands-on and supervisory experience in Entertainment and/or Corporate Events, or with an agency
  • Passion for Entertainment, broad knowledge of distribution networks, digital platforms, and streamers, and deep understanding of their businesses, fandoms, and corresponding individual cultures
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, and can communicate event ideas and turn them into reality
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and multitask in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented, and ever-changing environment without administrative support, and be able to make quick, reflexive decisions under pressure with grace

job.title: Senior Manager, Growth & Partnerships Analytics
job.description:
The FOX direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform is a new, forward-looking initiative within Tubi Media Group that brings FOX's unparalleled content portfolio including news, sports, and entertainment directly to consumers through an innovative subscription streaming service.

Led by a highly experienced team with deep backgrounds across media, technology, streaming, and content, and fully supported by Fox Corporation, this venture blends entrepreneurial spirit with strong media expertise.

Our vision is to create a unified, modern viewing experience that prioritizes the consumer and integrates live and on-demand content across multiple platforms.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the future of streaming during a transformative time in media. We are building a world-class team to bring that vision to life, and we're just getting started.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Senior Manager, Growth & Partnerships Analytics, you will lead performance analysis and executive-ready insights that explain what's driving subscription growth, channel performance, and promotional effectiveness, providing dedicated analytical support and strategic thinking for Growth & Partnerships, without duplicating FP&A's forecasting or deal-modeling work.

Embedded within FOX One's centralized analytics organization, this role serves as the critical thought partner to Strategy and Business Development leadership.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with strong commercial acumen and executive storytelling to influence high-impact strategic decisions.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead deep-dive analyses across direct subscription, distribution, and channel performance to identify what's driving growth, retention, and profitability.
  • Serve as the dedicated analytics and strategy partner to Growth & Partnerships, providing the analytical horsepower that function needs to move initiatives forward.
  • Design and analyze controlled experiments (A/B testing) to assess pricing, promotional, and offer effectiveness.
  • Translate performance and consumption trends into a clear point of view for Strategy and Business Development decision-making.
  • Partner with FP&A to ensure strategic decisions are grounded in accurate performance data — feeding their forecasting rather than duplicating it.
  • Leverage large-scale datasets using SQL and BI tools to uncover performance drivers and statistical relationships.
  • Deliver executive-ready insights for monthly and ad hoc leadership reviews.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • BA in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, or related field.
  • Typically, 8+ years in analytics, strategy, or business intelligence within subscription, media, technology, or digital platforms.
  • Strong track record turning performance data into clear insights and recommendations for non-technical senior stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Growth Analytics and Partnerships functions within a subscription or media business — collaborating on shared metrics without owning deal modeling.
  • Experience delivering executive-level presentations and translating complex analytics into clear business recommendations.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration across product, marketing, finance, operations, and partnerships.
  • Comfortable operating as an individual contributor, embedded closely with Growth & Partnerships stakeholders rather than managing a dedicated team.
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with demonstrated ability to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.
  • Strong experience in Tableau or Power BI, including executive dashboard development.
  • Experience analyzing partnership economics, revenue share structures, promotional ROI, and channel profitability.
  • Experience performing opportunity sizing and market modeling to support new revenue streams and distribution expansion.

job.title: Senior Operations Manager
job.description:
Fox is seeking a highly technical Senior Operations Manager to lead the evolution of customer billing, subscription, and payment experiences across FOX ONE’s digital ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of CRM Marketing, subscription lifecycle management, payments, and customer communications—requiring both strong product ownership and a deep technical foundation.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on engineering experience and a strong understanding of modern payment architectures, APIs, and distributed system integrations. You will partner closely with engineering, data, legal, and marketing teams to design and optimize secure, scalable payment, subscription, and transactional communication solutions that support acquisition, retention, and monetization across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

Our ecosystem includes PCI-compliant payment processing integrated with CRM platforms, subscription management systems, and communication tools, supporting recurring billing, promotions, and compliant customer messaging across multiple regions.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog for subscription billing, payment processing, and CRM-driven monetization and communication initiatives 
  • Translate marketing, legal, and business requirements into detailed technical user stories, acceptance criteria, and system-level specifications 
  • Collaborate with engineering on architecture, API design, and technical trade-offs across payment, CRM, and messaging systems 
  • Lead Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and roadmap execution 
  • Drive integrations with payment gateways, subscription platforms, transactional email providers, fraud tools, and third-party marketing technologies 
  • Design and optimize end-to-end subscription and billing communication flows, including signup confirmations, receipts, renewals, payment failures, retries, refunds, and cancellations 
  • Ensure all payment and customer communication workflows meet PCI-DSS, CAN-SPAM, CASL (as applicable), and state-level regulatory requirements (e.g., California Auto-Renewal Law, CCPA/CPRA) 
  • Partner with CRM Marketing to enable personalized, event-driven transactional email and in-app messaging experiences 
  • Monitor and improve key KPIs across payments and communications (conversion, deliverability, open rates, authorization rates, churn, retries, and chargebacks) 
  • Identify and mitigate technical and compliance risks early, proactively driving resolution 
  • Support product launches, experimentation (A/B testing), and continuous optimization of the subscriber lifecycle and communication strategy 
  • Own processor and partner integrations, improving delivery efficiency through better sequencing, parallelization, and reduced rework 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 8+ years of experience as an Operations Manager, Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role in a digital or subscription-based business 
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience (backend or full-stack preferred) 
  • 3+ years of experience working with payment gateways, subscription billing platforms, and/or transactional messaging systems
  • Subscription lifecycle management (trial, conversion, renewal, churn, win-back) 
  • Payment processing flows (authorization, capture, settlement, retries, refunds)
  • Transactional email systems (e.g., SendGrid, Amazon SES, Braze) and event-driven communication architectures 
  • RESTful APIs, event-driven systems, and microservices architecture 
  • Tokenization, encryption, and secure data handling 
  • PCI-DSS compliance and card-not-present transactions 
  • BI Monitoring detection tools and risk mitigation management
  • Familiarity with CAN-SPAM, CASL, and email compliance best practices 
  • Working knowledge of state-level regulations impacting subscriptions and communications (e.g., California Auto-Renewal Law, CCPA/CPRA, and similar consumer protection laws) 
  • Understanding of consent, opt-in/opt-out, and disclosure requirements across payment and communication touchpoints 
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEAL BREAKER

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 
  • Streaming, media, or direct-to-consumer (DTC) subscription platforms 
  • CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Braze, Adobe) 
  • Experimentation platforms and growth frameworks

job.title: Senior Systems Design Engineer
job.description:
Fox News Media is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Design Engineer to develop, maintain, and implement broadcast systems designs across our media facilities. This role will establish engineering standards, produce and review technical documentation, and ensure that system designs are accurately implemented in our in house NDOX documentation tool.

The ideal candidate has strong broadcast engineering experience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to translate operational requirements into clear, scalable, and supportable systems designs.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design broadcast systems for studios, control rooms, production spaces, technical facilities, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Define and maintain systems design standards, engineering guidelines, documentation requirements, drawing conventions, and design workflows.
  • Develop system architectures, signal-flow diagrams, block diagrams, equipment lists, rack elevations, wiring documentation, network requirements, and technical specifications.
  • Implement and maintain systems designs in NDOX, ensuring that design data, equipment information, system relationships, and documentation remain accurate and current.
  • Review engineering drawings, system designs, technical specifications, bills of materials, vendor submittals, and installation documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Perform design reviews and provide technical feedback to engineering teams, vendors, contractors, and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure that approved designs are implemented consistently during installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Design and support baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast systems using current industry practices and technologies.
  • Develop solutions incorporating SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast networking, routing, storage, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with broadcast engineering, operations, IT, networking, facilities, and vendors to validate requirements and ensure system interoperability.
  • Evaluate proposed technologies and equipment for technical suitability, lifecycle support, scalability, reliability, and alignment with engineering standards.
  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation and update NDOX records following system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and commissioning activities.
  • Participate in system testing, troubleshooting, acceptance reviews, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Support continuous improvement of design processes, documentation quality, and system lifecycle management.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience designing, integrating, or supporting complex broadcast, media, audiovisual, or technical infrastructure systems.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast system architecture, signal flow, routing, synchronization, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Experience developing and reviewing detailed engineering documentation and technical drawings.
  • Experience defining or applying engineering standards, design criteria, documentation practices, and quality-control processes.
  • Experience working with systems databases, documentation platforms, or facilities engineering management tools; experience with NDOX is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with IP-based broadcast technologies, including SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast, and networked media systems.
  • Experience designing baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast environments.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control systems, media asset management, storage, automation, monitoring, and cloud-based media workflows.
  • Proficiency with technical design and documentation tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of networking, VLANs, routing, switching, storage, cybersecurity principles, and system interoperability.
  • Experience reviewing vendor designs, submittals, installation drawings, test documentation, and as-built records.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Project coordination experience and PMP certification are preferred but not required.

Reporting to the Director, Ad Sales Engagement & Events, this role is responsible for planning and executing a range of events that support the sales organization, including bespoke client experiences, internal engagement initiatives, and on-site event execution.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is detail-oriented, and can manage multiple projects simultaneously while delivering high-quality experiences for both clients and internal stakeholders.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Plan and execute bespoke client events that support ad sales relationships and business development efforts
  • Manage end-to-end event logistics, including venue sourcing, vendor management, catering, production, hotel block management, transportation, and overall guest experience
  • Own all event communications and documentation, including attendee tracking, rooming lists, travel manifests, and activity selections with a high degree of accuracy
  • Oversee the development and approval of event communications (Save-the-Dates, invitations, RSVP materials, event branding collateral) in partnership with internal design teams
  • Develop and manage event budgets from inception through reconciliation, including expense authorizations, real-time tracking, and coordination with Finance
  • Manage vendor relationships, including onboarding, contracting, and invoice processing via Coupa
  • Lead internal engagement events such as team gatherings, leadership meetings, and employee experiences
  • Provide on-site event management, ensuring seamless execution from setup through breakdown
  • Partner closely with Ad Sales leads, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align events with business objectives
  • Develop and maintain timelines, run-of-show documents, and all event-related communications
  • Proactively troubleshoot and resolve issues in real time to ensure a high-quality attendee experience
  • Manage premium/merchandising programs, including concept development, sourcing, packaging, shipping, inventory tracking, and recipient management
  • Maintain key sales resources, including event calendars, inventory trackers, and client program materials
  • Create and maintain detailed event dossiers for each Ad Sales hospitality program
  • Support internal Ad Sales events, including charitable initiatives, team-building activities, and recognition programs
  • Partner with team coordinators to ensure timely and accurate reconciliation of all event expenses

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Extensive experience in corporate event planning a must (media experience preferred)
  • Proven experience managing client-facing events and corporate programs
  • Strong vendor relationships and negotiation skills
  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets and financial processes
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working with VIPs, C-level executives, and high-profile clients
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and problem-solve in real time
  • Highly detail-oriented with excellent time management and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • High level of professionalism and strong interpersonal skills
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings, and travel as needed
  • This role supports a dynamic event calendar and is not a traditional 9–5 position
  • Availability and responsiveness during active events and after-hours are required
  • Evening and extended hours will be necessary based on event schedules
  • Flexibility and a solutions-oriented mindset are essential

job.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
job.description:
Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).

Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.

Position Overview

The Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations bridges the gap between sales strategy, technology, and data analytics. You will eliminate friction in the sales cycle by optimizing our revenue, building robust forecasting models, and maximizing inventory yield. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring close collaboration with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Account Executives (AEs) to align sales performance with our overarching financial targets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Technology & Infrastructure

  • Optimize Systems & Maintain Data Integrity: Act as the system administrator to ensure clean data entry, accurate tracking, and seamless integration between platforms.
  • Automate Workflows: Design and deploy automated processes to reduce administrative tasks for the sales team.
  • Maintain and refine Account Executive (AE) coverage lists.

Forecasting & Pipeline Management

  • Build Models: Develop data-driven revenue forecasting models to provide executive leadership with predictable, forward-looking insights.
  • Sales Planning: Connect sales goals to pipeline, historical performance, product opportunity and forecast assumptions. 
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal stage to anticipate shifts in ad spend and market demand.
  • Guide Strategy: Turn pipeline data into actionable insights that help sales teams proactively address gaps in the revenue funnel.Investigate questions that are not readily answered by existing reports, distinguish signal from noise, and analyze performance by product, show, AE, account, advertiser, and campaign. Turn findings into decisions and follow-through.

Go-To-Market (GTM) Data & Analytics

  • Unified Dashboards: Build holistic reporting structures tracking performance by product (Video, YouTube, Audio, Direct Network, Programmatic). Also provide AEs and Leadership with customized reporting, dashboard and account spend analysis.
  • AE Specific Reporting: Create centralized dashboards for individual AEs to track weekly closed revenue and pipeline metrics, serving as the champion of the CRM.
  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Conduct revenue analysis, track year-over-year (YOY) account growth/declines, identify non-returning quarterly revenue, etc.
  • Business Planning: Formulate annual and year-end AE business plans using historical performance data to help FY planning in top down and bottoms up formats.
  • Build the capability to scale: Partner across departments to ensure processes, reporting, and technology support commercial decision-making. Help automate recurring analysis and establish repeatable practices as Red Seat Ventures grows.
  • Identify growth opportunities: Use client, advertiser, market, product, and pipeline data to identify untapped accounts, categories, agencies, products, and distribution opportunities. Develop options for where Sales could focus and how existing relationships could grow.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience: 5-7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Commercial Finance, ideally within media, digital advertising, or SaaS.
  • Analytical Skills: Mastery of Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools to synthesize messy data sets into clean, executive-ready charts.
  • Agility: Can answer ambiguous business questions and  work with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to turn analysis into action.

Preferred Skills

  • Industry Context: Deep understanding of the advertising sales industry and accounts lists; including the advertising ecosystem, specifically Podcasting, YouTube and Social.
  • Commercial Decision Influence: Experience with using data to influence sales planning, account prioritization, pricing, packaging, ratecards, yield, and revenue planning.
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex data trends to non-technical sales reps and executives alike.
  • CRM Expertise: Advanced, hands-on administration experience with Salesforce (building dashboards, custom objects, and reports).

job.title: Streaming Host/Reporter
job.description:
Come join Southern California’s news leader, FOX Local Los Angeles and KTTV! We are seeking dynamic, adaptable individuals who have a passion for journalism and thrive in front of the camera on broadcast, live hosting, and streaming platforms. We are currently searching for a full-time Streaming Host / Reporter with strong editorial, live interview, and unscripted hosting capabilities. Be part of a winning team in the heart of Los Angeles with a diverse culture that believes in supporting, mentoring, and training our staff.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Successful candidates are versatile newsroom professionals who are curious about the Los Angeles community; creative in sourcing and producing engaging content; and skilled at seamlessly hosting live streams, unscripted breaking news, and field interviews across our digital and broadcast ecosystems.

  • Serve as the on-air face and voice for FOX Local Los Angeles channels, digital platforms, and special coverage.
  • Lead engaging live interviews, host long-form segments, and drive conversational coverage during both breaking news events and scheduled streams.
  • Ditch the script and connect authentically with the audience, driving real-time digital engagement and viewer interaction.
  • Master newsroom streaming tools and video systems to independently operate, navigate, and anchor live digital broadcasts.
  • Pitch, research, write, and present compelling video and news content tailored for FOX Local Los Angeles apps, Connected TV, and social media.
  • Stay at the frontline of developing stories, taking on flexible hosting and field reporting duties as news breaks.
  • Maintain an active, professional social media presence that aligns with the FOX Local Los Angeles brand and fosters community connection.
  • Collaborate with newsroom producers, photographers, and field crews to adapt stories effectively across multiple platforms.
  • Perform other newsroom duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Deep familiarity with Southern California, its diverse communities, current events, and local culture is highly favorable.
  • High school diploma required; 4-year college degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • 2 to 5 years of professional experience as a streaming host, reporter, or Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional on-camera presence with proven unscripted delivery, live ad-libbing, and interviewing skills.
  • Basic experience with digital streaming workflows, non-linear video editing (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro), and switching tools (such as Tricaster).
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills under deadline pressure.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure, adapt to fast-moving story developments, and maintain strong journalistic integrity.

job.title: Supervisor, Media Production Unit
job.description:
As the Supervisor for the Media Production Unit, you are responsible for managing the Production Assistants who process all of the daily graphical orders requested by show units. The artwork created by MPG is seen by viewers watching all Fox News Media platforms including Fox News and Fox Business! You have an interest in people management, news, and design with exceptional attention to detail.

Our team is staffed 24/7; you must be able to report into our NY office 4-5 days per week and be willing to adjust your schedule based on news and programming needs.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage and train production assistants who assign and check day-of-air graphics for show teams
  • Maintain team schedule and adjust to meet programming needs
  • React to breaking news by proactively assigning graphics, delegating responsibilities to staff, and communicating with live control rooms and show teams
  • Train staff on the best methods for quality control from an editorial and visual perspective
  • Assign daily requests and check orders alongside the PAs as the schedule and workload dictates
  • Cultivate professional relationships with show producers and control room staff to facilitate communication, problem solve, and manage expectations
  • Work with show teams to prioritize orders and suggest solutions for special requests
  • Ensure seamless handoff of information across PA shifts
  • Mentor PA’s and work to advance their careers within the company

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of skills and demonstrated experience
  • Experience managing direct reports and providing employee feedback
  • Demonstrated experience problem solving and finding solutions
  • Exceptional organizational and decision-making skills
  • Demonstrated experience working under pressure and completing multiple tasks while maintaining a high degree of accuracy
  • Highly responsive to department needs and to external breaking news
  • Excellent editorial judgment and knowledge of current events
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proficient in Office, Google apps, and communication tools such as zoom and slack
  • Working knowledge of Photoshop, Adobe Suite, VizRT (or other real-time graphics system)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcasting, Journalism or Communications
  • Experience using order management systems such as Jira and Confluence
  • Experience working in a live control room

job.description:
Fox Corporation is seeking a Temporary Workplace Coordinator to support the FOX Workplace Team (under Real Estate) on Campus. This role offers a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in data input and analysis, along with assisting in supporting the software that informs the facilities teams.  If you are passionate about data, data accuracy, and the Facility and Real Estate areas, with a sprinkle of space planning and projects, then this role is for you!

This is a temporary assignment (approx. 6 months). Candidates must be available to work full-time (40 hours/week) for the duration of the project, on-site Mondays-Thursdays (4 days) and work from home on Fridays (1 day) in the Los Angeles area.

  • Pull data sets as needed for various projects from various sources
  • Use Chat GPT regularly to help with fine-tuning data

  • Clear communication and strong analytical and organizational skills

  • Comfortable juggling multiple deadlines while maintaining accuracy
  • Comfortable using a computer and looking at a monitor for the majority of the day
  • Knowledge of the MS Office suite of tools
  • Mid-level or higher knowledge of Excel
  • Familiar with Chat GPT or AI usage
  • Familiar with how to read a floor plan (for floor/building walks)
  • Creative thinking and problem-solving
  • Love for data and accuracy, with a little creativity and fun mixed in

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Some Real Estate knowledge

job.title: Traffic Coordinator
job.description:
Traffic Coordinator (Regular Full-Time)

KDFW – FOX 4 Dallas-Fort Worth | Dallas, TX

Are you a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where accuracy is everything? If so, you belong here. FOX 4 KDFW is looking for a collaborative Traffic Coordinator ready to make an immediate impact ensuring the accurate scheduling and execution of our commercial advertising.

Leveraging the scale and resources of Fox Corporation and Fox Television Stations, KDFW delivers best-in-class advertising solutions across broadcast and digital platforms, designed to help our advertising partners achieve measurable results.

The KDFW Traffic Department has an amazing opportunity for a Traffic Coordinator to play a critical role in the scheduling of both spot and paid programming commercial copy, working closely with advertising agencies and FOX Sales teams to help ensure every commercial airs as planned.

Why Join Us?

  • Collaborative Environment: Work in a fast-paced culture where teamwork and ideas are valued.
  • Learn & Grow: Build hands-on experience in broadcast traffic, copy coordination, and television scheduling within a large, multi-platform media organization.
  • Make an Impact: Play a critical role in the accurate execution of commercial schedules that drive revenue for FOX 4 and our advertising partners.


Job Summary

  • Copy Scheduling Support: Assist in the gathering and organization of materials needed to schedule copy for both spot buys and paid program schedules.
  • Commercial Scheduling: Ensure the accurate scheduling of commercial copy across all scheduled programming.
  • Agency & Sales Communication: Communicate daily with advertising agencies and FOX Sales teams to coordinate commercial scheduling and resolve issues.
  • Inbox Management: Monitor the shared email box and respond promptly to time-sensitive requests.
  • Log Management: Work displaced spots on logs in assigned dayparts as part of daily duties.
  • Accuracy & Prioritization: Maintain exceptional accuracy while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Additional Duties: Support other Traffic Department and station initiatives and perform additional projects as assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 1+ year of office, administrative, or coordination experience.
  • Organization: Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with a positive, professional approach.
  • Multitasking: Ability to multitask, prioritize competing deadlines, and perform effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with standard business software, including email, internet applications, and Microsoft Office or similar productivity tools.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Preferred Experience: Experience in television scheduling, broadcast traffic, copy coordination, or a related media operations role is a plus.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Communications, Broadcasting, Business, or a related field preferred.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Package: Excellent health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and 401(k) with company match.

Additional Details

  • FOX 4 KDFW is a 24/7 media operation; flexibility to work varied hours as needed is required.
  • Based in Dallas, TX at our KDFW station, supporting FOX 4 commercial scheduling and traffic operations.
  • The successful candidate must be able to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively with agencies, Sales, and station teams.

If you are ready to start your career with FOX and have the skills and experience to excel in this role, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Associate Manager, Strategy Promo Planning
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Associate Manager, Strategic Promo Planning (Digital) will support the planning and execution of promotional strategies for FOX Entertainment programming across FOX One, Hulu, Tubi, MVPD partners, and other digital and synergy platforms. This role will help translate FOX’s programming priorities into organized digital plans and ensure that assets, messaging, metadata, and partner support are delivered accurately and on time.


The Associate Manager will manage day-to-day coordination across digital and distribution partners, including promo trafficking, on-platform merchandising, CRM planning, asset approvals, partner communications, and support tracking. The role will work closely with the Strategic Promo Planning team and partners across Creative, Publicity, Legal, Platform Marketing, Distribution, and Performance & Insights. The Associate Manager, Strategic Promo Planning (Digital) will report to the Senior Manager, Strategic Promo Planning.


We are looking for a strategic-minded marketing professional with impeccable attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate takes initiative, communicates clearly, builds strong working relationships, and can take ownership of projects from planning through execution. They should be comfortable adjusting as priorities change while maintaining accuracy and a high level of organization.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the development and execution of digital and non-linear promotional plans across FOX One, Hulu, Tubi, VOD, MVPD partners, and synergy platforms
  • Coordinate promo trafficking, asset delivery, approvals, and partner support in collaboration with the team coordinator and internal stakeholders.
  • Plan and track synergy support across TMZ, Tubi, and News, including AV, banners, and pause ads
  • Support FOX Entertainment CRM planning and coordinate CRM opportunities with FOX One, Hulu, and other internal partners
  • Coordinate FOX One support, including short-form content, on-platform merchandising calendars, marketing updates, and title visibility
  • Coordinate Hulu support, including show page openings, promotional placements, Hulu Spotlight opportunities, key art delivery, marketing briefs, and upcoming slate presentations
  • Manage and update Tubi episode release schedules, monitor for discrepancies, and manage communication with Tubi counterparts
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for FOX Distribution and MVPD partners by sharing marketing updates, tracking support, coordinating asset approvals, and helping present upcoming programming priorities
  • Oversee the metadata library and legal lines in partnership with Publicity, Legal, and other internal teams
  • Keep trackers, calendars, planning documents, and status updates while monitoring deadlines, work orders, and deliverables
  • Provide campaign details and execution context to the team for performance reporting, post-campaign recaps, and future planning recommendations
  • Communicate plans, changes, deadlines, and follow-up needs clearly and contribute to a collaborative team environment

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 4+ years of experience in digital marketing, media planning, entertainment marketing, distribution, broadcast operations, or a related field
  • Experience working with digital platforms, streaming services, MVPDs, content partners, or other media and entertainment businesses
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams and external partners
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to keep information, assets, and schedules accurate
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets, trackers, calendars, presentations, and asset-management or cloud-based systems
  • Familiarity with streaming platforms, on-platform merchandising, CRM, digital promotion, or content operations
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and adjust quickly in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience in entertainment marketing, including work with streaming and digital platform partners, MVPDs, VOD, CRM, or digital content distribution
  • Experience supporting promotional campaigns, managing external partners, or coordinating entertainment marketing assets

job.title: Manager, Insights & Analytics - Subscription
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox News Media

FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FOX News Media is looking for a Manager, Insights & Analytics to support our growing portfolio of subscription products, anchored today by FOX Nation.


This is a hands-on analytics role. You will work across the full subscription lifecycle — how subscribers are acquired and retained, and what they actually do once they subscribe. Engagement and content consumption, marketing and activation, user journeys, churn and cohort behavior all sit within your scope. The common thread is SQL: we are looking for someone who can get to any subscription dataset, understand what it does and does not say, and turn it into an answer a business partner can use.


Because the role is scoped broadly rather than by function, it can flex as the portfolio grows. You may work across products alongside a marketing-focused counterpart, or take end-to-end analytics ownership of a single business unit depending on where the business needs depth. You will work closely with key operational stakeholders to understand how to best interpret data shifts day to day and identify trends to inform the business.

 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

Subscriber & Engagement Reporting

  • Build and own engagement reporting for subscription products — active days, session frequency, content starts and completion, title and category performance, and platform mix across web, mobile app, CTV, and third-party platforms
  • Analyze subscriber acquisition, retention, churn (voluntary and involuntary), cancellations, and plan mix and their impact on engagement
  • Connect engagement to retention, identifying the early-tenure behaviors that separate subscribers who stay from those who churn, and translating that into onboarding, content, and lifecycle recommendations
  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking key subscription and engagement metrics, in partnership with Data Engineering
  • Maintain and evolve recurring performance comparisons (month-over-month, cohort-over-cohort, pre- and post-launch), proactively flagging anomalies such as app issues, tracking gaps, and data quality problems before they distort reporting
  • Provide guidance to finance on cost as it relates to engagement of programming and inform future content strategies and acquisitions

Hands-On Data & Query Work

  • Write and maintain SQL (Snowflake or comparable) against subscription, billing, engagement, campaign, and behavioral data — joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large and imperfect sources
  • Conduct cohort analysis to identify trends by acquisition channel, offer, plan type, tenure, platform, and content affinity
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms and internal tracking (naming mismatches, missing records, deduplication logic) and resolve them at the query level
  • Support the transition from manual, on-demand reporting to self-service dashboards in partnership with Data Engineering

Marketing, Lifecycle & Campaign Measurement

  • Analyze campaign performance across marketing and CRM channels — email, push, in-app, SMS, and paid media — and connect activity to downstream subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Support attribution analysis (e.g., first-touch) to measure the impact of campaigns on subscription conversion and migration efforts
  • Conduct segmentation analysis to surface engagement trends, at-risk segments, and personalization opportunities
  • Support experimentation and test design, helping isolate confounding variables (for example content quality versus message format, or seasonality versus offer effect) so results are interpretable

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Translate analysis into clear, digestible summaries and recommendations for Programming, Marketing, CRM, Content, Product, and Finance stakeholders, tailoring the narrative to each audience
  • Respond to ad hoc requests from senior stakeholders with quick turnaround, clear caveats, and accurate data
  • Flag data quality issues and tracking gaps to Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering partners, and follow through to resolution

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Strong SQL skills required — able to independently write and troubleshoot queries involving joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large datasets. This is a must-have and the core of the role
  • Experience in subscription, growth, product, marketing, or media analytics, or a related quantitative and reporting role
  • Genuine curiosity about the whole subscriber picture — comfort moving between a churn cohort, a content engagement question, and a campaign performance read in the same week
  • Experience analyzing or reporting on subscription and lifecycle metrics (acquisition, churn, cancellations, retention, LTV)
  • Comfort working in a BI or visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or similar)
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for ad hoc analysis, including pivot tables
  • Good communication skills — able to explain data findings, and their limitations, clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented, with a track record of catching and resolving data quality issues before they reach leadership
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with recurring deadlines and frequent ad hoc requests
  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor
  • Familiarity with product analytics or engagement measurement tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4, Amplitude) a plus
  • Familiarity with subscription billing platforms (e.g., Recurly, Zuora, Stripe Billing) a plus
  • Exposure to a CRM or lifecycle platform such as Braze a plus
  • Prior experience in media, streaming, publishing, or another content subscription business a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Math, Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience

OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices.   • Availability: Must be flexible to work variable shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays as operational demands require.

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior Financial Analyst will support the FOX Entertainment network business, including working closely with the Studio, Distribution and Corporate Finance teams. We are looking for a motivated and career-oriented candidate with a proactive approach and strong analytical and Excel skills. The Senior Financial Analyst will work on monthly close, budgets and forecasts, key financial reporting, ad hoc analysis, and tracking of various payments and receipts.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare month-end reporting, including running system-generated reports and analyzing variance detail to be able to explain actuals vs budget and vs forecast variances

  • Collaborate with operational leads on various activities such as timely invoice submissions, coding accuracy, month-end accruals, and forecast/budget deliverables
  • Set up expense authorization codes in Workday and monitor related project spend
  • Prepare and process ad-hoc invoices and payments as needed
  • Support external audit, tax, and compliance requests by gathering quarterly and annual documentation
  • Perform ad-hoc reporting and special projects as required

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • BA/BS in Finance or Accounting
  • 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with all levels of the department 
  • Ability to listen and communicate well both verbally and in writing
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High proficiency in using computer systems particularly Advanced Excel, Microsoft Word, Database Management skills, and ERPs e.g. Workday
  • Independent judgment and be able to work on multiple assignments at once
  • Operate successfully in a fast paced, entrepreneurial environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Big 4 and/or entertainment experience

  • Design broadcast systems for studios, control rooms, production spaces, technical facilities, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Define and maintain systems design standards, engineering guidelines, documentation requirements, drawing conventions, and design workflows.
  • Develop system architectures, signal-flow diagrams, block diagrams, equipment lists, rack elevations, wiring documentation, network requirements, and technical specifications.
  • Implement and maintain systems designs in NDOX, ensuring that design data, equipment information, system relationships, and documentation remain accurate and current.
  • Review engineering drawings, system designs, technical specifications, bills of materials, vendor submittals, and installation documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Perform design reviews and provide technical feedback to engineering teams, vendors, contractors, and project stakeholders.
  • Ensure that approved designs are implemented consistently during installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Design and support baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast systems using current industry practices and technologies.
  • Develop solutions incorporating SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast networking, routing, storage, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with broadcast engineering, operations, IT, networking, facilities, and vendors to validate requirements and ensure system interoperability.
  • Evaluate proposed technologies and equipment for technical suitability, lifecycle support, scalability, reliability, and alignment with engineering standards.
  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation and update NDOX records following system modifications, upgrades, migrations, and commissioning activities.
  • Participate in system testing, troubleshooting, acceptance reviews, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Support continuous improvement of design processes, documentation quality, and system lifecycle management.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Broadcast Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience designing, integrating, or supporting complex broadcast, media, audiovisual, or technical infrastructure systems.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast system architecture, signal flow, routing, synchronization, monitoring, control, and facility infrastructure.
  • Experience developing and reviewing detailed engineering documentation and technical drawings.
  • Experience defining or applying engineering standards, design criteria, documentation practices, and quality-control processes.
  • Experience working with systems databases, documentation platforms, or facilities engineering management tools; experience with NDOX is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with IP-based broadcast technologies, including SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, PTP, multicast, and networked media systems.
  • Experience designing baseband, IP, and hybrid broadcast environments.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control systems, media asset management, storage, automation, monitoring, and cloud-based media workflows.
  • Proficiency with technical design and documentation tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, Lucidchart, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of networking, VLANs, routing, switching, storage, cybersecurity principles, and system interoperability.
  • Experience reviewing vendor designs, submittals, installation drawings, test documentation, and as-built records.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Project coordination experience and PMP certification are preferred but not required.
