job.title: Social Media Audience Engagement Manager, LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations (FTS) owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations, including stations in 14 of the top 15 markets and duopolies in 11. Eighteen are FOX Network affiliates, and together the stations produce approximately 1,300 hours of local news every week. FOX LOCAL, the company's free ad-supported digital and streaming product, extends that news, weather and local content across connected TV & mobile devices. LiveNOW from FOX expands the FTS portfolio even further as the only national streaming services to be truly live 24/7, covering breaking news and events as they happen.

JOB DESCRIPTION

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for an Audience Engagement Manager to help define how live, breaking news reaches and resonates with audiences across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X—and whatever comes next.

As the Audience Engagement Manager, you will be at the center of our distribution strategy—focused on growing reach, deepening engagement, and unlocking new audiences through smart, platform-native storytelling. You’ll be a key partner to our editorial team—bringing news judgment, content presentation and platform expertise to how we show up on all social platforms.

Reporting to the VP of LiveNOW, you will serve as a motivating, credible partner who provides clear, actionable guidance grounded in data, and help the entire team elevate how we reach audiences. 

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead Multi-Platform Strategy

  • Own and evolve LiveNOW’s presence across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, and emerging platforms

  • Continuously evaluate where audiences are going—and ensure LiveNOW is showing up with purpose and impact

  • Shape how LiveNOW shows up in vertical video ecosystems (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

Win on YouTube

  • Drive strategy across live streams, long-form video, and Shorts

  • Guide content team on packaging, programming, and presentation—including titles, thumbnails, descriptions, and live decisions that drive reach and watch time

Bring Editorial Judgment to Social

  • Act as a trusted editorial voice in how breaking news is presented across platforms

  • Help team understand what works—and what doesn’t, balancing platform performance with journalistic integrity

  • Provide clear guardrails on tone, framing, and platform-appropriate storytelling

Drive Live & Real-Time Execution

  • Lead how we package and distribute live breaking news in the moment

  • Partner closely with the team and editorial leaders to make fast, informed decisions during major news events

Build Workflows That Scale

  • Establish efficient, repeatable workflows that make it easy for producers and hosts to execute strong social and YouTube content

  • Create clarity—so teams know what to do, when to do it, and why it matters

Coach, Motivate & Empower the Team

  • Serve as a trusted, motivating partner to hosts and producers—someone they rely on for smart, practical guidance

  • Lead through influence by delivering crisp, actionable recommendations backed by performance data

  • Equip the team with clear playbooks, best practices, and ongoing feedback that drive results

Turn Insights Into Action

  • Analyze performance across platforms and translate data into clear, digestible takeaways

  • Identify trends, test new ideas, and quickly scale what works across the team

  • Keep the team engaged with updated performance data on progress to KPI goals

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Experience leading successful digital audience growth strategies, including social media and YouTube, with emphasis on news content (live is a plus!)

  • Strong understanding of both editorial decision-making and platform performance

  • Deep knowledge of YouTube (live + VOD + Shorts) and social platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Threads

  • Proven ability to create or guide compelling, platform-native content, especially in live and vertical formats

  • Ability to build trust quickly and influence teams without direct authority

  • Strong communicator who can deliver clear, concise, and data-backed guidance

  • Experience building workflows, playbooks, or systems that scale across a team

  • Data-driven mindset with sharp editorial instincts

  • Curiosity for emerging platforms, news formats, and audience behaviors

Why LiveNOW from FOX

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

JOB DESCRIPTION

Red Seat Ventures partners with the world's top creators across multiple genres to grow and monetize their content — through advertising, subscription, live events, and beyond. We take a multiplatform approach spanning podcasting, video, FAST, and more, backed by our own proprietary tech stack including Supercast (subscription) and Speakeasy (hosting, distribution, and monetization).


Named after Ted Williams' longest home run at Fenway Park, RSV was built with a simple mandate: swing for the fences. Today, we're the fastest-growing creator network, backed by Tubi Media Group and Fox Corporation.


Position Overview

The Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations bridges the gap between sales strategy, technology, and data analytics. You will eliminate friction in the sales cycle by optimizing our revenue, building robust forecasting models, and maximizing inventory yield. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring close collaboration with Sales Leadership, Finance, and Account Executives (AEs) to align sales performance with our overarching financial targets.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Technology & Infrastructure

  • Optimize Systems & Maintain Data Integrity: Act as the system administrator to ensure clean data entry, accurate tracking, and seamless integration between platforms.
  • Automate Workflows: Design and deploy automated processes to reduce administrative tasks for the sales team.
  • Maintain and refine Account Executive (AE) coverage lists.

Forecasting & Pipeline Management

  • Build Models: Develop data-driven revenue forecasting models to provide executive leadership with predictable, forward-looking insights.
  • Sales Planning: Connect sales goals to pipeline, historical performance, product opportunity and forecast assumptions. 
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal stage to anticipate shifts in ad spend and market demand.
  • Guide Strategy: Turn pipeline data into actionable insights that help sales teams proactively address gaps in the revenue funnel.Investigate questions that are not readily answered by existing reports, distinguish signal from noise, and analyze performance by product, show, AE, account, advertiser, and campaign. Turn findings into decisions and follow-through.

Go-To-Market (GTM) Data & Analytics

  • Unified Dashboards: Build holistic reporting structures tracking performance by product (Video, YouTube, Audio, Direct Network, Programmatic). Also provide AEs and Leadership with customized reporting, dashboard and account spend analysis.
  • AE Specific Reporting: Create centralized dashboards for individual AEs to track weekly closed revenue and pipeline metrics, serving as the champion of the CRM.
  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Conduct revenue analysis, track year-over-year (YOY) account growth/declines, identify non-returning quarterly revenue, etc.
  • Business Planning: Formulate annual and year-end AE business plans using historical performance data to help FY planning in top down and bottoms up formats.
  • Build the capability to scale: Partner across departments to ensure processes, reporting, and technology support commercial decision-making. Help automate recurring analysis and establish repeatable practices as Red Seat Ventures grows.
  • Identify growth opportunities: Use client, advertiser, market, product, and pipeline data to identify untapped accounts, categories, agencies, products, and distribution opportunities. Develop options for where Sales could focus and how existing relationships could grow.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience: 5-7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Commercial Finance, ideally within media, digital advertising, or SaaS.
  • Analytical Skills: Mastery of Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools to synthesize messy data sets into clean, executive-ready charts.
  • Agility: Can answer ambiguous business questions and  work with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to turn analysis into action.

Preferred Skills

  • Industry Context: Deep understanding of the advertising sales industry and accounts lists; including the advertising ecosystem, specifically Podcasting, YouTube and Social.
  • Commercial Decision Influence: Experience with using data to influence sales planning, account prioritization, pricing, packaging, ratecards, yield, and revenue planning.
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex data trends to non-technical sales reps and executives alike.
  • CRM Expertise: Advanced, hands-on administration experience with Salesforce (building dashboards, custom objects, and reports).

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Integrated Media Specialist (Account Executive– Outside Sales)

Territory-Based | Hybrid | Client-Facing Market Role

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network Location: Outside Sales, territory-based role in Nashville, TN | Hybrid (Remote + In-territory + 1 day in-office)

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of USA TODAY Co., we help businesses grow by bringing together advanced marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of digital marketing and one of the most trusted media networks in the country—helping businesses connect with customers across the full marketing funnel.

You’ll partner with clients to understand their goals, build strategies that combine performance-driven digital solutions with the reach of the USA TODAY Network, and deliver measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to be part of a team that doesn’t just sell products. We bring together the right mix of solutions to drive real business growth.

About the Role

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is a consultative, relationship-driven sales position for someone who loves owning the full sales cycle—from net-new prospecting through long-term account growth—and who thrives in both hunting and managing client relationships.

In this role, you will actively hunt for net-new business, while also managing, growing, and expanding an ongoing book of clients. You’ll create tailored marketing strategies, guide businesses from first conversation through ongoing performance discussions, and continually identify opportunities to deepen partnerships over time. You’ll act as a trusted marketing partner—not a transactional seller—balancing new business development with retention, upsell, and account expansion to drive long-term client value.

Our Integrated Media Specialist role is partnered with a post-sales team that manages campaign performance, optimizes results, and prepares reporting. Additional support resources are available, including the Data and Insights team, Client Strategists, and other product-specific resources.

In your first 90 days, you’ll gain confidence in LocaliQ’s solutions, tools, and sales approach while building meaningful prospecting and discovery habits. By the end of this period, you’ll be owning your territory and sales cycle end-to-end, with the support and coaching needed to set you up for long-term success.

Why This Role Stands Out:

Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and strong earning potential

Contests, and recognition programs for top performers

Consultative, full-cycle sales role with ownership from first conversation through long-term account growth

Hybrid flexibility with autonomy to manage your schedule and territory

Strong onboarding, coaching, and sales enablement to support a successful ramp

Access to an extensive mix of digital and traditional marketing solutions, enabling consultative, end-to-end strategies tailored to each client’s growth objectives

Career progression into senior sales and leadership roles

Backed by marketing expertise, post-sale specialists, and industry-leading tools

What You Will Do

Build a consistent prospecting cadence using cold calls, email, social outreach, networking, and in-person or virtual meetings to develop a strong pipeline.

Manage and grow a territory by balancing new business development, client retention, and account expansion.

Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to understand business goals, marketing challenges, and growth opportunities.

Build and present data-informed digital and traditional marketing proposals that connect strategy, tactics, and budget to client goals.

Own the full sales cycle—from initial outreach through close—while maintaining accurate CRM activity, pipeline management, and forecasting.

Partner with internal account management, creative, and strategy teams to support strong client outcomes.

Stay engaged post-sale through reporting, optimization, and performance conversations that support renewals and continued growth.

Qualifications

3+ years of B2B sales experience with success in new business development, account growth, or business development roles (experience level may vary by market and role level; Recruiter to update).

Ability to run a full-cycle, consultative sales process—from discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.

Strong prospecting skills across phone, email, social, networking, and relationship-based outreach.

Experience using CRM and sales tools with disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.

Comfort learning and discussing digital marketing solutions such as search, social, display, and video (direct experience is a plus, not required).

Excellent communication skills, business curiosity, and the ability to build credibility with diverse clients and stakeholders, influencing decisions through clear data-driven recommendations.

Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office Suite, and AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity.

Valid driver’s license and vehicle insurance

Who Thrives Here

High performers in this role are resilient, self-motivated, strategic and creative minded and competitive, with a strong drive to outperform and continuously take on greater impact. They are coachable and highly self-directed, comfortable initiating outreach, staying organized, asking thoughtful questions, and using data and tools to work efficiently. Energized by real-time results, they handle rejection well and maintain full ownership of their performance and trajectory.

Benefits

We believe high performance should be recognized and supported through compensation, development, and real opportunity to grow your skills.

Competitive base salary + Uncapped commission opportunity

401(k) with company match

Career progression opportunities

Flexibility and autonomy in a hybrid/remote work environment

High-performance culture with recognition, incentives

Comprehensive health, dental & vision coverage options and more

Unlimited MTO time off, including paid holidays

job.title: Photographer/Videographer
job.description:
Photographer/Videographer

The Arizona Republic/azcentral.com, part of the USA TODAY NETWORK, is looking for an experienced and talented videographer/photographer to join our team.

We are a creative, innovative, hardworking group covering everything from breaking news, sports, and in-depth story projects. Our visuals team at The Arizona Republic and azcentral.com has won numerous Emmy Awards, countless regional, national, and international awards.

We are looking for a professional Videographer/Photographer with at least three years of journalism experience, who is a confident, creative, and proven leader who believes flexibility, adaptability, and creativity are crucial to success.  We offer many opportunities for experimentation, growth, and storytelling on our digital platforms. The candidate must be flexible, motivated, and respond effectively to creative feedback.

Responsibilities:

Create quality multimedia storytelling using photography, videography, and text that accurately informs, entertains, and engages our audience.

Use audience metrics to assist in making coverage decisions.

Demonstrate high command of techniques and sophisticated craftsmanship in photo/video storytelling and community engagement. Acts as a community watchdog in this area of expertise.

Collaborate and connect with the community through visual storytelling and outreach (social media, on camera, forums, community leadership, etc.)

Work with content coaches and other journalists to evaluate what works, what doesn't and develop ongoing plans to satisfy audience needs better. Work on special projects and perform editing of visuals when needed.

Promote company brand, brands of colleagues, and the institutional brand.

Knowledgeable, coachable, and receptive to constructive criticism.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or master’s degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Internship or previous experience in the job duties preferred.

Able to work early mornings, nights or weekends.

Experience with multimedia storytelling techniques on multiple platforms. Exceptional core photojournalism skills (reporting, photography, and videography.)

Ability to use basic and advanced computer programs, including but not limited to video editing software Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and Photo Mechanic.

Self-motivated and self-directed.

Strong industry knowledge.

Organizational skills.

Understanding of social media and how to respond and engage fan base on digital platforms.

Effective communicator; able to get along with diverse personalities.

Able to multi-task and excel under intense deadline pressure in a rapidly changing environment.

Strong time-management skills.

Writing, spelling, grammar and local style.

Command of media law and Principles of Ethical Conduct.

Application Instructions

We are eager to learn more about you and how you fit this role. When you apply, don’t limit your upload to a resume; show us what you’ve done. To do so, please submit the following, in this order:

Your resume – one to two pages.

A cover letter outlining how you would approach the role.

Links to no more than three published stories, writing samples.

Completing these steps will ensure that your application receives the highest consideration.

job.title: Press Operator I
job.description:
Press Operator I

Gannett Publishing Services

Wilmington, Delaware

“We have an opening for a highly motivated individual in the Gannett corporation at one of our regional print facilities.”

“It is a fast-paced manufacturing operation which would require basic mechanical and\or manufacturing skill sets” This position is Full Time and will offer $20 per hour based on work-related experience.

The Wilmington GPS group is looking for a full-time Press Operator I to assist with daily production on our Goss HO presses. The work includes working with a team to prepare the presses for production, operates the presses or any of their components, cleans the presses and the pressroom, maintains the mechanical readiness of the presses, and other duties as assigned.Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success:

·Optimum quality of printed products.

·Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.

·Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.

·A clean and safe working environment.

Requirements:

This position requires a high school education or equivalent. Three years’ experience in web offset printing is desirable, although production experience of any kind may be helpful.Mechanical ability and familiarity with computers is preferred. Candidates should have the ability to adapt to change, prioritize work, handle multiple tasks, remain flexible and interact with people while demonstrating patience.You must be able to lift/carry up to 100 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 2000 pounds. A press operator spends most working hours on his/her feet.In addition to long periods of standing, a press operator is required to climb stairs on the six-level press structure.Operators engaged in press maintenance and some cleaning activities will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl. They often work in confined areas. Color vision is required.

This position is full-time shift work, which may include scheduled nights, and weekends.

job.title: Press Operator II
job.description:
Press Operator IIGannett Publishing ServicesRockaway, NJ

The Rockaway Facility is looking for a full time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our double wide presses. Under the direction of press management & supervisors—the Press Operator Il is assigned to perform printing related tasks that may include, but are not limited to: working as Primary Ink setting or Folder operator, oversight of plate processing; spotting plates; reel set-up & operation; newsprint staging; roll preparation; CMYK ink setting; advanced press operational controls; equipment maintenance; and specified reporting.

Every member of the pressroom staff constantly strives to achieve the following goals, and the contribution of every press operator is necessary for success. The primary objective is to support efficient press operations as needed to achieve & maintain on-time production, product quality standards, low waste, and operational safety.

Optimum quality of printed products.Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.A clean and safe working environment.

Requirements:

Candidate must be proficient in Mitsubishi, Wifag or similar newspaper press operations and functions. Must have knowledge of printing techniques, understanding basic ink/water balance, press quality standards.

Read and layout press diagrams accurately to accommodate color demand while maintaining maximum labor and waste efficiencies. Must understand how to layout press runs, install leads, and switch angle bars.

Must be proficient in all reel room operations and procedures.

Must understand all reel functions including tensioning system, roll delivery systems, roll/butt diameter, candidates should have the ability to adapt to change, prioritize work, handle multiple tasks, remain flexible and interact with people while demonstrating patience.

Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and meet all deadlines.

Forklift and clamp truck certification a plus.

Must have solid organizational and computer skills including good working knowledge of general business and Microsoft software programs.

You must be able to lift/carry up to 75 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 2000 pounds. A press operator Il spends most working hours on his/her feet. In addition to extended periods of standing, a press operator is required to climb stairs on the six-level press structure. Operators engaged in press maintenance and some cleaning activities will be required to stoop, kneel, crouch and crawl. They often work in confined areas. Color vision is required.

This position is Full-time shift work, which may include scheduled nights, weekends, and holidays.

job.title: Sales Associate
job.description:
Sales Associate, Marketing Solutions

Position Summary

LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network are seeking a motivated, career-driven Sales Associate to join our Marketing Solutions team. This entry-level sales role serves as the foundation for future growth into Media Specialist and Account Executive positions.

The Sales Associate is responsible for generating new business opportunities, building prospect pipelines, supporting open territories, and securing qualified meetings for the sales organization. Working closely with sales leaders and account teams, this role plays a critical part in driving future revenue growth through proactive prospecting, lead generation, and customer engagement.

What You'll Do

Prospecting & Business Development

Conduct outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other lead-generation channels.

Research local businesses and identify potential advertising and marketing opportunities.

Build and maintain prospect lists utilizing Salesforce, market intelligence tools, and industry resources.

Schedule qualified discovery meetings for Media Specialists and Account Executives.

Support open territories and transitional account assignments through business development activities.

Create and develop new sales opportunities that contribute to territory growth.

Sales Activity & Pipeline Management

Execute daily activity plans designed to achieve prospecting, meeting, and opportunity goals.

Maintain accurate prospect, activity, and pipeline data within Salesforce.

Follow established sales processes for lead qualification and opportunity management.

Monitor and update prospecting campaigns and outreach efforts.

Research industries, customer needs, and competitive insights to support sales strategy.

Collaboration & Sales Support

Partner with Sales Managers, Media Specialists, Account Executives, and Account Coordinators to support business growth.

Ensure qualified opportunities are documented and transitioned effectively.

Participate in ongoing coaching, training, and professional development programs.

Collaborate cross-functionally to support exceptional customer experiences.

Customer Engagement

Serve as an initial point of contact for prospective customers.

Conduct basic needs assessments and qualification conversations.

Build professional relationships with local business decision makers.

Represent LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network with professionalism and integrity.

Qualifications

Required

Associate's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Strong customer service mindset.

Ability to learn new sales tools, platforms, and processes quickly.

Self-motivated with a desire to build a sales career.

Preferred

1-3 years of experience in sales, customer service, account support, business development, or related fields.

Experience using Salesforce or other CRM platforms.

Experience working in a deadline-driven environment.

Familiarity with digital marketing, advertising, media, or customer acquisition strategies.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

This position offers a structured pathway into a full-cycle sales career. You'll receive hands-on experience in prospecting, pipeline management, customer engagement, and sales strategy while working alongside experienced media sales professionals. Successful Sales Associates will develop the foundational skills needed to advance into Media Specialist and Account Executive opportunities.

Technology & Tools

Salesforce CRM

Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)

Sales engagement and prospecting tools

Market research and business intelligence platforms

Work Environment

Hybrid or remote work environment

Regular business hours

Occasional travel for meetings, training, and team events

Collaborative, growth-oriented sales culture

Why LocaliQ?

LocaliQ combines the strength of the USA TODAY Network with leading digital marketing technology, helping businesses attract, convert, and retain customers through innovative marketing solutions. As a Sales Associate, you'll gain exposure to digital advertising, search marketing, social media, programmatic advertising, SEO, AI-powered marketing technology, and more while building a rewarding career in media sales.

This role is ideal for competitive, curious, and coachable individuals looking to launch a career in consultative sales and digital marketing.

job.title: Sr. Account Manager, Executive Accounts
job.description:
The Sr. Account Manager role is responsible for building, maintaining, & growing relationships with clients by managing their advertising campaigns across multiple publishers/platforms (ex. search, display, social ads, O&O digital/print media etc.). The primary focus is ensuring our clients achieve & exceed their desired marketing goals through strategic campaign planning, and data analysis. As the Account Manager, you will act as the primary point of contact for client concerns and needs post-sales.

Must possess strong expertise in existing & emerging business marketing solutions, coupled with the ability to collaborate with our sales partners, post sales optimizers to identify opportunities, and effectively deliver solutions that maximize a client's ROI; are minimum expectations. In this dynamic role, a change-minded person will be crucial for effectively navigating the ever-evolving landscape of digital and traditional marketing concepts. Seamlessly, the AM will integrate with various teams and adapt to new challenges, ensuring that strategies remain agile and responsive to client needs.

Position Requirements:

Closely partner with sales team(s), in owning the client relationship by: building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, & delivering results against joint business objectives

Understand, manage, and anticipate client expectations, gain client alignment, and fully mobilize/engage partner teams against the aligned approach while maintaining a strong communicative relationship

Create a consistent open line of communication ensuring our value story & service successes are in parallel to a client's needs/goals via performance reviews (Weekly, Monthly, etc.)

Articulate media programs to devise appropriate strategies and campaign implementation plans

Ensure a highly consistent marketing message across paid search, organic presence, display, social media, and O&O digital/print marketing channels

Review day to day campaign performance in collaboration with post sales optimization counterparts, assess digital campaign trends, facilitate client advertising performance discussions, & identify proactively creative new advertising techniques to further our client’s digital marketing needs

Hold primary responsibility for communicating and collaborating with backend support resources including, but not limited to, various digital solutions and ad operations teams, focused on delivering and exceeding client objectives (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, As Needed)

Ability to quickly master business process, marketing, and technology concepts

Demonstrated expertise in customer relationship management

Mastery of key technologies and systems to review and advise on digital marketing campaigns

Advanced capabilities to effectively understand and speak toward digital advertising campaigns –Search, Display, Marketing Management Systems, traditional marketing endeavors etc.

Strong technical skills to recommend, assess, modify/adjust, & routinely improve marketing campaigns over their lifecycle

Attentive To Detail

2+ years of hands-on experience managing online/digital advertising campaigns

job.title: Sr. Database Engineer
job.description:
As a Database Engineer, you will help operate and improve the database systems that power LOCALiQ, running primarily in the cloud across MySQL, PostgreSQL, and BigQuery. You will partner closely with software engineers, data engineers, analysts, and data scientists to keep our data platforms fast, safe, and available as our products scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is curious about data challenges, comfortable operating production systems, and motivated to automate the work that shouldn't be done by hand. You'll have the support of a senior team while owning meaningful pieces of the platform yourself.

We are a fast-paced, product-led engineering organization building the next generation of digital marketing management systems in partnership with Google, Bing, Yahoo, Facebook, and Snap. If you are technical, analytical, and eager to build solutions that directly impact the business, we want to talk to you.

What You'll Do

· Design, build, and operate database systems on MySQL, PostgreSQL, and BigQuery, primarily on Google Cloud Platform.

· Maintain performance, availability, and security across LOCALiQ's production database estate.

· Ensure data safety and data integrity, including backup, recovery, and disaster recovery validation.

· Perform routine database operations such as upgrades, patching, schema changes, replication management, and capacity planning.

· Tune and troubleshoot slow queries, blocking, and replication issues alongside application teams.

· Review database changes to minimize deployment risk, and help teams design schemas and access patterns that scale.

· Automate recurring operational work through scripting, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Participate in a scheduled 24x7 on-call rotation shared with other team members.

Required Skills

· 3+ years of experience in a Database Engineer, Database Administrator, or similar role.

· Hands-on experience managing production database infrastructure in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

· Working knowledge of relational databases — MySQL and/or PostgreSQL — including administration, replication, and backup/recovery.

#LI-NR2

job.title: Warehouse Worker/Mailroom Inserter
job.description:
Warehouse Worker/Mailroom InserterThe Ledger, Lakeland$15.00 per hour The Ledger has immediate part-time openings for Mailroom Inserters. This is an entry-level position performing post-press-related packaging tasks.

Responsibilities:

Feed preprints into the insert machine hopper neatly and accurately.

Monitor the insert machine to reduce double inserts and/or skips so that all jackets have the correct inserts.

Remove completed bundles, weighing 10 to 50 pounds, and stack them neatly for the next step in packaging delivery.

Run and monitor press lines to ensure continuous production, proper setup, and timely output of finished products.

Apply product keys to the appropriate products and bundles on press lines, ensuring accuracy and alignment with production requirements.

Organize, stack, and stage products for shipping to support efficient loading and on-time distribution.

Label multiple pieces for mail distribution, ensuring accuracy and compliance with mailing requirements.

Perform general clean-up of papers, skids, and debris that accumulate during the workday.

Requirements:

High School Diploma/GED

Employees must have a high degree of safety awareness.

Above-average problem-solving skills are necessary to monitor and repair automatic inserting and collating equipment.

Requires physical dexterity to lift and move material. Must be able to stand for long periods of time and must be able to lift or pile newspaper products that vary in weight from 10 to 50 pounds or more at one time.

Must be able to change work assignments on short notice and be flexible in scheduling.

Position requires working in production areas while forklifts, pallet jacks, inserting, and related equipment are in use.

(Los Angeles, CA)

job.title: ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE REPRESENTATIVE - SHARED SERVICES
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

Job Summary/Description:

The Shared Services Accounts Receivable Representative is responsible for multiple Gray Media Markets Accounts Receivable functions while providing quality customer service to our markets daily.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Maintain the day-to-day payment posting for multiple markets.
• Opening, batching, and using a 10-key calculator to calculate each market’s daily check deposits.
• Maintaining a ticket queue for multiple markets to include research requests, adjustments, transfers, and refunds.
• Invoicing assigned markets on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
• Provide customer service using strong interpersonal, organizational, time management, and multitasking skills.
• Taking clear ownership of AR responsibilities and willingly offering to assist others.
• Partner with Director of AR, AR Manager, Team Leads, Accounting Managers, station personnel, and credit & collections to resolve issues promptly for any station.
• Cash sheet entries and accurate reconciliation of AR on a daily, weekly & monthly basis.
• Data analysis for accuracy of payments, adjustments, transfers, and billing.
• Manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Contribute to the growth of the company through a successful team.

Qualifications/Requirements: 

Attributes:
• Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Excel and Adobe
• Strong work ethic, initiative, and a level of cooperation that supports the team and broader AR department
• Detail-oriented and the ability to perform duties with an elevated level of accuracy
• Strong interpersonal skills (approachable, flexible, and dependable)
• Ability to work well in a team environment; yet be self-directed in workload and time management
• Ability to build and maintain cross-functional relationships
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Strong organizational skills

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people, go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references 

(Current employees who are interested in this position can apply through the Gray-TV UltiPro self-service portal.) 

SHARED SERVICES/Gray Media is a drug-free company 

Additional Info: 

Gray Media provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Gray Media complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Gray Media expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with Gray’s employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

job.description:

About KPHO/KTVK:

Home to 3TV, CBS 5, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona’s Family produces 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. 3TV is #1 in Arizona and one of the strongest independent stations in the country. Our CBS station is highly competitive in news and has top-rated sports and prime content. Our digital reach is also best-in-market—Azfamily.com leads the market in multi-platform unique users and is home to Arizona’s Family Originals (long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, nearing 2M downloads). Arizona’s Family Sports features premier properties, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and AIA state championships.

Job Summary/Description:  

We are seeking a decisive, high-energy, and exceptionally organized Assignment News Editor to help lead evening news-gathering operations. The ideal candidate is a galvanizing leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses impeccable news judgment, and maintains a calm, collected demeanor under the intense pressure of breaking news. As the central nervous system of our newsroom, you will coordinate our field crews, monitor breaking developments, and collaborate across digital and broadcast platforms to ensure our coverage is fast, accurate, and impactful.

Duties/Key Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

Editorial Leadership & News Judgment:
* Drive the Daily Agenda: Actively monitor scanner traffic, social media, wire services, public records, and viewer tips to identify compelling, original local stories.
* Daily Pitching & Collaboration: Attend daily editorial meetings and pitch story ideas for potential coverage.
* Decisive Prioritization: Exercise sharp, ethical news judgment to determine which stories merit coverage, dispatching crews efficiently to maximize impact.
* Galvanize the Team: Serve as an inspiring and motivating force in the newsroom, encouraging collaboration, high energy, and dedication to our community-first mission.

Operations & Breaking News Management:
* Strategic Logistics: Coordinate daily assignments, scheduling, and logistics for reporters, photographers, and multi-skilled journalists (MSJs).
* The Calm in the Storm: Maintain absolute composure and clear-headed decision-making during breaking news, guiding field crews safely and directing information flow with precision.
* Ability to Pivot: Adapt instantly as news conditions change, seamlessly shifting resources and re-prioritizing stories without losing organizational focus.
* Deadline Performance (A MUST): Demonstrate the ability to meet short deadlines, prioritize assignments, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously with a positive, can-do attitude.

Clear & Collaborative Communication:
* Cross-Platform Integration: Partner closely with Executive Producers, Digital/Streaming Leaders, and the Digital Team to ensure content is optimized for broadcast, web, and streaming platforms.
* Outside Relationship Building: Proactively build and maintain strong professional relationships with outside sources, including public information officers (PIOs), subject experts, and community leaders.
* Concise Dispatching: Deliver clear, brief, and actionable instructions to crews in the field and anchors in the studio.

Qualifications/Requirements:

Hard & Soft Skills:
* Experience: 2+ years of experience in a commercial newsroom (assignment desk, producing, or digital reporting preferred).
* Sharp News Judgment: Deep understanding of defamation laws, journalistic ethics, AP Style, and what makes a story impactful for local audiences.
* High-Volume Multitasking: Able to track multiple moving parts, crews, and short-term deadlines simultaneously under pressure.
* Calm & Collected: Possesses a naturally steady, reassuring presence that stabilizes the newsroom during high-stress breaking news cycles.
* Galvanizing Leadership Style: Known for rallying teams around a shared vision, mentoring emerging talent, and building a positive, collaborative newsroom culture.
* Exceptional Agility: High tolerance for ambiguity and a proven ability to pivot strategies in seconds when the situation demands.

Broadcast and Production Systems:

- Manage signal flow across SDI infrastructure, including routing, monitoring, and conversion systems.
- Work closely with production and news teams to resolve live on-air technical issues quickly and effectively
- Create and maintain clear system documentation and standard operating procedures

Information Technology and Networking:
- Work with the Regional IT manager to maintain Information technology and support users locally.
- Oversee VMware virtual machines, Windows servers, user workstations, and system backups in coordination with corporate IT
- Manage Active Directory, LAN/WAN-related hardware, and local network security
- Support newsroom systems, automation interfaces, and shared storage environments
- Maintain alignment with Gray Media corporate IT and broadcast technology initiatives
- Ensure proper cybersecurity practices and software updates across technical systems

Leadership and Collaboration:
- Serve as a key technical leader when the Chief Engineer is unavailable or off-site
- Promote proactive maintenance and continuous improvement within the department
- Communicate effectively with newsroom, production, and corporate personnel
- Maintain a calm, professional demeanor under pressure and during live operations

Qualifications/Requirements:

Desired Qualifications/Requirements:
- Working knowledge of Grass Valley switchers, Evertz, Imagine,& Grass Valley Routers, and ENPS
- Understanding of SDI signal flow, routing, audio distribution, and monitoring systems
- Experience with VMware virtual environments, Windows server, Active Directory, and system backups
- Knowledge of VLANs, routing, and network configuration within a broadcast plant
- Basic understanding of transmitters and RF fundamentals preferred
- Must be available for on-call support, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a proactive mindset
- Strong organizational and documentation skills with attention to detail
- Effective communication and vendor management skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a live production environment
- 5 or more years of experience in broadcast engineering and information technology

About WLUC:

WLUC has been a fixture in Upper Michigan for 70 years. The #1-rated WLUC is the market leader and an NBC affiliate. The younger FOX UP News is #2 in this competitive six-station market.

Job Summary/Description:  

Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who loves the thrill of keeping a complex system running smoothly? Do you thrive on the challenge of bridging the gap between traditional broadcasting and the future of media? We’re looking for a Broadcast/IT Maintenance Technician who isn't just looking for a job, but a chance to be the technical backbone of WLUC. Whether it’s ensuring our live streams are rock-solid or keeping our newsroom systems firing on all cylinders, you’ll be the one making sure the magic happens—across every screen.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Own the infrastructure: Install and maintain the video, audio, and computer systems that power our station, from server-based record systems to non-linear editors.
• Bridge the digital divide: Manage servers, network security, and network services to ensure our multi-platform content reaches our audience without a hitch.
• Support the storytellers: Provide direct technical support for the News Department, ensuring our reporters and anchors have the tools they need to win the day.
• Master the hardware: Take charge of PC hardware and software support, installing and repairing workstations on-site with precision and speed.
• Keep us on the air: Assist with the maintenance of transmitters, studio equipment, and Master Control to ensure our signal—and our reputation—stays strong.
• Secure our future: Apply regular security updates and develop a deep knowledge of facility-specific IT needs to keep us ahead of the curve.
• Manage the fleet: Help keep our team moving by scheduling vehicle maintenance and performing weekly inspections (because news happens everywhere).
• Maintain the environment: Handle general building maintenance and even assist with plowing at studio or transmitter locations when the U.P. weather gets "interesting."

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Technical foundation: An Associate’s degree in IT, electronics, or a computer-related field (you know your stuff).
• A "get it done" attitude: You’re a self-starter who can work efficiently without someone looking over your shoulder.
• Problem-solving prowess: You’re proficient at troubleshooting and can stay cool when the pressure is on and the clock is ticking.
• Digital fluency: Strong familiarity with Microsoft operating systems, Office, and core LAN/WAN networking technologies.
• Communication skills: You can explain technical issues to non-technical people without making it weird.
• Physical agility: You’re comfortable climbing a ladder (up to 10 feet).
• Flexibility: You understand that media is a 24/7 business and are ready to accommodate shift changes, including evenings and weekends.
• A team-first mindset: You’re dedicated to quality and love working with other departments to reach a common goal.
• A valid driver’s license

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 46 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency that offers national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KBTX:

KBTX Media operates the CBS and CW affiliates in Bryan-College Station, Texas, serving an 18-county area known as the Brazos Valley. For nearly 70 years, we’ve been the dominant choice for local news and entertainment. Our team produces nearly 40 hours of broadcast content each week, along with a constant presence online at KBTX.com.

KBTX is routinely recognized among the best in the state by organizations including the Associated Press, RTDNA and the Lone Star EMMY Chapter of the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences. The station has won four consecutive Texas Association of Broadcasters’ Bonner McLane Public Service awards, and in 2023 won a National Edward R. Murrow Award for Digital content. KBTX is also a recent Texas AP Broadcasters/Freedom of Information Foundation of Texas Station of the Year and Texas Associated Press Broadcasters Station of the Year.

The station has launched the careers of many well-known journalists, meteorologists and network executives, and takes pride in helping talent grow quickly into the nation’s largest television markets. The work family of KBTX is made up of a group of dedicated, professional and passionate individuals who are the backbone of our daily mission.
Bryan-College Station, Texas is a community of more than 250,000 people and the largest single metro in the Waco-Temple-Bryan DMA. The twin cities have a unique small town feeling, but offers big city amenities, including a vibrant arts community, a city-wide, all-terrain trail system, and world-class dining and nightlife. Bryan and College Station are routinely recognized as leaders in quality of life and as one of the fastest-growing communities in the country.

College Station is home to Texas A&M University, the nation’s largest university. Aggie home football games attract more than 100,000 in the stands, with tens of thousands more camped outside celebrating at tailgates during football weekends.
Learn more about KBTX at www.kbtx.com.

We are extremely passionate about our collegiate sports teams, including The Ohio State University Buckeyes, the University of Michigan Wolverines, the University of Toledo Rockets, and the Bowling Green University Falcons.

About WNEM:

At WNEM, it is our job and inherent desire to be the best local television station in the Mid- Michigan market and the #1 digital platform across the state, region, and the country. We are committed to the highest standards of excellence in our local news, entertainment, information, and public service programming.
We have the top-rated news station plus broadcast website. We are a Midsize market with opportunity to grow. We are a self-starting team driven for success with unique selling opportunities for a creative seller. Essential to that effort is a foundation of honesty and integrity — qualities which help us earn and build trust with our viewers, co-workers, and business partners.

Job Summary/Description:

WNEM is looking for a forward-thinking, high-energy Digital Content Manager to lead our growing digital operation and oversee the creation and publishing of content across all WNEM multimedia platforms. This role will drive audience engagement and expand CTV/streaming performance, while ensuring the station stays ahead of digital best practices and emerging trends—including SEO and social strategy.

As part of the newsroom leadership team, the Digital Content Manager helps deliver accurate, timely, and compelling content for a diverse audience. The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer and communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven newsroom.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Write and publish breaking and enterprise coverage across WNEM’s digital and various social platforms.
- Lead the collection and verification of user-generated content and produce enterprise/interactive storytelling, including interactive maps, infographics, special online streams, and CTV shows.
- Use analytics to monitor engagement, optimize video and story placement, and increase overall digital consumption.
- Expand CTV adoption and engagement by partnering with news and marketing teams to create and promote exclusive CTV content on platforms such as Roku, Amazon Fire TV, and Apple TV.
- Increase social referrals by developing engaging, shareable content that drives users back to WNEM’s owned and operated platforms.
- Track algorithm changes on platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok and adjust posting strategies as needed.
- Lead WNEM’s responsible AI strategy by developing ethical AI-use guidelines, evaluating and improving AI tools for content and engagement with human oversight, and staying current on AI trends to enhance content delivery, all in compliance with our company AI policy.
- Work with the digital team and other newsroom leaders to build and execute content plans, including regular reviews of successes and opportunities using digital analytics tools.
- Lead and coach a team of digital content creators, ensuring they are trained, supported, and meeting goals.
- Collaborate closely with reporters, producers, and newsroom staff to identify breaking news, trends, and features for digital distribution.
- Manage content flow by prioritizing coverage and monitoring all digital channels to ensure timely, accurate publication.
- Coordinate with marketing and promotions to align digital strategy with station-wide initiatives.

WKYT-TV is home to the CBS and CW affiliates in beautiful Lexington, KY. The station sits amongst picturesque horse farms in the Thoroughbred Capital of the World.

The Lexington DMA (#63) provides a competitive news environment, and WKYT has emerged as the news leader, producing over 11.5 hours of news per day. Our team of award-winning professionals thrives in a fast-paced, yet fun, environment.

Job Summary/Description:

WKYT in Lexington, Kentucky, is looking for a part-time weekend digital content producer for its award-winning and innovative digital platforms. We have all the tools for success and innovation in digital content: an outstanding, dedicated team in front of the camera and behind the scenes; live streaming capabilities with multiple live trucks and TVUs; access to a drone for enhancing coverage; and a podcasting studio.

This producer will help power both news and sports digital and social coverage on weekends — publishing breaking news fast, supporting game-night highlights/scores/recaps, and creating social-first video for station accounts.

Part-time: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, 2:00 p.m. – 10:30 p.m. (~25.5 hrs/week)

• Collaborate with news managers, producers, assignment editors, reporters, photographers, weather, and sports to anticipate content needs and execute coverage plans.
• Strengthen stories with clean writing, headlines, basic graphics/templates, research, and consistent station branding.
• Write clearly for multiple platforms under tight deadlines with strong editorial judgment, accuracy, and adherence to journalistic ethics and libel laws.
Schedule:
• Part-time: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, 2:00 p.m. – 10:30 p.m. (~25.5 hrs/week)
• Some holiday and late-night work may be required depending on sports/news coverage needs.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in journalism/communications or related field (or equivalent newsroom/digital experience).
• Must have consistent availability for Fri-Sun 2-10:30 p.m. schedule.
• Demonstrated ability to publish quickly and accurately on digital platforms (web + social).
• Comfortable editing short-form video; experience with in-app editing tools (IG/TikTok) strongly preferred.
• Experience with a newsroom CMS and basic video editing tools preferred; willingness to learn our editing system is required.
• Strong news judgment, clean writing, attention to detail, and calm decision-making under deadline pressure.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills; thrives in a fast-paced, team-driven environment. Passion for both news and sports coverage a plus.

About KLTV:

KLTV is the dominant station in the Tyler/Longview, TX area of East Texas. We are an ABC affiliate and have been #1 by every ratings measure, uninterrupted in every newscast for 30+ years. We also have a very powerful, dominant digital presence in the market. We are a leader in the industry in digital innovation and digital products--operating and populating 11 different apps and producing an 19-hour a 19-hour-a-day live streaming news service from our newsroom on OTT, desktop, and on our mobile apps.

Modern facility. Top-notch equipment. Experienced News Managers. Positive, encouraging workplace with an emphasis on teaching job skills and journalism. Dominant station preparing for the future in a very powerful company in this industry. We believe we are among the best newsrooms in the country.

Job Summary/Description:

This is a unique position. For the last nine years, KLTV/KTRE has operated a successful, live digital broadcast from our newsroom. Thousands watch each day as our hosts report news as it is breaking, live from our newsroom. East Texas Now is live, local news and talk 19 hours a day and in operation seven days a week. This is an established, mature streaming production that has served as the model for many others in the industry.

The hosts produce, present, and technically direct their shows every day using a special interface developed for and with the input of KLTV/KTRE. East Texas Now is live each day on desktop, mobile devices, in our apps, and on Amazon Fire and Roku OTT devices. East Texas Now even has its own dedicated app with integrated chat that allows viewers to interact with the host. If you can talk, love breaking news, and are technically inclined to multitask while talking in front of one of multiple cameras, this is an exciting, groundbreaking position.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Handle Breaking News
- Talk to reporters and news makers via FaceTime and Skype
- Self-direct the show
- Set up and coordinate guests for in-studio or remote appearances
- Plan content for each day
- Perform "live read" commercials from the East Texas Now desk
- Talk a lot!

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Competence in reporting live, online, and on air
- Reporting on digital platforms, often live via FaceTime or Skype
- Setting up guests and reporters
- Computer skills
- Position generally alternates schedules dayside/nightside weekly
- Experience in talk radio is a plus

Job Summary/Description:

In addition to the attention to detail required by an MCO, this position also requires a close working relationship with news producers to create and execute dynamic, fast-paced newscasts. About WSIL/KFVS:

KFVS/WSIL is the market-leading CBS/ABC/CW affiliate serving the Cape Girardeau, MO-Paducah, KY-Harrisburg, IL region. Heartland News delivers trusted coverage and First Alert Weather across America's Heartland. KFVS/WSIL delivers consistent results for our advertisers. In 2026, KFVS was named Missouri Medium Market Station of the Year.

Job Summary/Description:

An Engineering Supervisor is comfortable with RF broadcast equipment and transmitters, as well as IP-based newsgathering and IT infrastructure. You will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring our content reaches our community on every screen, every time.

Assist the Chief Engineer in directing our engineering, IT, and facilities teams to keep our stations performing at their best. Oversee installation and maintenance of equipment. Ensure safety and compliance. Bridge the gap between traditional broadcast and modern IP communication, making sure our content flows seamlessly across all platforms.

What You’ll Do:
· Lead the technical charge: Assist the Chief Engineer in directing our engineering, IT, and facilities teams to keep the station at the top of its game.
· Own the infrastructure: Oversee the installation and maintenance of everything from audio/video switchers to critical IT systems and RF equipment.
· Manage the daily grind: Help with management of a diverse team of engineers, IT pros, and technical media producers to ensure seamless 24/7 operations.
· Ensure safety and compliance: Serve as a guardian of our standards, potentially acting as the Safety Coordinator and ensuring we’re always in line with FCC and OSHA regulations.
· Drive digital integration: Bridge the gap between traditional broadcast and modern IP communication, making sure our content flows seamlessly across all platforms.
· Support the bottom line: Assist with the preparation and maintenance of the departmental budget to keep our technical operations running efficiently.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
· Broadcast expertise: You have 5+ years of experience in a broadcast engineering environment (field operations and IP news-gathering experience is a huge plus!).
· Technical versatility: You’re a pro with digital broadcast equipment—transmitters, encoders, automation systems, and audio consoles are your second language.
· A calm-under-pressure mindset: You can manage multiple tight deadlines and make clear, smart decisions when things get stressful or unexpected.
· Problem-solving DNA: You have a deep understanding of both serial and IP communication and a knack for project management.
· Educational foundation: A bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or IT is great, but we also value equivalent real-world experience that proves you know your stuff.
· Flexibility: You understand that news doesn’t stop at 5 PM; you’re ready to support a 24/7 operation, including occasional nights, weekends, and on-call shifts.
· A valid driver’s license: You’re ready to head to the transmitter site or into the field whenever the job calls.

Why You’ll Love It Here:
· Innovation at the core: You’ll work with cutting-edge technology in an environment that is constantly evolving to meet the needs of a multi-platform audience.
· Real community impact: Your work ensures that vital news and information reach our neighbors when they need it most.
· A supportive team: Join a group of passionate professionals who value scrappiness, empathy, and high-fives as much as technical precision.
· Growth opportunities: At Gray Media, we don’t just maintain equipment; we grow careers and invest in our people.

Ready to lead the future of broadcast technology? Let’s build something great together.

About WILX:

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy Award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

Job Summary/Description:

WILX-WSYM, the dominant news leader in Lansing, Michigan, is seeking an experienced, dynamic News Executive Producer/Anchor to lead and host “The 517 Report”, a new local newscast focused on the mid-Michigan market. This is a leadership role for a hands-on journalist who wants to shape a new program from the ground up, combining editorial leadership with a primary on-air presence. 

The ideal candidate will oversee all aspects of newscast production, manage the daily editorial workflow, and anchor the show. A key component of this role is conducting high-impact, live and pre-recorded interviews with local newsmakers, business leaders, and community voices on the most critical issues and events affecting viewers across Ingham, Jackson, Eaton, and Clinton counties. 

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

• Lead the editorial vision, content development, and production of a new local newscast focused on the Lansing and Jackson communities — ensuring high standards of journalism, production quality, and brand consistency.
• Oversee the daily editorial direction of the newscast. Collaborate closely with producers to shape daily content, review scripts, and deliver dynamic newscasts.
• Coach and mentor newsroom staff, providing constructive feedback.
• Anchor newscasts with high energy, credibility, authority, and a conversational delivery.
• Schedule, prepare, and conduct compelling in-depth interviews with local newsmakers, public officials, and community leaders on major issues.
• Pitch, research, write, and produce compelling local news stories.
• Deliver live reports from the field and in-studio during breaking news and severe weather events.
• Publish engaging, timely content to the station’s website, mobile app, and social media channels.

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 such markets measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 47 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KHNL:

KGMB (CBS), KHNL (NBC), and K5 collectively make up Hawaii News Now, the state's dominant multimedia news organization with the largest digital news footprint in the islands. The station is an award-winning station, rich with tradition and a history of earning National and Regional Murrow Awards as well as Emmy Awards and recognition of excellence. HNN's parent company is Gray TV, a leading digital media and broadcasting company. Located in beautiful Honolulu, Hawaii, Hawaii News Now also provides diverse sub-channels such as Telemundo, Antenna TV, Grit TV, This TV, Escape, and Bounce TV. If you love culture, diversity, and the aloha spirit, it's all here for you.

The Training Program:                              

General Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the role: Step into the shoes of a producer, MMJ, meteorologist, or media sales executive and handle real-world assignments (yes, the kind that may go on air and online).
  • Drive digital engagement: Create content that lives beyond the TV screen, think social media, streaming apps, and web stories because we’re digital-first, always.
  • Collaborate with pros: Work side-by-side with seasoned veterans who are the best in the business, gaining insights you won’t find in any textbook.
  • Commit to the craft: Dedicate 25 hours per week for 10 weeks to mastering your specialty and building a professional-grade portfolio.
  • Make an impact: Tell stories that matter to the community or help local businesses grow through innovative media strategies.
  • Build your future: Position yourself at the front of the line for full-time career opportunities within Gray Media’s network of 117 stations.

What You Bring:

  • Current enrollment: You’re a college student (Junior or Senior status preferred) chasing a degree in Journalism, Communications, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A "doer" mindset: You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty and take initiative; you’re here to work, not just watch.
  • Digital savvy: You understand that media happens everywhere, from the big screen to the palm of someone’s hand.
  • Strong work ethic: You bring urgency, organization, and a "can-do" attitude to every shift. 
  • Communication skills: You can tell a story, pitch an idea, or explain a forecast with clarity and confidence.
  • Reliability: You’re ready to commit to the full 10-week program and the 25-hour weekly schedule.
  • Passion for local: You care about the community and want to see how local media makes a real difference.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Real-world experience: You’ll graduate with more than just a line on your resume; you’ll have the experience of having done the job.
  • Unprecedented access: With 113 stations across the U.S., you’re part of a massive, innovative network that’s leading the future of media.
  • Career fast-track: We love hiring our own. This program is designed to be the ultimate audition for your first full-time role with Gray.
  • Paid training: Earn while you learn. This is a paid internship. 
  • A culture of innovation: We’re evolving on purpose, and you’ll be right there on the front lines of that evolution.

    Qualifications/Requirements:

    ▪️ Be currently enrolled in a college/university (preferred Junior/Senior)
    ▪️ Strong work ethic and organizational skills
    ▪️ College Student, junior or senior, earning a degree in Journalism/Communications, Business, Advertising/PR, Entertainment and Media Studios, or related fields, with a desire to get hands-on experience in the local media industry

job.title: INTERNSHIP/ HETS PARTNERSHIP - KFVS
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Gray Media, or Gray, is a multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. The company is the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 113 television markets that collectively reach approximately 36 percent of US television households. The portfolio includes 77 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second-highest-rated television station, as well as the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 45 markets totaling nearly 1.5 million Hispanic TV Households. The company also owns Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Gray's additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KFVS:

KFVS12 is the #1 local TV station serving as the CBS/CW/MeTV/Outlaw/Telemundo/Oxygen/GRIT affiliate in the Cape Girardeau, Missouri/Paducah, Kentucky/Harrisburg, Illinois market. Founded in 1954, KFVS12 has a rich heritage of serving "America's Heartland" with the best local news and weather information, along with a legacy of community service and disaster relief. KFVS12 produces more local news than any other station in the market, currently offering over 50 hours of news content every week, along with special high-profile, topical local programming. Heartland News on KFVS12 consistently leads the competition in award-winning journalism having been honored this year with numerous Missouri and Illinois Broadcasters' Awards as well as the prestigious Edward R. Murrow Awards.

The Cape Girardeau market covers 45 counties in four states and is home to four division-one universities. It is where the North meets the South and the East meets the West. The area is rich with many diverse communities, including historic riverfront towns, that offer a variety of unique benefits and recreational opportunities. It is also conveniently located for easy travel to St. Louis, Memphis, Nashville, and Chicago.

The station has an exceptional staff that is committed to maintaining the legacy of the institution of KFVS. They are forward-thinking with news coverage in on-air newscasts and 24/7 on numerous digital platforms, consistently leading the competition in digital traffic across the board. This provides exciting opportunities throughout the station including News, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and more.

Job Summary/Description:

KFVS is seeking applicants for bilingual interns in partnership with Southeast Missouri State University and three universities located in Puerto Rico that belong to the Hispanic Educational Technology Services (HETS) program. Applicants should be in their junior or senior year at a HETS partner University and willing to live in Cape Girardeau, Missouri for a semester while attending Southeast Missouri State University. These positions will teach producing, shooting, and editing skills while contributing and creating content for Spanish-speaking Gray Television outlets. Partnership Universities include:

  • Inter-American University – Universidad Inter American De Puerto Rico
  • Sacred Heart University -- Universidad Del Sagrado Carazon
  • Ana G. Mendez University – Universidad Ana G. Mendez

Qualifications/Requirements:

* Meet enrollment criteria above
* Train with digital producer to produce/write/edit for KFVS digital properties.
* Work with a photojournalist to learn camera operation basics.
* Shadow Multi-Media Journalist to learn how to shoot/write/edit news stories for broadcast and/or streaming.
* Translate relevant stories from English to Spanish for digital properties.
* Enrolled in a HETS-affiliated school.
* Proficient in English and Spanish.

*** Intern rate of pay can range from minimum wage in your state to $15 an hour ***

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

(Current employees who are interested in this position can apply through the Gray-TV UltiPro self-service portal)
