job.title: INVESTIGATIVE REPORTER/MMJ - WNDU
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WNDU:

WNDU boasts a history of more than 70 years and sits on the campus of the world-renowned University of Notre Dame. We cover northwest Indiana and southwest Michigan. We produce over 36 hours of live news each week and continue to expand our coverage. Our team is committed to the highest standards in news, entertainment, informational, and public service programming. Our viewers love having a major research university in their backyard, the history of a strong manufacturing sector, and a robust court system. They also demand accountability from those institutions. The stories are here. We need the right journalist to find the stories and tell them.

Job Summary/Description:

WNDU in South Bend, Indiana is looking for an Investigative Reporter/MMJ. You will dig. You will file records requests. You will work sources. You will gather documents. You will tell complex, consequential stories in ways that are clear, fair, and impossible to ignore. And you will do it across every platform, on air, online, and on social. This role is not just about producing lengthy series pieces; we expect you on air regularly as part of the 16 News Now team. When a breaking news story has an investigative angle, a document, a record, a source with context no one else has, we want you gathering and fronting that information, bringing depth and accountability to stories as they happen, not weeks later. If you have the chops and the experience, we want to hear from you; apply now.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

- Drive original daily investigative and enterprise reporting for WNDU. We need more than a long-form series. We want accountability journalism that shows up in every newscast.
- File and manage public records requests (FOIA, state open records) as a core reporting tool, not an afterthought.
- Use data, documents, and records to build stories from the ground up.
- Develop, cultivate, and protect confidential sources across government, law enforcement, business, and the community.
- Examine breaking and day-of news through an investigative lens - gathering records, sourcing context, and fronting stories that go deeper than the surface.
- Manage longer-form investigations simultaneously at different stages of development.
- Shoot, write, edit, and present your own stories as a full MMJ. Own the story from pitch to air. We do have photographers who will work with you, but you shouldn't be reliant on them for every story or shoot.
- Translate complex investigative findings into compelling, accessible content for broadcast, digital, and social audiences.
- Collaborate with editorial leadership on story development, legal review, and publication strategy.
- Uphold the highest standards of accuracy, fairness, and SPJ ethics - every story, every time.

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Proven investigative or accountability reporting experience; we want to see the work.
- A track record of using public records, data, or documents to break original stories.
- The ability to work at two speeds simultaneously: daily investigative hits AND longer-term series development.
- Strong on-camera presence and MMJ skills; you shoot, edit, and present your own material, and you are comfortable being a visible, recognizable face of the 16 News Now brand.
- Source development skills built over time; you have relationships, and you know how to build new ones.
- The ability to take a dense, document-heavy story and make it matter to a general audience.
- Unshakable ethical standards; you understand the weight of this work, and you handle it accordingly.
- Comfort with legal and editorial scrutiny; you document your reporting, and you stand behind it.
- Resilience: investigations get complicated, sources go cold, and stories take longer than expected, but you do not quit.
- Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to drive a company vehicle.
- A journalism-related degree is preferred, but not required; your body of work must speak for itself.
- Must be able to carry 35+ pounds of gear, and be experienced in shooting and editing unique content. We do have photographers to partner with on appropriate assignments.
- Familiarity with ENPS, Arc, and Edius is a plus, but not required.

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people,  go to https://gray.tv/careers#currentopenings, you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

About KCBD:

KCBD NewsChannel 11 is the NBC affiliate in Lubbock, Texas, and the dominant #1 station in the market. KCBD is the number one news station in the area and a great place to work; professional with a family environment. We operate 30 channels, including KCBD, KJTV, KXTQ, KLCW, and KMYL.

Job Summary/Description:  

Troubleshooting, maintaining, and installing studio and editing equipment, and installing and maintaining computer equipment. This is a Monday-Friday position, but occasional weekend and night shifts will be necessary. We do rotate on call weekly.
• Tanium experience is a plus.
• All engineering staff are on call 24/7 in case of an emergency.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

• Have good People Skills to work with the other Departments and personnel, along with the ability to fix any issue on the fly. Our engineering motto is no problem too big or small for us to handle.
• Have expert knowledge regarding equipment, IT technology, systems, and be able to step in and assist in emergencies.

KWTX News 10 is the CBS affiliate serving Central Texas. We're the news leader in our market, covering Waco, Temple, Killeen, Harker Heights, Copperas Cove, Bryan, and the surrounding communities across broadcast and digital. We're a Gray Media station, and we take our connection to this community seriously — and few things connect a community like Friday night football.

Job Summary/Description:

KWTX News 10 is looking for a Lead Reporter/MMJ to work evenings out of our Waco newsroom, with a focus on investigative reporting and breaking news. This role is for someone who already has sources across Central Texas and knows how to work them — someone who wants to break the story everyone else is chasing, not follow it. You'll turn daily content for all platforms, build original enterprise stories, and produce a monthly investigative report that's entirely your own. You'll also work directly with Gray's investigative team on original reporting for our market and take part in our late-night streaming shows. We're also looking for a leader. - Report and produce daily content across broadcast and digital platforms during evening shifts

- Shoot, write, and edit your own stories as an MMJ
- Cover breaking news as it happens, including live reporting from the scene
- Participate in KWTX's late-night streaming programming
- Serve as a mentor to newer reporters and MMJs in the newsroom, offering guidance on reporting, storytelling, and sourcing
- Maintain and grow a network of sources across Central Texas government, law enforcement, and community organizations
- Collaborate with the assignment desk and news leadership on story development and coverage planning

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Proven track record of investigative and enterprise reporting
- Strong, established sources across Central Texas or demonstrated ability to build them quickly
- Experience as a multimedia journalist — comfortable shooting, writing, and editing your own stories
- A bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field is preferred
- Excellent written and on-camera storytelling skills
- Understanding of and adherence to AP Style and broadcast writing standards
- Strong news judgment, sound editorial decision-making, and the ability to work independently
- Leadership qualities and a genuine interest in mentoring newer journalists
- Comfortable working evenings and appearing live for breaking news and streaming programming
- Valid driver's license and good driving record required
- Newsroom experience required; investigative reporting experience strongly preferred

WKYT-TV is home to the CBS and CW affiliates in beautiful Lexington, KY. The station sits amongst picturesque horse farms in the Thoroughbred Capital of the World.

The Lexington DMA (#63) provides a competitive news environment, and WKYT has emerged as the news leader, producing 11.5 hours of news per day. Our team of award-winning professionals thrives in a fast-paced, yet fun, environment.

Lexington is home to a thriving downtown scene, phenomenal restaurants and breweries, and, of course, Keeneland Race Course, the most beautiful horse track you'll ever visit. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a program produced by the station's news department. Technical Skills:

o Proficiency with digital CMS platforms for website publishing.

 Core Strengths:
o A proven self-starter with exceptional organizational and time-management skills.
o Excellent written and verbal communication, with an ability to work quickly and decisively under daily broadcast deadlines.

job.title: MEDIA EXECUTIVE - KSFY/KDLT (SIOUX FALLS)
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls and the surrounding area remain one of the fastest-growing regions in the Upper Midwest and are home to 300,000 people, constituting more than 30% of the state's population. Healthcare and finance make up much of a diverse and broad workforce. The business climate in South Dakota continues to be one of the top in the nation, fueled by no state income tax and a diverse workforce.

There is never a shortage of activities or events, with summers packed with outdoor festivals and concerts, including free concerts at the Levitt at the Falls outdoor music venue.

Still, many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails and parks, including the namesake of the city, the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! Yes, winters can be challenging, but it does not mean people hibernate. Colder temperatures provide plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. From parades like the annual Parade of Lights down Phillips Avenue to outdoor ice skating parks, life does not slow down in the winter in Sioux Falls.

The city is home to a 12,000-seat arena that is continually hosting major events and entertainment acts, ranging from the Professional Bull Riders, college and semi-professional hockey, indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Garth Brooks, and Elton John.

The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, an indoor ice-skating facility, a basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. Multiple award-winning golf courses, both public and private, surround the city, offering a relaxing and challenging day on the links

Culinary appetites never need to look far from being satiated, as there is no shortage of places to eat. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it’s also known for many great locally owned, nationally recognized restaurants and restaurateurs. For those looking for a quick weekend getaway, nothing to fear. You can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five. Since Sioux Falls is centrally located in the Midwest, direct and connecting flights to almost anywhere in the United States are often less than a few hours in length.

Dakota News Now is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a relatively new studio in downtown Sioux Falls, branding all stations under the Dakota News Now umbrella. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 36 hours of news each week.

Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It’s a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news and assisting local clientele in achieving their marketing goals.

Learn more about Dakota News Now & Sioux Falls here: https://www.dakotanewsnow.com/page/ksfykdlt-careers/

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who sees a complex technical glitch and thinks, "Challenge accepted"? Do you dream in gigabytes and broadcast frequencies, and thrive on the adrenaline of keeping a 24/7 operation running flawlessly? We’re looking for a Media Systems Engineer to be the technological heartbeat of our central and western Nebraska stations. Whether it’s maintaining massive tower sites or ensuring a live stream hits every phone in the state, you’ll be the wizard behind the curtain, making sure our communities stay connected and informed.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

• Master the infrastructure: Maintain and evolve broadcast systems across Hastings, Grand Island, North Platte, and every tower site in between (yes, you’re the guardian of the signal!).

• Monitor the pulse: Keep a close eye on multiple air channels and transmitters, ensuring our "on-air" product is always high-quality and high-definition.
• Bridge the IT gap: Use your deep knowledge of server and desktop operating systems to keep our newsgathering, weather, and graphic systems running at peak performance.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• The Foundation: An engineering or electronics degree (or equivalent experience) plus 2-3 years in the broadcast or professional tech world.
• Digital Fluency: You’re a pro with IP-based video/audio transport and streaming technologies—you know the future of media is multi-platform.
• Cool Under Pressure: When the "On Air" light is red, and something breaks, you’re the calmest person in the room.
• A Strategic Mindset: You’re detail-oriented, self-motivated, and always thinking two steps ahead of the next technical update.
• Communication Skills: You can explain complex tech to a non-technical producer without breaking a sweat.
• Road Warrior Spirit: You’ve got a clean driving record and are ready to hop in a company vehicle to support our Nebraska properties (with the occasional overnight stay).
• 24/7 Readiness: You understand that news doesn’t stop at 5:00 PM and are ready to support a round-the-clock operation.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who sees a storm on the horizon and immediately starts thinking about how to explain the "why" and "when" to your neighbors? WHSV is looking for a high-energy Meteorologist to join our award-winning First Alert Weather Team in the beautiful Shenandoah Valley. This isn't just about reading the models; it’s about owning the weather narrative across every platform—from our weekend evening newscasts to the palm of our viewers' hands.

- Independence and teamwork: You can crush a solo shift but also thrive in a collaborative "weather center" environment. You bring a positive attitude to our team's strong work culture.
- Technical chops: You know your way around weather graphics systems and are ready to push the limits of what they can do.
- Urgency and calm: You handle severe weather with the perfect mix of "get-to-the-basement" urgency and "I’ve got this" authority while being able to make decisions quickly.

Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KSFY/KDLT:

Sioux Falls is one of the fastest-growing cities in the Upper Midwest and is home to more than 220,000 people. Healthcare and finance make up much of the workforce in Sioux Falls. There is never a shortage of things to do here. Summers are packed with outdoor festivals and concert events. Many also enjoy the city’s nearly 30 miles of bike trails; be sure to stop by the beautiful waterfalls of the Big Sioux River! And winter doesn’t mean people hibernate; there are plenty of outdoor and indoor activities all winter long. In 2014, the city built a 12,000 seat area that has hosted everything from PBR events, hockey and indoor football, to concerts with names like Paul McCartney, Carrie Underwood and Elton John. The city is also home to a new indoor aquatic center, indoor ice skating facility, basketball arena, and an indoor tennis complex. There is no shortage of places to eat either. Not only is Sioux Falls home to many familiar restaurant chains, but it’s also known for many great locally-owned restaurants. And if you want to get away for the weekend, you can drive to Omaha in three hours, Minneapolis in four, and the Black Hills in five.

KSFY/KDLT is an award-winning television operation serving viewers in the eastern half of South Dakota as well as portions of southwest Minnesota and northwest Iowa. The stations operate from a new studio in downtown Sioux Falls as one rebranded organization called Dakota News Now. The facilities put Dakota News Now on the cutting edge of television and news gathering technology, making it one of the most state-of-the-art television stations in the market and the region. The Dakota News Now team produces 36 hours of news each week. Some of our employees have been here for more than 25 years. For others, this is their first job out of college. It’s a great mix that gives us different perspectives while covering the news. People here enjoy the work they do, and everyone steps up to the plate during major news events like breaking news and severe weather.

Learn more about Dakota News Now & Sioux Falls here: https://www.dakotanewsnow.com/page/ksfykdlt-careers/

- Analyze raw scientific data, models, and other available and relevant information to create an accurate weather forecast for our viewing area
- Create a compelling, conversational presentation of the weather forecast for broadcast, streaming, digital, and social media audiences
- Develop digital-first weather content
- Accurately forecast and track severe weather

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Bachelor of Science in Meteorology or a related field is required.
- On-air experience is preferred, but we are willing to train the right candidate.

About KNOP:

• The Ultimate Training Ground: North Platte is the best-kept secret for career growth. You will learn more here in one year than you would in three years elsewhere because you get to touch every part of the operation.
• Real Impact: In a market like ours, your work is seen and felt immediately. You aren't just a number; you are a vital part of the community's daily life.
• Outdoor & Community Life: Enjoy the authentic Nebraska lifestyle, from incredible outdoor recreation to spectacular community theater and music, all while working in a newsroom that feels like family.

Job Summary/Description:

Be a journalist who can truly do it all! We’re looking for a high-energy, multi-talented storyteller to join KNOP-TV in North Platte, Nebraska. This isn't a "stay in your lane" kind of job. From the anchor desk to the sidelines, and from breaking news to live weather updates, you will master every facet of modern media across broadcast and streaming platforms.

• A "get it done" attitude: You’re excited by the idea of doing everything—news, weather, and sports—and you thrive on the variety of a small-market newsroom.
• Screen presence: Whether you’re behind the anchor desk or live on a smartphone in the field, you bring charisma, clarity, and a digital-first mindset.
• Technical curiosity: You’re ready to master ENG gear, non-linear editing (Edius), and newsroom systems (ENPS) to produce professional content on tight deadlines.
• Storytelling chops: You have a degree in journalism (or equivalent experience) and a passion for finding the "why" behind every story.
• Composure under pressure: When news breaks, you’re the calm in the storm, able to synthesize facts quickly and go live at a moment’s notice.
• Community heart: You’re genuinely curious about the people of Nebraska and want to make a real impact in a tight-knit, supportive environment.
• The basics: A valid driver’s license and a clean driving record are a must for this mobile role.

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy Award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

• Represent the station professionally at community events and station initiatives.
• Maintain a collaborative, team-first attitude in the newsroom.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• At least two years of professional television news anchoring and reporting experience.
• Strong news judgment and excellent writing skills for on-air and digital platforms.
• Excellent on-air presence, exceptional ad-libbing skills, and a calm, decisive demeanor during live breaking news and unscripted coverage.

We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

Job Summary/Description:

The ideal candidate must be a newsroom leader who brings strong editorial instincts, collaborates effectively with the morning news team, and excels at reporting. Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

About KEYC:

Since 1960, KEYC-TV/KMNF-CD have succeeded with a culture that values skills, encourages creativity, and fosters professional growth.

Enjoy all four seasons in the booming Greater Mankato metropolitan area. The friendly, welcoming region is a happy mix of city and country living. We maintain the most highly visited social media sites in southern Minnesota.

Job Summary/Description:  

KEYC News Now is searching for that rare talent who can not only chase down a story but also command the anchor desk and produce a killer newscast. If you're a storyteller who thrives on urgency, connects deeply with people, and sees every platform—from broadcast to TikTok—as an opportunity to inform, then get ready to make your mark. We're talking about owning the news from concept to air (and online!), delivering content that truly resonates with our viewers.

Ready to report and help anchor for a station that truly impacts its community? We want to hear from you!

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

What You'll Do:
* Create compelling content: Report, shoot, write, voice, and edit daily news stories for both television and our buzzing digital platforms, making sure every piece is relevant and engaging.
* Lead the newscast: Anchor and produce dynamic newscasts as needed, bringing energy and authority to every broadcast and ensuring our viewers are informed and connected.
* Own the story cycle: From generating 3+ fresh story ideas daily to breaking news live on location, you'll be the force driving our local coverage.
* Drive digital engagement: Master social media and online news production, updating our website and social accounts throughout the day with urgency and immediacy.
* Connect with the community: Build authentic relationships and truly "think like a viewer," delivering news that matters most to the local community.
* Collaborate seamlessly: Work hand-in-hand with the news team, bringing a great attitude and leadership skills to every shift, even when schedules shift.
* Uphold our standards: Adhere to the highest standards of news judgment, ethics, and station branding in all content you create.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
* A Bachelor's Degree in Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field—you've got the foundation.
* Proven broadcast journalism experience: You know the rhythm of a newsroom and the demands of live television.
* Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills: You craft balanced, clear, and concise copy that grabs attention.
* A true digital-first mindset: You don't just understand digital/social media strategy; you execute it with urgency.
* Sharp news judgment and unwavering ethics: You know what's important and how to tell the story responsibly.
* The grit to go get the story: Able to carry 35-45 pounds of ENG equipment and ready to cover anything from features to breaking news.
* Impeccable time management skills and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines.
* Integrity, accountability, and a team-player attitude—you make the newsroom better.
* A valid driver's license and a clean driving record—you're ready to hit the road when news breaks.
* Flexibility to work various schedules, as news doesn't always keep regular hours.

Why You'll Love It Here:
* Multi-faceted impact: This isn't just a job; it's a chance to truly shape local news across all platforms.
* Community connection: You'll be at the forefront of stories that matter, building real relationships within the KEYC News Now community.
* Dynamic environment: One day you're digging deep into a feature, the next you're live on breaking news. Every day is different, and every day is exciting.
* Competitive compensation: We offer a salary/wage of $20-23 per hour (DOE), reflecting your valuable experience and versatility.
* Be part of the future: Gray Media is committed to innovation, and you'll be a key player in how we deliver news in a digital-first world.

WEAU is hiring a dynamic, deadline-driven Multimedia Journalist based in our La Crosse Bureau. This position is for a journalist who can operate independently, generate daily story ideas, and build the relationships needed to own coverage in the La Crosse area. You’ll produce accurate, viewer-focused reporting for our newscasts and digital platforms, with an emphasis on trust, transparency, and fairness.

WEAU News is the dominant news organization serving western Wisconsin. We are committed to earning and keeping the public’s trust through accurate, transparent, and unbiased journalism. We deliver essential local news across every platform our audience uses — digital, mobile, streaming, and broadcast — and we take that responsibility seriously.

Job Summary/Description:  

WEAU News is hiring an evening anchor to help lead a digital-first newsroom serving Eau Claire, La Crosse, and western Wisconsin. Our goal is to be the premier multi-platform news organization in the state, putting streaming, on-demand video, mobile alerts, and social media at the center of how our audience connects with us.
The most valuable trait for this role is ownership. When news breaks, we expect our anchors to ensure WEAU owns the story with speed, accuracy, and strong news judgment across all platforms. This is a high-visibility role that demands excellence, adaptability, and unwavering editorial integrity.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Storytelling & Digital Execution (Primary Focus):
• Write for Different Platforms: Write clear, accurate, and engaging copy adapted specifically for each platform, seamlessly shifting styles between broadcast scripts, in-depth web articles, quick-strike push alerts, and social media.
• Digital-First Storytelling: Commit to immediate digital delivery, including creating platform-native vertical videos, mobile-optimized clips, and real-time text updates during active news events.
• Audience-Focused Engagement: Publish stories, video clips, and breaking developments to the station website, app, and social channels with compelling, attention-getting framing that avoids clickbait and maintains our high standards of trust.
• Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Apply strong SEO best practices, including keyword optimization, clear headline writing, and metadata tagging to maximize the reach and searchability of our local reporting.
• Collaboration: Work closely with digital producers and editors to ensure accuracy, speed, and editorial integrity online.

On-Air & Streaming Performance:
• Anchor afternoon and evening newscasts, breaking news cut-ins, and streaming segments with consistent quality.
• Conduct compelling, live interviews with newsmakers, experts, and community leaders across both broadcast and digital platforms.
• Pivot seamlessly during breaking news, delivering timely updates for streaming, mobile alerts, and social media feeds.
• Maintain a professional, credible, and engaging on-air presence tailored to each distribution platform.

Newscast Production & Story Development:
• Collaborate with producers on story selection, rundown stacking, and digital-first coverage plans.
• Pitch and develop unique local stories that resonate in mobile, social, and streaming environments.
• Participate in daily editorial meetings with a sharp focus on multiplatform distribution.

About KPHO/KTVK:

Home to 3TV, CBS 5, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona’s Family produces 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. 3TV is #1 in Arizona and one of the strongest independent stations in the country. Our CBS station is highly competitive in news and has top-rated sports and prime content. Our digital reach is also best-in-market—Azfamily.com leads the market in multi-platform unique users and is home to Arizona’s Family Originals (long-form programs, documentaries, docuseries, and podcasts, including True Crime Arizona, nearing 2M downloads). Arizona’s Family Sports features premier properties, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and AIA state championships.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who actually loves the thrill of morning news? Do you thrive on the adrenaline of uncovering exclusive content and the challenge of bringing it to life with demonstrative, high-energy live shots? We’re looking for a Weekend Morning Anchor/Reporter who doesn’t just read the news—you own it. Whether you’re leading the desk on Saturday & Sunday mornings or reporting live from the field with a "show-don't-tell" mindset, you’ll be the face of the best morning show in Arizona. This isn't just a seat at a desk; it’s a multi-platform partnership where you’ll also have the chance to step into the spotlight as a fill-in host for our streaming shows.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do:
• Lead the morning conversation: Anchor weekend morning newscasts with energy, authenticity, and a conversational style that makes viewers feel like they’re waking up with a friend.
• Master the live shot: Deliver demonstrative, active live reports that take the audience to the heart of the story—no "standing in front of a building" here!
• Own the digital space: Engage our audience across all platforms, from social media updates to hosting live Q&A segments and filling in on our streaming shows.
• Drive the editorial engine: Be a newsroom leader who pitches original, promotable story ideas and collaborates deeply with producers to craft a winning show.
• Connect with the community: Get out from behind the desk to build real relationships with news sources and represent the station at local events (yes, you’ll be a local celebrity!).
• Craft compelling narratives: Research, write, and edit in-depth content, including hard news, features, and mini-documentaries that matter to Arizona.

What You Bring:
• A "Morning Person" mindset: You bring the energy even before the sun comes up (and you know how to make it look easy).
• Killer live skills: You’re a pro at field anchoring and can handle the unpredictability of live TV with authority and calm.
• Digital-first curiosity: You’re constantly engaged in the news cycle and know how to pivot your storytelling for streaming and social platforms.

Home to CBS 5, 3TV, and Arizona’s Family Sports, Arizona's Family produces more than 100+ hours of local news and programming every week. And the reach of Arizona's Family doesn't stop with linear television. Azfamily.com is the market's top performer in local multi-platform unique users. It is also home to Arizona's Family Originals. Arizona’s Family Sports is home to the state’s premier sports franchises, including the Arizona Cardinals, Phoenix Suns, Phoenix Mercury, Phoenix Rising, and the Arizona Interscholastic Association high school state championships.

Job Summary/Description:

Can you tell a story that stops a scroll and commands a screen? Are you the kind of editor who lives for the adrenaline of a breaking news cycle and knows exactly how to turn raw footage into a powerful, high-impact narrative? Arizona’s Family is looking for a high-energy News Video Editor to join our team in Phoenix. We don’t just "cut tape" here—we craft visual experiences across broadcast, social, and digital platforms that empower Arizonans to live their best lives. If you’re a technical wizard with a creative soul and a "get it done" attitude, we want to see your reel.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

What You'll Do:
• Craft compelling narratives: Edit high-impact video for daily news, investigative pieces, and special projects across all platforms (TV, web, and social).
• Manage the feed: Acquire and route video feeds from satellite, microwave, and backpacks, ensuring our field crews are always ready for air.
• Master the workflow: Work closely with the Chief News Editor to keep our content management and archive systems running like a well-oiled machine.
• Collaborate in real-time: Communicate with control rooms and field crews with urgency and precision to execute flawless live broadcasts.

What You Bring:
• Non-linear expertise: You’re a pro with modern editing software and understand the technical nuances of digital workflows.
• News-first mindset: You understand the urgency of a newsroom and can pivot from a breaking news clip to a long-form feature without missing a beat.
• Visual storytelling chops: You have an "eye" for great shots and an "ear" for perfect pacing that keeps viewers engaged.
• Digital fluency: You understand what makes a video go viral and how to optimize news content for different social platforms.
• Grace under pressure: You thrive in a fast-paced, high-stress environment and never miss a deadline (even when the clock is ticking down).
• Technical savvy: Familiarity with receiving feeds and managing assets in a content management system.
• Team-first attitude: You’re a communicator who lifts the team and is always looking for ways to improve the final product.

Why You'll Love It Here:
• Be a part of a powerhouse: Work for Arizona’s most-watched station and a leader in multi-platform innovation.
• Real community impact: Your work helps raise millions for local charities and powers movements like our Surprise Squad.
• Creative freedom: We value "scrappiness" and digital-first thinking—if you have a great idea for a social edit, we want to hear it.
• Growth opportunities: At Gray Media, we focus on the training and development of the best and brightest in the business.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• High School diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism/Production, Communications, or equivalent experience preferred
• Two years’ experience working as a news video editor in a television news environment preferred
• Strong understanding of non-linear editing
• Familiarity with receiving video feeds from satellite, microwave, backpack, and other transmission sources preferred
• Must be able to work accurately in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while consistently meeting deadlines
• Must possess an understanding of current journalism standards
• Strong technical and organizational skills

Ready to create something amazing with Arizona's Family? Let's talk.

WTVG is located in Northwestern Ohio. Our viewers and customers are extremely friendly and down-to-earth. We are a region of proud automotive workers home to several manufacturing plants. We are extremely passionate about our collegiate sports teams, including The Ohio State University Buckeyes, the University of Michigan Wolverines, the University of Toledo Rockets, and the Bowling Green University Falcons.

We enjoy all four seasons and the activities that come with each. Nature is always a short distance away, with many surrounding parks and Lake Erie for recreation. The roller coaster capital of the world, Cedar Point, is just a short drive from the television station. We have two minor league sports teams. Since 1948, generations of families have grown up counting on WTVG to be a window to their world on-air and now digitally. There is a culture within our walls that recognizes the responsibility we carry to continue what was started seventy years ago. We take pride in our ratings, our content, our status, and the need to maintain the work ethic that got us to where we are.

There has always been a family atmosphere at WTVG. We care about each other, and know that we are stronger as one team than as many individuals. We take our jobs seriously, and know that we can be successful and have fun at the same time.

Now let our team tell you why our viewers say “This Is Home.”

WMTV is the NBC and CW affiliate headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin. We work hard and take pride in getting it right!

Our producers are true newsroom leaders. You will contribute daily to elevating our newscasts and will be an ambassador—championing our community initiatives. We are consistently recognized for serving our communities through initiatives like the WMTV Diaper Drive, our Share Your Holidays campaign benefiting Second Harvest Foodbank of Southern Wisconsin, and Take Your Brat To Work Day—the original, drive-through fundraising event.

Join our award-winning team and live, work, and play in a community that is consistently named one of the best places to live in America. We are just 1.5 hours from Milwaukee, 2.5 hours from Chicago, and 5 hours from Minneapolis/St. Paul.

Job Description/Summary:

Are you a news junkie who thrives on the rush of a ticking clock? Do you love making a complex story click, whether it is on a living room TV or a phone? WMTV 15 News wants a high-energy, digital-first Newscast Producer to join our award-winning team. You will be our utility player: own evening newscasts on-air or streaming, lead your own streaming show, and jump in to help across the week.

Duties/Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

You will be our utility player: own evening newscasts on-air or streaming, lead your own streaming show, and jump in to help across the week. WMTV 15 News is redefining local news across every screen in vibrant Madison, a capital city and college town where your work truly matters every day. At WMTV, you get hands-on training and the career mobility of Gray Media; this is a place to grow fast while helping build the future.

- Own breaking news: Act with urgency, send push alerts, launch live streams, update WMTV15News.com as news breaks

- Partner with leadership: Report to and work with News Director and Executive Producer to execute digital-first strategy

- Time management: Work quickly with accuracy, multitask and prioritize

Successful candidates will have solid news judgment and a working foundation of producing basics. Together, we break local news on our website, push it on social, and add context & emotion on television. Writing is at the core of the position, and you’ll be expected to seamlessly move between formats.

As a producer, you're expected to be more than a show-stacker. Our producers embrace advanced concepts of aggressive showcasing and hungry rundowns while boothing, adding "happening now" live content and real-time social interaction to newscasts.

- Selects, showcases & writes local, regional, national & international content for newscast presentations.
- Makes graphics, maps & lower thirds for all stories.
- Collaborates with directors for clean production to increase studio storytelling
- Writes copy for web and edits video for playback
- Edits video for newscasts
- Communicates with newsmakers and fields inquiries from viewers

Qualifications/Requirements:

- Two years of newscast producing experience helpful. Also needed:
- A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate
- An internship in a commercial newsroom
- A degree or intensive coursework in communications and/or journalism
- Knowledge of video editing and scripting software

Gray's Digital Content Center and strategy team provides national content and strategic guidance to 120+ markets across the U.S. to drive audience on web, connected TV, news and weather apps, and social media distribution channels.

Job Summary/Description:

Gray Media is looking for confident, creative, and innovative digital content leaders to work with our newsrooms to grow their audiences and brands using digital, connected TV, and social media platforms.

The RDD's job is to ensure quality local content has effective production and distribution strategies to serve and grow our local audiences.

You will consult with newsrooms on how to best serve their local audiences on CTV, websites, mobile apps, and social media accounts.

Successful candidates will have demonstrated exceptional growth through years of digital-focused newsroom leadership experience. You will develop strategy and tactics to help formulate long-term digital playbooks for newsrooms in markets of all sizes.

You will become well-versed in the consumption trends of the audiences in your region to provide timely recommendations.

The Regional Digital Director will work remotely in any Gray Media market and will be a key part of our leadership team in hitting key audience and revenue targets.

• Constant communication with newsrooms under your regional purview
• Daily monitoring of station digital metrics to drive strategic recommendations
• Key focus on increasing total watch time across your region for station-owned CTV apps
• Regular monitoring of station social media execution for alignment with best practices
• Develop and lead best practice trainings and follow-up implementation
• Serve as a hands-on strategist during breaking news and severe weather
• Facilitate regional collaboration in strategic geographic areas for big stories and events
• Coach digital leaders and teams to strengthen the pipeline
• Partner with general managers and news directors to execute digital excellence

Qualifications/Requirements:

• 10+ years of television/digital media content production experience
• 5+ years of newsroom management/leadership experience
• Proven aptitude in using content management systems
• Demonstrated experience with driving audience via social media and search
• Demonstrated experience with growing consumption on CTV
• Ambition to help local stations excel on every digital platform

It is the market’s top-rated broadcast television station, a digital publisher reaching tens of millions of users each year, and the home of GDM Columbia, a full-service in-house digital advertising agency with national scale. Columbia, South Carolina, is a vibrant and growing capital city with a diverse population. WIS is located downtown, just two blocks from the South Carolina Statehouse.

Our community combines affordable quality of living with a variety of entertainment and activities to accommodate your lifestyle, whether it's our 50,000-acre Lake Murray, our Columbia Fireflies minor league baseball team, the Riverbanks Zoo & Gardens, nearby Congaree National Park, and so much more.

job.title: SPORTS REPORTER AND ANCHOR - WILX
job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About WILX:

Gray Media Lansing (WILX-WSYM) News 10, home of the highly rated NBC and FOX affiliates in Lansing, Michigan, is on a dynamic growth trajectory. Our combined operations produce over 50 hours of local news per week—and counting. We are Mid-Michigan's undisputed media leader, home to Emmy-award-winning journalists, the Michigan Association of Broadcasters’ “Station of the Year,” your exclusive home for the Detroit Lions on FOX 47, and home to Studio 10, our popular daily local lifestyle show. Alongside our powerhouse primary stations, our family of channels includes MeTV (10.2) and the regional Great Lakes Sports & Entertainment Network (47.2).

Beyond traditional broadcast, we are a true 24/7 multi-platform powerhouse. Through www.News10Lansing.com and our dedicated News 10 and First Alert Weather apps, and our continuous livestreaming channel News10+, our audience stays connected to trusted local coverage whenever and wherever they need it.
We are a breaking news and weather-first station with a fierce commitment to original, local reporting. Our respected anchors and reporters live in the community and have made our newsroom their home—including the longest-running sportscaster in the state of Michigan. Our leadership team is equally passionate about mentoring and developing the next generation of top-tier journalists.

Mid-Michigan (the Lansing/Jackson area) is a big news market, home to the state capital and Michigan State University. It is a vibrant, diverse, stable, and highly affordable region that offers an outstanding quality of life. Lansing is ideally located just an hour from Grand Rapids and downtown Detroit, and is perfect for day trips “up north” to explore some of the most beautiful scenic spots in the country. If you love lakes, boating, fishing, camping, beaches, downhill skiing, craft breweries, local wineries, Broadway shows, Big Ten sports, minor-league baseball, and professional NFL, NBA, and NHL games... Michigan has it all! Come grow your career with our winning, forward-thinking team.

Job Summary/Description:

Are you the kind of person who lives for the Friday night lights and the roar of a Big Ten stadium? Do you believe that sports are about more than just box scores — that they’re about the heartbeat of a community? We’re looking for a high-energy Sports Reporter and Anchor to join our powerhouse team at WILX and WSYM. Whether you’re breaking down a massive Spartans win, profiling a high school underdog, or owning the conversation on social media, you’ll be the face of sports in Mid-Michigan. This isn't just a job behind a desk; it’s a multi-platform mission to tell the stories that matter most to our fans.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

What You'll Do:
• Own the sports desk: Anchor high-energy sportscasts that move beyond simple highlights to provide the context and depth our viewers crave.
• Tell "More Than a Game" stories: Shoot, write, and edit compelling packages that capture the raw emotion and community pride of Mid-Michigan sports.
• Drive the digital conversation: Break stories on our website, mobile app, social media channels – engage with fans on digital platforms and find creative ways to grow our streaming presence.
• Lead the "Prep Rally": Take a front-row seat in our award-winning live high school, college, and pro sports coverage, from Friday night football specials to athlete profiles.
• Enterprise local features: Dig deep to find the stories no one else is telling, building relationships with coaches, athletes, and local legends.

Qualifications/Requirements:

What You Bring:
• A killer on-air presence: You’re confident, authentic, and you know how to connect with an audience.
• Digital-first DNA: You understand that "the game" happens on Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, and our app just as much as it happens on the field.
• Scrappy MMJ skills: You’re a pro at shooting your own video and editing on the fly.
• Deep sports IQ: You know your way around a playbook and can speak the language of everything from Big Ten basketball to local golf.
• Urgency and accuracy: You thrive under the pressure of a ticking clock and never sacrifice the facts for speed.
• A team-player mindset: You’re ready to jump in, take feedback, and help the whole team win.
• The essentials: A degree in Journalism or a related field, a valid driver’s license, and a clean driving record are must-haves.

Why You'll Love It Here:
• The Ultimate Sports Market: From the intensity of Michigan State University to the deep-rooted traditions of our local high schools, you’ll never run out of great stories to tell.
• Innovation First: We’re not stuck in the past. You’ll have access to the latest tech and a team that’s obsessed with the future of digital media.
• Community Impact: You’ll be a local celebrity with a purpose, using your platform to highlight the best of Mid-Michigan.
• Growth Opportunities: As part of Gray Media, you’re joining a company that invests in its people and provides a clear path for career advancement.
• A Winning Culture: Work with a team of exceptional journalists who are as passionate about excellence as you are.

Ready to take the field and make your mark in Mid-Michigan? Let’s talk.

WMTV has an immediate opening for a Technical Media Producer. The TMP directs live and prerecorded productions as assigned, using our Ross Overdrive production automation system paired with coding in ENPS to deliver a quality News Show. - Preparing the production rundowns for automation operation by coding the rundown in AP ENPS / Ross Overdrive plugin
- Understanding of all relevant equipment in the studio, production, and technical core areas
- Editing video for playback and working closely with the news team to ensure quality
- Field directing Special projects including WMTV's "Share your Holidays", UW Madison's Homecoming Parade, and our "On the Road segment

Qualifications/Requirements:

- 2 years of previous broadcast or production experience with master control or production control is preferred, but we will train the right person. Ross Overdrive experience is a plus.
- Demonstrated ability to learn new concepts quickly and thoroughly
- Proven track record of prioritizing complex tasks
- Ability to communicate effectively – written and verbal
- Strong commitment to working effectively with others; both being trained by and training others in a team environment is a must
- Positive attitude and ability to adapt to changes
- Must be willing to work holidays and weekends if needed

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first- and/or second-highest-rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group with 46 markets and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies with the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

About KOLO:

KOLO is a station that gets the job done. Many of our employees have been with the company for years, and they pride themselves on their expertise and their ability to succeed. While Reno/Tahoe is a 100+ market, it has all the characteristics of a much larger West Coast market. In fact, some say Reno has a superior lifestyle and outdoor activities to its much larger neighboring markets. For these and many other reasons, KOLO is able to attract top-notch individuals. We pride ourselves on not limiting ourselves to the "news conference or press release journalism" stories that are easy to get. Our journalists know they need to tell stories on issues that matter to the Northern Nevada community and our viewers. Much of the station's identity is from KOLOCares, a program designed to better serve Northern Nevada through the wonderful non-profit organizations that are part of the community. KOLOCares was recently honored by the National Association of Broadcasters' Celebration of Service to Community Award. Every station is tasked to serve their community, but KOLO takes pride in finding unique ways to help our non-profit partners to reach their goals.

Reno has an illustrious history of boom or bust, and right now the area is booming! Life in Reno/Tahoe is not just about work. Northern Nevada boasts remarkable outdoor activities highlighted by the spectacular beauty of Lake Tahoe, world-renowned ski resorts in the Sierra, trout fishing in the Truckee River and Pyramid Lake, placid campgrounds, miles of hiking and biking trails and, yes, casinos. San Francisco, Yosemite, and Napa Valley are all an easy drive for a weekend getaway. job.title: Broadcast - Assistant Chief Engineer
job.description:
WGAL, the Hearst Television owned NBC affiliate serving the Harrisburg-Lancaster-Lebanon-York, PA market has an opening for an Assistant Chief Engineer.  In this role, you will help lead a team of technical professionals ranging from studio operators to IT and RF specialists as you organize, plan, manage, document and complete assignments within our live broadcast environment. This includes oversight of the equipment itself and execution of both local and corporate-led systems deployments and upgrades. As Assistant Chief Engineer you will monitor multiple air channels, maintain regulatory compliance, and ensure quality control of the on-air product.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and day-to-day directions to the Engineering and Technical Operations teams.
  • Oversee the operation, reliability, and maintenance of studio, field, transmission, and production equipment across multiple sites.
  • Assign daily priorities, communicate expectations, and guide technical staff in troubleshooting, maintenance, and project implementation.
  • Diagnose and resolve broadcast-system issues from RF transmission and signal distribution through equipment and component level troubleshooting.
  • Maintain transmitters, satellite antenna systems, microwave and RF systems, signal-routing and distribution systems, and related infrastructure.
  • Oversee the integrity, security, reliability, and maintenance of broadcast IT systems, networks, and infrastructure.
  • Train and coach team members on equipment operation, maintenance procedures, safety requirements, FCC regulations, and broadcast standards.
  • Assist the Chief Engineer with employee development, performance management, departmental training, and long-term technical planning.
  • Provide leadership and decision-making for the Technical Department in the Chief Engineers absence.
  • Assist with planning and execution of capital projects, system upgrades, equipment installation, and facility improvements.
  • Work with Operation Manager to develop schedules that support Master Control, Production, Technical, and other operational needs.
  • Ensure technical staff have the tools, test equipment, supplies, documentation, and information needed to perform their responsibilities successfully.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable FCC rules, licensing requirements, safety standards, and company policies.
  • Establish and maintain productive relationships with local vendors, contractors, and service providers.
  • Support facility and physical-plant management across multiple locations.
  • Promote a collaborative, accountable, service-oriented, and safety-focused work environment.

 

Requirements

  • This position requires a flexible schedule for operational needs. Evenings, weekends, holidays and participation in 24-hour emergency responses are expected.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Television Broadcast Operations/Maintenance
  • Demonstrated technical leadership or supervisory experience, including assigning work, coaching employees, and leading technical projects.
  • Strong understanding of the complete broadcast signal chain from RF transmission, studio production, routing, distribution, and monitoring systems.
  • Hands on experience diagnosing , troubleshooting, and repairing broadcast and production equipment at the system, board, and component levels.
  • Working knowledge of transmitters, antennas, satellite systems, signal-routing equipment, studio systems, test equipment, and IP-based broadcasting technologies.
  • Knowledge of FCC technical requirements, licensing, recordkeeping, and broadcast compliance.
  • Experience with broadcast IT systems, networking, network security, and infrastructure support.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, signal-flow diagrams, schematics, equipment manuals, and system documentation. Experience with AutoCAD is a plus.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and make sound technical decisions during time sensitive or high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds, climb ladders, work at heights, perform physical activities associated with equipment installation and maintenance with reasonable accommodation.
  • Must have current driver's license.
  • Higher education in technology, relevant SBE certification, or related military experience will be considered.

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That’s why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization that fosters collaboration and open communication, ensuring that the content we create is authentic, accurate, and connected to the communities we serve.

job.title: Digital Creative Content Strategist (freelance)
job.description:
Digital Creative Content Strategist (freelance)

 

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG) is seeking a Digital Creative Content Strategist to support digital content strategies, creative concepts, and original digital series across HMPG broadcast series, digital originals, and upcoming business opportunities. This individual contributor role has no direct reports, though it may help guide editors, freelancers, producers, and production partners on specific executions.

 

Working closely with the Digital Director and Digital Content Strategy Manager, this role helps shape content from strategy through execution, including building strategy decks, contributing to platform and channel recommendations, ideating digital activations, supporting digital original production planning, working with talent and creators, and occasionally traveling to shoots to capture content. The role also provides creative guidance to producers and editors through post-production. Final creative approval sits with the Digital Director and Digital Content Strategy Manager.

 

This position reports to the Digital Content Strategy Manager and is based in Glendale, CA, four days per week.

 

Responsibilities

  • Support the development of content strategies by researching platforms, identifying audience trends, drafting content pillars, and preparing first-pass strategic materials. 
  • Contribute platform-specific recommendations that help define what content belongs on each channel, how it should be formatted, audience fit and how it supports marketing goals. 
  • Work with editors, producers, and creative teams to help define the visual look and feel of original digital content, including pacing, graphics, recurring formats, captions, voice, and platform-native treatments.
  • Support business development by ideating digital activations, social extensions, creator integrations, talent ideas, original formats, audience engagement strategies, and practical production approaches for proposed broadcast and digital productions.
  • Support productions and their planning by gathering inputs related to various production departments and timelines.
  • Assist digital productions by preparing shoot agendas, shoot priorities, run-of-show documents, production notes, and creative briefs. May lead to smaller-scale digital shoots or content captures with oversight.
  • Travel to select shoots to support digital capture, production oversight, talent direction, and real-time creative decision-making; capture behind-the-scenes footage, social-first clips, interviews, talent moments, and supplemental assets when needed.
  • Research and recommend digital creators, influencers, editors, freelancers, and production partners.
  • Provide editors and producers with clear creative direction, pacing guidance, platform formatting direction, and visual references.

 

Internet Fluency and Cultural Judgment

  • Live natively on TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram as both a viewer and participant. This person does not need platform behavior explained to them and should bring informed opinions about what is working now, backed by real examples. 
  • Be chronically online in the best sense: consuming a high volume of content, developing strong taste, and knowing how to separate signal from noise. 
  • Bring sharp instincts for what feels current versus dated, forced, or unnecessary trend chasing. Understand creator culture, meme cycles, comment behavior, fandom dynamics, and each platform’s tone. 
  • Apply critical judgment to trends, copy, and strategy. This person should eliminate corporate, algorithmic, or AI-generated language, push back constructively, and flag ideas that may look good in a deck but will not connect with a real audience.

 

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in digital media, entertainment, branded content, social video, digital originals, creator-led production, or broadcast-adjacent content development.
  • Proven ability to create content strategy decks, pitch materials, client-facing presentations, creative proposals, or social content plans.
  • Hands-on background developing or producing digital original content, including short-form and long-form formats.
  • Practical knowledge of production planning, shoot logistics, budgeting, staffing, talent coordination, set workflows, and post-production processes.

  • Experience working with editors, producers, creators, influencers, talent, production teams, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders. Experience with educational, family-friendly, youth, lifestyle, sports, or mission-driven programming is preferred.

 

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of social platforms, digital video formats, audience behavior, creator culture, and platform-specific creative strategy.
  • Comfortable discussing digital analytics, audience growth, engagement, video performance, retention, content optimization, and platform trends.
  • Strong writing skills, including strategic positioning, captions, tone of voice, creative copy, pitch language, and presentation copy.
  • Ability to guide editors and producers on visual style, pacing, structure, graphics, format, and storytelling approach.
  • Familiarity with digital production equipment and workflows, including DSLR or cinema-style cameras, lighting, sound, lavaliers, and field production tools.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organization, and time-management skills; able to manage multiple shows, deadlines, priorities, and stakeholders at once.
  • Candidates must possess a valid passport with at least 18 months of remaining validity at the time of hire and must be willing and able to travel as needed.

 

Portfolio Requirement

Applicants must provide a portfolio or work samples that demonstrate digital content strategy, social-first creative ideas, campaign examples, writing samples, digital video work, or platform-specific content execution. Link documents or upload PDF with links to samples.

 

Education

job.title: Digital Sales Manager
job.description:
WPTZ/WNNE, Hearst Television’s NBC affiliates serving the Burlington, VT / Plattsburgh, NY market, are seeking a Digital Sales Manager to lead and expand our digital revenue. This is a strategic leadership role for a results-driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-evolving, digital-first environment and is passionate about developing teams and driving measurable client outcomes.

This role offers the opportunity to strengthen digital revenue in a dynamic market, leveraging Hearst’s industry-leading tools, data, and cross-platform capabilities. You will contribute to sales strategy, mentor team members, and help evolve how we support client success.

At Hearst Television, you will work alongside passionate professionals who take pride in delivering high-quality content and marketing solutions. You will also be part of a team-oriented culture where your digital expertise and leadership will help drive success in a digital-first environment.

About the Burlington–Plattsburgh Market
Burlington, Vermont, located along the shores of Lake Champlain, is a vibrant city known for its thriving arts scene, innovative business community, and exceptional quality of life. Residents enjoy true four-season living, with opportunities for sailing and kayaking in the summer, world-class skiing in the winter, and some of the most beautiful fall foliage in the country. The area offers a more balanced and accessible lifestyle than larger metropolitan areas, with short commute times and easy access to nature.

Plattsburgh, New York, offers a welcoming, close-knit community with a revitalized downtown featuring restaurants, shops, and cultural venues. Located on the western shore of Lake Champlain, Plattsburgh provides convenient access to both Burlington and Montreal, allowing residents to enjoy the benefits of a smaller community with access to a broader mix of cultural and economic experiences.

  • Lead the strategy and execution of digital revenue growth in support of station sales goals

  • Evaluate seller performance, identify development opportunities, and provide ongoing coaching to improve results

Revenue Growth and Client Strategy

  • Identify and support new digital revenue opportunities, including non-traditional and emerging solutions
  • Support negotiation of digital advertising opportunities, ensuring strong positioning and alignment with client goals
  • Develop strategic responses to client and agency RFPs, with a focus on driving new and incremental business
  • Build and maintain client and agency relationships to drive retention and growth
  • Partner with AEs to develop and deliver integrated digital marketing solutions

 

Operational Excellence and Accountability

  • Support digital revenue forecasting and maintain visibility into performance
  • Manage budgets related to digital initiatives with attention to efficiency and outcomes
  • Review insertion orders and sales documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency

 

Experience Requirements

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing and cross-platform media, including television and digital solutions
  • Experience generating revenue through new business development and account growth across multiple platforms
  • Ability to create persuasive presentations, respond to RFPs, and align solutions to client goals
  • Knowledge of pricing strategy and inventory management to maximize revenue opportunities
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound business judgment
  • Effective communication and relationship-building skills with clients, agencies, and internal teams
  • Ability to coach, support, and collaborate with sellers to drive team performance

job.title: Intern
job.description:
The WESH 2/ CW18 News Internship Program is a paid, rigorous and highly competitive hands-on experience that provides individuals the opportunity to learn about the operations of a broadcast television station. You will develop news writing, producing, reporting, and digital media skills while learning from award-winning staff at WESH 2 News. Additional opportunities are available in the behind-the-scenes areas of production/studio operations, weather and marketing/promotions. Your internship will prepare you for work in a real newsroom, giving you opportunities in nearly every aspect of news production.
 

Spring 2027 Session
Application Window: Nov. 14th, 2026– Dec. 15th, 2026
Session: Jan. 25th, 2027 – April 16th, 2027
*Dates are subject to change
 

WESH 2/CW18 offers paid internships in the departments below. In order to apply for an internship at WESH 2/CW18, please provide a cover letter with your application. The cover letter should include:
•    Semester i.e. Spring, Summer, or Fall (if applicable)
•    Department preference
•    Available start and end dates
•    Days and hours available to intern
 

Available Internships

Newsroom

Interns will work alongside reporters, producers, and news managers to learn skills in nearly all aspects of television news production. Examples include on-scene reporting, producing, video editing, research, and working at the assignment desk.

Production/Studio Operations

Interns will learn the technical aspects of live news broadcasts. Behind-the-scenes training will include learning robotic cameras, floor directing, lighting and show set-ups. Interns are required to be comfortable with height, able to lift light equipment, and work non-traditional hours.

Digital

Interns will learn how newsrooms publish content to digital platforms, analyze real-time online metrics and more. Interns will get the opportunity to research, write, and publish stories for WESH.com.

Weather

Interns must have working knowledge of a meteorology curriculum or closely related program of study. You will work with our team of meteorologists to learn the skills necessary in creating and delivering forecast information for a television and online audience.

Marketing/Promotions

Interns with an interest in marketing, advertising, promotion, or production will be given hands-on experience in these areas.

Orientation

Once you are accepted as an intern at WESH-TV, you will receive an instruction packet. Your first day at the station is set aside for orientation and you Must attend this. You will work three days a week, eight hours each shift with varying schedules. During the internship you should always check in with your assigned adviser upon entering the building.

Securing housing and transportation during the internship are the responsibility of the student. WESH-TV cannot offer support in this area.

job.title: Senior Digital Producer
job.description:
WBAL NewsRadio 1090 AM and FM 101.5 and 98 Rock, Hearst-owned radio stations in Baltimore, are seeking an innovative, data-driven Senior Digital Producer to lead digital strategy, audience growth initiatives and day-to-day platform operations.

The Senior Digital Producer will oversee the execution of digital strategy for WBAL.com and 98online.com. This role manages the organization and optimization of both WordPress content management systems (CMS) and works with editorial leaders to deliver timely, engaging digital experiences. The position focuses on digital planning, presentation and distribution; content priorities remain with each department’s editorial leadership.

Reporting to the Director of Digital & Creative Services, the Senior Digital Producer works closely with program directors, the Creative Services Director, newsroom staff, show producers and sales teams. The role develops strategies to grow audiences across websites, mobile, newsletters, podcasts, social media and emerging platforms, and uses performance data to recommend improvements. The salary range for this position is $50,000 - $52,000. 

The ideal candidate is passionate about digital publishing, audience development, analytics and emerging platforms. They bring strong editorial judgment, excellent organizational skills and experience managing digital content, using analytics to guide decisions and growing audiences across multiple platforms.

Job Responsibilities:                                     

  • Lead and execute the overall digital strategy for WBAL.com and 98online.com.
  • Manage and optimize the stations’ WordPress CMS platforms, ensuring content is accurate, current, well organized and visually engaging.
  • Analyze audience behavior, traffic trends and content performance to guide editorial and promotional recommendations.
  • Develop initiatives to grow audiences across web, mobile, newsletters, podcasts, social media and emerging platforms.
  • Lead SEO and content optimization efforts to improve discoverability and engagement.
  • Coordinate digital coverage plans for breaking news and major station events.
  • Work with Digital Content Producers, newsroom staff, show producers and on-air talent to support timely, effective digital publishing.
  • Train station personnel in digital best practices, content optimization, social publishing and emerging platform trends.
  • Use Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube and other platforms to engage audiences and promote station content.
  • Prepare regular analytics reports with actionable recommendations for editorial and business teams.

 

Experience Requirements:

  • Demonstrated success using analytics to drive audience growth and content performance.
  • Experience managing website content through a content management system.
  • Knowledge and experience with Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, and Audition preferred
  • Broadcasting degree or equivalent preferred
  • Knowledge of best practices for Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube

 

Qualifications Requirements:

  • Highly organized.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities.
  • Excellent news judgment.
  • Passion for audience growth and digital innovation.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent project management skills.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
  • Collaborative team player with strong cross-functional communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and train others without direct supervisory responsibility.
  • Flexible in schedule, with some availability needed outside regular hours for breaking news and major events.

 

Education:

  • Related experience and/or training considered as well as a combination of education and experience.
  • Military training from Defense Information School with experience will be considered
  • Hearst Television is a proud supporter of military veterans. Related military training and experience will be considered.
