What We Need:

Are you passionate about the automotive industry and energized by helping dealerships grow? iHeartMedia Automotive is seeking an experienced Automotive Marketing Consultant who understands the dealership business, thrives in face-to-face client relationships, and knows how to build innovative marketing strategies that drive traffic, leads, and vehicle sales. We're looking for someone who has spent time in dealerships, around dealerships, or working directly with automotive retailers. The ideal candidate understands the challenges dealers face every day, from inventory fluctuations and market share battles to lead generation and fixed operations growth. They can confidently sit across the table from Dealer Principals, General Managers, Marketing Directors, and agency partners, uncover business opportunities, and recommend solutions that produce measurable results. This is more than a media sales role. It's an opportunity to become a trusted business advisor backed by the industry's largest audio platform, exclusive automotive advertising solutions, proprietary audience targeting technologies, advanced attribution capabilities, and industry-leading automotive research resources.
If you love the automotive business, enjoy creating marketing ideas that dealers get excited about, and are driven by helping clients win, we'd love to meet you.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

 As an Automotive Marketing Consultant with iHeartMedia Automotive, you will help dealerships grow market share, increase showroom traffic, generate leads, and ultimately sell more vehicles.


You will:

  • Develop and grow relationships through consistent in-person dealership visits, networking, prospecting, referrals, and business development activities.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with Dealer Principals, General Managers, Dealer Operators, Marketing Directors, and agency partners.
  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand dealership objectives, competitive pressures, inventory concerns, fixed operations opportunities, and growth goals.
  • Create customized marketing strategies that help dealers drive awareness, shopper engagement, traffic, leads, sales, and service revenue.
  • Leverage iHeartMedia Automotive's comprehensive automotive marketing stack, including:
    • Broadcast Radio
    • Streaming Audio
    • Podcasts
    • Connected TV (CTV)
    • OTT Video
    • Social Media Solutions
    • Display Advertising
    • Influencer Marketing
    • Proprietary Automotive Audience Targeting
    • Automotive Attribution & Matchback Reporting
    • Dealer Traffic Generation Programs
    • Exclusive Automotive Consumer Insights & Research
    • Proprietary Automotive Advertising Solutions
  • Utilize industry-leading automotive research resources, shopper insights, audience intelligence, and consumer behavior data to identify growth opportunities and build strategic recommendations.
  • Present creative, innovative marketing ideas that dealers love and that help their stores stand out in highly competitive markets.
  • Collaborate with automotive strategists, campaign specialists, creative teams, and product experts to develop integrated programs that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling business presentations supported by market intelligence, automotive data, consumer insights, and performance reporting.
  • Conduct ongoing business reviews and campaign recaps that clearly demonstrate results, ROI, and future growth opportunities.
  • Consistently exceed revenue goals through consultative selling, exceptional client service, and long-term relationship development.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

Automotive Expertise

  • 3+ years of experience working directly with automotive dealerships, dealer groups, OEM programs, automotive agencies, automotive technology providers, or automotive marketing organizations.
  • Proven experience managing advertising, marketing, or lead-generation programs for automobile dealers.
  • Deep understanding of the dealership business and the factors that drive vehicle sales, service revenue, customer acquisition, and market share growth.
  • Ability to confidently engage dealership ownership, executive leadership, and key decision-makers.
  • Experience conducting face-to-face meetings with Dealer Principals, General Managers, Marketing Directors, and ownership groups.
  • Understanding of automotive retail trends, dealer operations, consumer shopping behavior, and omni-channel marketing strategies.
  • Familiarity with co-op compliance, attribution reporting, and performance-based marketing solutions is preferred.
  • A genuine passion for the automotive industry and helping dealers succeed.

Consultative Selling & Relationship Building

  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships through face-to-face client interactions.
  • Strong consultative sales skills with a track record of identifying needs and developing customized marketing solutions.
  • Comfortable presenting strategic recommendations to dealer ownership and executive leadership teams.
  • Experience recommending and closing significant marketing investments.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • Highly competitive, self-motivated, and goal-oriented.
  • Ability to build a book of business that consistently produces budget-beating results through prospecting, presenting, and closing integrated marketing programs.

Strategic & Creative Thinking

  • Ability to develop unique marketing concepts and promotional ideas that drive dealership traffic and vehicle sales.
  • Experience building and managing complex, integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Strong understanding of how audio, digital, video, social, and emerging media channels influence automotive shoppers.
  • Ability to translate research, data, and analytics into actionable business recommendations.
  • A passion for solving business challenges and helping dealers outperform their competition.
  • Creative thinker who enjoys bringing fresh ideas to dealers that generate excitement and results.

Technology & Organization

  • Experience using Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong analytical and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and sales opportunities simultaneously.
  • Experience utilizing campaign analytics and reporting tools to demonstrate marketing effectiveness.

Requirements

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Ability to travel throughout assigned territory and conduct regular in-person dealership visits.
  • High School Diploma required; Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.

What You'll Get

  • Unlimited earning potential through a highly competitive compensation plan and uncapped commission structure.
  • Access to one of the most comprehensive automotive marketing platforms in the industry.
  • Exclusive automotive products, data sources, and advertising solutions unavailable through traditional media providers.
  • Industry-leading automotive research resources, shopper intelligence, and consumer insights.
  • Advanced attribution and reporting capabilities that help prove campaign effectiveness.
  • A comprehensive onboarding and training program designed to immerse you in our products, processes, and automotive sales strategies.
  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • Eligibility for iHeartMedia's President's Club and CEO's Club recognition programs.
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, company holidays, wellness resources, and employee assistance programs.
  • The support of a dedicated team of automotive specialists invested in your success.

Why iHeartMedia Automotive?


At iHeartMedia Automotive, you'll represent one of the most powerful and differentiated automotive marketing platforms in the industry.


You'll have access to exclusive automotive advertising solutions, industry-leading research and consumer intelligence, proprietary audience targeting technologies, advanced attribution capabilities, and the scale of America's largest audio network.

Most importantly, you'll become a strategic growth partner to dealerships, helping them drive more traffic, sell more vehicles, improve market share, and achieve measurable business results. If you're looking for an opportunity to combine your automotive expertise with best-in-class marketing solutions, we want to hear from you.

 

Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

job.description:

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

At iHeartMedia, we believe in the power of audio to connect, comfort, and inspire. As a Board Operator, you are a critical part of that mission—ensuring our broadcasts run smoothly and sound great, so we can be a trusted friend to millions of listeners anytime, anywhere.

Your precision and professionalism ensure that every show, every ad, and every moment reaches our audience with clarity and impact. You help us fulfill our promise to be there for our listeners—whether they’re commuting, working, or winding down—making you an essential part of the iHeartMedia mission.

  • Monitor on-air programming for quality, timing, and compliance with FCC regulations.

  • Coordinate with talent, producers, and traffic teams to ensure smooth transitions and accurate commercial placement. 

  • Troubleshoot technical issues in real time and escalate as needed.

  • Record, edit, and load audio content for playback using automation systems. 

  • Maintain logs and documentation for regulatory and internal compliance. 

  • Support remote broadcasts and live events as needed.

  • Strong technical aptitude and familiarity with broadcast equipment and automation systems (e.g., NexGen, Adobe Audition). 

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 

  • Availability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays. 

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; relevant certifications or coursework a plus.

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The World's Largest Broadcast Software Provider.

 

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

 

Here is what makes us different:

 

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

 

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

 

If this opportunity excites you, but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. At RCS Worldwide, we know that great talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive, collaborative workplace where people can grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

                                                                              

What We Need:

Join our team in a role with room to grow, reporting directly to the Director of Software Engineering. You'll work alongside data scientists and business stakeholders to turn data into reliable, production-ready solutions that drive decisions across the organization. If you're a self-motivated team player who enjoys a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering results, we'd love to hear from you.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Develop, test, deploy, and maintain data solutions that support business requirements, web applications, models, and analytics
  • Work closely with data scientists, analysts, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver reliable data solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows using PySpark, AWS Glue, Pandas, and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or AWS Step Functions
  • Implement data ingestion, transformation, validation, storage, and pipeline monitoring
  • Build infrastructure to support model training, scoring, and retraining, along with related reporting
  • Deploy and manage applications and pipelines using AWS CodePipeline and ECS
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot issues, and optimize pipeline performance
  • Collaborate with a small, agile team
  • Resolve technical issues through debugging and troubleshooting

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in data engineering.
  • Experience developing high-performance applications for large enterprises
  • Hands-on AWS cloud experience (or a similar cloud platform), including Glue, CodePipeline, and ECS
  • Strong proficiency in Python (including PySpark, Pandas, and DataFrames) and SQL
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines using AWS Glue or similar data-processing technologies
  • Experience building and managing ETL/ELT workflows using Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar orchestration tools
  • Understanding of data engineering concepts, including ingestion, transformation, validation, storage, and pipeline monitoring
  • Familiarity with data quality, pipeline monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
  • Database experience with Postgres, MongoDB, DynamoDB, and Athena
  • Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices
  • Experience with agile development methodologies
  • Proven track record of meeting project timelines with a sense of urgency​‌

Preferred

  • Experience with AWS SageMaker or similar ML platforms
  • Knowledge of Apache Iceberg and Delta tables

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Expertise with various technical disciplines and applications

  • Close attention to detail and quality orientation

  • Ability to multitask on a variety of critical projects

  • Ability to work independently, while also collaborating with others

  • Strong communication skills, particularly when explaining complex technical information

  • Ability to provide solutions to problems in situations that are atypical/infrequent

  • Analytical thinking and the ability to identify patterns

  • Efficiency with own work and impact of team results

  • Informal leadership capabilities with an interest in mentoring less experienced team members

What We Need:

We're looking for a talented full stack developer to help build the next generation of programming, playout, and content delivery systems for radio, streaming, and other digital platforms.

This is a high-visibility role with real room for growth. You'll work closely with our tech lead and Manager of Software Engineering to design, build, test, deploy, and maintain web applications and the APIs behind them — systems that run in the cloud, on the edge, and everywhere in between.

We're looking for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment: someone who can multi-task, take ownership of problems, and deliver against deadlines without losing sight of quality.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality software components using object-oriented and component-based patterns, with an emphasis on reuse, test-driven development, and automation
  • Build new features and enhancements for existing products, from intermediate to highly complex in scope
  • Write, test, and deploy React front ends and Node.js/TypeScript back ends, along with the serverless infrastructure that supports them
  • Work with our Architects to translate business and customer requirements into detailed technical designs and component specifications
  • Deliver software with minimal defects; identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues quickly
  • Estimate level of effort and contribute to planning for new features and system changes
  • Identify technical risks early and work with the team on mitigation plans
  • Maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines to keep releases smooth, fast, and reliable
  • Support and troubleshoot code running on edge devices deployed in the field
  • Use monitoring, alerting, and dashboards to keep an eye on system health and catch issues before they become problems

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 3+ years of experience in front end, back end, or full stack web development, with solid grounding in Agile principles and QA methodologies
  • Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript and Node.js
  • Experience building UIs with React
  • Comfort with Python, particularly for data science or AI/ML workloads, is a plus
  • Experience with AWS serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, SQS, Docker, etc.)
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation, ideally with AWS CodePipeline and CDK
  • Familiarity with CloudWatch (or similar) for monitoring, alerting, and dashboarding
  • Experience with NoSQL (MongoDB) and relational databases (Postgres or MySQL)
  • Experience with event-driven message based integrations
  • Solid debugging and troubleshooting skills across a variety of hardware and software environments
  • Experience profiling and tuning applications for CPU/memory efficiency
  • A track record of writing maintainable, extensible, future-proof code
  • Experience with end-to-end and user acceptance testing in an Agile context
  • Experience handling audio/media files and streams is a strong plus
  • Experience with code running on edge or field-deployed devices is a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to go deep on technical detail with peers and simplify complex concepts for others
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively within a team

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Experience with various technical disciplines and applications

  • Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved

  • Ability to multitask on a variety of critical projects

  • Ability to work independently, while also collaborating with others

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate moderately complex technical information within the team

  • Skills to recognize and solve frequently occurring problems

  • Analytical thinking

  • Resourcefulness and independent judgement

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

Compensation:

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data. In addition to salary, this position is also eligible for commissions. Commissions rates generally range from 2.0% to 10%+ depending on product, station and type of business.

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

job.description:

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

At iHeartMedia, events are more than just moments—they’re a core pillar of our brand. With over  20,000 local and national events annually, our Promotions & Events teams play a critical role in shaping how audiences experience the power of audio in real life. As a member of the team, you’ll be at the heart of this mission—bringing our stations, talent, and clients to life through unforgettable experiences.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Support the planning and execution of local events and promotions that align with station branding and client objectives, including concerts, community activations, and live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate logistics such as venue setup, staffing, signage, giveaways, and technical needs. 

  • Collaborate with Sales, Programming, and Marketing teams to develop integrated promotional campaigns that drive listener engagement and revenue. 

  • Serve as on-site lead during events, ensuring smooth execution and representing iHeartMedia with professionalism and positive energy. 

  • Engage with listeners and clients to create memorable brand interactions and gather feedback. 

  • Maintain promotional inventory and ensure all materials are prepped and transported as needed. 

  • Support digital and social media efforts by capturing content and promoting events across platforms. Track and report on event performance, including attendance, engagement, and client satisfaction. 

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable engaging with the public and clients. 

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed for events. 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with social media platforms and content creation tools is a plus. 

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required. 

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Ability to work within standardized procedures and an understanding of when to escalate
  • Skills to solve straightforward problems using established procedures
  • Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved
  • Common courtesy when communicating with coworkers and outside contacts

What We Need:

About AudioGraph: AudioGraph is iHeartMedia’s programmatic broadcast radio platform — the first at scale to let agencies plan, buy, and measure broadcast radio through the same programmatic workflows they use for digital. It connects 860+ stations across 150+ markets to the programmatic ecosystem through DSP integrations, audience targeting, and automated measurement.

Why This Role Matters: Sellers need a technical partner who can shorten deal cycles, remove friction, and make AudioGraph feel as easy to buy as digital. This role directly accelerates revenue by helping agencies say yes faster and ensuring every campaign delivers a best‑in‑class experience.

The Role: As Senior Solutions Engineer, you own AudioGraph’s technical go‑to‑market. You lead complex pre‑sale conversations, build repeatable implementation playbooks, and create the operational backbone for a seamless client experience from first pitch through post‑campaign wrap. Your work drives sales effectiveness, deal velocity, and client retention.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As Senior Solutions Engineer, you own the technical go-to-market for AudioGraph. You are the most technically fluent person on the commercial side of the business—leading complex pre-sale engagements, designing repeatable implementation playbooks, and building the operational infrastructure for a best-in-class customer experience from first pitch through post-campaign wrap-up. You will have direct, measurable impact on sales effectiveness, deal velocity, and client retention.

Sales Effectiveness & Deal Acceleration

  • Lead technical pre-sale engagements with agency holding companies and mid-market agencies, translating AudioGraph capabilities into solutions that align with their buying workflows, planning tools, and KPIs.

  • Build reusable pitch assets—technical one-pagers, demo environments, objection-handling frameworks, ROI calculators—that equip sellers to move deals forward without waiting for SE availability.

  • Reduce time-to-proposal by owning a standardized deal configuration process: audience strategy, market selection, measurement approach, and pricing structure templated and ready to customize.

  • Participate directly in high-value pitch meetings and RFP responses; own the technical narrative that differentiates AudioGraph from competing audio solutions.

  • Train and enable the seller base through recurring technical workshops, deal clinics, and 1:1 coaching on how to position AudioGraph’s capabilities.
     

Operational Excellence & Customer Experience

  • Design and own the end-to-end client lifecycle playbook.

  • Ensure seamless handoffs between sales, ad ops, and client services at every stage transition—no client should ever feel like they’re starting over with a new team.

  • Architect campaign configurations for complex deals including audience layering, frequency management, creative specifications, and cross-platform measurement design.
     

Platform & Partner Integration

  • Inform the product roadmap by synthesizing field-level technical feedback into prioritized requirements; participate in sprint reviews and beta testing for new capabilities.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 5–8 years of experience in solutions engineering, technical account management, or advanced ad operations within programmatic advertising.

  • Deep understanding of the programmatic supply chain: bid mechanics, deal structures (PMP/PG/preferred deals), header bidding, and SSP-DSP integration patterns.

  • Direct experience with major DSPs (Amazon, TTD, DV360, Viant, Basis, or equivalent) from a technical integration or partner perspective.

  • Hands-on proficiency with ad serving platforms (Triton, GAM, FreeWheel, or equivalent), including deal setup, inventory packaging, and log-level troubleshooting.

  • Strong grasp of audience data architecture: identity graphs, data onboarding, clean rooms, and how audience segments flow through the programmatic pipe.

  • Experience with measurement and attribution methodologies (pixel-based, exposure file, foot traffic, brand lift) and at least one vendor in the space.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and drive cross-functional projects without direct authority.

  • Excellent communication—comfortable presenting to agency leadership and equally comfortable debugging a bid stream with an engineer.
     

Nice to Have

  • Experience in audio, podcast, or broadcast advertising.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Operative AOS, or similar order management systems.

  • SQL proficiency and experience building operational dashboards or reporting pipelines.

  • Experience working within a media company or publisher-side ad tech team.

  • Prior experience in a player-coach or team lead capacity within an SE or technical solutions group.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • Expertise with various technical disciplines and applications
  • Close attention to detail and quality orientation
  • Ability to multitask on a variety of critical projects
  • Ability to work independently, while also collaborating with others
  • Strong communication skills, particularly when explaining complex technical information
  • Ability to provide solutions to problems in situations that are atypical/infrequent
  • Analytical thinking and the ability to identify patterns
  • Efficiency with own work and impact of team results
  • Informal leadership capabilities with an interest in mentoring less experienced team members

Compensation:

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

$112,000 - $140,000

VIRTUAL, NY

RCS Worldwide is home to four industry-defining brands: RCS, Media Monitors, Mediabase, and Florical Systems — serving the broadcast, music, and media intelligence markets across 120 countries. Every day, thousands of radio and television stations around the world rely on RCS technology to stay on air, sound great, and compete in a rapidly changing landscape.

 

Here is what makes us different:

 

We are the company behind the scenes of media that billions of people consume every day. When a song plays on your favorite radio station, when a song charts in the music industry, when a TV network stays on air without a second of downtime — there is a good chance RCS technology played a role. Our portfolio touches every corner of the media ecosystem, from playout and music scheduling to international advertising intelligence and airplay analytics.

 

We are a global team passionate about the industry we serve and moving with the speed and ambition to lead it forward.

  • Participate in sprint reviews, beta testing, and partner integration testing for new platform capabilities.

  • Own specific workstreams such as demo environment management, measurement vendor onboarding, or DSP integration support.

What You'll Need:

  • Working knowledge of major DSPs (Amazon, TTD, DV360, Viant, Basis, or equivalent) from a technical integration or partner support perspective.

  • Hands-on experience with ad serving platforms (Triton, GAM, FreeWheel, or equivalent), including deal setup, inventory packaging, and basic troubleshooting.

  • Exposure to measurement and attribution methodologies (pixel-based, exposure file, foot traffic, brand lift) and at least one vendor in the space.

  • Ability to operate independently on defined workstreams and escalate effectively when complexity exceeds scope.

  • Strong communication—comfortable presenting to agency teams and equally comfortable working through a technical issue with an engineer.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Experience with various technical disciplines and applications

  • Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved

  • Ability to multitask on a variety of critical projects

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate moderately complex technical information within the team

  • Skills to recognize and solve frequently occurring problems

  • Analytical thinking

  • Resourcefulness and independent judgement

$88,000 - $110,000

job.title: Account Executive - North Carolina
job.description:
Account Executive – North Carolina

Lee Enterprises, partnering with Amplified Digital, is seeking a driven and results-oriented Outside Sales Executive with a hunter mentality to sell digital advertising solutions to businesses.

Position Responsibilities

Prospect and generate new business through cold calling, networking, referrals, email outreach, and in-person and virtual meetings.

Consistently maintain a high level of outbound prospecting activity and sales appointments to build and advance the sales pipeline.

Identify and develop relationships with prospective clients and key decision-makers across an assigned geographic territory.

Conduct needs assessments to understand client goals, target audiences, marketing challenges, and desired outcomes.

Develop and present customized digital advertising proposals that align with client objectives and budgets.

Sell a comprehensive suite of digital advertising solutions, including, but not limited to, display, search, social, video, OTT/CTV, and website solutions.

Create, manage, and advance a sales pipeline from initial prospecting through close.

Negotiate and close new business while consistently working toward or exceeding assigned revenue goals.

Establish, grow, and manage a significant book of business through new client acquisition, retention, and account expansion.

Collaborate with internal digital marketing, campaign fulfillment, creative, analytics, and sales support teams to develop and execute client campaigns.

Monitor campaign performance and communicate results and optimization opportunities to clients.

Maintain accurate and timely prospect, client, activity, and pipeline information within the company CRM.

Stay current on digital advertising trends, emerging technologies, products, and competitive offerings.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Hunter mentality and strong drive to identify and pursue new business opportunities.

Consultative sales approach with the ability to uncover client needs and translate business objectives into effective advertising solutions.

Strong presentation, negotiation, closing, and relationship-building skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong understanding of digital marketing platforms, advertising technology, and campaign performance metrics.

Ability to confidently present and communicate with business owners, executives, and other decision-makers.

Strong organizational, time-management, and territory-management skills.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities while maintaining consistent follow-through.

Ability to analyze campaign performance and use data to communicate value and identify opportunities for optimization.

Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Familiarity with CRM systems and sales analytics.

Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.

Ability to travel as needed throughout the assigned territory and work effectively across all U.S. time zones.

Education & Experience

Minimum 3 years of recent outside sales experience required; digital advertising, media, marketing services, or B2B sales experience preferred.

Proven track record of prospecting, developing new business, and closing sales.

Demonstrated success establishing and growing a significant book of business.

Experience selling across a large geographic territory preferred.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite required.

Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform preferred.

Working knowledge of Google Analytics and Google Ads preferred; relevant certifications are a plus.

job.title: Business Reporter - Quad City Times
job.description:
Business Reporter — Quad-City Times

The Quad-City Times seeks a tenacious business reporter who will uncover the deals, decisions and power players shaping the local economy and chase down stories no other outlet has.

We want a reporter who builds sources, follows the money and digs into the decisions shaping the Quad-Cities economy. You should have the competitive drive to get stories first and the persistence to uncover information that businesses and public officials aren’t volunteering. This job requires someone who takes ownership of the beat and drives coverage without waiting for assignments.

The beat spans major employers, small businesses, manufacturing, development, commercial real estate, retail and the workforce on both sides of the Mississippi River. Your reporting will explain what business decisions mean for people’s jobs, neighborhoods and daily lives.

What you’ll do

Consistently pitch and pursue exclusive stories. Cultivate sources who bring you tips, spot developments early and chase promising leads with urgency and persistence.

Break news about employers, development projects, openings and closings, expansions, layoffs and changes in the local economy.

Go beyond announcements and ribbon-cuttings to examine how businesses operate, who benefits from investment and whether promises become reality.

Develop sources throughout the community, including workers, entrepreneurs, executives, developers, labor leaders, customers and neighborhood residents.

Use public records, financial filings, court documents and data to uncover stories and independently verify claims.

Scrutinize public incentives and economic development deals, tracking spending, commitments and results.

Connect regional and national economic trends to specific local consequences, making complex business issues clear and relevant.

Deliver a mix of quick-turn news, useful explainers, compelling profiles and deeper enterprise reporting.

Collaborate with editors and visual journalists to produce strong digital coverage, using audience questions and readership insights to sharpen the beat.

Uphold high standards for accuracy, fairness and independence, including when covering powerful local interests and advertisers.

What you’ll bring

Strong reporting, interviewing and writing skills, with work samples that demonstrate initiative and original reporting.

A record of finding stories beyond press releases and scheduled meetings, whether in professional, student or other journalism.

The confidence to ask difficult questions and the persistence to follow up when answers are incomplete.

An ability to understand financial information, evaluate data and explain complex subjects in plain language.

Strong news judgment and the ability to balance breaking news with longer-term reporting.

A commitment to building sources across industries, neighborhoods and levels of economic power.

Comfort with digital publishing and a willingness to develop visual and multimedia storytelling skills.

The ability to report throughout the Quad-Cities and adjust your schedule when news requires it.

Experience covering business, development, labor or local government is helpful. Knowledge of the Quad-Cities is a plus; curiosity, initiative and a drive to own the beat are essential.

How to apply

Submit a resume, a brief cover letter and three to five work samples. Explain how you uncovered at least one original story, and pitch two business stories you would pursue in the Quad-Cities.

job.title: Culture Reporter - Quad City Times
job.description:
Culture Reporter — Quad-City Times

The Quad-City Times seeks an ambitious, enterprising culture reporter who will aggressively pursue original stories and deliver coverage readers can’t find anywhere else.

We want someone who develops sources, follows tips, asks persistent questions and gets out into the community to uncover stories before they become public announcements. You should have a competitive drive to break news and the curiosity to recognize a compelling story others have missed.

This beat spans the people, places and ideas shaping culture in the Quad-Cities, from music, art and theater to food, festivals and neighborhood traditions. The expectation is to move beyond event previews and press releases to produce exclusive reporting, revealing profiles and deeply reported stories that help readers understand their community.

What you'll do

Consistently pitch and pursue original stories no other outlet has. Cultivate sources who bring you tips, spot developments early and follow promising leads with urgency and persistence.

Own and develop the culture beat, generating original ideas and building relationships with artists, performers, business owners, cultural organizations and residents.

Deliver a mix of timely news, reported features, profiles and useful guides that help readers decide where to go and what to experience.

Break news about cultural institutions, venues, restaurants and emerging trends, and follow developments beyond their initial announcement.

Explore questions of money, access, growth and change, including how cultural investment affects neighborhoods and whose stories receive attention.

Seek out communities, traditions and voices that have been overlooked in local coverage.

Collaborate with editors and visual journalists to tell stories through words, photography, video and other digital formats.

Use audience feedback and readership insights to make coverage more useful, discover new questions and build lasting reader relationships.

Maintain high standards for accuracy, fairness and independence, including when covering businesses and organizations featured in entertainment coverage.

What you’ll bring

Strong reporting, interviewing and writing skills, demonstrated through published work, student journalism or comparable experience.

The ability to balance quick-turn stories with deeper enterprise reporting and manage competing deadlines.

Curiosity about local culture and an instinct for finding the larger story behind an event or trend.

A commitment to inclusive sourcing and building trust across communities.

Comfort with digital publishing and social media, plus a willingness to develop photography and video skills.

The ability to report throughout the Quad-Cities and work occasional evenings and weekends as coverage requires.

Experience covering culture, arts, entertainment, food or community life is helpful. Knowledge of the Quad-Cities is a plus; an eagerness to learn the region is essential.

How to apply

Submit a resume, a brief cover letter and three to five work samples. Tell us how you would approach this beat and suggest two stories you would pursue.

job.title: Director of Advertising Technology and Operations
job.description:
The Director of Advertising Technology & Operations leads the IT function that supports Lee Enterprises’ advertising business. The role is accountable for the reliability and direction of advertising platforms, integrations, and technical operations spanning sales and order entry, digital fulfillment, creative and print production, billing and payments, and reporting.

The Director leads technical staff, sets priorities across daily support and change initiatives, and serves as a primary IT partner to Advertising leadership. Working with Finance, Sales Enablement, Product, Application Development, Infrastructure, Security, the PMO, and vendors, this position turns business needs into practical technology plans and provides leadership for major implementations and migrations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Directly supervises and develops the platform support analysts and other technical staff assigned to Advertising Operations. Sets individual and team priorities, allocates work, manages performance, plans coverage and succession, and supports staff development.

Core Responsibilities:

Own the IT strategy and operational performance of advertising order management, CRM and sales workflows, creative and production systems, digital advertising, payment processing, reporting, and related third-party platforms.

Directly lead the platform support analysts and other assigned technical staff; establish priorities, allocate capacity, develop employees, and maintain support coverage and institutional knowledge for critical systems.

Partner with Advertising and IT leadership to translate business requirements into technology roadmaps and a prioritized Jira backlog, balancing operational support, enhancements, and project delivery against available capacity.

Oversee application support, incident escalation, problem resolution, upgrades, change management, and operational readiness for revenue- and production-critical systems.

Lead the technical and operational aspects of platform implementations and migrations, including requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization, and transition or retirement of legacy systems.

Oversee integrations and data flows among order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, creative and pagination systems, billing, payments, and reporting; establish priorities for configuration, automation, and enhancements.

Ensure system changes are tested across connected workflows and validated with business users, including production checks and reconciliation where transactions affect financial records.

Partner with Finance on advertising billing, accounts receivable, payments, reconciliation, and controls at the points where advertising and financial systems meet.

Coordinate with development, architecture, infrastructure, security, and service management teams to resolve issues and align platforms with enterprise standards.

Manage advertising technology vendor relationships, including escalations, implementation commitments, service performance, technical requirements, and product direction.

Maintain operational documentation, access governance, audit support, business continuity, and disaster recovery practices for advertising systems.

Use Jira and a regular Agile planning and review cadence to track commitments, completed work, blockers, and dependencies; report delivery progress, system health, risks, and resource needs to IT leadership and business stakeholders. Coordinate timely response to critical issues, including after-hours escalation when necessary.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

Experience leading enterprise applications and technical teams in a complex, integrated operating environment.

Ability to direct work across application support, systems analysis, integrations, production technology, and software development disciplines.

Working knowledge of APIs, data exchanges, automation, vendor-hosted platforms, and the controls needed to support reliable cross-system processes.

Experience leading major implementations, migrations, upgrades, and vendor relationships while balancing ongoing support needs.

Ability to use Agile practices and Jira to manage a transparent backlog, guide planning and delivery reviews, and communicate progress and technical risks to engineers, vendors, business partners, and senior leaders.

Advertising, media, order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, payment, or production systems experience preferred; familiarity with Naviga Ad, Adbase, HubSpot, Google Ad Manager, or related platforms is an advantage.

Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT, enterprise applications, business systems, or related work, including at least three years leading technical teams or major technology programs.

Experience supporting integrated systems in a multi-location or enterprise environment preferred.

job.title: Distribution Coordinator
job.description:
The Quad City Times, a Lee Enterprises company, is hiring a full-time Distribution Coordinator.  This position is responsible to print daily and Sunday truck manifest to check advance and main draws. The Distribution Coordinator is responsible for accurate count of daily and Sunday newspaper advances by zip code and for zone; sort and distribute all alternate publication copies by district and route; count and verify draws for mains and advances prior to the carrier leaving the distribution center.

On-site, regular and reliable attendance is required. Staggered shifts range between 8PM and 5:30 AM on Sunday through Friday nights.  The Saturday night shifts are either 8PM to 5AM or 9PM to 5:30PM.

Must be able to lift 15 lbs.  Must pass background check and drug screen.

job.title: General Assignment Reporter-Aberdeen, SD
job.description:
General Assignment Reporter-Aberdeen, SD

The Aberdeen American News, part of Lee Enterprises, seeks a driven, digital-first general assignment reporter to cover Aberdeen, South Dakota, and contribute to statewide reporting. Breaking news and public safety will be central responsibilities, alongside coverage of local government, education and community life.

We’re looking for a resourceful journalist who can become an essential source of local news by breaking stories, asking consequential questions and explaining what developments mean for the people who live here.

This reporter will take a leading role in covering crime, courts, law enforcement, emergency response and other public safety issues. The job requires urgency when news breaks, sound judgment as events unfold and a commitment to verifying information before publishing. Building trusted sources across public safety agencies and the broader community will be essential.

Strong coverage goes beyond the initial incident. This reporter will pursue follow-up stories, examine public records and hold institutions accountable, helping readers understand the causes, consequences and community impact of public safety issues. We want reporting that treats victims, families and others affected by traumatic events with care and fairness.

The broader general assignment beat offers opportunities to explore how Aberdeen works and the people shaping its future. The ideal candidate is curious, persistent and eager to uncover both the issues everyone is discussing and those that deserve more attention, including local stories with statewide or national significance.

You should be comfortable working calmly under tight deadlines, making calls, reporting from the scene, delivering scoops and turning complex information into clear, conversational stories. This role requires balancing developing news with daily coverage and enterprise reporting, while keeping readers informed through timely, verified updates.

Digital storytelling is central to the job. We want someone who writes sharp, accurate headlines, understands search optimization and uses audience insights to identify useful coverage. You should be willing to experiment with live updates, explainers, Q&As, video and other formats that help readers understand the news.

Collaboration is equally important. This reporter will work closely with editors and colleagues, welcome feedback and participate in peer editing to strengthen our local and statewide coverage.

Responsibilities

Lead breaking news and public safety coverage, responding quickly to significant incidents and providing accurate, timely updates as stories develop.

Build and maintain sources among law enforcement, fire and emergency services, courts, local officials and community members.

Cover crime and court proceedings with accuracy, fairness and context, clearly distinguishing allegations from established facts.

Pursue public records and data to produce enterprise stories, accountability reporting and meaningful follow-ups to breaking news.

Report on local government, education, community issues and other general assignment topics.

Monitor developing news, community conversations and audience trends to identify consequential stories and emerging issues.

Produce clear, engaging coverage through articles, photography, video, newsletters, social media and alternative story formats.

Use audience metrics and search trends to inform story selection, strengthen headlines and help readers find our journalism.

Balance urgent assignments with planned coverage, managing multiple deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Collaborate with editors and colleagues on coverage plans, peer editing and new approaches to serving audiences, including useful evergreen content.

Requirements

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Strong reporting, writing and communication skills, with the ability to produce accurate, clear work under tight deadlines.

Sound news judgment and an understanding of journalism ethics, sourcing and verification.

The initiative to develop sources, ask difficult questions and pursue stories beyond official statements.

Ability to respond to breaking news and adapt coverage priorities as events unfold.

Familiarity with digital publishing, social media and search optimization; experience using social platforms to identify and report stories is a plus.

Experience with public records, public safety or courts reporting is a plus.

Ability to produce photos and video; experience creating graphics for digital and social audiences is a plus.

A collaborative approach and willingness to learn new tools and skills.

A valid driver’s license, reliable transportation and the minimum liability insurance required by state law.

Employment is contingent on passing a post-offer, pre-employment background check, motor vehicle record check and drug screen.

Why Join Us?

Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities.  We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match.  We also offer generous paid time off to allow flexibility to balance personal life and work.  This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

Lee Enterprises is a leading provider of local news and information and a major subscription and advertising platform, with daily and weekly newspapers and rapidly expanding digital products serving 114 markets across 25 states. Our core commitment is to provide valuable, intensely local news and information to the communities we serve.

Lee Enterprises is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We respect and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

For more information about Lee, check us out at www.lee.net.

job.description:

The Great Falls Tribune is seeking a general assignment reporter — with a special emphasis on public safety, police, courts and breaking news — to join a growing newspaper with a storied history and a bright future in Montana.
