The Media Operations, Operations & Technology group is responsible for prepping content needed for domestic and international distribution as well as broadcast operations. This includes transcode, edit and delivery services to meet client fulfilment around the globe 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Aside from supporting the day-to-day content supply, this position becomes integral to the success of high-profile LRP and strategic goals. We also support marketing supply chains as well as network stunts and events, which have included the Olympics, FIFA World Cup, and the Superbowl in the past.

The Content Solutions Specialist is responsible for strategy, administration, workflow design & solutions, integrations, and day-to-day operational builds. This role sits at the intersection of business stakeholders, clients, product, engineering, and operations; translating requirements into scalable content supply chain workflows and DAM/MAM solutions that support fast turnaround projects and LRP goals. This role designs and implements automations that support the full media asset lifecycle—from ingest through metadata enrichment & translations, QC, versioning, transcoding, delivery, and archival. 

The ideal candidate is deeply technical, operationally minded, and comfortable both gathering requirements from non-technical partners, and working closely with product and engineering to bring short term and long term workflow designs into the larger supply chain.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, build, and support end-to-end DAM/MAM supply chain workflows covering: 
    • Asset ingest (file- and API-based) 
    • Metadata validation, normalization, transformation and enrichment 
    • Automated QC and review workflows 
    • Transcoding and proxy generation 
    • Versioning, derivatives, packaging, and delivery 
  • Design and support API-based integrations between internal and third-party tooling and clients, for both upstream/downstream systems (e.g., MAMs, encoders, delivery platforms, analytics, metadata stores). 
  • Partner with Engineering on REST APIs, MCP integrations, webhooks, JSON/XML schemas/contracts, event-driven patterns, and authentication models. 
  • Build and maintain integration workflows using low-code (Java, YAML, Python, etc.) and automation platforms (e.g., Qibb, Power Automate/Logic Apps, ETLworks, AirTable) to orchestrate cross-system handoffs, automate operational processes and reduce manual touchpoints.
  • Build and support ETL metadata architecture, schemas and workflows supporting content ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and fulfillment.
  • Support and integrate supplementary CSC/Marketing Supply chain systems including AI Video & Image Technologies, Orange Logic DAM, Telestream Vantage Encoding, AWS EMC, Fabric Metadata, and other marketing, metadata, analytics, and discovery tools that intersect with the media content lifecycle.
  • Design and build agentic AI/ML‑enabled workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio (or equivalent), creating agents that streamline operational pain points, enable self‑service, orchestrate multi‑step workflows, and improve team productivity.
  • Create productivity and support solutions using our tools to enhance BAU & Projects.
  • Advise and maintain vendor engagement, including feature requests, issue escalation, release validation, and platform upgrade risk/benefits. 

Qualifications

Requirements: 

  • 2+ years of experience in full‑stack development using low‑code platforms to build scalable workflow solutions, leveraging Java, Python, or YAML for customization and integration.
  • 3+ years of experience in an operational, product, support or customer facing position for a media or technology company.
  • 3+ years experience in a role demonstrating strong technical, quantitative, or analytical skills
  • 3+ years experience in a role exhibiting excellent written and oral communications, effective interpersonal skills, project management, and presentation abilities

 

Desired Characteristics:

  • An individual with a strong desire to learn, take on new technologies and challenges.
  • Working knowledge of low-code, tools and best practices (python, java, yaml, github, vscode, etc).
  • Working knowledge/experience in ML/AI tools, functionality, enablement.
  • Ability to write clean documentation, SOPs, enable cross‑team training, and ongoing functional support for platforms and workflows.
  • Knowledge of operational ticketing/metrics/tracking systems; Salesforce, Jira, AirTable, SmartSheets, ServiceNow
  • Experience with film/tv/media workflow and content supply chain.
  • Knowledge of digital media video, audio, components and metadata.
  • Experience with DAM/MAM solutions (Orange Logic, Evertz Mediator, Frame.io, etc).
  • Experience with file encoders such as Vantage, AWS Elemental MediaConvert, Adobe Media Encoder, etc.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, problem solving, and escalation skills.
  • Experience working with or supporting post-production software and environments such Avid Media Composer, Adobe Suite, Final Cut Pro. Etc.
  • Experience with digital delivery methods, such as AWS, Aspera, Signiant, etc.
  • Experience with QC Software such as Baton, Quasar, GrayMeta Iris, Switch etc.
  • Experience with Closed Caption creation, editing and converting (CapMate, TimedText Flip, CaptionCreator, etc)
  • Experience supporting customer workflows through operations team and/or help desk.
  • Able to take on additional projects that require alignment across different internal teams for successful implementation and roll-out.
  • Strong ability to multi-task and make effective decisions in a high-pressure deadline driven environment.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interface with multiple departments, clients, and vendors.

Additional Requirements: 

  • Must be willing and able to work any shift including, overnights, swing, and/or weekend.
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the US.
  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. This position will report to the VP, Research & Editorial and transform our editorial systems that are the foundation to all of NBC Sports and Olympics content across all platforms serving critical stakeholders including on-air talent and production teams for the live coverage of events with initial primary focus on the upcoming summer and winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, Sunday Night Football, NBA, WNBA, MLB, Horse Racing, Golf, Premier League Soccer, and more.  

The ideal candidate for this role possesses deep experience in editorial content and systems, preferably both within NBC Sports and Olympics and other sporting enterprises to help drive a big picture viewpoint on what is necessary and what is possible. The ideal candidate also has significant experience working with both studio and remote on-air talent and production and other business leaders and can think through execution of this at their level seamlessly. This candidate additionally should possess a strong understanding of the types of analytics elite athletes and coaches use to assess their own performance. In short, this person is fluent in blending the science of information with the art of deployment.  

This is a senior level role that is capable of working independently for long stretches with little supervision required and is able to collaborate and drive results.  

Duties:  

  • Work with Editorial Team Leadership to transform the way information is captured, input, and output for the LA28 Games and other priority events, enabling key stakeholders to access the latest information in real-time and at any moment, not wait for reports to be carefully laid out and published and thus become instantly dated in today’s environment.   

  • Drive editorial research efforts to plug in to the new systems and troubleshoot and pivot on the fly. 

  • Train and be readily available to troubleshoot and evolve in real-time with editorial researchers at every step of this process. 

  • Partner constructively with stakeholders in other departments and outside vendors along with Editorial leadership to take the underlying editorial information foundations and fuel innovation in other content areas.  

  • Lead workshops and demonstrations and training with key stakeholders including talent and production leadership within NBC Sports.  

Basic Requirements: 

  • Minimum 8+ years working experience in a premier sports environment, including in editorial/research and information systems capacities  

  • Experience working in a matrixed environment, with the ability to build strong relationships, collaborate across multiple stakeholders, and navigate differing priorities 

  • Demonstrated success leading complex initiatives, change efforts, or business-critical projects 

  • Significant experience working under tight deadlines in a content creation environment with simultaneous premiums on both accuracy and expediency 

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience 

  • Demonstrated ability to blend raw data with narrative and editorial analysis and implement across teams 

  • Extensive experience working in a media, sports, news or editorial environment in particular with on air talent and production leadership 

  • Significant experience working with all stages of the editorial data life cycle – from acquisition to input to organization and structuring within dynamic databases, with flexible and various reporting needs, both ‘living’ and ‘static’, including expertise in troubleshooting and streamlining outputs and driving tangible insights. 

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving, and team-oriented environment, with a strong focus on innovation and continuous improvement 

  • Detail-oriented while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture and understand how systems and processes connect across the broader organization 

  • Must be flexible and able to work different schedules/hours including weekend

The NBCUniversal State & Local Government Affairs team develops and executes advocacy strategies that advance NBCUniversal’s business priorities and protect the company’s operations at the state and local levels. The team engages directly with state and local elected officials and manages relationships with trade associations and other third-party organizations to build support for NBCUniversal’s public policy agenda. NBCUniversal is looking for a Director, Government Affairs, to support the company in Los Angeles.

This Director position will report directly to the Senior Vice President, Head of Public Policy with matrix reporting to Vice President of Government and External Affairs.

Here You Can:

  • Develop and maintain relationships with policymakers, industry associations, community organizations, business groups and other key stakeholders in Los Angeles County and the City of Los Angeles.
  • Manage the public policy environment affecting NBCUniversal’s Los Angeles-area business operations including identifying risks, opportunities, and strategic advocacy priorities.
  • Identify, monitor, and analyze national trends in state and local public policy, including legislative and regulatory proposals affecting the company.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders across NBCUniversal, including Legal, Compliance Communications, and relevant business units, to assess policy impacts, and to develop advocacy strategies for advancing business objectives.
  • Advocate externally for policy positions that advance NBCUniversal’s corporate objectives and protect its business interests.
  • Clearly articulate the company’s policy positions through briefing materials, written responses, presentations, and internal policy discussions.
  • In partnership with NBCU’s Vice President of Government and External Affairs, develop and execute advocacy and stakeholder engagement strategies on issues affecting NBCUniversal in key jurisdictions across the country.
  • Support advocacy efforts designed to inform public opinion and influence legislative and regulatory decision-making through education, effective communication, and coalition building.
  • Represent NBCUniversal at industry conferences, public hearings, and other relevant events, serving as a credible ambassador for the company’s positions and interests.
  • Draft letters, presentations, testimony, and other materials communicating the company’s positions on legislative and regulatory matters.
  • Stay informed about industry developments, emerging state and local policy issues, and evolving regulatory frameworks.
  • Advise senior leadership on emerging legislative, regulatory, and political developments, providing strategic recommendations regarding potential risks, opportunities, and business impacts

Here You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in political science, international affairs, government, public affairs, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least seven years of experience in public policy, government affairs, government service, or a related field such as crisis and issue management.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing government affairs, public policy, or stakeholder engagement strategies in a complex, highly matrixed environment.
  • Deep knowledge of local legislative processes in Los Angeles County and/or the City of Los Angeles.
  • Solid political network in Los Angeles.
  • Exceptional writing and verbal skills, including the ability to distill complex policy issues into clear explanations and compelling messages.
  • Outstanding project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate legislative and regulatory proposals and assess their potential impact on the company.
  • Excellent organizational skills and proficiency with Microsoft suite of products such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Critical to this role is the ability to manage the trafficking system that delivers campaigns, ensuring the media plans are accurately reflecting the expected user experience.

The Director leads and develops a team responsible for campaign planning, trafficking, and ongoing optimization, ensuring flawless execution in a fast-faced environment.

  • Demonstrated experience owning campaign execution from planning through trafficking and delivery
  • Hands-on experience with campaign trafficking systems (e.g. FreeWheel or similar platforms)

The Global Security Operations team at NBCU seeks an energetic and enthusiastic safety and security specialist to support the daily work of NBCUs New’s teams across the U.S. This individual will be an integral part of a News Security team committed to delivering holistic support at a standard of excellence for all News personnel and newsgathering activities across the company.  

The Director, Security for NBCU will have oversight of security logistics and physical security operations for NBCU News personnel and spaces, including the planning and execution phases of all remote operations. This individual reports directly to the Senior Director of News Security, as part of the Global Security Operations team, working across all News properties.* This individual will manage vendor relationships and ensure the necessary resources, policies, processes, and plans are in place to protect the company’s employees, operations, physical property, and intellectual property. This position will deploy extensively with News personnel and will be based out of New York City. 

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

  • Work directly with News producers, camera operators, senior executives, talent and local staff on all aspects of the planning and execution of security logistics and operations, including, but not limited to, the planning and execution phase of all news remotes; this includes assessing security needs, securing appropriate vendors, traveling to remotes when required, and conducting post-mortems to identify lessons learned and opportunities for improvement.  
  • Assist in the management and coordination of News Security responses to dynamic and large-scale news stories, including coordinating across the team, and supporting a follow-the-sun model when appropriate.  Collaborate and coordinate across the News Security team to ensure a consistent and holistic approach to safety and security. 
  • Collaborate with the News Security team to stablish security guidelines and training requirements for News employees; coordinate all necessary security-related training, either as the training facilitator or as a direct liaison with contracted training vendors.  
  • Manage confidential and or sensitive information, and professionally, thoughtfully and sensitively provide support or guidance to News personnel and or management who might be navigating high-stress or emotionally difficult situations.  
  • Work Closely with the Global Security Operations and the NBCU Cyber Security team to coordinate and advise on News security needs and develop a regular communication rhythm with the NBCU Global Response & Intelligence Center (GRIC) team. Track news deployments and document and report incidents for data gathering and record-keeping purposes, and to facilitate regular monitoring, evaluation and learning to ensure industry-leading support.  
  • Assist appropriate News management (HR, Legal, etc.) with investigations when appropriate. Play an active role in representing the Security Department with Business Continuity and Crisis Management teams.  
  • Develop and maintain meaningful business relationships with Local and National law enforcement, government emergency response agencies, other news organizations, and other potential safety partners. Direct personal protection support for News senior executives and talent as needed.  
  • Provide guidance on the design, development, assessment, and effectiveness of company security policies, as well as training, tools, and resources related to newsgathering safety (e.g. PPE, specialist training, etc.).  
  • Develop, plan and execute against continued process optimization and quality improvement initiatives, focused on improving functions, quality, and costs including performance vs. best practice initiatives.  
  • Oversee vendors, including contracts, budgets, and invoice processing, and implement security action plans for News teams; coordinate all security vendors who operate remotely for News and ensure that standard operating procedures are fit for purpose, up to date, and adhered to.

Qualifications and Requirements  

  • Significant professional experience in media or news security, corporate security, military, law enforcement or similar.  
  • Experience managing budgets and stakeholder management, including working with external vendors.  
  • Experience with general security concepts and methods such as deployment planning, vulnerability assessments, privacy assessments, intrusion detection, incident response, and security policy creation. 
  • Must be willing to be on-call and available 24/7 for emergencies. 
  • Must be willing to travel, as needed, at times on short notice. 

Desired Characteristics  

  • Security experience in the field of News or Media safety or security. HEFAT experience is strongly preferred. 
  • Strong knowledge of trends and emerging threats to journalists and media organizations, particularly in the U.S.   
  • Self-starter, who leads with integrity, with strong attention to detail and time management skills.  
  • A team player with the ability to work collaboratively as part of a disbursed team. 
  • Experience working with senior level executives and/or high-profile talent, particularly related to security.  
  • Experience establishing and implementing departmental strategy as well as managing short and long-term projects. Ability to coordinate multiple projects, responsibilities, and deadlines concurrently. 
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, often with limited information.  
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred. 

Additional Information 

Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

The Director, Software Engineering leads the Legal Engineering delivery pillar within our Legal, Privacy & Compliance Engineering organization. You will lead the engineering team that build, integrate, and operate the technology powering our Legal department including, spanning contract lifecycle management, legal document management, eDiscovery and legal hold, intellectual property management, eBilling, and a growing portfolio of AI agentic workflows.

This is a build-and-lead role: you will own a portfolio that blends enterprise SaaS platforms with bespoke software and lead the engineering of the interoperability layer and differentiated custom applications that make the whole ecosystem greater than its parts. 

This role requires both deep technical and leadership with business acumen in the corporate legal space.  This leader will own the end-to-end delivery of legal technical solutions that enable capabilities across jurisdictions, partners directly with Product Management, Legal, and Cyber.  This role will be responsible for hiring, retaining, and continuously assessing the health and growth of the legal engineering team.

  • Engineering Leadership & Delivery
    • Leads a team of engineering managers, staff software engineers, and architects), plus contractors and interns
    • Own engineering delivery, technical health, reliability, and quality across the legal technology portfolio — SaaS platforms, custom applications, integrations, and data flows
    • Drive engineering excellence: architecture reviews, code quality, CI/CD, automated testing, and operational readiness
    • Steer programs at the right altitude — owning key decisions, pro-active escalations, and delivery health in partnership with our Technical Program Management and Product Management functions
    • Establish and uphold software quality, legal architecture and engineering standards, and NBCU cyber guidelines
    • Drive delivery across multiple complex concurrent programs/projects
    • Partner with Principal architect, scrum lead, product owner, and technical project manager to ensure standards and stakeholder visibility

    • Lead the strategy and engineering for interoperability between SaaS platforms and bespoke software — APIs, data integration, workflow orchestration, and shared services
    • Ensure solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and data governance standards

    • Engage directly with Legal department and Legal Operations leaders; translate their operational needs into reliable, scalable and secure engineering solutions

  • System Reliability & Performance: Proactively manage reliability and performance of all systems to ensure they meet global business needs. Partner closely with SaaS providers and internal teams to maintain system health and performance.

job.title: DreamWorks Technology - Principal Engineer, AI
job.description:
DreamWorks Animation is looking for more adventurous dreamers who shoot for the moon. We tell stories about the journeys our unconventional heroes take to make dreams come true. As a growth-minded studio, we pride ourselves on being one of the world's leading producers of high-quality, award-winning, animated films and series, reaching consumers around the globe. We push to feel more, laugh more, and build immersive new worlds.

DreamWorks creates a diverse array of original content in a variety of formats, delivering compelling stories with unique characters. We place tremendous value on the experiences our talent brings to the table from their own non-traditional paths to success. We believe in frequent communication and that transparency and trust yield the best work. We are a community of artists, technologists, innovators, and creators, who are passionate about animation and also happen to love eating lunch together. 

DreamWorks is seeking a highly collaborative AI Architect who will be a hands-on technical leader assistive across multiple teams aimed to provide results to both technical and creative departments. This role involves identifying, designing, and delivering AI-powered agentic architecture that eliminates the repetitive, manual, low-creativity tasks that pull artists and production management away from their craft, while maintaining high operational availability to ensure production systems run reliably. An ideal candidate should be an adventurous, growth-minded problem solver who thrives in collaborative environments, values transparency and trust, and possesses a deep passion for leveraging technology to empower artists and storytellers. 

If you are part of the fandom and believe teamwork makes the dream work, join us in #livingthedream and #doingyourdreamwork!

“What would you say you do here?”

  • Collaborate and advise on next-generation AI-assisted agentic workflows strategy alongside product owners, developers and creatives. 
  • Design and own the architecture for AI-powered frameworks and automation across the entire Studio pipeline and platforms.
  • Define the end-to-end architecture for ingestion, processing, and routing of operational telemetry (metrics, logs, traces).
  • Integrate solutions with popular industry DCC tools.
  • Prototype solutions for high-friction tasks: asset tagging, scene prep, render queue management, shot setup, and versioning.
  • Define technical standards and integration patterns for AI tooling across departments and shows.
  • Evaluate and select AI frameworks, foundation models, and automation technologies for creative production and operational stability.
  • Build and maintain a library of reusable AI components and automation patterns.
  • Partner with platform, systems and security teams to monitor model drift, system latency, and system security.
  • Write, test, and deploy production-ready tools that run reliably inside active show pipelines.
  • Develop reference implementations that set the canonical pattern for future pipeline AI work.
  • Partner with engineers and TDs to fold automation into existing artist-facing toolsets.
  • Maintain and iterate on deployed tools based on artist feedback and production data.
  • Drive adoption across both technical and creative departments so tools are understood, trusted, and used.
  • Create lightweight training and documentation for artists and engineers.
  • Establish metrics for automation impact and report results to studio leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and surface new automation opportunities as workflows evolve.

“What do I need to have in order to do this job?”

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years building production systems, with 2+ years building AI/ML systems for real workflows.
  • Hands-on experience deploying enterprise software in AI, data, or integration environments.
  • Expertise with containerization, orchestration, Python, TypeScript, React, and AI frameworks such as LangGraph, Spring AI and MCP.
  • Deep understanding of LLM model integration and tuning.
  • Experience with designing automation that reduces manual work in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven ability to influence senior engineers without authority and to be the person others learn from.
  • History of building and supporting durable artifacts: frameworks, templates, training, open source that extend to other projects.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate fluently between artists, production management, and engineers.
  • Genuine passion for animation, storytelling, or creative production.

“What can I offer?”

  • 2+ years in a Principal, Staff, or Lead role responsible for AI or pipeline automation, ideally in a creative studio.
  • Strong understanding of the animation production pipeline, departmental workflows, and industry-standard digital content creation (DCC) software.
  • Familiarity with animation frameworks and standards such as USD, Autodesk Flow Production Tracking and Jira.
  • Experience measuring and reporting the productivity impact of engineering tooling investments.
  • Stays current with AI trends and emerging technologies.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $190,000 - $230,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. job.title: Editorial Assistant, Shop TODAY
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

TODAY Digital is looking for an Editorial Assistant to support Shop TODAY’s editorial and commerce initiatives, specifically assisting in the digital production of Shop TODAY's commerce coverage across daily programming. This role serves as a key liaison between the editorial and production teams, creating commerce elements tied to digital content and on-air segments, identifying timely shopping trends, maintaining editorial production tools and ensuring seamless coordination with the editorial team.

The ideal candidate is an organized, detail-oriented individual with strong commerce instincts who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment. This position requires excellent editorial judgment, strong CMS knowledge, an understanding of SEO and audience trends, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute digital production requests from the editorial team and create all backend elements for digital commerce articles.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues in editorial production and work with the product team to escalate and resolve them. 
  • Support implementation of new production features within CMS and work with the editorial operations manager to improve the production process. 
  • Help facilitate curation of content on reader-facing Commerce fronts on TODAY.com.
  • Refresh/update high-priority articles and evergreen commerce content as assigned.
  • Pitch products for article inclusion as needed, using analytics and historical brand data to ensure pitches are relevant and expected top performers
  • Help maintain and update the various editorial calendars & trackers for the team, ensuring alignment across broadcast programming and editorial coverage.
  • Help with digital and seasonal story coverage as needed.
  • Support editorial coverage for major shopping events, including Prime Day and Black Friday/Cyber Monday.
  • Monitor story performance using analytics platforms and use insights to improve content, headlines, product curation and overall strategy
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maximize reach and conversions 

This position is eligible for company-sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary Range: $31.25 - $36.05

  • 1-2 years of related experience in lifestyle, commerce or service journalism
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Strong editorial judgment with the ability to write clean, engaging and conversion-minded copy
  • Experience working efficiently and accurately in a deadline-driven environment, managing multiple projects
  • Interest in shopping and lifestyle trends 
  • Experience writing and building in a CMS strongly preferred
  • Experience utilizing SEO best practices and tools
  • Excellent verbal/written communication skills and knowledge of AP style
  • Sharp editorial judgement and a clear understanding of the Shop TODAY voice and audience
  • E-commerce editorial experience preferred; familiarity with affiliate marketing platforms a plus

Additional Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through nbcunicareers.com to be considered 
  • Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the United States 
  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week, Monday-Thursday. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. job.title: Engineering Supervisor
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Engineering Supervisor will work closely with the Manager of Facilities Engineer and provide supervision of the Engineering team at both low and high-rise buildings. This includes the efficient operation, oversight and upkeep of the central plants, the installation, maintenance and repair of mechanical equipment, controls, plumbing and electrical systems, building envelopes, and grounds. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, coordinate all maintenance activities, manage vendor and employee relationships, and collaborate with contractors to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Execute weekly workplans, including preventative, corrective and reactive maintenance work orders assigned through the CMMS and mobile platforms
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activity, equipment performance, repair history, and costs in the CMMS
  • Work closely with the Chief Engineer to provide support for central chiller plants and other critical infrastructure supporting the sites, data centers, and critical spaces
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, including critical infrastructure, to ensure continuous, efficient, and safe operations
  • Partner with Facility Operations on all MEP and critical infrastructure preventative maintenance programs
  • Participate and provide support for annual LAFD REG4 testing
  • Monitor N4 building automation systems (BAS) to optimize energy use, systems performance, and maintain comfortable environments for employees and guests. Provide updates to management and Central Monitoring teams on alarms and impacts on operations
  • Work closely with the Critical Infrastructure System team on the ArcGIS platform, projects and emergency response strategies  
  • Partner with the Asset Management team to drive EAM processes and ensure assets are tagged and data is accurate in the Master Asset List
  • Participate in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOP) and key performance indicators (KPI’s) with Facility Operations and the Asset Management team
  • Oversee vendor and 3rd party contracted services to ensure scope of work is completed as required. Includes having all documents and costs added to the asset in the CMMS  
  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly (AQMD, OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements)
  • Support emergency preparedness initiatives and attend drills and exercises related to fire, disaster response, and business continuity
  • Ensure that general safety, fire prevention regulations, and safe working habits are enforced
  • Attend bid walks and assist with project oversite when required 
  • Support of multiple sites and assign tasks to Engineering teams as required within the Los Angeles area 
  • Maintain OSHA 30-hour certification  
  • Other duties as assigned

Let’s Talk About You:

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease

What You Have:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • 7+ years of experience in building engineering or a related field
  • Working knowledge of Class A commercial building operations and applicable fire/life safety testing requirements, including Los Angeles REG 4 where relevant.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS), including the ability to troubleshoot and coordinate repairs.
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
  • Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Will Make You Stand Out:

  • Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
  • OSHA 30-Hour General Industry certification, or ability to obtain/maintain certification within a company-designated timeframe.
  • Tridium N4 knowledge
  • EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
  • Relevant trade license HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours and travel as needed

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $95,000 - $110,000

job.description:

We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

ABOUT UNIVERSAL TELEVISION (UTV)  
Universal Television (UTV), a division of Universal Studio Group, is one of the largest and most successful television studios in the world. Led by President Erin Underhill, the studio is known for programming with broad appeal and cultural relevance. UTV currently produces over 40 primetime comedies and dramas across broadcast, cable, and streaming platforms. Home to commercial hits such as Dick Wolf's enormously successful “Law & Order,” “One Chicago” and “FBI”-branded series, UTV also produces celebrated premium series including the Emmy® Award-winning “Hacks” and “The Gilded Age,” fan favorites “St. Denis Medical,” “Loot,” “A Man on the Inside” and “The Four Seasons,” as well as cultural phenomena “Bel-Air,” “Never Have I Ever” and “The Best Man: The Final Chapters.” UTV’s library comprises some of the greatest contemporary shows in television history, including “The Office,” “Parks and Recreation,” “The Good Place,” “Will & Grace,” “Friday Night Lights,” “New Amsterdam” and more.

The Entertainment Coordinator will provide administrative support to two Drama Development executives within the Universal Television Studio organization, and serve as office liaison communicating with internal NBCU divisions as well as the external business and creative community.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • General administrative duties including but not limited to: answering telephones, scheduling meetings, planning all travel arrangements for executives, and compiling expense reports
  • Maintain submission log & other departmental documents
  • Assist in communication with the creative community on a daily basis
  • Conduct research on request and maintain a general awareness of industry trends, formats, talent and competitive environment
  • Distribute materials to internal and external parties as needed following strict protocols
  • Will be a team player and cover for other department assistants as needed

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum 1 year working within studio, network, agency or production company in an assistant capacity.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Working knowledge of Air Table, Adobe, Final Draft, Microsoft Office including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams
  • Experience with Canva or other visual/deck-building programs is a plus
  • Knowledge of how the TV development process works and key players within the industry
  • Willingness to read and write coverage for available IP – scripts, books, articles, podcasts, etc.
  • Multi-task oriented, excellent organizational and time management skills, as position will assist high volume department
  • Flexible, personable, self-starter, and extremely detail-oriented with the ability to interface with the creative community as well as all levels of NBCU staff
  • Team player who is willing to jump in to help when needed and has a positive attitude
  • Ability to work well in a fast paced, deadline driven environment

Additional Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV online to be considered
  • Willingness to work overtime and on weekends with short notice
  • Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program
  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. NBCUniversal is looking for a Facility Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the efficient operation, maintenance and repair of building envelopes, systems, equipment, grounds and infrastructure. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, conduct preventative maintenance, respond to service calls, escort vendors on site, and collaborate with contractors to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, including critical infrastructure, to ensure continuous, efficient, and safe operations
  • Monitor building automation systems (BAS) to optimize energy use, systems performance, and maintain comfortable environments for employees and guests
  • Address and resolve building system failures in a timely manner to minimize disruptions
  • Respond to service requests and emergencies during and after business hours
  • Conduct site inspections and meter readings as required
  • Complete preventative, corrective and reactive maintenance work orders assigned through the CMMS and mobile platform
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activity, equipment performance, repair history, and costs in the CMMS
  • Work closely with the Asset Management team to ensure assets are tagged and data is accurate in the Master Asset List
  • Participate in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOP) and key performance indicators (KPI’s) with Facility Operations and the Asset Management team
  • Oversee and support vendor and 3rd party contracted services.
  • Schedule and coordinate service calls with internal teams and external vendors
  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly 
  • Support emergency preparedness initiatives and attend drills and exercises related to fire, disaster response, and business continuity
  • Adhere to OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements
  • Support Facility Operations and support teams with event set-ups
  • Interior & exterior painting and general carpentry tasks as needed
  • Attend bid walks and assist with project oversite when required  
  • Other duties as assigned

Let’s Talk About You:

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease

What You Have:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required;
  • 3+ years of experience in building engineering, facilities management or a related field or equivalent
  • Understanding of Class A commercial building operations
  • Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS)
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
  • Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Would Make You Stand Out:

  • Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills
  • Relevant trade license or certifications (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage)
  • EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
  • Understanding of Class A high rise operations and REG 4

Additional Requirements:

  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite. 
  • Ability to work flexible hours and travel as needed

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $46.00 - $48.00/hourly

Position Overview:

As part of the Peacock Data Science team, the Senior Lead Data Scientist will be responsible for creating recommendation and personalization solutions for one or more verticals of Peacock Video Streaming Service. 

You’ll collaborate with an international, cross-functional team of engineers, architects, product managers and analysts to identify and prioritize enhancements to Peacock’s personalization models. Your responsibilities will touch everything from feature creation to model evaluation and deployment, and you’ll have opportunities to work on cutting edge machine learning like foundation models and reinforcement learning.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work with a group of data scientists in the development of recommendation and personalization models using statistical, machine learning and data mining methodologies.
  • Drive the collection and manipulation of new data and the refinement of existing data sources.
  • Translate complex problems and solutions to all levels of the organization.
  • Collaborate with software and data architects in building real-time and automated batch implementations of data science solutions and integrating them into the streaming service architecture.
  • Drive innovation of the statistical and machine learning methodologies and tools used by the team.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Advanced (Master or PhD) degree with specialization in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Operations Research or another quantitative field or equivalent.
  • 5+ years of combined experience in machine learning in industry or research.
  • Experience with commercial recommender systems or a lead role in an advanced research recommender system project.
  • Strong working experience with deep learning.
  • Proficient in Python.  
  • Experience in data processing using SQL and PySpark.
  • Experience working with foundation models and other GenAI technologies.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience in media analytics and application of data science to the content streaming and TV industry.
  • Good understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and graph methodologies.
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering.
  • Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, and Databricks (or equivalent).
  • Experience with large-scale video assets.
  • Team oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn new methods and tools.

Additional Requirements: 

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

Role Summary

The Manager, Compensation will lead and execute a broad range of compensation initiatives, including market pricing, compensation planning, program administration, job architecture, and the evaluation of compensation practices and policies. This role will serve as a trusted advisor to HR and business stakeholders, translating complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support competitive, equitable, and effective compensation programs. The Manager will independently manage projects, strengthen processes and governance, and help deliver a consistent employee and stakeholder experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead market pricing, benchmarking, and competitive assessments for a broad range of roles, and develop well-supported compensation recommendations for HR and business leaders.
  • Serve as a compensation advisor to HR partners and business stakeholders, providing guidance on compensation programs, pay decisions, organizational changes, and other complex compensation matters.
  • Participate in external compensation surveys and oversee the organization, validation, and analysis of market data
  • Manage the administration and ongoing enhancement of employee recognition programs, including peer-to-peer recognition, anniversary milestone recognition, and spot recognition. Evaluate participation and effectiveness, manage vendor relationships, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and drive a consistent and engaging employee experience.
  • Develop compensation-related communications, presentations, and educational materials for employees, managers, HR partners, and senior leadership, translating complex concepts into clear and actionable guidance.
  • Evaluate compensation levels, pay mix, program effectiveness, market competitiveness, and internal equity, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Lead key components of annual compensation planning, including process coordination, data validation, reporting, analytics, issue resolution, and stakeholder support.
  • Support compensation governance and regulatory compliance by strengthening controls, documentation, reporting, and consistent process execution.
  • Monitor market, industry, regulatory, and economic trends, and recommend enhancements that support the ongoing effectiveness and competitiveness of compensation programs.
  • Partner with HR Operations and HR Technology teams to define business requirements, improve processes, resolve system issues, and ensure HR systems accurately support compensation programs, job architecture, and pay administration.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive compensation experience, or related experience in human resources, finance, consulting, or a similar analytical discipline.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing compensation programs and projects, including market pricing, salary administration, incentive compensation, compensation planning, or compensation analytics.
  • Experience advising HR and business leaders on compensation matters and developing recommendations for complex or sensitive situations.
  • Experience working with compensation survey data, HRIS platforms, compensation systems, and reporting tools; experience supporting job architecture and employee recognition programs is a plus.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis, financial modelling, reporting, and data validation; ability to work effectively with large and complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Ability to translate complex data and compensation concepts into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for a range of audiences.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and drive work forward independently.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, and integrity in handling sensitive and confidential information.

The Manager is responsible for developing insights and recommendations that inform executive compensation decisions, monitoring market and regulatory developments, and supporting Compensation Committee and senior leadership materials. This position provides an opportunity to influence executive compensation strategy while ensuring programs remain competitive, aligned with business objectives, and reflective of evolving market practices and governance standards.

Here You Can:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting SEC filings, proxy statement preparation, executive compensation disclosures, or related governance activities preferred.
  • Solid analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with compensation survey data, market pricing tools, HRIS platforms, compensation systems, and reporting tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence decisions and build credibility with business partners and stakeholders.

NBCUniversal is looking for a Manager of Facilities Engineering! In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing a team of Engineers and support staff on the efficient operation, maintenance and repair of building envelopes, systems, equipment, infrastructure and grounds for both low and high rise buildings. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, coordinate all maintenance activities, manage vendor relationships, and collaborate with contractors to ensure the facility operates efficiently, remains safe and is compliant with all regulations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Oversee chiller plants and other critical infrastructure supporting the sites, data centers, and critical spaces
  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, including critical infrastructure, to ensure continuous, efficient, and safe operations
  • Manage all MEP and critical infrastructure preventative maintenance programs. Including creating and maintaining an annual service calendar
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance activity, equipment performance, repair history, and costs in the CMMS
  • Coordinate and oversee annual LAFD REG4 testing
  • Monitor N4 building automation systems (BAS) to optimize energy use, systems performance, and maintain comfortable environments for employees and guests. Provide updates to management and Central Monitoring teams on alarms and impacts on operations
  • Develop weekly workplans and assign preventative, corrective and reactive maintenance work orders assigned through the CMMS and mobile platform with the assistance of the planner / scheduler
  • Work closely with the Critical Infrastructure System team on the ArcGIS platform, projects and emergency response strategies  
  • Assist the Asset Management team developing and driving EAM processes and ensuring assets are tagged and data is accurate in the Master Asset List
  • Participate in the development and implementation of standard operating procedures (SOP) and key performance indicators (KPI’s) with Facility Operations and the Asset Management team
  • Manage vendor and 3rd party contracted services to ensure scope of work is completed as required. Includes having all documents and costs added to the asset in the CMMS  
  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly (AQMD, OSHA, ADA and other regulatory requirements)
  • Support emergency preparedness initiatives and attend drills and exercises related to fire, disaster response, and business continuity
  • Work closely with the Director of Facilities and Facility Managers on capital project planning, annual operating budgets, including attending bid walks and assisting with project oversite when required 
  • Support of multiple sites and assign tasks to Engineering teams as required within the Los Angeles area 
  • Maintain OSHA 30-hour certification  
  • Other duties as assigned 

Let’s Talk About You:

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Facilities Guru- You have extensive experience leading complex facility operations and engineering solutions. You are a pro at managing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems, along with general maintenance of grounds, facilities and otherwise
  • Analytical expert- Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills
  • Project Wrangler – expertise in seeing opportunities for improvement, gaining support, breaking down to bite-sized chunks, executing and seeking feedback will give you a superpower to strategically partner with clients and change workflow as opportunities arise
  • Juggler – You know how to manage multiple tasks and priorities and move them all along effectively while keeping stakeholders updating and informed
  • Executer – You get things done!  Using strong business acumen, inciteful analytical skills, and superior organizational skills, troubleshooting skills, and diagnostic skills to manage through competing priorities within a matrixed environment
  • Self-starter – You are motivated, can work with minimal guidance, and can identify helpful resources to get the job done

What You Have:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent 
  • 10+ years of experience in building engineering, facilities operations, critical infrastructure, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of Class A commercial building operations and applicable fire/life safety testing requirements, including Los Angeles REG 4 where relevant.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS), including the ability to troubleshoot and coordinate repairs.
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
  • Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Will Make You Stand Out:

  • OSHA 30-Hour General Industry certification, or ability to obtain/maintain certification within a company-designated timeframe.
  • Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
  • EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
  • Tridium N4 knowledge
  • Relevant trade license HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage

The Finance Manager is a key role on the Universal Studio Group (USG) Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team and will be responsible for driving Free Cash Flow (FCF) financial forecasting, reporting and analysis across the studio. This position partners with cross-divisional teams (including Production Finance, Controllership, Participations & Residuals teams, Studios, UTE, and NBCU Corporate) to drive strategic decision making, streamline processes, and ensure accurate financial performance. This role will report to the Director of Financial Planning & Analysis for USG.  

Essential Responsibilities 

Studio Delivery Volume Forecasting & Reporting 

  • Lead forecasting and reporting processes for the USG’s portfolio, including monthly presentations of production and delivery projections to Senior Finance Executives. 
  • Maintain and track key Studio volume metrics to ensure accuracy and transparency. 

Financial Modeling & Forecasting 

  • Build and manage detailed 3rd Party & Peacock Collections in partnership with the USG Operating Cash Flow (OCF) team and cross-divisional finance stakeholders (NBC/Cable/Peacock). 
  • Support long-range planning through the development of annual operating plans, forecasts, and five-year financial models. 

Free Cash Flow (FCF) Management 

  • Oversee the FCF pacing process by reviewing production spending, tax credits, development, collections, audits, Accounts Receivable (AR) aging, Participations & Residuals. 
  • Manage the 13-week cash flow forecast on a weekly basis. 
  • Identify and communicate risks and opportunities, delivering clear updates to USG/Studios Finance leadership and the corporate FP&A team. 
  • Manage FCF submissions, reporting, analytics, and scenario planning to support informed decision-making. 

Executive & Strategic Support 

  • Assist with preparing executive presentations covering key business topics (e.g., Year over Year (YoY) analysis, OCF to FCF conversion). 
  • Provide ad hoc financial analysis and insights to help guide strategic initiatives. 

Close & Controllership Support 

  • Lead critical close processes, including close checks, in close coordination with the Controllership team during month and quarter-end. 

Corporate Partnership & Reporting 

  • Collaborate with corporate FP&A to provide studio-level analytics, elimination details, and key supplemental reporting. 
  • Work in partnership with the Studios & UTE Finance teams to provide key analysis and reporting 

Project Management & Process Improvement 

  • Drive key initiatives across the studio, including process simplification, systems upgrades, and implementation of best practices to improve efficiency. 

Basic Requirements: 

  • BS/BA degree with Accounting/Finance focus preferred 
  • 4+ years public and/or private accounting, or FP&A experience preferred 
  • High proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint  
  • Accounting / Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) knowledge 

Desired Characteristics: 

  • Experience managing FP&A cycles is preferred 
  • Team player with ability to work well in a cross-functional environments and willingness to jump into projects to meet department goals 
  • Ability to quickly grasp new concepts and problem solve
  • Strong initiative and ability to manage multiple projects  
  • Ability to work independently 
  • Strong interpersonal skills: ability to work and communicate effectively with all levels of finance, operations, and senior management 
  • Continuous improvement attitude, willingness to seek out and implement best practices 
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational, analytical and PC skills 
  • Strong organization and time management skills; ability to deliver on multiple project assignments, meet tight deadlines and be effective under pressure 
  • Entertainment / Media / TV Production experience preferred 
  • SAP or Essbase knowledge preferred with exposure to BPC a plus

NBC News Group is looking for a passionate, motivated candidate to join the Digital Analytics team. The Manager will play a critical role on the team, shaping analytics approaches, ensuring data accuracy, identifying key trends and performance drivers, and translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. You will partner with a diverse group of stakeholders across editorial, marketing, finance, product, and business teams to help them understand what audiences are watching and listening to, how they’re engaging with our content, and where opportunities exist to improve programming, distribution, and the overall audience experience.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in data analysis, a sharp eye for patterns, and a deep interest in digital media, streaming, and audio. You understand industry trends, content consumption, and audience behavior—and are excited to turn that knowledge into meaningful insights that help shape strategy across NBC News Group.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and support daily, weekly, and monthly reporting on audience consumption, engagement, and content performance, evolving reporting approaches as business needs change
  • Develop dashboards, presentations, and data visualizations that clearly communicate performance trends, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Create and maintain audience and consumption forecasts for streaming platforms in partnership with finance and planning teams
  • Partner closely with communications and marketing teams to develop data-driven messaging around streaming performance, audience growth, and key milestones
  • Monitor the broader streaming and digital media landscape to identify industry trends, evolving audience behaviors, and competitive performance
  • Partner with editorial, product, finance, marketing, and business teams on ad hoc analyses that answer key business questions and inform strategic decision-making
  • Help ensure the accuracy and consistency of streaming and audio data, reporting, and measurement methodologies across the organization

  • BA/BS or MS degree in a quantitative area of study (Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or related discipline)
  • Experience with web and social analytics tools (Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Domo, or Power BI
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel (R or Python a plus)

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and maintaining strong attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to translate complex data and analyses into clear, compelling insights for audiences with varying levels of analytical expertise
  • Strong analytical thinking, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for using data to uncover insights and solve problems

NBCUniversal is seeking a Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) Manager to join the Facilities Operations and Engineering team in Universal City, CA. This role works closely with all divisions of West Coast Studio Operations and reports to the Director of Critical Infrastructure. As an individual contributor, the MEP Manager is responsible for overseeing day-to-day facility operations across the NBCUniversal Studio Lot, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.
 

What You’ll Do: 

  • Works under the direction of the Director of Facilities Infrastructure Systems to support MEP operations across studio facilities and production environments, ensuring reliable and efficient infrastructure.
  • Enforce safety protocols across MEP operations, ensuring full compliance with EHS regulations and industry’s best practices. 
  • Monitor the quality of all MEP services, repairs, and installations to ensure work meets technical specifications and the highest performance standards. 
  • Collaborate with the asset management team to maintain accurate inventory and lifecycle tracking of all equipment and infrastructure, supporting long-term planning and capital replacement strategies. 
  • Ensure preventive maintenance programs and inspection routines are consistently executed to maintain system performance, safety, and regulatory compliance. 
  • Partner with the Contracts Manager to support procurement and financial activities, including vendor sourcing, RFP development, contract negotiation and administration, budget tracking, and purchase approvals. 
  • Engage with external vendors and contractors, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with quality expectations and contractual requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot and respond to operational challenges including after-hours issues such as equipment failures, HVAC disruptions, and electrical or plumbing incidents that may impact production and theme park/CityWalk operations in some instances. 
  • Coordinate and prioritize MEP work requests, ensuring timely and accurate completion across electrical, plumbing, and HVAC systems. 
  • Contribute to the development and management of the studio operations budget, ensuring effective resource allocation and cost control. 
  • Participate in the planning and oversight of capital improvement projects involving MEP systems, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery. Monitor project performance, including schedule adherence, cost control, quality standards, and estimate reviews.
  • Support critical infrastructure planning, enterprise standards development, and general building systems automation/reporting to include supporting external sites as needed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and provide regular updates to leadership and stakeholders. 
  • Coordinate daily operational schedules across MEP functions to ensure alignment with production needs. 
  • Recommend and support the procurement of equipment, tools, and supplies to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness. 
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful project planning and implementation. 
  • Support the development and implementation of training programs to ensure MEP staff remain proficient with current technologies, codes, and standards. 
  • Support initiatives focused on energy efficiency and sustainability in alignment with organizational environmental goals. 
  • Partner with Emergency Services teams to ensure rapid and effective response to MEP related incidents. Ensure all facility modifications comply with applicable codes and regulations, including those related to fire protection and boiler systems.
  • Attend required meetings and participate in ongoing professional development to maintain technical expertise. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Let’s Talk About You…

  • Analytical - You create tools and processes quickly and accurately to provide job estimates for clients levering deep industry experience, historical trends, teams and vendor relationships.
  • Executer - You get things done and take accountability! Using strong business acumen, organizational and superior process/project management skills, you prioritize and execute numerous complex projects in parallel.
  • Customer Service Skills - You communicate effectively and solve problems to drive customer service and make client delivery a priority.  
  • Principles - Displays integrity, responsibility, accountability, teamwork, and ethics.
  • Team Player - Fosters a culture of teamwork, mutual respect, and collaboration across diverse teams. Builds and maintains strong, productive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
     

What You Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education in Engineering, Business or related field
  • 3+ years prior experience in facility maintenance operations
  • 3+ years of experience managing union personnel
  • 2+ years of experience in work planning and analysis
  • 2+ years of experience in cost-effective internal business practices
  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics and verification
     

What Would Make You a Stand-out:

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems (HVAC, piping, cooling systems, building automation, utilities and electrical systems)
  • Experience with enterprise Integrated Workplace Management Systems, work planning and scheduling and materials management
  • Demonstrates proficiency in Microsoft Office, ArcGIS, Building/Energy Management Systems such as Tridium and other relevant tools.
  • Working knowledge and understanding of building codes and standards, safety workplace practices, environmental compliance, energy efficiency standards, accessibility requirements, fire safety and suppression systems, emergency and disaster preparedness as well as other applicable standards, codes, and requirements relevant to the job function
  • Comfortable operating in high-pressure, mission-critical builds
  • 5+ years prior experience in Facilities or equivalent complex facility operation.
  • Professional designations such as BOMA, LEED, etc.
  • Experience managing in a union environment
