The Media Management Operations Specialist is a specialized, hands-on technical role responsible for the processing, management, quality control, organization, storage, and lifecycle of media assets supporting network broadcast, sports, news, and production operations.

Job Duties:

  • Execute and monitor media ingest, transcoding, transfer, QC, archive, restoration, export, and distribution workflows across broadcast, post-production, and cloud-based environments.
  • Manage and organize media within MAM, AVID, Cloud systems, archive, and shared-storage systems, ensuring assets are properly processed, organized, accessible, and available within required deadlines.
  • Perform comprehensive technical and visual quality control (QC) of media, identifying issues involving video, audio, timecode, resolution, frame rate, synchronization, file integrity, metadata, and technical specifications.
  • Validate metadata, naming conventions, folder structures, media placement, and delivery specifications to ensure accuracy and compliance with established standards.
  • Monitor media storage, asset availability, retention, archive, and restoration activities in support of content lifecycle and storage-management requirements.
  • Independently troubleshoot failed or delayed ingest, transcode, transfer, archive, restoration, and delivery workflows and perform appropriate first-level corrective actions.
  • Analyze workflow failures, identify potential points of failure, gather relevant technical information, and provide detailed escalations to Engineering, Media Systems, and other technical teams when required.
  • Support time-sensitive media requirements for live events, sports, digital streaming, broadcast, and production operations.
  • Maintain accurate operational documentation and clearly communicate workflow status, technical discrepancies, risks, and escalations to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve media-management processes, operational efficiency, and workflow reliability.
  • Collaborate with Media Operations, Sports Operations, Production, Editorial, Engineering, Media Systems, and other technical teams to resolve issues and meet critical production deadlines.
  • Adapts to fluctuating schedules, including nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays, in a high-demand, fast-paced environment.
  • Works under the direct supervision of the Sr Manager of Media Operations and is responsible for completing any other tasks as assigned by the manager.

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a production, postproduction, broadcast, or communications environment
  • Fluency in English & Spanish
  • Strong technical knowledge of broadcast media management and post-production workflows, including ingest, transcoding, QC, media movement, storage management, archive, restoration, distribution, and content lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with professional MAM and AVID environments, including AVID Media Composer, Interplay, Media Central Cloud UX, Media Shuttle, or comparable broadcast and post-production platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of professional video formats, codecs, resolutions, frame rates, and media specifications, including HD, UHD/4K, MXF, MOV, MP4, Apple ProRes, XAVC, and proxy media.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based broadcast and post-production environments, including Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud technologies and the integration of cloud and on-premises media workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise in technical and visual media QC, including the ability to identify and assess video, audio, timecode, synchronization, metadata, file-integrity, and specification-related issues.
  • Strong knowledge of media storage, metadata management, naming conventions, folder structures, asset organization, retention, archive, and restoration principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot media workflow failures, identify probable causes, perform initial corrective actions, and determine when technical escalation is required.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an understanding of workflow dependencies and downstream impacts across editorial, production, distribution, and broadcast operations.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications and media delivery requirements and ensure assets meet established technical and operational standards.
  • Ability to independently prioritize and manage multiple high-volume, time-sensitive workflows while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to quickly learn and develop proficiency in new broadcast, post-production, MAM, cloud, and media-management technologies.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Bachelor’s or 2-year degree in Communications or Media preferred
  • Experience in international broadcast operations or media.
  • Familiarity with broadcast and digital streaming media workflows.
  • Exceptional time management, facilitation, and organizational skills
  • Self-starter who exhibits ownership on assigned tasks and who will push for solutions that solve immediate problems while building towards long-term goals
  • Ability to multitask and work in a fast paced, dead-line driven environment
  • Accustomed to working in a team and collaborating with all levels within the organization
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail
  • Ability to build rapport with clients and manage expectations
  • Ability to effectively be flexible in approach, and respond well to pressure

Additional Requirements:

  • This position is required to be performed on onsite from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite. 
  • Must be willing to work in the greater Miami, Florida area
  • Willingness to travel with short notice and on weekends
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must be willing to work flexible hours including late and/or last-minute scheduling changes in a 24/7 production work environment
  • Must be available to work (whenever necessary for show production) early mornings, evenings, overnights, holidays and weekends
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program

This role is part of a 24/7 operational environment responsible for quality control, preparation, and distribution of media assets across NBCUniversal broadcast, cable, streaming, international, and digital platforms. Abilty to perform quality control of content for NBCUniversal distribution using several technical processes & technologies including, but not limited to, Audio/Video QC, subtitle QC, audio language recognition, order prioritization, cross team communication and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically capable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform technical quality control (QC) of digital media assets, including long-form content, short-form content, metadata, captioning, subtitles, and various audio mixes.
  • Verify audio, video, subtitle/caption, and metadata integrity to ensure compliance with NBCUniversal and distribution partner specifications.
  • Support media ingest, transcode, edit, segmentation, and preparation workflows across multiple delivery platforms.
  • Prepare and fulfill media assets for broadcast networks, owned-and-operated stations, Peacock, internation platforms, and other digital outlets.
  • Conduct real-time, spot check, and file-based content QC to identify technical, legal, and creative issues.
  • Maintain accurate metadata and media records within Media Asset Management (MAM) and workflow systems.
  • Troubleshoot issues within media workflows, following established escalation paths and communicating status to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Program Operations, On-Air Marketing, Programming, and external partners.
  • Learn and execute new workflows, tools, and technologies introduced into the Media Operations ecosystem.
  • Support departmental performance goals related to reliability, accuracy, and timeliness of deliveries.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • A High School Diploma and relevant certification or Associate's Degree in Media or Communications, or equivalent professional experience in broadcast, digital, or post production role.
  • A solid understanding of television production, broadcast operations, and/or news/sports/entertainment technical production requirements.

Desired Characteristics:

  • 1+ years of experience in a production, post production, broadcast, or communications environment     
  • 2+ years' of experience in a job or school related activity using computers and software applications including MS outlook, MS Word, & MS Excel.     
  • Knowledge of various media formats/VTRs (Digibeta, HDcam, XDcam), file types (QT, WMV, MXF, DNX, DV, etc) and video standards (NTSC, PAL)     
  • Basic understanding of digital video/audio including compression codecs, file systems, file transfer applications and Content Distribution
  • Experience in international broadcast operations or media especially in a quality control capacity.     
  • A team player, who is always respectful, follows rules and policy, has good communication skills, and maintains a positive attitude.     
  • A punctual, hardworking, disciplined, and dependable individual     
  • Experience in a fast paced, quick turn and/or live broadcast environment.     
  • Fluency or intermediate understanding of other languages     
  • Understanding of international files standards & frame rates     
  • 2-5 years of experience in the multi-channel broadcast facility doing content-prep and quality-control work      
  • Professional experience with SD & HD tape decks and/or file formats and specifications.     
  • Intermediate understanding of audio and video signal flow (waveform monitors, vector scopes, patch bay and routing systems)      
  • Prior experience using Media Asset Management (MAM) and centralized workflow software.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

About the Role

NBC 5 Chicago (WMAQ) and is seeking a dynamic, engaging and enterprising multiplatform storyteller. This person should be a news breaker that our viewers trust and want to watch as they’re getting answers on issues that affect their lives. They will focus on audience impact and providing context for stories of multiple lengths and formats across linear television, streaming, social media, and digital publishing.

Why This Role Matters

Trust is at an all-time low in many parts of everyday life. Our communities need journalists who fight for them, explain why a story matters and tell it through people they can connect with. That means making complicated topics easy to understand, delivering clear takeaways and reporting with empathy. We need someone who feels relatable and authentic—someone viewers trust to have their back and help them better understand the world they’re living through.

What You’ll Do

  • Break news on issues that affect viewers in the Chicago market
  • Research, develop, write, and produce short, medium, and long-term news stories and projects
  • Deliver reports regularly on all platforms in multiple formats
  • Tell stories through the lens of viewer impact on their life, neighborhood, family, happiness, and physical, mental, and financial wellness
  • Craft compelling stories that viewers can connect with and want to watch
  • Produce breaking and developing news stories by contributing to both the overall newsgathering process and by producing reporting for airing/publishing
  • Build a deep bench of sources that allow you and the station to be ahead on a story to ensure our reporting is driving the conversation
  • Host special programming across platforms
  • Nurture relationships with a variety of sources that allow you to contribute to any relevant storyline we’re covering
  • Recruit new viewers to your reporting and our brand across multiple platforms including social media
  • Iterate on new storytelling methods with photojournalists and leadership
  • Be a great teammate that contributes to the mission and vision the newsroom
  • Work in concert with newsroom leadership and the NBC News Group Legal and Standards team to conduct and present legal, accurate, and ethical reports

You Should Have

  • A minimum of 10 years reporting on-camera delivering unique, engaging, and concise reports in multiple formats across platforms
  • A hunger to pitch enterprising stories every day to keep yourself, our news programs, and station relevant and a trusted first-to-check source in the market
  • A thirst to score exclusives, break news, elevate new storylines and win every day
  • A skilled storyteller who knows how to frame a story — no matter how dry — to make a viewer understand its importance and why the report matters
  • A sharp editorial eye focused on accuracy, ethics, fairness, and diverse
    community representation
  • A fail-fast mentality with a willingness to take risks, try new things, and learn from wins and failures for future use
  • A curious, creative spirit and an instinct for what will “stop the scroll” and attract loyal viewers to one or more of our products
  • An owner mentality to ensure that the entire organization always performs at its best

Bonus, If You Have A…

  • Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Spanish
  • Experience anchoring newscasts or hosting multiplatform shows
  • Understanding of story-centricity and related workflows
  • Background shooting and editing on a variety of equipment and tools
  • History of producing written, video and graphical content for digital news outlets
  • Familiarity with linear and digital analytics and platform performance insights

Required Qualifications (The Corporate Stuff)

  • Adhere to NBC News Group standards, policies and ethics
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Must be willining to work in Chicago, IL
  • Must be available to weekends, evenings and holidays as required
  • Must be able to work in the field and be licensed to operate a vehicle
  • Must join SAG-AFTRA union if not currently a member

  • Review staffing needs and identify coverage gaps.
  • Escalate late arrivals, call-outs, and operational issues.

We’re looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, engaging, and user-centered digital experiences across our web and mobile products. This role requires a strong understanding of UX and UI design principles, exceptional communication skills, and expert proficiency in Figma.

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Technical Product Manager to join the AI Content and Media Product team within Operations & Technology. This role sits at the intersection of machine learning systems, large‑scale media workflows, metadata standards, and enterprise integrations, translating complex technical capabilities into scalable, production‑ready products used across NBCUniversal.

This is a hands‑on senior individual contributor role that combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, and execution. The role partners closely with Engineering, Data Science, Program Management, and business stakeholders to ensure your product delivers clear, reliable value aligned to organizational goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Product Development
    • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including Engineering, Data Science, Program Management, Product, and Scrum to scope, develop, and deliver GenAI‑powered product capabilities
    • Develop a deep understanding of stakeholder workflows and business needs to define clear, actionable product requirements and user stories
    • Own one or more defined product areas, driving work from discovery through delivery and iteration
    • Partner with cross‑functional teams to define and maintain an outcome‑based roadmap grounded in customer insights, technical constraints, and business priorities
    • Conduct product testing to validate functionality, accuracy, and performance, and support demos and product reviews
    • Own and maintain product features post‑launch, incorporating feedback to continuously refine and improve capabilities
  • Execution & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Drive execution of product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with near‑ and mid‑term priorities
    • Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors across the end to end GenAI use case lifecycle
    • Prepare and present product updates, documentation, metrics, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership
    • Evaluate tradeoffs between model quality, performance, cost, and latency in partnership with technical teams
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement
    • Stay informed on emerging AI, LLM, and machine learning technologies and relevant vendor offerings
    • Contribute to identifying reusable GenAI patterns and capabilities to support future product development
    • Identify opportunities to enhance product capabilities, improve operational processes, and drive efficiency
    • Provide mentorship and day‑to‑day guidance to junior Product Managers through collaboration, feedback, and shared execution

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in product management, product development, or related technical roles
  • Proven experience working as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager on complex, technology‑driven products
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts and system behavior into clear product requirements for both technical and non‑technical audiences
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI‑ or data‑driven products
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies and modern product development practices

Desired Characteristics:

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams
  • Advanced analytical, problem‑solving, and critical‑thinking skills
  • Self‑starter comfortable operating in an evolving and ambiguous problem space
  • Familiarity with product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Airtable
  • Proficiency with Lucidchart, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint
  • Experience in the Media & Entertainment industry
  • Knowledge of data governance, privacy, legal compliance, cybersecurity, and ethical AI best practices
  • Experience writing, reviewing, or contributing to codebases in modern programming languages

Additional Requirements:

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

NBCUniversal’s Enterprise Product Team builds products that provide essential capabilities to organizations throughout NBCUniversal. The team leverages deep relationships with our business engagement and engineering counterparts to build cohesive, end-to-end solutions for their clients or users. The product portfolio is aligned around critical NBCU functions such as Content/Title Management, Data & Analytics, Scheduling & Distribution, Media Asset Management and Content Sales.

As a part of the Product team, you will be responsible for several products in your department.  You will be in constant communication with clients on anything product related, including development progress, deliverables, and timelines. You will lead grooming sessions, and execute product demos, and walkthroughs.  You are an expert in your area’s product features, capabilities, and functionality.  You will be a consultant on new multi-product initiatives or programs.  You will be a mentor to Product Specialists. 

Essential Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the end-to-end life cycle of products, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization.
  • Define and own overall product vision, strategy, and success metrics for key initiatives, including data warehouse and business intelligence platforms.

Roadmap & Backlog Ownership

  • Develop and maintain feature roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on business needs and strategic goals.
  • Lead grooming sessions to ensure a consistently up-to-date backlog of clearly defined features and user stories.
  • Fully document product features and capabilities in JIRA, including measurable acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Collaborate across functions (Engineering, Ad Sales, Programming, Operations, Product, Architecture) to capture and analyze requests, define data needs, and align priorities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into actionable product features and conceptual models.

Technical Collaboration & Solution Design

  • Partner with architecture and solutions leaders to identify optimal technical solutions that meet client and business needs.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and vendors to implement automation and workflow optimizations.

Data-Driven Product Development

  • Perform hands-on data exploration and analysis of large datasets to inform product decisions and enable data-driven features.
  • Continually leverage business insights and analytics to refine platform strategy and solve high-impact problems.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Define and execute user acceptance testing for new features and integrations.
  • Ensure all workflows and vendor deliverables adhere to NBCUniversal standards and industry regulations.

Incident & Change Management

  • Coordinate resolution of operational issues promptly to minimize disruption.
  • Manage change requests effectively to maintain stability in live environments.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Track and report on vendor performance metrics (uptime, error rates, turnaround times).
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for processes, integrations, and SLAs.
  • Ensure all product and vendor workflows comply with internal standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a role demonstrating strong technical, quantitative, and analytical skills.

  • Expertise in the SDLC process, with a focus on scoping, iteration planning, user story and acceptance criteria writing, rollout management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - capable of assessing ambiguous situations, evaluating diverse factors, and adapting existing approaches to devise effective solutions.

At NBC News Digital, our mission is to transform our customers’ understanding of the world through our best-in-class journalism, insights, and helpful, informative, real-time services. Our digital and television products across NBC News, Today, NBC Local and Telemundo reach millions of users worldwide, and we’ve got even more growth opportunities ahead. We’re looking for the next great Platforms Product Manager to join us in that adventure, and we’re hoping it’s you!

As our Platforms Product Manager, you’ll own the strategy, execution and successful delivery of audience and revenue-driving initiatives, developing features, robust platform experiences and insights across our award-winning, market-leading news products. You’ll thrive making impactful decisions for a brand customers know and trust, based on a deep understanding and ability to draw actionable insights from user data and research, and be acknowledged as the company’s expert in the space.

Your passion will be to discover, develop and ship products and features which deliver both meaningful benefit to our users and strategic business growth success for our company.

Day-to-day, you’ll succeed by learning which solutions are simultaneously impactful, usable, valuable, and feasible, through product discovery, clear prioritization of effort and collaborative design thinking. You’ll lead, coach and motivate a dedicated, cross-functional Agile team by communicating your vision, authoring user stories, optimizing team welfare and experience, actively prioritizing the backlog, and coordinating regularly and clearly with partners, external vendors and stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and share a deep understanding of the customer, data, business, and industry
  • Establish, articulate, and advocate product vision, strategy, and what business-facing success looks like
  • Define and build consensus on meaningful metrics for success
  • Prioritize upcoming sprints, features and enhancements in story backlog
  • Build and maintain roadmap (annual and quarterly KPIs and OKRs) to ensure alignment and focus on resourcing, progress and success
  • Create a clear path for defining value for users and business growth
  • Author use cases and user stories and build shared understanding around user needs and the definition of “done”
  • Identify and implement opportunities to reduce technical, business and user experience debt
  • Discover value-driven opportunities via product discovery experiments and methods
  • Identify and map customer goals, values and needs rather than “wants” or “table stakes”
  • Inform decisions with unbiased qualitative and quantitative data
  • Ensure good communication and transparency by partnering with internal teams including editorial, marketing, advertising, business development and others
  • Coordinate and collaborate with product peers and their teams to share learnings, leverage shared effort and ensure quality cross-platform experience
  • Minimum of 5+ years in digital growth experience, especially around platform performance, streaming experiences and technical product management, combined with domain subject-matter expertise and proven thought leadership
  • Proven ability to deliver successful, valuable customer and business outcomes
  • Strong user experience sensibilities
  • Strong experience with analytics, and using user research to drive decisions
  • Strong experience with Agile methodologies, sprints, prioritization and debt elimination

Desired Characteristics:

  • Human-centered thinking and a strong empathy for solving problems for customers
  • Exceptional written, spoken and visual communication skills
  • Exceptional storytelling skills
  • Exceptional organizational and analytical skills
  • Ability to speak fluently with business people, stakeholders, partners, engineers
  • Experience in the media, news, or technology/internet industries
  • Experience with Product Discovery, Design Thinking, Lean Product a plus

  • Share best practices across sales enablement product success, the COE, AP&O and Salesforce Support teams.  
  • Ensure accuracy of Ad Sales data (i.e., accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities).

The Revenue Accountant is responsible for the end to end accounting for the billing to cash processes for Universal+ sales across Partnerships, as well as Direct to Consumer revenues, in accordance with US GAAP across all entities within the LatAm Hub & Spanish LatAm joint venture (SPL).

Universal+ DTC is currently available in 16 countries across Latin America and the Caribbean and is currently in a growth phase, requiring strong attention to scale, accuracy, evolving operational requirements, and a keen interest in process development.

  • Responsible for accurate and timely recording of all revenue entries under US GAAP involving journal entry preparation and review, Interco management, P&L variance analysis and external contractual reporting to Partners.

  • Support the Manager with accounting for the end-to-end revenue lifecycle for Affiliate Partnerships and DTC Revenue, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with contractual terms, through analysis of complex contracts and transactions to assess accounting and operational implications.
  • Optimize finance-related operational processes and procedures to streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and support the company's growth objectives, including developing robust reporting processes in compliance with Partnership contracts.

  • Assist the Manager with the implementation and scalable processes for DTC and new Partnership launches across Latin America by overseeing all finance-related aspects of the project, including end-to-end process development alongside commercial, product and data insights teams.
  • Assist the Manager with the implementation financial controls, processes, and systems to support the new platform's operations and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Assist the Manager and Director, Revenue Accounting in ad hoc finance projects such as systems implementation to drive strong controllership, simplification and automation improvements.

  • Minimum of 3 years of revenue accounting experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex data analysis and financial modeling
  • Strong attention to detail with proven ability to resolve problems independently
  • Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to think strategically and provide actionable recommendations.

NBCU’s Telemundo Enterprises is seeking a Senior Analyst, Digital Analytics to join the Cross-Platform Analytics team and help drive data-informed decisions across Telemundo’s digital and streaming business. This role will focus on analyzing cross-platform content and audience performance and translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders across Streaming, Programming, Marketing, Editorial, and Strategy & Insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to tell compelling stories with data and will play an important role in developing executive-ready reporting, supporting high-priority ad-hoc analyses, and mentoring junior analysts on the team.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze cross-platform content performance across Telemundo’s digital and streaming ecosystem, including VOD, live, FAST, and other digitally distributed content.
  • Support data analysis and reporting requests by querying dashboards and reporting tools such as Tableau and Domo, and translating findings into actionable insights for stakeholders.
  • Conduct title-level and content-driven analyses to identify trends in audience engagement, consumption, and performance across platforms.
  • Build clean, executive-ready PowerPoint narratives explaining title-level and content-driven trends in Telemundo Streaming growth for recurring reporting, strategic initiatives, and high-visibility ad-hoc requests.
  • Develop and maintain recurring reports, analyses, and performance frameworks that help stakeholders understand what is driving changes in streaming and digital performance.
  • Partner with Streaming, Programming, Marketing, Editorial, and Strategy & Insights teams to answer complex business questions and support data-led decision making.
  • Lead ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to uncover audience and content insights, including audience segmentation, consumption and behavior analysis, and findings that inform content development, programming, and broader business strategy.
  • Identify trends, opportunities, and anomalies in the data and clearly communicate the implications to both analytical and non-technical audiences.
  • Help ensure data quality and accuracy by identifying inconsistencies, validating results, and partnering with technical teams to resolve data and reporting issues.
  • Mentor and guide junior analysts by reviewing analyses, providing feedback, and helping raise the team’s overall analytical rigor and storytelling standards.
  • Contribute to improving analytical processes, reporting methodologies, and scalable approaches to cross-platform analytics.

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant quantitative field such as Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics, preferably within media, digital, streaming, television, or another consumer-facing business.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work quickly and accurately while producing high-quality, error-free results.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, lookups, modeling, and other analytical functionality.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets and/or cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau, Domo, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills with demonstrated experience building clear, concise, executive-ready presentations and data narratives.
  • Fluency in the language of digital media and online measurement, including impressions, CTR, CPM, eCPM, uniques, pageviews, visits, viewability, starts, minutes, completion, and other engagement metrics.
  • Strong understanding of streaming and digital content performance metrics and audience behavior.
  • Experience conducting audience segmentation and analyzing audience consumption and behavioral patterns.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting analytical findings to senior stakeholders and executive audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality analysis in a fast-paced environment.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience analyzing cross-platform content performance within a streaming, subscription, or digital media business.
  • Experience using audience and content analytics to inform content development, programming, or strategic decisions.
  • Familiarity with TV and streaming business models and performance metrics.
  • Experience evaluating the relationship between content, audience behavior, and streaming performance.
  • Experience using data to develop forecasts, benchmarks, projections, or performance estimates.
  • Experience with statistical analysis, modeling, experimentation, or other advanced analytical techniques.
  • Strong data storytelling skills and the ability to turn complex analysis into a simple, compelling narrative.
  • Experience mentoring junior analysts or contributing to the development of analytical best practices.
  • Strong curiosity and interest in understanding the 'why' behind audience and content performance.
  • Spanish language proficiency is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales Creative Group, part of Rock Studios, is an industry-leading, award-winning team that develops groundbreaking creative campaigns and premium marketing experiences for the world’s most influential brands. We partner closely with advertisers to deliver custom, multi-platform solutions that leverage the power of NBCUniversal’s iconic content, talent, intellectual property and audiences across linear, streaming, digital, social and live experiences.

We are seeking a Senior Executive Producer to serve as one of the senior production leaders within Rock Studios. You will oversee a significant slate of advertising and marketing productions, partnering with creative, sales, clients and internal business teams to bring ambitious ideas from concept through final delivery.

As an ideal candidate, you will have deep production expertise with strategic leadership, strong creative instincts and exceptional business judgment. You'll need extensive experience producing integrated campaigns across a wide range of budgets, timelines and production models and be equally comfortable developing a production approach, negotiating a major production bid, finding smart solutions within limited resources, advising senior stakeholders, managing high-profile talent, leading a set, and solving problems when the unexpected happens.

This is both a hands-on Executive Producer and senior leadership role. You will directly oversee marquee projects while mentoring production teams, strengthening external partnerships and helping evolve how Rock Studios approaches production at scale.

This position reports directly to the Vice President, Production & Operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as Executive Producer across a diverse portfolio of advertising, branded content and integrated marketing initiatives—from lean, fast-turn assignments to complex marquee productions—overseeing work from early creative development and scoping through production, post-production and final delivery.
  • Partner closely with creative teams to evaluate concepts for feasibility, identify the strongest production approach and translate ambitious ideas into exceptional, executable work while protecting the creative intent.
  • Lead production across a broad range of formats, including custom branded content, digital and social campaigns, talent-led content, original branded entertainment series.
  • Own the production strategy for assigned campaigns, including production methodology, schedules, budgets, staffing models, vendor strategy, risk assessment and contingency planning.
  • Develop and manage production budgets and estimates across a wide range of scales; oversee competitive bidding, bid leveling, vendor negotiations, cost reporting, change management and final reconciliation while maximizing creative value within available resources.
  • Lead director, production company and key vendor searches; identify and negotiate with the right creative and production partners for each assignment while maintaining a strong external network of directors, producers, crews, studios and post-production partners.
  • Oversee all phases of production and post-production, including pre-production, casting, locations, talent, crew, technical planning, on-set execution, editorial, motion graphics, VFX, music, sound, color, finishing, versioning and final delivery.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Music Services, Talent Relations and other internal teams to ensure productions meet NBCUniversal standards and business requirements.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of production contracts, rights and clearances, music licensing, releases, insurance, labor requirements and applicable union and guild considerations.
  • Serve as a trusted senior production partner to internal stakeholders, clients and agencies, helping teams understand production implications, solve challenges and establish realistic scopes, budgets and timelines.
  • Participate in the development and pitching of major opportunities when production strategy, feasibility, budgeting or executional expertise is required.
  • Build trusted relationships across NBCUniversal and with clients, agencies and external partners, representing Rock Studios with credibility and authority in senior-level conversations.
  • Oversee and mentor producers and freelance production teams, establishing clear expectations and helping develop the next generation of production leaders.
  • Partner with the Vice President, Production & Operations on resource planning, production forecasting, staffing strategy, vendor strategy and allocation of production resources across the broader slate.
  • Help evolve Rock Studios’ production organization by identifying opportunities to improve workflows, methodologies and infrastructure while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, creative ambition and responsible financial stewardship.
  • Proactively assess creative, financial, logistical, legal and reputational risk and develop solutions before those risks affect the work.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in advertising and marketing production, with significant experience leading multi-platform campaigns across a range of scales and budgets—from lean, fast-turn productions to complex, high-budget work.
  • Extensive experience working within an advertising agency, creative agency, production company, brand studio, entertainment marketing organization or comparable creative production environment.
  • Ability to operate simultaneously as a strategic production leader and hands-on Executive Producer, leading multiple concurrent productions while maintaining command of creative, financial and logistical details.
  • Exceptional understanding of physical production and post-production workflows across live action, editorial, VFX, motion design, music, audio and finishing.
  • Strong command of production finance, including estimating, bidding, negotiating, cost management, forecasting and reconciliation, with the ability to maximize production value at varying budget levels.
  • Extensive experience managing directors, production companies, freelance producers, crews and post-production partners.
  • Strong knowledge of production business affairs, talent agreements, music and footage licensing, releases, rights and clearances, union and guild requirements and other production-related legal considerations.
  • Proven experience producing with celebrity or high-profile talent and managing sensitive, high-stakes productions.
  • Strong creative judgment with the ability to contribute meaningfully to creative conversations while understanding the distinction between creative leadership and production leadership.
  • Exceptional business judgment, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance creative ambition, client objectives, production realities and financial responsibility while working with senior executives, clients, creative leaders and external partners.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, make decisions quickly and remain calm, pragmatic and solutions-oriented in high-pressure environments.
  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills with experience developing producers and building high-performing production teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 12+ years of professional production experience, including substantial experience in advertising, branded content, marketing or agency production.
  • Significant experience serving as an Executive Producer or equivalent senior production leader on integrated advertising and marketing campaigns.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex productions on time, on budget and at a consistently high creative standard.
  • Experience managing production budgets of varying scale and complexity and negotiating with production companies, vendors and creative partners.
  • Willingness to travel and work outside traditional business hours when productions require it.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience within a leading advertising agency, creative agency, entertainment company, network, streamer or sophisticated in-house brand studio.
  • Experience with both traditional advertising production and emerging formats across streaming, digital, social, experiential and creator-led content.
  • A deep and current network of directors, production companies, producers, crews and post-production partners.
  • A reputation for being an excellent partner to creative teams -- someone who finds ways to make ambitious ideas happen rather than simply identifying limitations.
  • Strong executive presence paired with a low-ego, collaborative leadership style.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort working in an environment where the work, technology and production models continue to evolve.
  • Passion for outstanding creative work and a track record of building the teams and production environments required to achieve it.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.description:

We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. Role Purpose:

Reporting to the Director, Legal Innovation & Operations, Vendor & Cost Management, the Senior Manager owns the day-to-day operation of the Legal Department's e-billing, invoice, rate, accrual, outside counsel onboarding, and vendor-management processes and turns legal spend data into accurate, decision-ready reporting. The role partners with attorneys, outside counsel, Finance, and Procurement to keep legal spend visible, compliant, and well controlled.

Here you can:

  • Own the business administration and configuration of the Legal Department’s e-billing and matter management platform, including matter, firm, supplier, timekeeper, and rate structures, user access models, workflow design, validation logic, and system rules.
  • Manage the invoice lifecycle from intake through payment, reviewing invoices against Outside Counsel Guidelines, approved rates, matter information, and budgets, and resolving exceptions with law firms, attorneys, Finance, and Accounts Payable.
  • Identify and document potential billing-compliance issues, including rate discrepancies, duplicate charges, prohibited or non-billable charges, and apparent deviations from approved staffing or billing arrangements; resolve routine issues with the firm or provider through completion and escalate material or recurring exceptions to the Director.
  • Lead the implementation and ongoing operation of AI-assisted invoice review and spend analytics, including configuration, evaluation criteria, human review controls, and measurement of results, and inform tool selection with operational testing and data.
  • Run the recurring accrual-collection process with outside counsel and legal service providers, review submissions for completeness and consistency, and reconcile accrual data with Finance.
  • Prepare recurring spend reports, billing-compliance metrics, and validated data inputs supporting law firm and provider scorecards, and quality-check source data before it is incorporated into leadership reporting.
  • Analyze spend by legal group, firm, matter, and other established categories, and surface variances, unusual transactions, data gaps, and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Coordinate supplier and system setup with Finance, Procurement and Accounts Payable,  and maintain accurate firm, provider, engagement, vendor, and matter records and the Legal Department's outside counsel and vendor register.
  • Serve as the primary operational contact for law firms and vendors on billing requirements, invoice status, e-billing procedures, and onboarding requirements, and provide guidance to internal users on legal spend and vendor processes.

Here you'll need:

  •  8+ years of experience in legal spend management, e-billing, or finance and procurement systems, including administering and implementing complex, large-scale spend, billing, and vendor management solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, operations, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new legal, financial, and analytics technologies.
  •  A solid understanding of legal spend processes, including budgeting, forecasting, accrual management, billing compliance, invoice reconciliation and consolidated spend reporting.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to organize, validate, reconcile, and analyze financial and operational data.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational, and communication skills, and the ability to handle confidential legal, financial, and commercial information appropriately.

What we'll look for:

  • Experience with TyMetrix 360 or a comparable legal e-billing and matter-management platform.
  • Familiarity with SAP or a comparable ERP in a functional capacity, and with accounts payable, procurement, and supplier master integration
  • Solid service orientation and the ability to work effectively with attorneys, senior leaders, outside counsel, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

  • Fact-check under pressure, ensure strict adherence to journalistic standards, and handle copyright or legal & standards issues
  • Demonstrated experience leading in or closely alongside a live control room

job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales One Platform Ad Products team builds and operates the systems that power NBCUniversal’s $10B+ advertising business, including core ad serving, programmatic, and activation capabilities across CTV and digital.

Within AP&S, the Programmatic Demand team is responsible for product strategy and development of demand-side capabilities across NBCU’s programmatic ecosystem.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Demand to drive the evolution of how programmatic demand is optimized, scaled, and productized across NBCU’s streaming footprint.

Role Overview

This role focuses on developing scalable products, systems, and workflows that improve programmatic demand performance across NBCU’s ad tech stack.

You will identify inefficiencies in auction dynamics, platform behavior, and partner integrations—and translate those insights into durable product solutions rather than one-off optimizations.

A key focus area will be live event monetization, where concurrency, DSP behavior, and system constraints introduce complex demand-side challenges that require structured, product-led solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Auction Performance & Optimization Systems

  • Design and build scalable solutions (tools, workflows, automation) to analyze and optimize auction performance across bid rate, win rate, fill, pacing, and timeouts
  • Translate performance insights into productized capabilities (e.g., automated optimization frameworks, configuration layers, or decisioning logic)
  • Partner with Engineering to implement systems that continuously improve demand efficiency and revenue outcomes

Live Event Monetization (CTV Focus)

  • Identify performance gaps and system constraints in live event auctions (e.g., scaling limits, DSP throttling, timeout behavior)
  • Drive development of product solutions to increase stability, scalability, and performance in high-concurrency environments
  • Partner cross-functionally and externally to ensure platform and partner readiness for tentpole events

Platform Configuration & Deal Strategy

  • Define product-driven approaches to deal structure, configuration standards, and optimization across PG and PMP
  • Improve how platform settings (e.g., in FreeWheel and partner DSPs) translate into predictable demand performance
  • Productize best practices to reduce inefficiencies and variability in deal execution

Partner Integrations & Performance

  • Identify systemic partner performance issues and drive long-term solutions (vs. one-off fixes)
  • Inform product strategy based on partner capabilities, limitations, and evolving DSP behavior

Additional Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Testing: Own requirements and validation for demand optimization features and experiments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Align Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, and Strategy on priorities and outcomes
  • Issue Resolution: Lead root cause analysis and improve systems/processes to prevent recurring issues
  • Documentation & Enablement: Translate product functionality into clear internal guidance and GTM alignment
  • Market Insights: Monitor industry trends and inform product direction

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystems, including digital ad serving, measurement frameworks, identity signals, and privacy controls—and how these components work together to enable scalable, addressable advertising across CTV and digital environments
  • Experience implementing and validating measurement and data pipelines, with a focus on ensuring consistency and accuracy across platforms (e.g., bid requests, attribution, viewability, IVT, and delivery metrics)
  • Solid working knowledge of privacy regulations and industry signals (e.g., CCPA, GDPR, GPP, ATT, COPPA), and their implications for data usage, identity resolution, targeting, and measurement in a programmatic context
  • Experience understanding identity and user signals (e.g., device IDs, platform identifiers, consent signals) to enable privacy-compliant audience targeting and optimization
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into scalable, productized solutions - particularly within programmatic demand, auction dynamics, or partner integrations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience diagnosing performance gaps, data discrepancies, and system inefficiencies, and driving root-cause resolution in production environments
  • Experience developing or leveraging automation and/or AI-driven approaches to monitor, validate, and improve the stability, quality, and performance of demand systems and measurement capabilities
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively across Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, Strategy, and external partners to drive aligned outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in high-scalability, high-concurrency environments (e.g., CTV and live events), with a product mindset focused on building durable, system-level solutions rather than one-off fixes
  • Minimum of 3+ years of product management experience, preferably within digital advertising, ad tech, or data-driven platforms; experience in CTV, streaming, or programmatic demand strongly preferred

Additional Requirements:

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

The Sous Chef – Margaritaville, will be responsible for directing, managing and successfully operating a high volume branded concept on CityWalk. As Sous Chef, the position will be a primary “go-to” for the kitchen team and responsible for the functions and flow of the back of the house.

The Sous Chef is responsible for ensuring that the food served always meets or exceeds standards of excellence. While this position will report to the Restaurant Chef, this position is responsible for setting the expectations for all kitchen team members to maximize productivity. This individual must be able to work effectively with limited supervision and demonstrate leadership to motivate others.

Essential Functions:

  • Drive operating profit goals and sales.
  • Optimize profits by controlling food, beverage, and labor costs.
  • Consistently achieve operational excellence.
  • Develop and retain exceptional talent.
  • Ensure compliance with all local, state, and federal laws regarding food quality, safety, labor, and employment.
  • Partner with Human Resources to train and develop restaurant leaders at every level.
  • Maintain or exceed weekly budgeted variable operation profit by controlling cost of goods & variable labor.
  • Communicate restaurant results to the Restaurant Chef and General Manager with recommendations for improvement.
  • Ensure high Team Member and Guest Engagement.
  • Mentors and counsels team members and enforce appropriate policies and procedures ensuring that everything is within compliance of venue and company standards.
  • Promote company's mission and values.
  • Ensure company policy and brand standards are followed.
  • Optimize profits by controlling food, beverage, and labor costs.
  • Prepare and present hourly team member reviews.
  • Complete all tasks assigned by the Executive Sous Chef on time.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Order supplies, food and ingredients based on rapidly shifting demand.
  • Hire and train kitchen staff in specific stations, and cross-train as necessary.  
  • Create schedules for kitchen staff to ensure there are always enough workers to meet the demand.
  • Maintain inventory levels and conduct full inventories.
  • Schedule and oversee necessary maintenance and repairs on kitchen appliances.  
  • Assist the management team with menu changes and adjustments. 
  • Respond personally to guest questions, special recipe requests and complaints.
  • Maintain a clean workspace and all times.
  • Work at a fast and efficient pace. The Sous Chef is a “working chef.”
  • Ability to read and follow recipes as well as follow up with prep and line cooks food preparation.
  • Has a thorough knowledge of food cost, labor cost and inventory functions.
  • Chemical safety comprehension.
  • Analyze financial reports to quickly identify and address trends and issues in area performance, including cost of goods, variable labor, and profitability.
  • Exceed annual operating profit targets.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality Management or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of management experience in high quality chain or independent restaurant group.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and POS systems.
  • Ability to work rotating schedules, holidays, weekends and nights.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Proven track record and experience in the development and implementation of strong training programs and tools developed to reduce employee attrition and create internal culture of development for staff.
  • Excellent management skills in leading a diverse team and working under tight and fast track deadlines.
  • Strong P&L experience, command of budgeting and costs controls.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, organizational and multi-tasking skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate across all lines of business, and with all levels of management.
  • Strong organizational, planning, delegation, mentoring and coaching skills.
  • A strong passion for delivering the highest quality of guest service and superior food concepts.

Additional Requirements:

  • (Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks.   • Strong skills in data processing using SQL

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum and Kanban).  
  • A flair for communicating clearly via design document, text, voice and code to a wide variety of nationalities.

The Senior Producer will play a key role in the control room, building and managing rundowns, responding to breaking news, coordinating correspondents and live elements, and making real-time editorial decisions.   • Lead the editorial and production execution of programming across linear television, streaming/FAST, digital, and social platforms

  • Make quick editorial decisions during live coverage while maintaining accuracy, balance, standards, and production quality
  • Produce live and taped interviews and segments from initial concept and research through final execution
  • Identify, pitch, and develop strong news, political, and community stories that can work across multiple platforms
  • Book high-profile guests, newsmakers, experts, political figures, analysts, and community leaders
  • Research topics and prepare strong, editorially sound interview questions and briefing materials
  • Write and edit scripts, teases, banners, headlines, and other editorial copy
  • Adapt content and storytelling for the specific needs of broadcast, streaming, digital, and social audiences
  • Collaborate closely with executive producers, assignment editors, correspondents, reporters, digital teams, and newsroom leadership
  • Help plan and execute major breaking-news events, elections, debates, town halls, special events, and other large-scale coverage
  • Maintain strong relationships with sources, press offices, publicists, experts, and community leaders
  • Provide editorial guidance and mentorship to producers, associate producers, and bookers
  • Work effectively under intense deadline pressure and adjust programming quickly as news develops
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Minimum 5–7 years of television or multi-platform newsroom experience, with significant experience producing and line producing live programming
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a live show from the control room and manage rapidly changing rundowns
  • Strong knowledge of live television production, breaking-news workflows, and control-room operations
  • Experience producing content for multiple platforms, including broadcast, streaming/FAST, digital, and social
  • Strong editorial judgment, news instincts, writing, research, and storytelling skills
  • Proven experience booking and producing interviews with high-profile guests and newsmakers
  • Ability to coordinate multiple live elements, correspondents, guests, graphics, video, and technical resources simultaneously
  • Experience with newsroom systems such as iNews, Avid, ENPS, or similar platforms
  • Strong understanding of current events, including U.S. politics and major national and international news
  • Bilingual: fluent in Spanish and English, written and verbal
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and leadership skills
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays, particularly during breaking news and major events
  • Ability to travel for major news events and special coverage when required

job.title: Transmission Operator - NBC Sports
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBC Sports is looking for an experienced Transmission Operator to support live broadcast operations from our Stamford facility. In this role, you'll coordinate with internal teams, transmission providers, and technology partners to ensure reliable, high-quality content delivery for some of the biggest events in sports, including the Olympics, NFL, NBA, golf, and soccer.

The ideal candidate has experience with broadcast transmission technologies such as fiber, satellite, bonded cellular, IP-based transport, video, and audio systems, along with strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to perform in a fast-paced live production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinates transmission activities and check-ins for high-profile sporting events using the company-wide scheduling system.
  • Works closely with Operations and Production teams to support transmission and routing needs and ensure high-quality broadcast delivery.
  • Monitors and troubleshoots on-air video, audio, satellite, communications, and multiplexed signals across multiple broadcast streams.
  • Partners with transmission carriers to resolve issues, manage escalations, coordinate maintenance, and maintain reliable service.
  • Establishes standard operation procedures for transmission activities, including remote check-ins, quality control processes, ingest, and outgoing feeds.
  • Provides transmission support and feed coordination for internal partners across the organization.
  • Collaborates with Engineering to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Assists with equipment setup, testing, and configuration as needed.

Basic Requirements

  • 2+ years of broadcast, transmission, media operations, or related live production experience.
  • Knowledge of broadcast transmission and media transport systems, including fiber, satellite, and IP-based workflows.
  • Ability to troubleshoot video, audio, and communications signals.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple live events simultaneously.
  • Ability to assist with critical decision-making in time-sensitive, live broadcast environments
  • Experience working in a 24/7 operational environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supporting live sports or large-scale live event broadcasts.
  • Experience supporting REMI / remote production models.
  • Ability to interpret signal flow documentation (CAD drawings) and perform systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting matrix communications systems and large-scale routing infrastructures.
  • Familiarity with SMPTE 2110 environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based media transport and IP video workflows.
  • Experience working with H.264, HEVC, JPEG2000, ASI, and 4K workflows.

Additional Requirements

  • Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must be willing to work in Stamford, CT
  • Must be able to work holidays, nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) and overtime as necessary
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • It is the policy of NBCUniversal and NBCUniversal’ s affiliated businesses to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy) sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Required On-Site: This position is designated as full-time on-site and must be performed from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $35.00 - $39.00 per hour.

job.title: Vice President, Content Delivery Networks
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. With unequalled scale, our teams make the most out of every opportunity to collaborate and learn from one another. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

The Vice President, Content Delivery Networks will be part of the Global Video Engineering organization and will be responsible for overall strategy, design, and execution of content delivery for our OTT products. The Vice President will oversee a team of CDN, Data and Software engineers who are subject matter experts in next generation distribution, who will ensure the fidelity, quality, and availability of our delivery network for the benefit of our global audiences.

Job Responsibilities

Technical Expertise

  • Devise and execute Content Delivery Strategy to deliver current and planned media products & events at necessary performance & scale.
  • Attract and retain a multi-national team of subject matter experts to deliver strategy.
  • Develop relationships and engage with partner ISPs & telco industry to ensure performant access.
  • Collaborate with procurement teams to manage key vendor commercial relationships.
  • Ensure technology decisions supporting strategy are made from the latest market research of vendors and competition.
  • Engage with Legal and Finance teams to negotiate vendor contracts and manage budgets.
  • Conduct Short/long term technology evaluations (e.g. multicast, p2p, hybrid/ISP CDNs, deeper distribution, self-build CDN)
  • Involvement in E2E technology planning, product governance and regulatory/legal matters.
  • Own the end-to-end CDN roadmap, including capacity planning, performance optimization, resiliency, cost efficiency, and future-state architecture across global streaming products.
  • Set and govern CDN reliability, quality, and performance standards, ensuring measurable KPIs and SLAs for availability, latency, startup time, rebuffering, and overall viewer experience.
  • Lead incident readiness and operational excellence for high-profile live events and peak traffic moments, including escalation protocols, risk mitigation, and post-event learnings.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, Distribution, and Platform Engineering to ensure CDN strategy supports business priorities, product launches, global expansion, and audience growth.
  • Drive vendor strategy and optimization, including multi-CDN strategy, contract performance, vendor scorecards, cost modeling, and negotiation support.
  • Champion innovation in next-generation content delivery, including automation, observability, traffic steering, edge compute, ISP partnerships, and emerging delivery models.
  • Establish data-driven decision-making practices by using real-time monitoring, analytics, and performance insights to improve delivery quality and business outcomes.
  • Ensure security, compliance, and risk controls are embedded into CDN architecture and third-party partnerships, especially for global content distribution.
  • Develop succession plans and an organizational structure for the CDN function to ensure scalability, continuity, and long-term leadership depth.
  • Represent the CDN function with senior executives, translating technical performance, risk, investment needs, and roadmap tradeoffs into clear business recommendations.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Strategic leader with the ability to set a clear vision, translate business priorities into actionable technology roadmaps, and drive execution across complex, global teams.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and executive stakeholders, and align teams around shared outcomes. 
  • Strong people leadership skills, including attracting, developing, and retaining high-performing technical talent while fostering accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical topics, make data-informed recommendations, and influence senior leaders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-scale environment, balancing innovation, operational excellence, risk management, and business impact.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of ten (10) years’ experience managing large-scale digital software systems, preferably in the Content Delivery Network space
  • Minimum of five (5) years’ experience leading a CDN function
  • Expertise in software security best practices and tooling
  • Expertise in digital video codecs and encoding profiles
  • Experience in digital media or direct-to-consumer video business highly preferred
  • Expertise in high-availability software patterns and performance testing
  • Knowledge of Cloud & Container Security

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience in deploying tools such as Web Application Firewalls, Container Security, Static & Dynamic Code Analysis
  • In depth knowledge of all OTT platforms, including optimization of delivery methodology of each with a passion for staying on the cutting edge of digital video delivery
  • Passionate about leading a team of engineers and committed to building world-class software systems
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical colleagues and executives
  • Ability to understand large complex software systems and their interdependencies

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies.
