job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About Us:

FOX 5 and KUSI are leading television stations in the San Diego market, providing news, entertainment, and impactful advertising solutions to businesses throughout the region. We offer a dynamic and collaborative work environment where talented individuals can thrive and grow. We are committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients and providing our viewers with the highest quality programming.

 

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated, growth-minded Account Executive who takes ownership of their business and is driven to win. This role is responsible for generating new business, developing and managing client relationships, and growing revenue by strategically selling and upselling our full suite of television and digital advertising solutions.

The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who does not wait for opportunities to come to them. They consistently prospect, build a healthy sales pipeline, identify opportunities within existing accounts, and develop customized solutions that address clients' business and marketing objectives. Success in this role requires a strong sense of accountability, persistence, competitive drive, and the ability to consistently achieve or exceed established revenue and activity goals.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Generate new and incremental revenue, with a strong focus on new business and digital revenue growth, and achieve monthly sales goals through proactive prospecting, business development, and outside sales. Identify prospective advertisers, build relationships with key decision makers, and maintain a qualified pipeline by consistently developing and closing new business through cold calling, networking, referrals, targeted outreach, and other lead-generation strategies.
  • Manage client accounts, ensuring client satisfaction and maximizing revenue potential through strategic account growth, upselling, and cross-selling of broadcast, digital, streaming, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Conduct needs assessments to understand clients' business objectives, challenges, target audiences, and marketing goals, and develop customized broadcast and digital advertising solutions that address those objectives.
  • Present compelling proposals and negotiate advertising contracts with a focus on converting opportunities into new and incremental revenue.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including sales management, creative services, and others, to ensure seamless campaign execution.
  • Monitor campaign performance and provide clients with regular updates and reports, using performance insights to identify optimization, renewal, and additional revenue opportunities.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, digital advertising capabilities, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to effectively position the station's comprehensive marketing solutions.
  • Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets, including established expectations for new business and digital revenue growth.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of prospecting activity, sales opportunities, pipeline development, client interactions, and account activity in the CRM system.
  • Attend client meetings and industry events to develop relationships, generate leads, uncover new business opportunities, and expand the station's advertiser base.
  • Demonstrate a consistent sense of urgency, self-motivation, and accountability in prospecting and business development, with success measured by the ability to generate new business, grow digital revenue, expand existing accounts, and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and building strong client relationships.
  • Strong understanding of the media landscape and digital marketing strategies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software.  
  • Experience with Nielsen or other media measurement tools a plus.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Compensation - $70K Guarantee or Draw plus commission.
  • #LI-Onsite

 

Benefits:

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including:

  • Competitive compensation structure
  • Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
  • Paid time off (vacation, sick leave)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Opportunities for professional development and growth

SCAM ALERT:

Please be aware candidates may be at risk of being targeted by scammers seeking personal data or money. Recruiters with Nexstar Media Group and its local stations will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with Nexstar.tv domain or official station email addresses (example:@wreg.com).  Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nexstar or its recruiters via any other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. We will not contact you using a @gmail email address. If you are unsure about the authenticity of a job inquiry or offer, email us at corporaterecruiters@nexstar.tv.

job.title: Congressional Reporter
job.description:
Congressional reporter

The Hill, a division of Nexstar Media Group, is hiring a Congressional Reporter to cover the House. The position will have a focus on healthcare, and the reporter must have the ability to extend coverage to the Senate. It also requires a familiarity and comfort with writing about a broad range of policies.


About the role: 

The person filling this role will be responsible for a mix of spot news stories, regular briefs and features. A successful candidate will have the ability to build sources that can help provide daily scoops to be used across The Hill’s platforms, including our newsletters. We want to write stories that make people stop and think, and that grab their attention. Candidates who gravitate toward news stories that are unique, and who can write in a compelling and informative way, will have the best chance of success in this role.

The ability to work collaboratively with others on the Congress, White House and campaign teams and on various policy beats is key.

Responsibilities include: 

-Working with the rest of our House team to provide full coverage of the House of Representatives, from committee hearings and press conferences to floor votes.

-Recognizing news immediately when it happens, while also recognizing trend stories that affect the political scene.

-Writing a mix of short and longer news briefs and features for The Hill’s website and newspaper.

-Writing stories on healthcare, which will be a major part of the next congressional session. These stories can include legislative efforts to change and improve the healthcare system and enterprise stories about steps the administration is taking.

- An ability to go on television or take the stage at Hill events to discuss complex policies and political fights in a digestible manner.


Skills and qualifications: 

A degree in journalism or a related field is required, and previous reporting experience in a metro or national media environment is preferred. 

Candidates should have good instincts for understanding what readers want and be able to produce error-free, clean journalism on a tight timetable. Basic familiarity with Google Trends, SEO skills and real-time analytics are a plus. 


Flexibility to adjust schedule and assignments as business needs evolve

To apply: Please upload your materials with as much of the following as possible: your updated resume, a brief cover letter explaining your interest and fit for the position, and your portfolio/clips or links to a few samples of your work. Completing these steps will ensure that you receive the highest consideration.

Any person in this position will be represented by the Washington-Baltimore News Guild, Communications Workers of America Local 32035, AFL-CIO. 


About The Hill

Established in 1994, The Hill is the country’s definitive digital source for non-partisan political news and information. Inside the Beltway, it’s known as an essential, agenda-setting read for lawmakers and influencers. Beyond the Capitol, The Hill’s trusted content is shared more often on social media than any other political news brand in America.

job.title: Digital Producer

job.title: Digital Producer
job.description:

job.title: KFTA-FOX Main Evening Anchor
job.description:
KFTA-TV, the FOX affiliate in Northwest Arkansas, is looking for a Main Evening Anchor!

We need a hands-on anchor who is ready to lead by example. You must be a team player, an excellent coach, and possess a passion for community.

Our anchors are working journalists.  The successful candidate will take an active role in daily newsgathering for all mediums. This anchor must maintain an on-air persona that is friendly and authoritative, exhibit urgency every day, particularly during breaking news, and have a high-level of engagement on all social media platforms.

Leadership is a must! As Main Anchor, you’ll be expected to lead by example and work with newsroom managers to coach and motivate other staff. You will volunteer in the community.

Applicants should have at least three years of on-air anchoring experience and a year or two of reporting experience.

Overall, we’re looking for an experienced, hard-working journalist with a positive attitude and a team-oriented, leadership nature who can drive higher levels of social engagement, web traffic, and television viewing from our audience.

If interested, apply online or email resume and reel to News Director Josh Harvison at jharvison@knwa.com.

Northwest Arkansas is a rapidly growing and vibrant community filled with rolling hills, rivers, lakes and Fortune 500 company headquarters. Many high-end business industries call NWA home, and they bring in some of the best talent in their fields. Cost of living is low, and quality of life is high. Add in our world-class museums, performing arts centers, major sporting venues, amazing concerts, fantastic foodie destinations and tons of community-centric events, and Northwest Arkansas can’t be beat! 

  

In fact, U.S. News ranks Fayetteville seventh best place to live in the country!  http://realestate.usnews.com/places/arkansas/fayetteville 

   

Our newsroom is forward-thinking and built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth and development of talent, and a desire to win. We are consistently winning awards from our local audiences for our commitment to our community and our service-centered sense of duty. 

Whether you’re looking for a place to settle in or a place to equip yourself and launch into that “big step” – we have a proven track record of providing both outcomes.  

*Must include a link to online reel when applying. 

Job Duties 

  • Present news stories and other content for all platforms. 
  • Ensure all news content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality. 
  • Work with management to enterprise and develop stories daily. 
  • Evaluate news leads and tips to develop story ideas. 
  • Build a network of sources who supply information that allow the station to stay ahead of its competitors. 
  • Write and deliver news stories in a clear and concise manner. 
  • Demonstrate compelling storytelling using dynamic live shots and stand-ups, creative graphics, and use of digital and social media platforms 
  • Communicate clearly and respectfully with management and team members. 
  • Assist in writing, copy editing, researching and coordinating news programming and other content. 
  • Coach and mentor young talent. 
  • Act as a field reporter as assigned. 
  • Conduct interviews with news personnel and others. 
  • Respond to breaking news and other urgent newsroom situations as required. 
  • Participate in promotional activities including public appearances and community volunteer opportunities. 
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.  
  • Edit video clips as assigned. 
  • Write content for the website and other digital platforms. 
  • Assist in the producing of newscasts as needed.
  • Interact with viewers/users on social media sites. 
  • Promote teamwork and maintain attitude of cooperation with all station personnel.

Requirements & Skills: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience. 
  • Fluency in English. 
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required. 
  • Minimum three years of experience in news anchoring and two years of on-camera news reporting. 
  • Superior on-air presence. 
  • Excellent news judgment with an expansive knowledge of local and national current events, history, newsmakers and issues. 
  • Experience guiding, directing and motivating others. 
  • Ability to identify the developmental needs of others and to coach, mentor or otherwise help others to improve their knowledge or skills. 
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment. 
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. 
  • Ability to effectively listen to fully understand problems and communicate with a team to shape a solution. 
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record. 
  • Flexibility to work any shift.

Ready to help shape the future of media? At WAVY-TV, WVBT FOX43, and CW Hampton Roads, we do more than sell TV—we help local businesses grow with creative marketing solutions across broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms. We're looking for a driven, motivated Account Executive who enjoys building relationships, thinking strategically, and helping clients connect with their audiences through the power of multi-platform media.

About the Role:

As an Account Executive at WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads, you'll serve as a consultative partner to local and regional businesses—developing custom advertising strategies across our robust multimedia portfolio. You’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values creativity, integrity, and performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospect and secure new business through networking, referrals, and outreach.
  • Manage and grow a book of active clients, cultivating long-term partnerships.
  • Develop integrated marketing campaigns that include linear TV, streaming (OTT/CTV), digital display, social, and branded content.
  • Work cross-functionally with production, creative, promotions, and digital teams to bring campaigns to life.
  • Deliver clear, data-backed proposals and recommendations to clients.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual revenue goals and quarterly targets.
  • Stay current on media trends, competitive insights, and emerging platforms.

What We’re Looking For:

  • A creative, proactive problem solver who thrives on helping clients succeed.
  • A persuasive storyteller who can connect business challenges to tailored media solutions.
  • A self-starter with strong time management and follow-through skills.
  • A confident communicator—written, verbal, and in client-facing presentations.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Communications or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 2-5 years of proven success in media, marketing, or B2B sales.
  • Knowledge of digital advertising platforms (e.g., OTT, SEO/SEM, etc.).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; CRM experience is a plus.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

Why WAVY-TV, WVBT and CW Hampton Roads?

  • We're part of Nexstar Media Group, the nation’s largest local media company.
  • Our reach includes NFL, college football, Hampton Roads Show, and trusted news coverage.
  • Access to advanced tools, strong leadership, and hands-on sales training.
  • Full benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k) & monthly phone allowance provided.

To be considered for this job you must apply online at https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar.

Commission based

job.title: NewsNation - Broadcast Engineer in Charge - Part-time
job.description:
The Broadcast Engineer in Charge will be responsible for providing front-line broadcast engineering and technical support across multiple studios and control rooms within our production environment. The role involves supporting all broadcast systems and technology for live day-of-air programs, troubleshooting hardware and systems, managing projects that include system design, integration, and commissioning. This position requires a combination of maintenance and project management/system engineering skills. The support spans seven days a week, with certain periods requiring availability as part of a 24x7 schedule.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform system-level troubleshooting of technical facilities, including control rooms, studio equipment, audio equipment, and associated computer systems.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance on studio and control room equipment.
  • Assist Studio Operations with technical setup in control rooms and studios.
  • Collaborate with production and operations teams to implement technical solutions that meet production initiatives.
  • Install and update equipment and systems software.
  • Repair and troubleshoot equipment to the module level using industry-standard test equipment.
  • Manage projects, design systems, and assist with system integration and commissioning.

Qualifications


Basic Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in a television broadcast environment or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • BS degree in Engineering, Communications, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Final candidates may be asked to complete a job-related skills assessment related to this position.

Desired Characteristics:

  • Proficiency with broadcast production systems and software, including audio consoles, intercom systems, video switchers, wireless audio, server-based playout, and test and measurement equipment.
  • Understanding of TCP/IP networks.
  • Knowledge of digital TV (HDSDI).
  • Proficiency in software-driven broadcast video equipment.
  • Ability to read and understand system signal flow diagrams for television control room and studio facilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to remain calm and focused under the pressures of live television.
  • Strong hands-on problem-solving skills with broadcast-related equipment and systems.
  • Understanding of the urgent needs of on-air sports and the ability to remain productive in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.
  • Ability to support a 24x7 production environment.
  • Willingness and ability to learn new production technologies.
  • Preferred experience in live production environments.
  • Knowledge of computer server installation and maintenance.
  • Specific experience with:
  • Sony cameras 
  • RTS Intercom
  • Calrec audio consoles
  • Tektronix and Leader test and measurement systems.
  • Knowledge of SMPTE 2110 standards.
  • Experience in system design, AutoCAD, and project management.
  • Understanding of wireless audio and communication technologies.
  • Comms Systems (RTS ADAM/Omneo) knowledge
  • Experience with Comms Systems (RTS ADAM/Omneo)
  • Strong customer focus with a commitment to delivering high-quality technical support.
  • Self-starter with the ability to meet deadlines and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to diplomatically engage with colleagues across various departments.

job.title: NewsNation - Feed Room Operator - Part-time
job.description:
Location: New York, NY (On-Site)
Department: Engineering Operations
Compensation: $50.00 - $60.00/hour

About NewsNation

NewsNation is a National Television News Network owned by Nexstar Media Group, delivering trusted news coverage across Cable, Streaming, and Digital platforms. Our teams in New York, Chicago, and Washington, DC work together to produce high-quality journalism supported by innovative technology and operational excellence.

Position Summary

The Feed Room Operator supports NewsNation's live newsgathering and Broadcast Operations by Receiving, Monitoring, Recording, Routing, and Transmitting incoming and outgoing signals for network programming. Working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, this role serves as the first layer of technical quality control, ensuring the reliability and integrity of live and recorded content used across NewsNation broadcasts.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong communication, troubleshooting with decision-making skills who can work effectively in a team environment while maintaining accuracy under pressure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, Monitor, Record, and Transmit live and recorded broadcast signals.
  • Coordinate incoming and outgoing feeds utilizing TVU, LiveU, Dejero, Satellite, IP-based and Streaming transmission technologies.
  • Route essential sources into Frame Syncs for live broadcasts
  • Schedule and manage recordings for New York-based broadcasts and production operations.
  • Perform quality control checks on incoming and outgoing video and audio signals to ensure broadcast standards are met.
  • Troubleshoot transmission, routing, and signal issues and escalate concerns as appropriate.
  • Communicate effectively with Production, Control Room, Assignment Desk, Engineering, and Field Operations teams.
  • Maintain accurate logs and records of feed activity, recordings, and transmission schedules.
  • Support Breaking News, Special Events, and Live coverage requirements.
  • Identify workflow efficiencies and contribute to continuous operational improvements.
  • Adhere to all technical, operational, and safety procedures while meeting strict deadlines.

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of television newsgathering, broadcast operations, feed room, master control or related experience.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to work calmly under pressure.
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced, deadline-driven live news environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and common business software applications.
  • Self-motivated with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to technical quality control.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by network leadership 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with TVU, LiveU, Dejero, Bitcentral, and ENPS systems.
  • Familiarity with Satellite, IP, bonded cellular and Streaming transmission workflows.
  • Experience supporting live Network News or Major-Market television operations.
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality control procedures and network technical standards.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Broadcast Production, Journalism or a related or equivalent field professional experience.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Must be able to report On-Site to NewsNation's New York Newsroom and Production facility.
  • Schedule may include Mornings, Evenings, Overnights, Weekends, Holidays, and extended hours.
  • Availability for Breaking News, Special Events, and emergency coverage is required.
  • Attendance, Punctuality, and Schedule flexibility are essential.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure while supporting live television operations.

Union Representation

This position is represented by IBEW Local 1212 and is covered by the applicable collective bargaining agreement.


Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more.   Part-time employees are eligible for 401(k) and any local/state leave plans.  Union positions are subject to the benefits outlined in their Collective Bargaining Agreement.

Candidate should be a problem solver and quick thinker to resolve existing issues and to work around problems that arise during live news and productions. Early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays will be a part of the schedule. Please be prepared to furnish current references and shows (if available).

job.title: Production Technician
job.description:
WNCT TV in Greenville, NC is looking for a Production Technician to join our team! The Production Technician has four primary tasks:  Newscast Directing, Newscast Audio Operator, Media Center Operator and Master Control Operator.

  • Operates studio cameras and field cameras for live and taped events
  • Composes and frames shots, applying the technical aspects of light, lenses and camera settings to achieve the effects sought by directors, station management, other personnel
  • Adjusts positions and controls of cameras to change focus, exposure and lighting as requested by the directors, station management, other personnel
  • Operates audio equipment for live and taped events
  • Operates computer editing systems, electronic titling systems, video switching equipment, and digital video effects units to produce a final product
  • Collaborate with the director and studio staff to coordinate the action in the studio
  • Builds and decorates the set and/or provides props used for production
  • Assist in the installation, operation and maintenance of sound recording equipment
  • Operate studio graphic systems during broadcast/production
  • Provide audio production-related support as needed and may work with outside production facilities
  • Assist in digital media productions, liaising with appropriate departments
  • May convert analog recordings, film, or printed materials to digital format
  • Maintains and stores equipment, records and tapes

Requirements & Skills:

  • Degree in Communication or related field, or equivalent training and/or experience
  • Experience in television, film, or post production preferred but not required
  • Must be able to interact well with video journalists, anchors, videographers, news managers, production and engineering staff
  • Detail oriented
  • Excellent communication and organization skills

job.title: Reporter
job.description:
WDAF-TV FOX4 in Kansas City is seeking a dynamic and enterprising News Reporter to join our team. This role is ideal for a journalist who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative newsroom and is passionate about telling compelling stories across broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms.


The successful candidate will be a strong storyteller with excellent live reporting skills, a deep understanding of local issues, and the ability to connect with viewers in a clear, engaging, and meaningful way.


  • Enterprise original, impactful stories that resonate with the local community across all platforms – broadcast, digital, streaming, and social media.
  • Deliver live reports with confidence and clarity, especially during breaking news and developing stories.
  • Write, present, and produce content in a clear, concise, and engaging manner tailored to each platform
  • Build and maintain a network of sources to stay ahead of the news curve.
  • Conduct interviews with newsmakers and community members to enhance storytelling.
  • Collaborate with producers, photographers, and newsroom staff to shape coverage and segment ideas.
  • Ensure all content meets FOX4’s standards for journalistic integrity and production quality.
  • Contribute video and visual content for broadcast, digital, streaming, and social platforms, including shooting and editing content as needed. 
  • Contribute to the station’s digital presence.
  • Take part in special projects and other duties as assigned.


Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum two years of experience in news reporting.
  • Strong on-air presence and ability to ad-lib effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal.
  • Solid news judgment and a broad understanding of current events, local issues, and storytelling techniques.
  • Open to feedback and coaching, with a track record of applying guidance to improve performance.
  • Ability to work well in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Proficiency with newsroom technology, video editing software, digital publishing tools, and multimedia storytelling techniques. 
  • Ability to meet deadlines, manage multiple assignments, and adapt to breaking news.
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record.
  • Flexibility to work any shift, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

job.title: Reporter I, MultiMedia Journalist
job.description:
KNWA-TV and KFTA-TV, the NBC and FOX affiliates in Northwest Arkansas, are looking for a Multi-Media Journalist Reporter to serve our community!

 

We need a trustworthy and motivated reporter who is ready to immerse themselves in the NWA and River Valley communities and dig deep to find the stories that will make in impact.

 

As an MMJ Reporter, you’ll be expected to develop relationships throughout the community, stay on top of current events, develop and enterprise impactful stories, shoot and edit video, write compelling scripts, perform engaging live shots, and contribute content across all platforms.

 

MMJ Reporters must maintain an on-air persona that is friendly, energetic and authoritative, exhibit urgency every day, particularly during breaking news, and have a high-level of engagement on all social media platforms.

   

Overall, we’re looking for a motivated, hard-working journalist with a positive attitude and a team-oriented, leadership nature who can connect with viewers and tell impactful stories across Northwest Arkansas. 

 

Northwest Arkansas is a rapidly growing and vibrant community filled with rolling hills, rivers, lakes and Fortune 500 company headquarters. Many high-end business industries call NWA home, and they bring in some of the best talent in their fields. Cost of living is low, and quality of life is high. Add in our world-class museums, performing arts centers, major sporting venues, amazing concerts, fantastic foodie destinations and tons of community-centric events, and Northwest Arkansas can’t be beat!

  

Our newsroom is forward-thinking and built on a strong emphasis of positive reinforcement, feedback, growth and development of talent, and a desire to win. We are consistently winning awards from our local audiences for our commitment to our community and our service-centered sense of duty.

 

Whether you’re looking for a place to settle in or a place to equip yourself and launch into that “big step” – we have a proven track record of providing both outcomes. 

 

*Must include a link to online reel when applying in order to be considered.

  • Present news stories and other content for all platforms.
  • Ensure all news content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality.
  • Work with management to enterprise and develop stories daily.
  • Evaluate news leads and tips to develop story ideas.
  • Build a network of sources who supply information that allows the Station to stay ahead of its competitors.
  • Write and deliver news stories in a clear and concise manner.
  • Demonstrate compelling storytelling using dynamic live shots and stand-ups, creative graphics, and use of digital and social media platforms
  • Communicate clearly and respectfully with management and team members.
  • Assist in writing, copy editing, researching and coordinating news programming and other content.
  • Act as a field photojournalist and reporter as assigned.
  • Conduct interviews with community leaders, residents and others.
  • Respond to breaking news and other urgent newsrooms situations as required.
  • Participate in promotional activities including public appearances and community volunteer opportunities.
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Shoot and edit video clips as assigned.
  • Write content for the website and other digital platforms.
  • May produce newscasts.
  • Interact with viewers/users on social media sites.
  • Promote teamwork and maintain attitude of cooperation with all station personnel.
     

 ​Requirements & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required.
  • Superior on-air presence.
  • Professional experience in news anchoring and/or on-camera news reporting preferred.
  • Excellent news judgment with an expansive knowledge of local and national current events, history, newsmakers and issues.
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to effectively listen to fully understand problems and communicate with a team to shape a solution.
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record.
  • Flexibility to work any shift.

job.title: Reporter I, MultiMedia Journalist
job.description:
The Multimedia Journalist Reporter produces, reports, shoots, writes, voices, edits and feeds news production content for all platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging and meaningful to news consumers.

  • Reports news stories for broadcast, describing the background and details of events
  • Arranges interviews with people who can provide information about stories

  • Receives assignments and evaluates leads and tips to develop story ideas
  • Discusses issues with producers and/or news managers to establish priorities or positions
  • Checks reference materials such as books, news files or public records to obtain relevant facts
  • Revises work to meet editorial approval or to fit time requirements
  • Shoots and edits news events and news reports
  • Produces and presents reports for all platforms
  • Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality
  • Writes stories for the web and other eMedia platforms
  • Interacts with viewers/users on social media sites
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Minimum two years’ experience in news reporting (Depending on market size)
  • Superior on-air presence
  • Proficiency with computers, telephones, copiers, scanners, fax machines and other office equipment
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record
  • Flexibility to work any shift

job.title: Reporter/MMJ
job.description:
KTXL-FOX40, the Nexstar station in Sacramento, is looking for an experienced Reporter/MMJ to join our growing team. 


The ideal candidate should have the ability to enterprise relevant, unique, broad appeal content every day. Have the skills and desire to dig deeper, go beyond the obvious and bring an investigative mindset to day-turn stories.


You should also have outstanding live reporting skills, capable of covering breaking news, severe weather, and other developing stories in an aggressive, compelling, creative way.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Report news stories for broadcast, describing the background and details of events
  • Build network of sources that will enable FOX40 News to stay ahead of its competitors
  • Research topics, vet tips for credibility and relevance, gather information for possible broadcast and publication
  • Arrange and conduct interviews, shoot video, edit packages (and Vo/Sots)
  • Review copy for accuracy, style and proper grammar and punctuation, following prescribed editorial direction and guidelines
  • Pitch stories of interest to a diverse audience, while also understanding the importance of targeting specific members of that audience
  • Promote teamwork and maintain attitude of cooperation and collaboration with all station personnel
  • Interact frequently with viewers/users on social media platforms to build engagement and brand
  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned, including attendance at public events and community service initiative.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Broadcast Journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to ad lib when required
  • Minimum three years’ experience in news reporting (Depending on market size)
  • Superior on-air presence
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Social media expertise, proficiency
  • Knowledge of current newsgathering technology, including video cameras, editing equipment and newsroom computer systems 
  • Valid driver’s license with a good driving record
  • Flexibility to work any shift

Compensation - $28.85+/hr commensurate with experience and skill level.


To be considered for this position, you must apply online at: https://nexstar.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/nexstar


Please remember to upload a copy of your resume and include a link to your work.

job.title: Sales Account Executive
job.description:
Queen City News is seeking a Multimedia Marketing Executive, responsible for selling television, digital, and social media advertising solutions to local businesses and ad agencies. The ideal candidate is coachable, thrives in a goal-oriented team environment and has strong interpersonal skills. We provide the tools for powerful advertising solutions - you provide a positive attitude, client focus, and desire to WIN! If you want to work for the best, we want to hear from you today!

The Multimedia Marketing Executive generates advertising revenue by calling on established agencies, cold-calling new prospects and convincing potential clients of the merits of television, digital and social media advertising. job.title: Senior Manager, Ad Sales Research and Measurement Solutions
job.description:
JOB DUTIES: Conduct market analysis to understand consumer behavior, and media consumption trends. Support ad sales research teams from pre-buy to post-buy process. Collaborate with sales teams to provide research-driven insights that support ad sales pitches and client meetings, and request for information (RFI) and request for proposal (RFP) procurement processes. Produce performance reports for ad sales comprising program insights, audience reach, and other key performance indicators (KPIs). Collect business intelligence data from available industry reports, public information, field reports, or purchased sources. Devise methods for identifying data patterns and trends in available information sources. Mine media research tools like Nielsen, comScore, and MRI. Conduct primary research projects including study development, analysis, visualization and presenting insights via presentations. Design, implement and execute research studies to showcase the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. Work closely with the marketing, sales, and content teams to align research initiatives with broader business strategies. Create clear, compelling visual reports and dashboards to communicate research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Lead presentations to the sales and support teams, summarizing research insights and strategic recommendations.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Marketing, Data Science, Digital Media, or related field. Must have five (5) years progressive, post-baccalaureate experience as a Business Analyst, Digital Research Manager or related occupation. 

 

SKILLS: Must have: 

  • Experience writing, programming and analyzing primary research data.  
  • Three (3) years experience with media and advertising research or market research.  
  • Three (3) years experience developing reporting and insight from behavioral data and managing external client and agency requests.  
  • Three (3) years experience developing monthly and quarterly reporting (performance dashboards, audience profiling, and competitive insights).  
  • Three (3) years experience developing insights for television programming and supporting digital platforms including digital video, newsletters, CTV, audio/podcasting and social.  
  • Three (3) years experience with at least three of the following third-party marketing tools: MRI-Simmons; YouGov; Adobe Analytics; Comscore Media Metrix, Mobile/Video Metrix, and Plan Metrix; YouTube Analytics; Ipsos Affluent Study; Erdos & Morgan Opinion Leaders Survey; or market research databases eMarketer and Mintel.  
  • Two (2) years experience running measurement projects (Brand Lift studies) and working with measurement vendors (Kantar or RealEyes). 

 

This is a full-time (40 hours/week) professional position. Job location: 1301 6th Avenue NY, NY 10019. Wage Offer: $134,650 per annum.  To apply, email resume and cover letter to NBusch@nexstar.tv and reference job title.  EOE.  Principals only.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
WJZY / Queen City News is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to help lead the growth of our digital and cross-platform advertising business in the Charlotte market. This is a sales-focused, consultative leadership role for someone who understands that successful digital selling is about more than presenting products. The Strategic Account Manager will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Managers, and clients to uncover business challenges, develop compelling marketing strategies, and build solutions that drive measurable results. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, strong communicator, curious problem solver, and confident sales partner who can help transform complex digital marketing opportunities into simple, compelling solutions for local businesses. You will serve as a digital and cross-platform subject matter expert, helping the sales team identify opportunities, strengthen client relationships, win new business, and grow existing accounts.

  • Key Responsibilities

    Drive Digital Revenue Growth

  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Managers to identify, develop, and close digital and cross-platform revenue opportunities.
  • Develop strategies to grow both new and existing digital business.
  • Identify high-potential accounts and verticals and create targeted sales strategies to penetrate those opportunities.
  • Participate in client meetings and presentations as a strategic marketing and digital subject matter expert.
  • Help sales teams increase the value of client relationships by expanding marketing solutions beyond traditional television.

  • Become a Strategic Sales Partner

  • Work alongside Account Executives throughout the sales process—from prospecting and discovery through presentation, closing, and campaign strategy.
  • Help sellers prepare for meetings through research, business intelligence, and development of a clear client-focused point of view.
  • Coach and collaborate with sellers on digital strategy, positioning, objection handling, and solution development.
  • Bring creativity and a challenger-style, consultative approach to client conversations.
  • Help simplify complex digital marketing concepts and translate them into clear business outcomes.

  • Develop Client-Centric Marketing Solutions

  • Conduct research to understand a client's business, competitive environment, target audience, and marketing objectives.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to uncover client needs and opportunities rather than relying on a product-first sales approach.
  • Develop customized marketing strategies designed to increase awareness, generate leads, drive conversions, and grow market share.
  • Present recommendations with a focus on business outcomes, audience strategy, measurement, and return on investment.
  • Build trusted relationships with local businesses and advertising agencies by serving as a marketing resource and strategic advisor.

  • Lead Digital Sales Enablement

  • Keep the sales organization informed about new products, capabilities, industry trends, best practices, and emerging opportunities.

  • What We're Looking For

    The ideal candidate will have:

  • Proven experience in digital advertising, media sales, marketing, advertising technology, or a related field.
  • Strong consultative and solution-based sales skills.
  • A demonstrated ability to develop relationships with clients and uncover business needs.
  • Experience presenting marketing strategies and recommendations to business owners, executives, and/or advertising agencies.
  • A strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem and current marketing trends.
  • The ability to translate complex marketing concepts, data, and technology into simple business solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • A proactive, competitive, and entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to understand how marketing impacts revenue and growth.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with salespeople while also taking ownership of revenue opportunities.
  • A willingness to continually learn and adapt in a rapidly changing media and advertising landscape.

  • What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role goes beyond selling digital products.

    The successful Strategic Account Manager will:

  • Grow digital revenue.
  • Help Account Executives win more business and larger opportunities.
  • Create stronger, more strategic client relationships.
  • Turn client business challenges into compelling marketing solutions.
  • Increase adoption of cross-platform solutions.
  • Elevate the digital expertise of the entire sales organization.
  • Become a trusted strategic resource for both clients and sellers.

  • This is an opportunity for a sales-minded marketing strategist who wants to have a direct impact on revenue, client success, and the evolution of a modern local media organization.

job.title: Weekend Digital Producer
job.description:
Excited to grow your career?

 

We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we want you to apply!

 

The Weekend Digital Producer position leads the transition from broadcast focused newsrooms to multi-platform newsrooms through active daily example; providing training in methods, processes and tactics; as well as in creating/editing original content beyond that which is produced for on-air.

 

This person would also be responsible for managing our assignment desk during regular weekend shifts, providing the fuel to make our weekend news coverage stand out.

 

The successful candidate for this role will:

 

Develop and lead a winning strategy for station content

Have an expert understanding of Facebook, X, Instagram and other social media platforms

Use our Social Media and our website, YourCentralValley.com, to build and reinforce brand recognition

Determine a story's emphasis, length, and format, and organize material accordingly

Research and analyze background information related to news stories in order to be able to provide complete and accurate information

Gather information about events through research, interviews, experience or attendance at political, news, sports, artistic, social or other functions

Pitch on-brand local and trending stories during morning meetings

Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality

Writes stories for the web and other digital platforms

Performs other duties as assigned

Finds new ways to use Social Media and our website to engage with viewers

 

Requirements & Skills:

 

Degree in journalism; daily newspaper or news site experience required; live, working web samples and/or print pages preferred

Proficiency in Associated Press style, Adobe Creative Suite, Wordpress

Maintain positive work environment through active team participation and cooperation with co-workers in all departments

Responds positively to feedback

$20+per hour depending on experience and skills set.

job.title: Weekend Meteorologist/Content Creator
job.description:
WETM/18 News seeks a talented Meteorologist/Content Creator. The selected candidate will do on-air weather forecast segments primarily for our weekend newscasts. They will also fill in as needed for other newscasts throughout the week. They will also create content for our digital platforms, including WETM+, our Smart TV streaming app.  The weekend Meteorologist/Content Creator will report, shoot, write and edit weather/news reports across multiple platforms.

  • Produce and present weather/news reports for all platforms.
  • Ensures that all weather/news content meets company standards for journalistic integrity and production quality.
  • Writes and delivers weather / news stories in a clear and concise manner.
  • Assists in writing, copy editing, researching and coordinating weather programming and other content.
  • Responds to breaking and/or severe weather events and other urgent newsroom situations as required.
  • Works closely with the weather team to develop comprehensive weather coverage.
  • Participates in promotional activities including public appearances.
  • Writes web stories detailing the local forecast on a daily basis.
  • Interacts with viewers and users on social media sites.
  • The MMVJ part of the job includes reporting three days a week.
  • Ability to shoot pictures and edit stories from beginning to end.
  • Winning candidate will be posting on the web and social media.
  • Compensation Range: $16.00 - $17.00 per hour

 

Requirements & Skills:


  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Entry level to 2 years’ experience in weather presentation and reporting preferred.
  • Must be able to shoot video and perform non-linear editing. Ability to write story from beginning to end.  Knowledge of ENPS helpful.
  • Proficiency with Barron’s Radar is helpful.
  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments, and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of the field of Meteorology and a proven track record of forecasting.
  • Valid driver's license with a good driving record.
  • Flexibility to work any shift.

job.title: Associate, Real-Time Systems (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The Associate, Real-Time Systems supports the design, configuration, operation, and troubleshooting of Real-Time Systems that power NFL Media digital graphics experiences, including FAST channels, NFL+, RedZone, and other digital productions. This role serves as a technical resource for Viz graphics workflows, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, data integrations, and real-time content delivery while helping ensure reliable operation of critical production systems.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Viz graphics systems, render engines, ticker systems, L-Bar applications, and supporting software environments to ensure reliable delivery of graphics across FAST, digital, and RedZone platforms.
  • Support end-to-end graphics workflows including data-driven Viz graphics, scorebars, ticker content, promotional elements, sponsorship integrations, countdown clocks, and lower-third graphic packages to ensure accurate on-air and digital presentation.
  • Maintain RTS applications, databases, APIs, and automated page generation tools while validating data flow between internal services, graphics systems, and production environments.
  • Serve as a frontline technical resource during live productions by diagnosing and resolving graphics, connectivity, software, and data issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Partner with production, engineering, and operations teams to support FAST channel graphics, RedZone L-Bar workflows, ticker content management, and digital platform graphics delivery.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, diagrams, workflow guides, system inventories, and operational procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements and automation.
  • Assist with preparation, testing, deployment, and operational support for major league events including the NFL Draft, NFL Combine, International Games, Kickoff, Playoffs, and Super Bowl coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Digital Media, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting broadcast graphics, digital media operations, production technology, or real-time systems.
  • Experience supporting Vizrt, graphics rendering systems, or similar real-time graphics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of networking, Windows administration, system configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with data-driven graphics, APIs, databases, and content automation workflows.
  • Experience supporting live production, digital streaming, or broadcast operations.
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting FAST channels, OTT streaming platforms, or sports media operations.
  • Experience with Viz Trio, Viz Engine, ticker systems, or graphics automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and scripting/automation tools.
  • Experience supporting major live sporting events.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure during live productions.
  • Strong customer service mindset and production support orientation.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in control rooms, machine rooms, and production environments.
  • Occasional lifting and movement of production or IT equipment up to 40 pounds.

Travel

  • No travel typically required.

 Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule required.
  • Evening, overnight, weekend, and holiday work may be required during live productions and major events.
  • Overtime may be required based on production schedules.

The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

job.title: Manager, Football Business Strategy
job.description:
The Manager, Football Business Strategy will plan, implement, and execute initiatives that support Football Operations strategic priorities. The role will lead the research, testing, and development required to evaluate and implement innovations across Future of Football workstreams, while managing a portfolio of high- impact projects. This role will also address a diverse set of football business challenges by partnering regularly with internal departments, clubs, vendors, sponsors and other external stakeholders. The Manager, Football Business Strategy may also oversee interns, rotational analysts, coordinators, or project-based contributors supporting Football Business Strategy and Operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support the planning, execution, and oversight of strategic initiatives that support Football Operations priorities, including football innovation, game operations and policy, international growth, and long-range organizational planning.
  • Manage the League’s Future of Football portfolio, including technology evaluations, pilot programs, stakeholder alignment, testing plans, implementation support, and performance reporting for Football Operations leadership and club stakeholders.
  • Support Football Operations business planning, budget development, forecasting, enterprise risk management, KPI reporting, and strategic decision-making through financial, operational, and scenario analysis.
  • Serve as the project manager for football technology and data initiatives, including club analytics devices, data-sharing programs, operational technology deployments, game day support, and vendor-supported innovation efforts.
  • Develop executive-level presentations, recommendations, memoranda, and reporting for senior leadership, the Competition Committee, Future of Football Committee, Technology Committee, and other key stakeholder groups.
  • Lead vendor evaluation, procurement, contract administration, payment tracking, and RFP processes across assigned workstreams, including technology platforms, football operations services, and innovation partnerships.
  • Partner with internal and external partners to identify opportunities to improve football operations through emerging technologies, automation, data, and artificial intelligence.
  • Support international football development initiatives programs that strengthen football ecosystems, expand participation pathways, and support the long-term growth of the game globally.
  • Coordinate complex cross-functional projects and stakeholder engagement efforts, ensuring alignment across clubs, League departments, vendors, and external football organizations while delivering against established timelines and strategic objectives.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, decision logs, budgets, and status reporting for assigned initiatives.
  • Provide support across League tentpole events, football technology testing, and other Football Operations priorities.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in addressing ad hoc projects and evolving organizational needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5-7+ years of experience
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience in football operations, sports technology, data, and AI, with familiarity across emerging technologies, integration, and adoption workflows.
  • Experience managing strategic, operational, technology, or consulting projects with multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, vendor management, procurement, contracting, or RFP processes preferred.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, judgment, and follow-
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for executive, club, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with project management and collaboration tools preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business, technical, and operational information into clear recommendations and executive-ready materials.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  •  Collaborative relationship-builder who can work effectively across a small team and lead cross- functional stakeholder groups.
  • Proactive, adaptable self-starter who can manage ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and drive work to completion.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Ability to support game day, evening, weekend, and tentpole-event responsibilities when required by assigned projects.
  • Approximately 25% travel, including travel to League and club events, meetings, technology tests, and other Football Operations activities.

job.title: Seasonal Coordinator, Social Analytics & Listening
job.description:
The NFL is currently seeking a Seasonal Coordinator to join our Social Analytics and Listening Team (SALT) in the Social and Influencer Marketing department. This individual will be responsible for supporting SALT by working on reporting and analysis, with a special focus on the NFL’s international social handles. This individual will be key in deriving insights and driving global social strategy from data. The successful candidate will have a deep understanding of and passion for the National Football League, its member Clubs, Players, and social media strategy / data.

Essential Functions

  • Support the Social Analytics and Listening Team (SALT) by producing reporting and analysis of NFL social media performance.
  • Focus on international social media handles, identifying key trends and performance drivers.
  • Derive actionable insights from data to inform and optimize global social strategy.
  • Deliver regular reports and presentations to internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor and evaluate the impact of campaigns, content, and influencer partnerships.
  • Assist in social listening to track fan sentiment, cultural moments, and engagement trends.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 1–2+ years of experience in social media analytics, marketing analytics, or related data-driven role.
  • Proficiency with social media platforms (Instagram, X/Twitter, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, etc.) and their analytics tools.
  • Strong skills in Excel/Google Sheets

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Prior experience in sports, entertainment, or digital media analytics.
  • Familiarity with social listening platforms (e.g., Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker).
  • Experience working with global or multilingual social media accounts.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Collaborative team player with flexibility to support fast-paced projects.
  • Self-starter who can prioritize tasks and meet deadlines under pressure.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Associate
job.description:
The Broadcast Associate (BA) will work in a LIVE television control room and coordinate LIVE graphics for many different studio & remote shows.  Must work to ensure all graphics are spelled correctly, are factually & grammatically accurate, and reflect proper news judgment as stories develop. 

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the development and implementation of on-screen graphic elements
  • Work with the operator to build graphics, and monitor execution of graphics during the show
  • Communicate with line and edit producers to understand what material is covered in each show
  • Create graphics that reflect breaking news, current NFL topics, and statistics related to show content
  • Facilitate communication and exchange of ideas with the NFL Network graphics department 

Required Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail is required
  • Ability to establish open communication with all producers & others you will work with on a daily basis
  • Excellent organization skills required
  • Strong command of language and writing skills needed
  • Understanding of the NFL, current players and other key individuals necessary
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and/or projects at once
  • Strong ability to decipher the most important & most up-to-date information for each story
  • Strong understanding of the workflow in a TV control room environment
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to do basic stat/info research
  • Basic understanding of on-air graphic systems, specifically VizRT 

Qualifications

  • Previous professional experience in TV Production environment, including graphics, is strongly preferred 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to solve problems and work independently
  • Creative and collaborative attitude

Supervisory Responsibility 

  • Oversee graphics built by VizRT operators 

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time, up to 29 hours per week
  • Sunday availability from 7:30am - 4:30pm
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Segment Producer
job.description:
The NFL Media Group located in Inglewood, CA is looking for a seasonal part-time NFL RedZone Segment Producer. This position will report to the Coordinating Producer for NFL RedZone.

Responsibilities

  • Oversees EVS operators in the tape room during live NFL RedZone production, serving as a tape/live producer of the games that are assigned
  • Responsible for spotting key plays, interesting storylines during a full slate of NFL games
  • Take direction from show Producers to enhance content on NFL RedZone
  • Guides edit team through edits of highlights, and sound needed during the day for NFL RedZone
  • Coordinates with the on-air staff to write accurate and informative content as it relates to the segment
  • Uses a high level of sports knowledge and news judgment to determine the agenda, concepts, and content of the assigned games within NFL RedZone
  • Assign and give creative and editorial notes for high end element production
  • Supervise both short-form & long-form highlight production
  • Copy-edit scripts
  • Supervise, train, and mentor Associate Producers & Production Assistants
  • Produce sound for fill segments during NFL RedZone
  • Explain edit instructions in detail
  • Must bring creative statistical ideas to the NFL RedZone preshow meeting on Sunday mornings to help team enhance the show for the viewer
  • Bring to life statical information given in preshow editorial meeting when overseeing the live games that are assigned

Required Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of progressively complex studio or related production experience
  • Good production skills related to sporting events and graphics
  • A strong knowledge of live television production dynamics and working knowledge of the equipment and technologies in EVS, the control room and edit bays
  • Ability to carry out a broad range of assignments that range from highlight supervising to segment producing to on-air graphics with little or no preparation time in between
  • Have a good knowledge of the NFL and sports history
  • Supervisory experience with good leadership skills
  • Good writing and copy-editing skills
  • Knowledge of television graphics and VizRT graphics
  • Technical knowledge required - must have knowledge of what "works" on television
  • Specific knowledge of television production techniques used in a EVS tape room as well as the control room

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communication, Journalism or equivalent experience in a related field
  • Advanced understanding of linear editing and on-air graphics systems

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must have strong editorial skills and NFL knowledge to know what video and soundbites are best to edit
  • Must be able to respond quickly on short deadlines
  • Adhere to established production schedule to meet deadlines
  • A team-first attitude is mandatory

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time, up to 29 hours/week
  • 7:30am - 4:30pm Sunday availability
  • Overtime may be required on any given NFL RedZone Sunday
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Recruiter
job.description:
The Seasonal Recruiter will lead seasonal recruitment efforts for various NFL offices.  In this role, you will be a talent advisor and build strong relationships with the senior management team. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role with senior management, hiring managers, compensation, finance, and HR Business Partners in driving hiring and employee retention efficiencies that support the NFL's vision, mission, and values. 

Please note this role is in-person/office five days a week based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs).

Responsibilities 

  • Manage 40 to 50+ open seasonal requisitions at once across multiple departments and locations during peak hiring periods 
  • Execute full-cycle, high volume recruitment including screening, interviewing, and extending offers 
  • Support Early Career recruitment efforts during non-peak seasonal hiring times 
  • Build strong working relationships with HR and hiring managers to understand business needs, seasonal headcount planning, and job requirements

job.title: Senior Coordinator, Licensing (12-month Leave Cover)
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Licensing (Europe) supports the growth and execution of the NFL's consumer products, licensing, retail, and fan commerce initiatives across the European market. This role will assist in managing partner relationships, supporting e-commerce and retail programs, coordinating marketing and product development activities, and contributing to revenue-generating initiatives across key categories and channels. The position works closely with internal stakeholders, external partners, and NFL Clubs to help deliver an integrated consumer products strategy that supports fan engagement and business growth throughout Europe.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the day-to-day management of consumer products and licensing partners across product development, marketing, retail, and business operations.
  • Assist in the execution of initiatives that support annual revenue and business growth objectives across Europe.
  • Coordinate key activities related to the NFL Europe e-commerce business, including assortment planning, promotional execution, sales tracking, and reporting.
  • Partner with Consumer Products and Marketing teams to support the development and execution of annual marketing plans across social media, digital, CRM, influencer, and media channels.
  • Support partner marketing programs, retail activations, and fan engagement initiatives across European markets.
  • Coordinate product development activities, including quality control reviews, product approvals, rights management processes, and market-specific product opportunities.
  • Assist partners in executing retail strategies and identifying opportunities to expand market presence and product distribution.
  • Support merchandise and retail operations for NFL games, events, and activations throughout Europe.
  • Coordinate consumer products initiatives related to NFL Club Global Markets Programs and support locally relevant fan engagement efforts.
  • Work with internal insights and analytics teams to leverage fan and market data that inform product, retail, and partner strategies.
  • Prepare regular business reports, forecasts, sales updates, and performance analyses for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support management of licensing agencies and partner portfolios across designated territories.
  • Track and monitor regional consumer products marketing funds and assist with budget reporting.
  • Provide administrative, operational, and project coordination support across the European Consumer Products business.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2-4+ years of experience in licensing, consumer products, retail, account management, sports marketing, or a related field.
  • Experience working within a sports, entertainment, lifestyle, retail, or licensing environment.
  • Knowledge of the European retail and consumer products landscape.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and business reporting tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and with external partners.
  • Self-motivated with strong time management and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international business environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting licensing, merchandising, e-commerce, or retail businesses.
  • Familiarity with sports and entertainment consumer products environments.
  • Experience working with external agencies, retailers, or brand licensing partners.
  • Passion for sports and understanding of the NFL and its growing international fan base.

  • 40 hours per week in office
  • Expected to last up to 12 months based on business needs

job.title: Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Analytics
job.description:
Fan Engagement Data Science turns fan behavior into the strategies that shape how millions of fans experience the NFL. In this role, you'll sit at the center of that work, partnering with our NYC team and stakeholders across Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights, while leading a distributed offshore delivery team to turn ambiguous ideas into sharp, high-impact analytics. You’ll work end-to-end, from framing the right question to presenting the answer to Director- and VP-level leaders, on a fast-moving team delivering against one of the NFL's biggest fan engagement programs.

Responsibilities

  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights stakeholders into scoped, high-impact analytical work.
  • Lead and coach a distributed offshore delivery team, keeping quality, pace, and prioritization on track across a compressed daily overlap window.
  • Own your work end-to-end — from framing a hypothesis to presenting recommendations directly to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across marketing, technology, BI, and data engineering as a trusted analytics voice in the room.
  • Design segmentation, predictive models, and experiments (A/B tests) that convert fan behavior into targeted, actionable marketing strategies.
  • Apply GenAI/LLM-assisted analytics tools, within governed workflows, to move faster from data to insight.
  • Define and manage KPIs for fan engagement, partnering with the BI Center of Excellence to expand access to insight across the org.
  • Champion data quality and integrity across every initiative you touch

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in customer or fan data analytics, with a strong track record of translating data into marketing strategy.
  • Experience turning ambiguous business questions into scoped, delivery-ready analytical work.
  • Experience leading or closely partnering with distributed or offshore teams.
  • A confident, clear communicator — comfortable presenting directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL and Python; working knowledge of ML frameworks and GenAI/LLM-based analytics tools.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Understanding of data management principles, including identity resolution and marketing consent.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack (e.g., AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with customer data platforms (Adobe Experience Platform, or similar).
  • Familiarity with PII management and data privacy practices.
  • Experience with governed AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Familiarity with data observability tooling (e.g., Monte Carlo, Atlan).

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Bias to Ownership: Treats an ambiguous or stalled workstream as something to unblock and drive forward, not something to report status on and wait for direction.
  • Leadership Excellence: Strong leadership skills with a history of managing diverse, distributed, and cross-functional teams effectively.
  • Communication Mastery: Excellent ability to simplify complex data insights into strategic actions and communicate these clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, including in contested or high-pressure settings.
