job.title: Director, Finance Leadership Development Program
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Program Director to design, launch, and lead the program from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to build a flagship talent program at a major Media, Entertainment, and Tech company — shaping its curriculum, rotation structure, participant experience, and long-term success metrics. The ideal candidate combines finance acumen, program/project management rigor, a forward-looking view on how AI and technology are reshaping finance work, and a genuine passion for developing early-career talent. The Program Director will serve as the primary point of contact for participants, rotation managers, university recruiting partners, and finance leadership, ensuring the program delivers a cohesive, high-impact experience from recruitment through graduation and placement.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Program Design & Strategy
  • Build out the end-to-end structure of the program, including rotation sequencing, learning objectives, and success criteria for each of the three rotations.
  • Partner with finance leadership to identify and secure rotation placements (e.g., FP&A, Accounting & Controllership, Treasury, Investor Relations, Business Unit Finance, etc.) that provide breadth and depth of experience.
  • Design and continuously refine the technical finance capability curriculum (financial modeling, accounting, valuation, corporate finance fundamentals) in partnership with internal SMEs or external training providers.
  • Partner with the SVP of Innovation to design and integrate an AI-forward training track — covering AI/ML fundamentals for finance, generative AI tools for modeling and analysis, automation of routine finance workflows, and how emerging technology is changing the finance function — ensuring participants graduate as both strong technical financiers and confident, tech-savvy operators.
  • Continuously scan for new AI tools, platforms, and use cases relevant to finance and embed them into the curriculum as the technology landscape evolves.
  • Design and oversee the leadership development curriculum (communication, executive presence, project management, business acumen) in partnership with L&D/HR.

 

Participant Management & Experience
  • Own the day-to-day participant experience: onboarding, rotation transitions, performance check-ins, and end-of-program evaluation.
  • Serve as a primary mentor, coach, and advocate for program participants throughout their journey.
  • Facilitate regular touchpoints (1:1s, cohort sessions, exec speaker series) to build community and reinforce leadership development themes.
  • Track individual and cohort performance, proactively addressing performance or engagement concerns with rotation managers.

 

Stakeholder & Business Partnership
  • Act as the liaison between rotational participants and rotation managers, ensuring clear expectations, feedback loops, and successful integration into each business unit.
  • Partner with finance leadership to identify end-of-program placement recommendations based on participant strengths and business needs.
  • Build relationships with senior finance leaders to secure executive sponsorship, speaker engagement, and mentorship participation.
  • Serve as the primary finance-side partner to the SVP of Innovation, aligning on AI training content, piloting new tools with the cohort, and channeling participant feedback into the broader innovation roadmap.

 

Recruiting & Program Growth
  • Partner with University Recruiting to define target schools, candidate profile, and selection criteria for each incoming cohort — including evaluating candidates' comfort and curiosity with AI and data tools as part of the selection criteria.
  • Participate in candidate interviews and final selection decisions.
  • Represent the program at campus recruiting events, info sessions, and case competitions as needed.
  • Own program metrics and reporting (retention, performance, promotion/placement rates, participant satisfaction) and use data to continuously improve the program.

 

Program Operations
  • Manage program budget, vendor relationships (training providers, assessment tools, AI/tech platform vendors), and logistics.
  • Establish program governance, policies, and processes (rotation timing, performance review cadence, escalation paths).
  • Build the program's employer brand internally and externally as a flagship talent pipeline known for producing tech-fluent finance leaders.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or related field
  • 10+ years of professional experience, with a mix of finance/business experience and program management, talent development, or HR business partnering
  • Demonstrated experience building or running a rotational program, leadership development program, or similar early-career talent initiative
  • Strong knowledge of core finance functions (FP&A, accounting, corporate finance) sufficient to design meaningful rotational and technical training content
  • A tech-forward mindset — genuine curiosity about AI and how it's transforming finance, and comfort partnering with technical/innovation stakeholders to translate that into training content
  • Exemplary relationship-management skills, with credibility to engage confidently with senior finance executives and new graduates alike
  • Strong program/project management skills — able to manage multiple moving parts (curriculum, people, stakeholders, logistics) concurrently
  • Remarkable communication, coaching, and facilitation skills

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience in media, entertainment, or a large, complex corporate environment.
  • Prior experience with university recruiting or campus talent pipelines.
  • Familiarity with designing learning in the flow of work.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools in a finance or business context (e.g., generative AI for modeling/analysis, automation platforms).
  • Experience with HRIS/LMS platforms and program analytics/reporting tools
  • MBA a plus

job.title: Director, Global Title Marketing (Kids and Family)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Director of Global Title Marketing, Kids & Family is tasked with leading the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global marketing campaigns for select Paramount+ Kids & Family titles.   This role serves as a key cross-functional leader and steward of both individual titles and broader franchises. Developing campaigns that connect with kids across different age groups while also motivating parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.   The ideal candidate has solid marketing strategy skills and deep knowledge of kids entertainment, family viewing habits, and franchise building. They also understand how young audiences discover and engage with content as those habits keep changing. The Director must be a great leader, compelling storyteller, collaborative partner, and forward-thinking problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.   This is an onsite position at our New York or Burbank office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global go-to-market strategies
  • Translate series, film, character, and franchise attributes into differentiated campaign strategies that resonate with kids, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.
  • Develop audience strategies that account for distinct developmental stages, interests, viewing behaviors, and levels of parental influence across preschool, kids, tweens, teens, and family audiences.
  • Identify clear campaign objectives, audience priorities, strategic opportunities, and measures of success. Holding team members and partners accountable throughout campaign development and execution.
  • Apply a global perspective while recognizing regional differences in family dynamics, cultural relevance, content discovery, and children’s media consumption.
  • Ensure campaign strategies and executions are age-appropriate, inclusive, brand-safe, and aligned with applicable privacy, advertising, and platform guidelines.
  • Proactively identify key milestones, connect workstreams, resolve challenges, and ensure that creative and tactical executions ladder up to the overall strategy.
  • Brief cross-functional teams on campaign strategy so each discipline can develop a cohesive, audience-led plan.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and enthusiastic steward of assigned titles, characters, and franchises.
  • Build marketing strategies that support both the immediate title launch and long-term health, relevance, and growth
  • Partner with franchise, consumer products, licensing, retail, games, publishing, experiences, and other teams, where applicable. Creating related opportunities across the broader Paramount ecosystem.
  • Foster productive and trusting relationships with key stakeholders to ensure plans are developed and executed in a timely, collaborative, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain and build the team’s knowledge of the Kids & Family landscape, including audience behaviors, platform trends, franchise development, and responsible marketing practices.
  • Drive alignment among senior leadership and external partners. This includes: creators, executive producers, filmmakers, talent, studios, and co-production partners.
  • Clearly articulate the audience opportunity, campaign positioning, and strategic choices, behind recommendations.
  • Drive innovative thinking to develop 360-degree global stunts, partnerships, activations, and breakthrough campaign ideas that can generate excitement among kids and families.
  • Identify opportunities to bring titles and characters into the real world through family experiences, fan events, cultural moments, educational initiatives, and strategic brand partnerships.
  • Brief and lead “big idea” initiatives, managing internal teams and agency partners through execution.
  • Evaluate ideas through the distinct lenses of child appeal, parent or caregiver relevance, family participation, brand safety, and earned-media potential.
  • Partner with Media and Campaign Management teams to lead the development and execution of media campaigns across platforms that reach kids, parents, caregivers, and family audiences.
  • Understand the challenges of reaching young audiences. This includes streaming, digital video, social platforms, gaming environments, connected television, family programming, and media focused on parents.
  • Identify opportunities to reach parents and caregivers as content decision-makers while also building organic excitement and cultural relevance among young audiences.
  • Analyze audience research, campaign performance, competitive intelligence, and cultural trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy. Lead cross-functional reviews of awareness, consideration, engagement, viewing, acquisition, retention, co-viewing, repeat viewing, and franchise affinity. Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Combine quantitative data with qualitative audience knowledge. Recognizing that parents, caregivers, and children may each play different roles in content discovery and viewing decisions.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of entertainment marketing experience. With demonstrated experience developing campaigns for kids & family content, family entertainment, animation, or youth-focused brands.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience leading multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution and performance analysis.
  • Solid awareness of the distinct needs and behaviors of kids, tweens, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewing audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to market to young audiences responsibly and navigate relevant brand-safety, privacy, advertising, and platform considerations.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and a proven ability to manage relationships with senior internal stakeholders, creators, talent, filmmakers, studios, agencies, and external partners.
  • Robust strategic judgment and the ability to translate audience, cultural, creative, and business insights into actionable campaign strategies.
  • Data-driven marketer with experience analyzing campaign performance and applying learnings to optimize results.
  • Ability to manage multiple titles, priorities, and stakeholders within a dynamic and highly collaborative environment.
  • Exemplary written, verbal, and presentation skills, with solid attention to detail.
  • Experience marketing original series, films, animation, preschool content, or established Kids & Family franchises for a streaming service, studio, network, or entertainment brand.
  • Experience developing campaigns that speak to both young audiences and parents or caregivers.
  • Insight with emerging Kids & Family creators, platforms, fandoms, and digital content-discovery behaviors.
  • Experience developing global campaigns and adapting strategies for different markets and cultures.
  • Genuine affinity for Kids & Family entertainment, characters, storytelling, and fandom.
  • A collaborative spirit, creative instincts, and a great sense of humor.

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

job.title: Director, Internal Audit, IT
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

We are seeking a top-tier IT Audit Director to join the Paramount team! This person will be tasked with implementing a comprehensive program of Information Technology (IT) internal auditing throughout the Company. They are primarily in charge of defining the scope of audits to identify control deficiencies, security weaknesses, opportunities to streamline and improve operations, and promote best-in-class business practices.
The Director will lead a team of audit professionals. They will assess risks related to technology, operations, and compliance throughout the organization; this includes evaluating applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and strategic technology initiatives. The Director will also conduct administrative tasks to support an elite internal audit function. They will oversee multiple audits and special projects. They will present findings to management. Additionally, they will build solid partnerships with business and technology leaders across the Company.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct audit planning and risk assessments to establish audit scope, resource allocation, and audit priorities across technology and operational audit engagements
  • Lead audits of highly technical areas within applications and infrastructure, security and vulnerability assessments, third party management, identity and access management, change control, asset management, disaster recovery, data privacy, cybersecurity, cloud services, and other emerging technologies
  • Evaluate the design and performance of internal controls and communicate audit and special project findings to management by clearly articulating risk exposure and providing realistic, cost-effective recommendations to mitigate risk and improve operational efficiency
  • Assess risks and controls associated with system implementations, major technology transformations, and pre- and post-implementation reviews
  • Coordinate audit activities with IT and business management while supervising and critically evaluating the performance of audit staff
  • Serve as a primary audit contact for assigned business and technology functions, developing trusted relationships and providing risk-based insights to management and executive teams
  • Perform special assignments, including business process reviews, due diligence activities, investigations, and strategic risk assessments, as directed by the Vice President of Internal Audit
  • Review work completed by staff members to ensure sufficient documentation, quality, and support for audit conclusions
  • Support the Internal Audit Vice President in periodic risk assessments and development of the annual audit plan
  • Draft, edit, and review audit reports, executive summaries, special project reports, and administrative communications
  • Develop the technical, management, and audit capabilities of IT Audit Managers and Staff through coaching, mentoring, and formal development activities
  • Stay informed on emerging risks and trends in cybersecurity, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, media technology, privacy regulations, and technology governance
  • Partner with stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen risk management and control environments across the organization
  • Some domestic travel may be required

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, and we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is…YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team that values authenticity and embraces inclusion for all. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Director, Product Management
247Sports
Department: 247Sports
Reports to: VP & Head of 247Sports
Location: Nashville, TN (on-site)
Employment type: Full-time
Level: Director


About 247Sports:
247Sports is a leading destination for college sports recruiting coverage, player rankings, and team-focused fan communities. We combine deep evaluation data and expert analysis with a premium VIP subscription experience for the most dedicated fans in college sports.
Position summary


247Sports is hiring a Director of Product Management to own the product strategy and roadmap for our web and data experiences. This is a results-driven leadership role centered on turning the deep evaluation data 247Sports collects into premium, subscriber-facing products that make our VIP membership materially more valuable. The Director will lead product development across the recruiting database (RDB), scouting and evaluation tooling, and subscriber growth, and will partner closely with editorial, scouting, engineering, and site publishers to drive measurable results.
This is a full-time, on-site role based in our Nashville office. We are open to discussing relocation timing for the right candidate.


Key responsibilities:


Product strategy & VIP subscriber value
●    Own the product vision and roadmap for 247Sports web and data products, with a focus on driving VIP subscription value, retention, and acquisition.
●    Lead the flagship initiative to productize proprietary evaluation data, including scouting reports, verified and unverified measurables, track times, and cross-sport intel, into front-facing content and interactive tools that show subscribers how and why players are ranked.
●    Define and prioritize premium features such as player evaluation profiles, searchable and sortable measurables and testing data, cross-sport intel, and scout-grade comparison tools.


Scouting & recruiting product partnership
●    Partner with the scouting and recruiting teams to build and expand the internal evaluation tooling they rely on day to day, including the scouting-information repository, evaluation tracking, and rankings workflows.
●    Lead development of depth charts and impact ratings, connecting scouting data directly to consumer-facing products.


Recruiting database (RDB)
●    Own the roadmap to elevate the RDB product experience and establish it as the primary destination for premium evaluation data.


Product marketing & growth
●    Partner with site publishers on strategies that drive traffic, engagement, and subscriptions.
●    Tie data-driven product initiatives directly to measurable subscriber acquisition and retention outcomes.


Cross-functional leadership
●    Lead product initiatives across engineering, editorial, scouting, and design, setting direction, prioritizing the roadmap, and driving execution.
●    Provide QA, project management, and site-production oversight as needed across product areas.
●    Support the 247Sports app roadmap, contributing on the web, backend, and data components that feed it, including Player Rankings.


Qualifications


Required
●    10+ years of product management experience, including roadmap ownership.
●    Demonstrated track record of building and shipping complex, data-driven products from the ground up.
●    Proven ability to translate large or complex data sets into consumer-facing products and tools.
●    Strong background in subscription or membership products, with a focus on driving retention and growth.
●    Experience leading cross-functional teams and partnering with editorial, engineering, and business stakeholders.
●    Excellent product judgment, prioritization, and communication skills.


Preferred
●    Deep familiarity with college sports, recruiting, and player evaluation.
●    Experience founding or leading a product or business built on sports data or recruiting tools.
●    Background working directly with scouting or evaluation data and the teams that produce it.

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

job.title: Executive Assistant
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

  Overview     We are seeking an Executive Assistant to support multiple Paramount DTC Content department/function and leads. The role requires someone with integrity, a desire to be a right-hand to forge professional partnerships with dynamic executives / teams. Our ideal candidate is positive, flexible, poised as well as confident when working with clients, senior leaders and co-workers in a professional, approachable, and positive manner.   Responsibilities:
  • Manage and maintain calendars, travel arrangements and expenses for Paramount DTC Global content management team
  • Screen incoming calls, correspondence, interoffice materials and can prioritize and respond appropriately
  • Make appropriate and informed decisions regarding executives' available time
  • Coordinate high-level meetings and events (including, but not limited to, scheduling, agenda creation, logistics, space plans, catering, etc.) for the West Hollywood and other offices, as needed
  • Track, follow and make recommendations as needed regarding appropriate action, follow up, and due dates
  • Copy, scan, file, and track a variety of business documents and communications while maintaining a high-degree of confidentiality
  • Conduct research on specialized topics, as required
  • Develop internal network of EAs, Facilities, and other key contacts
  • Additional other duties and responsibilities, as assigned

 

Basic Qualifications:

job.title: Executive Producer
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.
If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

 

Are you a creative and innovative storyteller looking to make an impact? If so, KPIX 5 wants you as our next Executive News Producer!
 

 

We are looking for a transformational leader to help elevate our newscasts! This is a role for a showcasing influencer who will play a pivotal role in crafting, leading, and coordinating content for both traditional TV broadcasts and our growing digital-first platforms. The ideal candidate is someone who can help their team grow skills while setting a high standard for news quality through feedback and mentorship.

 

 

OVERVIEW AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Cultivate a work environment that encourages fresh ideas and community engagement for our diverse audience.
•    Lead a team of anchors, producers, reporters, meteorologists, photojournalists, digital content producers and editors with strong editorial judgment.
•    Exhibit strong editorial judgment, effective communication, and critical thinking skills.
•    Uphold outstanding grammar, spelling, and attention to detail in all content produced.
•    Contribute to the station's goal of growing digital-first content through daily editorial decisions.

 

 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Minimum of 5 years of experience in broadcast or cable news; at least 3 years of newsroom management experience.
•    Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
•    Familiarity with streaming platforms and working knowledge of digital video production techniques and online content management.
•    Available for early mornings, nights, overnights, weekends, holidays. 

 


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. job.title: FP&A Manager - Content Finance & Transformation
job.description:
FP&A Manager – Content Finance & Transformation

Budapest | 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract

📌 INTERNAL APPLICANTS: Thinking about making a move? Taking on a fixed-term assignment will NOT jeopardize your permanent employment. Under Paramount policy, internal transfers into fixed-term roles carry a guaranteed return to your previous or equivalent position upon completion. You retain full employment continuity—so you can step up, expand your scope, and bring your experience back.

The Opportunity

Shape how Paramount plans, funds, and measures its content—and help build the finance engine behind it.

We’re looking for an FP&A Manager to join our Content Finance team in Budapest. In this role, you’ll serve as the finance voice for Paramount’s US studio content portfolio, partnering directly with Content Finance, Acquisitions, and senior leadership on decisions that dictate what hits the screen.

Beyond portfolio strategy, you will be a key finance lead on our Oracle Fusion ERP implementation—designing how Paramount Finance operates for years to come across requirements gathering, UAT, data validation, and go-live. Few roles offer this rare double-impact: a seat at the table on major content investments paired with hands-on enterprise transformation experience.

Note on the contract: This is a focused 12-month window to drive meaningful change and gain standout resume experience. Depending on business needs, it can also open doors to future opportunities within Paramount.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Portfolio Strategy: Lead budgeting, forecasting, and the 5-year Long Range Plan for the US studio content portfolio.

  • Turn Numbers into Stories: Deliver sharp performance analysis and clear variance commentary to senior executive stakeholders.

  • Power Content Investments: Partner with Content Finance and Acquisitions to model, evaluate, and advise on prospective content investments.

  • Lead System Transformation: Serve as the core Finance voice throughout the Oracle Fusion rollout—from business requirements and UAT to data validation and post-go-live optimization.

  • Manage Risk & Opportunity: Track content spend against approved budgets, flagging risks and opportunities early.

  • Streamline Operations: Identify and execute opportunities to automate and modernize finance workflows as we transition to Oracle Fusion.

  • Core Financial Execution: Support month-end and quarter-end close activities while delivering high-impact ad hoc business cases for strategic initiatives.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 5–8 years in Finance, FP&A, Accounting, or a related discipline.

  • Technical Mastery: Advanced financial modeling skills and Excel expertise.

  • Systems Exposure: ERP experience (ideally Oracle Fusion); prior exposure to implementations or finance transformation projects is a strong plus.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Strong stakeholder management experience across international, matrixed, and cross-functional environments.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex financial insights clearly to both finance and non-finance audiences.

  • Adaptability: Comfort juggling competing priorities in a fast-paced media landscape.

  • Education & Languages: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; fluent English.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Health & Well-being: Private health insurance with access to top private clinics, health screening packages, and eyewear support.

  • Flexible Benefits: Monthly cafeteria package including SZÉP card, nursery support, and home loan assistance.

  • Professional Growth: Company-sponsored language courses following probation.

  • Paramount Perks: Exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings, weekly fresh fruit days, and a dog-friendly office environment.

job.title: FPI Intern
job.description:
Process Improvement Intern – Budapest

Want to see how global financial operations actually run behind the scenes—and how to make them smarter?

At Paramount, we believe even the smallest process tweak can make a massive impact. As a Process Improvement Intern, you’ll join our Controllership and Global Business Services (GBS) teams in Budapest. You’ll get a hands-on look at how a global media company operates, learn how to spot inefficiencies, and help us build simple, smart automation solutions.

If you like solving puzzles, working with data, and turning manual tasks into smooth workflows, this is the place to start your career!

What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Deal)

  • Keep Automations Running: Help monitor, run, and support the daily automations built by our Functional Process Improvement (FPI) team.

  • Troubleshoot & Fix: When an automated script hits a snag, you’ll be on the front line helping to debug and resolve simple issues.

  • Build Simple Automations: Work on basic Excel macros, scripts, and workflows (using tools like VBA, Alteryx, Python, or SAP GUI) to save time for the team.

  • Process Documentation: Map out existing workflows and write clear, easy-to-follow documentation for new process improvements.

  • Team & System Support: Handle administrative tasks within our FPI tools and help colleagues clean up templates and data.

  • Learn & Grow: Participate in workshops, online trainings, and team updates to build your technical and business skill set.

What We’re Looking For

  • Student Status: Active BSc/MSc studies in Business, Finance, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Tech Curiosity: A real interest in process optimization, digital tools, and automation.

  • Problem-Solving Mindset: You enjoy digging into data, logical thinking, and figuring out why something isn't working.

  • Language Skills: Confident English communication (both written and spoken).

  • The Extras (Nice to Have, Not Required):

    • Basic finance or accounting knowledge.

    • Any previous exposure to VBA, Python, Alteryx, or SAP scripting (even from university projects or self-learning!).

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Mentorship: You won't be left alone—you’ll work directly alongside experienced pros who are ready to guide and train you.

  • Practical Experience: Move beyond theory and gain resume-building experience with enterprise tools.

job.title: Head of Commercial Innovation
job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount (a Skydance corporation) means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. 

 

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.    

 

 

 

We now have a LEAVE COVER role available in our Sydney team for an experienced leader in digital marketing, ad technology or commercial strategy within media or advertising.  

 

Purpose of the role: 

 

The Head of Commercial Innovation is responsible for delivering Paramount ANZ’s streaming innovation strategy and roadmap in line with the Commercial Strategy, bridging Paramount’s global capabilities with the local business requirements to mobilise and operationalise new commercial solutions that drive advertising revenue and business growth.  The role owns the advertising innovation narrative, both internally and externally, advocating and influencing stakeholders across the business whilst positioning Paramount ANZ as a recognised authority and leader in emerging trends, to ensure the organisation remains at the forefront of advertising innovation.    

 

Functions will include:  

  

Strategic Leadership 

  • Defining and delivering Paramount ANZs Digital Innovation Strategy and Roadmap, setting and tracking KKPIs to measure success
  • Providing strategic oversight of Innovation Initiatives against the Commercial strategy
  • Collaborating with VP Sales, National Digital Sales Director and Head of Commercial Data to ensure strategic alignment and delivery of the commercial strategy
  • Championing innovation for the Australian business, bridging Paramount’s global capabilities and innovation requirements with the local business and market relevance
  • Acting as an authority on emerging trends and technology across the streaming landscape
  • Owning the strategic direction of vendor and partner relationships
  • Representing the Commercial Innovation agenda at a leadership and forum level 

Cross-functional leadership and delivery 

  • Leading the delivery of strategic initiatives within the Innovation Roadmap, mobilising cross-functional teams to deliver on key requirements
  • Overseeing delivery of the Premium Ads Growth Strategy
  • Leading the development and execution of the Innovation Sales Strategy 

 Commercial performance and governance 

  • Overseeing commercial adoption of innovation solutions and measuring business impact
  • Assessing the success of Innovation Initiatives in line with KPIs
  • Evaluating commercial impact, scalability and alignment with transformation goals
  • Leveraging insights to refine innovation strategy and identify new opportunities 

People management 

  • Leading the Commercial Innovation team fostering a culture of curiosity, experimentation and constant learning
  • Coaching the team to grow capability, setting clear goals and giving them ownership to deliver against them
  • Creating clear pathways for the team to move fast, cutting through complexity, unblocking challenges and supporting new ideas to streamline processes and improve delivery 

 

What are we looking for in the Head of Commercial Innovation?  

  

  • 10+ years of experience working in digital marketing, ad technology, or commercial strategy roles within media or advertising. 
  • Deep understanding of digital media, programmatic, and streaming landscapes including ad technology vendors, emerging technologies, and sales/client environments. 
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including setting performance goals and building team capability. 
  • Experience executing strategic initiatives and influencing outcomes across multiple departments or business units.  
  • Experience in project and/or product management to bring new solutions and capability to market. 
  • Experience in strategic partnership development and management, including commercial negotiations, ensuring partnerships deliver long-term commercial value. 
  • Outstanding communication, presentation and influencing skills
  • Demonstrable creative problem-solving at a leadership level with the ability to prioritise and lead multiple concurrent strategic workstreams

Sitting within the vibrant, agile-focused EMEA HR Operations function, the HR Co-Ordinator, based in Poland, is the first point of contact for HR queries and plays a key role in supporting the efficient delivery of HR services to the business and wider People team. As part of the EMEA HR Operations Team, you will provide administrative and coordination support across the full employee lifecycle to employees predominantly in Poland, as well as Hungary, Czech Republic and Germany, ensuring a smooth and positive employee experience.

 

Working within a busy and fast-paced environment, you will manage day-to-day HR queries through our ticketing system, ensuring requests are handled promptly and within agreed service levels. You will support core HR processes such as onboarding, offboarding, and employee changes, while maintaining accurate employee records and data across HR systems.

 

As part of a team going through an exciting period of change, you will help shape the ongoing improvement of HR processes by spotting opportunities to enhance efficiency and service delivery. This role offers great exposure to a wide range of HR activities and is an excellent opportunity to build a strong foundation in HR operations.

 

What will you do:

  • Be the first point of contact for HR queries from employees and managers across Poland and the wider EMEA region via the AskHR Salesforce ticketing system,
  • Deliver a high-quality employee experience by responding within agreed SLAs and ensure effective queries resolution or, where needed, escalating to the relevant specialist team,

  • Manage data change tickets and job requisition requests in line with internal process, partnering with HRBPs, Compensation, Finance, and the HR Data Team to ensure accurate and timely processing,
  • Contribute to accurate HR data through regular reporting, data validation, and system updates, partnering with the HR Data team on regular data audits,

job.title: Lead Data Scientist
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG)! DIG is a key connector across the Paramount Streaming verticals. Our group is made up of subject matter experts who prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products. We also assess, aggregate, and analyze data, and we shape both qualitative and quantitative stories and insights. In short, we give our stakeholders decision support, clear performance views, and recommendations that help the business grow!

 

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Lead Data Scientist reports to the Senior Director of Data Science. You'll support a wide range of projects, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives, and Finance. This role calls for a solid analytical foundation, real curiosity about subscriber behavior, and the skill to run careful analysis that feeds straight into strategy!

 

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, communicates clearly, and has hands-on experience (or eagerness to grow) in causal inference and experimentation.

 

This role supports two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to grow it?
  2. How do our optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey affect the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Run causal inference analyses (e.g., diff-in-diff, matching, uplift modeling) under the Sr. Director's guidance. You'll find which subscriber behaviors truly drive retention and long-term value, while correcting for known biases in streaming data.
  • Help map the subscriber journey to pinpoint where lifecycle, product, pricing, and promo levers have the most impact.
  • Help design, set up, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, win-back), including power analysis, monitoring, and read-outs.
  • Build and maintain reporting and models that turn journey optimization into ARPU, survival, and LTV metrics for stakeholders.
  • Own the SQL/Python data pulls, cleaning, and analysis pipelines behind the team's causal and LTV modeling.
  • Prepare clear, well-organized presentations and summaries of your findings for stakeholders.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Product Analytics to check data quality and fix issues in our experimentation and behavioral data pipelines.
  • Stay current on causal inference and experimentation best practices and help promote sound methods across the team.
  • Mentor junior analysts on SQL, statistical methods, and analytical best practices as the team grows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related).
  • 5+ years in data science/analytics, with hands-on use of causal inference or experimentation methods (e.g., A/B testing, diff-in-diff, propensity score matching) — not just predictive modeling.
  • Experience designing or analyzing A/B tests, including an understanding of common pitfalls (novelty effects, selection bias, sample ratio mismatch).
  • Solid SQL skills and proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis.
  • Experience working with or building LTV, survival, or churn-related metrics.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to turn analytical results into clear takeaways for non-technical stakeholders.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience in subscription/DTC streaming, media, or another subscription business (e.g., SaaS, telecom).
  • Familiarity with subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Exposure to advanced causal techniques (e.g., instrumental variables, double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

The Role
We are looking for a Lead DevOps Engineer to join our Applied Intelligence Personalization team. You'll build and maintain scalable, low-latency infrastructure that powers personalization and engagement across Paramount's streaming platforms. Our workloads include real-time machine-learning inference, event-driven messaging, and high-traffic backend services — so deep Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud-infrastructure expertise is the core of the role, with ML-serving experience as a solid plus.

The ideal candidate has 4+ years of production DevOps / SRE experience, is fluent in Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, and cares deeply about reliability, latency, and developer velocity.

Your Day-to-Day
- Design, implement, and manage scalable and reliable Kubernetes-based infrastructure for personalization services.
- Build and own CI/CD pipelines that ship services (and ML models) to production safely — canary, rollback, progressive delivery.
- Stand up observability and monitoring with Prometheus, New Relic, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana; define SLIs / SLOs and drive error-budget discipline.
- Ensure high availability, security, and performance of production APIs and streaming data pipelines.
- Partner with application, data, and ML engineers to integrate their workloads smoothly into the platform.
- Implement autoscaling strategies (HPA, KEDA, traffic-driven) for variable, bursty traffic patterns.
- Manage Pub/Sub and event-driven architectures for real-time messaging, engagement analytics, and inter-service communication.
- Optimize hot-path services using Redis, Memcached, and other caching strategies.
- Debug and tackle production issues around latency, scaling, and reliability.

Key Projects
- Build and optimize real-time serving infrastructure for personalization and engagement (including ML-inference workloads).
- Develop scalable, secure CI/CD pipelines for deploying services and ML models.
- Implement log aggregation and monitoring solutions for platform-wide observability.
- Optimize Kubernetes-based serving for minimal latency and efficient resource utilization.
- Improve A/B testing infrastructure to track the impact of personalized experiences.
- Enhance streaming data pipelines to support real-time data consumers.

Basic Qualifications
- 4+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure Engineering.
- Solid experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
- Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and ArgoCD.
- Deep knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, or Azure.
- Expertise in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Helm.
- Experience with message queues and event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka, etc.).
- Proficiency in monitoring and logging solutions (New Relic, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
- Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go for automation.
- Track record of owning production reliability — SLIs / SLOs, incident response, postmortems.

Preferred / Additional Qualifications
- Experience deploying and operating ML models in production (TF Serving, Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve).

- GPU / accelerator scheduling and node-pool management on Kubernetes.
- Knowledge with load balancing, API gateways, and caching strategies at scale.
- Experience with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation infrastructure.
- Experience optimizing low-latency microservices for personalization or recommendation workloads.
- Passion for building and maintaining high-performance infrastructure for real-time applications.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

ML Platform Lead Engineer, Training & Inference
Organization: Applied Machine Learning Group (AMLG) → ML Platform
Level: Lead / Senior Lead (IC4–IC5)

 

Overview 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Lead ML Platform Engineer to architect and own the technical direction for our Training and Inference infrastructure. This is a high-leverage role designed for an expert who understands the deep technical stack required to shift ML models from research to global production. You will be responsible for the "engine room" of the AMLG, ensuring that our MLEs can train massive models efficiently and serve them with sub-millisecond reliability. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems and hardware acceleration. You will lead the adoption and optimization of AnyScale (Ray) for distributed training and manage a high-performance Kubernetes-based inference environment. You aren't just managing clusters; you are building a seamless, scalable platform that abstracts the complexity of GPUs and distributed compute for the entire organization.

Why This Role Matters

The ML Platform Lead is the force-multiplier for every other ML pod. In this role, you will directly shape:

The Training Foundation: Establishing AnyScale/Ray as the standard for distributed compute, enabling MLEs to train models on petabytes of data without managing infrastructure.
Inference at Scale: Architecting the serving layer that handles billions of requests per day, optimizing for both p99 latency and GPU utilization.
Operational Excellence: Setting the organizational standards for how ML models are deployed, monitored, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Roadmap & Strategy: Own the long-term architectural direction for the Training and Inference domains, ensuring the platform scales 10x over a 1–3 year horizon.
Distributed Training Leadership: Lead the implementation and optimization of Ray/AnyScale, providing a unified compute layer for batch processing, model training, and reinforcement learning.
High-Performance Inference: Design and maintain K8s-based inference servers (e.g., Triton, TorchServe, or vLLM) optimized for GPU memory management and high throughput.
Hardware & Cost Optimization: Navigate the trade-offs between different GPU instances (A100s, H100s, T4s), optimizing for cost, availability, and performance.
Cross-Team Standardization: Solve high-leverage problems that affect multiple pods (e.g., Entry, Session, Presentation), establishing reusable patterns for CI/CD, model versioning, and canary deployments.
Reliability Engineering: Define and enforce SLIs/SLOs for the platform, ensuring that infrastructure failures never interrupt the user-facing personalization experience.
Mentorship & Coaching: Act as a technical mentor to senior engineers across the ML Platform and Applied ML pods, raising the bar for system design and operational rigor.

Basic Qualifications

6-8+ years of experience in ML Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or high-scale Backend Engineering.
Orchestration & Serving: Extensive experience with Kubernetes (K8s) and serving frameworks for large-scale ML models.
Hardware Proficiency: Strong knowledge of GPU architecture, CUDA, and optimizing ML workloads for hardware acceleration.
Leadership (IC4/5): Proven track record of owning the technical direction for a major domain anddriving impact across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Infra-as-Code (Terraform/Pulumi) and building automated MLOps pipelines.
Distributed Systems Mastery: Deep expertise with Ray (AnyScale) or similar distributed compute frameworks.
Familiarity with ML observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Weights & Biases, or MLFlow).
Experience managing multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud ML environments.
Deep knowledge of Python and C++ for performance-critical systems.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you will:

Unify the Compute Layer: Successfully transition the majority of AMLG training workloads to a governed AnyScale/Ray environment.
Optimize Inference ROI: Measurably improve GPU utilization and reduce inference costs through better auto-scaling and server optimization.
Establish Durable Standards: Author the "Gold Standard" for ML deployments that is adopted by at least three other pods in the organization.
Reduce Systemic Risk: Implement a self-healing infrastructure layer that significantly reduces manual intervention for cluster-related failures.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer
Personalization & Recommendation Systems


Overview
We’re hiring a Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational excellence, observability, reliability, and governance layer around our personalization and recommendation ML systems. 

Our recommendation models retrain and deploy frequently. You will define how we detect model behavior changes, diagnose issues quickly, and prevent bad deployments from reaching customers.


This is a lead-level IC role: you’ll set technical direction and drive adoption across ML Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, and Product.


Sitting within ML Platform and Infrastructure, you’ll partner closely with ML engineers who own model development. You’re not expected to build infrastructure from scratch, but you’ll define what good looks like, evaluate tooling, and own the day-to-day operational layer.


What You’ll Do

Own ML production reliability strategy

  • Define and lead the operational strategy for production ML systems, including monitoring, traceability, deployment safety, incident response, and post-deployment validation.

  • Set the standards ML teams use to assess model health, performance, and trustworthiness in production.

Own model traceability and governance

  • Ensure every production model has clear lineage (data, features, code, artifacts, validation, deployment history) and drive adoption of model registry and metadata tooling across ML teams.

Build end-to-end ML observability

  • Design and implement monitoring across the full ML signal path: data arrival, feature freshness, distribution stability, candidate generation, ranking behavior, model metrics, serving latency, and SLA performance.

Define production health metrics

  • Partner with ML, data, product, and business stakeholders to define post-deployment metrics covering model quality, system reliability, business guardrails, and degradation indicators.

Detect drift and degradation proactively

  • Detect data drift, feature drift, model behavior changes, and silent failures before they impact customers via thresholding, alerting, anomaly detection, and release-over-release monitoring.

Lead diagnostic tooling and root-cause analysis

  • Build dashboards, logs, and diagnostic workflows that progress quickly from “recommendations look off” to root cause, with context captured across candidates, features, scores, ranking decisions, and downstream outcomes.

Own ML deployment safety

  • Define and operate automated gates that prevent bad models or bad data from being promoted to production. Partner with MLEs to establish validation checks, rollback criteria, canary strategies, shadow testing, and release health reviews.

Lead ML incident response

  • Own incident response practices for ML systems, including rollback playbooks, hotfix strategies, severity definitions, tradeoff frameworks, communications, and post-mortems. Drive closure of systemic gaps after incidents rather than only resolving the immediate issue.

Partner across ML Platform, Data, and ML

  • Partner with DevOps/Platform on infrastructure and observability needs; with Data Engineering on data quality, drift, and freshness; and with ML Engineering to embed operational requirements into development and deployment workflows.

Set standards and mentor others

  • Act as the technical lead for ML operations: establish reusable patterns, playbooks, and standards, and mentor engineers on reliability, observability, and operational rigor.


Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, ML platform, applied ML, MLOps, data platform, reliability engineering, or a related technical role.

  • Demonstrated experience operating production ML systems, including monitoring, deployment, incident response, model validation, data quality, or reliability ownership.

  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams, especially where success required influencing architecture, tooling, standards, or adoption.

  • Hands-on experience with model registries, feature stores, ML metadata systems, production monitoring, model deployment pipelines, or ML observability platforms.

  • Solid knowledge of end-to-end ML systems, including training data, features, model artifacts, offline validation, online serving, post-deployment metrics, and business outcome measurement.

  • Ability to reason about ML operational failure modes: stale features, distribution shift, training-serving skew, delayed labels, and offline-online metric gaps.

  • Solid SQL skills and comfort investigating data quality, feature distributions, model outputs, pipeline behavior, and production anomalies.

  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration with Platform, Data, and ML Engineering to deliver production-grade operational capabilities.

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain ML system health, risks, incidents, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation, personalization, ranking, search, ads, content discovery, or marketplace ML systems at scale.

  • Experience with real-time or near-real-time model serving systems.

  • Experience with feature stores, model registries, metadata stores, experiment tracking, data quality tools, lineage systems, or observability platforms.

  • Experience designing automated validation gates, canary deployments, rollback strategies, shadow deployments, or progressive delivery workflows for ML systems.

  • Experience with A/B testing, experiment guardrails, counterfactual evaluation, or offline-to-online metric alignment.

  • Experience with cloud-native production environments, distributed data pipelines, orchestration frameworks, or streaming systems.

  • Experience leading incident reviews, post-mortems, reliability programs, or operational excellence initiatives.

  • Experience defining standards, playbooks, or governance frameworks for production ML systems.


What Success Looks Like

  • Within the first 90 days, you will have assessed the current production ML operational landscape, identified the highest-risk gaps, and established a prioritized roadmap for observability, traceability, deployment safety, and incident response.

  • Within six months, our production recommendation systems will have clearer model lineage, stronger monitoring coverage, better diagnostic workflows, and more reliable deployment gates.

  • Within one year, ML operations will be a repeatable, trusted function: teams will know what is running, why it was promoted, how it is performing, when something is wrong, and how to recover quickly.

 

Leveling Signal
The right candidate defines strategy, leads cross-functional execution, and sets engineering standards while staying hands-on enough to investigate production issues directly.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

As the Lead Live Event Technology Engineer, you will own the technical escalation function for Paramount+'s global Live Event Operations team, setting the standard for how Tier-1 live streaming events are supported, diagnosed, and recovered. You are the senior technical authority when a high-profile broadcast is at risk, and the person who makes sure the same problem doesn't happen twice.

 This role goes beyond resolving incidents. You will lead technical investigations across the end-to-end live streaming ecosystem (acquisition, encoding, packaging, delivery, playback, advertising, and platform integrations), direct cross-functional response with Engineering, Product, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and distribution partners, and drive the systemic improvements that raise the reliability bar for the entire platform. You will also mentor and develop engineers and operators, shape operational standards, and influence the roadmap for live streaming tooling, monitoring, and architecture.

 ---

 ## Key Responsibilities

 **Technical leadership and escalation**
 - Serve as the senior technical escalation authority for the Live Event Operations team during Tier-1 live events, making high-stakes mitigation calls in real time.
 - Lead technical bridge calls during critical incidents, directing engineers and partners, communicating impact and recovery status to leadership, and owning the decision path through resolution.
 - Guide Live Event Operators during event execution, validating mitigation actions and building their technical judgment over time.

 **Deep technical investigation**
 - Diagnose complex, service-impacting issues across contribution feeds, cloud encoding, packaging, DRM, origin, CDN delivery, playback, and client applications.
 - Perform detailed analysis using streaming manifests, player logs, encoder metrics, QoS/QoE analytics, SCTE-35 signaling, transport stream analysis, and cloud monitoring tools.

 **Reliability and continuous improvement**
 - Own the post-event RCA program: run root cause reviews, identify systemic and recurring failure patterns, and drive corrective actions to completion with Engineering and Product.
 - Define and lead pre-event readiness standards, including technical validation, redundancy verification, workflow testing, and production readiness reviews for major events.
 - Partner with Engineering and Product to shape architecture, failover strategy, and observability improvements based on what live events reveal.

 **Vendor and partner ownership**
 - Manage technical relationships with CDN providers, cloud vendors, and distribution partners, including escalation paths, performance expectations, and issue resolution.
 - Lead evaluation, certification, onboarding, and production rollout of new streaming technologies, cloud workflows, monitoring tools, and vendor integrations.

 **Team and operational excellence**
 - Mentor and coach engineers and operators; raise the technical depth of the broader Live Event Operations team.
 - Establish and maintain troubleshooting documentation, operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and knowledge base content that scale beyond any one person.
 - Participate in and help shape the on-call rotation supporting global live streaming operations and high-severity production incidents.

Additional Day to day:
●    Quality Assurance workflows across a suite of back-end and front-end frameworks
●    Other video QA and software engineers to build, test, and release these video platforms●    Automation testing across the whole end-to-end video lifecycle, including acquisition, processing, delivery and playback. 
●    Development and maintenance of internal automated QA systems, ensuring that QA testing is seamlessly integrated with continuous integration and deployment strategies
●    Define and develop useful metrics and alerts for monitoring live streaming events and proactively identify reliability risks.
●    Mentor and guide engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and technical excellence.
●    Working with internal services to increase automation of the QA workflow. 
 ---

 ## Required Qualifications

 - 8+ years supporting large-scale live streaming, OTT platforms, broadcast technology, or video delivery systems, with a track record of technical leadership.

job.description:

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, and we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is…YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team that values authenticity and embraces inclusion for all. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees. You fuel our culture of purpose, passion, and collaboration. We’re in this together.

Job Posting Title: Lead Software Engineer, CBS Sports Digital
Department: CBS Sports.com Technology
Location: Louisville, Kentucky; Nashville, Tennessee; Fort Lauderdale, Florida; 


Lead Software Engineer, Solutions Team - CBSSports

Join CBS Digital  and shape the future of sports & news  media through cutting-edge AI-powered content and deeply personalized fan experiences across mobile, web, and digital platforms. We are seeking a Lead Software Engineer to be a core member of our Content Management team. 


What You Will Do
●    Implement AI Features: Implement and assist in the architecture of advanced Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to power intelligent recommendations and dynamic user personalization.
●    Drive Development: Drive the rapid prototyping and full-cycle development of production-grade features for mobile and web applications.
●    Contribute to Standards: Promote and adhere to scalable platform standards, engineering patterns, and reusable components across the organization.
●    Collaborate and Prototype: Work closely within a small engineering group, partnering with design and product teams to rapidly design, develop, and prototype solutions to key business challenges.
●    Utilize AI: Utilize AI development tools to optimize your workflow and promote the use of AI-driven development practices across the team.
●    Operational Excellence: Implement solutions with scalability and reliability in mind, incorporating appropriate testing, monitoring, and alerting.
●    Mentor and Document: Contribute to clear documentation and diagrams to facilitate easy onboarding for other engineers and support teams. Review code to ensure adherence to best practices (style, testability, efficiency).
●    Monorepo Tooling: Utilize and contribute to the evolution of monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web and mobile applications.
●    Type Safety & Standards: Adhere to and contribute to the evolution of TypeScript and typing standards (e.g., strict mode, shared types, codegen) so that codebases stay maintainable, type-safe end to end, and refactor-safe.


Required Qualifications
●    Experience in AI:  Experience or familiarity with Generative AI and RAG architectures.
●    Platform Experience: Experience contributing to scalable platform products and adhering to cross-team engineering standards.
●    Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
●    Browser & Performance: Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).
●    Monorepo Experience: Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages, task pipelines, and cross-project dependencies.
●    Education & Experience: BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
●    7+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js) and Node.js.
●    Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and advanced ES6+ features.
●    Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.
●    Experience consuming and designing APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client and microservices-based architectures.
●    Proven experience modeling complex data flows for transactional and integration workflows.
●    Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or OCI) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
●    Familiarity with distributed systems concepts including caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
●    Experience designing and developing highly scalable, high-performance applications.
●    Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including use of monitoring/observability tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, New Relic).
●    Soft Skills: Able to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex code problems. Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.


Preferred Qualifications

●    Exposure to popular proprietary or open-source CMS systems such as Wordpress, Drupal, Joomla, Magento
●    1+ years experience with one or more vector databases (e.g., TurboPuffer, Mongo Atlas).
●    Cloud Focus: 3+ years experience working with Cloud technologies (AWS is strongly preferred).
●    Frontend Skills: React/Next.js experience with fundamental HTML/CSS (layout, specificity, cross-browser compatibility).
●    Collaboration: Proven experience in cross-team collaboration for requirements, implementation, and testing.
●    Certifications: Cloud certifications (GCP, AWS, OCI).
●    AI Tooling & Standards: Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails—rules, commands, skills, sub-agents—to keep AI-generated code clean, consistent, and production-ready.
●    Theming & Styling:  Experience with multiple styling approaches (Stylex, CSS Modules, SASS, CSS-in-JS) and design tokens in component libraries or design system.

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. Lead Product Designer, CBS Sports App

Discipline: Design | Team Model: Embedded on a cross-functional CBS Sports App squad

Location: New York, NY

 

The Mission

CBS Sports is the digital stadium for millions of fans. We hold the rights to the biggest moments in sports—NFL, UEFA Champions League, March Madness, the Masters, and UFC. We aren't just a scoreboard; we’re a massive content engine of fantasy leagues, live video, and deep journalism. We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join a small, cross-functional squad that operates with the speed of a startup and the scale of a legacy giant.

 

The Role: Build and Own

You won’t just work on a product; you’ll own the design outcomes from first framing through ship. We believe in a builder culture where designers aren't waiting for handoffs or research gates. You will:

  • Own the Project: Take full responsibility for your product squad’s design outcomes. You lead the direction from initial concept to the final shipped experience.

  • Build Constantly: Prototype early and often. We use AI tools (like Cursor or Claude) to visualize ideas and test interactions before they hit engineering, letting us move faster than ever.

  • Lead with Visual Craft: We need designers who bring energy, taste, and dynamic design sensibilities. Whether it’s motion that obeys physics or layouts that capture the intensity of game day, your work should set the bar for the squad.

  • Shape the Product: You’ll trade honest, real-time feedback with engineers and PMs. We don't just "deliver" designs; we shape products in the build.

 

Core Capabilities

  • Visual Design: You have a refined eye for type hierarchy, layouts, and intuitive UI/UX. You deliver high-impact, immersive designs for complex app systems that capture the intensity of game day and live sports.

  • Motion & Interactivity: You understand motion as a logical system. Your designs feel tactile, precise, and alive.

  • Fluency in Native Design: You have deep experience with mobile paradigms (iOS/Android). You know how to leverage native capabilities to elevate the user experience.

  • Owner Mindset: You treat research as a velocity tool, not a gate. You use your intuition, analytics, and direct fan feedback to make smart product decisions quickly.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience.

  • A portfolio showing shipped consumer work on mobile apps or web (required).

  • Comfort moving across prototyping, production, and interaction design without handoffs.

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Passion for sports, betting, live events, or broadcast media.

  • Experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows.

  • Contributions to a design system.
