job.title: Legal Intern
job.description:
Paramount is a global media and entertainment organisation with some of the best known and loved brands in the world. In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   
 
We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free all these great shows (and more) on 10 as well as 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, and a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV, known as FAST channels, as well as our subscription video on demand service, Paramount+.    

 

 

Paramount is looking for a motivated Legal Intern who is available at least 2 days per week for an unpaid practical legal training placement with a potential progression to a paid paralegal role.  As a Legal Intern you will gain valuable legal and media industry experience as part of our energetic and professional in-house legal team in an evolving media landscape. 
  
What you’ll do as a Legal Intern:  
  
As a Legal Intern you will assist the legal team in a broad range of commercial, programming, IT, digital and operations matters. This will involve contract reviews and negotiation, legal research, precedent development and providing advice and support to the business. 
 
This role would ideally suit a law student in their penultimate or final year of study, needing to satisfy the required quota of practical legal training. The role is accommodating of university assignments and exams timetables. 

What are we looking for in a Legal Intern? What’s important?   
  
•    Ability to understand, review and draft a wide variety of contracts 
•    Ability to undertake varied and complex research and/or analytical tasks 
•    Exceptional attention to detail 
•    Skilled, effective and professional interpersonal, written and communication skills  
•    Ability to adapt to and communicate with various types of people internally and externally 
•    Sound time management skills and the ability to perform a variety of tasks 
•    Proficient computer skills 
•    Ability to work collaboratively and effectively as a team member 
•    High level of motivation and ability to take initiative 
•    Ability to take direction  
 
Extra points for the following, but not necessarily required:   
  
•    Completion of one or more of the following university subjects: intellectual property law, media law and entertainment law 
•    Strong grades in other relevant subjects, such as contract law 
•    Experience working in a law firm or in-house legal environment 
•    Strong interest in media especially entertainment media 
•    Familiarity with digital media and content services available in the Australian market 


If you are interested in this wonderful opportunity, please upload all three of the following documents when you apply. 

1.    a cover letter detailing why you are interested in the role, relevant study, qualifications and/or experience and why you are suitable for the role; 
2.    your CV; and 
3.    a copy of your university academic transcript.

 

Please indicate, in your covering letter, whether you have used artificial intelligence to assist you in the preparation of your covering letter, CV or academic transcript.


 

 

Paramount embraces differences and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds regardless of factors such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property or birth. These grounds also include age, nationality, marital status, disability, place of residence and sexual orientation.  

We’re honoured to have been named on Diversity Council Australia’s annual list of Inclusive Employers in 2023-24 and 2024-25. This acknowledgement highlights our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and supported. 

Paramount acknowledges Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as Australia's original storytellers and the first peoples of the lands where we create, broadcast and connect. We pay our respects to their timeless stories that continue to shape Country and culture.

The CBS Stations' Local Ad Sales team is responsible for driving all local revenue growth across all Paramount Global streaming & digital assets, as well as the 27 owned & operated CBS Television Stations. This team collaborates across Paramount Global and CBS Stations divisions, providing thought leadership that drives the local sales GTM strategy, innovation opportunities, training & development, and revenue generation.


Position Overview:


We are looking for exceptional candidates for the Manager, Account Management role, who will train and develop Account Managers to drive client and campaign excellence across our portfolio of digital & streaming assets, inclusive of Paramount+, CBS, Pluto TV, and more. The candidate will also work closely and collaborate with sales teams, clients, and internal Paramount teams.


Role Details:

 

The Manager, Account Management sits between individual-contributor account management and regional sales leadership, providing the day-to-day client and campaign management, coaching, and quality control that the Account Manager team needs to deliver sales performance. While the Account Managers roll up into their Directors, the Manager, Account Management works in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) and Local Sales Management to translate revenue goals and priorities into clear direction for the team.

 

The Manager, Account Management, will work directly with Account Managers on account sales strategy, campaign specifics, and client escalations. This role is also the primary point of contact for the internal teams that power local sales delivery -- including Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, and Ad Systems -- building and maintaining the workflows the Local team relies on to execute successfully. The ideal candidate is a proactive, organized communicator who is energized by developing people, driving excellence, and building a strong culture.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Directly develop the Account Manager team, including workload distribution, coaching, and sales performance feedback
  • Work in tandem with the Regional Digital Sales Director(s) to lead the Account Manager team through the full sales cycle for all clients
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Data, Ad Operations, Yield, Marketing, Research, Ad Systems, and other internal teams to deliver the best-in-class client experience
  • Partner with Directors and Sales Leadership to ensure Account Managers have the tools, training, and support needed to execute digital & streaming campaigns and become a future account executive
  • Identify workflow gaps between Local Sales and internal partner teams, and drive process improvements that drive revenue growth
  • Report team & client performance, and development progress to the Regional Digital Sales Director

 

Qualifications:
What you bring to the team:

 

You have:

  • 3+ years of experience in advertising/media account management, sales or sales support, with digital, streaming and/or linear experience preferred
  • Prior experience mentoring, training, or informally leading other account management or sales staff
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams (e.g. Ad Operations, Yield, Data, Marketing, Research) to solve workflow and process challenges on behalf of the sales team
  • Excels in communication, organizational and time management
  • Team-first mentality
  • Dedicated and driven work ethic

 

You might also have:

  • BS / BA degree preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • Understanding of the following applications is a plus: Salesforce, Operative, GAM, Google Analytics, FreeWheel, WideOrbit, Google Suite or other web related applications

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

We are seeking a highly skilled and proficient Manager, Application Security and Compliance to lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of our Oracle Fusion and Oracle EPM security architecture. In this role, you will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for application security and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance across our enterprise systems. You will be in charge of ensuring strict Segregation of Duties (SoD), managing user access governance, and mitigating risk across Oracle Fusion (ERP, Procurement, and HCM), Oracle EPM, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical expertise in Oracle Identity and Access Management (IAM) and a deep knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGC) and compliance frameworks.


Responsibilities:

 

  • Security Architecture and Role Management Design and Maintenance: Create custom job roles and duty roles. Keep data security policies updated in Oracle Fusion (ERP, Procurement, HCM), Oracle EPM, and FDI environments.

  • Access Governance: Oversee user access reviews and certification campaigns, with an opportunity to leverage Oracle Access Governance for automated provisioning and analytics.

  • Compliance & Risk Management SOX Compliance: Ensure all Oracle environments strictly adhere to SOX compliance, ITGCs, and internal security policies.

  • Risk Mitigation: Implement, configure, and manage Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud (Advanced Access Controls and Advanced Financial Controls) to continuously monitor and uphold Segregation of Duties (SoD).

  • Audit Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors, providing necessary reports, evidence, and system walkthroughs.

  • Remediation: Identify security vulnerabilities or SoD conflicts and proactively design and execute remediation plans.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Accounting Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience specializing in Oracle Application Security and IT Audit/Compliance. Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, COSO framework, and IT General Controls (ITGC).

  • Oracle Fusion Expertise: Proven experience designing and maintaining complex security roles across Oracle Fusion ERP, Procurement, and HCM.

  • Oracle EPM Security: Hands-on experience managing security matrices and user access within Oracle Enterprise Performance Management.

  • Oracle IAM: Sound knowledge and deep hands-on experience with Oracle Identity and Access Management frameworks.

  • Risk Management Cloud: Direct implementation experience with Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud (AAC/AFC) for SoD and transaction monitoring.

  • OIC Knowledge: Clear comprehension of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) roles, privileges, and integration security.



Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Hands-on expertise or certification in Oracle Access Governance.

  • Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or Oracle Certified Security Specialist).

  • Great communication skills. Ability to explain complex technical security concepts in simple terms for business compliance requirements.

  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • Ability to collaborate successfully with cross-functional teams, including Finance, HR, IT, and Internal Audit.

job.description:

Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

The Manager, Brand Marketing & Global Events will support the development, planning, and execution of consumer-facing events and experiential marketing programs across Paramount Streaming, including Paramount+ and Pluto TV. This role will play a key part in bringing our brands, content, sports partnerships, and fan experiences to life through strategic activations that drive awareness, engagement, and fandom among audiences worldwide.   This position will lead daily planning and execution of various activities, both domestic and international. It will play a key role in coordinating different functions. This includes planning operations, communicating with stakeholders, and carrying out on-site tasks. Key initiatives may include major sponsorships, fan conventions, festivals, premieres, and brand experiences, including programs such as Formula 1, CCXP Mexico, CCXP Brazil, and other strategic events throughout the year.   The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, detail-oriented, and thrives in a dynamic environment. They are equally comfortable managing logistics and timelines as they are contributing ideas, solving problems, and partnering across a broad group of stakeholders to deliver extraordinary consumer experiences. They are forward-thinking, solutions-oriented, enthusiastic to learn, and enthusiastic about helping bring world-class entertainment and fan experiences to audiences around the globe.   This is an onsite position at our New York office.  

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead day-to-day planning and execution for global consumer activations, experiential programs, sponsorships, and live events across Paramount+ and Pluto TV.

  • Foster alignment between domestic and international teams to ensure activations are executed successfully while addressing regional market needs.
  • Contribute to activation strategy and planning by helping shape event concepts, consumer experiences, and engagement opportunities that support broader business and marketing goals.
  • Own project documentation, timelines, status reports, meeting recaps, and stakeholder updates.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and operational challenges, proactively recommending solutions and escalation paths when needed.
  • Support the development of presentations, planning materials, executive updates, and post-event recaps.
  • Track and organize activation performance metrics, attendee feedback, earned media results, partner reporting, and other key success indicators.
  • Lead post-event recap development and document key learnings and recommendations.
  • Support ongoing optimization efforts by identifying opportunities to improve processes, execution, and consumer impact across future activations.

  • 6+ years of experience in consumer activation, experiential marketing, live events, brand activations, or related fields.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Proven experience planning and executing large-scale consumer activations, festivals, conventions, experiential programs, or live events.
  • Robust project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Remarkable organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and project management tools.
  • Experience in entertainment, media, streaming, sports, or consumer brands.
  • Experience supporting international events or working with global stakeholders.
  • Awareness with fan conventions, experiential marketing, or live event production.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is a plus.
  • Experience working with Latin American markets and international stakeholders is preferred.
  • Affinity for entertainment, pop culture, sports, and consumer engagement.

job.title: Manager, Publicity - Germany
job.description:
Got a nose for a great story and the relationships to get it placed? Paramount+ is looking for a Publicity Manager to join our Direct-to-Consumer team in Berlin on a temporary contract for circa 1 year — helping bring our Originals to life across Germany, Switzerland, and Austria.

This is a fast-start opportunity for a publicity pro who wants to get straight into the action. You'll sit at the centre of campaigns from first announcement through premiere night: building media strategy, wrangling talent schedules, pulling off press days that actually land, and keeping a fast-moving campaign calendar on track. One day you're pitching a top entertainment journalist, the next you're briefing talent ahead of a junket, the next you're in the room with Marketing and Creative shaping how a show gets positioned in a crowded streaming market.

  • Executing publicity campaigns for Paramount+ Original series — scripted and unscripted

  • Coordinating talent availability, media appearances, and press events (including the occasional evening or weekend when a premiere calls for it)
  • Partnering across Marketing, Creative, Awards, and Events to keep campaigns joined-up
  • Tracking coverage and campaign performance so we know what's working

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in entertainment publicity for TV, streaming, or film
  • A working knowledge of the DACH media landscape — journalists, trades, podcasts, and platforms
  • Comfort managing talent relationships with professionalism and discretion
  • Confidence and experience supporting and leading several campaigns at once without dropping a ball

This is a chance to work on some of the biggest titles hitting Paramount+ in the region — with real ownership from day one, not just supporting someone else's plan. It's ideal if you're looking for immediate, high-impact experience at a major global streamer, want to build your network in entertainment publicity fast, or you're available now and ready to hit the ground running. job.title: Manager, Retail Development
job.description:
Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.

 

Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

 

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

 

Role Overview:

The Manager, Retail Development, Products & Experiences is in charge of executing retail and e-commerce strategies that drive sell-in of licensed merchandise across key retail partners. This role manages day-to-day relationships with Amazon, Costco and additionally coordinates all Canadian retailers.   This is an onsite position at our Los Angeles office.  

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage relationships with retail partners (Primarily Canadian retailers, Amazon and Costco) and licensees to drive sell-in and sell-through of licensed products across all major product categories including Toys, Sporting Goods, Apparel, Home, Accessories, Food & Beverage and Essentials & Beauty.
  • Execute retail and e-commerce strategies across category responsibilities, including Amazon vendor/marketplace programs and Costco roadshow and club placements
  • Be the account and retail expert across categories
  • Contribute to overall account long term planning and strategy
  • Monitor online detail-page content, search performance, and in-club retail performance to identify opportunities to increase sales and distribution
  • Partner with licensing category teams to support product launches and retail activations in partnership with licensees
  • Ensure brand consistency and compliance across all licensed products and retail placements, including digital shelf standards
  • Conduct virtual and in-person retail audits to ensure merchandising standards are met and identify new opportunities
  • Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitive activity across e-commerce and club channels
  • Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, category, franchise) to support campaigns

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in retail, e-commerce, licensing, consumer products, or business development
  • Bachelor's degree

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work individually with solid organizational skills, attention to detail and follow-up
  • Experience working with licensed brands or retail partnerships preferred
  • Deep knowledge of e-commerce and club retail environments and merchandising strategies
  • Exemplary relationship management and communication skills
  • Analytical mindset with experience using sales data to drive decisions
  • Working knowledge of entertainment, categories and/or retail industry ideally with in depth knowledge of Amazon, Costco or other major consumer products retailers

 

About Skydance
Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.

job.title: Manager, Technical Program Manager
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.


Brand/Division Overview:
We are the PMO at Paramount Streaming, that boasts unparalleled insight into transforming Agile Teams at Scale. Our program managers, release managers, project managers and scrum masters bring passion to iterative delivery and process while keeping our eyes on the goal and motivating one another to do the same! Our team blends program management, technical architecture, and engineering leadership to keep our platforms stable while continuously evolving them.


Role Details:
We're seeking a Manager, Technical Program Management who can operate as the subject matter expert on our technical architecture, working directly with engineers on implementation, risk, and scope, while coordinating across engineering, product, and business requests. This isn't a role that runs on status updates and timelines; it requires enough technical fluency to catch flawed scoping and surface dependencies before they become rework. This role also leads a team of Project Managers, responsible for their day-to-day workload, growth, and development, and ensuring the team's work stays aligned to architectural priorities.


Your Day-to-Day:
●    Serve as the subject matter expert on core technical architecture, working directly with engineers on how architectural changes get implemented, what they touch, and where they introduce risk.
●    Manage and develop a team of Project Managers, overseeing workload distribution, prioritization across their portfolios, and their growth as program/project managers.
●    Guide requirements-gathering on large architectural initiatives toward an agreed MVP, managing scope creep as multiple teams propose competing approaches.
●    Stand up and lead focused working groups (tiger teams) to execute isolated architectural changes without disrupting the broader platform.
●    Run and facilitate Architecture Intake, a standing forum with engineering leads across architecture and feature teams, reviewing new RFCs before they're committed to the roadmap.
●    Triage daily requests and escalations from feature teams across Paramount Streaming's platforms that depend on shared architecture systems, distinguishing routine asks from signals of deeper dependency issues.
●    Communicate program health, risk, and architectural roadmap status to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.


Basic Qualifications:
●    7+ years of technical program management experience in a complex, matrixed engineering organization, ideally supporting platform or architecture teams rather than feature delivery teams.
●    Prior experience managing or mentoring other program/project managers, with direct people-management responsibility (performance, growth, workload balancing).
●    Demonstrated ability to understand and reason about system architecture deeply enough to evaluate engineering estimates, scoping, and technical tradeoffs directly with engineers, not just track them.
●    Experience running structured technical review processes (e.g., architecture review boards, RFC processes) to drive cross-team alignment on technical direction.
●    Experience managing platform or infrastructure work with dependencies across multiple engineering teams and SRE.
●    Strong judgment on when to escalate, when to push back, and when to let engineering teams self-direct.
●    High proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and technical documentation; strong written and verbal communication with both engineers and leadership.
●    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
●    Familiarity with Next.js, Module Federation, micro-frontend architectures, or similar web platform technologies.
●    Experience in direct-to-consumer streaming, media, or high-traffic web platforms.
●    Background as a software engineer or technical lead prior to moving into program management.

job.title: Media Exchange Operator
job.description:
Paramount Skydance Corporation is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, Pluto TV, Network 10 (Australia) and Channel 5 (UK).   In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.   

 

 

We’re now looking for a Media Exchange Operator to join our busy Sydney station on a CASUAL basis, with hours and days varying depending on demand. 

 

What you’ll do as a Media Exchange Operator:

You’ll combine your strong attention to detail and technical skills to ingest and prepare media for News and Production, working closely with newsroom and production staff to keep media-based operations running smoothly. Working with state-of-the-art technology in a supportive, high-morale team, you’ll have the chance to expand your skills, collaborate across business units and engage in the power of content.

This is a place where variety is the norm, teamwork is strong, and learning opportunities are everywhere.

 

Functions will also include:

 

  • Ingesting media for News and Production, from local news gathering and production shoots to international satellite feeds.
  • Scheduling records for News and Production, ensuring media assets are readily available within our Media Asset Management system for all our internal production teams and newsroom.
  • Preparing and monitoring playout media for live studio News and Production, applying advanced workflow tools to track media through each stage of the process.
  • QC of News and Production media assets, ensuring technical standards are maintained.
  • Maintaining clear media metadata naming conventions and asset organisation within a vast media management system shared by a large number of users
  • Maintaining archival requirements, ensuring media assets are properly kept for future use.
  • Completing basic editing to prepare media for playout, or condense content where necessary.
  • Liaising with newsroom and production staff, the Network Operations Centre (NOC) and acquisitions crews, ensuring all broadcast items are ready for edit when required.
  • Distributing media to internal teams and external organisations, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.

 

What are we looking for in a Media Exchange Operator? What’s important?

•    You will need to be a highly motivated self-starter who can thrive in a deadline driven environment 
•    Have effective communication skills with strong customer service focus. 
•    High attention to detail.
•    Strong computer literacy and enjoy the use of new technology
•    Ability to learn and adapt to continuously evolving technology, practices and procedures. 
•    Can work within a 24/7 day rotating roster.

job.title: Multiplatform Ops Coordinator
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

For our Amsterdam office we are currently recruiting a full time (40 hours/week):

 

Multiplatform Operations Coordinator

 

Is this the role for you?

 

Behind every show that streams smoothly, on time, everywhere in the world, there’s a coordinator making sure it happens. Could that be you?

 

Paramount’s Global Fulfillment Operations team in Amsterdam is looking for a full time Multiplatform Operations Coordinator to join the crew. We get content ready and delivered to streaming and non linear platforms worldwide, so clients and colleagues around the globe are happy with content that lands exactly where it should, exactly when it should.

 

What will you be doing?

 

Your role:

  • Being the go to person for clients and stakeholders, keeping things clear, quick and helpful

  • Getting content prepared, processed, triaged and troubleshot so it’s ready to publish

  • Juggling lots of priorities without dropping quality or missing deadlines

  • Spotting issues early, fixing the simple ones yourself and knowing who to call for the rest

  • Keeping documentation, trackers and Jira tickets so tidy that anyone could pick up your work

  • Getting hands on with systems like What’sOn, PTS, VMS and other tools that keep content moving

  • Being part of a global, cross functional team, sharing ideas and helping us keep getting better

  • Jumping in on new launches, onboardings and workflow changes as we grow

 

What are we looking for?

 

You might be our new Multiplatform Operations Coordinator if you:

  • Are fluent in English (required), with any extra language as a bonus

  • Communicate clearly, directly and honestly, and treat everyone with respect

  • Are a proactive self starter who can manage your own workload

  • Are persistent and resourceful, and get things done

  • Have an eye for detail and a genuinely organised mind

  • Take deadlines seriously

  • Bring an open, positive attitude and love a new challenge

  • Are keen to learn new tools and technical skills

  • Are great with people, building real relationships across teams and cultures

  • Stay flexible when priorities change

  • Love media and entertainment and are curious about how it all comes together

 

Does this sound like you?

If this role has sparked your interest, we’d be delighted to hear your story. Send us your CV and a motivation letter telling us what attracts you to the role.

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.description:
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

In Australia, we deliver premium content on any screen, anytime, anywhere, via an enhanced viewing ecosystem.   We pride ourselves on creating content that gets people talking. What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.   

 

 

 

 

Our extraordinary Marketing team has an opportunity available for an experienced and energetic digital marketing specialist with a track record of digital marketing best practice, strategic delivery, segmentation, media agencies, marketing automation platforms and online channels.

 

This is a permanent full-time role that can be based in SYDNEY or BRISBANE.
 
Enough about us! What you’ll do as National Marketing Growth Manager:
 
Working closely with the National Marketing Director Broadcast & Digital you’ll be responsible for driving marketing growth and retention, customer engagement, and building a high performing, future-ready digital marketing team for the linear and digital television division of Paramount ANZ, including 10, 10’s streaming platform, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy, and Nickelodeon. You’ll have the opportunity to work on innovative and ‘world first’ digital activations, working with cross-functional teams to bring ideas to life. 
 
Functions will include: 
 

  • Leading digital acquisition strategies to grow our customer base and optimise cost per acquisition, developing strategies to grow active an addressable users, consumption, loyalty and advocacy with a plan for increasing our digital maturity
  • Working closely with Marketing leaders and media agency to ensure we are booking the most effective platforms and placements, implementing efficiencies across various channels, partners and platforms
  • Leading and mentoring digital marketing team members, ensuring growth goals are achieved via paid performance marketing and owned communication channels
  • Managing our Customer Engagement Platform and martech partners
  • Ensuring best practice use of all paid, owned and earned digital and social placements, with data-led recommendations for optimisation and creative improvements  
  • Analysis of performance metrics using tools like Adobe Analytics, Braze, Branch, and agency paid metrics; implement optimizations.
  • Managing the timely reporting to the NMD of all efforts, ensuring we are always considering both paid metrics and business outcomes against industry and previous campaign benchmarks for context. 
  • Budget management for digital initiatives as required, including forecasting and reconciliation  
  • Ensuring all marketing roadmap items are carried out in a timely manner, and proactively propose improvements 
     

This is what we’re looking for:

 

  • At least 5 years of experience in digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing best practice, strategic delivery, segmentation, marketing automation platforms and online channels
  • Data-led, digitally savvy and confident in delivering complex data into meaningful insights
  • Experience in leading and building high performing teams
  • Confident and effective stakeholder management skills
  • Proactive, collaborative, agile and always curious
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills

job.description:

Overview:

 

As Partnership Manager, Programmatic Partnerships, you'll team up with Paramount's core DSP, SSP, and platform partner leads to grow our TV programmatic business! You will own the relationships with technical and analytical contacts at our DSP and SSP programmatic partners. You'll also own the relationships at our platform/distribution partners (e.g., Roku, Samsung, Amazon Fire TV) and mediation platforms like SpringServe, Publica, etc. You'll work across all of these groups to boost value — and revenue — across our partner ecosystem. You'll also be the go-between for our key product and ops teams. In this role, you'll turn partner and market feedback into clear plans. Our ideal candidate is decisive and blends great relationship skills with deep CTV programmatic know-how and a love of data to guide every partnership decision!

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Team up with Paramount's DSP, SSP, and platform partner leads to align on strategy and drive shared priorities across the programmatic business.
  • Own the relationships with technical and analytical contacts at our DSP and SSP programmatic partners and at our platform/distribution partners, handling both day-to-day needs and long-term planning.
  • Help manage the relationships with mediation platforms (e.g., SpringServe, Publica, etc.), and keep integrations running smoothly.
  • Serve as the main link to our product and ops teams, sharing partner feedback that helps shape roadmaps and requirements.
  • Track how our programmatic partners perform — SSP performance, demand quality, fill rates, CPMs, win rates, and revenue contribution — to shape partnership strategy and get the most value from every partner.
  • Work with our internal monetization teams on bidding trends, pricing, and deal strategy to find new ways to optimize and grow revenue across the partner ecosystem.
  • Review new programmatic and platform partners and integrations, and bring clear, data-backed recommendations to go/no-go decisions.
  • Stay current on industry trends (identity, signal loss, SPO, curation, measurement) to inform partner strategy.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 3-5 years in programmatic advertising, ad tech, or partnerships, with CTV/video experience and a track record managing outside partner relationships (DSPs, SSPs, and/or distribution platforms).
  • SQL proficiency required; Python/R a plus.
  • Experience with CTV/video ad servers and mediation platforms (e.g., SpringServe, Publica) and SSPs (Magnite, PubMatic, Index Exchange, OpenX).
  • Strong knowledge of DSPs, header bidding, OpenRTB, deal IDs, SSAI, and SPO.
  • A proven approach to managing both technical and analytical relationships with programmatic and platform partners to drive real business results.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to win over both technical and non-technical people inside Paramount and at partner organizations.

job.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering (45445) 

 

 

Overview:

 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead our ShortForm & Video Intelligence pod. This team is in charge of a critical mission: the automated transformation of our massive long-form content library into "ShortForm" assets—high-impact clips, "gists," and social-ready highlights. You will lead the development of the models that "watch" our content to identify narrative hooks, emotional climaxes, and key characters to create compelling bite-sized experiences.

 

This is a deeply technical leadership role requiring mastery of multi-modal machine learning. You will oversee the creation of intelligence layers that perform video safety analysis (nudity/profanity detection), spoiler detection, and sophisticated narrative comprehension. Your work ensures that our ShortForm content is not only engaging but also safe, contextually precise, and optimized for discovery across the Paramount ecosystem.

 

The ShortForm pod unlocks the value of our entire catalog. In this role, you will directly shape:

 

  • The "Gist" Ecosystem: Building the engine that generates short-form previews, allowing users to "snack" on content before committing to a full watch.
  • Platform Safety & Integrity: Owning the "Video Intelligence" filters that protect our brand and users through automated detection of sensitive or restricted content.
  • Narrative AI: Transitioning beyond simple metadata to a world where AI understands story arcs, character importance, and "viral" moments within a film or episode. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Lead the ShortForm Pod: Define the technical roadmap for automated clip generation and video insight, managing a high-performing pod of ML engineers.
  • Architect Multi-Modal Models: Design and deploy models that synthesize signals across video (pixels), audio (speech/music), and text (transcripts/scripts) to understand content context.
  • Own Video Intelligence: Develop and scale robust computer vision and audio classifiers for nudity, profanity, and sensitive content detection.
  • Advance Narrative Understanding: Build models that can identify "hooks," "climax points," and "narrative summaries" to automate the creation of trailers and highlights.
  • Spoiler & Context Detection: Create intelligence layers that identify plot-critical "spoilers" to ensure ShortForm assets don't ruin the viewing experience for new users.
  • Scalable Content Pipelines: Partner with Content Engineering to integrate these models into petabyte-scale video processing workflows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 6-8+ years of experience in machine learning, with a heavy focus on Computer Vision (CV) and Multi-Modal architectures.
  • Deep Learning Expertise: Mastery of PyTorch or TensorFlow, specifically for video-based tasks (e.g., Video Transformers, 3D CNNs). Video Intelligence: Proven experience building safety/moderation models (Nudity, Profanity, Hate Speech) or content-tagging systems.
  • Leadership: Experience leading senior technical teams and translating complex "creative" goals into engineering requirements.
  • Video Tech Stack: Knowledge of video processing frameworks (FFmpeg) and handling various codecs/resolutions at scale.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience with Generative AI for Video (automated editing or style transfer).
  • Background in NLP/Speech for sync-ing transcripts with video frames.
  • Knowledge of Narrative Theory or experience in the media/entertainment industry.
  • Experience deploying large-scale models in Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP/Azure) with high GPU utilization efficiency.

 

#LI-RJ1

job.title: PTP Invoice Auditor
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Paramount is home to CBS, Nickelodeon, MTV, and Paramount Pictures. Behind every show, film, and stream is a long list of suppliers who need to be paid accurately and on time. That's where you come in. We're growing our Procure-to-Pay (PTP) team in Budapest and looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Invoice Auditor. You'll be the quality checkpoint for invoices across our international entities. You'll catch what's wrong, work out why, and help us stop it happening again.

Contract: Fixed term, 12 months, with extension possible based on business needs
Start: As soon as possible. We're looking for someone who can start at short notice and commit to the full 12 months.

Closing date: 17th October 2026

What you'll do

  • Work the invoice error queues in SAP and Oracle, digging into why invoices aren't posting and getting them unstuck
  • Chase down aged invoices and open purchase orders (GR/IR exceptions) with the business so suppliers are paid on time
  • Run fiscal and tax compliance checks on invoices for our international entities
  • Recover vendor credit balances, overpayments, and unapplied credits
  • Enter approved invoices manually when automation can't
  • Be the go-to for vendor and stakeholder queries, partnering with Procurement, Disbursements, and Finance teams
  • Spot patterns in recurring issues and help fix them at the root, improving both efficiency and control

What you'll bring

Essential

  • 1-3 years in Procure-to-Pay, Accounts Payable, or a similar finance operations setting
  • Hands-on ERP experience
  • Strong Excel skills (analysis, reporting, reconciliations)
  • Fluent English, written and spoken
  • A sharp eye for detail and a knack for problem-solving
  • Ability to commute to our Budapest office 2-3 days a week

Nice to have

  • Oracle Fusion Cloud and/or SAP experience
  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business
  • Hungarian or other languages
  • Experience in a shared services or GBS environment

You're likely a great fit if you like finding the needle in the haystack, take pride in getting it right, and are happy to pick up the phone or message to get an issue resolved.

Why this role

  • Real exposure: You'll work across systems, entities, and countries and see how a global media business runs its finance operations end to end
    Hands-on learning: You'll build deep knowledge of PTP processes, tax and compliance reviews, and SAP and Oracle
  • A genuine team: You'll join a collaborative GBS team in a friendly Budapest office
  • Perks: Private health insurance with a screening package, a monthly cafeteria package (SZÉP card, nursery, and home loan support), eyewear support, language courses after probation, weekly fresh fruit days and a dog-friendly office

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.description:

The Infrastructure & Media Technology department is a central technology organization that sits within the Product & Tech team of Paramount Skydance. We support multiple lines of business including Enterprise Applications, Ad Platforms, Linear Broadcasting & Distribution and Media Supply Chain. It is a fun and stimulating environment because the problems we solve are at tremendous scale. If you are interested in spearheading technological change and making a high impact at a premier media company, this is the role for you.

 

The Senior Cloud Architect is in charge of defining architectural standards, security frameworks and automation goals for all cloud deployments operated by Infrastructure & Media Technology. It is a high-impact and strategic role with a large scope that allows the candidate to work with brilliant co-workers to help solve some of Paramount’s most pressing technical challenges. The Senior Cloud Architect will have the ability to greatly influence cloud policy as well be a visionary for how Paramount should adopt the cloud over the next 3 to 5 years. They will have an opportunity to lead a team and partner with a globally distributed workforce to define and execute on a strategy to enable applications to deploy to the cloud in a cost-conscious, repeatable and secure way.

 

Primary Responsibilities:

 

Hands on engineering capability in support of Paramount Technology’s goal of migrating workloads between public cloud providers

Define strategy for migrating applications from various Linux versions (Amazon Linux, CentOS, Ubuntu, etc) to a standard running on Oracle Linux

Collaborate and define, document and educate on standards to be followed for the following: 

 

  • Foundational cloud architecture Automation framework, tools and taxonomy Continuous Integration / Deployment methodology
  • Security Governance (In collaboration with Information Security)
  • Partner with and advise Cloud Engineering organization on infrastructure architecture, cloud network design, infrastructure automation and security best practices
  • Drive infrastructure strategy for security operations Collaborate with Paramount Skydance Information Security organization on Company security standards
  • Lead team of Infrastructure Security engineers to detect and mitigate vulnerabilities in our environment
  • Continually evaluate the startup market for innovative solutions in the areas of infrastructure automation, cloud security and observability
  • Proficiency with Kubernetes
  • Drive the certification process for new operating systems and software, ensuring compatibility and compliance standards are met

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • The ideal candidate will possess the following knowledge, experience, and talents:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
  • 6+ years’ experience spanning at least 2 IT disciplines including technical architecture, network design, application development, middleware, database, OS or devops
  • 3 + years experience with Kubernetes(deploying applications, working with helm charts and operators)
  • Deep knowledge of multiple cloud provider offerings Amazon Web Services/GCP/OCI/Azure
  • Proficiency in Python or JavaScript or Terraform or Golang
  • Experience with large scale migrations of enterprise systems to public cloud
  • Experience working with cross functional teams across multiple time zones and varying cultural backgrounds
  • Experience designing, implementing and managing virtual private networks in public cloud ecosystems and connectivity to the physical layer

 

Additional Qualification

 

  • 5+ years’ experience with the following technologies: AWS/Linux/Terraform
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tooling and capabilities to enhance and accelerate coding / automation tasks (e.g. Cursor, GitHub CoPilot, Claude Code, etc)
  • Proven ability to influence peers on advantages of standardization, automation and shift left principles
  • Demonstrated ability to implement architectural standards in large companies working across diverse teams with varying business and application requirements
  • Experience drafting statements of work and providing feedback to legal department on business terms for data services contracts
  • Strong experience in building a highly effective and collaborative team culture that supports learning new technologies and challenges the status quo.
  • Highly effective at communicating complex ideas in easy-to-understand language

job.description:

  Overview: Lights, camera, action! Paramount Pictures is actively searching for a new Senior Coordinator to join our Partnership Marketing team! This role sits at the heart of how Paramount brings its theatrical film promotions to life across the globe. Based onsite at the Paramount lot in Los Angeles five days a week, this position provides critical administrative and organizational support across multiple managers and film titles — from centralizing documentation and tracking for leadership, to coordinating premiere logistics and vendor management, to keeping creative assets and partnership materials organized and flowing to the right teams. This role is a critical organizational hub for the team. Apply now and join our team!   Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Support end-to-end execution of theatrical film promotions with global, domestic and international partners across TV & broadcast, packaging, retail, digital, social, print, press, radio, and field opportunities
  • Ensure all external partners' creative submissions are saved, organized, and updated within the department's shared drives folders
  • Lead and oversee the development and delivery of merchandise and prize packages for multiple film titles to be used globally as needed
  • Creating and maintaining team materials, including status reports, case studies, tracking documents, research projects, international directives, promotional guidelines, and other partnership-related resources and documents
  • Support the day-to-day management of promotional partnerships, including preparing meeting notes, recaps, wrap reports, and other documentation
  • Own the end-to-end management and distribution of film assets — including trailers, sizzles, logos, posters, stills, and key art — serving as the central point of contact for internal teams and external partners
  • Spearhead vendor onboarding/payments and process invoices
  • Provide on-site support at premieres involving partner management domestically and internationally as needed
  • Assist in routing creative approvals, organizing partner screenings, creating timelines and schedules, and handling any additional last-minute projects as assigned at any time
  • Centralize document management, particularly for senior leadership visibility
  • Handle task overflow related to movie premieres, including event ticket management for titles
  • Provide support to the team on all assignments
  Basic Qualifications:
  • 3+ years of experience in a studio marketing, promotions, or partnerships department; experience in advertising or promotion agencies with account management and/or sales, or experience in an administrative-heavy or executive assistant (EA) role
  • Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred
  • Experience in International Marketing or global operations is a plus
  • Experience in a centralized team hub role, with strong skills in keeping processes and people organized, is desired

In This Role You’ll:

 

The Senior Data Engineer should possess a deep sense of curiosity and a passion for building data pipelines, data structures and data products and the ability to communicate data structures and tools throughout the Paramount Digital Media organization.

The candidate for this role will use their skills in reverse engineering, analytics, and creative, experimental solutions to devise data and BI solutions. They will have experience supporting data pipeline development, which includes machine learning algorithms using disparate data sources. They will work closely with BI, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams to implement data-driven plans that drive the business. They will also be able to lead a project from inception to completion, as well as help mentor junior members of the team on standard processes and approaches around data.

 

Responsibilities Include:

· Works with large volumes of traffic data and user behaviors to build pipelines that enhance raw data.

· Able to break down and communicate highly complex data problems into simple, feasible solutions.

· Extract patterns from large datasets and transform data into an informational advantage.

· Find answers to business questions via hands-on exploration of data sets via Jupyter, SQL, dashboards, statistical analysis, and data visualizations.

· Partner with the internal product and business intelligence teams to determine the best approach around data ingestion, structure, and storage, and ensure successful implementation in partnership with the team.

· Lead initiatives to improve data quality and effectiveness by contributing ideas and collaborating with engineering, BI teams, and business units to implement changes.

· Ongoing development of technical solutions while developing and maintaining documentation, at times training impacted teams.

· Early on collaboration with the team on internal initiatives to create strategies that improve company processes.

· Look at ways of improving efficiency by staying current on the latest technology and trends and introducing team members to such.

· Develop prototypes to proof out strategies for data pipelines and products.

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:

 

· Bachelor's degree and 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering and Analytics fields or consulting roles with a focus on digital analytics implementations.

· Experience with large scale data warehouse management systems such as BigQuery with advanced level understanding of warehouse cost management and query optimization

· Proficient in Python.

· Experience with Airflow or equivalent tools for orchestration of pipelines.

· Experience with Data Modeling of performant table structures.

· Able to write SQL to perform common types of analysis and transformations.

· Strong problem-solving and creative-thinking skills.

· Ability to design and implement technical solutions, maintain accurate documentation, and deliver training to impacted teams as needed.

· Experience developing solutions to business requirements via hands-on discovery and exploration of data.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences, as well as translating business requirements into Data Solutions

· Strong experience with ETL & ELT.

· Experience building and deploying applications on GCP cloud platform.

· Influences and applies data standards, policies, and procedures

· Builds strong commitment within the team to support the appropriate team priorities

· Knowledge of new and evolving technologies via formal training and self-directed education

 

Bonus Skills:

 

· Experience with BigQuery and other GCP technologies.

· Experience with Docker and container deployment.

· Experience with Marketing tools like Kochava, Braze, Branch, Salesforce Marketing Cloud is a plus.

· Experience with exploratory data analysis using tools like iPython Notebook, Pandas & matplotlib, etc.

job.title: Senior Director, Data Science
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team. DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group consists of subject matter experts that prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products; assess, aggregate, and analyze data; and shape qualitative and quantitative based narratives and insights, providing stakeholders with decision support, performance clarity and business driving recommendations.

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Senior Director will report into the VP of User Lifecycle Analytics, and will support a wide range of initiatives, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives and Finance. This role requires the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, an inquisitive nature, attention to detail, and a passion for media, ideally with experience in analyzing user journeys and advanced causal inference frameworks.

This role owns two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to encourage it? 
  2. How are optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey impacting the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design and lead causal inference frameworks (quasi-experimental methods, uplift modeling, instrumental variables, matching, diff-in-diff). Find what truly drives retention and value.
  • Work with Lifecycle Marketing and Product to turn causal findings into clear levers. These span content, onboarding, pricing, and promos to improve subscriber health.
  • Own how we link content and journey optimization to outcomes like ARPU, survival, and LTV.
  • Design, launch, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, involvement, win-back). Use sound design. Deliver clear results.
  • Build and keep LTV and survival models with the causal drivers above. Finance and DTC teams can then use them.
  • Lead subscriber journey mapping. Find where levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promos) drive the most causal impact on retention and monetization.
  • Run pricing and promo analyses to shape pricing and promo design. Weigh short-term conversion against long-term value.
  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical teams, like DTC leaders and Finance.
  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of data scientists and analysts. Set technical standards and review methods.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Product Analytics. Keep the data systems for causal analysis (experiment platforms, behavioral and billing data) reliable.
  • Share findings with senior leaders to shape the roadmap. Guide where we invest across Marketing, Product, and Finance.

 

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Computer Science).
  • 10+ years in data science/analytics. This covers hands-on and team-leading work. It spans causal inference methods (diff-in-diff, propensity matching, instrumental variables, uplift modeling, synthetic control).
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and experiments at scale, handling common pitfalls (novelty and network effects, selection bias).
  • Built or run LTV, survival, or churn models. Turned them into financial metrics (ARPU, retention curves).
  • Strong SQL skills and a stats language (Python or R) for causal modeling.
  • A proven track record leading and growing a team of data scientists or analysts.
  • A clear communicator who can present complex work to senior leaders and shape decisions.
  • Experience working across Marketing, Product, and Finance teams.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Know pricing awareness/elasticity work. Design smart promos.
  • Skilled in subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Skilled in Bayesian or ML-based causal techniques (e.g., double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. job.title: Senior FP&A Analyst, Streaming Finance
job.description:
Shape the Future of Streaming | Senior FP&A Analyst (Budapest)

 

At Paramount, we don’t just watch content—we define it. From blockbuster movies to world-class streaming, our global team brings iconic entertainment to millions.

We are expanding our Streaming Affiliate Finance FP&A team and looking for a Senior Analyst in Budapest to own financial planning and analysis for the EMEA & APAC regions. In this role, you will work directly alongside the Budapest-based Senior Director/Lead, serving as their key partner locally while collaborating with a high-performing international team across New York and London.

If you’re ready to turn complex financial data into strategic insights, drive regional business decisions, and thrive in an interconnected global business, we want to hear from you.

 

Where You Fit In & Team Structure

 

  • Local Partnership: You will be joining as the first analyst on the ground in Budapest, working directly with your Hiring Manager/Director. You'll have direct mentorship, clear visibility, and a strong local sounding board.

  • Global Scope (EMEA & APAC): You will take end-to-end financial ownership of the EMEA & APAC markets. You’ll align with teammates handling Canada & LATAM (based in New York) and specialized large-contract FP&A (based in London).

  • High-Level Impact: Together, the regional outputs are consolidated locally in Budapest before being presented directly to executive leadership in New York.

  • Budapest Office Life: While your day-to-day workflow is tied to the global Streaming Affiliate Finance team, you’ll be based in a vibrant, friendly Budapest office alongside sister finance and business teams. Expect regular team lunches, social events, joint team-building activities, and a welcoming community on-site!

 

What You’ll Do

 

  • Drive Regional FP&A (EMEA & APAC): Own financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting for Paramount’s Streaming Affiliate operations across EMEA and APAC.

  • Master Financial Planning Cycle: Support the Long-Range Plan, Annual Operating Plan, quarterly forecasts, and monthly financial reviews.

  • Track & Optimize Performance: Manage revenue and cost models, variance analyses, and continuous performance tracking to identify risks and growth opportunities.

  • Partner with Global Stakeholders: Work closely with cross-functional teams in Europe, Asia, and the US to evaluate new commercial initiatives and support strategic decision-making.

  • Modernize & Automate: Drive continuous improvement, process standardization, and automation across financial reporting and workflows.

  • Deliver Executive Analytics: Prepare impactful ad hoc financial analyses, business cases, and presentations for global leadership.

 

What We’re Looking For

 

  • Experience: 4+ years of FP&A and/or Accounting experience, with a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.

  • Regional or Global Mindset: Comfort working with cross-border stakeholders and managing dynamic, multi-market financial data.

  • Analytical Precision: Strong problem-solving capabilities with a knack for translating complex data into clear strategic insights.

  • Fluent English Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to collaborate smoothly with teams in New York, London, and across the globe.

  • Technical Savvy: Advanced Excel skills. Hands-on experience with systems like SAP, Oracle, or Longview is a strong advantage.

  • Accounting Foundations: Solid understanding of US GAAP, IFRS, or equivalent accounting principles.

  • Self-Starter & Agility: Ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

 

Why You’ll Love Working Here

 

| Health & Wellness | Private health insurance with private clinic access and annual screening packages, plus eyewear support. | | Financial Flexibility | Monthly cafeteria plan featuring SZÉP card options, nursery support, and home loan assistance. | | Office Perks | Fresh fruit delivered weekly, cross-team social events, and a dog-friendly office—so your four-legged best friend can come to work with you! | | Growth & Culture | Company-sponsored language courses (post-probation) and exclusive pre-premiere movie screenings before official releases. |

  • Contract Type: 1-year fixed-term contract (with strong potential for extension)

  • Location: Budapest, Hungary (Hybrid / Office-based)

 

Ready to take ownership of EMEA & APAC finance on a global stage? Apply today!

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in marketing or a related field.

The Senior Network Engineer role focuses on the implementation and support of reliable, scalable network solutions supporting media and corporate systems. This position is primarily hands-on and technical, working within the broader network architecture and engineering organization to deliver and maintain high-performance, mission‑critical network services. 

The role participates in network projects across the full lifecycle and collaborates closely with peer engineers, operations teams, and cross‑functional partners.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Video) 

Location: Remote

 

Overview

The Video Engineering team is in charge of supporting the video delivery and architecture of VOD and Live content streamed on Paramount+ and other Paramount brands. Our team is also in charge of managing services tasked with ingesting content into video cms, encoding, packaging with DRM, delivery and content distribution of premium content to millions of users every day.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who will play a key role in optimizing and streamlining our video workflows. This engineer will leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate development cycles and drive efficiency across our video pipeline. Working closely with the Video Engineering team, they will build and enhance cloud-native solutions on GCP and OCI to support the encoding, packaging, and delivery of VOD and Live content across Paramount+ and other Paramount brands. The candidate will also be tasked with building, deploying, and managing video encoding and packaging applications in the cloud, while collaborating with engineers across platforms including Desktop, OTT, and Mobile.

 

Your Day-to-Day

  • Identify bottlenecks and optimize video workflows to improve efficiency across encoding and delivery
  • Integrate AI-powered tools into development processes to accelerate build cycles and reduce manual effort
  • Build and manage scalable cloud-native applications on OCI and GCP for video processing
  • Design, develop, and maintain microservices to support modular and scalable video platform architecture
  • Collaborate with development teams on re-architecting and migrating existing monolithic systems into microservices-based cloud architectures
  • Monitor and improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of microservices across the video pipeline
  • Actively influence future innovations by staying current with the latest software engineering and video technology trends
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and teamwork across the engineering organization

 

Key Projects

  • Optimize and modernize the cloud video encoding platform to improve workflow efficiency and reduce processing times
  • Design and implement microservices-based architectures to replace existing monolithic systems
  • Build and deploy AI-driven tools and automation to accelerate development and streamline video operations
  • Develop and scale cloud-native video transcoding solutions on GCP and OCI

 

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
  • 5+ years working with programming languages such as Golang, Java, Python
  • Experience using AI tools in software development. This includes working with prompt engineering. AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, and working with large language models such as Anthropic Claude
  • 3+ years of experience designing, building, and maintaining microservices architectures
  • 3+ years working with Cloud/SaaS services such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or Google Cloud
  • BS/MS Degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study, or equivalent applicable experience

 

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with container technology and orchestration such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with technical writing and design documentation
  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or a similar, related field
  • Experience with video codecs and protocols such as H.264, HEVC, AV1, HLS, RTMP

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

  Senior Software Engineer, CMS Platform Paramount Streaming • Technology & Engineering   Location: Burbank, CA / New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA • Full-Time (onsite)  

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, CMS to build and own the web experiences at the heart of our content management platform - shipping high-quality code across a polyglot stack that powers Paramount+, Pluto TV, and CBS.com. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: you'll spend most of your time crafting fast, resilient, server-rendered React applications, and you'll own features end to end - from the component layer down through the APIs and data model that back them; along with event driven messaging for external integrations.

 

Motivational Fit

 

·You'll become the person the team turns to on frontend architecture and web performance, lead small-to-medium projects from design through production, and mentor other engineers.

·You care about how things feel for users and how maintainable they are for the engineers who come after you.

·You are driven to improve code quality, developer experience and team processes

 

Responsibilities

 

•     Build and evolve server-rendered React applications: design high-quality, accessible, performant UIs with Next.js and modern React, with server-side rendering (SSR) at the core of how we deliver fast first-load experiences at streaming scale.

•     Own component architecture: establish and champion clean, reusable component patterns and shared design conventions that scale across the codebase and keep the team moving quickly.

•     Drive web performance: measure and improve Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, bundle size, caching, and load performance — and set the standards other engineers follow.

•     Deliver features end to end: design complete solutions that span the frontend and the services behind it — building and evolving REST APIs in Java/Spring Boot and modeling the data with PostgreSQL (entities, schema, migrations) that power those experiences.

•     Develop the API and data layer: build the Node.js and Spring Boot service layers that connect the frontend to the platform, with an eye to clean contracts and clear boundaries that also supports external clients through messaging.

•     Improve developer experience and quality: raise the bar on testing, observability, tooling, and team processes — making the whole team faster, the codebase healthier and reduce technical debt

•     Ownership: take ownership of small to medium projects from design through production, coach colleagues, and help codify expertise — including clear, agent-readable docs and conventions — so both people and AI agents can ramp quickly.

•     Mentorship: mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing including effective AI-augmented workflows

•     Collaboration: collaborate with stakeholders and partner teams to ensure seamless integrations and cohesive experiences

•     Participate in on-call rotations, incident resolution and RCAs

•     Help grow the team through interviewing and onboarding new members


Required Qualifications

 

 

•     BS in Comp Science or related field, or equivalent applicable experience

•     5+ years of professional software engineering experience

•     Strong React expertise, with production experience building server-rendered applications (SSR) using Next.js or a similar framework.

•     Deep frontend fundamentals: component architecture, TypeScript, state management, and a genuine command of web performance and accessibility.

•     Full-stack range: comfort building the services behind the UI — Node.js and/or Java/Spring Boot REST APIs — and modeling data in a relational database such as PostgreSQL (entities, schema design, migrations).

•     End-to-end ownership: a track record of taking features from design through production, and the judgment to make sound architectural tradeoffs across the stack.

•     Senior-level collaboration: strong communication, a habit of mentoring, and the ability to set patterns others adopt.

•     Technical writing: comfort producing clear design documentation and conventions.

 

Preferred
