•     Experience with message brokers (Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub) / event driven messaging systems

•     Experience with search tools like Solr and Elasticsearch

 

Nice-to-Have

 

     Familiarity with content management domains, media/streaming, or other high-traffic consumer platforms.

 

How We Work

 

AI is part of how we build every day, and we expect our engineers to be fluent with it. This is core to the role, not a bonus.

 

Required:

 

•     Daily fluency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot — we provide licenses). Agents draft, you direct and review. You know how to prompt effectively, when to trust the output, and how to catch what it gets wrong.

•     Judgment over autopilot: you review agent-generated code critically, hold the quality bar, and can explain your reasoning. As a senior engineer, you'll help shape how the team uses these tools well — encoding conventions, setting review patterns for agent-generated code, and mentoring juniors on           judgment.

•     Exposure to building agentic workflows developing systems where AI agents take on multi-step tasks with the right guardrails.

•     Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar approaches for connecting AI agents to tools, data, and services.

Why Join

 

You'll work on web experiences seen by millions, on a team that pairs a strong frontend craft culture with real full-stack ownership and an AI-native way of building. We provide the tools, the licenses, and the room to shape how modern web engineering is done at one of the industry's most recognizable brands.

Senior Software Engineer, Front End – CBS Sports Digital

Req: 45930 | Department: CBS Sports.com Technology | Type: Full-Time, On-Site Locations: Nashville, TN; Louisville, KY; Fort Lauderdale, FL

 

 

 

About the Role

Join CBS Sports Digital and help build the web experiences that millions of sports fans use every day across CBSSports.com and our apps. We are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer to join our Content Management team, a small engineering group that partners closely with design and product to turn ideas into fast, accessible, production-grade fan experiences.

 

You will own the quality of what fans see and feel: how fast pages load, how components behave, and how reliably we ship. Candidates with Lead-level scope are also encouraged to apply.

What You Will Do

  • Build Front-End Features: Design and ship production-grade features for web using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, from prototype through launch.

  • Own Performance: Improve and protect Core Web Vitals through rendering strategy, code splitting, lazy loading, and image and asset optimization.

  • Contribute to Standards: Build and evolve reusable components and shared patterns that scale across the organization.

  • Collaborate and Prototype: Work with design and product to quickly design, develop, and test solutions to key business challenges.

  • Raise the Bar on Code Quality: Review code for style, testability, accessibility, and efficiency, and mentor engineers on front-end best practices.

  • Type Safety: Contribute to TypeScript standards (strict mode, shared types, codegen) so our codebases stay maintainable and refactor-safe.

  • Monorepo Workflows: Use and contribute to monorepo tooling (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) to support build, test, and deploy across web applications.

  • Operational Excellence: Build with reliability in mind, including testing, front-end monitoring, and alerting.

  • Document: Contribute clear documentation and diagrams to help onboard other engineers.

  • Use AI Tools: Use AI development tools to speed up your workflow and share what works with the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade web applications with React and Next.js.

  • Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming, generics, strict typing, and modern ES6+ features.

  • Deep knowledge of HTML and CSS, including responsive layout, cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of browser behavior, rendering, and front-end performance (e.g., Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting).

  • Experience consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL), including Apollo Client.

  • Experience with monorepo tooling and workflows (e.g., Turborepo, Nx), including shared packages and task pipelines.

  • Experience with component libraries or design systems and with testing front-end code (unit, integration, end-to-end).

  • Working knowledge of Node.js for server-side rendering and API layers.

  • Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including monitoring tools (e.g., New Relic, OpenTelemetry).

  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple styling approaches (StyleX, CSS Modules, SASS, CSS-in-JS) and design tokens.

  • Exposure to CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.

  • Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and with setting up guardrails (rules, commands, skills, sub-agents) to keep AI-generated code clean and production-ready.

  • Familiarity with Generative AI and RAG concepts, or experience building AI-powered features.

  • Cloud experience (AWS preferred) and familiarity with containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, OCI).

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

Overview

BET Media Group is seeking a highly motivated Senior Account Executive to join our Midwest Sales team. The Senior Account Executive will be tasked with developing and growing advertising revenue across BET's portfolio of linear, streaming, digital, social, branded content, experiential, and cross-platform solutions.   This individual will own a portfolio of key agency and client relationships, identify new business opportunities, and develop strategic revenue plans that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is a consultative seller with deep marketplace relationships, a proven track record of exceeding revenue goals, and experience creating integrated marketing solutions that extend beyond traditional media sales. This role is important throughout the entire year and is a significant role during the Upfront. This individual will be based in the Chicago office and report to the Senior Director of Midwest Sales.  

Responsibilities include but not limited to

  • Own and manage a portfolio of key agency and client relationships across the Midwest territory.
  • Develop and execute annual account growth strategies that drive revenue across linear, digital, streaming, social, branded content, and experiential platforms.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities while expanding existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling initiatives.
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports (weekly activity reports, account updates, proposal reviews, monthly projections and forecasts) for management.
  • Create sales presentations for key, target categories and accounts within the territory.
  • Create customized, insight-driven sales presentations and integrated marketing proposals aligned with clients goals and objectives.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Your next step in finance, with real ownership

Are you a couple of years into your accounting career and ready for more than month-end tasks? Join Paramount's Controllership team in Budapest and own the accounting for compensation-related activity across our international networks business.

You won't be buried in a back-office queue. You'll work directly with Treasury, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash, and you'll help shape how accounting work moves into our Budapest hub over the coming years.

 

What you'll do

  • Own your processes end to end, from monthly journals, accruals and prepayments to account reconciliations and balance sheet rollforwards

  • Turn the numbers into insight by building the financial and operational metrics the business uses to make decisions

  • Partner with Finance and Operations colleagues across the organisation, and be the person they come to when they need an answer

  • Help migrate new accounting activities into Budapest, and standardise how we do things as we grow

  • Spot where we can work smarter, then fix it. We want your ideas and we'll give you room to run with them

  • Keep our controls strong (SOX) and work with external auditors on quarterly and annual reviews

  • Pick up ad hoc analysis and management requests, and support your manager and team when needed

 

What you bring

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

  • 2+ years of accounting experience across a mix of activities (journals, reconciliations, close)

  • A solid grasp of general accounting principles

  • Business-level English, written and spoken (B2/C1+)

  • Confident Excel skills, plus Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint

  • A proactive, structured approach: you see things through to the end

  • Experience in a shared services or multinational environment

  • SOX or audit exposure

  • A track record of improving a process you've worked on

 

As part of our selection process, you will be invited to complete a series of short assessments as part of the screening stage. These assessments help to identify your skills aligned to the role both in terms of your approach to work and also technical ability. Applicants will be invited to complete the testing post the role advert closing on 17th October 2026.

job.title: Sr Data Engineer (Data Architecture and Modeling)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview and Responsibilities:

 

The Signal Intelligence (SigInt) team turns a high-volume, multi-source data ecosystem — operational systems, client-app event streams, ad-tech platforms, stitcher events, ad server logs, and telemetry — into the trusted data models, metrics, and dashboards that drive business, product, and ad-ops decisions.

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer who is, in equal measure, a data modeler, a SQL craftsperson, and an analyst — not only a pipeline builder. You will own data end-to-end: modeling raw events into conformed, analytics-ready marts; writing the analytical SQL that answers hard business questions; defining the metrics leadership relies on; and building the pipelines that feed it all. Because we sit close to the business, translating ambiguous questions into durable models and clear insight matters as much as engineering the pipeline.

In practice, you will be the team's data sherpa — the person who knows the data terrain cold, guides analysts and business partners through it, and turns an ambiguous “can we find out X?” into a trusted, well-modeled answer. You own the map — the definitions, lineage, and the “why” behind the numbers — as much as the pipelines.

This is an analytics-engineering role on a semi-business team. It is not a pure platform / infrastructure position — if your passion is exclusively distributed-systems plumbing with little interest in modeling, analysis, or guiding the business, this will not be the right fit.

 

Responsibilities Include:

 

Modeling & architecture — the core of the role

• Design and own the dimensional and semantic models — conformed dimensions, facts, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions (Type 2), and well-defined grain — that serve as the trusted source of truth.

• Architect data marts spanning operational, advertising, and telemetry domains for analytics, reporting, AI, and operational use.

• Establish shared definitions and a semantic / metrics layer so users, sessions, devices, content, campaigns, and impressions mean the same thing everywhere.

SQL & analysis

• Write and optimize sophisticated analytical SQL — window functions, cohort and funnel logic, sessionization, distributions — on large event-scale datasets.

• Analyze complex datasets to find patterns, quantify drivers, and produce actionable insight; define new metrics and KPIs (usage, revenue, etc.) and the logic behind them.

• Independently investigate variance across platforms and communicate findings clearly to peers and senior leadership.

Business partnership

• Be the go-to guide for the data — the person who knows where every number comes from, what it means, and its quirks and landmines.

• Own the institutional knowledge of the data — definitions, lineage, and the reasoning behind metrics — and make it legible so analysts, ad ops, product, and finance can self-serve with confidence.

• Partner with stakeholders and source-system owners to translate ambiguous business questions into durable data models and metrics, and support/conduct strategic investigations and analysis.

Pipelines, quality & delivery

• Build and harmonize the ingestion and transformation pipelines — event data from client apps, ad-tech platforms, stitchers, ad servers, and telemetry — that feed the models, handling deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Stitch identity and sessions across client, server, and ad-side events for accurate user, content, and revenue analytics.

• Establish data-quality standards (testing, monitoring, alerting, freshness and volume SLAs) and troubleshoot incidents end-to-end — from a dashboard anomaly back through marts, transformations, and raw logs.

• Support and improve BI dashboards; document datasets, lineage, and business logic so the data map stays trustworthy and current.

• Mentor engineers and analysts on SQL, modeling, event data, and engineering best practices.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

• Expert SQL, including analytical SQL craft (window functions, complex joins, cohort / funnel / sessionization logic) and performance tuning on large event-scale datasets.

• Deep data-modeling expertise — dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, conformed dimensions, grain, and data-mart design; able to design a trusted source of truth from messy multi-source data.

• Strong data analysis and business translation — able to independently investigate data, define metrics and KPIs, and act as a trusted guide who turns ambiguous business questions into clear answers and enables others to self-serve.

• A guide’s temperament — curiosity to learn the data terrain deeply, patience to help non-technical partners, and communication that earns trust across the business.

• dbt (or an equivalent transformation / modeling framework).

• Cloud warehouse — BigQuery strongly preferred (our environment); Snowflake or Databricks acceptable with a fast ramp.

• Python for data processing and pipeline development.

• Orchestration experience (Airflow).

• High-volume event data — clickstream, telemetry, ad impressions, or similar — including deduplication, late-arriving data, sessionization, and schema evolution.

• Proven track record harmonizing data across multiple source systems with conflicting schemas, identifiers, or grain.

• BI tools (DOMO, Looker, Mode) — comfort both consuming and supporting their development.

• Experience debugging data-quality issues across the full stack — from BI tool to warehouse to raw event logs.

• BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

• Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

• Semantic-layer experience (LookML, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube).

• Streaming-media / ad-tech domain (ad servers, SSAI / stitchers, VAST/VMAP, impression and fill-rate metrics).

• Streaming ingestion (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

• Statistical analysis with R and predictive-analytics tooling; experimentation / A-B analysis.

• Master data management or entity resolution.

• MS in a quantitative discipline; experience mentoring or leading engineers/analysts.

 

How you will succeed in this role:

 

• You think in models and metrics, not just pipelines.

• You are the person others come to when they are lost in the data — and you like being that guide.

• You are as comfortable in a SQL console or a dashboard as in a DAG, and you move fluidly between business context and technical root cause.

• You treat data as a product — with users, definitions, SLAs, and documentation.

• You turn ambiguous business questions into clean models and clear answers.

 

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. This position is bonus eligible.

The Senior Network Engineer role focuses on the implementation and support of reliable, scalable network solutions supporting media and corporate systems. This position is primarily hands-on and technical, working within the broader network architecture and engineering organization to deliver and maintain high-performance, mission critical network services.


The role participates in network projects across the full lifecycle and collaborates closely with peer engineers, operations teams, and cross functional partners.


 
Responsibilities Include


•    Design, implement, and support scalable, highly available routing and switching solutions for media and corporate network environments.

•    Work with vendors and internal teams to troubleshoot issues and support hardware/software lifecycle activities.

•    Solid understanding of routing and switching protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF, MPLS).

job.title: Sr Live Event Technology Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

Sr Live Event Technology Specialist (Streaming Operations Specialist)

Location:
Flexible / Global (based on operational needs)

Role Overview

As a Sr. Live Event Technology Specialist, you will serve as the primary technical escalation point for Paramount+’s global Live Event Operations team, providing technical support for Tier-1 live streaming events. This role focuses on diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues across the end-to-end live streaming ecosystem while minimizing customer impact during high-profile live broadcasts.

Working alongside Live Event Operators, Engineering, Product, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and distribution partners, you will lead technical investigations, coordinate cross-functional incident response, and drive root cause analysis for issues affecting acquisition, encoding, packaging, delivery, playback, advertising, and platform integrations.

Your expertise will ensure rapid issue mitigation, operational excellence, and continuous improvements across Paramount’s live streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical escalation point for the Live Event Operations team during live events.
  • Support global Tier-1 live streaming events by troubleshooting complex issues across the complete video delivery chain.
  • Investigate service-impacting issues involving contribution feeds, cloud encoding, packaging, DRM, origin, CDN delivery, playback, and client applications.
  • Perform detailed technical analysis using streaming manifests, player logs, encoder metrics, QoS/QoE analytics, SCTE-35 signaling, transport stream analysis, and cloud monitoring tools.
  • Coordinate technical response across Engineering, Platform, Network Operations, CDN providers, cloud vendors, and third-party partners to restore service quickly.
  • Lead technical bridge calls during critical incidents, providing real-time updates, impact assessments, mitigation strategies, and recovery coordination.
  • Support Live Event Operators by providing technical guidance during event execution, validating mitigation actions, and assisting with operational decision-making.
  • Perform pre-event technical validation, redundancy verification, workflow testing, and production readiness reviews.
  • Conduct post-event root cause analysis (RCA), identify systemic issues, and drive corrective actions to improve platform reliability.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting documentation, operational runbooks, monitoring procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support certification, onboarding, and production rollout of new streaming technologies, cloud workflows, monitoring tools, and vendor integrations.
  • Participate in on-call rotations supporting global live streaming operations and high-severity production incidents.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years supporting large-scale live streaming, OTT platforms, broadcast technology, or video delivery systems.
  • Experience serving as a technical escalation resource supporting live operations teams during Tier-1 live events.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across end-to-end streaming architectures including:
    • Contribution and video transport
    • Cloud encoding and transcoding
    • Packaging and origin services
    • DRM
    • SSAI/DAI
    • CDN distribution
    • Player playback
  • Deep understanding of HLS, DASH, CMAF/fMP4, MPEG-TS, SCTE-35, timed metadata, and adaptive bitrate streaming.
  • Experience analyzing manifests, transport streams, encoder logs, player telemetry, QoS/QoE metrics, and cloud infrastructure metrics.
  • Familiarity with AWS Media Services, CDN technologies, cloud networking, and streaming observability platforms.
  • Working knowledge of contribution protocols including SRT, Zixi, RIST, RTP, UDP, and multicast workflows.
  • Strong understanding of DRM, SSAI, client playback behavior, redundancy architectures, and failover strategies.
  • Excellent incident management, root cause analysis, and cross-functional communication skills in high-pressure live production environments.

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. The service is also the streaming home to unmatched sports programming, including every CBS Sports event, from golf to football to basketball and more, plus exclusive streaming rights for major sports properties, including some of the world’s biggest and most popular soccer leagues. Paramount+ also enables subscribers to stream local CBS stations live across the U.S. in addition to the ability to stream Paramount Streaming’s other live channels: CBSN for 24/7 news, CBS Sports HQ for sports news and analysis, and ET Live for entertainment coverage.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Overview:

The Senior Manager, CBS Owned Stations Security is an individual contributor responsible for the security posture of Paramount's fifteen CBS owned and operated television stations. This role sits within the Global Security Operations organization and reports to the VP, Global Security Operations, with a dotted line to the President, Stations and Digital, CBS News and Stations to keep security priorities aligned with station leadership and day to day operations.
The Senior Manager aligns station level security programs with enterprise Global Security standards, oversees the security vendors supporting station operations, and coordinates training that protects station employees, contractors, and on air talent. This role partners with Crisis Management and Environmental Health and Safety on preparedness, personal protective equipment, and training, and serves as the field level point of contact for security matters affecting the station group.


This role requires approximately seventy percent travel across the station group. When not traveling, this is an office based position and is not a hybrid role; the employee is required to be in the office five days a week, Monday through Friday.

 

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Station Security Program Alignment

  • Align security programs, standards, and protocols across all fifteen CBS owned and operated stations with enterprise Global Security policy
  • Conduct site level security assessments and drive remediation of identified gaps in coordination with station management
  • Serve as the field level security point of contact for station general managers and news directors
  • Maintain a regular working cadence with CBS News Leadership to keep them informed of security priorities, risk exposure, and program changes

 

Vendor Oversight and Performance Management

  • Oversee contracted security vendors supporting the station group, including guard force staffing, post orders, and day to day performance
  • Manage vendor onboarding, scheduling, and invoice reconciliation across the fifteen stations
  • Monitor vendor compliance with service level agreements and escalate performance issues to the VP, Global Security Operations
  • Oversee and audit security related purchase orders and invoices

 

Training and Security Culture

  • Coordinate and ensure the delivery of world class security training for station employees, including workplace violence prevention, active assailant response, field safety, and travel safety
  • Partner with HR and station leadership to embed security training into new hire onboarding
  • Maintain training records and completion tracking across the station group

 

Crisis Management and EHS Partnership

  • Partner with Crisis Management on station level emergency preparedness planning, drills, and response protocols
  • Partner with Environmental Health and Safety on personal protective equipment programs, hazard assessments, and preparedness training relevant to security incidents
  • Support coordinated response to incidents affecting station personnel, facilities, or on air talent
    Protection of People and On Air Talent
  • Responsible for the safety and security of all personnel across the station group, including employees, contractors, and on air talent
  • Coordinate protective measures for on air talent and all employees during field assignments, remote broadcasts, and high profile coverage
  • Provide security guidance for coverage of high risk or high profile events at the station level

 

Reporting and Continuous Improvement

  • Provide regular reporting to the VP, Global Security Operations on station security posture, vendor performance, and training completion
  • Identify recurring risk trends across the station group and recommend program improvements
  • Support after action reviews following security incidents at the station level

 

Leadership Level and Scope

  • Senior Manager level individual contributor with security oversight across fifteen owned and operated stations
  • No direct FTE reports; functional oversight of contracted security vendor personnel
  • Approximately seventy percent travel across the station group

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Eight or more years of experience in corporate security, law enforcement, or media security
  • Experience overseeing contracted security vendors, including guard force management
  • Experience developing and delivering security training programs
  • Working knowledge of crisis management and emergency preparedness principles
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across all levels of an organization
  • Ability to travel approximately seventy percent of the time, including on short notice
  • Ability to operate autonomously across multiple sites with minimal direct oversight
  • Proficient in MS Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • Comfortable working under pressure and tight deadlines, which may include nights and weekends
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience in broadcast, media, or entertainment security
  • Experience protecting on air talent or other high profile individuals
  • ASIS Certified Protection Professional
  • Association of Threat Assessment Professionals, Certified Threat Manager certification
  • Experience partnering with Environmental Health and Safety on PPE and preparedness programs
  • Background in law enforcement or military security operations

 

Eligibility requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV online to be considered
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States

Overview
Paramount: A Skydance Corporation is seeking a Media Operations Senior Manager to join the Editorial Post Production Operations (EPPO) Media Management & Archives team within Production Technology and Operations. This role carries end-to-end ownership of media infrastructure, access, and workflow decisions supporting high-volume, multi-brand production across Paramount's global ecosystem. Based in LA, the position sets and enforces storage and archive policy, provisions and secures editorial and production access, manages vendor tools and relationships, and serves as an escalation point for the technical issues that most directly affect production continuity. The role partners daily with production, editorial, engineering, content security, and network stakeholders across coasts, and coordinates directly with the NYC and Hollywood Post Support teams.

•    Provision, audit, and secure access to media environments; work with clients to determine what requires restricted access for sensitive materials versus open access for a group of users
•    Set up and support live and near-live production and streaming workflows (e.g., WildMoka ingest, movie recorder routing) and troubleshoot encoding and routing issues in partnership with engineering
•    Coordinate media transfer, transit, and delivery workflows across internal teams and external vendors/post houses using enterprise tools (e.g., Signiant/Media Shuttle, Aspera)
•    Manage relationships with media technology vendors, including feature evaluation and usage guidance for shared services and tools
•    Serve as the first point of contact for cross-brand client groups for media needs, archive/retrieval, and workflow troubleshooting
•    Maintain and audit reference data supporting media operations, such as personnel/location directories and workflow documentation
•    Manage a team of media coordinators, including scheduling, time-off and overtime approvals, training, and client communication
Qualifications
•    5+ years of experience in media management, post-production operations, or media infrastructure/IT roles supporting production, with prior coordinator-level experience preferred
•    Demonstrated experience managing storage systems, Active Directory security groups, and access provisioning in a production or enterprise media environment
•    Strong working knowledge of editorial workflows, media formats/codecs, and professional editing platforms (Avid, Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve)
•    Experience with cloud storage platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI), enterprise file transfer systems (Signiant/Media Shuttle, Aspera), and MAM/DAM or archive systems
•    Basic understanding of live and near-live production and streaming ingest workflows
•    Ability to make and own operational decisions for the betterment of clients, balancing the team's ability to support those decisions
•    Strong cross-functional communication skills, with experience supporting multiple brands, productions, and stakeholder groups simultaneously
•    Willingness to travel and support on-site production workflows as needed, including off-hours coverage
•    Experience managing a team

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Overview: 

The Sr. Manager, Social Media is the strategic lead for assigned titles on the Paramount+ Social team. This person owns the end-to-end social strategy for their title portfolio - translating marketing priorities into fan-forward social campaigns with a defined strategic and creative POV. This role is pivotal in leading the day-to-day planning and execution of social media campaigns, creative ideation and production, and working closely with Marketing, Creative, Publicity and other internal and external stakeholders. The ideal candidate has prior experience working in digital marketing and/or social media, creating partnerships with colleagues across divisions, and is enthusiastic about entertainment.   This position reports to the Director, Social Media on the P+ team.   This is an onsite position at our New York office.   

Responsibilities Include but not limited to:

  • Craft data-driven social strategies for campaigns through platform-native creative and ongoing fan engagement
  • Build and maintain social content calendars per title in AirTable, covering both launch campaigns and always-on publishing across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and YouTube
  • Develop tone of voice across multiple properties and platforms and ensure that all content and copy adheres to the established brand
  • Anticipate cultural trends and identify how assigned IP can authentically participate to drive earned media and deepen fan relationships
  • Consistently refine and optimize content and formats based on social insights and evolving best practices
  • Ideate talent-based and footage-based content that ladders up to overall campaign creative, and work alongside producers and editors through production and post-production process
  • Interface with talent and Executive Producers as needed to present creative ideas, shoot concepts, and social strategy
  • Collaborate closely with Paramount+ teams across Marketing, Creative, Publicity etc.
  • Bring a creative mind to frequent brainstorming sessions to pitch new social content ideas that you will lead from ideation to execution
  • Oversee the paid social creative delivery and approvals process, ensuring all content is on-brand, platform-optimized, and delivered on time
  • Lead and mentor Coordinators on day-to-day publishing, execution, and creative development

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in social media, digital marketing, television, and/or entertainment

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated track record of developing and executing innovative social/digital marketing campaigns
  • Insight with tactics used to build fan communities
  • Proficiency in social content development, execution and best practices across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and X
  • Deep knowledge of existing and emerging social platforms
  • Robust project management skills with the ability to manage multiple titles and timelines simultaneously
  • Exemplary written and verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Knowledge of scripted television production and the content marketing lifecycle

Overview

Reporting to team leadership, this role manages a project-based team of 3-5 resources building cloud-native media platforms, workflow automation, integrations, and AI-driven production services. 


The Senior Manager translates management's technical direction into executable engineering plans and owns day-to-day delivery, implementation quality, and production readiness. The role stays hands-on in solution design, code review, and high-risk work, and serves as a senior day-to-day technical lead, maintaining continuity of execution and technical direction. 

 


Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years hands-on software engineering experience building enterprise applications, APIs, or distributed systems.

  • Strong communication skills, able to translate technical risk and trade-offs for nontechnical stakeholders, with sound judgment under strain and the ability to influence across teams and vendors without direct authority. 

 


Core Responsibilities
Engineering & People Leadership

  • Select, onboard, direct, and evaluate consultant resources; manage vendor performance, project capacity, deliverables, and structured knowledge transfer as assignments change.

Engineering Delivery

  • Translate architecture direction into technical plans, milestones, staffing, and releases.

  • Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs to leadership and stakeholders.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide day-to-day technical direction within architecture standards set by leadership.
  • Set expectations for code quality, testing, APIs, documentation, security, and deployment automation.
  • Promote reusable services and integrations over one-off solutions.
  • Escalate significant architecture, platform, and vendor decisions to leadership.
  • Maintain enough architectural depth and institutional knowledge to represent the team's technical direction independently when leadership is unavailable. 


AI Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Lead delivery of cloud-native services, media workflow integrations, metadata platforms, archive modernization, and content migration initiatives.

  • Set standards for responsible use of AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent); ensure AI-generated code is reviewed, tested, and documented to normal engineering and security standards.

Production Ownership

  • Own production readiness and engineering support for services built by the team.
  • Ensure monitoring, runbooks, deployment procedures, rollback plans, and escalation paths are in place.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring defects and reliability issues.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between frontline operational support and engineering escalation.

job.title: Sr. Software Engineer Cloud infrastructure
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview

The Applied Intelligence Data Engineering team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure. This is a hybrid role that blends deep software engineering with hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure. It is purpose-built for engineers who are equally writing production Java services and designing multi-cloud platform architecture.

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of cloud-native systems. You will build high-performance streaming applications and architect the infrastructure they run on. You will also ensure both are production-grade, observable, and secure. You will bridge application and platform engineering, reducing the gap between what software teams need and what the cloud platform delivers.

This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes, and software engineering best practices. You should have a track record of operating at both the application and infrastructure layers.

 

Key Responsibilities

Optimize Data Streaming Applications on Cloud

  • Own end-to-end performance of data streaming applications running on cloud infrastructure — from Kafka topic configuration through consumer processing and downstream delivery.
  • Profile and tune streaming pipelines to maximize throughput and minimize latency, leveraging cloud-native compute, storage, and networking resources.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks at the intersection of application code and cloud resource constraints, including CPU throttling, network saturation, I/O limits, and memory constraints.
  • Design and implement cloud resource utilization strategies. This includes spot/preemptible instances, managed streaming services, and dynamic node pool scaling to balance performance with cost efficiency.
  • Benchmark streaming pipelines end-to-end and translate findings into actionable infrastructure and code improvements.
  • Collaborate with Data and AI/ML engineering teams to ensure streaming pipelines are optimally provisioned for real-time feature engineering, inference, and analytics workloads.


Design & Build Cloud-Native Applications

  • Develop high-throughput, low-latency streaming applications using Java and Kafka.
  • Design event-driven microservices that process, enrich, and route real-time data at scale.
  • Implement reactive, non-blocking architectures to support high concurrency and resilience.
  • Develop reusable streaming frameworks, libraries, and platform capabilities to improve engineering velocity and standardization.


Architect & Operate Multi-Cloud Infrastructure

  • Architect, implement, and optimize multi-cloud infrastructure across GCP and OCI to support large-scale data and streaming workloads.
  • Design and implement advanced networking architectures, including VPC peering, VPNs, load balancers, and cross-region failover strategies.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code frameworks to standardize deployments and enable developer self-service.
  • Define autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization strategies for high-volume production systems.
  • Contribute to platform-wide architecture decisions related to scalability, resiliency, high availability, and disaster recovery.


Kubernetes & Container Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments (GKE, OKE) across cloud platforms.
  • Implement container orchestration best practices, service-mesh configurations, and rolling-deployment strategies.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to improve developer tooling, deployment automation, and runtime reliability.

 

Production Reliability & Performance

  • Ensure production-grade reliability, observability, and operational maturity across streaming platforms and infrastructure.
  • Implement comprehensive observability using Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and health monitoring.
  • Optimize systems for throughput, latency, resiliency, resource efficiency, and cloud cost governance.
  • Build automated testing strategies for streaming and infrastructure workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortems to improve uptime and reduce operational risk.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate streaming architectures with batch processing, data lakes, and analytical platforms.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.
  • Work closely with AI/ML engineering teams to support real-time feature engineering, inference pipelines, and operational AI workload.
  • Clearly communicate technical tradeoffs to engineering stakeholders. Also, discuss scalability considerations and operational risks.

 

Technical Management

  • Lead architectural discussions, design reviews, and technical deep dives across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure.
  • Drive engineering standards across code quality, documentation, observability, security, and platform maintainability.
  • Influence long-term technical strategy and modernization initiatives for real-time data infrastructure and cloud platforms.

 

Required Technical Skills

Streaming Optimization & Cloud Resource Utilization

  • Deep expertise in optimizing data streaming applications for throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency across cloud environments.
  • Proficient in tuning Kafka producers, consumers, and brokers — including batch sizing, compression, partition strategies, and consumer lag management — within cloud-hosted deployments.
  • Experience leveraging cloud-native managed services (e.g., Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub, BigQuery Streaming; OCI Streaming) to complement or extend Kafka-based pipelines.
  • Skilled at right-sizing and dynamically allocating cloud compute resources (VMs, node pools, spot/preemptible instances) to match streaming workload profiles and reduce infrastructure spend.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native autoscaling patterns for streaming consumers, including KEDA, HPA, and custom metrics-based scaling in Kubernetes.
  • Ability to identify and address performance bottlenecks at the intersection of application code and cloud resource limits
  • You should have experience benchmarking and profiling streaming pipelines from start to finish. You also need to turn your findings into improvements for infrastructure and code.

 

Basic Qualifications

This is a hybrid role. Candidates must have hands-on experience in both software engineering and cloud infrastructure.

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering and cloud infrastructure, with at least 3+ years in each area.
  • Demonstrated expertise in optimizing data streaming applications on cloud infrastructure.
  • Proven track record building and operating production-grade real-time data platforms.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and collaborating across teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

#LI-PV1

 

Paramount Streaming, a division within Paramount Global, is the home to the company's direct-to-consumer services spanning free and paid in the form of Pluto TV and Paramount+. Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview

It will build fault-tolerant streaming applications supporting real-time analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and critical data services. This role will design and build high-performance, fault-tolerant streaming applications that power real-time analytics, APIs, AI workflows, and mission-critical data services across the organization. You will architect and implement distributed, event-driven systems using Java, Kafka, Kubernetes, and modern reactive frameworks. As a senior engineer, you will set the technical direction. You will mentor other engineers. You will also ensure that our streaming platforms are reliable, scalable, and operate smoothly. This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, concurrency, and cloud-native microservices.

 

Primary Responsibilities

Design & Build Real-Time Streaming Applications

  • Develop high-throughput, low-latency streaming applications using Java and Kafka.
  • Design event-driven microservices that process, enrich, and route real-time data at scale.
  • Implement reactive, non-blocking architectures to support high concurrency and resilience. Create reusable streaming frameworks and libraries. These will help improve engineering efficiency and standardization across the platform.

 

Architect Scalable Distributed Systems

  • Design and optimize distributed streaming architectures. You will work with Kafka topics, partitioning strategies, consumer groups, schema management, and event lifecycle patterns.
  • Help make architecture decisions for the whole platform. This includes scalability, resiliency, high availability, disaster recovery, and deployments across multiple regions.
  • Drive best practices around event modeling, schema evolution, idempotency, replayability, and data consistency across streaming systems.
  • Build and optimize horizontally scalable services deployed within Kubernetes-based cloud environments.
  • Production Reliability & Performance Make sure that streaming platforms and services are reliable and easy to monitor. Keep these systems operationally mature.
  • Optimize systems for throughput, latency, resiliency, resource efficiency, and infrastructure cost management. Set up full observability using metrics and centralized logging. Use distributed tracing, alerting, and health monitoring tools.
  • Build automated testing strategies for streaming workflows, including unit, integration, contract, chaos, and performance testing.
  • Participate in production support. Help with incident response and root-cause analysis. Work on initiatives to improve reliability continuously.

 

Cloud-Native & Kubernetes Engineering

  • Deploy and manage containerized microservices within Kubernetes environments across GCP, AWS, or similar cloud platforms.
  • Define strategies for autoscaling, deployment, failover, and resource optimization. These strategies will focus on high-volume production systems.
  • Create and manage CI/CD pipelines. This includes Infrastructure-as-Code and workflows for automated deployment.
  • Collaborate with platform engineering teams to improve developer tooling, deployment automation, and runtime reliability.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to integrate streaming architectures with batch processing systems, data lakes, and analytical platforms.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and API teams to enable real-time services and data-driven applications.
  • Work closely with AI/ML engineering teams to support real-time feature engineering, inference pipelines, and operational AI workloads.
  • Clearly explain the tradeoffs of different technical options. Discuss scalability considerations and operational risks with engineering stakeholders.

 

Required Technical Skills 

Java & Reactive Programming

  • Advanced proficiency in Java, including concurrency, multithreading, and JVM performance tuning.
  • Strong experience with reactive frameworks such as Spring WebFlux, Project Reactor, or similar.
  • Deep knowledge of asynchronous, non-blocking system design. Kafka & Event-Driven Architecture
  • Extensive experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, streams, schema registry).
  • Strong knowledge of partitioning strategies, offset management, rebalancing, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing event schemas and managing schema evolution.
  • Familiarity with Kafka Streams, Flink, or similar stream-processing frameworks.

Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Systems

  • Strong hands-on experience deploying and operating applications in Kubernetes. You should have experience using Docker for containerization. It's also important to have knowledge of microservices architecture. You should understand how autoscaling functions. You also need to learn about rolling deployments. It's important to know patterns that ensure reliable production.

 

Basic Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years working on streaming or distributed systems. You should have experience in designing, building, and running production-grade real-time systems. This includes event-driven systems. You should be comfortable working in cloud-based systems that use microservices. This includes engineering environments that focus on these technologies.
  • Ability to take ownership of complex technical work and deliver reliable solutions autonomously.
  • Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team engineering standards.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering and product teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field; advanced degree preferred.

#LI-PV1

Pluto TV is the global leader in free ad-supported TV, delivering more than 1,400 global channels and an extensive library of streaming content, including live and original channels. Paramount+, digital subscription video-on-demand and live streaming service, combines live sports, breaking news, and A Mountain of Entertainment™. Paramount+ features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including SHOWTIME®.

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.


About Inside Edition:

Inside Edition is television's longest-running, top-rated, and most-honored syndicated newsmagazine. It is a daily, half-hour, nationally syndicated show that focuses on national issues, medical, health, human interest, animal stories, and backstage reports from the entertainment industry. The program also offers exclusive newsmaker interviews and investigative reports.  

Overview:

Inside Edition is looking for a story coordinator for its award-winning TV news program. The position is an exemplary opportunity for someone who is committed to consumer, investigative, entertainment, and features reporting and is looking for an entry-level job with strong growth potential. This position is full-time, non-staff, with a staffing opportunity. Story Coordinators work closely with producers to find and coordinate all aspects of TV news segments. Candidates must have exemplary research, phone, and people skills. Duties involve securing interviews and gathering information, doing background research utilizing public records, and conducting pre-interviews.   This is a full-time position. The salary range is $45,000-$55,000 annually, with overtime eligibility.  

Basic Qualifications:

  • Some prior reporting experience in television or print.
  • Must be a highly motivated self-starter.
  • Strong written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • A passion for local and national news.
  • Proficient in technology and social media.
  • Able to travel and work nights/weekends as necessary.
 

Additional Qualifications:

  • B.S or B.A. Degree or equivalent.
  • Booking experience in television or media.
  • A working knowledge of government, courts, law enforcement, and FOIA.

 

 

CBS Media Ventures is the preeminent company in television syndication. CMV produces or distributes popular, critically acclaimed hits including “Dr. Phil,” “Judge Judy,” “Entertainment Tonight,” “Wheel of Fortune,” “Jeopardy!,” “Inside Edition,” “Rachael Ray” and “The Drew Barrymore Show.”

The division also handles national barter advertising sales for Debmar-Mercury's and Fox's first-run syndicated programming, and operates Dabl, a multiplatform, advertiser-supported lifestyle network (www.dabl.com). CMV is part of CBS Entertainment Group and a division of Paramount Global.

Your Day-to-Day 

● Assist Producers and Associate Producers with the day-to-day production of CBS Sports Digital programming. 

● Build and fire live studio graphics using Ross XPression. 

● Capture, edit, and assemble video clips using Adobe Premiere and other non-linear editing systems.

● Prepare highlights, one-plays, interviews, and other video content for distribution across CBS Sports Digital platforms. 

● Screen and organize video content for use across digital and streaming platforms.

● Edit, encode, and publish video content for digital distribution. 

● Assist with the preparation of video, graphics, scripts, and other elements for live programming. 

● Support control room and studio production as assigned. 

● Help maintain accurate and organized production materials, files, and content.

● Work closely with Producers and Associate Producers to fulfill day-to-day production requests. 

● Assist with special events, breaking news coverage, and other high-priority programming as needed. 

Key Projects 

● Assist with the production of live shows, podcasts, segments, and other digital programming. 

● Help identify and prepare compelling video and graphic elements for programming.

● Support the creation and distribution of content across streaming, digital, mobile, and social platforms. 

 

What You Bring to the Team 

● Bachelor’s degree in communications, digital media production, broadcasting, video production, or a related field preferred. 

● 1+ years of experience in broadcast, digital media, video production, or a related field preferred. 

● Knowledge of fundamental video editing and encoding concepts. 

● Proficiency with or working knowledge of Adobe Premiere. 

● Familiarity with graphics systems such as Ross XPression is a plus. 

● Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow direction in a live production environment. 

● Strong organizational and time management skills. 

● Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities while working under tight deadlines.

● Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with Producers, Associate Producers, and other production staff. 

● Strong understanding of digital, streaming, mobile, and internet platforms.

● Must be willing and able to work flexible hours, including early mornings, weekends, overnights, holidays, and other shifts as needed. 

● Strong knowledge of major and minor professional and collegiate sports.

● Passion for sports and an interest in sports media and digital programming.

 

 

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Live Services Automation
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

Paramount+ streams some of the biggest live sports and events in the world, and our Live Services Product (LSP) oversees the backend platform that makes it possible. LSP provides operators with one experience through our Live Events CMS. The live services automations team supports this. They create specialized services to manage provider integrations. They also oversee orchestration, automation, and distribution. Each of these services is separate.

 

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to expand the Live Services Automation area within LSP. This includes systems that automatically process incoming live signal inputs. You will set up and manage channel infrastructure. You will also make sure that each live show element is checked and ready before it goes on air. Finally, you will consistently distribute live content to our target destinations for the Paramount+ experience.

 

This is a deeply technical, backend-first role. The Live Events CMS owns the operator-facing surface, and you own the domain logic underneath it that extends its functionality through automation with 1st party/3rd part integrations. You'll partner closely with the CMS product owner to make sure the workflows you build surface cleanly through the CMS, and you'll report to the Live Services lead on platform strategy and vision.

 

Experience with live streaming, broadcast, or real-time systems is strongly preferred. We want someone who understands the ecosystem and its challenges. They should know what works and what might fail during a live event. This knowledge will help them build systems that work well and can recover automatically. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

Own Backend Platform Strategy

 

  • Shape and ship the roadmap for the Live Services Platform. Focus on automation, workflows, and links between systems.

  • Build services that scale with every live event. Cover the full path from scheduling to playback and monitoring.

 

Drive Automation & Orchestration

 

  • Design automation that removes manual steps from live event setup.

  • Build "self-healing" workflows that boost reliability and cut extra   work.

 

Lead Integrations Across Systems

 

  • Own the links between Summit and other systems. This covers scheduling, channels, listings, signal acquisition, and monitoring.

  • Keep data flowing smoothly across internal platforms and third-party services.

 

Translate Operations into Systems

 

  • Partner with Live Operations and Engineering. Turn real-time needs into backend  solutions that scale.

  • Spot bottlenecks and design systems that run better at scale.

 

Define Technical Solutions

 

  • Write clear product docs with senior engineering and product leads. This covers API contracts, workflows, sequence diagrams, and system designs.

  • Give engineering teams clear direction on architecture, dependencies, and      integration patterns.

 

Agile Product Ownership

 

  • Act as Product Owner for a devoted engineering team.

  • Manage the backlog, set priorities, and ship deeply technical platform features.

 

Cross-Functional Management

 

  • Align stakeholders across product, engineering, and operations on backend      platform strategy and delivery.

  • Support big live event launches with systems that never miss a beat!

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 2-4 years in Technical Product Management or a closely related engineering role, with hands-on depth in backend systems, APIs, and/or platform products.

  • A track record of shipping automation, orchestration, or distributed integrations.

  • You should have a solid knowledge of event-driven architecture. You should also know about workflow orchestration and contracts between services.

  • Comfort living in APIs, system links, and data flows; UI experience is not needed.

  • Well-developed technical writing: API specs, sequence diagrams, system workflows.

  • Experience owning a backlog and leading technical delivery on an Agile team.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Live streaming, live sports, or broadcast operations experience — you understand the stakes of a live event and how automation reduces them.

  • Experience integrating third-party data providers (stats, scheduling, listings, or similar feeds) into a platform via versioned contracts.

  • Knowledge of reliability patterns: retries, reconciliation and observability at scale.

 

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.title: Technician
job.description:
CBS News Chicago is in search of a skilled and experienced news production talent. Ideal candidate will have an expert understanding of local news production. Candidate will have both field, studio and transmission experience. Will support broadcast and multi-platform social media strategies and cbschicago.com. Studio duties included but not limited to teleprompter, jib operator, editing, transmission control and field duties including professional operation of broadcast cameras, drones, digital microwave, non-linear editing systems, and IP based broadcast applications.

 

This is a per diem position.

 

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Candidates should demonstrate knowledge and experience with all aspects of ENG news and studio production, including Sony HD cameras, Edius non-linear editing, jib, teleprompter and lighting.
  • Safely operating company vehicles, including microwave equipped vans and trucks, on potentially long drives in all weather conditions.
  • Bring creativity and imagination to the job of broadcast storytelling
  • Ensure that all daily show production deadlines are met
  • Take extreme care to ensure that news equipment is protected from theft and damage.
  • Consistently contribute to editorial process in team environment with story ideas and attention to production strategy.
  • Other duties, as assigned.
  • All shifts including, nights, weekends, early mornings and holidays.
  • Will fill shifts based on production needs including vacation relief.

 

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Results-Oriented and Innovative
  • Excellent storytelling skills
  • Ability to work under deadline pressure

 

PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Five years’ experience as a photographer, editor and studio technician in preferably in a top 30 market.
  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, media production or similar field preferred or related experience.
  • Familiarity with Chicago area, desirable
  • Strong non-linear editing background, including Edius
  • Valid Illinois drivers license
  • Drone ENG experience with FAA Part 107 certification a plus
  • IBEW Local 1220 Per Diem Technician Position

 

REQUIREMENTS OF CBS NEWS CHICAGO TECHNICIANS

  • Capable of potentially lengthy, physically and emotionally stressful assignments in the field. The unpredictable nature of news assignments often requires extending scheduled shifts on short notice.
  • Physical ability to carry and manipulate at least 75lbs of gear, set up and breakdown broadcast production equipment, usually alone, and on tight deadlines. Activities include driving and positioning large, microwave equipped vans; operating and orienting retractable antenna masts within strict safety guidelines; executing long cable runs of perhaps several hundred feet; carrying, setting up and operating tripods, video cameras and batteries.
  • Capable of driving company vehicles in all conditions and on potentially long (3 to 4 hour) drives to and from assignments.
  • Flexibility regarding assigned work schedule, including the potential of regular shifts that involve weekends and/or late nights and/or overnights.
  • Consistent ability to communicate reliably and credibly, especially about information related to safety issues in the field. Reliably communicate details associated with editorial content of stories and logistical information associated with production deadlines. The ability to gather important information at various news locations.
  • Ability to deal with complex logistical situations in the field including the ability to compete for position with other news media, cope with interference from the public and inter-act with third-parties such as fire, police and security personnel.
  • Consistent ability to interact with the co-workers and the public in a calm and professional manner.
  • Candidate can adapt to writing content for air. Will contribute to social media strategies and multimedia journalism.

job.title: TV Media Finance Intern
job.description:
🎬 Finance Intern (FP&A) – TV Media

Location: [City / Hybrid] | Duration: 12-Month Contract | Commitment: Full-time

 

The Vibe

Ever wondered how major TV shows, streaming deals, and media networks actually make money?

We’re looking for a Finance Intern to join our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team. If you’re sharp with numbers, obsessed with media, and eager to see how modern finance works behind the scenes, this is your launchpad.

You won't just be doing coffee runs—you’ll be working directly on budget modeling, stream-lining workflows, and helping us roll out a massive new ERP system transformation.

 

What You’ll Be Doing (The Real Deal)

  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Help build and maintain annual budgets and forecasts. You’ll pull inputs from different media departments and keep our financial models clean and tight.

  • Reporting & Analytics: Build financial reports and presentations that help senior leaders make real-time decisions about media operations.

  • Hands-On Operations: Keep our financial trackers up to date. You’ll get a front-row seat to how corporate finance operates from end-to-end.

  • Process & Documentation Support: Support the team in documenting existing processes and help identify simple opportunities for automation and simplification (e.g. cleaning up templates, reducing repetitive manual steps).

  • ERP System Transformation: Get direct experience on a major tech implementation—participating in testing, data validation, and rollout alongside senior team members.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Connect with teams across the business to gather insights, answer questions, and keep projects moving forward.

 

What You Bring

  • Education: Currently pursuing a BSc or MSc in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related quantitative field.

  • Spreadsheet Savvy: Strong Excel skills (you know your way around formulas, pivot tables, and clean data structures).

  • Communication: Confident, clear English (written & spoken). You’re comfortable talking to people across different levels and teams.

  • Curiosity & Mindset: Quick to pick up new tools, eager to solve problems, and comfortable asking questions when something doesn't make sense.

 

What’s In It For You?

  • Real Impact: No busywork. You’ll be working on active financial models and major tech projects from week one.

  • Modern Tech Stack Experience: Gain resume-defining exposure to enterprise ERP systems and financial automation.

  • Mentorship: Work directly with experienced finance professionals who care about your growth and career trajectory.

  • Industry Insights: Deep-dive into the TV and media industry, learning how creative projects translate into commercial strategy.

 

Ready to apply?

Send us your resume and a quick note on why you're interested in the media finance space. Let’s build something great together.

Overview:

This role would partner with our Chief Product Officer and org leaders in Media Systems, Production Platform, and Design. The role will architect and drive talent, organizational, and culture strategies that accelerate innovation, elevate creative excellence, and deliver measurable business outcomes.   The ideal candidate is a strategic leader and builder who can navigate the complex intersection of creativity and business. They will design organizational models and leadership frameworks that promote agility, high performance, and growth.

The main objective of the marketing strategy and in-market plans will be to drive viewership, consumer engagement, while delivering unprecedented brand love for the BET brand. 

Key focus areas for the role include developing show launch strategies, leading brief development, and building winning cross functional launch plans that include partnerships with insights, paid media, brand creative studio, digital/social marketing, show experiential, and performance research. The role will also be integral to developing bold and disruptive ideas to further build the BET brand on a local, national, and global basis.

The role will report directly to the EVP of Marketing BET Networks. The ideal candidate will be a skilled and creative marketing professional with robust analytic, strategy, media, and project management skills. One who has a disruptive and curious nature, as well as the ability to solve problems creatively and autonomously will be welcomed to a high performing and dynamic team that is focused on doing meaningful work that matters.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Development and execution of BET brand strategies designed to drive brand health and love for BET
  • Operate as the connective tissue for brands and various corporate departments to share information across the organization
  • Develop marketing briefs by compiling research, insights, competitive analysis
  • Manage delivery of marketing campaigns in collaboration with other departments across disciplines (On-Air, Paid Media, Digital, Social, Press/Special Events, etc.)
  • Create and execute in-market brand events as needed in support of consumer marketing initiatives
  • Identify unique partnership opportunities that reinforce the BET brand
  • Successfully create internal and external presentations (decks, one-sheets, recap reports, etc.)
  • Budget tracking for campaigns and initiatives
  • Analyze performance and monitor partnership investments
  • Make sure improvements are made to meet overall ROI goals

 

 

Basic Qualifications: 

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience
  • Exemplary collaboration skills inside complex organizations
  • Demonstrate robust analytic thinking and ability to operate as a business owner
  • Ability to project-manage from start to finish
  • Top-notch written, verbal communication, and presentation skills
  • Flexibility, initiative, desire for dynamic environment
  • Solid interpersonal, relationship-development skills
  • Effective problem-solver with “can-do” attitude
  • Exemplary attention to detail and proficient PowerPoint skills
  • Well-organized with a deep ability to prioritize and a master at multitasking

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience in marketing, advertising, or media strategy preferred

  • Direct experience targeting the BET core audience 

 


The BET Media Group, a unit of Paramount (NASDAQ: PARAA; PARA; PARAP), is the world's largest media company dedicated to entertaining, engaging, and empowering the Black community and championing Black culture. Connecting Black audiences through a portfolio of brands including BET, BET+, BET Gospel, BET HER, BET International, BET Jams, BET Soul, BET Studios, and VH1, the BET Media Group is a thriving media ecosystem of leading interconnected platforms across cable TV, streaming, digital, studios, live events and international.
