job.title: Maintenance Engineer III, KSHB/KMCI
job.description:
Are you a technically skilled broadcast professional who takes pride in keeping complex systems running flawlessly — day in and day out? KSHB & KMCI in Kansas City, MO are looking for a Maintenance Engineer to join our engineering team and play a critical role in the quality and reliability of everything we put on air. From preventive maintenance and emergency repairs to the full operation of video, audio, and radio frequency (RF) systems — including satellite and microwave equipment — you'll be the expert our team counts on when it matters most. If you love solving tough technical challenges, working with cutting-edge broadcast technology, and making a real impact, this is the role for you.

This job description applies to all employees but may vary depending upon union agreements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Provide world class customer service to all business partners internal and external to the Scripps organization with a positive "can do" attitude.
  • Support, maintain, and install the full range of broadcast, Radio Frequency (RF), and production systems based on both Serial Digital Interface (SDI), and Internet Protocol (IP) based architecture.
  • Setup and enhance software, hardware, server, automation and workflow systems, projects and equipment to enable our teams to be both productive and efficient. Ensure all meet current industry standards and comply with Company policies and expectations.
  • Partner with the news department to develop, build and support content workflow and support systems including integration and problem-solving software, hardware, networking and infrastructure. This will include support and integration of audio and video, cameras, editing systems, streaming, content management and workflow.
  • Use company purchasing management system to purchase and track assets and services as well as replacement cycles. This will include contributing to budgeting planning with the team and Director of Engineering to support business needs.
  • Drive and assist in the operation, support, and maintenance of mobile live trucks which may involve work in confined spaces and on top of vehicle with the use of mobile work platform. Live truck technology may include microwave, satellite, cellular bonding, and video/audio equipment.
  • Resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently, often under pressure.
  • Design improvements to our operation.
  • Maintain logs and reports as per FCC Rules and Regulations.
  • Provide, enhance, and utilize proactive monitoring system to anticipate technical issues and be able to act accordingly.
  • Update technical plan documentation when installations are completed to include changes that are made.
  • Document and maintain records of equipment repairs.
  • Research part numbers and pricing to determine where to purchase and the cost of repairs.
  • Operate studio, news and control room equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associates degree in related field or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 5+ years experience in related field preferred
  • Network certification required (Cisco, CompTIA Network+)
  • SBE certification preferred
  • At least 3 year broadcast operations experience preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Must have working knowledge of all the following areas, and specialize in at least one of these areas: Broadcast and production systems support and engineering including SDI and IP based technology and workflow Extensive knowledge of computer networking, broadcast automation and workflow systems Transmitter support and engineering
  • Strong understanding and ability to work with IT/cellular systems, servers, and devices, and actively pursue emerging technology in these areas
  • Solid working knowledge of software for server and client operating systems including active directory
  • Working knowledge of Computer Aided Design (CAD)
  • Positive "can do" attitude and willingness to learn and grow with the job
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver a high level of customer service
  • Team player
  • Effective communication skills with all level of internal and external customers and partners
  • Ability to resolve complex problems not covered by existing procedures or practices independently often whilst under pressure
  • Knowledge of FCC rules
  • Ability and willingness to learn complex new systems
  • Self-motivated to work independently under timeline to achieve departmental and station goals
  • Ability to comprehend schematics, mechanical drawings and technical manuals
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work within deadlines
  • Familiarity with various test instruments, alignment apparatuses and knowledge of personal computers
  • Deep operational knowledge of studio, news and control room technology
  • Ability to guide and coach colleagues
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule including able to work multiple days, holidays, evenings, weekends, and possible overtime hours as needed
  • Availability to travel over multiple days is possible
  • Must be able to work in changing weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Kansas City is a city with deep roots and serious energy — a place where a world-class barbecue culture, a thriving jazz heritage, and passionate sports fandom come together in one of the Midwest's most livable metros. The 18th & Vine Jazz District celebrates the city's musical legacy, while dozens of renowned BBQ joints have made Kansas City a destination for food lovers from around the country. The Crossroads Arts District pulses with galleries, breweries, live music venues, and some of the region's best restaurants, making it easy to find something new every weekend.

Sports are a way of life here. The Kansas City Chiefs have brought Super Bowl glory to a city that shows up loud and proud, while the Royals, Sporting KC, and the Kansas City Current give fans year-round reasons to cheer. The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, the Kauffman Center for the Performing Arts, and the National World War I Museum and Memorial add rich cultural depth to the city's character. Outdoor enthusiasts enjoy Swope Park, the Missouri River trails, and easy weekend escapes to the Ozarks or the Flint Hills.

Best of all, Kansas City offers an exceptional quality of life at a cost well below the national average. With affordable housing, friendly neighborhoods, a growing tech and creative economy, and a genuine sense of community, it's a city that's easy to arrive in — and even easier to call home.

job.title: Meteorologist (Part Time, Temporary), WMAR
job.description:
WMAR, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Baltimore, Maryland, is seeking a Part Time, Temporary Meteorologist to join our weather team. This is an exciting opportunity to deliver critical weather information to one of the Mid-Atlantic's most dynamic markets. You'll analyze meteorological data and prepare forecasts that help our community stay informed and safe, whether it's tracking severe weather or planning their week ahead.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.
  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.
  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, Radio, Internet.
  • Assist management in evaluations of potential new weather data gathering and presentation computers.
  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Report live from event sites or mobile broadcast unit.
  • May write and produce quality news and weather stories for multiple media platforms.
  • May report, write, capture visual content, edit and produce stories for multiple platforms on deadline, such as Internet and digital channels.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Perform other duties as needed and assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelors degree in Meteorology preferred
  • Generally 3+ years experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including weather and newsroom computer systems
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Knowledge of editing systems
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Baltimore, Maryland, is a vibrant city rich in history and culture, offering an exceptional quality of life on the Chesapeake Bay. Known as "Charm City," Baltimore boasts world-class attractions including the National Aquarium, historic Fort McHenry, and the iconic Inner Harbor. The city's diverse neighborhoods each have their own character, from the cobblestone streets of Fells Point to the artistic energy of Station North. Food lovers will appreciate Baltimore's famous crab cakes and thriving restaurant scene, while sports fans can cheer on the Orioles at Camden Yards or the Ravens at M&T Bank Stadium. With easy access to Washington, D.C., Philadelphia, and the beaches of the Eastern Shore, Baltimore offers the perfect blend of urban excitement and coastal living. The city's affordable cost of living compared to other major East Coast metros, combined with its strong sense of community and rich cultural heritage, makes it an ideal place to call home.

job.title: Meteorologist, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN 9, we know weather is more than a forecast. It helps our viewers plan their days, stay safe during severe conditions, and stay connected to the community they call home. As our Morning Meteorologist, you'll be a trusted voice delivering accurate, engaging, and impactful weather coverage across multiple platforms. You'll analyze data from advanced weather technology, provide critical updates when conditions change, and help viewers understand the stories behind the forecast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative newsroom committed to serving Southern Arizona with urgency, accuracy, and innovation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Analyze weather data from radar, satellite, and other forecasting tools to create accurate forecasts and weather stories.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling daily weathercasts for morning newscasts.
  • Provide urgent weather updates and breaking weather coverage when severe conditions impact the community.
  • Create and present weather content across television, digital, radio, and social media platforms.
  • Evaluate weather developments and identify story opportunities that impact local audiences.
  • Report live from the field, community events, and weather-related locations as needed.
  • Produce weather graphics and visual presentations using modern weather technology and newsroom systems.
  • Write and produce weather and news content for multiple platforms under daily deadlines.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, reporters, and newsroom leadership to deliver comprehensive coverage.
  • Research, gather, and verify information through interviews, observation, and data analysis to create informative weather storytelling.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology preferred.
  • Generally 3+ years of meteorology, weather broadcasting, or related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required for this driving role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong understanding of meteorology, forecasting principles, and weather presentation techniques.
  • Proficiency with weather systems, newsroom technology, and computer-based forecasting tools.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and field reporting workflows.
  • Experience with video editing systems and digital content production.
  • Strong broadcast writing skills and knowledge of AP Style.
  • Ability to create and publish engaging content across websites, social media, and digital platforms.
  • Excellent communication and on-air presentation skills.
  • Strong news judgment and storytelling ability.
  • Self-motivation and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and breaking-weather situations simultaneously.

OUR TEAM:


At KGUN 9, you'll join a passionate team of journalists, storytellers, and weather professionals who are dedicated to serving Southern Arizona. We value collaboration, curiosity, creativity, and community connection. Our newsroom brings together people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, creating an environment where great ideas thrive and meaningful local journalism makes a difference every day.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Tucson offers a unique blend of desert beauty, vibrant culture, and outdoor adventure. Surrounded by stunning mountain ranges and blessed with more than 300 days of sunshine each year, the region provides endless opportunities for hiking, cycling, golf, and exploring the outdoors.


You'll also enjoy Tucson's rich culinary scene, thriving arts community, historic neighborhoods, and welcoming atmosphere. From breathtaking sunsets in the Sonoran Desert to world-class festivals and cultural attractions, Tucson is a place where both career and lifestyle can flourish.

As the trusted voice that keeps the Treasure Valley informed and safe, you'll be at the forefront of weather coverage in one of the most dynamic and growing markets in the Mountain West.

  • Prepare and deliver daily weathercasts utilizing all available weather data and graphics computers.

  • Prepare and deliver urgent weather updates interrupting regular programming as necessary.

  • Prepare and deliver all weathercast materials over a variety of mediums, including, but not limited to: TV, radio, streaming, and digital platforms.

Boise, Idaho offers an unbeatable quality of life where outdoor adventure meets urban sophistication. As one of the fastest-growing cities in America, Boise combines small-town charm with big-city amenities. The city sits at the base of the stunning Boise Foothills, offering immediate access to world-class hiking, mountain biking, and skiing at Bogus Basin—just 16 miles from downtown. The Boise River Greenbelt winds through the heart of the city, providing 25 miles of scenic pathways perfect for running, cycling, or leisurely strolls.

Downtown Boise boasts a thriving food and craft beer scene, vibrant arts and culture including the Boise Philharmonic and Idaho Shakespeare Festival, and professional sports with the Boise State Broncos. The city enjoys four distinct seasons with over 200 days of sunshine annually, making it perfect for year-round outdoor recreation. With a growing tech sector, affordable cost of living compared to other Western cities, and a welcoming community atmosphere, Boise truly offers the best of both worlds—urban energy and natural beauty at your doorstep.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KRTV
job.description:
At KRTV, we tell the stories that matter most to the communities we serve. As a Multimedia Journalist, you'll research, report, shoot, write, edit, and deliver compelling local news content across multiple platforms. You'll be at the center of breaking news, community events, and impactful storytelling, helping viewers stay informed and connected.


This role offers the opportunity to build strong relationships throughout the Great Falls community while developing engaging content for broadcast, digital, and social audiences. If you're a passionate storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom, we'd love to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Research, develop, and pitch story ideas from news leads, tips, and community sources.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation, and independent research.
  • Write clear, accurate, and engaging stories that meet broadcast and digital editorial standards.
  • Capture high-quality video and still photography to support storytelling efforts.
  • Edit video content for television broadcasts, websites, social media channels, and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news, community events, and special coverage.
  • Appear on-air for interviews, narrations, and news presentations.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and newsroom colleagues to create compelling content.
  • Assist producers with newscast preparation and content development.
  • Partner with digital teams to publish and promote stories across multiple platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of journalism, reporting, multimedia, or related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, strong driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company requirements.
  • Ability to travel locally for assignments and drive company or personal vehicles as needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong broadcast writing skills with knowledge of AP Style.
  • Experience with videography and non-linear editing systems preferred.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Experience editing video using Final Cut Pro or similar editing platforms.
  • Proficiency with newsroom computer systems and digital publishing tools.
  • Ability to post and manage content across websites and digital platforms.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and storytelling skills.
  • A self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:


At KRTV, you'll join a passionate team of journalists, storytellers, content creators, and community advocates dedicated to delivering trusted local news. We value collaboration, curiosity, innovation, and integrity. Our newsroom brings together people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives who share a commitment to serving viewers and making a meaningful impact across north-central Montana.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Great Falls offers an exceptional quality of life with easy access to some of the most breathtaking landscapes in the American West. Situated along the Missouri River and surrounded by Montana's natural beauty, the area provides endless opportunities for outdoor recreation, including hiking, fishing, camping, skiing, and wildlife exploration.


Whether you're enjoying local restaurants, exploring nearby state parks, visiting cultural attractions, or taking in panoramic mountain views, Great Falls combines small-town friendliness with big outdoor adventure. It's an ideal place for journalists who enjoy connecting with their communities while experiencing all that Montana has to offer.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, WKBW
job.description:
WKBW, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Buffalo, NY, is looking for a passionate Multimedia Journalist to join our team. In this role, you'll research, write, capture visual content, and edit stories that inform and engage our community — from the field to the digital screen. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom and are ready to make a real impact on the audience we serve, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills
  • Proficient at posting content to various websites
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Buffalo, NY, is a city with serious heart — a place where gritty determination meets genuine community pride. Situated on the eastern shore of Lake Erie in western New York, Buffalo has undergone a remarkable revitalization, with a booming culinary scene, a thriving arts community, and a waterfront that draws visitors and residents alike. The city is, of course, the birthplace of the Buffalo wing, and its food culture runs deep — from beef on weck at neighborhood taverns to sponge candy from beloved local chocolatiers. The rejuvenated Canalside district pulses with concerts, festivals, and waterfront activities year-round.


Culture runs deep in Buffalo, too. The Buffalo AKG Art Museum (formerly the Albright-Knox) is one of the oldest public art institutions in the country and houses one of the most significant modern art collections in the world. Frank Lloyd Wright's Darwin Martin House and the city's magnificent Olmsted-designed park system — one of the most intact in North America — speak to Buffalo's extraordinary architectural heritage. Shea's Performing Arts Center brings Broadway touring productions and world-class performances to a stunning Rococo Revival theater right in the heart of downtown.


And if you love sports, Buffalo is your town. The beloved Buffalo Bills (NFL) and the Buffalo Sabres (NHL) inspire some of the most passionate fan bases in professional sports. Beyond the games, outdoor adventure is always close at hand — Niagara Falls is just 20 miles away, and the surrounding region offers hiking, skiing, boating, and state parks in every season. Buffalo is a city that rewards those who put down roots, offering an affordable cost of living, a welcoming spirit, and a community proud of its comeback story.

WMAR, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Baltimore, MD, is looking for a passionate, versatile journalist to research, write, capture visual content, and edit compelling stories across multiple platforms. You'll be the voice for the Annapolis/Anne Arundel County community, bringing important local stories to life while connecting with the diverse audiences that make this region unique. If you thrive in fast-moving environments and love bringing important stories to life for your community, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Receive assignment or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interview, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine angle or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assists in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on television program when conducting taped interview or narration.
  • Give live reports from site of event or mobile broadcast unit.
  • Work cooperatively with photographer assigned to story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producer in preparing newscast.
  • Assist online staff in preparing for multi media stories.

  • BS/BA in related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred
  • Knowledge of broadcast quality camera equipment
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment

  • Proficient at posting content to various websites

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Baltimore is a city with deep roots and a vibrant present. Anchored by the iconic Inner Harbor, the city offers a stunning waterfront experience featuring the National Aquarium, the Maryland Science Center, and the historic USS Constellation. Just a short drive away, Fort McHenry — the birthplace of the Star-Spangled Banner — stands as a testament to the city's storied past. Historic neighborhoods like Fells Point and Federal Hill blend cobblestone charm with lively restaurants, bars, and boutiques that draw residents and visitors alike.


Baltimore is a proud sports town, home to the NFL's Baltimore Ravens and MLB's Baltimore Orioles, whose games at Oriole Park at Camden Yards — widely regarded as one of the most beautiful ballparks in the country — are a beloved community tradition. The city's food scene is legendary, anchored by the Chesapeake Bay's famous blue crabs, steamed and seasoned with Old Bay — a Maryland institution. From seafood shacks to James Beard Award-winning restaurants, the culinary landscape here is as rich and diverse as the city itself.


Beyond the food and sports, Baltimore boasts a thriving arts scene anchored by the Baltimore Museum of Art, home to the world's largest collection of Henri Matisse works, and the one-of-a-kind American Visionary Art Museum. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate Patapsco Valley State Park and the nearby Chesapeake Bay for hiking, kayaking, and sailing. And Baltimore's location is unbeatable — situated between Washington, D.C. (about 40 miles south) and Philadelphia, residents enjoy easy access to world-class destinations while calling a truly authentic, dynamic city home.

job.title: Sales Planner
job.description:
Are you a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of media, sales, and storytelling through numbers? Scripps is looking for a Sales Planner to play a critical role in driving linear revenue by crafting compelling proposals, managing campaign performance, and building powerful partnerships with agencies and sales teams alike. In this role, you'll be at the heart of the action — balancing advertiser goals with inventory strategy to deliver results that move the business forward.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Build linear media proposals aligned with pricing guidance, planning strategies, and inventory availability.
  • Partner with internal pricing teams and buying agencies to support negotiations for upfront and scatter buys.
  • Identify opportunities to maximize revenue across linear platforms by adapting plans to market and inventory conditions.
  • Monitor campaign performance against deal guarantees and proactively coordinate schedule adjustments to address under or over delivery.
  • Coordinate execution of on-air linear marketing campaigns from initial pitch through final activation.
  • Support P&I and revenue sales management on ad hoc analyses and projects.
  • Work closely with the Commercial Operations team to meet log deadlines and ensure accurate, timely delivery of all on air elements.
  • Partner with Sales teams and clients to address billing discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with agencies, present media plans/programming opportunities, and maintain ongoing communication.
  • Provide guidance and training to Sales Assistants on sales planning processes, tools, and practices.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong understanding of ad sales terminology and media math
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong problem solving & analytical skills
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a constantly evolving media landscape
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills, ability to multi-task and handle projects independently, as well as part of a team
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel)
  • Wide Orbit Network experience a plus

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


New York City is one of the world's great media capitals — and for good reason. Home to major networks, global agencies, and the pulse of the advertising industry, NYC puts you at the center of it all. The five boroughs offer an unmatched mix of neighborhoods, cuisines, arts, and culture, from the iconic skyline of Manhattan to the vibrant energy of Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island. World-class museums, Broadway shows, and legendary music venues mean there's always something to explore after hours.


Beyond the culture, New York is an outdoor enthusiast's playground in every season. Central Park offers a green escape in the heart of the city, while the Hudson River Greenway, Prospect Park, and the beaches of the Rockaways are just a subway or short drive away. The city's extensive transit network makes it easy to get around without a car, and weekend getaways to the Catskills, the Hamptons, or the Jersey Shore are well within reach.

Whether you're a lifelong New Yorker or arriving for the first time, the city has a way of matching your ambition and feeding your curiosity. With a food scene that spans every corner of the globe, a sports culture anchored by the Yankees, Mets, Knicks, Rangers, Giants, Jets, and more, and a professional network unlike anywhere else, New York City isn't just a place to work — it's a place to grow.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, Nashville
job.description:
Scripps Sports is looking for a passionate, experienced sports sales professional to help drive revenue growth for the Nashville Predators TV Broadcasts on Scripps Sports, one of the NHL's most recognized franchises. As a Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, you'll leverage the power of live sports and the strength of the Predators-Scripps partnership to develop strategic sponsorships, build lasting client partnerships, and create innovative linear and digital advertising and marketing solutions for regional and national advertisers. If you're a proven seller who thrives on developing new business, exceeding revenue goals, and delivering winning solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact with a growing sports media organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect and develop relationships with regional and national accounts to generate new business opportunities.
  • Conduct needs analyses and create customized sports sponsorship and advertising solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Secure appointments, present recommendations, negotiate agreements, and close sales to achieve revenue goals.
  • Create and sell sponsorship packages utilizing acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory, with a primary focus on Nashville Predators partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage the strength and visibility of the Nashville Predators brand to develop creative, integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Collaborate with Scripps national and local Account Executives on strategic sports sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in internal planning meetings to establish sales strategies, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term client partnerships through exceptional service, retention efforts, and referral generation.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to new and existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, sponsorship pitches, and partnership recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Manage all aspects of client service, including media negotiations, proposal development, campaign execution, collections, reporting, and account retention activities.
  • Entertain prospective and existing clients through sporting events and other business development opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client activity, pipeline, forecasting, account information, and revenue projections within CRM systems.
  • Resolve makegoods and other sales-related issues while ensuring client satisfaction.
  • Communicate regularly with sales leadership regarding account status, revenue performance, and business opportunities.
  • Travel up to 25% as needed to support client meetings, sponsorship opportunities, sporting events, and business development activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in sports, media, sponsorship, advertising, partnership sales, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of success achieving and exceeding revenue goals in a highly accountable sales environment.
  • Valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strong understanding of sports sponsorships, media sales, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and develop strategic, customized partnership programs.
  • Exceptional prospecting, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of media sales platforms and advertising solutions.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to confidently present to executives and audiences of all sizes in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and departments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for sports, partnership development, and revenue generation.
  • Ability to effectively represent the Nashville Predators and Scripps Sports brands in the marketplace.

WHAT WE'LL OFFER

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Retirement savings opportunities, including company matching.
  • Generous paid time off and holidays.
  • Employee wellness programs and resources.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The opportunity to represent one of the most exciting brands in professional sports while helping clients connect with passionate fans.
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture where your contributions directly impact business growth and success.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY

At Scripps Sports, you'll join a team that is redefining local sports media and building powerful connections between fans, teams, and advertisers. Utilizing our Nashville Predators broadcasts, you'll help brands tap into the passion, reach, and engagement of live sports while creating partnerships that drive measurable business results. If you're energized by sports, motivated by sales success, and excited about representing a premier NHL franchise, you'll find an incredible opportunity to grow your career and make a lasting impact in Nashville, Tennessee, one of the country's most vibrant sports, entertainment, and business communities.

job.title: Senior Manager, IT Audit (Hybrid - Cincinnati)
job.description:
Join Scripps as a Senior Manager, IT Audit and play a pivotal role in safeguarding our technology infrastructure while driving continuous improvement across the organization. In this critical position, you'll oversee all aspects of the IT control audits. In addition, this position will manage compliance efforts related to the company's IT general controls and assist in the identification and execution of value-adding projects. If you're a strategic thinker with deep expertise in IT controls and a passion for enhancing organizational effectiveness, we want to hear from you!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Manage the planning and execution of audits of IT general controls and automated business applications.
  • Manage the planning and execution of value-adding consulting projects for corporate and operating unit management.
  • Perform reviews of IT audit reports to ensure accuracy and completeness of issues.
  • Assist in identifying and developing value-adding projects within the company.
  • Assist with developing and conducting compliance training programs related to IT internal controls and Sarbanes-Oxley.
  • In collaboration with corporate IT, reevaluate existing control designs and related efficiencies and make recommendations to corporate IT for improvements and efficiencies.
  • Review remediation plans related to IT control audit findings.
  • Participate in the selection and implementation of new or replacement business systems and upgrades across the company to ensure information technology control issues are properly addressed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • CISA certification or equivalent  preferred
  • Prior managerial experience preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Foundational knowledge of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity principles preferred
  • Understand internal control concepts and experience in applying them to document, plan, perform and report on the evaluation of business processes, areas and functions
  • Understand internal auditing standards, COSO, risk assessment practices, and high-level technical aspects of accounting and financial reporting
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on IT general controls and related control concept
  • Demonstrated expertise of information technology and/or information technology-focused audit and reporting practices
  • Ability to plan and execute complex projects, including defining scope, timelines, resources, deliverables, and related risks
  • Strong analytical, interpersonal, and written/verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team on multiple projects

job.title: Senior Producer, Social Media (Remote)
job.description:
The E.W. Scripps Company is seeking a Senior Producer, Social Media responsible for producing video, graphics, editing, ideating and written content for use on all social media channels.

  • Create original video and graphic content for all platforms that aligns with the network's brand.

job.title: Briefing Coordinator, Live Journalism
job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

Semafor seeks recent college graduates with experience working in communications, on Capitol Hill, or within executive offices to support our flagship live journalism events in a temporary role to prepare our journalists, speakers, and attendees for participation at our flagship convening, Silicon Valley & The World. You will collaborate with our content, programming, and events teams to develop briefing materials, prepare background research, gather biographies, and organize key event logistical information. The ideal candidate is highly organized and has an extreme attention to detail, independently motivated, and exceptionally responsive. This is more than an administrative and operations role; it is a fast-paced command center position at the intersection of media, live production, and executive operations.

Your Responsibilities 

  • Compile and synthesize complex logistical information.
  • Draft, format, and distribute briefing packets for VIP speakers, moderators, and attendees.
  • Research key talking points and gather speaker and attendee biographies. 
  • Support Semafor’s events team with other duties as required in preparation for the event. 

What makes you qualified

  • 1–2 years of experience in journalism, communications, Capitol Hill, or executive assistance in a high-velocity environment (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience)
  • Impeccable judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and a calm, customer-service-driven composure when details change
  • Exceptional project management skills with the strongest attention to detail and an ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities
  • Strongest communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Word, and Google Workspace

Compensation:

  • The hourly rate for this position will be $32.00 USD. Individual compensation varies based on job related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility, and qualifications.

 

Additional job details

Semafor offers a Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) policy to our full-time, salaried employees who may take paid time off as-needed without a prescribed limit or defined balance.

Semafor, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and enthusiastically encourages people from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. Semafor, Inc. will consider all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

job.title: Anchor/Reporter/Producer
job.description:
KFDM/FOX Southeast Texas has an opening for a dynamic and versatile Anchor/Reporter/Producer. In this role, you will be required to produce daily content for our morning and noon news programs, produce newscasts on the television side, and create content on a variety of platforms including our web sites and social media accounts.

Qualifications:

  • Must have at least 2 years of on-air experience
  • Live shot experience is required

While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel

job.title: Assistant Chief Engineer
job.description:
Have you always had a knack for problem-solving? Are you the type of person who enjoys being hands-on and also doesn’t mind taking a break every now and then to coach another teammate towards perfecting their craft? Our team needs YOU to continue to elevate our engineering team. The Assistant Chief Engineer plays an imperative role as the go-between resource for the engineering team, leadership, and the location’s personnel. We need a dynamic team lead to help grow the impact of our engineering team! What you can expect working as an Assistant Chief Engineer:

What you can expect working as an Assistant Chief Engineer:

  • To work with a team focused on meaningful relationships
  • A high-energy environment
  • A chance to work on a team supported, influenced & lead by some of the Broadcast Industry’s leading innovators
  • Related on-the-job experience
  • To work at the TV station regularly & to travel with the News team routinely
  • Daily opportunities to learn the art of how-to (re)prioritize.
  • The station’s obstacles and challenges are your challenges.
  • The possibility of unexpected and/or late-night calls for engineering-emergencies at the station
  • Act as the subject matter expert and point of contact for all things as it relates to equipment and technology at the location, as well as stay up-to-date on the new industry standards
  • Provide additional support and resource subject matter expertise in the absence of the Chief Engineer to all staff (including leadership and location personnel, and the onsite Engineering team)
  • Support and assist the News department in maintaining must-have for live production
  • Implement, install & maintain engineering systems and provide end-user support across all departments
  • Provide transmitter support
  • Replace or adjust defective and/or improperly functioning equipment
  • Networking / Wiring
  • Administrative “musts” (i.e., tracking and organizing department-related budget information)

Requirements:

  • On-the-job and/or formal training repairing transmitters
  • Valid & unencumbered driver’s license
  • Work experience, education, and/or formal training/certification in one or more of an engineering-related fields (e.g., technology; information systems; computer science; electrical engineering and/or electronics).
  • Ability to lift 40-50 lbs

Bonus points for…

  • Previous broadcast experience
  • Familiarity with FCC regulations
  • Engineering-related certifications

Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $72,384-$84,431.61 annually and performance based bonuses. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Assistant News Director
job.description:
Assistant News Director — News 4 & Fox 11

The Assistant News Director helps lead the newsroom’s daily editorial, operational and people-management responsibilities. This position works closely with the News Director to deliver accurate, impactful local journalism across broadcast, digital and social platforms.

Key responsibilities

  • Help set and execute the daily editorial agenda, with an emphasis on breaking news, enterprise reporting, investigative work and community-focused coverage.
  • Lead daily editorial meetings; coordinate assignments, live coverage, special projects and major-event plans.
  • Coach reporters, producers, anchors, photographers and digital staff on writing, storytelling, live execution, ethics and urgency.
  • Oversee newsroom workflows, staffing, schedules and performance expectations; assist with hiring, evaluations, scheduling and corrective action.
  • Ensure newscasts and digital coverage are accurate, compelling, visually strong and delivered on deadline.
  • Collaborate with producers and executive producers to improve rundown structure, breaking-news coverage, teases, graphics and multiplatform presentation.
  • Guide coverage during breaking news, severe weather, elections, public safety events and other high-impact situations.
  • Help grow audience through strong local reporting, accountability journalism and content tailored for broadcast, web, mobile and social.
  • Maintain constructive relationships with community leaders, agencies and news sources.

  • Serve as News Director when needed and perform other newsroom leadership duties as assigned.

    Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred.
  • At least five years of television news experience; newsroom leadership experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead under deadline pressure and make sound editorial decisions.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast writing, producing, live coverage, digital journalism and social media.
  • Proven coaching, communication and team-building skills.
  • Commitment to accurate, fair, ethical journalism and compelling storytelling.
  • Flexible schedule, including early mornings, nights, weekends, holidays and breaking-news coverage.
  • This role supports Sinclair’s local-news mission: high-quality reporting that matters to viewers, strengthens accountability and performs across platforms. 
 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace.   • Solid understanding of core hardware, computer systems, and electrical systems
  • Experience working with microwaves, transmitters and satellites is preferred
  • Self-motivated and the ability to work efficiently without direct supervision
  • Confidence in troubleshooting problems and effectively communicating solutions to internal and external customers

  • Must be flexible to accommodate shift changes including extended hours, weekends, and evenings
  • Ability to work on ladders, stand for long periods of time, and lift computers or equipment up to 50 lbs.
  • Associates degree or higher in electronics or a related field is preferred

job.title: Broadcast Engineer
job.description:
WLFL/WRDC is looking for a full-time Broadcast Engineer! This individual will be responsible for installing and maintaining video, audio, and other equipment associated with television broadcasting. This includes server-based record and play-out systems, non-linear editors, master control, production, and routing switchers, Satellite IRDs, encoders, automation, data networks, and broadcast transmission equipment. 

Job responsibilities will include:

  • Maintenance and repair of transmitters (UHF TV, Microwave, Fiber, satellite, etc.), receivers, cameras, switchers, graphic systems, audio equipment, video tape systems, routers, automation/editing systems, intercoms, two-way radios, monitors, and display systems
  • Provide technical and operational support to users
  • Consult and communicate with engineering management and other engineers on technical issues as required
  • Provide specific engineering signal flow diagrams for CAD documentation on all work performed on technical systems
  • Perform all technical work to engineering standards and practices
     

What skills do you need to be successful in our role?

  • Solid understanding of core hardware, computer systems, electrical and electronic systems
  • Ability to read and understand electronic schematics, system diagrams, and follow written troubleshooting instructions
  • Experience working with RF equipment: UHF high power and microwave
  • Self-motivated and the ability to work efficiently without direct supervision
  • Confidence in troubleshooting problems and effectively communicating solutions to the engineering team
  • Hold a valid driver's license
  • Must be capable of taking on-call duties in rotation with the rest of the engineering department
  • Ability to work on ladders, stand for long periods of time, and lift equipment up to 50 lbs.

job.title: Broadcast News Producer, Full Measure
job.description:
Full Measure with Sharyl Attkisson has a great opportunity for you!

Full Measure is a weekly Sunday news program focusing on investigative, original and accountability reporting. The host is Sharyl Attkisson, five-time Emmy Award winner and recipient of the Edward R. Murrow award for investigative reporting. She is backed by a team of award-winning journalists.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated broadcast producer to join the team of the nationally acclaimed broadcast.

Candidates should have experience as a broadcast line producer. We want someone who has the technical skills to manage a broadcast as well as offering experience producing stories/content for a show with high standards for investigative reporting.

The position requires someone with good communication skills, a desire to engage and contribute to an atmosphere of top-level journalists and who has the knowledge of multi-platform production to engage audiences at every level. This is for a person seeking both the challenge and reward of making a great broadcast, even better.

Essential Duties and Requirements include the following:

  • Exemplary verbal and written communication skills
  • Energy and positivity
  • Ability to take direction and work efficiently during breaking news events
  • Must work well in a team environment
  • Must be a self-starter who can generate his or her own story ideas on a daily basis
  • Ability to edit video for stories
  • Ability to create graphics for newscast
  • Ability to work under deadline and on a flexible schedule is required
  • Contribute story ideas to daily editorial meetings
  • Oversee coverage in control room during production.
  • Conduct interviews when required via, phone, email, Skype, or other methods
  • Participate in regular content planning meetings
  • Post content on assigned digital platforms daily
  • Other duties as assigned

 

Qualifications: 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • A minimum of three (2) years’ experience producing engaging television newscasts at commercial news operations
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to learn to execute news strategies and goals
  • Flexibility and on-the-spot problem solving abilities are a must
  • Proficiency with non-linear editing (i.e. Avid) and newsroom systems such as iNews

 

When applying online, candidate must provide examples of newscast they have produced that show exceptional creativity. Please provide a link to your work.

About Full Measure:

Each week, we have a cover story that explores untouchable topics in a fearless way including: immigration, terrorism, government waste, national security and whistleblower reports on government and corporate abuse and misdeeds.

Full Measure is broadcast to millions of households on 177 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks. It also streams live Sunday mornings at 9:30 a.m. ET.

This position requires strong skills in journalism, leadership, and creativity. The candidate will oversee the day-to-day production of the program. This position will also work closely with the Executive Producer and Director on the newscast and its content. In this position, you will contribute content to newscasts and digital platforms.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $57,680 to $72,100. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Campaign Strategist - AMP Sports
job.description:
AMP Sports is looking for a detail-oriented, collaborative Campaign Strategist to support the execution of advertising campaigns across linear, digital, social, podcast, and owned-and-operated platforms.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the center of a fast-paced sports-media business. You will partner closely with Sales, Planning, Account Management, Traffic, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to ensure campaigns are launched accurately, paced effectively, delivered successfully, and managed efficiently from order entry through completion.

The right candidate is highly organized, proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.

What You’ll Do

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Support post-sale execution of advertising campaigns across linear, digital, social, podcast, and owned-and-operated platforms.
  • Coordinate campaign setup, trafficking, flighting, inventory allocation, and fulfillment activities.
  • Monitor campaign delivery, pacing, and performance; proactively identify and resolve issues to keep campaigns on track.
  • Maintain accurate campaign, advertiser, inventory, and order information across company systems.
  • Support make-goods, liability management, inventory adjustments, and campaign documentation.

 

Sales Support & Account Coordination

  • Serve as a primary operational resource for Account Executives, Planners, Account Managers, and other internal stakeholders.
  • Provide timely campaign updates, status reporting, and issue resolution.
  • Respond to campaign-related inquiries and support client-service efforts through proactive communication and follow-through.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Planning, Traffic, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to drive successful campaign execution.
  • Support discrepancy resolution, billing validation, and monthly reporting processes.
  • Assist with inventory management, revenue tracking, and quarterly readiness activities.
  • Help ensure campaign commitments, reporting, and documentation are accurate, complete, and delivered on time.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred.
  • 1–3 years of experience in advertising operations, campaign management, media planning, sales support, traffic, account management, or a related field.
  • Understanding of linear and digital advertising workflows and campaign execution.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Excel and experience working with reporting, inventory management, and campaign-tracking tools.
  • Experience with advertising and workflow platforms such as GAM, Broadway, JIRA, Teams, Megaphone, Sprout, Smartsheet, or similar tools preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

 

The base hourly compensation range for this role is $22.60 to $26.57 per hour. In addition, this role may be eligible for a quartely bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Client Services Manager
job.description:
CLIENT SERVICES MANAGER

WHO WE ARE:

We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team that keeps creative projects, digital campaigns, and client deliverables moving across multiple Sinclair markets. On the Agile Content Creation Engagement Team (ACCET), we partner with Sales, Creative Services, Production, and Digital to ensure every project is executed accurately, efficiently, and on time.

Our mission? Deliver an exceptional client experience by combining operational excellence with creative collaboration. Whether coordinating commercial production, managing integrated marketing campaigns, or supporting high-volume workflows, we help bring great ideas to life while keeping teams aligned every step of the way.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As a Client Services Manager, you'll lead a team of Content Creators while remaining hands-on in the creative process. You'll oversee workflow across multiple Sinclair markets, helping projects move from concept to completion while keeping teams aligned, timelines on track, and clients supported every step of the way.

You'll partner with Sales, Creative Services, Production, and Digital teams to remove roadblocks, coach and develop your team, and ensure every campaign is delivered accurately, on schedule, and with the creative quality our clients expect. When needed, you'll jump in to write, produce, shoot, and edit commercial spots, branded content, and promotional creative. You’ll lead by example to help bring great ideas to life.

YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST:

  • Lead and support a team of Content Creators responsible for producing commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, and client deliverables across multiple Sinclair markets.
  • Coordinate workflow across multiple Sinclair markets, ensuring projects move efficiently from order entry through final delivery.
  • Partner with Sales, Creative Services, Production, and Digital teams to establish priorities, manage timelines, and resolve challenges.
  • Review project requests for completeness, accuracy, and required creative assets before production begins.
  • Track production schedules, revisions, approvals, and air-ready deadlines to ensure timely delivery.
  • Oversee quality control of commercial spots, digital campaigns, and other client deliverables.
  • Contribute creatively by writing, producing, shooting, and editing commercial spots, branded content, and other creative projects as business needs require.
  • Manage workflow through Adobe Workfront and other Sinclair systems while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop team members through training, performance feedback, and workflow best practices.

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE:

  • A passion for storytelling, creative collaboration, and delivering exceptional client experiences.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach teams, inspire creativity, and build accountability.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative mindset with the confidence to work across departments and build strong relationships with internal teams and clients.
  • A continuous improvement mentality with a focus on quality, efficiency, and operational excellence.

 

WHY IT MATTERS:

Behind every successful campaign is a team that keeps the work moving. This role serves as the operational backbone for multiple Sinclair markets while helping shape the creative work itself. By leading talented Content Creators, supporting our partners across the organization, and contributing to production when needed, you'll help create campaigns that connect with audiences, strengthen client relationships, and deliver results.

 

What skills do you need to be successful in our role?

  • 3–5 years of experience in client services, creative services, production coordination, media operations, or account management.
  • Experience leading creative teams or managing high-volume production workflows.
  • Strong understanding of commercial production, digital advertising, integrated marketing campaigns, and creative project management.
  • Ability to write, produce, shoot, and edit compelling commercial and branded content.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Experience with workflow management systems such as Adobe Workfront or similar project management platforms is preferred.
  • Exceptional communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting several markets simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to navigate internal and external employee and client relationships.
  • Must maintain a valid driver's license and good driving record.
  • Ability to routinely lift, carry, and move production equipment in excess of 40 lbs.
  • A college degree is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Sinclair systems, workflows, and operational processes is preferred.

job.title: Client Services Senior Content Creator
job.description:
Are you an experienced creative storyteller who can lead high-quality production from idea through final delivery? Do you strive for “Excellence in Everything” while helping shape stronger creative, support teammates, and keep production moving?

Join Sinclair, Inc. and the Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) as a Senior Content Creator based in our Pittsburgh, PA TV station group. This senior hands-on production role is focused on writing, producing, shooting, editing, and delivering high-impact creative content across multiple markets and platforms.

As a Senior Content Creator, you will own complex client, market, regional, and national creative projects while helping guide creative execution, strengthen production quality, and support the development of other Content Creators. This role is ideal for someone with strong production judgment, advanced hands-on skills, and the ability to lead by example without losing connection to the work.

This is a senior creative role for someone who can step into the most important projects, shape scripts and concepts, produce shoots, solve edits, protect quality standards, and help bring priority work across the finish line.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an ACCET Senior Content Creator, you will create and help lead commercial, branded, digital, promotional, and multi-platform content for assigned markets while supporting strong creative quality, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

Lead High-Quality Creative Production

  • Write, produce, shoot, edit, and deliver commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, promotional creative, and other client deliverables.

  • Own high-profile, complex, or priority projects from concept through final delivery, including scripting, pre-production, field production, editing, graphics, audio, revisions, approvals, and exports.

  • Develop creative that is clear, compelling, strategically aligned, and appropriate for the audience, platform, client, and market need.

  • Maintain high standards for storytelling, visual quality, brand consistency, pacing, sound, graphics, and overall production value.

  • Use strong creative judgment to solve production challenges, improve creative outcomes, and protect the quality of the final product.

 

Support Market, Regional, and National Production Needs

  • Produce creative work for multiple assigned markets while balancing deadlines, priorities, revisions, and client expectations.

  • Support high-profile, priority, multi-market, regional, or national productions as business needs require.

  • Coordinate production details with Client Services Managers, Strategists, Project Managers, Sales teams, clients, and market stakeholders.

  • Help keep production moving during urgent deadlines, high-volume periods, priority campaigns, or complex client deliverables.

  • Adapt quickly to changing production needs, shifting priorities, production constraints, and time-sensitive requests.

 

Provide Creative Leadership and Team Support

  • Serve as a senior creative resource for Content Creators, helping support quality, clarity, creative direction, and production problem-solving.

  • Provide constructive feedback, practical guidance, and creative support to help teammates strengthen scripts, shoots, edits, graphics, audio, and final delivery.

  • Mentor and support Content Creators through knowledge sharing, production best practices, and feedback that helps raise the overall quality of the team.

  • Help translate client, Sales, and market needs into clear creative direction that can be executed effectively.

  • Model strong professionalism, accountability, collaboration, and creative ownership across ACCET.

 

Collaborate Across Teams and Maintain Workflow Standards

  • Partner with Sales, Client Services, Brand, Digital, Project Managers, and market leadership to understand goals and expectations.

  • Participate in creative discussions, campaign planning, production conversations, and feedback exchanges as needed.

  • Communicate clearly about project status, creative needs, production challenges, asset requirements, and delivery timelines.

  • Use Adobe Workfront and other Sinclair systems to track assignments, respond to requests, update project status, and support workflow accuracy.

  • Follow ACCET production standards, file management expectations, brand guidelines, quality-control steps, and approval processes.

 

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE SPECIAL

  • A senior hands-on creative role with impact across multiple television markets.

  • Opportunity to lead and produce high-profile commercial, branded, digital, and promotional content.

  • A chance to support local, regional, and national creative work inside ACCET.

  • A role that combines advanced production skill with mentorship, creative judgment, and team support.

  • A fast-moving environment where storytelling, craft, collaboration, problem-solving, and creative ownership matter.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Advanced writing, producing, shooting, editing, storytelling, communication, and organizational skills.

  • 3+ years of experience in commercial production, broadcast television, creative services, video production, post-production, digital content, agency work, or a related field preferred.

  • Experience with cameras and understanding of lighting set-ups

  • Ability to independently lead polished commercial, branded, digital, or promotional content from concept through delivery.

  • Strong understanding of video production workflows, including concept development, scripting, shooting, editing, graphics, audio, client approvals, revisions, and final export.

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro; experience with After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Audition, or similar tools is a plus.

  • Familiarity with digital video, social media content, OTT/CTV advertising, branded content, and multi-platform campaign production preferred.

  • Experience providing creative feedback, mentoring teammates, or helping guide production quality is preferred.

  • Comfort working in project management systems; Adobe Workfront experience is a plus.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to lift, carry, and move production equipment as needed; valid driver license and good driving record may be required for production-related needs.

  • A proactive mindset focused on creativity, collaboration, accountability, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

 

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

  • You are an experienced creator who wants to lead by example while still staying hands-on in the work.

  • You can write, shoot, produce, edit, shape creative, and solve production challenges at a high level.

  • You enjoy helping teammates grow while maintaining strong standards for creative quality and delivery.

  • You can manage several projects at once while keeping priorities clear, quality high, and deadlines on track.

  • You communicate clearly, take feedback well, and work effectively with creative, Sales, client, and leadership partners.

  • You want to help ACCET deliver meaningful, high-quality creative work across multiple markets and platforms.

 

WORKING HOURS AND TRAVEL

  • Typical schedule is Monday to Friday during standard business hours.

  • Schedule flexibility may be required based on production needs, client deliverables, station events, regional or national productions, or other time-sensitive projects.

  • Some longer days, nights, weekends, or holidays may be required based on business needs.

  • Travel may be required but is expected to be infrequent.

 

If you are ready to lead high-quality creative execution, stay hands-on in the production process, support a strong creative team, and help ACCET deliver impactful work across multiple markets, we want to hear from you.
