job.title: College Marketing Representative, Nashville - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a paid part‑time employee of The Orchard, you’ll serve as a key advocate for the artists we distribute. Each month, you’ll promote 10–20 artists through a mix of digital and in‑person marketing across your campus and college town. You’ll be a tastemaker in your community, collaborating with student organizations, local businesses, record stores, DJs, promoters, and more to build meaningful visibility for new releases and touring artists across a wide range of genres.

In this role, you’ll lead listening events, organize campus activations, and create social media content that directly supports our artists. You’ll gain hands-on experience in music marketing while staying ahead of the curve on emerging talent and new music, all while shaping how students in your market discover and engage with The Orchard’s roster.

What you'll do:

  • Organically create awareness of The Orchard’s artists by cultivating authentic relationships with key campus and local influencers including college radio, student organizations, newspapers, and community media to unlock opportunities for reviews, radio plays, interviews, and standout exposure.
  • Maintain a local social media presence that promotes the artists you’ll be working with, utilizing a mix of digital assets that are supplied to you and creating your own content to support The Orchard’s artists
  • Implement in-person marketing initiatives at record stores, lifestyle shops, and on campus
  • Research appropriate online sites, forums, and networks for the key 18-24yr old demographic for each artist
  • Research & attend local and campus events that will best facilitate the promotion of our artists
  • Attend our artists' shows to hand out promotional tools and get feedback from fans
  • Submit a detailed report on your marketing successes and initiatives for each campaign you run

Perks:

  • You will gain real world music industry experience that will be a great addition to your resume
  • You have the opportunity to express your creativity through your locally run social channels, in our team brainstorms, and in your concert/album reviews
  • You’ll have access to inside information that will improve your marketing outreach
  • You’ll receive free ticket(s) into our artists’ shows & possible meet and greet passes
  • You’ll build valuable relationships within your local music industry
  • + many more!

Who you are:

  • You are an Undergraduate Student currently enrolled in a 4 year university in Nashville with a minimum of 2 years left prior to graduation
  • You are able to manage your own hours and be accountable for the work assigned to you
  • You have a passion for music, an understanding of how your peers discover and consume music, and a deep interest in music business & marketing
  • You have an understanding of social media marketing, you stay current on trends, and you have an active presence creating content on TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube
  • You have availability of 20 hours per week
  • You’re well-written, well-spoken, a team player, and an excellent communicator
  • You have reliable transportation and live within 30 minutes of Nashville
  • You have a flexible schedule for team conference calls and tour coverage

What We Give You:

  • You will gain real world music industry experience that will be a great addition to your resume
  • You have the opportunity to express your creativity through your locally run social channels, in our team brainstorms, and in your concert/album reviews
  • You’ll have access to inside information that will improve your marketing outreach
  • You’ll receive free ticket(s) into our artists’ shows & possible meet and greet passes
  • You’ll build valuable relationships within your local music industry
  • + many more!

job.title: Consultant - Product Designer
job.description:
As Product Designer – Fan Platform & D2C, you will work closely with our SaaS partner, UI/UX, Marketing, and Product teams to develop and enhance features across our fan platform StampEight. You'll translate user and business requirements into clear product specifications, help design and optimize Artist Pages and customer journeys, and support the launch of digital products and experiences across content, commerce, and fan engagement. Success in this role means delivering intuitive, user-centric features that improve the fan experience and contribute to the platform's growth.

What you'll do:

  • Work closely with our SaaS partner and UI/UX team to design, develop, test, and launch new features and enhancements across the Fan Platform
  • Help design and optimize Artist Pages, fan journeys, and other platform experiences to improve usability, engagement, and conversion.
  • Create wireframes, user flows, and product documentation, ensuring features align with business objectives and user needs.
  • Coordinate with Marketing, CRM, Content, and Product teams to support feature launches and ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Monitor platform performance, analyse user behaviour and feedback, and recommend improvements based on data and insights.
  • Gather business and user requirements and translate them into clear product specifications, user stories, and functional requirements.

Who you are:

  • Previous Experience: ~5 years of experience in Product Management, Digital Product Development, UI/UX, or Business Analysis, with experience working on consumer-facing web or mobile applications. Experience collaborating with engineering teams or SaaS platforms is preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design, or a related field. Certifications in Product Management, UX, or Agile are a plus.
  • Skills: Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, user journey mapping, wireframing (Figma or similar), product documentation (PRDs, user stories), Agile methodologies, and product analytics. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Interests: Passion for digital products, consumer technology, music and entertainment, fan communities, and creating intuitive user experiences that solve real customer needs

What we give you:

job.title: Content Creator (Latin Music) - AWAL
job.description:
At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Content Creator will be a key member of our digital marketing team, working across the full AWAL catalogue of artists with a special focus on creating content for Latin region and other diaspora communities within the US.  Your main objective is to generate interest and ultimately streams for our artists, doing so by creating and distributing engaging and sticky content on social media and driving dialogue about your content and the music connected to it.  You must be deeply familiar with Latin music and other global music scenes to succeed in this role. You will have the flexibility to identify the trends you are most excited about, create the content you think will most resonate, and pick the music from AWAL that is the best fit. You will be responsible for strategizing on the best ways and places to distribute that content and for executing on that strategy. In a nutshell, we are looking for someone who is already creating and distributing content through socials, deeply passionate about building a career in music, self-driven in executing strategies that support our artists, and globally minded. Anyone who can join our team and deliver on that mission will find unlimited opportunities for growth at AWAL.

What you'll do:

  • You live immersed in culture, particularly for Latin communities in the US
  • You speak Spanish fluently or natively
  • You are intensely curious and highly creative
  • You create your own path
  • You have experience with content creation, design, editing and copywriting
  • You are chronically online and tapped into current social media conversations & internet trends
  • You are hungry and hard working and as interested in team goals as your own
  • You understand the difference between something real and something fleeting
  • You are proactive and a self-starter
  • You are motivated to make an immediate and tangible impact with your work
  • You want to see your work lead to real artists building real audiences
  • You want to shape the future of music marketing vs following strategies from the past
  • You want a place where an accelerated career in music is within reach

Who you are:

You have previously built and grown social accounts and have independently created content that has achieved virality. Alongside your application, please submit links to the accounts you have created and operated containing the content you have shot/produced/designed/edited.

What we give you:

  • A temporary contract
  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

California based applicants have certain rights under California law. Please see our California Recruitment Privacy Policy for more details.

job.title: Content Planning Assistant Manager
job.description:

job.title: Coordinador, PX & Manejo Oficina, Costa Rica
job.description:
El Coordinador de Experiencia de las Personas (PX) y de Oficina (Consultor) proporcionará apoyo esencial al Socio Comercial de PX y al Presidente CAC en general en la gestión de diversos procesos relacionados con las personas y la administración de la oficina. Este rol se centra en asistir en la gestión del ciclo de vida del empleado desde la incorporación hasta la salida, el desarrollo del desempeño, las iniciativas de compromiso y el cumplimiento de las políticas de PX y la legislación laboral local, asegurando un entorno de trabajo positivo y colaborativo.

El rol contribuye a asegurar una experiencia consistente, justa y de calidad, impulsando el engagement, el desempeño, el desarrollo y la efectividad organizativa mediante prácticas centradas en las personas y basadas en datos.

Lo que haras:

  • Apoyo de Business Partnering
    • Actuar como primer punto de contacto (con supervisión) para consultas de gerentes y empleados/as dentro de su perímetro.
    • Dar soporte al/la PX Business Partner en el día a día de temas de personas, asegurando consistencia con políticas internas y prácticas laborales locales.
  • Ciclo de vida del empleado/a
    • Apoyar procesos de onboarding, seguimiento de periodo de prueba, movilidad interna y offboarding.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de hitos clave del ciclo de vida, garantizando una experiencia positiva y documentación en tiempo y forma.
    • Apoyar los procesos de incorporación, el seguimiento del período de prueba, la movilidad interna y las actividades de desvinculación.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de los hitos clave en el ciclo de vida del empleado, asegurando una documentación oportuna y una experiencia positiva para los empleados.
  • Desempeño y desarrollo
    • Apoyar los ciclos de desempeño (objetivos, seguimiento, evaluación): comunicación, coordinación de tiempos, soporte en herramientas y reporting.
    • Colaborar con el Socio de Negocios de PX para identificar necesidades de capacitación y coordinar acciones con The Learning Curator, Latin-Iberia o proveedores externos.
    • Asistir en el apoyo logístico para los ciclos de desempeño, incluyendo la programación de evaluaciones y el seguimiento de plazos.
  • Engagement y cultura
    • Liderar iniciativas de engagement y cultura, colaborando con y apoyando a los comités internos (p. ej., Comité de Cultura) y Comunicación.
    • Contribuir a la planificación y ejecución de acciones de experiencia alineadas con los valores de la compañía (GPP).
  • Procesos y políticas de People
    • Apoyar el despliegue de políticas, guías y actualizaciones de procesos; ayudar a que los managers comprendan y apliquen los criterios.
    • Mantener documentación de procesos y FAQs; proponer mejoras a partir de dudas recurrentes y feedback.
  • Datos y reporting
    • Recopilar y dar seguimiento a métricas de personas (movimientos de plantilla, ausencias, completitud de ciclos, acciones de engagement, etc.) bajo la guía del Socio de Negocios de PX.
    • Preparar reportes básicos e insights para el PXBP/PX Leadership; asegurar la calidad del dato en sistemas de RR. HH.
  • Relaciones laborales / Employee Relations (rol de apoyo)
    • Apoyar la gestión administrativa de casos (registro, documentación, seguimiento) o cualquier problema de gestión de rendimiento, bajo la guía del PXBP o equipo de People Relations.
    • Coordinar reuniones, comunicaciones y próximos pasos, manteniendo confidencialidad y cumplimiento normativo.
    • Apoyo en proyectos especiales ad hoc y en la administración según sea necesario.
  • Manejo de Oficina
    • Actuar como punto de contacto principal con el propietario del inmueble en relación con todos los asuntos pertinentes a la oficina.
    • Manejar contratos con proveedores, reparaciones y cumplimiento de normativas operacionales de la oficina.
    • Supervisar y coordinar la empresa de limpieza, asegurando el mantenimiento y limpieza general de la oficina, así como gestionar y dar seguimiento a los proveedores externos responsables de servicios y mantenimiento de la oficina.
    • Gestionar el envío y la recepción de correspondencia y paquetería, asegurando su correcta distribución y registro cuando sea necesario.

Quien eres:

  • 3 – 4 años de experiencia en RR. HH., People, Talent, People Ops o funciones similares.
  • Conocimiento intermedio de procesos de RR. HH.: ciclo de vida, desempeño, formación y reporting.
  • Capacidad para manejar información confidencial con rigor y discreción.
  • Organización y seguimiento: gestión de múltiples tareas, cumplimiento de plazos y control documental.
  • Orientación a datos: manejo de Excel/Google Sheets y capacidad de elaborar reportes básicos.
  • Comunicación clara y efectiva (oral y escrita) y capacidad para interactuar con distintos niveles de la organización.
  • Nivel de inglés: Fluidez en inglés (oral y escrita) requerida
  • Empatía y orientación a las personas; capacidad de escucha activa.
  • Proactividad y mentalidad de mejora continua.
  • Atención al detalle y sentido de la responsabilidad.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y colaborar en entornos cambiantes.
  • Resiliencia y buena gestión de la presión en periodos de alta actividad (ciclos, cambios, picos).
  • Mentalidad de servicio: buscar soluciones y facilitar el trabajo de managers y equipos.

Lo que te ofrezemos:

  • Un contrato temporal
  • Unirte a una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y global donde puedes canalizar tu pasión todos los días.
  • Un entorno de oficina moderno diseñado para fomentar la productividad, la creatividad y el trabajo en equipo, empoderándote para dar lo mejor de ti.
  • Inversión en tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional, permitiéndote prosperar en nuestra comunidad vibrante.
  • Espacio para acelerar el progreso, generar impacto positivo y crear lo que viene después.
  • Una plataforma para impulsar el cambio positivo, con oportunidades para contribuir a nuestras iniciativas de impacto social, diversidad, equidad e inclusión

job.title: Coordinator, BLA and A&R Admin - Masterworks
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

SONY MUSIC MASTERWORKS is a multi-faceted worldwide entertainment business specializing in recorded music and live events.

On the music side, SONY MUSIC MASTERWORKS is comprised of the label imprints Masterworks, Sony Classical, Milan Records, XXIM Records, and Masterworks Broadway which collectively, specialize in instrumental music (classical, neo-classical and classical crossover), soundtracks (film & television, video games, anime) and Broadway cast albums.  

MASTERWORKS LIVE! is comprised of fourteen innovative live event businesses, which as a collective conceives, builds, presents and promotes original and IP-based events and experiences in Music, Theater, TV, Film, Gaming, Anime, Sports Entertainment and more.  The division encompasses Backyard Cinema Black Ink Presents, Black Sky Creative, Culture Creative, GEA Live, The Luna Entertainment Group, MAC Global, Proactiv Entertainment, RG Live, RoadCo Entertainment, Roast Productions, Seaview Productions, Senbla, Ltd. and Terrapin Station Entertainment.

Sony Music Masterworks is seeking a Coordinator to provide essential administrative support to business and legal affairs and A&R administration for both recorded music and live. The position is based in Sony Music’s NYC headquarters, but the role is global in scope, requiring frequent contact with our colleagues in Los Angeles, the UK, Europe, Australia and Japan. This position offers a tremendous opportunity to learn, contribute and grow within a team-oriented environment.

The Coordinator, BLA & A&R Admin reports to the Senior Director of Business & Legal Affairs and the A&R Administration Department of Masterworks. This position will liaise with the various departments within the worldwide Sony Music Masterworks Division and Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Inter-Company Accounting, Release Planning, Royalties, Label Artists, their management, and recording studios.

We’re looking for candidates with a passion for the entertainment business as a whole, but with particular interest in music, live events and technology.  Meticulous organizational skills and the ability to pay close attention to detail are a must.  Candidates must also have the proven ability to manage a variety of tasks in a fast-paced environment, excellent oral and written communication skills, and the ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively across departments in a proactive and professional manner.

Who you are:

job.description:
Established in 1997, Sony Music Entertainment is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan, with a presence in over 100 countries through our affiliates. Sony Music's Corporate Development team for Asia & the Middle East works across some of the highest-growth music markets in the world, and has been behind many of the region's most significant transactions. Our work spans M&A and minority investments in music and entertainment businesses, music IP catalogue acquisitions, and strategic joint ventures.

We're seeking a highly analytical Manager to join us, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, Asia & Middle East. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial modeling, commercial analysis, and deal execution, with a genuine interest in music, entertainment, and media.

 

What you will do:

  • Financial Modeling: Build and own the financial models underpinning valuation and deal structuring.
  • Commercial Analysis: Conduct industry and competitor analysis to evaluate potential acquisition and investment targets, joint ventures, and strategic initiatives.

  • Presentation: Draft investment memos to communicate with senior management, crafting compelling stories and presentations that convey complex information clearly and persuasively.

job.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
The Digital Marketing Coordinator is a key support role within the Digital Marketing & Audience Development team, providing hands-on assistance across artist and label campaigns. The role will work closely with Digital, Marketing, Social & Content, Influencer and wider label teams to support domestic and international artist campaigns across paid, owned and earned digital channels. The Coordinator will build and deliver email communications, support database growth and segmentation, and maintain CRM best practice. Alongside this, they will gain broad experience across digital marketing, including social media, content, creator campaigns, digital platforms, reporting and campaign coordination.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is highly organised, digitally savvy, creative and passionate about music and internet culture, and who is looking to develop a broad career in digital marketing.

What you'll do:

Digital Campaign Support

  • Serve as a key contact for the digital marketing team, collaborating with internal managers, artists, labels, and external partners to deliver domestic and international campaigns.
  • Manage day-to-day project workflows, including campaign timelines, tracking documents, asset folders, release links, and general digital housekeeping.
  • Support paid media execution, creator and influencer activations, fan acquisition pages, competitions, and pre-save campaigns

Social, Content & Owned Channels

  • Support the delivery and scheduling of social media plans across label-owned platforms, including TikTok and Instagram, while contributing to overall channel strategy.
  • Capture mobile-first content at live shows, events, and artist shoots, performing basic short-form video editing like cutting clips, subtitling, and adding trending audio.
  • Identify strategic opportunities across social channels and campaign touchpoints to convert social followers into owned channel audiences.

CRM & Audience Development

  • Build, schedule, and execute targeted email and SMS CRM campaigns for artist and label accounts, maintaining the master CRM calendar.
  • Grow first-party fan databases by managing data capture across websites, pre-saves, and competitions while maintaining CRM data hygiene and privacy compliance.
  • Develop, test, and optimise automated fan journeys, sign-up flows, and lifecycle messaging to improve overall campaign conversion.

Reporting & Insights

  • Collect and analyse campaign metrics across social, CRM, paid media, and UGC activity using internal and external reporting tools.
  • Consolidate performance data into regular reports and share actionable insights to inform future marketing strategy and campaign optimization.

Trends, Innovation & Team Development

  • Monitor emerging digital trends, platform updates, streaming features, and internet culture to identify creative opportunities for artists.
  • Prepare internal presentations, case studies, and educational updates for the broader marketing team and assist in key digital partner meetings

Who you are:

  • Passionate about music, digital culture, and how audiences engage with artists across social, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Creative, curious, and proactive, with an interest in audience development, CRM, and content strategy.
  • Data-literate, able to interpret campaign performance and turn insights into action.
  • Highly organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator and collaborative team player who enjoys working with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience in digital marketing, CRM, social media, content, or the wider entertainment industry.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, reporting tools, and the ability to quickly learn new platforms and technologies.
  • Experience working within a record label, music company, creative agency, or similar environment.
  • Hands-on experience delivering social media campaigns, CRM communications, or short-form video content.
  • Familiarity with creative tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, website CMS platforms, fan capture tools, and digital music marketing workflows

What we give you:

  • You join a global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day. 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.

job.title: Digital Marketing Creative Manager – Domestic
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment Indonesia is looking for Domestic Digital Marketing Creative Manager to leads digital campaign strategy and execution for local frontline releases, driving audience growth, fan engagement, and streaming performance across key platforms. Success in this role means turning artist vision into culturally relevant, data-informed campaigns that build strong artist brands and deliver measurable commercial impact.

 

What you will do:

Platform & Audience Growth
•    Drive audience growth and fan engagement across key digital platforms including Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X.
•    Identify platform-specific opportunities to increase visibility, discovery, and conversion for releases and artist brands.
•    Partner with internal and external teams to deliver compelling digital content, rollout assets, and channel activations.


Release Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration
•    Manage campaign execution from pre-release through post-release in close collaboration with marketing, commercial, creative, and artist teams.
•    Ensure timelines, deliverables, and approvals are aligned to support smooth and timely release rollouts.

Performance Tracking & Insights
•    Monitor campaign performance across streaming, social, and content metrics to evaluate effectiveness and optimize in real time.

Market & Consumer Insights
•    Monitor digital trends, audience behavior, and competitor activity to identify new campaign opportunities.
•    Use data and market insights to refine targeting, content strategy, and platform priorities for local releases.
•    Stay close to music, culture, and fan communities to keep campaigns relevant and locally resonant.

 

Who you are:

job.title: Director A&R - AWAL
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Director, A&R with AWAL will be responsible for finding and acquiring recording artists, songs and producers as well as leading artist development efforts for designated artists in their genre. This role will report directly to the SVP, Head of A&R, AWAL North America and can be in New York or Los Angeles.

What you'll do:

  • Find and acquire recording artists, songs and producers through demos, recordings and live performances.
  • Cultivate relationships with artists and representatives and negotiate deals.
  • Solicit producers and coordinate meetings with artists and producers.
  • Spearhead recording, mixing and mastering sessions.
  • Select singles and key tracks.
  • Act as liaison with artist, artist managers and art department regarding marketing concepts.

Who you are:

  • 6-8 years of experience in A&R and artist development.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Strong artist relation skills.
  • Ability to multitask and juggle multiple projects throughout the day.
  • Ability to handle and defuse intense situations.
  • Ability to handle talent relations effectively.
  • Able to work across multiple departments successfully.
  • Ability to understand, manage and forecast budgets.
  • Travel is required as needed.
  • Must be willing and able to attend concerts, artist appearances, and photo and video shoots as requested.
  • Must be able to attend artist performances, recording sessions and rehearsals.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Sony Music Entertainment (SME) is seeking a Director to join our Emerging Technology team. This role is central to SME's work to drive innovation and bring responsible AI solutions into real-world use across the organization.

The Director will operationalize SME’s emerging technology priorities by managing the end-to-end lifecycle for promising AI vendors and tools, from scouting and evaluation through pilots, rollout, and scaled adoption. Working alongside SME labels and external partners, this role will equip teams with new AI tools and skills while running creative and business R&D programs that explore emerging capabilities, surface insights, and reshape workflows.

What you'll do:

Vendor pipeline and evaluation

  • Source and maintain a pipeline of AI companies, tools, and models that address creative and business priorities.
  • Evaluate vendors using defined criteria and document findings to support decision-making.
  • Build and maintain working relationships with existing and emerging AI vendors, staying close on product roadmaps, performance, and implementation needs.

Rollout and adoption

  • Partner with internal teams to guide selected vendor engagements through contracting, security review, approvals, and launch logistics.
  • Execute structured rollouts of approved AI tools across the organization, including stakeholder coordination, user communication, training workshops, onboarding materials, and case studies. Adjust plans based on adoption signals and measured impact.

  • Cultivate internal communities of AI-forward practitioners to develop case studies and support pilots that transform workflows.

R&D programs

  • Lead day-to-day execution of R&D programs to accelerate innovation across content production, business operations, and consumer experiences.

Communication

  • Develop executive briefings and reports to highlight progress, insights, and opportunities.
 

Who you are:

  • Hands-on AI practitioner. You’re a power user of generative AI tools for content production and business workflows, strong in prompt engineering, conceptually grounded in how models are trained and fine-tuned, and ideally experienced with agentic workflows.
  • Active in the AI landscape. You track new models, tools, and vendors as they emerge and quickly assess what's real versus overhyped. You test tools constantly and have well-formed views on which ones actually deliver.
  • Proven execution operator. You've assessed startups or products, run pilots, managed scaled rollouts, and worked with partners to influence execution and product direction.
  • Strong collaborator and capability-builder. Equally comfortable with a quick tactical question or a sustained partnership to help a team unlock new ways of working with AI, with the relationship-building and cross-functional skills to drive lasting impact.
  • Structured but nimble operator. You bring real project management discipline (clear plans, owners, and follow-through) without becoming rigid as innovation work evolves. You deliver through trust and influence with cross-functional partners.
  • Responsible innovation operator. You bring enterprise innovation and change management experience, including enablement (training, onboarding materials, and internal communities). You take projects from concept through adoption while recognizing when they touch governance, policy, or rights considerations, and you raise those questions early.
  • Excellent communicator. You translate technical concepts and user feedback into compelling, actionable recommendations for leaders at every level.
  • Industry experience. Experience in music, media, or entertainment is preferred.

 

What we give you:

job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time. 

What you'll do 

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Prepare management accounts and support the interface between local statutory ledgers and corporate reporting ledgers, including US GAAP reporting requirements.
  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.
  • Prepare and coordinate group tax reporting packages, including information required for corporate tax consolidation and global reporting requirements.
  • Assist with non-resident withholding tax (NRWT) compliance, including review of applicable requirements, supporting documentation, and timely submission of filings.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation while liaising with internal stakeholders, external tax advisors, and tax authorities to resolve queries and ensure compliance.

Audit, Governance & Internal Controls

  • Support year-end statutory audits by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency.

Royalty & Special Projects

  • Prepare royalty statements and financial reporting for joint venture deals, licensing arrangements, and other commercial agreements.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, process improvement projects, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Who you are

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliation processes, and financial close activities.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, currencies, and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and finance teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative finance team environment.

Education and Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, with CA/CPA qualification or progress towards professional qualification preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in accounts payable, general ledger accounting, financial accounting, or a similar finance operations role within a multinational or fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience in invoice processing, purchase order workflows, payment runs, journal entries, month-end closing, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with SAP ERP, Business Warehouse (BW), or other financial systems is preferred, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and internal controls, with experience managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

What we give you

 

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
The Finance Director is the strategic finance business partner to the Country General Manager and regional leadership, providing commercial and financial leadership to drive sustainable business growth and value creation. The role is responsible for leading the country's financial planning and analysis, business partnering, commercial deal evaluation, financial reporting, governance, and compliance, while ensuring strong financial controls and operational excellence.

Working closely with commercial, marketing, A&R, business development, legal, and regional finance teams, the Finance Director provides financial insights to support strategic initiatives, artist investments, licensing and distribution agreements, and other commercial opportunities. The role leads budgeting, forecasting, business case development, and performance management to support informed decision-making and deliver business objectives.

In addition to its strategic focus, the role oversees all aspects of the country finance function, including accounting, treasury, cash flow management, financial reporting, tax, audit, internal controls, and statutory compliance, ensuring adherence to company policies, IFRS, and local regulatory requirements. The Finance Director also drives process improvements, cost optimisation, and effective risk management while partnering with regional finance and shared service teams to deliver a high-performing finance function.

 

What you'll do 

Business Partnering, Commercial Finance & Strategic Planning

  • Partner with the Country General Manager (GM), Regional Managing Director, and cross-functional teams including Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Business Development, Legal, and Business Affairs to evaluate business opportunities and strategic initiatives.
  • Act as the trusted finance business partner, providing commercial and financial insights to support strategic decision-making and sustainable business growth.
  • Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, investments, partnerships, and commercial transactions by developing financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the country, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Deliver insightful management reporting, financial analysis, and performance scorecards to country and regional leadership, providing recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Commercial Transactions, Artist Deals & Strategic Investments

  • Provide financial leadership and commercial support for artist signings, licensing agreements, royalty arrangements, publishing, distribution, and other commercial transactions.
  • Evaluate deal economics, profitability, recoupment structures, investment returns, and financial risks associated with artist contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Partner with Legal and Business Affairs during contract negotiations and deal execution.
  • Support strategic investment initiatives and M&A activities by performing financial analysis, due diligence, valuation, and post-investment performance monitoring where applicable.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management

  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and financial planning in accordance with global finance processes.
  • Ensure accurate revenue, cost, and cash flow forecasting while monitoring performance against financial targets and key business metrics.
  • Prepare monthly management reports, financial dashboards, variance analyses, and forecasts for country management and regional finance.
  • Manage affiliate performance reporting and maintain a single source of financial data for business decision-making.

Finance Operations & Financial Control

  • Lead the country finance function, overseeing accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, payroll, royalty processing, cash flow management, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
  • Ensure accurate preparation of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow) in accordance with IFRS, company policies, and local statutory requirements.
  • Drive operational excellence, finance process improvements, and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency and strengthen financial controls.
  • Maintain effective governance frameworks, finance policies, and internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure compliance.

Risk Management, Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, IFRS, local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and internal control standards.
  • Manage statutory audits and maintain relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Oversee corporate income tax, GST/VAT, withholding tax, transfer pricing, and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and financial risks while safeguarding company assets and investments.
  • Drive cost control initiatives, manage operating expenses and headcount budgets, and ensure efficient use of financial resources.
  • Ensure timely royalty processing, financial reconciliations, and resolution of operational backlogs.

 

 

Who you are

Experience

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
The Finance Director is the strategic finance business partner to the Country General Manager and regional leadership, providing commercial and financial leadership to drive sustainable business growth and value creation. The role is responsible for leading the country's financial planning and analysis, business partnering, commercial deal evaluation, financial reporting, governance, and compliance, while ensuring strong financial controls and operational excellence.

Working closely with commercial, marketing, A&R, business development, legal, and regional finance teams, the Finance Director provides financial insights to support strategic initiatives, artist investments, licensing and distribution agreements, and other commercial opportunities. The role leads budgeting, forecasting, business case development, and performance management to support informed decision-making and deliver business objectives.

In addition to its strategic focus, the role oversees all aspects of the country finance function, including accounting, treasury, cash flow management, financial reporting, tax, audit, internal controls, and statutory compliance, ensuring adherence to company policies, IFRS, and local regulatory requirements. The Finance Director also drives process improvements, cost optimisation, and effective risk management while partnering with regional finance and shared service teams to deliver a high-performing finance function.

 

What you'll do 

Business Partnering, Commercial Finance & Strategic Planning

  • Partner with the Country General Manager (GM), Regional Managing Director, and cross-functional teams including Commercial, Marketing, A&R, Business Development, Legal, and Business Affairs to evaluate business opportunities and strategic initiatives.
  • Act as the trusted finance business partner, providing commercial and financial insights to support strategic decision-making and sustainable business growth.
  • Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, investments, partnerships, and commercial transactions by developing financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses.
  • Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the country, ensuring alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Deliver insightful management reporting, financial analysis, and performance scorecards to country and regional leadership, providing recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.

Commercial Transactions, Artist Deals & Strategic Investments

  • Provide financial leadership and commercial support for artist signings, licensing agreements, royalty arrangements, publishing, distribution, and other commercial transactions.
  • Evaluate deal economics, profitability, recoupment structures, investment returns, and financial risks associated with artist contracts and commercial agreements.
  • Partner with Legal and Business Affairs during contract negotiations and deal execution.
  • Support strategic investment initiatives and M&A activities by performing financial analysis, due diligence, valuation, and post-investment performance monitoring where applicable.

Financial Planning, Reporting & Performance Management

  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and financial planning in accordance with global finance processes.
  • Ensure accurate revenue, cost, and cash flow forecasting while monitoring performance against financial targets and key business metrics.
  • Prepare monthly management reports, financial dashboards, variance analyses, and forecasts for country management and regional finance.
  • Manage affiliate performance reporting and maintain a single source of financial data for business decision-making.

Finance Operations & Financial Control

  • Lead the country finance function, overseeing accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, treasury, payroll, royalty processing, cash flow management, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities.
  • Ensure accurate preparation of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow) in accordance with IFRS, company policies, and local statutory requirements.
  • Drive operational excellence, finance process improvements, and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency and strengthen financial controls.
  • Maintain effective governance frameworks, finance policies, and internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure compliance.

Risk Management, Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, IFRS, local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and internal control standards.
  • Manage statutory audits and maintain relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities.
  • Oversee corporate income tax, GST/VAT, withholding tax, transfer pricing, and statutory reporting obligations.
  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and financial risks while safeguarding company assets and investments.
  • Drive cost control initiatives, manage operating expenses and headcount budgets, and ensure efficient use of financial resources.
  • Ensure timely royalty processing, financial reconciliations, and resolution of operational backlogs.

 

 

Who you are

Experience

  • 10–15 years of progressive finance experience spanning commercial finance, FP&A, financial control, and business partnering, with a proven track record in multinational organisations. Experience in the media, entertainment, consumer, or other fast-paced industries is an advantage.
  • Solid experience within a medium-sized to large international organisation, partnering closely with regional finance teams while serving as the finance lead for an in-country business.
  • Proven ability to act as a strategic finance business partner within a matrix organisation, influencing senior stakeholders and supporting commercial decision-making.
  • Demonstrated track record of combining strong financial and commercial acumen to identify business risks and opportunities, drive FP&A initiatives, and support sustainable business growth.

Capabilities

  • Strategic Finance & Business Partnering: Strong expertise in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, business case development, performance reporting, and commercial decision support.
  • Finance Leadership & Operational Excellence: Proven ability to lead finance operations, strengthen governance and internal controls, optimise finance processes, and drive continuous improvement through automation and operational excellence.
  • People & Stakeholder Leadership: Effective leader with experience developing high-performing teams and building trusted relationships with business leaders, regional finance, artists and their ecosystem, and internal and external stakeholders across a matrix organisation.
  • Commercial & Analytical Acumen: Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate financial insights into actionable recommendations, balancing commercial objectives with financial discipline and risk management.

Education and Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, or a related discipline; an MBA in Finance or Accounting is an advantage.
  • Professional accounting qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent preferred, with strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, tax, statutory compliance, ERP systems, and advanced financial analysis tools.
  • Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.

 

What we give you

  • An opportunity to influence the strategic direction of our Southeast Asia business 
  • The ability to foster innovation and make a significant impact on the domestic music industry in Southeast Asia
  • You join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community that empowers you to drive the creative journey
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork
  • We are committed to investing in your personal growth and development.

job.title: Finance Manager - The Merch Collective
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Merch Collective is a strategic merchandise partner connecting our clients to their fans. We are an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talented—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership.

As a Finance Manager at The Merch Collective you’ll work closely with the Assistant Controller overseeing financial operations, with a concentration on Artist Royalties and Accounts Receivable. Your role will encompass assisting with providing variance analysis and recommended corrective actions to improve financial performance. Success in the role will be dependent on strong analytical skills. 

What you'll do:

  • Assistance with the ownership of all Royalty Statements, including coordination across departments to reconcile all associated revenue, COGS and other expenses summarized in a completed settlement at the end of each Tour. Oversite and management of data calculations to confirm accuracy before final approvals for settlements and payment submissions.
  • Conduct Quickbooks general ledger activity research in analyzing account balance and transaction details and preparing journal entries as needed. Prepare and analyze monthly financial reporting. Daily banking and QuickBooks reconciliations.
  • Assist with Month end close: monthly reporting of actual performance, reconciling financial statements. Research and collection of Accounts Receivable open invoicing.
  • Communications across multiple departments to resolve discrepancies and process outlying data exceptions.
  • Research and special projects as assigned.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 2 - 3 years of proven accounting experience in a fast-paced environment managing month-end close processes
  • Proficiency with financial systems and tools (SAP Business Objects/BPC experience preferred)
  • Highly skilled in Microsoft Excel (index/match, lookups, pivot tables, etc.) and proficient in other Microsoft Office suite applications
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Global Artist Accounting Analyst - Ceremony Of Roses
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As the Analyst, Global Artist Accounting at Ceremony of Roses, you will support artist accounting, royalty reporting, and financial operations across the Ceremony of Roses group of companies, which are part of Sony Music Entertainment. This role serves as a flexible shared resource across COR's affiliated businesses, providing support on a need-based basis as priorities and workloads shift across the group. You will partner with finance and operating teams across affiliates to help deliver timely and accurate artist settlements, interpret contractual economics, reconcile underlying financial activity, and support accurate financial reporting. Success in this role requires strong accounting and analytical skills, attention to detail, comfort working across multiple businesses and systems, and the ability to prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment. This is an office-first role located in Culver City, CA and requires working 4 days in office per week.

What you'll do:

Artist Accounting & Royalty Settlements

  • Prepare and maintain artist royalty statements and settlement schedules across multiple revenue channels, including Tour, Ecommerce, Retail, and Licensing, for affiliates across the Ceremony of Roses group.
  • Review artist contracts and related agreements to ensure accurate interpretation and application of royalty rates, profit splits, recoupable costs, advances, and other settlement terms.
  • Reconcile revenue, costs, cash activity, and other settlement inputs to underlying operational and accounting records.
  • Identify settlement discrepancies, investigate variances, and coordinate with affiliate finance and operating teams to resolve issues on a timely basis.

Affiliate Support & Workload Triage

  • Provide artist accounting and finance support across Ceremony of Roses affiliated companies based on business needs, settlement calendars, and workload priorities.
  • Partner with finance leads across the group to assess open deliverables, prioritize work, and provide additional capacity where it is most needed.
  • Adapt to different affiliate processes, systems, and business models while helping drive consistency in artist accounting practices across the group.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Support analysis of artist and project economics, including revenue, costs, margins, royalties, and settlement performance across revenue channels.
  • Assist with variance analysis and other financial reporting needed to explain artist, project, or affiliate performance.
  • Prepare schedules, analyses, and reporting materials for affiliate finance teams and Ceremony of Roses leadership as needed.

Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Support month-end close activities across affiliates, including preparation and review of artist royalty, revenue, cost, and tour-related accruals.
  • Reconcile artist accounting and operational data to the general ledger and investigate differences across systems or reporting sources.
  • Partner with affiliate Accounting and Finance teams to support complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting.

Process Improvement & Special Projects

  • Help standardize artist accounting, settlement, and reconciliation processes across the Ceremony of Roses group while respecting affiliate-specific business requirements.
  • Assist with process improvements, documentation, and automation initiatives that improve the timeliness and accuracy of artist accounting and reporting.
  • Support ad hoc finance, accounting, and cross-functional projects across affiliates as priorities evolve.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 1 – 2 years of experience in accounting, artist/royalty accounting, financial analysis, or related roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to reconcile and analyze large or detailed financial datasets.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to interpret contracts and translate financial terms into accurate royalty and settlement calculations.
  • Experience with royalty reporting, artist accounting, revenue-share arrangements, or similar contractual accounting models.
  • Experience working with merchandise, Ecommerce, retail, touring, licensing, music, entertainment, or consumer product revenue streams is preferred.
  • Familiarity with SAP, ERP systems, royalty platforms, or other financial reporting tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across different teams, affiliates, and operating environments.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

California based applicants have certain rights under California law. Please see our California Recruitment Privacy Policy for more details.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for.  The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.California Pay Range$71,000—$75,000 USD

job.title: Head of Data - GSA (m/w/d)
job.description:
Vollzeit, ab sofort, unbefristet, Standort Berlin

Die/Der Head of Data, GSA führt die Data-Intelligence-Unit für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz und spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung einer datengestützten Unternehmenskultur. In dieser Matrixfunktion agiert die/der Head of Data an der Schnittstelle zwischen lokalen Business Units und den regionalen sowie globalen Data-Intelligence-Teams. Die Position verbindet strategische Beratung der Business Units, analytische und technische Führung, die Entwicklung von Talenten sowie die Zusammenarbeit über Länder- und Funktionsgrenzen hinweg. Die/Der Head of Data stellt sicher, dass Daten und Insights einen messbaren Beitrag zu den regionalen Businessprioritäten leisten und gleichzeitig im Einklang mit den Data-Intelligence-Strategien auf regionaler und globaler Ebene stehen.

 

Was du machst

  • Du übersetzt komplexe Daten durch regelmäßige und Ad-hoc-Analysen in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder und entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis der geschäftlichen Prioritäten in den betreuten Märkten.
  • Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Analytics von deskriptiven hin zu diagnostischen und prädiktiven Ansätzen voran und bleibst dabei eng in analytische Fragestellungen eingebunden, indem du Methoden, Herangehensweisen und Best Practices aktiv mitgestaltest.
  • Du setzt die regionale Data-Intelligence-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz um und überführst strategische Prioritäten in konkrete Maßnahmen für Reporting, Tools, Datenprodukte und Capability Building.
  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Datenteams über mehrere Märkte hinweg, förderst den Austausch von Best Practices und stellst Konsistenz bei KPI-Definitionen, Reporting-Standards und Governance sicher.
  • Du unterstützt die Entwicklung und Implementierung regionaler KPI-Frameworks, Dashboards und Reporting-Standards sowie die Migration auf moderne Datenplattformen und KI-gestützte Workflows.
  • Du befähigst Business-Teams durch Trainings zu Datentools, Dashboards und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen und fungierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business-Stakeholdern und technischen Teams.
  • Du agierst als vertrauenswürdige:r Sparringspartner:in für Senior Stakeholder in der GSA-Region, vertrittst lokale Perspektiven und Geschäftsanforderungen in regionalen und globalen Data-Initiativen und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Balance zwischen lokalen Bedürfnissen und übergeordneten strategischen Zielsetzungen.
  • Du schaffst die Balance zwischen regionalen Standards und lokalen Marktanforderungen, überzeugst Stakeholder durch klare Kommunikation und datenbasiertes Storytelling und förderst die Akzeptanz datengetriebener Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen der Organisation.
  • Du förderst eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, unterstützt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams und stellst eine effektive Priorisierung sowie Ressourcenplanung sicher.

 

Wer du bist

  • Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung in Analytics, Data Science, Insights oder vergleichbaren Bereichen, idealerweise in einem regionalen oder Multi-Markt-Umfeld.
  • Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Management- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten sowie geschäftliche Herausforderungen in datenbasierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
  • Du hast deine Führungsstärke sowohl durch die direkte Führung von Mitarbeitenden als auch durch die fachliche Leitung von Projekten und funktionsübergreifenden Teams unter Beweis gestellt.
  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Reporting-Lösungen, Dashboards, KPI-Frameworks sowie im Umgang mit Data-Governance-Prinzipien mit.
  • Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte analytische und technische Expertise sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL (Snowflake), Python und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Streamlit, Tableau oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
  • Du arbeitest kollaborativ, proaktiv und möchtest Verantwortung in einem strategischen und internationalen Umfeld übernehmen und weiter ausbauen.
  • Erfahrung in der Musikindustrie ist von Vorteil, insbesondere ein gutes Verständnis von Streaming-Geschäftsmodellen, digitalem Musikkonsum und den wesentlichen Marktdynamiken.

 

Wir bieten dir

job.title: International Marketing Director
job.description:
This exciting new role will develop and execute global campaign strategies for Sony Music Middle East business. This role has a huge focus on innovation – you’ll be responsible for architecting our international frontline and catalogue strategy, effectively and creatively managing how our catalogue and frontline are exploited across an eclectic roster of artists.

You’ll work closely with international markets on campaign development and execution, maximizing the opportunity for artists' catalogues alongside new releases, tracking trends, and identifying opportunities around key milestones. In addition, the role will be responsible for developing and nurturing a thriving fan community for international music artists, with a primary objective of engaging and connecting with fans across various platforms, fostering a sense of community, and driving fan loyalty.

What you'll do:

Drive revenue and optimize marketing spend
  • Increase the region’s market share in global consumption of international repertoire
  • Manage audience and consumption goals for international artists and songs in the region
  • Make strategic spend decisions based on audience insights and data from different platforms
  • Identify strategic opportunities for catalogue and frontline marketing activations in digital space – spanning content marketing, anniversary campaigns, re-heat campaigns and remixes
Fan Engagement and Community Development:
  • Develop and implement strategies to grow and engage a vibrant fan community for international artists.
  • Apply best practices and latest trends in international marketing, including but not limited to the use of digital assets, AI, gaming, social and music platforms and traditional media to create meaningful fan experiences and drive consumption.
Events and Fan Experiences:
  • Plan and coordinate fan-centric events, both online and offline, such as live streams, virtual meet-ups, fan contests, and exclusive fan experiences.
  • Collaborate with event organizers, partners, and stakeholders to execute successful fan-focused initiatives.
Collaborative Partnerships:
  • Build a creative network in the region with internal teams and external partners that can help deliver marketing campaigns for international repertoire.
  • To network, connect with and pitch creative and collaborative projects for international artists or songs e.g., collaboration/remix opportunities with local artists; touring/ concerts/ festival opportunities; televised/ media opportunities, e.g. award Shows, sports opening ceremonies, etc
  • Lead a dynamic, culturally aware, and forward-thinking team that experiments with new technologies and platforms and responds quickly to adapt to new trends and fan preferences
  • Close collaboration with the international markets to implement campaign rollout, localizing activations as needed, and ensuring good communication throughout regarding strategy, asset delivery, etc.

 

Who you are:

Demonstrable experience in leading, developing and executing successful multicultural marketing campaigns at a regional scale in a creative industry. You have a passion for music and an understanding of various genres and music cultures. Skills include:

  • Digital Marketing and engagement: Ability to deliver campaigns and experiences, drive consumption, and increase engagement through digital platforms
  • Fandom Management: Ability to build and grow a community of followers and monetize it through a variety of online and offline channels
  • Data Literacy: Ability to analyze the music market and relevant data and apply insights to make decisions to drive/improve results
  • Strategic planning: Ability to define a strategy and a set of priorities, develop an execution plan and allocate the resources to different projects to make it happen
  • Relationship management: Build trusting and long-lasting relationships with artists and their ecosystem, as well as with external and internal stakeholders; creating a network of connections and building credibility and rapport at all levels of the business
  • Cultural awareness: Understand popular culture and the underlying cultural patterns and factors that influence behaviors in different teams and countries
 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives
  • Annual leave, medical leave, annual home leave tickets for employee and spouse, and medical insurance.
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break

 

Equal Opportunities

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.
