job.title: Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, Argentina - The Orchard
job.description:
ABOUT THE ORCHARD

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, your role is crucial in driving the success of our clients' releases through innovative marketing plans and strategies, and data-driven campaigns. You will serve as a key point of contact, keeping labels and artists ahead of industry trends, platform tools, and audience engagement with plans and best practices. Owning and nurturing strong relationships with clients and internal teams is essential to creating impactful activations, building fanbases, and achieving overall release objectives.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the marketing point of contact for labels and artists leading discussions around marketing strategies, campaign planning, data collection, and ongoing performance evaluation.
  • Conceptualize and execute creative marketing campaigns in order to remain at the forefront of marketing and audience development.
  • Oversee and manage marketing campaigns for high-priority releases, focusing on specific artist and label initiatives within a given team. Drive informed decisions based on data and performance metrics.
  • Analyze the impact of campaigns and the value of various fan and audience segments, identifying trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities to optimize both pre- and post-release strategies.
  • Utilize in-depth knowledge of platforms and tools to build audiences, engage fanbases, and drive demand.
  • Provide regular reports and key insights to team and regional leads regarding campaign success and areas for improvement.
  • Seek out opportunities for the development of the artist and label roster through internal resources and external tools or services that could enhance campaign efforts.
  • Work with multiple departments and teams to bring innovative marketing activations to life, both digitally and in the real world. Foster fan community relationships to amplify campaign reach and effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with different The Orchard teams across the globe to identify and leverage cultural touchpoints for audience acquisition, engagement, and other label objectives.
  • Be proactive in identifying challenges and providing solutions to keep release campaigns on track. Demonstrate flexibility and balance in supporting label needs. Be nimble as priorities arise outside of standard processes, with the ability to act with urgency and strategic vision.

Who you are:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in strategy marketing
  • Experience in music marketing is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Passionate about music, a regular attendee of live shows, interested in discovering new music, trend-savvy, and curious.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines
  • A strong passion for music, creativity and marketing trends
  • Proven track record of success in developing marketing plans and strategies
  • Proficiency in Spanish and English is required
  • Extensive knowledge of the music industry, including trends, challenges, and opportunities
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with artists, labels, and other key partners
  • Creative thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative marketing and promotional campaigns

What we give you:

  • An opportunity to influence music on a global stage.
  • A modern, diverse and creative work environment.
  • An investment in your learning & development.
  • A comprehensive and attractive benefits package including healthcare coverage, voluntary benefits, and family resources.

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Junior Manager, Music Content & Marketing - Liquid State
job.description:
This hybrid role combines content production and marketing promotion and is directly responsible for leading the planning and execution of commercial music release projects. You will bridge creative vision and commercial objectives, independently managing end-to-end core music projects - from early-stage planning, A&R and content creation to full campaign rollout amid growing project scale and complexity that demand strong cross-team collaboration and resource coordination. Join us to lead landmark music initiatives and fuel commercial growth through creative content and innovative marketing.

 

What you'll do:

  • Market & Competitive Analysis: Conduct competitive research on music genres, major streaming platforms and user music consumption behaviours; propose and pitch new content projects based on data insights and market trends.
  • Content Planning & A&R: Scout songwriters, producers and artists for projects; oversee quality control of mixes, masters and final deliverables; identify commercially valuable music content aligned with market trends.
  • Marketing & Release Strategy: Formulate release strategies and marketing plans, refine core selling points, product positioning and narrative promotion angles with key marketing hooks and storytelling angles.
  • Project Management: Oversee timelines, deliverables and budget control for all content projects; coordinate cross-functional teams and resources to ensure smooth execution of both in-house and co-produced projects.
  • Rights & Compliance: Manage copyright licensing and compliance clearance for co-produced content.
  • Partnership & Execution: Independently communicate, execute and advance cooperation matters; follow up contracts and maintain partner relationships.
  • Performance Tracking: Track core KPIs including streaming volumes, revenue and ROI, and optimize campaigns based on performance data.
  • Complete other temporary work assigned by the supervisor and the company.

 

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree or above; majors in Music, Communication, Marketing and related disciplines are preferred.
  • 3-5 years of working experience in the music industry, with proven full-cycle song promotion experience from zero to one; proficient in the complete music production workflow and marketing logic.
  • Possess dual A&R and marketing capabilities; capable of independently managing end-to-end music projects with a track record of successful hit song releases.
  • Familiar with promotion logics and algorithm mechanisms of mainstream music & short-video platforms, including QQ Music, NetEase, Cloud Music, Douyin, Kuaishou and Bilibili.
  • Excellent content planning acumen, able to spot commercially valuable music content by capturing market trends timely.
  • Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with outstanding time management and cross-department communication & coordination skills; resilient and able to thrive under heavy work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong English proficiency. 
  • Established personal network of artists, producers and songwriters; able to integrate industry resources to facilitate project delivery. 
  • In-depth professional insight into specific music genres especially electronic dance music (e.g., hip-hop, folk, pop). 
  • Previous employment experience at record labels, hit-song indie labels or content studios of music streaming platforms. 
  • Show/Performance industry experiences/resources.

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey.
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork.
  • We invest in your professional growth & development.

 

Equal Opportunities

job.title: Junior Manager, Public Performance & Finance Support - Colombia
job.description:
Sobre Sony Music Entertainment

En Sony Music Entertainment, impulsamos el viaje creativo. Hemos desempeñado un papel pionero en la historia de la música, desde la creación del primer sello discográfico hasta la invención del disco plano. Hemos apoyado a algunos de los artistas más icónicos de la música y producido algunas de las grabaciones más influyentes de todos los tiempos.

Hoy trabajamos en más de 70 países, apoyando un diverso roster de superestrellas internacionales, artistas en desarrollo e independientes, y creadores visionarios. Desde nuestra posición en la intersección de la música, el entretenimiento y la tecnología, aportamos imaginación y experiencia a los productos y plataformas más recientes, adoptamos nuevos modelos de negocio, empleamos herramientas innovadoras y brindamos información poderosa que ayuda a nuestros artistas a expandir sus límites creativos y llegar a nuevas audiencias.
En todo lo que hacemos, estamos comprometidos con la integridad artística, la transparencia y el espíritu emprendedor.

Sony Music Entertainment forma parte de la familia de compañías globales Sony.

Asegurar que todos los lanzamientos de fonogramas de SONY MUSIC sean acreditados dentro de las sociedades de gestión colectiva para garantizar el recaudo de estos usos en los establecimientos públicos y apoyar la operación del área financiera en ciertas actividades puntuales.

Qué harás:

  • Desde el modelo de la Promesa Global de las Personas, GPP, los Valores y los Comportamientos de SMG en todo lo que hace, ayudando a impulsar una cultura sostenible de alto rendimiento dentro de nuestro negocio
  • Acreditar los fonogramas en todos los formatos disponibles, tanto digitales como análogos, garantizando su correcta identificación y registro en las plataformas y sistemas correspondientes, con el fin de asegurar su adecuada gestión y el cumplimiento de los estándares de la industria.
  • Coordinar y ejecutar el retiro de fonogramas de todas las plataformas y formatos disponibles cuando los derechos correspondientes hayan expirado o ya no estén vigentes, asegurando el cumplimiento de las normativas legales y las políticas internas de la compañía.
  • Gestionar y resolver conflictos relacionados con la acreditación de fonogramas cuando dos o más productores, hayan registrado el mismo fonograma, asegurando una revisión objetiva, la correcta asignación de derechos y el cumplimiento de los lineamientos establecidos por la compañía y las entidades de gestión colectiva.
  • Gestionar la elaboración y seguimiento de facturas manuales en coordinación con Shared Services, relacionadas con acuerdos de sincronización, nuevos negocios y broadcasting, asegurando la correcta emisión de los documentos, el cumplimiento de los procesos financieros establecidos que permitan su adecuada contabilización.
  • Crear y administrar familias de fonogramas en los sistemas corporativos, garantizando la disponibilidad y confiabilidad de la información necesaria para el monitoreo de gastos, la generación de reportes y el análisis financiero por parte de las diferentes áreas involucradas.
  • Realizar la validación y seguimiento de las cuentas de balance de Marketing generadas por el equipo de Contabilidad, asegurando la razonabilidad de los registros, la identificación oportuna de inconsistencias y el adecuado soporte de las cifras financieras.
  • Consolidar, analizar y validar la información requerida para la construcción del indicador de Market Share, garantizando la confiabilidad de los datos y la elaboración oportuna de los reportes para su presentación, revisión y análisis junto con el Finance Sr. Manager.

  • Gestionar la elaboración y presentación de reportes financieros y de gestión relacionados con Marketing, Talento y Overheads, incluyendo informes de cierre, cargue de Forecast y Budget de la región Andes, asegurando la precisión de la información, el cumplimiento de los cronogramas establecidos y el soporte a la toma de decisiones del negocio

Quién eres:

  • Profesional en Administración de Empresas y/o Finanzas.
  • Conocimientos solidos en manejo Excel y SAP.
  • Experiencia de mínimo de 3 años en cargos de similar responsabilidad, deseable en compañías multinacionales.
  • Inglés B1.
  • Persona con gran habilidad para conectar con otros, construyendo relaciones de confianza y colaboración. Se comunica con claridad, respeto y seguridad, lo que le permite influir positivamente en su entorno. Es proactiva, toma la iniciativa y actúa con responsabilidad, siempre enfocada en encontrar soluciones. Tiene una mentalidad analítica que le permite entender contextos complejos y tomar decisiones acertadas. Su capacidad para unir personas, ideas y procesos lo convierte en un verdadero conector dentro del equipo y la organización. (relaciones interpersonales - comunicación asertiva - proactividad – responsabilidad – acción - análisis – conexión).

Lo que te damos:

  • Te unes a una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y global donde tienes la oportunidad de canalizar tu pasión cada día
  • Un entorno de oficina moderno diseñado para fomentar la productividad, la creatividad y el trabajo en equipo que te permite aportar lo mejor de ti mismo
  • Inversión en tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional que te permita prosperar en nuestra vibrante comunidad.
  • El espacio para acelerar el progreso, perturbar positivamente y crear lo que suceda a continuación.
  • Te damos la plataforma para liderar el cambio positivo, con la oportunidad de contribuir a nuestras iniciativas de impacto social, diversidad, equidad e inclusión.
  • Una cartera de prestaciones que responde a sus necesidades y las de su familia, desde ayudas al bienestar y prestaciones familiares hasta tiempo libre remunerado para ayudarle a conciliar la vida laboral y personal.
  • Tiempo libre para las vacaciones de fin de año.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we're committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music's Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to join our engineering team in our London office. Our PDEGO suite powers all of Sony Music's most critical business capabilities—ensuring monetization, data and analytics depth, marketing and music release at scale for artists across the globe.

As a technical lead, you'll help shape the architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technical direction of one of our product spaces at global scale. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to modernize systems while mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence across the team.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the technical design and implementation of scalable software solutions supporting Sony Music's critical global B2B2C platforms.
  • Drive architecture decisions across distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, and platform services.
  • Partner closely with Product, Operations, and teams of stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code while establishing engineering best practices across the team
  • Lead technical design sessions, architecture reviews, and modernization initiatives
  • Design resilient services and integrations with internal and third-party platforms
  • Champion application reliability, performance, observability, and operational excellence
  • Mentor engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, and architectural guidance
  • Identify technical debt and lead initiatives to improve scalability, maintainability, and developer productivity
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis across distributed systems
  • Collaborate with engineering leadership to define the long-term technical roadmap for the platform you are focused on

Who you are:

Seeking 10+ years of software engineering experience in the following areas:

  • Experience implementing distributed systems
  • Strong experience with Python and JavaScript
  • Experience building frontend applications using TypeScript and React
  • Experience with various database technologies and query languages (we use Snowflake, MySQL, Neo4j, Kafka, OpenSearch, and more)
  • Experience designing microservices and APIs using REST, HTTP, and OAuth
  • Comfortable with AWS cloud technologies
  • Experience using log analysis and monitoring tools to investigate production issues and improve reliability
  • Experience writing unit, integration, and automated tests
  • Experience working within Agile development teams
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence engineering and business stakeholders
  • Passion for solving complex technical problems and mentoring engineers

The ideal candidate

  • Deep understanding of software architecture, domain modeling, and scalable system design
  • Experience designing data models and optimizing schemas for complex business domains
  • Experience working with large datasets and high-volume systems
  • Can mobilize engineering teams around a technical vision and lead execution across multiple initiatives
  • Establishes engineering best practices, coding standards, and development processes that improve quality and delivery
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to balance immediate business needs against long-term platform investments
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives without direct people management responsibility
  • Passionate about mentoring engineers and fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Interest in music, technology, and building systems that directly support artists and creators

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Hybrid work environment: Our London office is designed for collaboration, offering a balanced hybrid setup (3 days in office / 2 days remote)
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives 
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break 

Equal Opportunities

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.

We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

Privacy Policy

Please click here to read our privacy policy before beginning the application process as you will need to agree to the terms of the policy before submitting your information.

Please note that applicants must be at least 18 years of age.

job.title: Legal Counsel
job.description:

job.title: Live Experience Manager
job.description:
RG Live is looking for a highly organised, motivated, and commercially minded individual to join our growing Live Experiences team. The role offers the opportunity to support the delivery and expansion of large-scale event formats - from light trails to immersive location-based experiences - across global markets. You’ll play a central role in keeping projects running while contributing to the evolution of exciting, audience-facing experiences.

The role involves direct ownership and management of key commercial projects across the portfolio, working across core functions including ticketing, marketing, and finance to coordinate a smooth and successful delivery. You’ll also work closely with multiple external partners, and support the development of junior team members.

We’re looking for someone with proven experience in event promotion, strong commercial understanding, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Most importantly, you’ll bring energy, a proactive mindset, and a genuine enthusiasm for being part of an ambitious and growing team.

What you'll do:

Project Management
•    Attend and lead Senior Management Team meetings as required, conducting venue visits on a regular basis (where applicable).
•    Collaborate closely with venue teams and wider operational partners to ensure successful event delivery.
•    Monitor and execute opportunities for sales and profit maximization throughout the yearly event cycle.
•    Ensure booking processes, builds and reporting are executed accurately by the ticketing team for key projects.
•    Support re-contracting of sites where applicable.

Ticketing
•    Manage and support ticketing functions of the business as and where required – inclusive of relationship management, event builds, and creation and circulation of sales reports.
•    Support the Director of Development and Innovation in the development of ticketing practices for the company going forwards.
•    Support wider team / ticket agents in customer service responsibilities.

Financial Management
•    Monitor financial performance across assigned sites, working with the Director of Live Experiences and Finance team to support accurate and regular re-forecasting.
•    Manage, develop and grow P&L models for individual projects, ensuring they are kept up to date and accurate – with any key variances raised to the wider team.
•    Support the financial reconciliation of assigned projects with venues and internal and external teams.

Wider Business Support
•    Assist with the management, implementation, and growth of F&B and other secondary income opportunities across the portfolio.
•    Support the development and delivery of new and existing sponsors where required
•    Support the Director of Live Experiences and Director of Development and Innovation with delivery of P&L models and wider research for potential new projects.

job.title: Manager, A&R - AWAL
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Manager, A&R with AWAL will be responsible for finding and acquiring recording artists, songs and producers as well as leading artist development efforts for artists in all genres. This role will report directly to the President and Head of A&R, AWAL North America.

What you'll do:

  • Attend live shows at clubs, showcases, concerts, and other venues.
  • Provide comprehensive feedback on new music to the Head of A&R and/or other requesting senior A&R executives.
  • Propose new artists for AWAL.
  • Visit artist/band websites and social networking sites.
  • Search for new songs for existing talent on AWAL.
  • Coordinate label relationships for an artist once they are signed to AWAL.
  • Provide creative input and direction on artist’s material.
  • Find suitable producers and recording studios
  • Coordinate pre-production and production, mixing, mastering
  • Plan recording budgets for assigned projects.
  • Keep projects within agreed budget and schedule/timeline.
  • Evaluate recording and mixing progress for AWAL artists.
  • Coordinate all asset deliverables to appropriate production department/areas in timely manner.
  • Maintain files/records on all shows attended.
  • Work closely with other label departments/employees including marketing, publicity, sales to determine follow up steps once the record has been completed.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with industry insiders (managers, agents, attorneys, concert promoters, radio promo reps, retail contacts, trade and consumer press, tastemakers, etc.).

Who you are:

  • Passionate about all things music.
  • Have three (3) + years of music or entertainment industry experience, with a demonstrated track record of finding new and emerging artists/talent.
  • Have knowledge of the different steps in the making of and release of a record required.
  • Must have prior experience working with artists from a variety of genres.
  • A proactive, self-starter who has strong problem solving, social, and interpersonal skills.
  • Exceptional communication and time management skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while still paying attention to detail and spotting potential issues is absolutely key.

 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for.  The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.New York Pay Range$75,000—$85,000 USD

job.title: Manager, Campaign Operations - RCA Records
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a Manager, Campaign Operations to join a newly established function at RCA Records. Campaign Operations is the connective tissue between departments — tracking, surfacing, and flagging cross-departmental activity across the full roster to ensure that when a decision gets made in one room, every other team knows what it means for them.

Reporting to the Campaign Operations Lead and sitting within the SVP Commercial Partnerships organization, this role will own the day-to-day operational relationship with a cluster of departments, monitoring their workflows, lead times, and deliverables across every active artist campaign. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of how to work cross-functionally between departments, thrives in ambiguity, and brings the kind of diplomatic, low-ego energy that builds trust without creating friction.

What you'll do:

  • Department Relationship Management: Own the day-to-day operational relationship with an assigned cluster of departments. Learn their workflows, lead times, tools, and pain points. Become the person they trust to represent their status accurately.
  • Release Readiness Monitoring: Track workability status across all active releases. Surface gaps in clearances, masters, artwork, agreements, and delivery timelines before they become blockers.
  • Budget Visibility & Tracking: Monitor campaign spend against approved budgets across the roster. Surface divergence, flag overages, and track budget status in real time so that the people who own those decisions have full information. Campaign Ops does not approve or deny spend — it ensures the numbers are visible and accurate.
  • Cross-Department Flagging: Identify when an issue in one department affects another. Surface the connection, prompt the teams involved, and track resolution.
  • Meeting Support: Contribute to cross-department meeting preparation, transcript processing, and action item tracking. Help produce Goal Briefs and meeting notes for distribution.
  • Artist Briefing Support: Assist in producing artist briefings and prep packages for new signings and key roster moments. Compile information from multiple departments into a single, clear picture.
  • Data Layer Maintenance: Keep shared operational data current and accurate across Airtable and internal dashboards. Ensure department status is reflected in real time.
  • Escalation: When an issue cannot be resolved at the department level, route to the Campaign Operations Lead for consolidation. The team speaks as a unit.
  • Tool & System Awareness: Stay current on internal tools, Sony enterprise systems, and department-specific platforms. Surface what exists, who uses it, and where there are gaps or duplication.

Who you are:

  • Minimum of 3 years in the music industry, entertainment, media, or a similar field, with previous experience working collaboratively across various teams and departments.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities across a large roster.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across teams. You can translate technical or operational information into clear, concise language for varied audiences.
  • Familiarity with project management or operational tracking tools (Airtable, Asana, Monday, or similar). Willingness to learn new systems quickly.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records. Comfortable tracking dozens of open items across multiple workstreams without losing threads.
  • Diplomatic and low-ego. This role requires navigating departmental sensitivities without creating friction. You amplify other teams’ work — you don’t add oversight.
  • Curiosity about how systems work and why they break. Interest in process improvement, data visibility, and operational design.
  • You are a motivated self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans

job.title: Manager, Corporate Development - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

The Orchard has an immediate opening for a Corporate Development Manager.  This position plays a critical role in driving The Orchard’s M&A transactions, strategic investments and global growth opportunities.

This is an ideal position for an ambitious self-starter with proven strategic acumen who is passionate about and well-versed in the media & entertainment industry and driven to execute high-impact deals across music, technology and digital networks businesses. Working closely with senior management throughout The Orchard and Sony Music puts the Manager in a unique position to directly influence high-level strategic decision-making and deliver impactful business analysis across the organization.

What You'll Do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.
  • Deal Execution: Lead transactions from start to finish, including preliminary evaluation, deal structuring, due diligence coordination, valuation and cross-functional execution for potential M&A, investments and strategic partnerships
  • Relationship & Industry Network: Develop, cultivate, and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external partners, investors, industry experts, and founders across the media, music, and startup ecosystems
  • Financial Modeling & Strategic Analysis: Build sophisticated financial models and conduct macro-level analyses on The Orchard’s M&A strategy to support transaction decision-making
  • Executive Communication: Synthesize complex financial and strategic analysis into clear, compelling decks and memos to effectively present investment recommendations directly to senior executive leadership
  • Market Intelligence: Understand and monitor regional markets, industry trends, competitive landscapes, and internal product development efforts to proactively evaluate business opportunities

Who You Are:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Work Experience: 5+ years of experience working in a corporate development role at a media & entertainment company or in an investment banking or management consulting role focused on the media & entertainment industry.
  • Technical Expertise: Advanced financial modeling, valuation, and Excel skills, with demonstrated experience analyzing and drawing actionable conclusions from large, complex data sets
  • Advanced Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of successfully influencing key stakeholders and communicating a vision and roadmap along with the resourcing needs to achieve it
  • Project Management: Strong project management skills, including the ability to independently think end-to-end, manage long-term projects, manage multiple projects simultaneously and produce high quality deliverables
  • Industry Passion: Strong understanding of and passion for the evolving music, digital media and technology landscape

  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans

  • Distribute critical assets to global retail and marketing teams, to ensure all cross-functional stakeholders are appraised of our labels' efforts to support releases.

job.title: Onestream Application Admin
job.description:

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music is seeking a OneStream Application Administrator / Support Analyst to support and enhance our OneStream compensation and payroll integration platform. This role will serve as the primary operational owner of the OneStream environment, providing application administration, user support, troubleshooting, security administration, reporting support, and issue triage.

The ideal candidate will possess practical OneStream experience, strong troubleshooting abilities, and an understanding of financial systems and business processes. The role will work closely with Finance, Payroll, HR, SAP support teams, and external implementation partners to ensure the stability, performance, and continuous improvement of the OneStream application.

What you'll do:

  • Role model SMG’s Global People Promise, Values and Behaviors in all that you do, helping to drive a sustainable high-performance culture within our business
  • Serve as the primary administrator and support contact for the OneStream application, including user access, security, and configuration management.  Support business users by responding to questions, resolving issues, and providing guidance on system functionality.
  • Troubleshoot and triage production issues, building the skillset to determine whether problems originate in OneStream, SAP, integrations, master data, or user processes.
  • Manage and support monthly operational processes, data loads, payroll-related processes, and system monitoring activities.
  • Maintain and enhance financial reports, calculations, business rules, and data processing workflows.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Payroll, HR, SAP teams, and external support partners to resolve application and integration issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation, user guides, training materials, and operational procedures.

Who you are:

  • 1-3+ years of hands-on OneStream administration, support, troubleshooting, or development experience. Familiarity with OneStream business rules and a working knowledge of VB.NET.
  • Ability to investigate application issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolutions across multiple teams.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to troubleshoot data and integration-related issues.
  • Understanding of financial systems concepts, including general ledger, cost centers, company codes, balance sheets, and income statements.
  • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors—delivering excellent customer service in a production environment, along with clear documentation and knowledge-sharing.

 

What we give you:

job.description:
If you’re interested in future opportunities within our OTC (Order to Cash) team, we invite you to apply to our OTC Talent Pool by submitting your CV through this application. job.title: Physical Sales & E-Commerce Executive, SEA
job.description:
The Physical Sales & E-Commerce Executive will support Sony Music’s growth of the physical market across Southeast Asia. The role will support the development and operation of physical sales channels for Vinyl, CDs and other physical products, working across both wholesale/distribution and D2C channels.

The role focuses on developing and operating sales channels, ensuring products are priced appropriately, inventory is forecasted and managed effectively, order are fulfilled and collected, and sales channels are maintained and optimised. This includes supporting the development of D2C infrastructure and storefronts using Shopify.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and grow physical sales channels across Southeast Asian territories, supporting the sale of Vinyl, CDs and other physical products.
  • Manage the day-to-day operational requirements of sales channels, including pricing, inventory management, forecasting, orders, delivery and collection of payments.
  • Support the development and management of wholesale/distribution channels, working with local distributors and retail partners to increase physical distribution and sales.
  • Support the development and operation of D2C sales channels, including the ongoing maintenance and optimisation of Shopify powered storefronts.
  • Act as a key operational contact for local and international stakeholders, working across labels, artist teams, merchandise companies, distributors, retail partner and platform partners.
  • Assist in the delivery of album launches, pre-orders, bundles and release activity across wholesale and D2C sales channels, working closely with artist, label and merchandise company partners.
  • Oversee the operational flow of physical products into sales channels, collaborating with fulfilment, logistics and other partners to maintain high service standards.
  • Support sales channel performance, contributing to sales targets, inventory optimisation, forecasting and commercial performance.

Who you are:

  • 2+ years experience in a physical sales, e-commerce or online retail role.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing sales channels and/or e-commerce stores.
  • Sales and operational experience, ideally with physical music products or consumer products.
  • Experience working with distributors, retail partners and D2C sales channels.
  • Comfortable working across multiple projects, artists and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Strong understanding of sales performance, inventory and forecasting and using data to guide decisions.
  • Highly organised, detail oriented, and confident working with numbers, spreadsheets, and Microsoft tools such as Excel, Teams, and Copilot.  
  • Hands-on Shopify experience.
  • Familiarity with the Southeast Asian retail or consumer landscape is advantageous.
 

What we give you:

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next

job.title: Principal Software Engineer, Pub Admin
job.description:
At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music’s Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is seeking a Principal Software Engineer within our Pub Admin product team in our London King’s Cross office. Pub Admin is our unified, modern rights and royalty platform - where our engineers help transform a complex domain into simple, scalable, high-performance product solutions for Sony Music’s global songwriting community.

What you'll do:

  • Work with a cross-functional team to build products that empower artists and record labels across the globe
  • Contribute to all tiers of our architecture to produce high quality, robust user experiences
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code
  • Work closely with product management to understand client requirements
  • Design, communicate and execute a vision in collaboration with your team and other teams across the technology organization
  • Participate in re-architecture, refinement and technical design of various systems
  • Mentor more junior engineers and contribute to a culture of continuous learning

Who you are:

  • Seeking staff or principal software engineering experience in the following areas:
  • Experience implementing distributed systems
  • Experience in a scripting language (we use Python and JavaScript)
  • Experience building frontend applications (we use TypeScript, React, and GraphQL)
  • Experience with various database technologies and query languages (we use Neo4j, Kafka, MySQL, Snowflake, OpenSearch, and more)
  • Familiar with low-latency techniques to help improve page load time and reliability
  • Experience with microservices, APIs, and related standards such as REST, HTTP, and OAuth
  • Comfortable with AWS Cloud technologies
  • Experience using log analysis to investigate bugs and performance issues

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
As a Product Manager, you'll play a central role in bringing Sony Music artists and releases to market. Working across a diverse roster of local and international talent, you'll lead the planning and execution of release campaigns, helping artists connect with fans and achieve commercial success across physical and digital channels.

Partnering closely with artists, managers and internal teams across Marketing, Digital, Sales, A&R and Operations, you'll develop innovative campaigns, oversee release strategy, manage budgets, and identify opportunities to grow audiences, engagement and revenue. This is a fast-paced, highly collaborative role for someone who combines creativity, commercial thinking and a passion for music.

What You'll Do

Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and deliver release strategies, marketing campaigns, and artist development plans.
  • Forecast project performance and oversee marketing activity from planning through to release.
  • Manage contracts, invoices, and project administration.

Media Promotion

  • Build strong relationships with media partners to maximise artist visibility.
  • Coordinate interviews, appearances, fan events, and other promotional opportunities.
  • Oversee the creation of advertising and promotional materials.

Social Media & Content Strategy

  • Partner with the Digital Marketing team to create content and social campaigns that grow audiences and engagement.
  • Support campaigns across streaming, social, and digital platforms.

Physical Sales

  • Coordinate physical releases with artists, managers, A&R, Sales, and Operations teams.
  • Create sales materials and retail tools to support commercial success.

Digital Sales

  • Work with Digital Sales teams to deliver campaigns across DSPs, social platforms, and digital partners.
  • Identify opportunities to increase streams, reach, and revenue.

Internal Systems & Operations

  • Manage release set-up, asset delivery, and metadata across internal systems.
  • Partner with Operations to ensure releases are delivered accurately and on time.

Reporting

  • Share regular marketing, sales, and campaign performance updates with stakeholders and artist teams.

Marketing Budget Management

  • Develop and manage marketing budgets aligned to release objectives.
  • Track spend and ensure campaigns are delivered within budget.

Who You Are

  • Experience in the music industry across marketing, promotions, publicity, digital marketing, events, or artist development.
  • Strong understanding of social media, digital platforms, and music consumption trends.
  • Confident using Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • A creative thinker with a strategic mindset and focus on results.
  • Flexible and willing to travel for artist activity, events, content shoots, and campaigns.
  • Passionate about music, culture, and connecting artists with fans.

 

What we give you:

job.title: Retail & Licensing Coordinator - Ceremony Of Roses
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Ceremony of Roses is an agile creative practice built to solve the commercial and creative challenges of the world’s top artists. As Sony Music’s merchandise partner, we serve a roster of global talent—both within and beyond the Sony ecosystem. We’re defined by our commitment to product excellence, delivering products that are made to be kept, worn, and loved for years to come. Our best-in-class creative team delivers culture-leading, artist-specific collections that build artist brands beyond their music. Most importantly, we deliver customer excellence, embedding ourselves as an extension of each client’s team, bringing transparency, accountability, and tailored support to every partnership

The Licensing and Retail Coordinator sits at the center of CoR's licensing and retail program, driving the product development process from submission through approval while building the pitch materials that bring new opportunities to life.

What you'll do:

  • Supports the business development function of CoR Artists Licensed Merchandise + Retail program with administrative and sales support.

Product Development:

  • Coordinate product submissions for the Commercial retail & licensing team, ensuring projects are tracked, coordinated, and delivered on time to meet the deadlines of both Ceremony of Roses (CoR) and our partners.

Administrative Support:

  • Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Commercial team, including meeting coordination, calendar management, accurate note-taking, trade show and exhibit planning, and daily operational support.

Sample Tracking:

  • Facilitate all artist sample management activities, including tracking, organization, cataloging, inventory maintenance, and distribution across the artist roster. This role requires exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

Asset Management:

  • Support the organization, management, and distribution of artist artwork and creative assets to external partners, ensuring all file links are current, accessible, and shared securely.

Selling:

  • Assist in the creation visually compelling pitch documents and materials to highlight retail merch opportunities as directed by commercial retail sales team on a monthly and quarterly basis. Strict timelines to be met on this process.

Who you are:

  • You genuinely love music and understand why the culture around an artist matters as much as the product itself.
  • You have 1-2 years of experience with product development, contract management, and royalty reporting processes.
  • You have strong organizational and project management skills with a keen eye for detail. Asana experience is a plus. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and pick up new software is a plus.
  • You're an exceptional communicator who manages time and competing priorities without dropping the ball.
  • You're enthusiastic — proactive, self-motivated, and always looking for ways to grow and performs in a fast-paced environment.
  • You’re a team player who works well in an open office environment.
  • You're plugged into culture. You know what's trending, what's resonating, and why, and you bring that lens to everything from brand pitches to partner evaluation.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best 
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching 
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

California based applicants have certain rights under California law. Please see our California Recruitment Privacy Policy for more details.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for.  The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.California Pay Range$50,000—$55,000 USD

In our Royalty Operations team, you will be a key contributor to the day-to-day operations within Royalties and will be involved in all aspects of artist royalties, managing and delivering accurate and timely royalty statements, performing reviews, analysis and reconciliations, managing and prioritizing clearing of suspense items, responding to internal and external inquiries, contract interpretation, coding and special projects. In Royalty Accounting, you will be responsible for all aspects of royalty accounting for designated affiliates, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of accounting closes, performing account analysis and reconciliation, and royalty reporting.  You will work closely with all areas of the royalty department, corporate, global reporting and planning and external auditors.

The GFSS team is based in our modern workspace at the Elektrownia Powiśle centre in Warsaw.

If you’re looking to grow your career in finance within a global, creative, and fast‑paced organisation, we’d love to hear from you.

 

What you'll do as a Royalties Accountant:

  • Prepare, review and analyze capitalized balances, associated royalty payables, recoupable recording and marketing costs, for reasonableness and proper accounting treatment.  Prepare label talent provision and marketing recovery journal entries
  • Review foreign royalty expense and prepare monthly accrual vs. actual analysis, intercompany reconciliations and associated journal entries
  • Perform various balance sheet account analysis related to artist, copyright, union and foreign royalties to substantiate balances and clear reconciling items.  This includes any royalty system to general ledger reconciliations
  • Monitor, review and analyze artist/copyright/union expense for reasonableness and proper accounting treatment.  Prepare manual journal entries to adjust royalty expense
  • Special projects/other duties as assigned by management
  • Review and improve internal controls where applicable

What you'll do as a Royalties Operations Analyst:

Royalty Contract Interpretation and Coding:

  • Read the artist, producer, and/or third-party contract to obtain relevant information.
  • Interpret contractual clauses related to the royalty obligation, including understanding the legal definitions of terms used within the contracts or related documents.
  • Coordinate with Label’s legal and business affairs staff to obtain missing information.
  • Set up and maintain accurate contractual information within the royalty system

Royalty Statement Review:

  • Prepare the appropriate accounting statements as contractually required,
  • Review sales and costs to ensure they are accurately stated.
  • Update and analyze unrecouped balance analysis at account level.
  • Prepare and research variance-reporting analysis to understand fluctuations with balances and payments.

Sales & Suspense Management:

  • Review the new release schedule and work with the affiliate personal to ensure new releases are coded within the appropriate timeframe.
  • Run sales query and reviewing results with Manager.
  • Prepare and review suspense reports and provide reports to affiliate on a weekly basis.

Inquiries & Special Projects:

  • Serve as Point of Contact for various internal and external inquiries related to assigned accounts.
  • Provide Manager with status reports regarding the assigned artist accounts.
  • Provide guidance to the entry-level staff members including providing an overview of tools available to assist in the completion of the assigned tasks.
  • Assist in process design improvements focused on enhancing quality while reducing resource requirements.

Who you are: 

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or Finance
  • Relevant work experience
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel (Pivot tables & VLOOKUP) and Outlook; SAP, EROS, and JIRA experience a plus
  • Detail oriented individual with strong organizational and leadership skills that can handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to interact well with different levels within the organization.
  • Ability to analyze and review information from several different sources (corporate systems). 
  • Polish and English language, written and oral
  What we give you:

With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. job.title: Senior / Royalty Operations Analyst
job.description:
The Global Finance Shared Service Centre supports the core business with finance related matters, covering a wide scope of activities across the globe. We ensure suppliers and artists are paid on time for the amazing work they create. We work closely with the local finance teams around the world which means we have an excellent understanding of how the company operates and are kept up to date with key developments in this exciting and fast paced industry. Our teams play a key role in ensuring Sony Music achieve their annual goals each year.

As a Senior or Royalty Analyst, you will be a key contributor to the day-to-day operations within Royalties and will be involved in all aspects of artist royalties, managing and delivering accurate and timely royalty statements, performing reviews, analysis and reconciliations, managing and prioritizing clearing of suspense items, responding to internal and external inquiries, contract interpretation, coding and special projects.

job.title: Senior Accountant – Finanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d)
job.description:
Location: Berlin, Hamburg,

 

Wir suchen kurzfristig einen erfahrenen Finanzbuchhalter

Die Kings Road Merch GmbH ist ein weltweit etablierter Full-Service Anbieter von Merchandise-Produkten und -Dienstleistungen.

Als eigenständige deutsche Tochter eines weltweiten Musikkonzerns bieten wir individuelle Webshops für Bands oder Künstler an. Auf ihren Touren betreuen wir das Merchandising in Spielstätten in ganz Europa.

Unsere Services reichen dabei von der Herstellung der Merch-Produkte über die Lagerung und Logistik in unserem Logistikzentrum in Dortmund, die europaweite Tourbetreuung sowie den Betrieb individualisierter Webshops.

Wir suchen dich, wenn du Spaß daran hast, in der Musikindustrie rund um bedruckte T-Shirts und Fanartikel zu arbeiten. Europäische Umsatzsteuern, OSS und Quellensteuern schrecken dich nicht ab? Du möchtest mit unserem ERP-System NetSuite und eng mit internationalen Finance-Partnern arbeiten?

Als Senior Accountant übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Steuerung, Überwachung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finance- und Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von Kings Road Merch. In enger Abstimmung mit dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation stellst du sicher, dass Abschlüsse, Reporting, Compliance und interne Kontrollen verlässlich, fristgerecht und nach einheitlichen Standards umgesetzt werden.

Aufgaben

  • Zentrale Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von KRM
  • Eigenständige Betreuung der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung
  • Prüfung von Rechnungen und Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs
  • Forderungsmanagement
  • Erstellung der Umsatzsteuermeldungen in allen europäischen Ländern in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem internationalen Compliance Partner
  • Vorbereitung und Koordination der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB sowie des Reportings
  • Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung des monatlichen Finanzreportings an die US-Muttergesellschaft
  • Funktion als zentrale Finance-Schnittstelle zwischen KRM EU, dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation
  • Sicherstellung verlässlicher interner Kontrollen, Dokumentationen und einheitlicher Accounting-Standards
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen und Automatisierungen innerhalb der Finance-Prozesse
  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und effizienten Nutzung von NetSuite

 

Profil

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Steuerfachangestellte:r oder Finanzbuchhalter:in; alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer eigenverantwortlichen Accounting-Funktion
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Finanzbuchhaltung und Abschlusserstellung nach HGB
  • Erfahrung mit Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen sowie Finanz- und Konzernreporting; IFRS-Kenntnisse sind wünschenswert
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Verbesserung von Accounting-Prozessen, idealerweise in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld
  • Fähigkeit, eigenständig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eng mit internationalen Finance- und Managementteams zusammenzuarbeiten
  • Erfahrung mit NetSuite oder die Bereitschaft, sich einzuarbeiten
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für die regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen Finance-Organisation

Unser Angebot

  • Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten im Musikbusiness
  • Sicherheit und Möglichkeiten eines internationalen Konzerns
  • Modernes, digitalisiertes Accounting im weltweiten Umfeld
  • Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Mo-Fr) mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten
  • Vielfältiges Team
  • Moderne Altersvorsorge
  • Fahrkostenzuschuss oder Jobrad

 

English Translation:

Location: Berlin, Hamburg, 


We are currently seeking a Senior Accountant.

Kings Road Merch GmbH is a globally established full-service provider of merchandise products and services. As an independent German subsidiary of a global music group, we offer customized online shops for bands and artists. We manage merchandising at venues throughout Europe during their tours.

Our services range from the production of merchandise products to storage and logistics in our logistics center in Dortmund, Europe-wide tour support, and the operation of customized online shops.

We are looking for you if you enjoy working in the music industry with printed T-shirts and merchandise. European VAT, OSS and withholding tax requirements do not intimidate you, and you are keen to work with NetSuite and collaborate closely with international Finance partners.

As Senior Accountant, you will play a key role in overseeing and continuously improving the finance and accounting processes supporting KRM's European business. Working closely with the European management team and the global Finance organization, you will ensure that financial close, reporting, compliance and internal controls are accurate, timely and consistently applied.

  • Support the continued development and effective use of NetSuite

 

Who you are:

  • Completed commercial training, ideally as a tax clerk or financial accountant, or an equivalent qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in an accounting role with a high level of ownership
  • Strong knowledge of financial accounting and financial statement preparation under the German Commercial Code (HGB)
  • Experience with monthly and annual financial statements as well as financial and group reporting; IFRS knowledge is desirable
  • Experience in overseeing and improving accounting processes, ideally within an international business environment
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with international Finance and management teams
  • Proficiency in Oracle NetSuite and Microsoft Excel is highly desirable.
  • Good English skills for regular collaboration with the global Finance organization

 

What we offer

  • Exciting and varied activities in the music business
  • Security and opportunities of an international corporation
  • Modern, digitalized accounting in a global environment
  • Personal responsibility and development opportunities
  • Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes

job.title: Senior Business Solutions Specialist - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

About Business Solutions

Business Solutions partners with our label, marketing, and release planning teams to build the tools and workflows that help them run more effectively. We operate as a trusted internal partner, not an order-taking function. Our work is guided by three principles: Fail Fast: test ideas quickly, and don't let perfection get in the way of progress; Learn Quickly: treat every iteration as a chance to learn, document, and adapt; and Move Forward: keep the work, and the people we support, moving.

Role Summary

The Senior Business Solutions Specialist is the trusted day-to-day partner for a dedicated portfolio of business units spanning US and international markets, owning the full solution lifecycle from discovery through delivery, while mentoring the broader NYC Specialist team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned business units
  • Run discovery, scoping, and requirements-gathering sessions independently
  • Build and maintain business systems, automations, and workflows supporting label, marketing, and release operations
  • Write specs and requirements for integrations with internal Sony Music systems
  • Lead data migrations for assigned business units
  • Test solutions with end users and incorporate feedback quickly
  • Share best practices with the broader team, contributing repeatable patterns and playbook content to support other junior Specialists
  • Escalate architecture/platform-level questions to the Architect
  • Identify opportunities to centralize and standardize workflows across assigned BUs
  • Lead enablement and change-adoption efforts within your portfolio – training business users to use AI tools (e.g., Claude Cowork) to solve their own recurring problems, not just handing off finished solutions
  • Define success metrics for initiatives in your portfolio and use adoption/usage data to evaluate outcomes and guide iteration
  • Ensure initiatives align with governance, privacy, security, and compliance requirements, partnering with the Architect and relevant stakeholders (Legal, InfoSec) as needed


Required Qualifications

  • 5-8+ years in business/systems analysis, solutions consulting, or enterprise no-code/low-code platform administration, with the judgment to build solutions that are secure, scalable, and well-governed
  • Demonstrated ability to run point independently with senior business stakeholders
  • Strong requirements-gathering, process-mapping, and documentation skills
  • Experience with data migrations
  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects and business units
  • Extensive A.I. experience using tools such as Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Google Gemini
  • Basic scripting, SQL, or automation-logic familiarity
  • Tool-agnostic and adaptable to learning new platforms as workflows expand
  • Experience leading change adoption or user enablement efforts within a business function
  • Comfortable defining measures of success and using data to evaluate outcomes


Nice to Have (not required)

  • Music industry experience; media & entertainment adjacency (rights, royalties, metadata) a plus
  • Airtable certification or deep hands-on Airtable expertise (our current core platform)

A Note on Applying

  • We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day  
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.  
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next  
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
