job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As the Senior Director, Commercial Partnerships, you will play a key role in strategy for growing Sony Music Nashville's artists across DSPs and commercial partners. You'll secure visibility and editorial support, build campaigns that drive discovery and streaming growth, and help develop new revenue opportunities. Reporting to the SVP, Commercial Partnerships, you'll be a primary point of contact for key partners and a strategic voice across the label.

What you'll do:

  • Own and deepen relationships with DSP and commercial partners to maximize exposure for priorities
  • Lead pitching strategy for new releases and current priorities, using internal data to build compelling cases for editorial, marketing, and programming support.
  • Build playlist and campaign plans that grow fans for new and established artists, both on streaming services and beyond them.
  • Help execute commercial campaigns that add revenue on top of streaming for artists and the label.
  • Weave artist and partner opportunities around key cultural and country-format moments such as CMA Fest, holiday, and tentpole releases.
  • Work efficiently with other departments to align strategy and goals for our artists and releases.
  • Act as an ambassador for the SMN roster internally, with management, and with partners.
  • Track and report on campaign performance and manage budgets where applicable.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years of music industry experience across streaming, editorial, playlisting, partner relationships, and/or commercial or retail partnerships.
  • Established relationships with key DSP and commercial partners.
  • Strong analytical skills. You're comfortable with streaming and consumption data (e.g., Luminate, platform analytics) and can turn insights into strategy and pitches.

job.description:

Who you are:

  • Core audience of Western pop music, J-Pop, and K-Pop, with sustained engagement with the music industry ecosystem, fandom subcultures, and major industry charts—possessing independent music taste that extends beyond mainstream hits;
  • Possess basic music deconstruction skills—able to identify internet-friendly song segments and determine their optimal presentation formats (e.g., melodic hooks, production highlights, artist persona tie-ins, etc.), with a demonstrated instinct for music/artist marketing.
  • Proficient in PS (cover art, posters, etc.) and CapCut/Jianying (rapid editing); proficiency in FCP / Premiere Pro and AI content generation tools (e.g., Midjourney, Jimeng, Suno, etc.) is a strong plus;
  •  Possess basic shooting skills and a solid aesthetic sense for visual composition.

  • Clear understanding of how to guide users from a single post or short video to search for the "Sony Music" mini-program and complete final conversion.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills—able to coordinate efficiently with internal teams as well as handle on-site external shoots and interviews;
  • Logical, execution-oriented, with a proactive learning mindset and a commitment to post-campaign review and iterative optimization based on data feedback;
  • English proficiency required; Japanese or other additional languages are a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Solution Manager - The Orchard
job.description:
The Orchard (a wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment) is a leading music distribution company operating in over 40 markets worldwide – distributing music from independent artists including Ozuna, Skepta, Jorja Smith, and Kelsea Ballerini. With cutting edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world. At The Orchard, the focus is to provide a comfortable, social and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

The Solutions Associate Manager (Korea) acts as the primary client-facing operational and administrative liaison between local partners and The Orchard’s global Legal, Finance, Operations and Rights Management teams. Moving away from traditional standalone label support, this role owns the full end-to-end client onboarding, supports digital release logistics, handles financial/administrative escalations, and delivers actionable performance analytics. The ideal candidate is a corss-functional problem solver with a strict “see-it-through” mindset, dedicated to eliminating operational friction, safeguarding royalty flows, and supporting roster growth.

 

What you'll do:

End-to-End Client Onboarding & Back-Office Integration

  • Oversee the complete operational and administrative onboarding lifecycle of new Korean artists and labels, from the account set up to payment readiness, and catalog ingestion, working in close partnership with the Relationship Management Team.
  • Guide clients through the onboarding process, conduct platform demonstrations, and ensure seamless system adoption.
  • Resolve payment blockers by gathering, verifying, and processing financial/banking documentations in coordination with global Finance and Contract Admin teams. 
  • Manage administrative catalog transitions, including payee changes (LOD, assignments, entity name changes), payment holds, and client offboarding workflows, as needed

Release Operations & Product Logistics Support

  • Autonomously manage complex digital release setups (eg. timed releases), and advanced metadata updates in collaboration with the Relationship Management Team
  • Act as the local escalation point for product blocks or copyright/compliance flags, with Content Review Team
  • Coordinate with centralized Operations to process catalog adjustments, remaps, takedowns, transfers, and store whitelisting

Domestic Client Support

  • Deliver release schedules and metadata updates seamlessly to major domestic DSPs
  • Compile, update and optimize master release lists of key local titles, tracking placement updates and providing feedback loops to partners and internal stakeholders. 

Data Analytics & Performance Reporting 

  • Establish and manage a structured data reporting routine across release cycles (Day 1, Daily, Weekly, Monthly) to monitor streaming trends, algorithmic pick-ups, and market performance. 
  • Analyze listener demographics, geographic consumption spikes, and playlist performance to provide actionable insights for localized commercial and marketing campaigns. 
  • Utilize internal BI tools (eg. Looker) to monitor monthly client revenue fluctuations, identifying growth opportunities or investigating underlying operational causes behind revenue drops

Cross-Functional Problem Solving & Global Alignment

  • Investigate and resolve day-to-day administrative, financial, and operational client inquiries with end-to-end ownership, ensuring a streamlined and positive partner experience.
  • Collaborate with Rights Management, Legal and Claims teams to safeguard content integrity (eg. ownership disputes, asset remaps, rights conflicts)
  • Maintain internal system fluency (including proprietary back-end applications (eg. Zendesk), and obtain necessary industry certifications/standards.

 

Who you are:

  • Minimum 5+ years of total professional experience in digital operations, client administration, or content distribution (including at least 2+ years of direct experience within music distribution, record label, or digital media platforms sectors)
  • A strong advantage in digital media, content, music or platform-based businesses
  • Solid understanding of digital supply chain workflows, metadata standards, and streaming platform mechanics. Proficiency with platform tools (eg. Spotify for Artists, iTunes Connect, or YouTube CMS) and proprietary backend content system.
  • Proactive problem solver with a strong financial/contractual baseline. Highly advanced organizational skills with the ability to multi-task, prioritize under tight deadlines, and maintain a strict “see-it-through” problem-solving mindset.
  • Professional fluency in both English and Korean is required (written and spoken).

 

 

What we give you:

job.title: VP, D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy (Fan Engagement)
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing artists, songwriters, producers, and creators. Across our business, we are building the next generation of music commerce, fan engagement, and direct-to-consumer experiences globally.

The Role

Sony Music is seeking a VP, D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy to join the global Sony Music D2C organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Sony Music D2C, this role will lead the D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy team within The Greenhouse, Sony Music’s centralized D2C division.

The purpose of this team is to make D2C marketing a constant, evergreen discipline for labels that today focus their effort on the release cycle. It is a central, cross-label team that acts as an extension of label digital marketing and international market execution — providing D2C expertise, filling execution capacity gaps, and building the frameworks that let others work well — while leaving artist narrative and campaign strategy with the label.

This is deliberately a small centre rather than a large production function. Labels resource their own D2C people for their own repertoire; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that unlock the value those teams create. Where a label does not yet have that capability, the team carries more of the work early and steps back as the label staffs up. There is no embedded headcount — the team operates as a shared service across labels and territories.

The VP is accountable for the quality and commercial performance of D2C creative, product and campaign activity across the roster, and for the relationships that make it work: with label marketing, creative and commerce teams, with the international marketing team, and with partners across The Greenhouse. Much of the work is proposing rather than deciding — the label approves throughout — which makes credibility, judgement and influence without authority central to the role.

The role leads a team of five to six, organised around three pillars: creative, covering design systems, production and D2C visual standards; product, covering D2C product management, pricing and lifecycle; and campaign, covering CRM, fan acquisition and marketing operations. The ideal candidate combines strong D2C product instincts, fan marketing expertise, creative sensibility and operational rigour, with a deep understanding of how fans engage with artists, music, merchandise and culture across global markets.

How This Team Operates

  • A small centre, not a production house. Labels resource their own D2C people; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that let them create value.
  • Proposes rather than decides. Recommendations are put to the label for approval. The team holds no authority independent of the label, and labels retain final say on every D2C decision.
  • Reuses and refines rather than originates. Artist narrative and campaign concept sit with the label. The team adapts existing creative for D2C — merchandise creative is the one area where it originates.
  • Depth varies by situation. On a frontline release the team is advisory. Between release cycles, on evergreen catalog, it is the primary owner of D2C activity with label approval. On superstar campaigns it is fully engaged alongside label and international teams.
  • Depth also tapers by label. Heavier engagement early where D2C capability is thin, lighter as the label staffs up — every label lands in the same place.
  • Always-on, not campaign-by-campaign. Label marketing works per release; international marketing works per market, per release. This team spans releases and keeps D2C running between them.

What You’ll Do

Creative

  • Build the D2C design system — templates, asset taxonomies and scalable creative frameworks that let labels and territories execute high-quality D2C creative at volume across markets.
  • Establish D2C visual and email standards, including motion templates, content hierarchy, build quality and testing practice, with labels supplying artist voice and brand direction.
  • Produce merchandise and D2C product creative that labels do not produce in-house — pack shots, product mockups, banners and bundle imagery.
  • Produce D2C social assets and CRM builds when label teams lack the capacity, and refine or extend existing creative for D2C where core assets are limited.
  • Create pitch decks and D2C creative concepts that help label teams sell campaign ideas internally and to artist teams.
  • Resolve international asset adaptation, where D2C creative differs meaningfully by territory and is today handled late and inconsistently.
  • Supply campaign creative and merchandising direction to the Store Experience team, who build and run the storefronts.

Product

  • Establish the process linking D2C with marketing, sales and merchandising — the coordination gap labels consistently identify as their biggest constraint, where marketing learns of product and release decisions too late to build a proper campaign.
  • Develop D2C product insight across bundles, exclusives, premium formats and drops, proposed to the label for approval.
  • Own D2C pricing and promotional recommendations across markets, with label approval and international input from the commercial strategy team.
  • Run competitor scanning, launch retrospectives and evergreen product ideation, bringing trend and net-new format thinking to label and commerce teams.
  • Build lifecycle and scarcity frameworks — pre-order windows, limited editions, flash drops, live-show tie-ins, gated access and evergreen replenishment.
  • Ensure D2C approaches are globally consistent where scale matters and locally adapted where fan behaviour, language, pricing, territory, chart rules or fulfilment realities require it.
  • Partner with operations on launch readiness, product setup and localisation, and supply demand signals into the forecasting and insights team.

Campaign, CRM & Marketing Operations

  • Train label teams to think D2C natively — what assets are needed, at what cadence, and which products fit which moments.
  • Build the D2C campaign cadence, framework and schedule that keeps label campaigns on track — a named gap where no one currently owns the rhythm of D2C activity across a release.
  • Own domestic D2C CRM and lifecycle marketing across the full fan journey — email, SMS and owned channels — including automated journeys that keep fans engaged between release moments, not only campaign sends.
  • Develop a fan segmentation framework spanning casual fans, active fans and superfans, enabling more personalised communication and experiences across every channel.
  • Build the first-party data strategy that captures fan preferences and behaviours to create richer fan profiles, and own domestic fan acquisition.
  • Provide D2C budget deployment and retargeting guidance, developed with the label.
  • Create D2C paid media best-practice frameworks across Meta, TikTok and Google, with clear guidance on campaign structure, audience strategy and measurement. D2C performance marketing is a distinct discipline from awareness and engagement advertising and is not resourced consistently across labels today.
  • Define flywheel analytics, channel health standards and reporting — tracking acquisition, engagement, retention and monetisation, and how fans move from streaming, social and owned properties into D2C channels.
  • Establish best practice for loyalty and VIP programmes that reward engagement rather than purchase alone, social commerce integrations, and creator and affiliate partnerships — with labels executing against those standards.
  • Advise label teams on preorder strategy, launch timing, segmentation, local market messaging and campaign optimisation, and drive a test-and-learn culture across creative and messaging.
  • Over time, develop predictive audience modelling to identify high-value fans and churn risk, and prepare the design system and asset taxonomy for AI-assisted asset generation.

Partnership & Interlock

  • Serve as the central D2C creative, product and campaign partner to labels, artist teams and territories — including Columbia, RCA, Epic and the UK — and to Ceremony of Roses, The Orchard and merchandise partners.
  • Define and operate the interlock with the international marketing team, who own market localisation and in-territory execution for US repertoire. This role owns the domestic equivalent and sets the global standard; the handoff between the two requires clear, agreed triggers.
  • Work across The Greenhouse with the Store Experience, Business Operations, Commercial Strategy and Customer Satisfaction functions, whose scope adjoins this team’s at multiple points.
  • Build the relationships and credibility to influence without authority across a highly matrixed global organisation.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years across fan engagement, D2C marketing, CRM, eCommerce, merchandising or digital marketing in a high-volume, multi-stakeholder environment; music or entertainment experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of music fan behaviour, artist marketing, D2C commerce and fan engagement ecosystems.
  • Track record of enabling distributed teams — building playbooks, standards and frameworks that others execute — rather than only running work centrally. Comfortable moving between doing the work and teaching it.
  • Able to operate through influence rather than authority, and to build the trust that makes label teams want to work with a central function.
  • Strong knowledge of lifecycle marketing, CRM platforms, email and SMS execution, segmentation and first-party data strategy. Familiarity with Shopify ecosystems and D2C storefront operations.
  • Practical experience with D2C performance marketing — paid media planning, audience targeting and return on ad spend — or the judgement to build that capability.
  • Strong creative instincts and experience collaborating across design, marketing, merchandising and product functions, with the credibility to work alongside label creative teams.
  • Experience building scalable campaign workflows, design systems and operational best practice in high-volume environments.
  • Global mindset and sensitivity to local market nuance — fan behaviour, pricing, language, cultural context, release priorities, chart rules and fulfilment realities.
  • Passion for music, fandom, culture and evolving consumer experiences.

What We Give You

  • An opportunity to shape the future of global music commerce and fan engagement at scale.
  • Collaboration with industry-leading artists, labels and entertainment executives.
  • A dynamic and entrepreneurial culture within one of the world’s leading entertainment companies.
  • Investment in professional growth and long-term career development.
  • Competitive compensation package including salary, bonus eligibility, comprehensive benefits and additional Sony Music perks.

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for.  The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.New York Pay Range$200,000—$250,000 USD

The VP is the primary conduit for new revenue and value proposition opportunities. The successful candidate must be able to drive the business at a fast pace in an ever-changing environment.  While not required, experience in the independent sector is preferred.

The Orchard is a leading music distribution company operating in over 50 markets worldwide – distributing and marketing music from independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world. At The Orchard, our focus is to provide a comfortable, social and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

job.title: Android Engineer - Fan Monetization
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

We are looking for a mid-level Android Engineer to join the SoundCloud Fan Monetization team. Our mission is to deepen the connection between fans and creators, building features that enhance how fans engage with and support their favorite artists. In this role, you will operate as part of a truly global team, collaborating regularly with engineers and product partners in London, Berlin, and elsewhere to deliver high-quality mobile experiences. You’ll focus almost exclusively on a modern Jetpack Compose stack, shipping high-impact features to millions of users worldwide.

This role offers a fantastic growth runway. You'll work in a forward-thinking environment that fully embraces AI acceleration to streamline development, while focusing on building clean, intuitive user interfaces.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and scale SoundCloud's fan-facing features across Android, focusing heavily on building clean, responsive UI and features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
  • Embrace and utilize advanced AI tools to safely, securely, and responsibly accelerate your coding workflows, code reviews, and testing
  • Partner closely with product, design, and data teams across our international offices (including London and Berlin) to define, build, and iterate on features
  • Participate in feature scoping, product experimentation (A/B testing), analytics integration, and agile delivery to optimize user engagement
  • Engage in code reviews and engineering best practices to maintain a high standard of performance, accessibility, and platform consistency

Experience and Background:

  • 3+ years of experience building Android applications with a solid foundation in Kotlin and a strong familiarity with Jetpack Compose
  • You prefer looking forward; this role focuses entirely on our modern Kotlin/Jetpack Compose components, with no requirement to maintain or refactor legacy Java or outdated architectures
  • Excited about leveraging AI development assistants to optimize your productivity, code quality, and learning
  • Skilled at working within agile, distributed teams, proactively communicating, and breaking down problems into elegant, maintainable code
  • While your primary focus is Android, an openness or curiosity toward occasionally learning or collaborating across other tech stacks—such as iOS, Web, or Backend (Go)—is a welcome plus
  • You love music, mobile products, and the idea of helping creators build closer bonds with their audience

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

  • Mentor and expand the local Berlin accounting team, overseeing AP, procurement operations and reconciliation of VAT/Sales Tax accounts in cooperation with the Tax Team
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of a new software solution for group financial consolidation

  • Solid understanding of German HGB statutory framework, local compliance, and tax audit procedures

  • Fluency in written and spoken English and German, paired with strong, constructive interpersonal skills

job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Artist Success team. You will take technical ownership of the tools that help artists understand their audiences, grow their careers, and help the music industry discover its next stars. You will work within a high-performing, multi-disciplinary squad across our frontend (React, iOS, and Android) and backend (GraphQL, TypeScript) services, focused on strategic Artist Success products including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and artist-facing growth and insights experiences. This is an IC-heavy role for a technical expert who wants to drive architecture and execution while maintaining a hands-on presence in the code.

The ideal candidate has a track record of building and evolving complex, high-quality products across frontend, API, backend, and data systems. You are a generalist who can navigate user-facing application logic, service architecture, data-intensive systems, or infrastructure bottlenecks with equal ease.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and other partners to shape the technical direction and roadmap across Artist Success products, including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and related artist-facing experiences. You'll help the team make thoughtful architectural decisions and build scalable, secure systems that support large datasets and high-performance user experiences
  • Act as a senior technical contributor for a small, expert squad. You will contribute through architectural clarity, rigorous peer reviews, and a focus on maintaining high execution momentum
  • Work as a peer to Product Managers and Designers to define requirements across Artist Success. You'll turn vague business "wants" into concrete technical "hows," ensuring the team builds the right things in the most efficient way
  • Ensure high technical standards across frontend and backend disciplines. While the team is highly capable, you are responsible for contributing to the overall technical health, consistency, and long-term sustainability of the codebase
  • Own the infrastructure and health of your domain. You'll manage deployment patterns, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and ensure we adhere to modern security standards
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier while keeping the needs, judgment, and experience of the people using and building our products at the center of the work

Experience and Background:

  • 4-6+ years of experience with React and modern frontend development, with the ability to influence architectural decisions and drive best practices; experience with native iOS or Android applications is a plus
  • Strong proficiency in GraphQL and TypeScript for building reliable APIs and services, with familiarity in Golang or Scala, and a strong understanding of storage, querying, and data-intensive systems such as BigQuery and SQL
  • Strong capability in Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, and container orchestration
  • Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data

job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. As a Senior Principal Engineer, you will combine deep technical expertise with strategic vision and people leadership to drive the development of large-scale recommendation, personalization, and search systems. The mission is clear: architect systems to extract high-fidelity insights from user interactions with the world’s largest audio dataset to connect artists and fans through music. You will define the technical North Star for ML across engineering, delivering impactful data-driven products while leading and growing a high-performing team of Engineers and Scientists. This role reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer and will work in lockstep with the Music Intelligence, Content, and Recommendations teams. You will also be part of a small group leading the charge in architecting the agentic workflows and LLM-assisted systems that will allow us to ship Musical Intelligence at 10x the speed of traditional teams.

  • Lead the technical strategy and execution for SoundCloud’s ML systems (e.g., recommendation, ranking, personalization), including model development, deployment, and scaling
  • Lead the exploration of advanced modeling techniques including Deep Neural Networks, LLMs, large recommender systems, multi-modal embeddings and transformer-based architectures to create unique and impactful listening experiences

  • Lead, mentor, and grow ML Engineers and Scientists across SoundCloud

  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in machine learning, identifying opportunities to apply them at SoundCloud
  • Lead the leveraging of agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier to work at 10x the speed of traditional methods

Experience and Background:

  • Proven track record of defining technical strategy and driving execution for large-scale ML systems, particularly in recommendation, personalization, or search
  • Experience setting technical roadmaps, influencing cross-functional priorities, and balancing business, product, and engineering trade-offs at an organizational level
  • Experience leading and scaling teams of ML Engineers and Scientists, including hiring, mentoring, and developing high-performing talent

  • Hands-on familiarity with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and data processing pipelines, combined with strong software engineering foundations
  • Thought leadership in ML and data science, with a track record of driving technical innovation and applying emerging industry trends

  • Utilize advanced AI design tools and methodologies to supercharge your design process, accelerate rapid prototyping, automate repetitive tasks, and scale your output
  • Conduct scrappy user research and leverage insights to create workflows, UI, and interactions that support creators in uploading, managing, and monetizing their content

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Anti-Abuse
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Anti-Abuse Team, with a mission to keep connections between fans and creators safe and authentic, while building and operating an abuse prevention platform at global scale. The role can be based in either our Berlin or London office.

Our services are at the heart of SoundCloud’s user journeys. We operate a substantial suite of event-based services, combining specialised and generalised detection approaches to tackle complex architectural problems where scale, adaptability and fast decision-making are critical.

You’ll join a self-sufficient team passionate about abuse prevention, building scalable and adaptable solutions that stay ahead of emerging risks. The role combines long-term platform and architecture work with rapid response to new abuse vectors, giving you the opportunity to solve both strategic and time-sensitive engineering problems.

You’ll have significant end-to-end ownership to identify problems, shape solutions and drive projects from the ground up, working directly with engineering and T&S Professionals. If you’re creative, proactive and enjoy being the expert who turns complex problems into effective solutions, you’ll have plenty of room to make an impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve reusable platform capabilities and services that enable other teams to detect and respond to emerging abuse patterns at scale
  • Shape the platform architecture and technical strategy, balancing long-term scalability with rapid responses to emerging challenges
  • Partner with Product, Analytics, Trust & Safety professionals, and Engineering teams to identify and address abuse patterns across the organisation, driving alignment on solutions and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.
  • Own problems end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining solutions to driving projects through delivery
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing cost, latency, complexity, scalability and maintainability
  • Drive architecture discussions, contribute to technical strategy, and improve engineering practices, processes and tooling.
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Continuously learn and share knowledge of industry best practices in abuse prevention and detection
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (e.g. BigQuery or similar)
  • Knowledge of different API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Strong professional experience with Go; experience with Scala or another language is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience in abuse prevention, fraud detection or Trust & Safety is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

Experience and Background

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating distributed, event-driven backend systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience in building distributed data processing and ETL pipelines, metrics and supporting ML infrastructure 
  • Experience with microservices, SQL and NoSQL databases, container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, security, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble, collaborative, team-first mindset and an eagerness to learn and support your colleagues

job.title: On Air Talent
job.description:
About SBS:

As a pioneer in Spanish-language media, SBS has always been at the forefront of the evolution of Hispanic entertainment in the U.S. In this era of technological advancements and media convergence, SBS is poised to capitalize on its vast array of proprietary content across multiple platforms. Our unwavering commitment is to create exceptional, high-quality branded entertainment that resonates deeply with the Hispanic consumer. Our impressive growth on the web with LaMusica.com and the promising reception of our latest venture, the podcast initiative, are testament to SBS' long-term strategy. By seamlessly delivering content through diverse channels, we not only maximize revenue but also extend the reach of our beloved brands. SBS remains steadfast in our leadership position in today's dynamic and ever-expanding U.S. Hispanic market, and we are determined to continue pushing boundaries and shaping the future of Hispanic media.

Position Summary

On-air Talent Personality is responsible for the daily broadcasting of a radio station to which is assigned, and their work focuses on engaging the listening or viewing audience in a creative and engaging manner while maintaining FCC compliance for content. 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

•   Perform live broadcast show that is entertaining and informative to their audience

•   Interview personalities and guests

•   Record commercials for later broadcast.

•   Serve as a reporter as assigned, including special reports 

•   Select program content, in conjunction with producers, based on factors such as program specialties, audience tastes, or requests from the public.

•   Provide commentary and conduct interviews during “Live” transmissions, and other events

•   Develop sources and story ideas

•   Make promotional appearances at public or private events in order to represent the company.

•   Participates in regular internal meetings to review new content, topics, with Executive Producer and team

•   Have an active presence on social media that engages the audience

•   Other duties as required

Essential duties and responsibilities are those most important or most frequently performed duties.  Employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in a similar position
  • Must have engaging on-air presence.
  • Must possess impeccable diction in Spanish language, preferably fully bilingual (Spanish/English)
  • Be creative and have great story telling and writing skills in Spanish. 
  • Pleasant and well-controlled voice and good timing when speaking on air.
  • Ability to interact with audience and clients in a public setting.
  • Gather news information and prepare it for on-air delivery.
  • Familiar with current events (national and international), enjoys participating in conversational debates.
  • Must be able to work well under strict deadlines and pressure.
  • Able to work long hours, including weekends and holidays, when necessary
  • Teamwork/Cooperation with positive working relationships
  • Must be creative, have a sharp wit and able to improvise and think quickly while on air.

In addition to meeting the minimum qualifications listed above, an individual must be able to perform each of the established essential functions to perform this job successfully.

Physical Requirements

Work involves exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally or a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Jobs may be defined as sedentary when walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Why work for SBS?

Spanish Broadcasting Systems (SBS) offers a unique and exciting opportunity to be part of the leading Hispanic-focused media company in the industry. By joining our team, you will become an integral part of shaping and influencing the landscape of Spanish-language broadcasting. We take pride in our rich heritage and commitment to serving the vibrant Hispanic community with compelling content and innovative programming. At SBS, you will be surrounded by a diverse and talented group of professionals who share a passion for media, creativity, and cultural connectivity. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized. With access to state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technologies, you will have the tools to bring your ideas to life and create impactful experiences for our audience. Additionally, SBS provides ample opportunities for personal and professional growth, with ongoing learning and development programs designed to enhance your skills and advance your career. If you are seeking a dynamic and rewarding career in the world of Spanish-language broadcasting, SBS is the place to be. Join us and be part of a team that is making a difference in the lives of millions of people every day.

  2. Safely and professionally set up and dismantle event infrastructure, including tents, tables, banners, sound equipment, and promotional displays.
  3. Represent the radio station brand(s) at community events, concerts, festivals, and business locations, serving as the station1s face to the public.

  1. Build strong, positive relationships within the community to boost station visibility, increase audience engagement, and establish valuable promotional partnerships.

About Suno

About the role

The Lead Corporate Security Engineer will be our domain expert for securing our Corporate IT environment. You’ll work closely with colleagues in IT, Business Systems, Security, and Engineering to ensure that our corporate systems are implemented and maintained securely. As a senior member of the team, your impact will be split between building your team, enabling others, and doing hands-on work to mature our systems, processes, and behaviors. You'll lead the corporate security domain end to end: identity and access governance, endpoint and vulnerability management, detection and response, third-party integration risk, vendor assessment, and SaaS posture. You'll set the standard, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the outcome. IT Engineering runs the platforms day to day and are your closest partners. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/BiNdRVfLZRJXlfSW How this role works with IT Ownership splits by layer, not by system. IT Engineering owns the run; you own the standard and the direction. You set the corporate security roadmap. What we secure, in what order, to what bar with buy-in from leadership and XFN stakeholders IT engineering owns platform operations. Our SaaS portfolio is administered and integrated by them. You define what those platforms must enforce You raise the bar around you. You make your reasoning explicit so that partners make good security calls without you in the room, and you build the tooling and defaults that make the secure path the default path What you'll own Identity and access governance Own the access model at Suno: the RBAC and entitlement design, least-privilege defaults, and the governance layer in Lumos that enforces them Set the standard for what access review, certification, and approval should look like here — then build toward it rather than importing someone else's framework Drive access lifecycle automation so joiner/mover/leaver is correct by default and exceptions are visible Get ahead of non-human identity: service accounts, agents, and automations are a growing share of what holds access at Suno, and we need a model for them before it's urgent Endpoint security and vulnerability management Own the security standard for our fleet: hardening baseline, compliance signals, device trust, and how endpoint posture feeds access decisions Own third-party vulnerability management as a program — coverage, risk-based remediation SLAs, reporting, and the negotiation with teams whose tools are the problem Partner with the IT engineer who owns Kandji so the standard becomes deployed policy without degrading how people work Detection and response Own our EDR deployment and maintenance Collaborate with Detection and Response on corporate security incidents to closure Third-party and integration risk Own how Suno evaluates third-party access: integration and OAuth review for Slack, Google Workspace and the rest of the portfolio, plus vendor security assessment at purchase and renewal Define our risk appetite in practice and make it legible enough that others apply it without you Turn recurring decisions into policy, scope guidance, and tooling so the review queue shrinks as the company grows SaaS security posture Build and own the program: the bar for our SaaS applications, the assessment cadence, and the remediation that follows Improve tenant-level configuration across the portfolio — SSO and SCIM coverage, MFA and session policy, admin role hygiene, OAuth grant and token management, data sharing defaults Cross-functional leadership Work with IT, Security, Engineering, AI Enablement, and Legal to shape how Suno builds and buys Influence the scope of what comes next: how our GRC function plugs in, what we automate versus staff, where the next investment goes Mentor and raise the technical bar for people around you, including partners who aren't security specialists What success looks like First 90 days: you've formed your own view of our security posture, built working relationships with the IT engineers the broader Security team, and told us the three things we're wrong about First 6 months: a corporate security roadmap exists that IT and the CISO are aligned behind, with the sequencing and the tradeoffs made explicit; the highest-risk items are already moving First year: entitlement sprawl and vulnerability backlog are measurably down, detection reflects our real risks, third-party review is fast enough that nobody routes around it, and the standard holds because it's built into tooling and shared judgment rather than into you What you'll bring ~8+ years in corporate/enterprise security or security engineering, including having owned identity, endpoint, or SaaS security as a domain rather than as a set of tickets Deep hands-on expertise with a modern IdP and with IGA or access-governance tooling (Lumos, Veza, ConductorOne, Opal, or similar) You've designed an entitlement or RBAC model across a large SaaS portfolio and lived with the consequences long enough to know what breaks Endpoint security depth in a macOS-primary fleet: MDM-delivered hardening, compliance and device trust, third-party patch and vulnerability management at scale Strong command of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM, and of the risk model behind third-party integrations A track record of setting a security standard that other people applied without you enforcing it — written policy, tooling, defaults, or all three

Experience

influencing engineering and business teams who don't report to you, early enough in their process to change the outcome Automation fluency: Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, and a habit of building integrations and internal tooling as a normal part of the job Excellent writing and judgment under ambiguity. You can hold a position with an executive and change it when the evidence says to A calibrated sense of risk and how to communicate likelihood, impact, and tradeoffs Helpful, not required: insider risk or DLP programs, zero-trust network access, SOC 2 or ISO program ownership, just-in-time access patterns or identity-as-code, securing AI agent and non-human identity access, prior

experience

as the first or second security hire at a fast-growing company.

About the Role

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store. This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that. About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Behavioral Engineer to make safe behavior the path of least resistance at Suno. Instead of only catching abuse after it happens, you'll work upstream. You'll study how bad actors exploit our product and where well-intentioned employees fall into risky shortcuts. Then you'll redesign the flows, defaults, friction points, and incentives underneath so that harmful behavior is structurally harder to carry out. Working at the intersection of behavioral science, product design, and security and trust & safety, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to build risk-reducing changes directly into their roadmaps. This work will help lay the foundation for Suno's security programs and strengthen our overall risk posture across security, trust & safety, fraud, and privacy. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/PWNyTikQfKQyZZ9V

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Investigate how abuse and risk actually happen on our platform and inside the company. That includes reading logs, interviewing support and ops teams, and reconstructing user and employee journeys to find the easy paths to harm. Design concrete changes to signup flows, permission defaults, rate limits, approval steps, and verification gates, working alongside PMs and designers. Get your recommendations onto other teams' roadmaps by making the case in planning meetings, writing proposals, and negotiating trade-offs, all without owning the roadmap yourself. Measure changes in real behavior, not just detection rates. You'll define success metrics before a change ships and run before/after comparisons to prove impact. Lead cross-functional root-cause reviews after incidents and near-misses by asking what about the design made risky behavior the easy option, then turning the answers into concrete backlog items. Stay ahead of new attack patterns by tracking industry incidents and behavioral science research. You'll design targeted awareness and training only where it's the best lever, and make sure people actually find it useful. Help make safe, trustworthy experiences part of how Suno builds every product, in service of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

MUST-HAVES 6+ years of

experience

in trust & safety, security, fraud, anti-abuse, or risk-focused product work, with the technical fluency to dig into logs and data yourself and to work credibly with engineers on implementation. A track record of reducing risky behavior through product and process design (flows, defaults, friction, incentives), with measurable before/after results. Strong influence skills, including a history of getting changes prioritized on roadmaps you didn't own by building trust with Product, Engineering, and Design partners. NICE-TO-HAVES Formal background in behavioral science, behavioral economics, human factors, or UX research.

Experience

at a consumer tech company at scale, especially one with user-generated content, creator platforms, or payments.

Experience

supporting security compliance programs (e.g. SOC 2), or being an early or founding hire in a trust, safety, or security function. Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. job.description:
About Suno

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

About the Role

We're looking for a Staff Security GRC Analyst to build Suno's security compliance program from the ground up. You'll report to our CISO, work alongside our AppSec and InfraSec teams, and own the control framework that ties everything together: which controls we have, how they map to SOC 2 and NIST CSF, and whether they actually work. You're as comfortable reading a cloud config as an audit standard, and you'd rather automate evidence collection with AI than chase screenshots. It's a greenfield build with real stakes and a direct line to leadership. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/8U6fbhqLEghsnRsm

What You'll Do

Build and own Suno's security control framework, mapping controls to SOC 2, NIST CSF, and future frameworks, and writing control descriptions with the teams who run them. Lead SOC 2 preparation end to end, from gap assessments and readiness tracking to driving remediation with control owners and working with our external auditor. Automate evidence collection and control monitoring with scripts, integrations, and AI tools, deciding where human review stays in the loop. Run vendor security reviews, keep our security policies current, and answer customer security questionnaires alongside Product and Legal. Partner with the CISO to give leadership and the board a clear, evidence-backed view of our security posture, and lay the foundations of GRC as part of a growing Security team. Help earn the trust of the partners and customers who bring Suno to more people, so creating music can be part of everyone's day.

What You'll Need

Must-Haves 7–9 years in GRC, security compliance, or IT audit. Hands-on, end-to-end ownership of a security compliance program as its primary owner, ideally including taking a company through its first SOC 2. Deep working knowledge of SOC 2 and NIST CSF, including control mapping, audit mechanics (design vs. operating effectiveness, sampling, evidence), and staying current as requirements evolve. Enough technical fluency to read a cloud configuration, access setup, or pipeline and judge whether it enforces what the control says. You don't need to write production code. Comfort building your own automation with scripts or AI tools. Nice-to-Haves

Experience

standing up continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence collection, including what it covered and what changed as a result.

Experience

applying LLMs to assurance work, such as control drafting, framework mapping, or evidence testing.

Experience

with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, and with a modern GRC platform. Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or CRISC. Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff or Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to build the program foundation for Suno's Security organization. Security is scaling its team, processes, technology, and programs all at once, and today there's no dedicated program function to hold that work together. You'll own the cross-functional structure that turns security priorities into programs that run and get finished. You'll start with Vulnerability Management and Security by Design, and you'll also help our IT organization set up operational structures it can own and run on its own. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Research, and Legal, and as the work grows, you'll have the chance to build a team around it. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/JCWHRbjyL8Ytppbb

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Drive Suno's Vulnerability Management program end-to-end, covering intake, prioritization, remediation tracking, and verified closure with Engineering. Stand up Safety and Security by Design as a repeatable program, with clear processes, checklists, launch gates, and accountability across teams. Own Security's roadmap and planning artifacts, turning risk priorities into tracked plans with clear owners and milestones. Track incident response follow-ups and post-incident corrective actions until they're verified as resolved. Build audit-readiness tracking that maps requirements to owners and evidence across teams. Serve as the connective tissue between Security and Engineering, Research, and Legal. You'll surface blockers, sequence dependencies, and drive programs to completion. Partner with IT to set up processes, tracking systems, and operating cadences that IT then owns and runs independently. Help make security part of how Suno builds every new model and feature, in service of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone.

job.title: 2027 Summer News Intern | Multiple Locations
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

2027 TEGNA Summer News Internship Program

Your Future Starts Here

At TEGNA, making news isn’t legacy — it’s leadership.

This isn’t old-school TV. We’re setting the pace for a sustainable, streaming-first future of journalism.

We’re hiring bold, creative interns who embrace cutting-edge tech to deliver high-impact journalism that makes a difference.

This 10-week paid internship runs May 31 – August 6, 2027, at select TEGNA stations nationwide.

Many interns launch full-time TEGNA careers right after the program.

What You’ll Do

  • Pitch and research stories that matter
  • Create content for streaming, digital, social, and TV
  • Work alongside reporters, producers, anchors, and meteorologists—sometimes in the field
  • Jump in on special projects that shape local coverage

How This Internship Skyrockets Your Career

  • Hands-On Work – Real assignments for your demo reel
  • Career Growth – Development sessions to fast-track your skills
  • Networking – Learn from some of the nation’s top media pros
  • Paid Opportunity – Earn money while making an impact in a fast-paced newsroom
    • The standard compensation rate is $15.00 per hour unless a higher state or local minimum wage overrides it. Notable exceptions include:
      • Denver, CO - $19.84 per hour
      • Sacramento, CA - $17.40 per hour
      • San Diego, CA - $17.75 per hour
      • Seattle, WA - $21.30 per hour
      • Spokane, WA - $17.13 per hour

What We’re Looking For

  • Current college juniors or seniors with a 3.0 GPA or higher
  • Studying journalism, communications, or a related major
  • Passion for one of these three career paths:
    • TV news producing
    • TV news reporting
    • TV meteorology
  • Experience writing, editing, fact-checking, and using digital/social tools
  • Strong communicator who never misses deadlines

This internship is not for sports or film. It’s for hard-news journalists and meteorologists ready to disrupt the industry and deliver information in new ways that meet audiences where they are.

A Final Note

Our summer internship program is highly competitive. We review every application personally, but only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews.

  • Rolling applications — most 2027 interns hired by the end of 2026
  • Decisions by email — expect updates by Jan/Feb 2027
  • Summer Only — Our internships are in the summer, not fall or spring
Pay Range $15—$15 USD

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven technology or digital media sales account executive to join our team. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth through the sale of digital and television media solutions, including streaming and broadcast television, digital advertising, and content partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in digital sales, business development with a deep understanding of media and marketing trends, and the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships. This role requires a strategic approach to identifying opportunities, pitching solutions, and delivering measurable results for clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive sales by identifying and securing new business opportunities across multiple digital channels, including streaming, online video and display, and content marketing solutions.
  • Client Relationship Management: Develop and nurture long-term relationships with clients, ensuring their marketing needs are met and identifying areas for upselling and cross-selling additional services.
  • Consultative Selling: Provide consultative solutions to clients by understanding their business goals, analyzing market trends, and recommending tailored marketing strategies that drive results.
  • Market Research & Lead Generation: Research industry trends and competitor offerings to develop a robust pipeline of prospective clients and stay ahead of market shifts.
  • Proposal Development & Pitching: Craft compelling sales presentations and proposals that showcase the value of our media offerings, using data and insights to communicate potential ROI.
  • Campaign Management & Optimization: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful campaign execution, monitoring performance, and optimizing for maximum effectiveness and client satisfaction.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Regularly review and report on sales targets, campaign performance, and key metrics to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management, and product teams to align on campaign strategies, creative assets, and ad placements that meet clients’ needs.
  • Performance Management: Strategically use CRM and prospecting tools to manage and achieve quotas as it pertains to activity metrics and revenue goals.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in digital media sales, advertising, or a related industry
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and industry trends, including programmatic, streaming media, display, video, social, and content marketing
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to interpret data and analytics to provide actionable insights
  • Self-motivated, with a passion for sales and digital media
  • Proficient in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with ad management tools a plus
  • Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and be able to travel locally to meet with clients and business partners as needed.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in working with business owners and/or agency clients
  • Knowledge of streaming and digital media
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, DSPs, and SSPs.

Why Join Us? We offer a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions make an immediate impact. Join a forward-thinking team and drive the future of media sales with access to cutting-edge tools and resources.

KWES-TV Midland, the TEGNA-owned NBC affiliate in Midland-Odessa, is seeking a competitive, coachable and results-driven Account Executive to develop new business and grow a portfolio of advertising clients. This is an opportunity to build a career in media sales while gaining experience across broadcast television, streaming, connected TV and digital advertising.

You’ll sell one of the strongest portfolios in the market, combining the reach and trust of KWES broadcast television with the targeting and growth of streaming. On the linear side, you’ll connect advertisers with the large, engaged local audiences that turn to Midland-Odessa’s trusted news and programming. On the streaming side, you’ll leverage Premion, TEGNA’s streaming and CTV advertising business, to reach cord-cutting audiences across a premium marketplace of 125+ OTT and connected-TV publishers. Together with digital video, display and content solutions, you’ll have a powerful cross-screen portfolio to help local businesses reach their customers and achieve their goals.

We provide the coaching, tools and support to help you build your skills and your business. You bring the drive to learn, compete and succeed.

Responsibilities

Develop new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline through consistent prospecting. Research local businesses, identify key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

Manage the full sales process. Prospect, qualify, uncover client needs, present solutions, handle objections and close business while working toward established activity and revenue goals.

Sell consultatively. Learn each client’s business and marketing goals and recommend the right mix of broadcast television, Premion streaming/CTV and digital solutions to deliver measurable results.

Build compelling proposals. Develop data-informed presentations that demonstrate how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting can work together to meet client objectives.

Grow client relationships. Build new accounts into long-term partnerships by delivering results, maintaining strong relationships and identifying opportunities for continued growth.

Manage your pipeline. Use CRM and prospecting tools to manage activity, maintain an accurate pipeline and keep opportunities moving. Partner with account, creative and product teams to deliver effective campaigns for clients.

Requirements

Competitive, self-motivated and goal-oriented with a genuine interest in building a career in sales.

Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.

Coachable, curious and motivated to learn consultative media sales.

Strong organizational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Interest in broadcast television, streaming/CTV and digital advertising, with a willingness to learn and stay current on the evolving media landscape.

Sales, customer service, marketing or advertising experience preferred but not required. Internships, relevant coursework and transferable experience are welcome.

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Comfort with Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM or digital advertising tools is a plus.

Layered with digital video, display, and content solutions, it's a cross-screen story few competitors can match and in your hands, a clear advantage in every pitch. 

We give experienced sellers the portfolio, the autonomy, and the support to build something significant. Top performers grow their books, their earnings, and their careers. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of local and regional advertisers, connect with key decision-makers and create opportunities across broadcast TV, Premion streaming/CTV and digital.

  • Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, qualify, present, negotiate and close business while consistently meeting activity and revenue targets.
  • Grow and defend the book. Turn accounts into long-term partnerships; expand them through smart upsell and cross-sell across the portfolio and stay close enough to results to renew and grow every cycle. 
  • Pitch with data. Build compelling, insight-driven proposals that show advertisers exactly how broadcast reach and connected-TV targeting combine to deliver ROI. 
  • Run your business. Manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and keep deals moving in CRM and partner with account, creative, and product teams to deliver campaigns that perform and retain.

  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, open new business, and build a self-sustaining pipeline. You don't wait for leads 
  • Command of the modern media landscape: broadcast television, streaming/CTV, programmatic, digital video, display, social, and content 
  • Experience selling to business owners and/or agencies, and the presence to lead the room in a strategic pitch 
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills

With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Account Manager supports Account Executives’ sales efforts by taking ownership of fulfillment in such a way that the AE can play their role of being client-facing, creating opportunities and closing revenue. The Account Manager manages the day-to-day responsibilities of accounts to ensure proper implementation of their solutions. The Account Manager influences and drives sales by providing superior customer service and support across Broadcast Television and Digital, aiming at retaining clients and growing business. This  job reports to Sales Manager. 

 

Responsibilities:

  • Provide support to assigned Account Executives on post-sale activity including campaign implementation, maintenance, and review.
  • Daily interaction with existing advertising agencies and direct clients; this responsibility includes maintenance of client schedules on television and digital in addition to implementation of special projects and promotions.
  • Works in tandem with Account Executives, Marketing Director, Research Director, and Creative Services to support client needs.
  • Attend sales meetings and sales trainings to gain sales, product and process information and keep abreast of company products and services to articulate to client, when appropriate.
  • Partner with designated Account Executives in identifying new/incremental revenue based on campaign results.
  • Assist designated Account Executives with maintenance of contracts, generating avails, traffic, make-goods, collection and overall customer service.
  • Regular tracking of clients’ audience delivery using ratings, impressions, clients KPIs, and campaign fulfillment.
  • Coordinate with team to set up new customer accounts, contracts, order entry and revisions.

 

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of account management in a professional, fast-paced media sales environment.
  • Track record of successfully retaining and growing clients.
  • Knowledge of marketing solutions including broadcasting and digital advertising is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics and advertising solutions is highly desirable.
  • Prior experience using CRM systems and MS Office suite.
  • Able to make decisions and solve problems independently to support customer needs.
  • Self-motivation and willingness to work as a team player are essential attributes.
  • Demonstrate ability to be creative, flexible, and able to adapt to change with evolving priorities.
  • Creative with ability to work effectively as part of a team and independently.
  • Detail oriented with ability to handle and prioritize multiple tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Position requires strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as strong organization and time management skills.
Pay Range $26.50—$36.06 USD

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.
