job.title: Anchor
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KWES-TV Midland-Odessa a TEGNA NBC affiliate in Midland-Odessa has an amazing opportunity for a creative, innovative, and enterprising Anchor who is an excellent on-camera communicator to help serve the needs of our audience and community. We are looking for a journalist who excels at both accountability reporting and breaking news. We are seeking candidates who will trailblaze the future of news, find and defend the truth, and tell the stories of our community. This anchor should be someone who is comfortable asking tough but fair questions. This journalist must be able to work with producers to develop smart and engaging newscasts. We are looking for someone who understands the “why” behind stories and excels at impact journalism. The Anchor is a newsroom leader who will be one of the faces of the station in charge of developing contacts and relationships in the community enabling them to create and present unique, compelling, and innovative stories of interest.  

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Use editorial judgment to help determine content of the newscasts.
  • Work with producer and team to create unique, fast-paced innovative newscasts.
  • Use social media to determine content of newscasts and highlight big social stories.
  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.
  • Develop story ideas, write, shoot and edit news stories for on-air broadcasting.
  • Develop original content through social listening and independent sources.
  • Perform other tasks as required by supervisor or executive producer.
  • Journalism and/or Communication degree preferred.
  • Understand the tenets of professional Journalism.
  • Excellent, creative presentation and writing skills a must

Requirements: 

  • Minimum 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience
  • Develop story ideas, write, shoot and edit news stories for television, mobile and social platforms.
  • Write in an exciting, captivating, and authentic manner.
  • Use the latest editing and photography tools to tell great stories.
  • Develop original content through social listening and independent sources.
  • Deliver on-air news events in an engaging, exciting, and accurate manner.
  • Interview news subjects and research for facts and credibility.
  • Write and post daily on all digital platforms including social media.
  • Enterprise news stories.
  • Write for the web, including attaching images and streaming video.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.

Responsibilities:

  • Flexible scheduling: this position includes weekends, and may also cover early mornings, nights, or holidays as needed.

job.title: Broadcast Engineer Lead
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WFMY is seeking a Broadcast Engineer Lead to drive innovation and maintain excellence across our broadcast and IT infrastructure. This is a pivotal role for a technical visionary who balances hands-on expertise with strategic project leadership.

The Broadcast Engineer Lead is responsible for shaping system design decisions, defining local engineering standards, and leading complex projects that directly impact station operations. Operating with significant autonomy, you will not only execute tasks but also take full accountability for technical outcomes, ensuring our 24/7 environment remains resilient, modern, and efficient.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership & Ownership
  • System Accountability: Serve as the primary technical owner for key broadcast and IT systems; ensure reliability, scalability, and long-term performance.
  • Strategic Direction: Make independent decisions regarding system architecture and technical standards within corporate guidelines.
  • Modernization: Proactively identify opportunities for upgrades and recommend technology roadmaps aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Influence & Mentorship: Act as the technical authority and escalation point for engineering staff; mentor team members by setting direction and reviewing work for quality.
  • Project Leadership & Design
  • End-to-End Project Management: Lead the planning, technical design, and execution of major local, capital, and corporate engineering projects.

job.description:

Position:        Inventory Specialist
Department:    TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO)
Location:    Any TEGNA market 

Description:
We are hiring! The TEGNA Commercial Operations (TCO) team is looking for a talented and motivated person to join our team.
A broadcast Traffic department maximizes revenue for a television station through careful consideration of spot placement and program formatting. We describe our group as “Commercial Operations” because we do more than just place spots on a log; we work hand in hand with the sales, marketing/promotions, programming, news and engineering departments to create an on-air product that generates positive results for both our stations and clients. Our daily workflow has often been described as working a puzzle; we manipulate commercial inventory to maximize an advertiser’s return on investment. 
A successful Inventory Specialist pays attention to detail, is customer-service oriented, shows initiative and can balance multiple projects and requests while meeting daily deadlines.  

Specific job requirements include:
•    Using WideOrbit Traffic software, manage commercial inventory by accurately preempting or placing spots on the broadcast log
•    Meet daily log finalization deadlines and clear oversold inventory 13 weeks out
•    Understand and follow spot placement guidelines to ensure client specifications are met
•    Verify the broadcast log is maximized for revenue and meets product and advertiser separation requirements
•    Collaborate with TCO and station teammates to identify and communicate revenue opportunities to the sales team
•    Process sales orders and assist sales team with accurate order entry
•    Various other duties as assigned


If this sounds like a great fit, we are looking for applicants with the following skills and experience:
•    High school diploma (required)
•    Undergraduate degree in marketing, communications, or a related field (preferred)
•    Broadcasting, cable or radio traffic or sales support experience (preferred)
•    WideOrbit traffic system knowledge (preferred)
•    Proficient with computer software/applications, including Microsoft Office: Outlook, Word and Excel (required)
•    Attention to detail and strong organizational skills (required)
•    Desire to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment (required)
•    If you have relevant work experience, we are willing to train the right candidate
•    Work from home flexibility, must be in a TEGNA market

job.title: Collection Specialist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA, one of the most geographically diverse broadcasters in the U.S., is seeking a Collections Specialist to join our Shared Services team. This position will be part of the TEGNA corporate team with company-wide responsibility but will be physically located at our NBC Affiliate in Indianapolis, WTHR. The Collections Specialist is responsible for contacting customers to ensure timely payments of accounts receivables for an assigned portfolio and working with station personnel to minimize the risk of incurring write-offs and/or credit adjustments. This individual will ensure appropriate contact with customers and station personnel is followed per policy and all relationships are appropriately maintained for assigned portfolio.

Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to:
•    Perform collection activity including reviewing accounts receivable reports, performing daily analysis of balances, payments, and making customer service calls leading to sound decisions to minimize risk and implement effective solutions.
•    Engage in the investigation and resolution of customer issues/inquiries in a prompt, effective, and professional manner.
•    Plan and execute periodic calls with station personnel to review account balances, update status, and make decisions regarding next actions.
•    Prepare reporting and analysis as needed for review by others.
•    Communicate with the Credit team regarding updates needed to credit profile status/ratings.
•    Submit appropriate information to third-party collection agencies upon assignment.
•    Identify and communicates cash-in-advance accounts with debit balances
•    Makes appropriate notations on accounts in WideOrbit


Responsibilities:
•    High School Diploma or GED
•    2 years of customer service or business-to-business collections experience
•    Keen ability to determine which accounts require attention and ability to prioritize actions needed each day
•    Excellent written and verbal skills including superior customer service skills
•    Understanding of ‘soft’ collection methods and helping customers resolve issues and set dates for action with timely follow-up
•    Strong organizational skills to plan one’s day without being provided specific actions by the supervisor
•    High-level of customer service skill with the ability be seen as someone helping TEGNA customers resolve balance issues and providing high-quality service to our stations
•    Good Excel skills with history of exporting to Excel with minor formatting of results
•    Ability to run and command remote meetings with sales and local finance to review accounts


Requirements:
•    Two or four-year degree
•    Experience in a business-to-business collection environment handling hundreds of accounts primarily using AR Aging reports as the source for account action
•    4 or more years of experience
•    Broadcast Industry experience

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. TEGNA is seeking a Digital Campaign Specialist to support local broadcast stations with their digital advertising operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to grow their career in digital ad operations within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Location:

This role may be based at any TEGNA market location. Candidates should be located within commuting distance of a TEGNA market office and will follow the hybrid work schedule applicable to their local TEGNA location.

About the Role

As a Digital Campaign Specialist, you will work exclusively with TEGNA properties across various ad-serving platforms and order management systems. You’ll help manage CTV (Connected TV) and digital advertising campaigns from setup through delivery, ensuring they launch accurately, run smoothly, and meet performance goals.

This position involves campaign trafficking, troubleshooting, optimization, reporting, and quality assurance, making it ideal for individuals with strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in digital advertising technology.

This role includes participation in an on-call rotation after appropriate training.

Responsibilities:

  • Master the digital workflow between business units and Ad Operations.
  • Develop expertise in ad servers and order management systems, with an emphasis on CTV campaign execution.
  • Set up, schedule, and manage digital advertising campaigns accurately, including CTV-specific formats and delivery methods.
  • Ensure proper deployment of creative assets by understanding ad specifications, templates, and ad-tag technologies, including VAST/VPAID tags and dynamic ad insertion.
  • Provide timely support to TEGNA stations and internal stakeholders, particularly for CTV and digital campaign delivery issues.
  • Troubleshoot campaign performance concerns and conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure campaign accuracy and effectiveness.
  • Send campaign reports, communicate technical information clearly, and manage service-level agreement expectations.
  • Monitor shared inboxes and workflow systems consistently and respond to requests in a timely manner.
  • Track campaign performance and implement optimization strategies, including fill-rate management, frequency capping, and ad podding.
  • Ensure campaigns meet applicable rate-card requirements and revenue-margin standards.
  • Collaborate effectively with vendors, stations, and internal teams while maintaining a customer-focused approach.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college in a related discipline required.
  • 1–2 years of experience with ad-serving platforms, digital advertising, campaign management, or ad trafficking preferred.
  • 3–5 years of practical experience in digital technology or advertising may be accepted in lieu of a degree.
  • Hands-on experience with CTV ad trafficking, Server-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI), and VAST/VPAID tags is preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to work effectively in a technical environment.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML and JavaScript is a plus.
  • Experience with CTV or digital advertising platforms such as Publica or Google Ad Manager (GAM) is preferred.
  • Quick learner with a growth mindset and collaborative approach to teamwork.


Why Join Us?

  • Hands-on training and mentorship to develop your expertise in digital ad operations.
  • Opportunity to work with digital advertising and CTV technology across TEGNA's nationwide portfolio of local markets.
  • Hybrid work environment with the ability to be based at a TEGNA market location across the country.
  • Exposure to multiple ad-serving, campaign-management, and reporting platforms.

The Digital Sales Strategist plays a critical strategic role and has primary responsibility for campaign success through management and optimization of digital media campaigns to ensure launch and successful delivery.

Main role mission:

The Digital Sales Strategist will assist and strategize with key members of the sales staff including Account Executives, Sales Activation team, and sales leaders, to develop digital solutions by leveraging ad-serving interfaces and other operational platforms. The Digital Sales Strategist’s primary responsibility is campaign success through creating and implementing comprehensive marketing solutions, pre-sales order entry, campaign management, and optimization of Digital Media campaigns to ensure launch and successful delivery.

Responsibilities:

· Work strategically with our sales team to generate marketing solutions that will deliver exceptional client results through our industry-leading digital platforms, including the leading premium CTV/OTT advertising solution, Premion. · Partner with the Account Executives and Digital Sales Manager to generate digital revenue. · Lead in retention, expansion, and development of new digital business · Identify and quantify consumer audiences that would be receptive to client advertising messages. · Identify revenue-generating opportunities by exposing gaps in current digital advertising campaigns, such as impression share deficiencies, missing platforms, etc., that will further promote the client objectives. · Efficiently process digital sales orders by receiving, understanding, and accurately inputting them into multiple systems. · Support campaign execution by trafficking creative, communicating with our internal and external vendors, and monitoring live campaigns. · Prepare ad hoc and month-end reports for all digital accounts.

· Oversee the development of digital creative materials including display ads and dynamic video ads. · Proactively monitor and analyze digital campaigns to create solutions to retain and grow our digital revenue. · Create case studies and communicate successful digital campaign results to the sales team. · Monitor competitor websites for potential new revenue opportunities. · Attend client calls, if needed, as the digital expert on our product offerings.

 

Requirements:

· 1 to 3 years of digital marketing sales support, inside or outside sales experience.

· Expert knowledge of all facets of digital sales and marketing with good grasp of OTT and targeted display/video pre-roll.

· Adept at creating new revenue opportunities from synergies between interactive sales and other mediums.

· Google AdWords and Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) certifications highly desirable.

· Strong presenter and communicator with internal and external customers and partners.

· Reports to: Digital Sales Manager

Our team strives for growth, and we seek a leader who shares this ambition. As the executive producer, you will work closely with producers to create captivating shows and explore new methods of presenting audience-focused content that aligns with the needs of our community.

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate and execute long-term newsroom strategy
  • Train, develop, and coach the newsroom team with a focus on mentoring content creators across all platforms
  • Oversee the daily editorial process
  • Oversee the on-air execution and provide coaching and showcasing techniques
  • Review, approve scripts, and provide writing/copy editing to rundowns to ensure accuracy and quality
  • Source and recruit top-notch journalists
  • Participate in coordinating all aspects of coverage, from breaking news to enterprise story production and specials
  • Ensure the news coverage meets our brand, policies, values, and FCC rules
  • Direct newsroom operations and manage schedules
  • Work with newsroom management to establish goals and further develop our local brand

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field
  • Prior industry experience as a news producer and as a newsroom leader
  • Track record of quality journalism, high integrity, and ethical decision-making
  • Passion for growing journalists and fostering a creative, positive, and collaborative newsroom
  • Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news, and changing events
  • Strong organization, planning skills and the ability to work under constant time-sensitive deadlines
  • Knowledge of AP ENPS, Edius, photojournalism, video editing, and content management systems a plus

 

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Investigative MSJ
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WTOL 11, Toledo’s News Leader, is looking for a Multi-Skilled Journalist to join our award-winning 11Investigates team.This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career journalist who wants to learn how to dig deeper, ask tough questions and tell stories that make a difference. You don’t need years of investigative reporting experience. We’re looking for someone with strong journalism fundamentals, curiosity, determination and a willingness to sharpen your skills. You’ll work alongside our Emmy Award-winning and national Edward R. Murrow Award-winning journalists, gaining hands-on experience in investigative, accountability and consumer reporting.

What You’ll Do
As part of the 11Investigates team, you will:
•    Pitch, shoot, write, edit and report stories across broadcast, digital and streaming platforms.
•    Work alongside experienced investigative journalists to research and develop stories.
•    File and track FOIA and public records requests
•    Research court records, government documents, public information and data to help uncover new stories.
•    Follow up on daily news stories and look for unanswered questions and accountability angles.
•    Take viewer calls, emails and story tips and help determine where our newsroom can get involved.
•    Support our Call 11 for Action reporting by helping investigate consumer concerns and working to get viewers answers.
•    Conduct interviews with community members, public officials and other newsmakers.
•    Create journalism for all WTOL 11 platforms, including television, WTOL.com, streaming, social media and vertical video.
•    Assist with breaking news and major coverage when needed.


The ideal candidate
•    Has a degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or equivalent journalism experience.
•    Understands the basics of reporting, writing, shooting and video editing.
•    Has strong writing and communication skills.
•    Is comfortable approaching people, making phone calls and asking questions.
•    Has strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and fairness.
•    File public records requests, analyze documents and conduct accountability interviews.
•    Can manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
•    Wants coaching and is eager to grow as a reporter, storyteller and investigative journalist.

Why WTOL 11

At WTOL 11, you'll have the opportunity to develop skills that can set you apart throughout your career.
Our 11Investigates and Call 11 for Action teams are committed to listening to our community, uncovering problems, finding answers and holding those in power accountable.

We're looking for someone ready to learn, work hard and grow.
If you're curious, competitive and passionate about journalism that can make a difference, we want to hear from you.

job.title: Investigative Reporter
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KSDK, TEGNA’s NBC affiliate in St. Louis, is looking for an experienced Investigative Multi-Skilled Journalist to join our award-winning team. We’re seeking a journalist with a strong investigative track record who produces stories that create real impact. The ideal candidate is a dynamic and creative storyteller who thrives on uncovering the truth, holding those in power accountable, and delivering original journalism across all platforms, including broadcast, digital and streaming. This role is built for a curious, ethical and relentless reporter with a passion for enterprise and investigative work. Whether it's a deep-dive data piece, a fast-paced accountability story, or a visually rich digital experience, you know how to tell stories that matter—and make audiences care.

Responsibilities:
• Pitch, develop, and produce both short- and long-term investigative and enterprise stories.
• Dig deep into complex issues, find untold angles and uncover what others miss.
• Use open records laws, data analysis and innovative research methods to drive reporting.
• Build and maintain strong source networks across our coverage area.
• Write and deliver stories in a clear, compelling, and authentic voice across streaming, TV, digital and social platforms.
• Shoot and edit high-quality visual content using the latest gear and editing tools.
• Create content that’s not only informative but highly shareable and impactful.
• Enhance storytelling with graphics, data visualizations, social media elements and user-generated content.
• Collaborate with producers, editors, photographers and digital staff to maximize storytelling potential.
• Contribute to story development meetings and help shape the direction of ongoing coverage.
• Help cover breaking news as needed.

Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or related field.
• 5-7+ years of investigative journalism experience preferred.
• Experience using open records tools, PACER, LexisNexis and public databases.
• Strong storyteller skills with the ability to make the complicated understandable.
• Clear, compelling writing style adaptable for multiple platforms.
• Must be able to use all available tools to enhance stories, including AI.
• Digital-first mindset with strong understanding of social platforms and audience engagement.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Calm and confident under pressure, especially in breaking news situations.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.

job.title: Marketing Lead - East
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

The Marketing Lead is the primary strategic partner to the Regional Marketing Director (RMD) and drives marketing execution across the full ecosystem of centralized capabilities: Production, Paid Media, Social, CRM and Lifecycle. This role translates strategy into integrated campaign plans, owns the campaign calendar, and is the day-to-day marketing contact for station leadership across the portfolio.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • This person excels at navigating complexity, building stakeholder trust, and leading integrated work across multiple teams and markets.

Strategic & Campaign Leadership

  • Develop the campaign brief for each initiative — translating RMD strategy into an integrated plan with clear objectives, target audiences, key messages, channel mix and success metrics — and submit to the RMD for approval before execution begins.
  • Own the regional campaign calendar and integrated delivery timeline; ensure all campaigns are planned, resourced and launched on time and to spec.
  • Lead campaign development and execution, coordinating across Production, Paid, Social, CRM, Lifecycle and other centralized capabilities.
  • Direct Marketing Specialist to initiate campaign setup in monday.com; confirm boards are complete with the right assignments, timelines and deliverables.
  • Collaborate with Production through the creative development process — bring the audience, brand, and business context to concept development and scripting.
  • Hold creative and strategic standards across all campaign deliverables; ensure every asset is on-brand, on-message, and built to perform.
  • Drive clarity and prioritization across a complex portfolio of concurrent campaigns; make informed trade-offs and escalate strategic conflicts to the RMD as needed.

Station Partnership & Communications

  • Serve as the day-to-day marketing partner to station general managers, news directors and content leaders across the region.
  • Communicate campaign plans, status, and results clearly to station stakeholders; manage expectations, align on priorities and surface issues early.
  • Maintain the continuity and market context that allow centralized teams to move fast and with credibility in each market.

Campaign Performance & Team Development

  • Establish measurement frameworks for campaigns; track and report performance against objectives for the RMD and station leadership.
  • Apply audience data, ratings, digital analytics and market feedback to sharpen campaign strategy; translate performance patterns into recommendations that improve future planning and strengthen the team's overall approach.
  • Model campaign management discipline, strategic thinking and stakeholder communications; raise the overall capability and consistency of the marketing team.

 

Requirements:

  • 5–7 years in marketing, integrated campaign management or brand strategy — media, broadcast or a fast-moving content environment strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead integrated campaigns across multiple markets, channels and stakeholder groups simultaneously.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communications skills; comfortable translating complex strategy into clear stakeholder-ready messaging and creative briefs.
  • Strong command of campaign planning, prioritization and project management; experience with monday.com, Asana or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across paid media, social, CRM, content and other marketing channels toward shared campaign outcomes.
  • Familiarity with audience research, ratings, digital analytics and performance measurement in a media or broadcast context.
  • Comfortable operating in a 24/7 news-driven environment with fast-moving priorities, breaking news demands and tight timelines.
  • Must be willing to travel to markets within the portfolio when needed.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Media Strategist
Department: Sales / Revenue Strategy
Location: Market or Regional
Position Overview
The Media Strategist partners with local and regional sales teams to design, optimize, and support integrated advertising solutions across linear TV, digital, OTT/CTV, and emerging platforms. This role blends data-driven strategy, client insight, and media expertise to drive revenue growth, improve campaign performance, and elevate the quality of sales proposals and executions.

The Media Strategist acts as a strategic extension of the sales team—translating client business objectives into effective media strategies that deliver measurable results while aligning with TEGNA’s audience reach, content strengths, and data capabilities.
________________________________________
Responsibilities:
Strategic Planning & Client Solutions
•    Develop customized, insight-led media strategies aligned to advertiser goals, target audiences, and KPIs
•    Translate client objectives into full-funnel, multi-platform campaign recommendations
•    Support proposal development with clear narratives, audience insights, and performance rationale
•    Ensure strategies align with TEGNA best practices, inventory availability, and pricing models
Sales Partnership & Enablement
•    Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Sales Managers, and Directors of Sales
•    Participate in client meetings and presentations as the strategic media expert
•    Support new business pitches, RFPs, and renewals with compelling strategy and data
•    Educate sales teams on platform capabilities, audience products, and evolving media trends
Data, Insights & Optimization
•    Leverage first-party data, research tools, and third-party insights to inform strategy

About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WFAA-TV, the ABC TEGNA affiliate,  is looking for an experienced Multi-Skilled Journalist to help maintain our tradition of superior reporting and newsgathering. We are interested in finding a journalist who can create unique, memorable and well written stories, who can share them on all platforms with a mix of outstanding photography and unforgettable editing. If you're a creative storyteller who understands true multi-platform journalism and who is not bound by the methods of traditional TV news – we want to hear from you! 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities: 

  • Perform authoritative, compelling live shots in a developing story or in breaking news situations
  • Develop story ideas
  • Mine the community to find sources who will keep you informed about events and ideas in their areas of expertise
  • Ability to identify, write and produce stories within a specific framework.
  • Research for facts and credibility.
  • Maintain and develop sources who will help bring our reporting to the next level.
  • Shoot, write, produce and edit on air and online content within deadlines.
  • Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media (viewer pictures, webcam interviews, etc.) to enhance stories.
  • Use social media and digital tools to research, discover and distribute content.
  • Attend editorial meetings and offer story ideas daily.
  • Write in an exciting, captivating and authentic manner.

Requirements: 

  • 3-5 years reporting experience preferred.
  • Must possess solid news judgment, display strong communication skills, creativity, and ethical decision-making skills.
  • Strong writing skills, production skills and tease writing abilities.
  • ENPS, EDIUS and Axis graphics experience is preferred.
  • Must be organized with the ability to work under constant deadlines.
  • Must be able to calmly handle live breaking news situations and changing events.
  • Proven social and digital content creation ability.
  • Knowledge of Dallas a plus ​

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers. 

  Privacy Notice for California Residents   SMS Messaging Privacy Policy

job.title: Multi-Market Digital Sales Mgr
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WBIR-TV Kn TEGNA's NBC affiliate, is looking for a creative Multi-Market Digital Sales Manager (MMDSM) to join a top-performing sales team. You will be responsible for growing digital revenue with core and new business. As the Multi-Market Digital Sales Manager, you will manage and develop the digital sales skills and knowledge of the Account Executives and Account Managers and build strategies to win over clients within their markets. You also oversee performance and hold your team accountable for the achievement of their individual digital goals to achieve the collective objectives.   

This position reports to the Director of Sales

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Create, develop, and own strategies for generating and achieving digital revenue goals for the market.   
  • Recruit, retain, and effectively train top-performing sales and support talent on how to sell TEGNA’s large portfolio of digital products.  
  • Lead and develop a team of direct reports consisting of an Account Executive, an Account Manager, and manage dotted line reports.  
  • Supports sales staff with ride-along coaching, participating in client meetings, developing proposals, and acting as the subject matter expert on digital solutions.   
  • Identify market potential through lead generation and qualification.  
  • Analyze each account to create and maximize ideal marketing executions for clients, and complete appropriate business activity reports and forecasts as required.  
  • Develop strong relationships with local clients, manage key local accounts with your team and ensure top-shelf service is provided to all accounts.  
  • Review and adjust metrics to monitor sales/market share changes.  

Requirements: 

  • 5-7 years of successful digital sales and account engagement experience with 2 years of team management experience.   
  • Track record of successfully achieving or exceeding sales goals in digital media advertising industry, including OTT, within fast-changing, dynamic environments.    
  • Established leadership skills and demonstrated ability to develop teams with elite sales and customer service skills.   
  • Strategic thinker and disciplined executor comfortable developing and making recommendations to senior management.  
  • Strong presenter and communicator with internal and external customers and partners.   
  • Possess the ability to build an inclusive and positive work culture to foster success for the sales team.   
  • Proficiency with MS Office, Google Analytics, Wide Orbit Sales, Salesforce, Wide Orbit Traffic & Wide Orbit Analytics, ComScore, Matrix, Media Monitors, Tableau, and qualitative data. 
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects effectively under deadline pressure, and able to promptly adapt to changing priorities and goals.  
  • Ability to effectively solve problems.  
  • Travel up to 10% 

The position is bonus-eligible, subject to the terms of the respective plan.

KENS 5's morning lifestyle show, Great Day SA, is looking for a highly motivated, creative, and dynamic Multi-Skilled Journalist to join our team. We are seeking a storyteller who can shoot, write, edit, and deliver engaging content both on-air and across digital platforms.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a passion for lifestyle storytelling, a strong visual eye, and the ability to generate fresh, compelling content independently. You should be comfortable behind the camera, and in front of the camera conducting live and recorded interviews. If you're a creative journalist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves bringing exciting stories to life, we'd love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

Shoot, write, edit, and produce original lifestyle content for broadcast and digital platforms.
Use the latest photography and editing tools, including Adobe Premiere, to create engaging and visually compelling stories.
Develop unique, shareable content that resonates with television and social media audiences.
Conduct LIVE and recorded interviews for the show, both in-studio and in the field.
Pre-produce, shoot, and edit feature stories and lifestyle segments.
Write compelling scripts and create content that informs, entertains, and connects with viewers.
Edit b-roll, teases, promotional elements, and show content as assigned.
Research story ideas and regularly pitch creative, original content to the Executive Producer.
Attend editorial meetings, contribute story ideas, and content strategies.
Build and maintain relationships with sources, community partners, and potential guests.
Post content to social media platforms, including videos, photos, stories, and promotional content as assigned.
Use social media, digital tools, and audience trends to research, discover, and distribute content.
Monitor trends and identify opportunities for timely and relevant lifestyle coverage.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities

1-3 years of television news, lifestyle, or content production experience preferred. This is not an entry-level position.
Bachelor’s degree in journalism, Communications, Broadcasting, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
Strong photography, editing, and storytelling skills.
Proficiency with Adobe Premiere and modern content creation tools.
Comfortable appearing on camera and conducting live interviews.
Strong writing skills with the ability to craft compelling scripts and digital content.
Proven ability to generate creative story ideas and develop content independently.
Self-starter who can work with minimal supervision and take ownership of projects from concept to completion.
Strong understanding of social media platforms and digital audience engagement.
Experience creating and posting content across multiple social media platforms.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a collaborative team mindset.
Ability to adapt quickly and solve problems in a LIVE production environment.
Understanding of professional journalism ethics and standards.
Must be dependable, flexible, and reliable.
Valid driver's license and ability to travel to and from assignment locations.

job.title: Operations Analyst
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

This Operations Analyst role is part of a team that owns the day-to-day monitoring, support, and operational stability of TEGNA's broadcast and digital platforms while providing advanced support to stakeholders and business-critical applications. You'll work closely with distributed IT teams, engineering, and vendors in a 24x7 support environment—triaging incidents, resolving tickets, and keeping services online. Automating the repetitive task with AI and workflow tools. You'll leverage intelligent ticket routing, help implement our next predictive monitoring solution, and automations. Clear ownership from intake through resolution, sharp communication, and the ability to work across technical teams.

  • Incident Support & Workflow Automation 
    Own support tickets in ServiceNow from intake through resolution, with responsibility for issues spanning PC/Mac endpoints, imaging workflows, collaborative tools (Teams/O365), and emerging AI/workstream tooling. Troubleshoot complex endpoint issues across Intune (device compliance, conditional access, app distribution), hybrid identity systems (Okta, AD, Entra), and Exchange Online. Leverage Moveworks for intelligent ticket intake, prioritization, and automated routing to reduce manual triage. Coordinate cross-functionally with remote teams, document root causes and remediation steps in ServiceNow, and drive first-contact resolution rates. Identify automation opportunities—flagging repetitive tickets for workflow automation, knowledge gaps, and tooling inefficiencies that slow resolution. The role is also responsible for monitoring and supporting patch compliance.
  • System Monitoring and Operational Support 
    Provide proactive monitoring and day-to-day operational support for critical broadcast and streaming systems by responding to PagerDuty alerts, performing routine health checks in New Relic and native monitoring platforms, identifying early warning indicators, and taking preventative action to avoid service disruption. Own operational dashboards and alert tuning to reduce noise and catch real issues early.
  • Problem Management and Documentation 
    Analyze, resolve, and document incidents and recurring problems using structured root cause analysis. Capture resolutions, workarounds, and lessons learned in ServiceNow knowledge articles and operational runbooks. Drive continuous refinement of documentation to reduce repeat tickets and improve first-contact resolution rates.
  • Knowledge Management and Operational Readiness 
    Create, maintain, and improve operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base content to support the Service Desk and enable effective remote handoffs across distributed teams. Build self-service resources that reduce support load and empower end users.
  • Operational Flexibility and Continuous Improvement
    Adapt to changing priorities and operational demands, take ownership of assigned work, and constructively challenge existing tools and processes. Identify automation opportunities and champion process improvements that increase reliability, efficiency, and support outcomes.
  • Team Collaboration and Remote Support 
    Collaborate effectively with a globally distributed, remote-first team, including engineers, application owners, and broadcast/streaming operations. Support handoffs across time zones and enable a follow-the-sun operating model with clear communication and documentation.

Requirements:

  • College degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent hands-on experience in IT operations, service desk, or enterprise support roles.
  • Three or more years of experience in an operations or advanced helpdesk role, supporting enterprise applications, infrastructure, and end-user environments in a production or 24x7 support setting.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting broadcast, media, or digital workflow systems, including server platforms, end-user computing orchestration, and monitoring/management toolsets. Cloud and hybrid environment experience is a plus.
  • Strong working knowledge of IT service management practices and tooling, including ITIL concepts, incident and problem management, knowledge management, and ServiceNow.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and scripting technologies, such as PowerShell, Python, or similar languages, used to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual support effort.
  • Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent tickets, incidents, or tasks, working independently while collaborating effectively with remote and globally distributed teams.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document issues and resolutions and communicate technical information to a wide range of internal customers and business partners.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and identify practical, repeatable solutions.

TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

job.title: Paid Marketing Manager - Social
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

About the Role:

We’re seeking a highly skilled Paid Marketing Manager - Social with deep hands-on experience in scaling social media campaigns and a strong background in creative development and testing. This role requires someone who has an extensive understanding of the paid social ecosystem, including campaign strategy, execution, and performance optimization. The ideal candidate will have experience placing and managing media buys on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and others, with the ability to deliver measurable results. 

Responsibilities:

Campaign Strategy and Execution:

  • Develop and implement paid social media strategies that align with broader marketing objectives, focusing on driving traffic, engagement, and conversions.
  • Plan, execute, and manage paid media buys across platforms, including Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and emerging social platforms.
  • Set up campaigns with detailed targeting parameters, budgets, bidding strategies, and creative variations.
  • Monitor campaigns daily to ensure performance goals are met, adjusting bids and strategies as needed. 

Creative Development & Testing:

  • Partner closely with internal creative teams to concept, brief, and develop high-performing assets tailored for social and cross-channel use. 
  • Provide data-driven insights to influence creative direction, messaging, and visual strategy. 
  • Build structured A/B and multivariate testing roadmaps, including creative rotations, variant testing, messaging frameworks, and placement-level analyses. 
  • Translate testing results into actionable creative and channel recommendations. 

Performance Optimization & Analysis:

  • Monitor pacing, CAC/CPA efficiency, ROAS, retention, and device-level performance daily. 
  • Analyze in-platform metrics and downstream engagement to optimize budgets, bids, audiences, and creative mix. 
  • Work with analytics teams to refine dashboards, measurement strategies, and attribution frameworks. 
  • Run experiments across audiences, creatives, and placements to systematically improve efficiency. 

Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Collaborate with analytics, product, engineering, and creative teams to align efforts across acquisition, retention, and monetization. 
  • Influence creative and product roadmaps through insights and performance trends. 
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to leadership and peer teams. 

Operational Excellence:

  • Ensure accurate campaign setup, trafficking, tagging, and QA across all social campaigns. 
  • Maintain documentation of campaign learnings, testing frameworks, and optimization decisions. 
  • Ensure data integrity across MMPs, attribution systems, and platform dashboards. 

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience managing paid social media campaigns. 
  • Proficiency in using social media ad platforms, including Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Pinterest Ads, and others.  
  • Deep understanding of paid social media’s role within the broader digital marketing landscape.  
  • Knowledge of audience segmentation, retargeting strategies, and full-funnel paid social tactics. 
  • Experience working closely with creative teams to develop high-performing assets. 
  • Strong understanding of creative testing principles, A/B methodology, and the creative optimization cycle. 
  • Sharp analytical mindset with experience reading dashboards, performance reports, and attribution data. 
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex findings. 
  • Capable of thriving in a fast-paced, multi-project, high-growth environment.

Help us build the future of statewide local news in Arizona.
TEGNA is creating a statewide news operation by bringing together teams in Phoenix and Tucson to build a stronger content organization serving viewers across Arizona.
We are looking for a photojournalist based in Tucson to be part of a dedicated Southern Arizona news team serving our Tucson stations while also contributing to statewide coverage across our Phoenix and Tucson broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. This photojournalist will cover breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues and the people shaping Tucson and Southern Arizona. They will be deeply connected to the Tucson community while working as part of one collaborative Arizona newsroom serving audiences across both markets. This is an opportunity for an enterprising journalist who wants to help build something new: a truly statewide local-news operation with strong local teams in both Phoenix and Tucson.
Job summary
The photojournalist will be based in Tucson and serve as a key member of our Southern Arizona content team. This person will report, shoot, write and edit compelling journalism for our Tucson and Phoenix broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
The successful candidate will work closely with fellow reporters, photographers, producers and newsroom leaders in Tucson and Phoenix as part of one coordinated statewide content operation. They will be expected to develop original story ideas, build trusted sources, deliver compelling live reports and ensure the issues and communities of Southern Arizona are strongly represented across our coverage.

Responsibilities:
•    Cover live breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and platforms
•    Collaborate daily with newsroom teams in both Tucson and Phoenix as part of an integrated statewide content operation
•    Shoot, write, edit and produce impactful content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Own and develop original story ideas rooted in Tucson and Southern Arizona that are relevant locally and statewide
•    Build deep relationships and trusted sources throughout Southern Arizona
•    Be ready to go live for planned coverage and breaking-news situations across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and digital/streaming platforms, delivering clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Use social media and digital tools to discover, research, verify and share news content.
•    Uphold our newsroom standards for accuracy, fairness, urgency and compelling storytelling.
Requirements:
•    2 years of photojournalism experience
•    Proven ability to shoot, edit and produce strong broadcast and digital stories independently.
•    Strong news judgment, writing ability, ethical decision-making and attention to accuracy.
•    A track record of generating original story ideas and building trusted sources in a community.
•    Comfort working independently in the field while collaborating closely with a larger newsroom.
•    Ability to work quickly, calmly and accurately under deadline pressure.
•    Experience using social media and digital platforms for newsgathering and audience engagement

Help us build the future of statewide local news in Arizona.
TEGNA is creating a statewide news operation by bringing together teams in Phoenix and Tucson to build a stronger content organization serving viewers across Arizona. We are looking for a photojournalist who can also report on-air based in Tucson to be part of a dedicated Southern Arizona news team serving our Tucson stations while also contributing to statewide coverage across our Phoenix and Tucson broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. This photographer/reporter will cover breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues and the people shaping Tucson and Southern Arizona. They will be deeply connected to the Tucson community while working as part of one collaborative Arizona newsroom serving audiences across both markets.
This is an opportunity for an enterprising journalist who wants to help build something new: a truly statewide local-news operation with strong local teams in both Phoenix and Tucson.
Job summary
The Photographer/Reporter will be based in Tucson and serve as a key member of our Southern Arizona content team. This person will report, shoot, write and edit compelling journalism for our Tucson and Phoenix broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with fellow reporters, photographers, producers and newsroom leaders in Tucson and Phoenix as part of one coordinated statewide content operation. They will be expected to develop original story ideas, build trusted sources, deliver compelling live reports and ensure the issues and communities of Southern Arizona are strongly represented across our coverage.

Responsibilities:
•    Cover live breaking news, enterprise stories, major community issues across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and platforms
•    Collaborate daily with newsroom teams in both Tucson and Phoenix as part of an integrated statewide content operation
•    Report, shoot, write, edit and produce impactful content for broadcast, streaming, digital and social platforms.
•    Own and develop original story ideas rooted in Tucson and Southern Arizona that are relevant locally and statewide
•    Build deep relationships and trusted sources throughout Southern Arizona
•    Deliver clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Serve as a regular live presence across our Tucson and Phoenix newscasts and digital/streaming platforms, delivering clear, confident and conversational live reports in planned coverage and breaking-news situations
•    Use social media and digital tools to discover, research, verify and share news content.
•    Uphold our newsroom standards for accuracy, fairness, urgency and compelling storytelling.

Requirements:
•    2 years of reporting experience preferred.
•    Proven ability to shoot, write, edit and produce strong broadcast and digital stories independently.
•    Demonstrated ability to deliver polished, engaging live reports daily, including during breaking news.
•    Strong news judgment, writing ability, ethical decision-making and attention to accuracy.
•    A track record of generating original story ideas and building trusted sources in a community.
•    Comfort working independently in the field while collaborating closely with a larger newsroom.
•    Ability to work quickly, calmly and accurately under deadline pressure.
•    Experience using social media and digital platforms for newsgathering and audience engagement

job.description:

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. WOI/KCWI-TV, the TEGNA-owned ABC affiliate in Des Moines and WQAD the ABC affiliate in Quad Cities, is searching for an accomplished, strategic leader to serve as President & General Manager. 

The President & General Manager is responsible for the overall performance of both stations and markets, setting strategy and leading the organization to drive revenue growth, deliver high-quality local journalism, strengthen financial performance, grow audiences and deliver meaningful community impact across platforms. The successful candidate will be a proven business and people leader who builds high-performing teams, identifies new opportunities for growth, drives innovation and creates a culture of collaboration and accountability across both markets.

Responsibilities:

Leads the overall strategy and performance of both stations and markets, with accountability for content, sales, brand and operations across all platforms.

Develops and executes short- and long-term strategies to grow revenue, audience, market share and profitability in each market.

Provides strategic leadership for each station’s content operation, ensuring high-quality, relevant journalism that serves its local community, grows audiences and strengthens each station’s brand across platforms.

Leads multiplatform strategy across both markets, identifying opportunities to expand audience reach, engagement, content and distribution.

Partners with sales leadership in each market to drive revenue growth, strengthen customer relationships and deliver effective advertiser solutions.

Develops and manages annual budgets and forecasts, ensuring strong financial performance and accountability against business objectives across both markets.

Builds, develops and leads high-performing leadership teams across both stations, establishing clear expectations and accountability for results.

Creates alignment across content, sales and other functions while ensuring each market is responsive to its unique business, audience and community needs.

Drives innovation and continuous improvement, identifying new opportunities to grow the business, strengthen both operations and better serve audiences and customers.

Serves as a visible leader across both communities and builds strong relationships with community partners, advertisers, viewers and other key stakeholders.

Bachelor’s degree in journalism, business or related field and 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in media or a related industry.

Proven track record of leading high-performing teams and delivering strong business, financial and audience results.

Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategy, translate priorities into action and hold teams accountable for results.

Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting performance and driving revenue and profitability.

Experience leading across multiple functions and building alignment among teams with different priorities and areas of expertise.

Strong understanding of evolving media consumption, digital and streaming platforms, and opportunities to grow audiences and revenue across platforms.

Excellent judgment and critical-thinking skills with a demonstrated ability to make sound, data-informed decisions.

Innovative and growth-oriented mindset with a willingness to challenge existing approaches and identify new ways to win.

KHOU-TV, the TEGNA-owned affiliate in Houston, TX is seeking an innovative, tech-minded Producer to shape our daily newscasts. You’ll build & execute shows that engage, educate and inform our audiences. We value a collaborative, motivated multi-skilled journalist who works well within a team to bring the truth to our growing audiences across platforms, starting with our streaming and broadcast services. We want your authentic personality to drive your storytelling and writing in an exciting and captivating manner to hold the audience.​

​Responsibilities:​

•    Use your natural curiosity to pitch compelling stories, while leading the entire newscast process from ideation to execution.​

•    Craft and produce stories across platforms for diverse audiences, emphasizing quality, accuracy, and engagement.​

•    Build comprehensive rundowns with compelling stories, while also selecting your own production elements giving you full control of your show’s look and feel.​

•    Collaborate with newsroom leadership, production lead, and other producers to ensure editorial consistency and technical quality.​

•    Lead continuous, live coverage of breaking news and community events.​

•    Innovate in show design and storytelling, trying new approaches with guidance from supervisors.​

•    Apply data analytics to shape content and boost engagement.​

•    Commit to inclusive storytelling by amplifying underrepresented voices in the community.​

​
Requirements:​

•    Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field preferred.​

•    1-3 years of news content experience, ideally with experience in show production.​

•    Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple aspects of newscast production under tight deadlines.​

•    Excellent communication skills for coordinating within the newsroom and adapting plans in high-pressure, live situations.​

•    Ability to maintain composure and adaptability during breaking news and high-stakes events.​

•    Proficiency in news production tools preferred, with a willingness to learn new systems for production coding and show direction.​

•    Knowledge of vMix, Edius, or similar production platforms is beneficial but not required.​

•    A collaborative, growth-focused approach to leadership that aligns with the station’s commitment to innovation and community engagement.​

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

job.title: Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We're looking for a Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation to help TEGNA measure, learn from, and continuously improve our digital products. This role sits at the intersection of product analytics and experimentation, partnering with Product Managers to transform customer behavior into actionable insights that improve our websites, mobile apps, notifications, and personalization capabilities.

You'll help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities, enabling product teams to measure outcomes, validate hypotheses, and make confident, data-informed decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Working across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, QA, and Editorial, you'll help build a culture where analytics and experimentation are integral to how we discover, deliver, and continuously improve our products.

Who You Are

You are passionate about understanding customer behavior and using data to improve products. You enjoy digging into analytics, identifying opportunities, designing experiments, and translating complex findings into practical recommendations.

You're equally comfortable partnering with Product Managers to define success metrics, collaborating with Engineering on instrumentation requirements, working with Data teams to ensure analytics quality, partnering with UX Research and Design to better understand customer behavior, building dashboards, and helping stakeholders interpret the impact of new features, experiments, and customer journeys.

You have a strong analytical mindset but understand that data is only valuable when it leads to better decisions. You're curious, collaborative, and eager to develop expertise in product analytics and experimentation while helping teams build better products.

You're organized, proactive, and motivated by TEGNA's mission to connect and serve local communities everywhere.

Scope of Responsibility

Partner with Product Managers across TEGNA's Consumer Products organization to define success metrics, measure product performance, identify opportunities, and support experimentation initiatives.

Help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities by establishing best practices for instrumentation, dashboard development, experimentation, and product analysis.

Support product teams throughout the product lifecycle by helping define measurement plans, analyze product performance, and communicate actionable insights that improve customer outcomes.

Top Key Activities

  • Product Analytics - Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, develop dashboards, analyze customer behavior, and identify opportunities to improve product performance.
  • Analytics Enablement - Develop dashboards, reports, and reusable measurement frameworks that make product performance visible and actionable across the organization.
  • Instrumentation - Partner with Product Managers and Engineering to define analytics requirements, document event tracking, validate instrumentation, and improve the consistency and quality of product data.
  • Product Analysis - Analyze product performance, feature adoption, customer journeys, conversion funnels, engagement trends, and experiment results to generate actionable recommendations.
  • Experimentation - Support the design, execution, and measurement of A/B tests and feature rollouts, partnering with product teams to validate hypotheses and measure customer impact.
  • Communications - Present dashboards, findings, experiment results, and recommendations to product teams and stakeholders through clear written and verbal communication.

Domain Acumen

  • Experience working with digital product analytics platforms such as Amplitude (preferred) or Google Analytics.
  • Experience supporting A/B testing, experimentation, feature flagging, or progressive delivery using LaunchDarkly or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of product metrics including adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, funnels, and customer behavior analysis.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering to define or validate analytics instrumentation.
  • Ability to translate business questions into meaningful product insights.
  • Strong understanding of agile software development and how analytics supports continuous product improvement.
  • Experience with SQL, visualization tools, or business intelligence platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with digital media, publishing, consumer products, or content platforms is desirable.

Key Professional Traits and Requirements

  • 2-5 years of experience in Product Analytics, Digital Analytics, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and Engineering teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills
  • Comfortable collaborating across Product, Design, Engineering, QA, Data, and Editorial teams
  • Data-informed decision maker with experience measuring product outcomes
  • Curious, collaborative, and eager to learn
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments

Tools

Deep knowledge and proficiency with the following:

  • Analytics: Amplitude or equivalent
  • Experimentation: LaunchDarkly or equivalent
  • Atlassian products: Jira, Jira Product Discovery, Confluence
  • Visualization: Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio, or equivalent

Why Join Us?

Help shape how TEGNA builds better digital products through data.

As a Product Analyst, you'll partner with product teams across websites, mobile apps, personalization, notifications, experimentation, and analytics to help teams understand customer behavior, validate ideas, and continuously improve the experiences that reach millions of users every day.

You'll work alongside experienced product leaders and analysts, building deep expertise in product analytics and experimentation while making a meaningful impact on the future of local journalism.

This is an opportunity to grow your career at the intersection of analytics, experimentation, and product strategy, helping create a culture where every product decision is informed by data and every product improvement is measurable. #LI-MS1

WFAA has a strong legacy of community engagement. • Lead production efforts for the Community Impact Team, creating high-quality content for broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms
• Produce live and pre-produced community content, broadcast specials, PSAs, branded/partner content, and Community Impact franchises
• Oversee PSA production, inventory, placement, and post-campaign reporting
• Manage productions from concept and pre-production through shooting, editing, graphics, finishing, and delivery

• Excellent communication, leadership, collaboration, and project management skills

job.title: Reporter
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KGW is looking for a creative, driven and curious news reporter who can shoot and edit his or her own stories. Known in our newsroom as a “multi-skilled journalist,” MSJs are a key part of our newsroom’s coverage on both broadcast and digital platforms.

We are looking for a candidate who isn’t afraid to tackle complicated stories, who will hold the powerful accountable, and who gets excited at the prospect of creating great journalism. The ideal candidate will pitch smart stories and tell them in way that is both creative and engaging.

Most stories will be same-day turns, while other times you’ll be given more time to execute your vision. You can expect to work solo many days, although there are ample opportunities to work with a photographer, especially on breaking news or complex stories.
Please let us know if you have experience producing and anchoring weather forecasts. While not required, candidates who have weather experience will be given extra consideration.

Our ideal candidate embraces the digital future of our industry and can show examples of strong work on digital, streaming and social media platforms.

This role is a full-time, non-exempt position represented by SAG-AFTRA. The position may include weekend shifts.

Responsibilities:

•    Report, write, shoot and edit news stories for broadcast and digital platforms. Use creative production techniques such as graphics and new forms of media to enhance stories.
•    Consistently pitch strong story ideas.
•    Maintain the highest journalistic standards in every story you cover. We expect you’ll report stories accurately and honestly, treat sources with fairness and empathy, and hold yourself accountable when you make a mistake.

Requirements:

•    Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or related field
•    Strong understanding of journalism ethics and best practices with a minimum of three years of experience in broadcast journalism or a related field
•    Experience with shooting video, video editing, and web content management systems
•    Ability to generate creative, engaging, content-driven live shots
•    Strong social media skills and presence
•    Ability to calmly handle live, breaking news situations and changing events
•    Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
•    Knowledge of ENPS, Edius, Premiere, After Effects and Photoshop a plus
•    Ability to work days, mornings, nights or weekends as needed
