job.title: Video Reporter, Texas
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Times is looking for a Texas-based journalist with experience telling stories in video and text. You will work as part of a team of reporters and editors working from our newly created hub in Texas — a state that plays an essential role in the national discourse when it comes to politics, culture and business.

You have experience pitching stories and developing sources to deliver original and impactful journalism rooted in on-the-ground reporting that deepens our understanding of America. We're looking for a high-energy multimedia journalist – you should have a background that includes reporting in video and the ability to craft news and enterprise articles in text. You should be comfortable working across the two mediums, and you should have good judgment about when either is appropriate.

As a reporter, you are full of ideas on how to make an impact in our coverage and find innovative ways to tell stories. You have a body of work that shows effective sourcing, broad curiosity, a sharp eye for news, and a command of complex ideas. You have a track record of reporting that has produced scoops and helped to shape the conversation.

You are a self-starter and quick-thinker who is able and eager to jump on the news of the day (or week) with fresh visual ideas that advance the story or delve deeper and create high-quality, engaging videos across a variety of coverage areas.

This is a hybrid position based in Texas and includes regular attendance in the office each week per your departmental guidance and/or This role may require extensive travel across the state.

Responsibilities:

  • Pitch, report and write news and enterprise stories in text and video formats.
  • Develop compelling and well-structured scripts, integrating engaging visuals and rigorous fact-checking.
  • Report and produce video and text for news and enterprise projects. Either on-camera or behind the screens.
  • Collaborate with cinematographers, video editors, and motion graphics editors.
  • Contribute to live coverage on breaking news stories.
  • Deliver fast, clean copy in accessible style on complicated topics.
  • Ensure accuracy and clarity.
  • Break news on developing story lines across the region.
  • Collaborate with other national and video team reporters on news and enterprise; Work collaboratively with members of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Monitor wires, local and regional outlets, social media feeds and other sources for developing storylines, keeping us ahead of national competitors.
  • Meet tight deadlines and be able to thrive in a daily, unpredictable news environment.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • This role reports to the Texas Editor and a Senior Producer in Video, based in Los Angeles.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience working for a daily news organization (preferably in a digital video or broadcast newsroom).
  • A portfolio that demonstrates you are well-versed in a range of topics, and have a growing circle of sources across storylines and includes:

    • news, enterprise and analysis.

    • video you produced, shot or appeared in.

  • Proven experience leading field productions, writing scripts and editing compelling narratives.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the video production process and creative instincts that go beyond traditional text formats.
  • Crisp, clear, evocative writing skills that also demonstrate a mastery of journalistic style and standards.
  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Ability to shoot video.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A deep understanding of the issues facing the state, from experience living or working in Texas or the Southwest.
  • Strong editorial judgment and writing skills, with a passion for finding original, visual journalism opportunities in competitive news moments.
  • A foundational knowledge of legal, ethical and usage issues for visuals.
  • A willingness to be flexible as the news demands and the newsroom's needs evolve.
  • An openness to trying new storytelling approaches.

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

job.title: Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
job.description:
Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting

*This is a remote position that requires you to work closely and collaboratively with internal teams.*

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital and broadcast media and digital marketing solutions company principally focused on markets outside the top 50 in the U.S. Our assets include 340 radio stations across 74 local markets, more than 400 local news and entertainment websites and mobile apps, a subscription digital marketing services business (Townsquare Interactive) and a digital advertising division (Townsquare Ignite).

 

About the Opportunity:

The Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting owns Townsquare’s external reporting and technical accounting and is a key member of the accounting leadership team.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all aspects of the market operation with a particular focus on revenue generation across Townsquare’s multiple media and entertainment platforms.
  • Create a vision and strategy for consistent revenue and profit growth, with the ability to communicate and execute the plan
  • Support the content team (on air and on line) and hold them accountable to executing the brand strategy and delivering content excellence.
  • Recruit, train & develop top sales talent
  • Lead their sales team to exceed revenue targets by developing a sales strategy and holding the team accountable to hitting and exceeding their individual goals.
  • Ensure the station’s license is in order and that Federal Communications Commission (FCC) and other federal, state and local rules and regulations are followed.
  • Drive key account growth through the selling of results based, integrated programs while also pushing significant new business development.
  • Prepare and manage the fiscal budget. Develop/implement strategic goals to exceed local advertising, live events and digital services budgets.
  • Represent TSM to key client accounts and community; developing strong client relationships and community partnerships that further our business.

 

Qualifications:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

Education & Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or national firm preferred) and either at least three years of SEC reporting at a public registrant or equivalent experience auditing public companies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; active CPA license required.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and SEC rules (Regulation S-X and S-K).
  • Experience supervising and developing staff; month-end close experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong written communication skills and the judgment to present to senior management and the Audit Committee.

 

Computer Skills:

  • Advanced Excel required (Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, building and auditing complex models).
  • Hands-on experience with Workiva or similar reporting software, including inline XBRL tagging, strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP and IBM Planning Analytics (TM1/Cognos), or comparable ERP and planning systems, preferred. Working knowledge of SQL a plus.
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) for research, drafting and automation, consistent with Company policy, a plus.
  • Proficiency in Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive base salary
  • 3 weeks PTO
  • 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal/floating holidays)
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Comprehensive training and growth opportunities
  • Unlimited growth potential in a dynamic work environment

job.title: Multi-Media Account Executive
job.description:
Multi-Media Account Executive

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level:

Are you a driven, goal-oriented seller looking to grow your career in a high-impact role? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking experienced Account Executives who thrive in a fast-paced environment, love building relationships, and are motivated by helping local businesses succeed. If you’re a confident closer with a passion for strategic, consultative sales—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Dubuque stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a key member of our Dubuque sales team, you’ll take full ownership of building and managing a book of business. You’ll focus on bringing in new clients while maintaining long-term relationships with existing accounts. This is a full-cycle sales role where you’ll:

  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new business using data-driven insights and tools
  • Conduct in-depth needs assessments and present tailored marketing strategies
  • Represent our full portfolio of solutions including broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorships
  • Cross-sell and upsell to expand your clients’ reach and ROI
  • Partner with internal teams and collaborate on campaign execution and strategy
  • Work directly with your Market Leadership to meet and exceed individual and team goals

This is a consultative sales position where success is defined by your ability to build trust, deliver results, and help local businesses thrive.

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in sales (required)
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales goal
  • Demonstrated success in identifying and securing new business
  • Strong work ethic, drive, and competitiveness
  • Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community

job.title: Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer - WHWK
job.description:
Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer – WHWK

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Be the Voice, Face, Writer, Content and Community Influencer of Your Community:

Are you a creative personality with a passion for radio, digital storytelling, video content creation, and building community relationships? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re looking for a Radio Host / Multimedia Content Creator & Brand Influencer who can dominate the airwaves, create compelling local written content online, produce engaging video across platforms, and partner with local businesses as a trusted endorser and influencer.

This is a full-time, in-office role, working closely with a collaborative and fun local team. We’re searching for a true 360-degree multimedia talent with initiative—someone who thrives on radio, creates video content consistently, writes articles that demand attention, commands a room in person, and creates business opportunities with confidence. If you see yourself as a local influencer who can authentically connect, create content, endorse brands and generate revenue, this role was built for you.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Binghamton stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Radio Host / Digital Content Writer, you’ll play a key role in shaping the daily sound and digital presence of WHWK. You’ll engage audiences across on-air, online, social, and in the community by:

  • Hosting live, engaging on-air shows Monday through Friday
  • Preparing daily show content that entertains, informs, and connects with the target audience
  • Creating and publishing a minimum of two original local articles per day for the station website and mobile app
  • Writing and scheduling engaging posts across social platforms including Facebook and others
  • Connecting with listeners through interviews, live appearances, remotes, and community events
  • Representing the station at promotions, live broadcasts, and special programming initiatives
  • Producing commercials and assisting with market-wide programming and content needs
  • Championing the station brand “on the streets” by building authentic community relationships
  • Collaborating with on-air, digital, production, and sales teams to support integrated content initiatives
  • Creating and publishing original video content regularly, including social-first short-form video (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form segments that grow your personal on-screen brand
  • Prospecting and developing endorsement and influencer partnerships with local businesses, pitching yourself as a trusted community voice who can authentically promote products and services across on-air, video, and social platforms
  • Participating in person in high-visibility community events, client meetings, and business functions as a station ambassador who builds relationships that translate into revenue

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven, active track record creating original written digital content AND video content across social platforms (show us your pages)
  • Strong on-air presence AND on-camera comfort, with the ability to connect authentically with listeners and viewers across every platform
  • Knowledge of basic FCC rules and regulations
  • Solid understanding of current events and various formats
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Comfort multitasking, meeting deadlines, and working in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to operate control boards, remote broadcast equipment, and related production tools
  • Willingness to quickly learn and become proficient in NexGen and Adobe Audition
  • Exceptional public speaking, presentation, and networking skills with the confidence to walk into a business, build a relationship, and close an endorsement deal
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize effectively
  • Active video creator with a current, maintained presence on at least one short-form video platform (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) and demonstrated comfort on camera
  • Entrepreneurial, sales-minded instincts: you think about your personal brand as a business, proactively seek out partnership and endorsement opportunities, and are motivated by revenue tied to your influence
  • Experience with or strong interest in influencer marketing, brand endorsements, or sponsored content creation, including the ability to pitch yourself compellingly to local advertisers
  • High School Diploma (required)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

We offer a supportive environment where talent is developed and growth is encouraged:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program + endorsement revenue opportunities (your influence = your upside)
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunities for upward mobility within a growing media organization
  • Company discounts
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • And much more…

 

Ready to Own Your Market? Apply Today!

job.title: Regional Market Engineering Manager - Eastern Colorado & Wyoming
job.description:
Regional Market Engineering Manager - Eastern Colorado & Wyoming

*This is a hybrid position that involves travel, after-hours and weekend work, and on-call availability as required. You will be supporting our Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. *

 

About Townsquare Media:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

The Regional Market Engineering Manager Opportunity:

Townsquare Media is looking for a Market Engineering Manager to oversee our multi-station broadcast radio facility in the Fort Collins, Casper, Cheyenne, and Laramie markets. 

This position serves as the sole technical authority for market-level engineering operations and is responsible for the planning, analysis, and independent decision-making that governs broadcast continuity, FCC compliance, and infrastructure strategy across all assigned stations. The Market Engineering Manager exercises independent judgment on matters that directly affect station revenue, regulatory standing, and operational performance, and will personally perform technical work when operational circumstances require.

 

Essential Functions:

The following duties are essential functions of this position. The ability to perform each of these functions, with or without reasonable accommodation, is a condition of employment.

Independent Judgment and Decision-Making

  • Exercise independent judgment to assess, prioritize, and resolve technical failures affecting station broadcast continuity, including real-time decisions during on-air emergencies where delays directly impact revenue and regulatory standing
  • Evaluate equipment performance and determine appropriate corrective action, including the authority to take systems offline, reroute signals, or authorize emergency repairs without prior approval when broadcast continuity is at risk
  • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations
  • Develop and recommend capital expenditure plans for infrastructure upgrades, including vendor evaluation, budget proposals, and cost-benefit analysis for executive approval
  • Evaluate and select vendors and contractors for engineering projects and maintenance

Technical Operations

  • Inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed
  • Install and maintain LAN systems
  • Ensure compliance with all Company Engineering and Information Technology practices

Travel and Emergency Response

  • Maintain a valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
  • Drive independently to multiple transmitter sites across assigned markets, including remote locations
  • Respond to emergency equipment failures on short notice, including after hours and weekends; this role requires on-call availability reflecting the position’s independent authority over broadcast operations
  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Cognitive and Communication Requirements

  • Read and interpret technical documents, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, schematics, and procedure manuals
  • Follow detailed verbal and written instructions accurately and retain information necessary to complete tasks
  • Identify and differentiate between multiple transmitters, equipment components, and site locations
  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports, technical documentation, and correspondence
  • Communicate effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with the Senior Vice President of Engineering, Senior Vice President of
  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

Safety and Physical Requirements

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Follow all safety protocols for working with high-voltage equipment and at tower sites
  • Maintain situational awareness to prevent falls and injuries
  • Climb ladders and work at heights
  • Work in varying weather conditions and outdoor environments
  • Frequently stand, walk, sit, use hands to handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
  • Occasionally climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
  • Maintain close visual acuity to prepare and analyze data and figures, view a computer terminal, read extensively, inspect small defects and parts, operate machines, and use measurement devices

 

Qualifications:

Required

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible broadcast engineering experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgment in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists
  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

Preferred

  • SBE certification or computer-related certification
  • Experience with Zetta and Wheatstone systems

 

Benefits:

  • 3 weeks of PTO (+ 9 paid holidays)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Casual, high-energy work environment
  • Opportunity for upward mobility
  • Company provided laptop
  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Company discounts
  • Pet Insurance
  • Time off for volunteering
  • And much more…

 

 

Disclaimer:

This job description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. The incumbent will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required by the supervisor. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

 

About Us:

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing web sites, search engine optimization, social platforms and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 357 local terrestrial radio stations in 74 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com and Loudwire.com.

job.title: Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise
job.description:
Sales Internship, Townsquare Media Group – Boise

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Launch Your Sales & Media Career:

Interested in a career in sales, advertising, or digital marketing? Townsquare Media’s Sales Internship gives college students the opportunity to gain real-world experience while learning how businesses use media and marketing to grow.

As a Sales Intern with our Boise team, you won’t spend your internship sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work alongside experienced sales professionals, learn the fundamentals of consultative selling, and gain exposure to the full sales process—from identifying prospective clients and qualifying opportunities to conducting needs analysis and securing appointments.

You’ll also get a behind-the-scenes look at how a local media company operates, with exposure to our radio brands, digital marketing solutions, on-air operations, community events, and the teams that bring it all together.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Boise stations.  

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As an intern on our Boise sales team, you’ll gain hands-on experience with the fundamentals that drive successful sales organizations. You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn how to identify and research prospective local businesses
  • Develop prospecting skills through phone, email, and other outreach
  • Learn how to qualify potential clients and identify strong sales opportunities
  • Practice conducting needs analysis to better understand a business, its goals, and its marketing challenges
  • Build confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Learn how to secure appointments and create opportunities for our sales team
  • Shadow experienced Account Executives throughout different stages of the sales process
  • Gain exposure to client meetings, sales presentations, and marketing strategy
  • Learn how our team uses broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorship solutions to help local businesses grow
  • Develop an understanding of pipeline management, sales activity, and performance goals

 

You’ll also have opportunities to experience other areas of our Boise operation, including our radio stations, on-air teams, promotions, and off-site events, giving you a broader understanding of how sales connects with the entire organization.

This is a sales-focused internship designed to give you practical experience, meaningful coaching, and a strong foundation in consultative selling.

 

What You’ll Bring:

We’re looking for students who are curious, motivated, and excited to learn. You don’t need previous sales experience—we’ll help you build the skills.

  • Currently pursuing a college degree in Sales, Business, Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
  • Genuine interest in exploring a career in sales
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence starting conversations and willingness to step outside your comfort zone
  • Coachable mindset and desire to learn
  • Strong work ethic, organization, and follow-through
  • Positive attitude and ability to work collaboratively with a team
  • Interest in media, digital marketing, advertising, or local business is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This internship is designed to give you more than something to add to your resume. You’ll leave with real-world experience and a better understanding of what it takes to build a career in sales.

  • Hands-on sales training and coaching
  • Real-world experience in prospecting, qualifying, needs analysis, and appointment setting
  • Opportunities to shadow successful Account Executives
  • Exposure to digital advertising, radio, programmatic marketing, events, and local media
  • Experience working with local businesses and understanding their marketing challenges
  • Opportunities to attend station and community events
  • Direct access to experienced sales and market leadership
  • A chance to build your professional network and résumé before graduation
  • Exposure to potential career opportunities with Townsquare Media

 

If you’re competitive, curious, comfortable talking to people, and interested in learning how great sellers build relationships and create opportunities, we’d love to meet you.

job.title: Business Director
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are looking for a Business Director to join Translation and help lead our growing Eli Lilly partnership, bringing culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health.

Position Summary

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner across assigned Eli Lilly brands and workstreams. You will build a deep understanding of the client’s business, patient audiences, and category, translating those insights into clear direction and creative opportunities that connect brands with people in meaningful ways.

Working with the account’s Executive Director, you will lead client relationships, guide cross-functional teams, develop Business Leadership talent, and identify opportunities for growth. You will partner closely with Program Management on delivery and account financial health, balancing creative ambition with the rigor of a regulated category and the needs of a fast-growing business.

What You Will Do

Drive Business and Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the day-to-day senior business lead across assigned Lilly brands and workstreams, building trusted relationships with mid-to-senior client stakeholders and proactively shaping the business agenda.
  • Develop a strong understanding of brand priorities, patient experiences, barriers to engagement, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic counsel and creative development.
  • Translate complex client needs and feedback into clear priorities and actionable direction, constructively challenging clients when needed to strengthen the work.
  • Monitor relationship health and business performance, anticipating risks and partnering with the Executive Director to address issues before they affect the partnership.

Lead Creative Solutions with Business Impact

  • Partner with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Analytics to develop culturally relevant work grounded in business objectives, audience insights, and clear measures of success.
  • Champion communication that reflects real patient experiences and makes complex health topics understandable, empathetic, and relevant to everyday life.
  • Ensure work is strategically sound and client-ready, with compelling rationale and alignment to client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.
  • Work with Lilly’s brand teams, internal creative team, and agency partners to clarify roles, align recommendations, and maintain continuity across the work.
  • Partner with Production and Program Management to bring approved concepts to life within agreed scope, timing, and budget, advocating for additional investment when warranted.

Lead Teams and Strengthen Partnerships

  • Guide cross-functional teams with clear priorities, expectations, and decisions, creating a collaborative environment with shared accountability for the work.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Business Supervisors and other assigned Business Leadership team members through regular feedback and meaningful development opportunities.
  • Partner with Program Management, which leads operational planning and delivery, to align client expectations with scopes, schedules, staffing, and review requirements.
  • Work with client stakeholders and Program Management to anticipate approval needs, consolidate feedback, and help teams understand review decisions and their implications.
  • Navigate competing stakeholder needs and resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating significant relationship, commercial, or delivery risks appropriately.

Champion Growth and Financial Health

  • Develop and action growth plans for assigned brands and workstreams, connecting unmet client needs with Translation’s capabilities.
  • Co-own account financial health with Program Management, contributing to scope development, staffing recommendations, forecasting, and profitability management.
  • Identify scope changes and investment needs early, leading clear client conversations about the associated fees, priorities, and trade-offs.
  • Contribute to new business, recruiting, and departmental improvements that strengthen the agency and develop future Business Leadership talent.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities

  • Strong business judgment and strategic fluency, with the ability to learn complex categories and turn ambiguity into clear direction.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills, including the confidence to advise clients, explain creative rationale, and navigate sensitive conversations.
  • Ability to balance creative ambition with accuracy and client review requirements, partnering effectively with medical, legal, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Experience leading integrated campaigns across channels, with a strong understanding of creative development and production.
  • Commercial acumen across scopes, staffing, budgets, and account performance, paired with a collaborative approach to Program Management.
  • A proactive, hands-on leadership style, with sound prioritization, attention to detail, and the ability to develop others in a fast-moving environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of experience in an agency or communications-related industry, with a well-rounded understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and agency finance.
  • Proven success managing integrated campaigns, partnering with mid-to-senior-level clients, and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on production experience with large-scale, multi-channel initiatives.
  • Experience coaching junior account team members and contributing to scope development, account financial management, and organic growth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated brands, including familiarity with medical, legal, and regulatory review processes. Direct pharma experience is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.
  • Experience with consumer-facing health communications, patient storytelling, or brand launches.
  • Experience partnering with in-house creative teams and working within a multi-agency environment.
  • Experience developing culturally relevant campaigns, including talent partnerships, social content, or experiential work.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $115,000 - $135,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

job.title: Business Supervisor
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support our Eli Lilly business, helping bring culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote. 

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.
  • Build a working understanding of the client’s brands, patient audiences, competitive landscape, and business priorities to inform day-to-day client partnership and internal direction.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives, approved strategy, and client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.
  • Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

  • Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
  • Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.
  • Partner with Program Management and client stakeholders to clarify review requirements, consolidate feedback, and ensure teams understand approval decisions and their implications.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $83,000 - $100,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

job.title: Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans – empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first – disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator to join UnitedMasters! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: four days in office and one day remote.

The Role

As a Commerce & Artist Marketing Coordinator, you will help make sure our artists’ music lands in front of the right audiences and their physical product reaches the fans who want it. You will support the Commerce team as the day-to-day connective tissue between UnitedMasters and our DSPs: Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and others — keeping pitch calendars, release grids and editorial follow-ups running on time, and tracking what placements actually delivered. Alongside that, you will help coordinate physical products: vinyl, CDs and special collector formats, from manufacturing timelines through inventory and retail distribution.

Beyond the commerce remit, you will serve as a coordination point for the broader Music team — running the logistics behind our recurring team and leadership meetings, supporting our Artist Management team on high-priority administrative needs, and helping bring our label events and partner presentations to life. This is a role for someone who is energized by being the person who keeps a lot of moving parts on the rails.

This is an entry-level role built for someone who wants to learn the commercial engine of the music business from the inside while working directly alongside our artist management and label leadership. You will sit close to the decisions that determine how an independent release performs, and the relationships and instincts you build here with DSP partners and our artist-facing teams are the foundation of a career in music.

What You’ll Do

Commerce & DSP

  • Prepare and maintain the DSP pitch calendar for upcoming releases, ensuring every priority release is submitted on time and with complete, compelling supporting materials.
  • Assemble release assets, artist context and performance data for editorial submissions across Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music and emerging platforms, and draft supporting pitch copy in partnership with the Commerce lead.
  • Track playlist adds, editorial placements and store features across all DSP partners, and maintain a shared record the Commerce and Artist Marketing teams can rely on.
  • Pull and format weekly and post-release performance reporting from DSP partner portals, flagging trends, wins and misses to the Commerce lead.
  • Support partner meetings and DSP check-ins by building agendas and one-sheets, taking thorough notes, and driving follow-up items to completion.
  • Maintain a monthly roundup of DSP product changes, new pitch tools and editorial priorities for the broader team.

Physical Product

  • Coordinate physical product timelines for vinyl, CD and special collector formats — tracking manufacturing milestones, test pressings, approvals and in-stock dates against release dates.
  • Support inventory and retail distribution tracking, surfacing stock, reorder and sell-through issues to the Commerce lead and our manufacturing and distribution partners.

Music Team Coordination

  • Coordinate the Music team’s recurring meetings — including the weekly Artist Marketing meeting and the full Music Team meeting — owning agenda and deck preparation, notes, and follow-up to completion.
  • Provide administrative support to the Artist Management team for our highest-priority artists, including payment requests, contracting workflow and travel coordination.
  • Keep Brand Partnerships and Sync current on artist marketing activity through shared calendars, decks and marketing collateral.
  • Support the planning and execution of UnitedMasters label events and partner presentations, from run-of-show through day-of logistics.

Across Both

  • Set up vendors, process invoices and keep budget trackers current for DSP campaigns, physical product runs and artist management requests.
  • Partner with Artist Marketing, Creative and Artist Relations to align commerce moments with release and campaign plans.
  • Organize, catalog and distribute release assets and metadata so partners always have what they need, when they need it.

Who You Are

  • A genuine fan of music with real curiosity about how releases actually perform. You follow charts, playlists and drops because you want to.
  • Entry-level familiarity with the music streaming landscape and how DSPs surface and program music.
  • Comfortable in DSP partner portals — Spotify for Artists, Apple Music for Artists, Amazon Music for Artists — or able to get up to speed on them quickly.
  • Solid working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets: you can build and maintain a tracker, use basic formulas, and turn a raw export into something readable.
  • Experience with project management tools or clear aptitude for keeping many moving deadlines organized in one system.
  • Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the discipline to hold a calendar of dates that cannot slip.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write a clear, persuasive pitch.
  • Strong meeting craft — you can build a clean agenda, capture what actually mattered, and chase follow-ups until they are closed.
  • Genuine comfort with high-touch administrative work in service of senior stakeholders and top-priority artists.
  • Discretion and sound judgment. You will be close to artist contracts, payments and travel, and to leadership-level conversations.
  • A self-starter who can own weekly recurring tasks independently while taking direction from multiple stakeholders across Commerce, Artist Marketing and Artist Management — and who is comfortable asking which priority wins when two deadlines collide.
  • A team player who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves and known as the resourceful, positive person others want to work with.
  • Interest in the operational and commercial mechanics of a music release, from editorial pitching to what it takes to get vinyl into a fan’s hands.

Our Values

  • We Get on the Plane Entrepreneurial spirit means fully committing to the journey not just having the idea.
  • We Expect Challenge + Respect We constantly challenge each other and the work to reach excellence, always with respect.
  • We Are Defined by Our Resilience We stay resourceful, fail fast, keep getting better, and never quit on our mission or our team.
  • We Pursue Answers Before the Question Has to Be Asked We understand our customers so well that we anticipate what they need before they ask.
  • We Run Towards Darkness We have the courage to work through uncertainty rather than settling for an easier, inferior plan.
  • We Know What We Don’t Know We bring confidence in what we do know, and honesty about what we don’t.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $29-34/ hr (~$60 - 70k)

Our salary ranges are designed to be competitive for companies of our size and within our industry and represent just one part of our overall rewards package. We also offer company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans, a 401(k) with company match, and, depending on the role and individual circumstances, additional compensation opportunities such as bonuses and stock options.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodation

UnitedMasters is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Phishing Scam Warning

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: UnitedMasters is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from UnitedMasters without a formal interview process. Additionally, UnitedMasters will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to TA@unitedmasters.com.

job.title: Creative Operations Lead
job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business, not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious! 

We are looking for a Creative Operations Lead to join Translation!

What You'll Do

The Creative Operations Lead is a critical operational leader at Translation, responsible for ensuring the right people are on the right work at the right time across every active account and initiative. This role sits at the center of the agency's capacity ecosystem, partnering closely with the Program Management team to keep delivery on track, talent balanced, and the business protected.

As Translation scales its resource planning capabilities — including the rollout of a new, intuitive staffing and capacity platform, this lead will serve as both the operational owner of that tool and the strategic steward of how people are planned, protected, and prioritized across billable and non-billable work.

Resource Planning & Allocation

  • Own and manage staffing allocations across all active client accounts, ensuring people are planned accurately and updated in real time.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing adoption of Translation's new resource management platform, serving as the primary administrator and internal champion.
  • Surface capacity conflicts, volume pressure points, and over-allocation risks proactively — before they become delivery problems.
  • Partner daily with the PM team to align headcount plans with project timelines, scope changes, and shifting client demands.
  • Develop and maintain clear visibility into who is available, who is over-committed, and where gaps exist across all functions.
  • Track talent skills and passions.

Workload Balancing & Prioritization

  • Balance competing demands across billable client work, proactive creative opportunities, new business pitches, and internal initiatives.
  • Make and communicate clear recommendations on when and how to pull staff from non-billable work in service of billable priorities.
  • Establish and enforce workload thresholds that protect talent from burnout while maintaining agency output and quality.
  • Build frameworks for how to triage competing requests, ensuring leadership has the right information to make fast, informed staffing calls.

Freelancer Management

  • Proactively source and pipeline freelance talent in advance of high-volume periods, ensuring the agency is never caught flat-footed when capacity spikes.
  • Manage first holds on preferred freelancers across disciplines, maintaining relationships so Translation has priority access when demand peaks.
  • Negotiate freelance rates with an eye toward engagement length securing better terms for longer commitments while staying within agency margin thresholds.
  • Vet new freelancers in partnership with relevant discipline leads and key creative, strategy, and production leaders before adding them to the approved roster.
  • Own and maintain a current, organized freelancer database including rates, availability windows, past project history, and performance notes  so the agency can move quickly when a need arises.

Awards & Case Study Management

  • Own the end-to-end process for awards submissions tracking eligible work, managing timelines, coordinating materials, and submitting entries across relevant shows.
  • Build and maintain a living library of agency case studies, ensuring work is documented accurately and kept current across accounts.
  • Partner with Business Development, Business Leadership, Strategy, and Creative to capture the story behind Translation's best work in a format ready for new business, press, and agency promotion.
  • Develop a calendar and workflow for proactive awards planning to avoid last-minute scrambles.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the PM team, creating tight alignment between resource plans and delivery commitments.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Business Leadership and Client Engagement teams on capacity and staffing strategy, translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with People Operations on headcount planning, open role identification, and freelance needs driven by capacity gaps.
  • Represent resource management in agency planning conversations, including scoping, new business, and organizational design discussions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-account staffing in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly.
  • Strong command of resource management tools and platforms; experience leading a tool rollout or system migration is a plus.
  • Experience managing or willing to learn managing awards submissions and/or case study development, with a clear understanding of how agency recognition supports business development.
  • A systems thinker who is equally comfortable in the weeds of a staffing grid and in a strategic conversation about organizational design.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can translate operational complexity into simple, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  • A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly and maintains it under pressure.
  • High integrity around people data: this role has visibility into utilization and performance-adjacent information and must handle it with discretion.                                                                             

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in resource management, project management, creative operations, or a related function within a creative agency or marketing organization.
  • Deep understanding of how creative agencies work, the rhythms of production, the difference between billable and non-billable time, and how to protect both.
  • Freelance recruiting experience and negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing and enhancing a product or platform.
  • A strong network of freelance talent relationships.

UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

job.description:

job.description:
Who We Are

We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

The Sr. Business Director is a senior client and business leader responsible for the success, growth, and health of a significant, complex account. This person has already demonstrated success at the Business Director level and brings greater executive influence, commercial judgment, and organizational leadership. They will serve as a strategic advisor to senior clients, lead integrated teams, and remain close to the work while actively shaping and pushing clients forward in culture.

As a Business Director, you will serve as a strategic leader and trusted client partner, deeply invested in understanding your clients’ business challenges and uncovering opportunities to solve them through innovative, culturally attuned creative solutions. job.title: Sr. Context Planner
job.description:
Who We Are

We are a well-established independent agency and thriving music business, built to help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do. 

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. In 2022, Translation was awarded the number three spot in Ad Age’s Agency A-List and AdWeek’s Multicultural Agency of the Year. One year before, Translation was awarded Ad Age’s Small Agency of the Year. We’re unapologetically ambitious, but we’re also a tight-knit crew.

We are looking for a Senior Context Planner to join Translation! Please note that this role is a Hybrid role: three days in office and two days remote. 

Summary

The Senior Context Planner leads integrated communications and go-to-market planning that turns brand strategy and creative ideas into audience participation. As a strategic partner to clients and colleagues across disciplines, you define where, when, with whom and why a brand should show up, giving every channel a clear role. You move quickly and independently, form and defend a clear point of view, and translate complex thinking into compelling stories, thoughtfully designed decks and actionable plans.

You pair that planning craft with cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and the worlds they intersect with, from creators and fandom to fashion, gaming and internet behavior. With strong social instincts and a sharp creative eye, you understand how ideas come to life in-feed, spot emerging behaviors and formats, and turn those insights into meaningful opportunities for brands.

What You'll Do

Comms Planning.

  • Translate cultural insights and creative platforms into campaign architecture, defining the role of messaging, channels, moments and partners.
  • Build phasing and sequencing that shows how the idea unfolds over time.
  • Communicate the approach clearly and visually, making complex ecosystems simple and actionable

Cultural Insights

  • Identify meaningful cultural shifts, behaviors and communities relevant to the audience and brand.
  • Frame those signals into clear implications and opportunities for strategy and creative.
  • Use research and cultural inputs to sharpen the comms approach, not just report what’s happening, and contribute insights to company thought leadership (e.g. newsletters, social, etc.) beyond client work.

Creative world-building

  • Maintain a clear narrative throughline as the idea extends across the campaign ecosystem.
  • Shape how the idea is expressed across different touchpoints while preserving what makes it distinctive.
  • Identify opportunities for participation and amplification that help the idea travel further.

Campaign casting

  • Synthesize best practices across the talent x brand landscape into clear POVs
  • Develop talent filters and casting recommendations for creators, artists and partners who credibly bring the idea to life.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Build trust through clear and persuasive presentations
  • Collaborate across departments including strategy, creative, business leadership and production, including risk assessments, case studies and awards.
  • Mentor associate and mid level Context Planners, delegating clearly and providing feedback that strengthens their craft.
  • Actively connect with the UnitedMasters team for an understanding of upcoming milestones and priority artists for casting consideration in Translation brand campaigns.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Comfortable working quickly and independently, owning deliverables with light oversight and adapting as priorities shift.
  • Able to form and defend a clear POV, using cultural insights and research to make actionable recommendations.
  • Strong comms planning instincts, connecting audience behavior, brand opportunity and campaign choreography.
  • Sharp information design and visual taste: build strong decks, shape a clear story and make complex ideas simple and actionable.
  • Cultural fluency across sports, music, entertainment and pop culture, including their intersections with creators, fandom, fashion, gaming and internet behavior.
  • A social-first thinker with a strong creative eye for how ideas work in-feed and an instinct for emerging behaviors and formats.
  • Strong collaborator across disciplines, receptive to feedback and confident presenting to internal teams and clients.
  • Resourceful in research, curious about new platforms and media opportunities, and committed to refining the work.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Possess excellent time management, organization and prioritization skills.
  • Have the proven ability to work under tight deadlines and handle pressure, while consistently paying attention to accuracy and quality of work.
  • Exercise the ability to quickly and effectively adapt to changing needs and expectations.                                                                                        

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum 4-7 years experience in a strategic position in an agency or brand environment
  • 4-year college degree in Marketing, Advertising or Business preferred.

job.title: Sr. Program Manager
job.description:
Senior Program Manager 

Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business—not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to join Translation. This is a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn office (4 days in office).

What You'll Do

As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll own internal program coordination across assigned work and be a key driver of both operational excellence and program delivery. You will lead integrated campaigns and ensure we deliver groundbreaking work that meets our clients’ objectives and propels agency growth. You’ll blend strategic thinking with sharp project management and a strong sense of ownership, overseeing teams and guiding work from scope through execution while managing the health (budget, scope, team design) of your projects. The Sr. Program Manager reports to the Program Director (or Group Program Director) and will manage Associates and/or Managers. The Sr. PM partners with the Business Supervisor or Business Director to run most Tier 1 or 2 projects. 

Responsibilities

  • Oversee day-to-day program coordination and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring internal teams are aligned and work meets client expectations.
  • Drive the end-to-end process for integrated campaigns (film, experiential, digital/social, OOH), ensuring seamless delivery on time and on budget by developing and tracking tactical plans to develop each with a keen understanding of client parameters and objectives. Work with junior team members to create and manage all tactical schedules
  • Partner with Business Leadership counterpart to develop all scope proposals for assigned projects, developing a compelling proposal as well as profitable approach for the agency
  • Provide strong financial management of assigned accounts including managing all budget allocations, reviewing burn, proactively creating scope change orders (internal and external), proactively suggesting areas for optimization and macro view of out-of-pocket budget tracking
  • Lead all reporting and reconciliation processes in partnership with finance team 
  • Help digest all client feedback and lead the team on how we address and action the feedback. Understand and mentor teams on where/when to escalate creative feedback or work reviews to senior leadership 
  • Build and nurture strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor who understands how to get things done effectively and efficiently leveraging our teams and resources to create innovative and breakthrough creative solutions that solve clients business objectives 
  • Manage and mentor junior program managers, strategically deploying them across projects and fostering their professional growth.
  • Collaborate with department leads (account, production, creative, strategy) to assemble the right teams for each initiative, confirm the right allocations and manage overall workforce planning with Resource Management lead
  • Work closely with production to ensure timelines accommodate production requirements and projects continue to move seamlessly in execution 
  • Support the Business Lead and Production teams during executional and production phases of creative work to ensure absolute clarity client & media requirements, provide tactical support during production and oversee the successful delivery/traffic assets when required 
  • Partner with Creative, Production, and Business teams to turn campaign ideas into actionable plans, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables stay on track without compromising creative ambition.
  • Manage and monitor production and creative workflows, proactively identifying risks and driving solutions to keep projects moving smoothly.
  • Foster clear, integrated ways of working by aligning teams on roles, processes, and communication throughout the creative and production lifecycle.
  • Proactively identify potential issues or opportunities, keeping teams and clients informed and driving swift, effective solutions.
  • Oversee the creation of presentation materials that uphold agency standards and resonate with clients’ business objectives.
  • Participate in new business efforts, contributing to proposals, pitches, and strategic planning to showcase our operational strengths and capabilities
  • Champion a positive, collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, accountability, and a shared passion for producing culturally powerful work.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and “off-script” navigation skills, with the confidence to lead and adapt in dynamic situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex ideas clearly, accurately, and persuasively.
  • Deeply proactive, hands-on mentality—takes pride in their work, holds themselves accountable, and drives momentum across teams.
  • Diplomatic yet persistent; able to guide teams through peak moments with empathy, clarity, and a focus on solutions.
  • Highly organized with exceptional time management and prioritization abilities, balancing multiple workstreams with quality and care.
  • Passionate about people and culture, with a results-driven approach balanced by genuine curiosity and sensitivity to team dynamics.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of experience managing large-scale brands or programs within a creative agency or related communications environment.
  • Proven ability to build strong client partnerships that drive long-term growth and mutual success.
  • Demonstrated expertise managing multi-disciplinary teams across creative, production, and strategy disciplines.
  • Solid understanding of financial principles as they relate to agency scopes, budgets, and P&L impact.
  • Experience leading strategic and day-to-day client communications, as well as mentoring junior team members.
  • Familiarity with the lifecycle of integrated campaigns, including digital, social, print, and broadcast production.
  • Comfortable with Google Suite (Sheets and Slides); experience with Monday.com or SmartSheets is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telco or retail categories, or in performance marketing environments.
  • Background in managing cross-functional agency partners and leading collaborative workstreams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.
