job.title: B2B Engagement Marketing Lead
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is one of the most influential newsrooms in the world, and our subscriber base is growing to match. This role sits at the center of that growth responsible for how enterprise clients and professional product subscribers experience The Post after they sign up. WP Intelligence is our professional intelligence product line, delivering curated reporting, data, and analysis for decision-makers across industries. As the Engagement Marketing Lead for Enterprise and WP Intelligence, you will own the subscriber journey from activation through renewal designing omnichannel programs that help organizations and professionals get lasting value from their subscriptions.

Reporting to the Director of Engagement and Retention, you will partner closely with Enterprise Sales and Account Management, WP Intelligence Editorial, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, and Brand Marketing to build and execute strategies that drive measurable engagement and long-term retention.

Why This Role Matters

  • You support The Post’s mission to deliver world-class journalism while expanding reach and influence

  • You drive data-informed marketing strategies that improve activation, usage, and long-term retention

  • You thrive in collaborative environments that value initiative, clarity, and continuous improvement

  • You enjoy leading fast-paced, cross-platform programs that enhance subscriber experience and fuel business growth

How You'll Support the Mission

Lifecycle Strategy

  • Develop and execute full-funnel lifecycle programs that increase usage and deepen engagement across app, site, newsletters, and subscription benefits for enterprise and professional product subscribers.

  • Build subscriber journeys spanning lead progression, account activation, onboarding, education, loyalty, and renewal maintaining playbooks that support scalable, repeatable execution.

  • Design approaches that serve multiple audiences within a single account, including corporate and higher education end users, students, and key decision-makers.

  • Identify and promote product features, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities that drive long-term value and contract renewal.

  • Partner with Brand, Product, Engineering, and Editorial to align lifecycle initiatives with broader business goals and the group customer experience.

Performance and Experimentation

  • Monitor engagement trends, feature adoption, and lifecycle performance using dashboards and core KPIs.

  • Translate subscriber behavior into insights that guide strategy and experimentation.

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests to refine segmentation, messaging, channel sequencing, and timing.

  • Identify friction points in the subscriber experience and collaborate cross-functionally to improve activation, engagement, and renewal rates.

  • Partner with Analytics and Data Engineering to refine audience definitions, data inputs, and targeting models.

Execution and Operations

  • Design and manage integrated engagement campaigns across email, onsite surfaces, in-app messages, and push notifications.

  • Develop clear creative and technical briefs that guide asset production; lead QA and auditing to uphold accuracy across all touchpoints.

  • Document processes and improve operational workflows to support scalable delivery.

  • Use subscriber signals and feedback gathered in partnership with Enterprise Sales, Account Management, and Support — to inform proactive engagement strategies and feature improvements.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 6-8 years of experience in digital, growth, EdTech, or subscription marketing with deep expertise in customer engagement, activation, or habit formation across diverse audiences.

  • Experience working with B2B customers and partnering with internal Sales teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Marketing Technology platforms like Iterable, and familiarity with customer data systems and e-commerce platforms.

  • Proficiency with analytics tools such as Tableau, Looker, and Google Analytics; strong ability to evaluate performance and translate testing outcomes into decisions.

  • Excellent communication and project management skills, with a track record of influencing cross-functional partners and driving clarity in complex environments.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

The salary range for this position is:

$85,100 - $127,700 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

Your story awaits. Apply today!

Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

job.title: News Designer
job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.


Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a creative, collaborative and visually sophisticated designer to help shape how audiences experience our journalism across digital platforms.


News Design is a team of visual journalists who elevate The Post’s reporting through compelling, reader-centered storytelling. Working across digital formats and platforms, news designers collaborate with journalists throughout the newsroom to create presentations that deepen understanding, capture attention and make our journalism distinctive.


We are looking for a designer with exceptional visual instincts, strong editorial judgment and a passion for solving storytelling problems. The ideal candidate understands how typography, composition, color, imagery and interaction can work together to make journalism clearer and more powerful. They should be equally energized by creating an ambitious custom presentation for a major enterprise story and finding smart, elegant solutions on a tight news deadline.


This is a highly collaborative role. News designers work alongside reporters, editors, photographers, graphics journalists, illustrators and developers, contributing ideas from the earliest stages of a story through publication. We are looking for someone eager to experiment, take thoughtful creative risks and help evolve the visual identity of The Washington Post.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom and will require some night and weekend work.


What Motivates You:

  • You believe thoughtful design can fundamentally improve how audiences understand and experience journalism.
  • You enjoy finding the right visual approach for a story through typography, imagery, color, composition and interaction.
  • You are energized by solving complicated storytelling problems and turning them into intuitive reader experiences.
  • You thrive on collaborating with journalists from different disciplines.
  • You enjoy balancing ambitious long-term projects with the urgency of breaking and developing news.
  • You are curious about new technologies, formats and approaches to digital storytelling.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and visual journalists to conceive and build distinctive digital storytelling experiences.
  • Identify stories that would benefit from enhanced visual presentation and help develop the right design approach for each.
  • Create engaging, content-driven designs, illustrations and visual packages that are smart, original and reader-centered.
  • Guide the visual storytelling process from initial concept through publication, incorporating feedback and maintaining a high level of craft throughout.
  • Design experiences that work effectively across desktop, mobile, newsletters, social platforms and other digital surfaces.
  • Partner with developers and other visual journalists on interactive and custom storytelling projects.
  • Contribute to breaking and major news coverage, developing sophisticated visual solutions on tight deadlines.
  • Use art direction, illustration, animation and other techniques when they can strengthen a story.
  • Review work carefully for visual consistency, accessibility and accuracy before publication.
  • Contribute ideas that help evolve The Post’s visual identity and push our digital storytelling forward.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual design, creative thinking, initiative and curiosity.
  • Experience designing digital editorial experiences, interactive applications or other content-rich products.
  • Sophisticated understanding of typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy and information design.
  • Strong editorial instincts and a passion for using design in service of storytelling.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with an ability to build productive relationships across disciplines.
  • A demonstrated ability to manage multiple short- and long-term projects and deliver refined work under deadline pressure.
  • A thoughtful, ethical approach to incorporating new technologies including AI-assisted tools into the design brainstorming process, with sound judgment about where they strengthen the work but knowing human craft and editorial judgment must lead.
  • Experience with art direction, animation, illustration, original artwork or maintaining a cohesive visual identity is a plus.
  • Fluency with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS or JavaScript and familiarity with modern web frameworks such as React, Svelte, Angular or Vue is a plus.
  • A commitment to accessibility, accuracy and the highest standards of visual journalism.

Interested candidates should upload a résumé, cover letter and portfolio highlighting representative work to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Oct. 9 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to News Design Director Christine Ashack and Head of Visuals Soo-Jeong Kang.


The salary range for this position is: $85,100 - $127,700. The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements


 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development programs

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.

job.title: Opinions Researcher
job.description:
Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is looking for a careful, nimble researcher to join its Opinions section on a 6-month contract, with potential for extension. They will ensure all factual material included in articles is correct and supported with reliable sources, ensuring high standards of accuracy. They will also read and edit opinion articles for style, clarity and consistency.

 

The ideal candidate will have an eye for detail and thrive working in high-pressure news environments. They should have previous experience fact-checking, copy-editing or editing or proofreading for news or media organizations. They will be able to efficiently multitask and pivot between articles across a variety of subject areas. They will also have strong communication skills and feel comfortable working with op-ed editors and other team members on tight schedules. They should feel comfortable adopting new systems, tools and technology to bolster their work.

 

What Motivates You

  • You have strong attention to detail and communication skills.
  • You are comfortable in fast-moving environments and on deadline.
  • You believe in factual opinion journalism that combines accurate reporting with a clear perspective.
  • You are excited about the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in national media.

 

How You’ll Support The Mission

  • Review Opinion stories to ensure they contain accurate factual material, including names, dates and figures.
  • Edit stories for style and clarity
  • Collaborate with op-ed editors to strengthen argument.,
  • Work with senior opinion leaders to update and optimize workflows, trainings and resources for editing
  • Use trusted sources to verify information and ensure stories are up-to-date.
  • This position may include some work in the evenings or weekends.

 

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience with a news organization.
  • Previous experience fact-checking or copy-editing.
  • Ability to work efficiently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • A keen eye for detail and accuracy.
  • Preferably have experience training others for style, process and standards

job.title: Recruiter (Contract)
job.description:
Join the future of news

Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

At The Washington Post, we believe that great storytelling begins with great teams. As a Recruiter (Contract), you’ll operate at the intersection of strategic hiring and coordination—ensuring our recruiting engine runs smoothly while also leading a select set of full-cycle requisitions.


In this high-impact, collaborative role, you’ll help bring our mission to life by ensuring that every candidate, recruiter, and hiring manager experiences clarity, care, and momentum. This is more than just moving candidates through a pipeline — it’s about building trust, unlocking potential, and helping shape careers that support journalism that matters.


This role will cover an employee leave and is expected to last through March 2027. This position is based onsite five days a week in our Washington, DC office.


What Motivates You

  • You enjoy connecting talented people with opportunities where they can make a meaningful impact.
  • You take pride in creating a thoughtful, high-touch experience for candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruiting process.
  • You enjoy building trusted partnerships with hiring managers and helping them make informed hiring decisions.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment where strong organization, attention to detail, and timely follow-through keep multiple searches moving forward.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting as hiring needs, processes, and priorities evolve.
  • You value clear communication, collaboration, empathy, and professionalism in every interaction.
  • You enjoy balancing hands-on recruiting with the coordination required to deliver an efficient and well-managed hiring process.

How You'll Support the Mission


  • Manage approximately 5-10 open requisitions at times, primarily supporting hiring teams across corporate functions such as tech, finance, and operations.
  • Own the end-to-end recruiting process, including intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer preparation, and closing.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand role needs, advise on hiring strategies, and guide searches from intake through successful hire.
  • Source and screen candidates, conduct phone interviews, and develop thoughtful, qualified candidate shortlists.
  • Collaborate closely with hiring teams and other stakeholders to support timely, informed hiring decisions.
  • Deliver high-touch, timely communication that strengthens candidate relationships and supports a positive candidate experience.
  • Partner with Compensation and hiring managers to develop compelling, equitable offers.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


  • 5+ years of in-house corporate recruiting experience, including proven experience managing full-cycle searches, is required.
  • Experience managing full cycle recruiting, from hiring plans to offer negotiation, is required.
  • Experience recruiting for a variety of corporate functions including tech, finance, marketing, sales, and operations is highly preferred.
  • Experience with behavioral based interviews and candidate assessment is highly preferred.
  • Experience with applicant tracking systems, preferably Workday.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; highly detail-oriented.
  • Experience coordinating complex scheduling needs across teams and platforms.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Clear communicator with a customer-focused approach; empathetic and professional.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with hiring managers and candidates.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and adapting to new processes, platforms, and hiring needs.

job.description:

Why This Role Matters

 

We are looking for an experienced Security Specialist for our Security Operations Center (SOC) to help us elevate our corporate security function.


What Motivates You

  • You are committed to creating a safe and secure environment for employees, contractors, vendors, and guests.
  • You remain calm and responsive during emergencies and take pride in helping coordinate an effective response when safety or security issues arise.
  • You are attentive and vigilant, with the ability to identify potential security or safety concerns before they escalate.
  • You value strong customer service and know how to enforce security protocols in a polite yet assertive way.
  • You enjoy collaborating with internal teams, law enforcement, property management, and external security partners to maintain a safe workplace.
  • You are an independent thinker who looks ahead, identifies gaps, and seeks opportunities to strengthen security and safety practices.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Monitor building activity using Security Operations Center video and data-processing technology to identify and respond to potential security or safety concerns.
  • Serve as a point of contact between building security and WP security management, supporting day-to-day security operations and assigned weekday shifts.
  • Protect employees, contractors, vendors, and guests by coordinating security activities, monitoring access, checking credentials, and resolving incidents quickly and efficiently.
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, outside security firms, property management, event management, and other partners to support effective security operations and incident response.
  • Manage company badge and credential administration, including creating new and replacement badges and assigning appropriate access based on individual roles.
  • Conduct regular security rounds and surveillance of company properties to identify and address potential security or safety concerns.
  • Serve as a point of contact for emergencies involving security, business continuity, safety, medical events, personnel issues, or other threats, organizing and directing emergency response and supporting activities.
  • Analyze loss control and accident reports and conduct internal investigations in accordance with legal requirements and company policies.
  • Identify gaps in security and safety protocols and develop policies, procedures, and required security documentation to strengthen practices and support compliance with federal and state regulations.
  • Partner with functions across the company to implement and enforce security procedures and maintain a coordinated approach to workplace safety.
  • Support security and emergency operations by transporting personnel to medical facilities, maintaining proper chain of custody of assigned documents, responding to alarms, and dispatching appropriate personnel as needed.
  • Maintain accurate security records by documenting shift activities and incidents and submitting required reports at the end of each shift.
  • Support day-to-day Security Operations Center administration, including answering phones, photocopying, filing, and monitoring and responding to emails.

The Skills and Experience You Bring


Qualifications

  • High school diploma required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred; further education in security administration or similar field will be an asset.
  • Hands-on experience with surveillance techniques and technology (e.g. CCTV), as well emergency planning and response, is required.
  • Corporate security experience required.
  • Military, law enforcement, or intelligence experience preferred.
  • Excellent customer service, interpersonal, communication and collaboration skills.
  • Must be able to obtain and retain First Aid, CPR and AED certification.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Experience with badge / ID processing preferred.
  • Experience with Close Protection Security (CP) preferred.
  • Ability to enforce security protocols in a polite yet assertive way.
  • Independent thinking and forward-looking attitude.
  • Knowledge of best practices in security and safety, as well as federal and state regulations.

Why This Role Matters

 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join the Subscriptions team at The Washington Post. This role spans the full application stack with a strong emphasis on frontend applications and customer-facing experiences. You will design and build modern web applications primarily using React and TypeScript, while also contributing to backend services built with Java and Node.js and the AWS infrastructure and deployment systems that support them.


As a senior engineer, you will take ownership of complex technical work from design through production, contribute to architectural decisions, and help improve the quality, performance, reliability, accessibility, and maintainability of the applications our subscription products depend on.


The ideal candidate brings strong frontend engineering experience, particularly with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, along with practical experience working with backend services and APIs. You should be able to contribute to Java and Node.js applications and be comfortable with AWS, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. This is a frontend-focused role, but you should be capable of delivering effectively across the full stack.


We value autonomy, initiative, strong technical judgment, clear communication, and meaningful day-to-day use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including continually finding new ways to apply AI to software development, automation, operations, and team effectiveness.


What Motivates You

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the software you build and the customer experiences it supports.
  • Passionate about designing accessible, performant, reliable, and maintainable frontend applications.
  • Enjoys solving complex frontend and full-stack problems and driving work from design through production.
  • Comfortable working across React applications, backend services and APIs, AWS infrastructure, and production operations.
  • Proactive and comfortable driving complex work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Interested in understanding how applications operate in production rather than treating deployment and infrastructure as separate concerns.
  • Actively uses AI in day-to-day engineering and continually looks for ways to expand its impact on development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, and productivity.
  • Enjoys collaborating across engineering, product, and design while mentoring other engineers and communicating technical decisions clearly.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and operate customer-facing applications and services supporting our subscription products.
  • Develop modern frontend applications primarily using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Build and improve subscription experiences such as checkout, offers, paywalls, product pages, subscriber lifecycle flows, and mobile web and native app integrations.
  • Own technical solutions throughout their lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through deployment, observability, production support, and continuous improvement.
  • Make thoughtful frontend architectural decisions around component design, application structure, state management, API integration, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Build reusable components, shared libraries, and frontend patterns that improve consistency and development efficiency.
  • Contribute to backend services, APIs, integrations, automation, and tooling built with Java and Node.js.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to define reliable API contracts and integration patterns that support customer-facing experiences.
  • Work with AWS services and infrastructure supporting our applications and contribute to CI/CD, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Establish strong observability and diagnose issues spanning frontend applications, backend services, integrations, infrastructure, and deployment systems.
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, taking ownership of incident diagnosis, mitigation, communication, and follow-up.
  • Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, architectural limitations, and opportunities for improvement and proactively drive solutions.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical standards, architecture discussions, documentation, code quality, and engineering best practices.
  • Use AI throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve development, testing, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and operational workflows.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • Broad expertise building responsive, high-performance web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Solid background developing backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Node.js.
  • Experience working within AWS ecosystems, including containerized workloads (Docker/ECS) and foundational Infrastructure as Code concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of core web technologies, responsive layouts, web accessibility standards, and browser performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience establishing CI/CD automation and deployment pipeline configurations.
  • Familiarity with production monitoring and observability tools, including logging, metrics, alerting, and incident response.
  • Background building conversion-critical customer experiences, such as checkout flows, subscription systems, paywalls, or payment integrations.
  • Experience integrating web applications and micro-frontends with native mobile app environments.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to support day-to-day software development, testing, and troubleshooting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of frontend development with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • 3+ years of backend development with Java, Node.js, or both.
  • 2+ years of experience deploying and operating applications in AWS.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive design, accessibility, browser behavior, and frontend performance.
  • Experience with frontend architecture, reusable components, state management, API integration, and automated testing.
  • Experience building and integrating with RESTful APIs and distributed backend services.
  • Experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Experience with CI/CD and deployment automation using Jenkins or comparable tooling.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience building and operating containerized applications using Docker and ECS.
  • Experience with production observability, including logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting production applications through on-call rotations and incident response.
  • Ability to independently scope and drive complex technical work from design through production.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Significant hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools in day-to-day development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, or automation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of frontend development with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years of backend development with Java, Node.js, or both.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, deploying, and operating applications in AWS.
  • Experience with frontend monorepos, shared component libraries, design systems, or reusable application frameworks.
  • Experience building high-volume or conversion-sensitive experiences such as checkout, payments, subscriptions, ecommerce, registration, or account management.
  • Experience integrating web applications with native mobile applications.
  • Strong experience with Jenkins, AWS CDK, Terraform, containerized deployments, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Catchpoint, and AWS-native monitoring services.
  • Experience improving frontend performance, accessibility, application reliability, and developer productivity.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing frontend architecture and engineering practices across team boundaries.
  • Advanced use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including helping other engineers apply AI effectively across development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, and operations.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Gender affirming services

  • Free Post digital subscription

$119,700 - $199,300 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

job.title: Senior Photo Assignment Editor
job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.


Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking an experienced, imaginative and highly collaborative Senior Photo Assignment Editor to help lead photographic coverage across the newsroom.


We are looking for a visual journalist with exceptional news judgment, sophisticated visual taste and a deep understanding of how photography can distinguish and elevate journalism. This editor will help shape coverage from the earliest stages — identifying stories with strong visual potential, commissioning photographers with distinctive perspectives and ensuring that photography is integral to how our journalism is conceived, reported and presented.


The ideal candidate understands that powerful photography depends not only on what we commission and publish, but also on how audiences experience that work. They will think critically about image selection, sequencing, cropping and presentation and understand how those choices should evolve across mobile and desktop experiences, social platforms, newsletters and other destinations.


This editor should be equally comfortable directing photographic coverage of a major breaking-news event, developing an ambitious visual enterprise project and collaborating across disciplines to determine the strongest form for a story. As a senior member of the Photo department, they will also provide leadership and mentorship to photo editors, helping elevate the ambition, creativity and quality of The Post’s visual journalism.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom and will include some evening and weekend shifts to meet deadlines and respond to breaking news.


What Motivates You:

  • You believe photography can reveal dimensions of a story that words alone cannot capture.
  • You have a sophisticated visual sensibility and are constantly looking for original approaches to familiar subjects.
  • You thrive on the urgency of breaking news as well as the opportunity to develop ambitious visual enterprise.
  • You enjoy working closely with photographers and helping them produce distinctive, surprising work.
  • You think deeply about how audiences experience photography across different platforms and formats.
  • You are energized by mentoring visual journalists and helping raise the creative ambition of a team.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Assign, commission and edit photography for breaking news, daily coverage, features, investigations and ambitious visual enterprise.
  • Develop and pitch original photographic story ideas, including journalism conceived from the outset around the strengths of photography.
  • Identify visual opportunities early in the reporting process and work with reporters and editors across the newsroom to develop strong approaches.
  • Direct photographers in the field, providing clear editorial guidance while creating the conditions for distinctive and original work.
  • Apply exceptional visual and news judgment to image selection, sequencing, cropping and presentation.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about how photography should be experienced across mobile, desktop, social platforms, newsletters and other digital destinations.
  • Cultivate a broad and diverse network of freelance photographers and match photographers to assignments based on subject matter, geography, approach and visual sensibility.
  • Research, source and license photography when commissioned work is not appropriate, applying rigorous standards around accuracy, context, copyright, provenance and ethics.
  • Collaborate with News Design, Graphics, Audience, Product and other teams to determine the most effective visual form and presentation for major journalism.
  • Help develop visual approaches to breaking and planned coverage that take advantage of photography alongside video, graphics, text and other forms.
  • Stay current with changes in photography, visual culture, digital publishing, technology and audience behavior and apply that knowledge thoughtfully to coverage.
  • Experiment with new approaches to photographic storytelling and presentation while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy, ethics and craft.
  • Mentor photo editors and photographers, providing constructive feedback and helping colleagues develop their editorial judgment and visual storytelling skills.
  • Contribute to department-wide coverage planning and help shape The Post’s broader approach to photography and visual journalism.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • At least seven years of professional journalism experience, including substantial experience assigning and editing photography in a fast-paced newsroom.
  • Exceptional visual and editorial judgment and a demonstrated record of producing distinctive photographic journalism.
  • Deep knowledge of contemporary photography and a broad network of staff and freelance photographers.
  • Experience directing visual coverage of breaking news as well as developing longer-term enterprise and feature photography.
  • Strong understanding of digital storytelling and how photography should be selected, edited and presented for different platforms and audiences.
  • A generous, curious and collaborative editing style, with an openness to experimentation and new approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across disciplines and to mentor and develop visual journalists.
  • Strong understanding of photographic ethics, sourcing, copyright and image provenance.
  • Ability to make confident decisions under deadline pressure while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy and visual quality.
  • Fluency with professional photo-editing tools, including Photoshop and Photo Mechanic; familiarity with video and other digital publishing tools is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work some nights and weekends as news demands.

Interested candidates should upload a résumé, cover letter and portfolio or examples of relevant work to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Oct. 9 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to Deputy Photo Department Head Olivier Laurent, Photo Department Head Robert Miller and Head of Visuals Soo-Jeong Kang.


The starting salary range for this role is $110,000 - $160,000. The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of The Post’s recruiting team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

job.title: Style Politics and Culture Editor
job.description:
Application Instructions

Please list all professional experience and explain any gaps in employment history. All of your application materials, which may include PDF files of work samples and/or links to audio, video, photography or graphics, must be uploaded to the field labeled Resume/Cover Letter/Work Samples to be considered for the position.


Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is looking for a sharp, collaborative, versatile editor to lead Style's coverage of the intersection of power and culture.


This editor will oversee reporters who chronicle the people and forces driving Washington as well as the cultural conversations animating our group chats. From social circuits to campaign events and the digital ecosystems that define modern political life, this coverage captures the mood, moments and meaning behind D.C.’s ever-shifting locus of power.


In addition to politics, this editor will also work closely with reporters and columnists who capture broader trends across media, entertainment, fashion and lifestyle.


We’re looking for someone with an eye for the absurd, a knack for the weird and a sixth sense for stories that transcend political gamesmanship to resonate with readers around the U.S. and beyond. The ideal candidate is just as comfortable editing a profile on a presidential hopeful as they are in shaping a short piece on the newest hangout for Hill staffers. This editor will sharpen our coverage to elevate readers’ understanding of the intricacies and excesses of Washington.


We need an editor who can deftly move between quick-turn stories and longform features, helping reporters hone their voices and craft pieces that leave readers laughing, thinking or crying – ultimately understanding something new about politics, society and themselves.


The role sits within the Features department and is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom.


What Motivates You:

  • You are driven to shape coverage that captures the cultural forces defining this political moment.
  • You love a story with voice, humor and stylish writing.
  • You enjoy developing reporters and helping them produce ambitious, distinctive work.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced newsroom and are energized by both quick hits and long-form storytelling.
  • You value collaboration and are eager to work across desks to elevate coverage.

 

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Lead and manage reporters who cover politics, culture and trends.
  • Shape quick-turn profiles of the moment’s most talked-about figures, as well as deeper reported features.
  • Set editorial priorities and shape coverage that drives conversation and delivers insightful analysis and narrative storytelling.
  • Edit stories and columns across multiple formats — from enterprise and features to quick sceners and newsletters.
  • Collaborate with editors and reporters across desks to produce comprehensive, cross-disciplinary coverage.
  • Work with visual journalists and audience teams to present stories in compelling and innovative ways.
  • Monitor audience trends and performance data to inform coverage strategy and maximize reach.
  • Help foster a collaborative, creative and high-performing team culture.

 

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • A track record of editing high-impact journalism on culture, politics or related beats.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing reporters in a competitive newsroom.
  • Exceptional editorial judgment and the ability to shape stories for clarity and resonance.
  • Experience guiding both live coverage and longer-form enterprise or narrative work.
  • A deep interest in politics and power, as well as how they intersect with culture.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • A commitment to accuracy, fairness and the highest standards of journalism.

 

Interested candidates should upload a résumé and a cover letter to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Oct. 19 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to Deputy Features Editor Ellen McCarthy and Features Editor Amanda Finnegan.

job.title: Content Operations Specialist
job.description:
Content Operations Specialist

Overall Responsibilities

The Content Operations Specialist is responsible for managing and ensuring the technical and broadcast quality of all inbound and outbound content feeds, including video and audio signals, for live and recorded programming at Weather Group Television (WGT). This role combines responsibilities from media acquisitions and master control operations and longform content preparation for Entertainment Studios eight digital channels. As this position supports a 24x7 news/weather environment, candidates must have flexibility to work days, nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed and without advance notice.

Specific Responsibilities

ESN - Network Content Operations

  • Review the next day’s list of “barter shows” and editing requirements.

  • Edit barter show segments for two channels, match file titles, segment lengths, and proper transmission standards.  

  • Make necessary adjustments and verify all file segments for final delivery and playback.

  • Review playlists and associated content for missing segments or other incomplete assets

  • Purge older content files, per policy and procedures.

  • Verify all assets for all channels' playlists are correct and ready for playback

  • Verify timing for all playlists for the current day/weekend days.  

  • Communicate playlist or file issues to the appropriate internal or external partner and work toward a solution prior to air time. 

  • Process dub list for promotional/commercial assets

  • Upload/download files to/from the assigned storage repository (local or cloud)

WGT - MEDIA ACQUISITIONS

  • Ensure broadcast quality of all inbound/outbound video and audio feeds using scopes, analyzers, and level monitoring equipment.

  • Monitor multiple networks for high-standard quality control and report technical issues to appropriate departments.

  • Operate video/audio/L-Band routers, route remote feeds, and perform corrective actions to maintain broadcast signal integrity.

  • Manage content acquisition platforms, including LiveU, Dejero, TVU, LTN, and The Switch.

  • Use newsroom content systems to manage recordings and elements for live broadcasts.

  • Coordinate remote resources (IRDs, encoders, and format converters), adjusting levels and troubleshooting in real time.

  • Operate playout automation across networks to edit, load, and update playlists for live programming.

  • Perform daily checks on critical broadcast gear to maintain industry standards and proactively resolve system issues.

  • Utilize technical software tools, including FTP clients, satellite/scheduling software, MAM, MS Office, and Google Workspace.

TWC - MASTER CONTROL OPERATION

  • Responsible for editing, loading, and monitoring The Weather Channel (TWC) playlist using the automation systems.  

  • Work with Editorial and Programming teams to alter the playlist, within approved guidelines to maintain operational “on-air” continuity. 

  • Monitor multiple TWC feeds (uplinks, downlinks, STAR feeds, etc.) and those of other Allen Media & Entertainment Studios networks. 

  •  Provide Tier 1 technical support to internal technical teams by reporting/requesting Engineering  / IT assistance.   

  • Work closely with Engineering on any signal issues, alarms, or technical issues related to monitored network feeds. 

  • Perform operational checks, monitor video/audio quality, and proactively resolve system defects or failures.

  • Maintain shift logs, outage notifications, service request forms, and operational documentation.

  • Communicate status updates and repair workflows with management, engineering teams, and MCR clients.

  • Participate in technical training and adapt to changing operational demands.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Broadcasting, Communications, a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in news environments, teleport operations, cable, or national broadcast environments.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Ability to communicate professionally with multiple internal technical teams and external vendors. 

  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills, with the ability to manage time effectively and operational resources in a dynamic, 24/7 environment with critical deadlines.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of satellite news gathering (SNG) processes, digital satellite equipment, waveform and vector scopes, and spectrum analyzers.

  • Understanding of broadcast automation systems and how to monitor signal workflow for troubleshooting

  • Experience understanding file formats, including codecs, wrappers, and technical specs

  • Proficiency in HDTV, SDI, ASI, and IP formats, as well as conversion technologies

  • Experience with electronic news/field gathering, teleport, and satellite truck operations, including ingest operations, is desired.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to respond quickly to technical issues and implement solutions under operational constraints.

  • Ability to interact effectively and collaboratively across departments and with management, maintaining professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Sensitivity to the unique needs and challenges of a 24/7 operation, ensuring operational continuity and quality.

  • Ability to work in a project and live broadcast environment simultaneously

  • Basic understanding of closed captions, including formats and regulations.

Behavior Requirements

  • Unquestionably high ethical standards

  • Customer-focused and team player mentality

  • Flexible and adaptable attitude in an ever-changing environment

  • Ability to get along well with others, willing and able to deal with a diverse cultural & customer base in numerous types of challenging situations

  • Interest in learning as well as teaching and developing skills in others

  • Strong teamwork and problem-solving skills

  • Willingness to work in a team environment or on individual projects on an as-needed basis

  • Ability to interact effectively “horizontally” through Weather Group TV and Allen Media as needed, working closely and collaboratively with multiple departments and management


Physical Requirements

  • Will be required to sit in a chair from 2-5 hours at a time

  • Will be required to view multiple computer documents and video images on multiple screens and/or listen to multiple audio sources simultaneously

  • Must be able to lift and move equipment as required

  • May be required to carry a laptop.


Equal Opportunity

Allen Media Digital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job.title: Receptionist/Executive Assistant to Film & TV
job.description:
COMPANY PROFILE


Allen Media Group, LLC / Entertainment Studios is a leading global media, content, and technology company dedicated to delivering a comprehensive 360-degree experience to consumers and strategic partners worldwide. Our mission is to inform, entertain, and inspire audiences across our extensive multi-platform portfolio.


POSITION SUMMARY


The Receptionist / Executive Assistant to Film & TV Executive plays a vital, high-visibility role in maintaining smooth, seamless administrative operations across executive suites and front-office functions. Serving as the primary ambassador for the studio, the ideal candidate exhibits exceptional professional conduct, strong proactive problem-solving abilities, and an unwavering commitment to operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for executive clients, industry partners, guests, and media personnel.

  • Provide comprehensive administrative support, including answering high-volume calls, logging communications, managing complex schedules, and coordinating executive meetings.

  • Oversee facility organization and logistics, including supply management, physical office layout adjustments, and secure handling of incoming/outgoing mail, documents, and priority deliveries.

  • Manage employee ID badging, visitor access protocols, internal request ticketing, and conference room reservations.

  • Demonstrate high proficiency in executive calendar management, coordinating internal and external business engagements.

  • Develop polished pitch decks and executive presentations using Canva and standard design applications.

  • Evaluate screenplays, television pilots, and concept materials to produce concise, insightful coverage and analysis.

  • Maintain exceptional adaptability and composure when navigating evolving priorities and urgent deadlines.

  • Ensure executive kitchens, guest spaces, and common areas remain impeccably maintained and fully stocked.

  • Execute time-sensitive courier runs between the Culver City Studio facility and key partner locations across Greater Los Angeles.


QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS


  • Self-directed and proactive professional, capable of working independently and collaboratively across multi-functional teams.

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs to support office logistics and event setup.

  • Valid driver's license, reliable personal vehicle, current registration, and comprehensive vehicle insurance required for local transportation tasks.

  • Professional demeanor with a positive, solutions-oriented approach.

  • Exceptional organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and proven ability to manage competing priorities simultaneously.

  • Prior administrative or operational experience within an entertainment company or studio setting strongly preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) from an accredited university preferred.


Allen Media Group is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these characteristics. We are dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination.

job.title: Brand Director
job.description:
Description

  

About Us:

Weigel Broadcasting Co. is a family-owned media company based in Chicago, Illinois. The company owns and operates national television networks, as well as local broadcast stations throughout the country. Weigel is a leader in broadcast television with MeTV, Memorable Entertainment Television, the number one rated classic TV entertainment network, as well as the Catchy Comedy Network, the H&I - Heroes & Icons Network, the Story Television Network and WEST- Western Entertainment Series Television Network, plus the Movies! Network in cooperation with the Fox Television Stations, the Start TV Network and the Dabl Network in association with the CBS Television Stations, and the MeTV Toons Network in collaboration with Warner Bros. Discovery. Weigel produces the original network TV programs Svengoolie, Toon In With Me and Collector’s Call. Weigel's local stations include CBS, ABC, MeTV, The CW, MyNet, Telemundo and Univision network affiliates and independent stations, offering a mix of entertainment programming, local news and professional and college sports broadcasts in more than 30 U.S. markets including New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago. Weigel is the creator of the nationally syndicated music format MeTV FM. For more information on Weigel, visit: https://www.weigelbroadcasting.com/.


Brand Director:

Weigel Broadcasting in Chicago, IL is seeking an exceptional leader to drive promotional strategy and creative production across the Weigel networks.


About the Role 

· Collaborate with leadership to align creative strategy with ratings and brand growth objectives

· Maintain and evolve creative standards, workflows, and best practices across the department
 

What You’ll Do 

· Demonstrate detailed knowledge of Weigel network’s brand identities, ensuring consistency across all consumer touchpoints

· Manage all aspects of the Promotions team assignments, deadlines and performance

· Partner cross-functionally to coordinate on log formatting needs and timelines, ensuring consistent consumer awareness and promotion across the networks

· Write, produce, and edit quality creative material for Weigel’s platforms, setting the standard related to the brand presentation of the Weigel networks

· Provide your team with feedback and guidance on all aspects of day-to-day tasks and core job functions

· Align with the VP of Network Marketing on assisting in shaping seasonal, tentpole, franchise, and network-wide promotional initiatives

· Spearhead recruiting, developing, and retaining top creative talent

· Perform additional duties as assigned


What You’ll Bring 

· Management experience with an emphasis on top to bottom execution from inception to delivery on all tasks assigned to you and your team

· Awareness of competitive TV landscape with an emphasis on linear television

· Strategic mindset that connects creative execution with business objectives

· Strong editorial judgment and attention to brand consistency

· Must have strong leadership skills


If you have what we are looking for, please apply with your resume and cover letter.


What We Offer:

job.title: Accounts Payable Assistant
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Position Overview
The Accounts Payable Travel Assistant is a hands-on operational role responsible for keeping TKO's travel-related payables running smoothly and accurately. This position owns the day-to-day processing of invoices and vendor payments, partners closely with the Travel and Finance teams to maintain tight controls and plays an active role in driving process improvements through automation.


Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end processing of travel-related invoices — including hotel commissions, airline invoices, and travel agency billing — from receipt through payment.
  • Code and route invoices accurately, ensuring proper allocation and timely approvals.
  • Verify invoices against purchase orders, receipts, and approvals; resolve discrepancies before they impact payment cycles.
  • Reconcile vendor accounts on a regular cadence and escalate aged or unresolved items promptly.
  • Monitor vendor payment schedules to ensure all invoices are settled on time and in accordance with agreed terms.
  • Maintain audit-ready financial records and documentation in line with compliance standards.
  • Act as the operational point of contact for travel vendors, handling payment inquiries and billing disputes efficiently.
  • Execute month-end close tasks, including reconciliations, accruals, and reporting, to meet finance deadlines.
  • Partner with the WWE Travel Department to support audits and spend analysis on travel-related costs.
  • Operate and help optimize AI-powered invoice automation tools, identifying manual bottlenecks and recommending process improvements.

Required Skills

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in accounts payable, travel administration, or a related accounting operations role.
  • Strong attention to detail with a process-oriented, organized approach to high-volume work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; comfort working with financial systems and automation tools.
  • Proven ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. The WWE has one of the largest and most engaged audiences in all of sports and entertainment globally. The Director of Membership Growth will lead the growth and optimization of a new digital membership product to serve that audience.

 

This role will own the growth strategy across acquisition, conversion, engagement, and retention, with a particular focus on maximizing WWE’s owned fan ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines strong growth and lifecycle marketing experience with commercial judgment and product sensibility. This person be comfortable using data and fan insights to identify growth opportunities, improve the member experience, and help shape the product roadmap. Previous experience in subscription, membership, ecommerce, loyalty, ticketing, sports, media, entertainment, or consumer products is a plus. 6+ years of relevant experience preferred, but open based on fit.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own membership subscription growth, including paid members, revenue, conversion, engagement, retention, and churn.
  • Develop and manage the growth strategy across CRM, email, SMS, web, app, social, live events, and other owned channels.
  • Build lifecycle strategies across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, renewal, retention, and win-back.
  • Partner with CRM and Data teams to develop audience segmentation and personalization strategies based on fan behavior, purchase history, engagement, geography, and interests.
  • Partner closely with Product and Technology to prioritize product improvements that drive growth and member value.
  • Use member behavior, feedback, and performance data to inform new features, benefits, and experiences.
  • Collaborate across Marketing, Creative, Ticketing, Ecommerce, Social, Content, Events, and Partnerships to maximize member acquisition and engagement opportunities.
  • Own membership forecasting, performance reporting, and senior leadership readouts, including key growth drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Establish repeatable processes and operating cadences for campaigns, renewals, benefit launches, event activations, and major WWE moments

Position Title: Manager, Membership Growth

Location: Los Angeles, CA (onsite)

I. Position Summary:

Manager of Membership Growth to help launch and scale a new digital membership product. This role will focus on converting a broad fan audience and large and growing waitlist into a paid membership base. The ideal candidate can build lifecycle campaigns, segment audiences, test messaging and offers, analyze performance, and coordinate cross-functionally to drive membership growth. This is primarily an owned-channel growth role, rather than a paid media role. Previous experience in subscription, membership, ecommerce, loyalty, ticketing, sports, media, entertainment, or consumer products is a plus. 2–5 years of relevant experience preferred, but open based on fit.

II. Core Responsibilities:

  • Own paid member growth for the digital membership product, with responsibility for converting waitlist users and owned fan audiences into new paid members

  • Build and manage lifecycle campaigns across email, SMS, web, app, landing pages, and other owned channels to support launch and ongoing membership growth

  • Partner with CRM and Data teams to segment audiences based on fan behavior, engagement, purchase history, geography, event interest, and stated preferences

  • Support launch planning and execution, including campaign calendars, audience sequencing, and testing plans

  • A/B test and optimize campaign messaging, subject lines, CTAs, offers, timing, landing pages, and conversion flows

  • Work closely with Product to identify and improve key funnel moments from waitlist sign-up to paid membership conversion

  • Collaborate with Creative and Marketing teams to develop campaign assets that clearly communicate membership benefits and drive action

  • Coordinate with Ticketing, Ecommerce, Social, Content, and CRM teams to maximize owned-channel promotion and conversion opportunities across digital touchpoints

  • Partner with Events, Marketing, and on-site teams to plan and execute live event activations that drive waitlist growth, paid member sign-ups, and fan engagement

  • Track funnel performance and prepare weekly readouts covering waitlist growth, email engagement, click-through rate, landing page conversion, checkout completion, paid member conversion, revenue, retention, key learnings, and next steps

  • Help establish repeatable growth processes for future membership campaigns, renewals, benefit drops, event pushes, and seasonal moments
